	public static class DockingStrategyRegistrator
	{
		public static void RegisterLayoutPanelStrategy()
		{
			StrategyManager.Default.RegisterStrategy<LayoutPanel, LayoutPanelStrategy>();
		}

		public static void RegisterLayoutGroupStrategy()
		{
			StrategyManager.Default.RegisterStrategy<LayoutGroup, LayoutGroupStrategy<LayoutGroup, LayoutPanel, LayoutGroupWrapper>>();
		}

		public static void RegisterDocumentGroupStrategy()
		{
			StrategyManager.Default.RegisterStrategy<DocumentGroup, LayoutGroupStrategy<DocumentGroup, LayoutPanel, DocumentGroupWrapper>>();
		}

		public static void RegisterAutoHideGroupStrategy()
		{
			StrategyManager.Default.RegisterStrategy<AutoHideGroup, LayoutGroupStrategy<AutoHideGroup, LayoutPanel, AutoHideGroupWrapper>>();
		}
	}
	public class LayoutPanelWrapper : IContentPresenterWrapper<LayoutPanel>, ITargetWrapper<LayoutPanel>
	{
		public LayoutPanel Target { get; set; }

		public object Content
		{
			get
			{
				return Target.Content;
			}
			set
			{
				Target.Content = value;
			}
		}

		public DataTemplate ContentTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return Target.ContentTemplate;
			}
			set
			{
				Target.ContentTemplate = value;
			}
		}

		public DataTemplateSelector ContentTemplateSelector
		{
			get
			{
				return Target.ContentTemplateSelector;
			}
			set
			{
				Target.ContentTemplateSelector = value;
			}
		}
	}
	public class LayoutPanelStrategy : ContentPresenterStrategy<LayoutPanel, LayoutPanelWrapper>
	{
		protected override void InitializeCore()
		{
			base.InitializeCore();
			((CommonStrategyBase<LayoutPanel, LayoutPanelWrapper>)(object)this).Wrapper.Target.SetDataContextBinding = false;
		}
	}
	public abstract class LayoutGroupWrapperBase<TTarget, TChild> : ISelectorWrapper<TTarget>, IItemsControlWrapper<TTarget>, ITargetWrapper<TTarget> where TTarget : LayoutGroup where TChild : ContentItem
	{
		public class ChildClosingEventArgs : CancelEventArgs
		{
			public object ViewModel { get; private set; }

			public TChild Child { get; private set; }

			public ChildClosingEventArgs(object viewModel, TChild child)
			{
				ViewModel = viewModel;
				Child = child;
			}
		}

		private TTarget target;

		private DockLayoutManager manager;

		private ObservableCollection<object> itemsSource;

		private object selectedItem;

		private bool lockSelection;

		private readonly Dictionary<object, TChild> children;

		private bool focusOnSelectedItemChanged = true;

		public TTarget Target
		{
			get
			{
				return target;
			}
			set
			{
				if (target != value)
				{
					TTarget oldValue = target;
					target = value;
					OnTargetChanged(oldValue, target);
				}
			}
		}

		public IStrategyOwner Owner { get; set; }

		public DockLayoutManager Manager
		{
			get
			{
				if (manager == null)
				{
					UpdateManager();
				}
				return manager;
			}
			set
			{
				if (manager != value)
				{
					DockLayoutManager oldValue = manager;
					manager = value;
					OnManagerChanged(oldValue, manager);
				}
			}
		}

		public object ItemsSource
		{
			get
			{
				return itemsSource;
			}
			set
			{
				if (itemsSource != value)
				{
					ObservableCollection<object> oldValue = itemsSource;
					itemsSource = (ObservableCollection<object>)value;
					OnItemsSourceChanged(oldValue, itemsSource);
				}
			}
		}

		public object SelectedItem
		{
			get
			{
				return selectedItem;
			}
			set
			{
				object oldValue = selectedItem;
				selectedItem = value;
				OnSelectedItemChanged(oldValue, selectedItem);
			}
		}

		public DataTemplate ItemTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return Target.ItemContentTemplate;
			}
			set
			{
				Target.ItemContentTemplate = value;
			}
		}

		public DataTemplateSelector ItemTemplateSelector
		{
			get
			{
				return Target.ItemContentTemplateSelector;
			}
			set
			{
				Target.ItemContentTemplateSelector = value;
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler SelectionChanged;

		public event EventHandler<ChildClosingEventArgs> Closing;

		public LayoutGroupWrapperBase()
		{
			children = new Dictionary<object, TChild>();
		}

		public void SelectItem(object item, bool focus)
		{
			focusOnSelectedItemChanged = focus;
			SelectedItem = item;
			focusOnSelectedItemChanged = true;
		}

		protected virtual void OnTargetChanged(TTarget oldValue, TTarget newValue)
		{
			UpdateManager();
		}

		protected virtual void OnManagerChanged(DockLayoutManager oldValue, DockLayoutManager newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.DockItemActivated -= OnManagerDockItemActivated;
				oldValue.DockItemClosing -= OnManagerDockItemClosing;
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				newValue.DockItemActivated += OnManagerDockItemActivated;
				newValue.DockItemClosing += OnManagerDockItemClosing;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectedItemChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (newValue == null)
			{
				if (this.SelectionChanged != null && oldValue != newValue)
				{
					this.SelectionChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
				}
			}
			else if (children.ContainsKey(newValue))
			{
				TChild child = children[newValue];
				if (!lockSelection)
				{
					SelectChild(child);
				}
				if (this.SelectionChanged != null && oldValue != newValue)
				{
					this.SelectionChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
				}
			}
		}

		protected TChild GetChild(object viewModel)
		{
			if (!children.ContainsKey(viewModel))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return children[viewModel];
		}

		protected void ConfigureChild(TChild child, object viewModel)
		{
			string arg = Owner.RegionName ?? string.Empty;
			string key = Owner.GetKey(viewModel);
			string text = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(key)) ? $"{Target.GetType().Name}_{arg}_{key}" : null);
			if (text != null)
			{
				child.SetValue(FrameworkElement.NameProperty, text);
			}
			child.SetCurrentValue(FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty, viewModel);
			child.SetCurrentValue(ContentItem.ContentProperty, viewModel);
			child.SetCurrentValue(BaseLayoutItem.CaptionProperty, viewModel);
			Owner.ConfigureChild((DependencyObject)child);
		}

		protected void ClearChild(TChild child)
		{
			child.SetCurrentValue(FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty, null);
			child.SetCurrentValue(ContentItem.ContentProperty, null);
			child.SetCurrentValue(BaseLayoutItem.CaptionProperty, null);
		}

		protected virtual void SelectChild(TChild child)
		{
			if (Manager.DockController == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Manager.DockController.Restore(child);
			if (focusOnSelectedItemChanged)
			{
				Manager.DockController.Activate(child);
				if (Target.IsTabHost && !child.IsSelectedItem)
				{
					child.SetCurrentValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsSelectedItemProperty, true);
				}
			}
		}

		protected abstract TChild CreateChild(object viewModel);

		protected abstract void RemoveChild(TChild child);

		protected virtual void ClearChildren(IEnumerable<TChild> children)
		{
			foreach (TChild child in children)
			{
				RemoveChild(child);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void Add(object viewModel)
		{
			TChild value = CreateChild(viewModel);
			children.Add(viewModel, value);
		}

		protected virtual void Remove(object viewModel)
		{
			if (children.ContainsKey(viewModel))
			{
				RemoveChild(children[viewModel]);
				children.Remove(viewModel);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void Clear()
		{
			ClearChildren(children.Values);
			children.Clear();
		}

		private void UpdateManager()
		{
			if (Target == null)
			{
				Manager = null;
			}
			else if (manager == null)
			{
				Manager = Target.FindDockLayoutManager();
			}
		}

		private void OnManagerDockItemActivated(object sender, DockItemActivatedEventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (e.OldItem != null && e.OldItem is TChild && children.ContainsValue((TChild)e.OldItem) && e.Item == null)
			{
				flag = SelectedItem == children.GetKeyByValue((TChild)e.OldItem);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				lockSelection = true;
				SelectedItem = null;
				lockSelection = false;
			}
			else if (e.Item is TChild && children.ContainsValue((TChild)e.Item))
			{
				lockSelection = true;
				SelectedItem = children.GetKeyByValue((TChild)e.Item);
				lockSelection = false;
			}
		}

		private void OnManagerDockItemClosing(object sender, ItemCancelEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Item == null || e.Handled)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (e.Item is LayoutGroup layoutGroup)
			{
				(from x in layoutGroup.GetNestedItems().OfType<TChild>()
					where children.ContainsValue(x)
					select x).ForEach(delegate(TChild x)
				{
					Manager.DockController.Close(x);
				});
			}
			if (e.Item is TChild && children.ContainsValue((TChild)e.Item) && DockControllerHelper.GetActualClosingBehavior(Manager, e.Item) == ClosingBehavior.ImmediatelyRemove)
			{
				object keyByValue = children.GetKeyByValue((TChild)e.Item);
				ChildClosingEventArgs e2 = new ChildClosingEventArgs(keyByValue, (TChild)e.Item);
				if (this.Closing != null)
				{
					this.Closing(this, e2);
				}
				e.Cancel = e2.Cancel;
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private void OnItemsSourceChanged(ObservableCollection<object> oldValue, ObservableCollection<object> newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.CollectionChanged -= OnItemsSourceCollectionChanged;
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				newValue.CollectionChanged += OnItemsSourceCollectionChanged;
			}
		}

		private void OnItemsSourceCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move || e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace)
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset && itemsSource.Count == 0)
			{
				Clear();
				return;
			}
			if (e.NewItems != null)
			{
				foreach (object newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					Add(newItem);
				}
			}
			if (e.OldItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (object oldItem in e.OldItems)
			{
				Remove(oldItem);
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class LayoutGroupBaseWrapper<TTarget, TChild> : LayoutGroupWrapperBase<TTarget, TChild> where TTarget : LayoutGroup where TChild : LayoutPanel
	{
		private bool isFirstAdding = true;

		protected override TChild CreateChild(object viewModel)
		{
			TChild val = (TChild)new LayoutPanel();
			ConfigureChild(val, viewModel);
			base.Target.Add(val);
			base.Target.PrepareContainerForItemCore(val);
			return val;
		}

		protected override void RemoveChild(TChild child)
		{
			if (base.Manager.DockController != null)
			{
				base.Manager.DockController.RemovePanel(child);
				ClearChild(child);
			}
		}

		protected override void Add(object viewModel)
		{
			base.Add(viewModel);
			if (isFirstAdding && base.SelectedItem == null && base.Target.IsLoaded)
			{
				UpdateSelectionOnItemAdded(viewModel);
				isFirstAdding = false;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateSelectionOnItemAdded(object viewModel)
		{
			base.SelectedItem = viewModel;
		}
	}
	public class LayoutGroupWrapper : LayoutGroupBaseWrapper<LayoutGroup, LayoutPanel>
	{
	}
	public class DocumentGroupWrapper : LayoutGroupBaseWrapper<DocumentGroup, LayoutPanel>
	{
		protected override LayoutPanel CreateChild(object viewModel)
		{
			LayoutPanel layoutPanel = (LayoutPanel)base.Target.GetContainerForItem(viewModel);
			ConfigureChild(layoutPanel, viewModel);
			base.Target.PrepareContainerForItemCore(layoutPanel);
			base.Target.Add(layoutPanel);
			return layoutPanel;
		}
	}
	public class AutoHideGroupWrapper : LayoutGroupBaseWrapper<AutoHideGroup, LayoutPanel>
	{
		protected override void UpdateSelectionOnItemAdded(object viewModel)
		{
		}
	}
	public class LayoutGroupStrategy<TTarget, TChild, TWrapper> : SelectorStrategy<TTarget, TWrapper> where TTarget : LayoutGroup where TChild : ContentItem where TWrapper : LayoutGroupWrapperBase<TTarget, TChild>, new()
	{
		protected override void InitializeCore()
		{
			((SelectorStrategy<TTarget, ?>)(object)this).InitializeCore();
			((CommonStrategyBase<TTarget, ?>)(object)this).Wrapper.Owner = ((BaseStrategy<TTarget>)(object)this).Owner;
			((CommonStrategyBase<TTarget, ?>)(object)this).Wrapper.Closing += OnItemClosing;
		}

		protected override void UninitializeCore()
		{
			((CommonStrategyBase<TTarget, ?>)(object)this).Wrapper.Closing -= OnItemClosing;
			((CommonStrategyBase<TTarget, ?>)(object)this).Wrapper.Owner = null;
			((SelectorStrategy<TTarget, ?>)(object)this).UninitializeCore();
		}

		protected override void OnSelectedViewModelPropertyChanged(object oldValue, object newValue, bool focus)
		{
			((BaseStrategy<TTarget>)(object)this).Owner.SelectViewModel(newValue);
			if (((CommonStrategyBase<TTarget, ?>)(object)this).Wrapper != null)
			{
				((CommonStrategyBase<TTarget, ?>)(object)this).Wrapper.SelectItem(newValue, focus);
			}
		}

		private void OnItemClosing(object sender, LayoutGroupWrapperBase<TTarget, TChild>.ChildClosingEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!((BaseStrategy<TTarget>)(object)this).Owner.CanRemoveViewModel(e.ViewModel))
			{
				e.Cancel = true;
				return;
			}
			((BaseStrategy<TTarget>)(object)this).Owner.RemoveViewModel(e.ViewModel);
			((IStrategy)this).Remove(e.ViewModel);
		}

		public LayoutGroupStrategy()
		{
			((SelectorStrategy<TTarget, ?>)(object)this)..ctor();
		}
	}
}

	public class PreloadProvider : IPreloadSupport
	{
		IEnumerable<FrameworkElement> IPreloadSupport.GetConfiguredTree()
		{
			DockLayoutManager obj = new DockLayoutManager
			{
				DockingStyle = DockingStyle.VS2010,
				FloatingMode = FloatingMode.Desktop
			};
			LayoutGroup layoutGroup = new LayoutGroup();
			BaseLayoutItemCollection items = layoutGroup.Items;
			DocumentGroup obj2 = new DocumentGroup
			{
				Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal,
				Items = 
				{
					(BaseLayoutItem)new DocumentPanel
					{
						ItemWidth = new GridLength(1.0, GridUnitType.Pixel),
						Caption = "Panel 1"
					},
					(BaseLayoutItem)new DocumentPanel
					{
						ItemWidth = new GridLength(2.0, GridUnitType.Pixel),
						Caption = "Panel 2"
					}
				}
			};
			BaseLayoutItemCollection items2 = obj2.Items;
			DocumentPanel obj3 = new DocumentPanel
			{
				ItemWidth = new GridLength(1.0, GridUnitType.Auto),
				Caption = "Panel 3"
			};
			DXBorder val = new DXBorder();
			((FrameworkElement)val).Width = 50.0;
			((FrameworkElement)val).Height = 50.0;
			obj3.Content = (object)val;
			items2.Add(obj3);
			items.Add(obj2);
			BaseLayoutItemCollection items3 = layoutGroup.Items;
			DocumentGroup obj4 = new DocumentGroup
			{
				Orientation = Orientation.Vertical,
				Items = 
				{
					(BaseLayoutItem)new DocumentPanel
					{
						ItemWidth = new GridLength(1.0, GridUnitType.Pixel),
						Caption = "Panel 1",
						ShowBorder = true
					},
					(BaseLayoutItem)new DocumentPanel
					{
						ItemWidth = new GridLength(2.0, GridUnitType.Pixel),
						Caption = "Panel 2",
						ShowBorder = false
					}
				}
			};
			BaseLayoutItemCollection items4 = obj4.Items;
			DocumentPanel obj5 = new DocumentPanel
			{
				ItemWidth = new GridLength(1.0, GridUnitType.Auto),
				Caption = "Panel 3"
			};
			DXBorder val2 = new DXBorder();
			((FrameworkElement)val2).Width = 50.0;
			((FrameworkElement)val2).Height = 50.0;
			obj5.Content = (object)val2;
			items4.Add(obj5);
			items3.Add(obj4);
			BaseLayoutItemCollection items5 = layoutGroup.Items;
			TabbedGroup obj6 = new TabbedGroup
			{
				Items = 
				{
					(BaseLayoutItem)new LayoutPanel
					{
						ItemWidth = new GridLength(1.0, GridUnitType.Pixel),
						Caption = "Panel 1"
					},
					(BaseLayoutItem)new LayoutPanel
					{
						ItemWidth = new GridLength(2.0, GridUnitType.Pixel),
						Caption = "Panel 2"
					}
				}
			};
			BaseLayoutItemCollection items6 = obj6.Items;
			LayoutPanel obj7 = new LayoutPanel
			{
				ItemWidth = new GridLength(1.0, GridUnitType.Auto),
				Caption = "Panel 3"
			};
			DXBorder val3 = new DXBorder();
			((FrameworkElement)val3).Width = 50.0;
			((FrameworkElement)val3).Height = 50.0;
			obj7.Content = (object)val3;
			items6.Add(obj7);
			items5.Add(obj6);
			obj.LayoutRoot = layoutGroup;
			obj.ClosedPanels.Add(new LayoutPanel
			{
				Caption = "Closed Panel"
			});
			obj.FloatGroups.Add(new FloatGroup
			{
				Items = { (BaseLayoutItem)new LayoutPanel
				{
					Caption = "Float Panel"
				} }
			});
			yield return obj;
		}
	}

	[DXToolboxBrowsable(false)]
	public class ClosedItemsPanel : BarContainerControl, IDisposable
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty DockProperty;

		private DockLayoutManager container;

		[Obsolete("Use BarManager.Bars property instead.")]
		public ItemCollection Items => null;

		public bool IsDisposing { get; private set; }

		public BarManagerCategory Category { get; private set; }

		public DockLayoutManager Container
		{
			get
			{
				return container ?? DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager((DependencyObject)(object)this);
			}
			set
			{
				container = value;
			}
		}

		public Dock Dock
		{
			get
			{
				return (Dock)((DependencyObject)this).GetValue(DockProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)this).SetValue(DockProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		static ClosedItemsPanel()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<ClosedItemsPanel> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<ClosedItemsPanel>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("Dock", ref DockProperty, Dock.Top, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs ea)
			{
				((ClosedItemsPanel)(object)dObj).OnDockChanged((Dock)ea.OldValue, (Dock)ea.NewValue);
			});
		}

		public ClosedItemsPanel()
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Category = new BarManagerCategory
			{
				Name = DockingLocalizer.GetString(DockingStringId.ClosedPanelsCategory)
			};
			((FrameworkElement)this).Unloaded += OnUnloaded;
			FrameworkElementHelper.SetAllowDrop((FrameworkElement)(object)this, false);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (!IsDisposing)
			{
				IsDisposing = true;
				((FrameworkElement)this).Unloaded -= OnUnloaded;
				if (Container != null && !Container.IsDisposing)
				{
					Container.CustomizationController.ClosedItemsBar?.UpdatePanel(null);
				}
				BarManagerPropertyHelper.ClearBarManager((DependencyObject)(object)this);
			}
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		public void SetBarManager(BarManager manager)
		{
			BarManagerPropertyHelper.SetBarManager((DependencyObject)(object)this, manager);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			((BarContainerControl)this).OnApplyTemplate();
			Container = DockLayoutManager.FindManager((DependencyObject)(object)this);
			if (Container == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("Container");
			}
			if (Container.IsDisposing)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("The panel is used while its container's dispose operation is in progress.");
			}
			if (Container.CustomizationController == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("CustomizationController");
			}
			Container.CustomizationController.ClosedItemsBar?.UpdatePanel(this);
		}

		protected override void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			((BarContainerControl)this).OnLoaded(sender, e);
			if (Container != null && !Container.IsDisposing)
			{
				Container.CustomizationController.UpdateClosedItemsBar();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Container != null && !Container.IsDisposing)
			{
				ClosedItemsBar closedItemsBar = Container.CustomizationController.ClosedItemsBar;
				if (closedItemsBar != null)
				{
					Container.CustomizationController.HideClosedItemsBar();
					closedItemsBar.UpdatePanel(null);
				}
			}
			BarManagerPropertyHelper.ClearBarManager((DependencyObject)(object)this);
		}

		public void OnDockChanged(Dock oldValue, Dock newValue)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DockPanel.SetDock((UIElement)(object)this, newValue);
			((BarContainerControl)this).ContainerType = newValue.ToBarContainerType();
			if (Container != null && Container.CustomizationController.ClosedItemsBar != null)
			{
				ClosedItemsBar closedItemsBar = Container.CustomizationController.ClosedItemsBar;
				((Bar)closedItemsBar).DockInfo.ContainerType = newValue.ToBarContainerType();
				closedItemsBar.InvalidateContainerName();
			}
		}
	}
	public class ClosedItemsBar : Bar
	{
		private ClosedItemsPanel panel;

		public DockLayoutManager Container { get; private set; }

		public ClosedItemsPanel Panel
		{
			get
			{
				return panel;
			}
			private set
			{
				if (value != panel)
				{
					ClosedItemsPanel oldValue = panel;
					panel = value;
					OnPanelChanged(oldValue);
				}
			}
		}

		protected ClosedItemsBarInfo BarInfo { get; private set; }

		public ClosedItemsBar(ClosedItemsPanel panel)
		{
			Container = panel.Container;
			UpdatePanel(panel);
			((Bar)this).Caption = Panel.Category.Name;
			((Bar)this).UseWholeRow = (DefaultBoolean)0;
			((Bar)this).AllowQuickCustomization = (DefaultBoolean)1;
			((Bar)this).AllowCustomizationMenu = false;
			((Bar)this).ShowDragWidget = false;
			Container.LockClosedPanelsVisibility();
			try
			{
				((BarItemLinkHolderBase)this).Visible = false;
			}
			finally
			{
				Container.UnlockClosedPanelsVisibility();
			}
			CheckCategory();
			MergingProperties.SetElementMergingBehavior((DependencyObject)(object)this, (ElementMergingBehavior)1);
		}

		protected internal void UpdatePanel(ClosedItemsPanel panel)
		{
			if (panel == null)
			{
				((Bar)this).DockInfo.Reset();
				ClearItems();
			}
			Panel = panel;
		}

		protected void EnsureBarInfo()
		{
			if (BarInfo == null)
			{
				BarInfo = CreateBarInfo(Container);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnVisibleChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((Bar)this).DockInfo.ContainerName = (((bool)e.NewValue) ? ((FrameworkElement)(object)Panel).Name : null);
			((Bar)this).OnVisibleChanged(e);
			if (!Container.IsClosedPanelsVisibilityLocked && Container.ClosedPanelsBarVisibility == ClosedPanelsBarVisibility.Auto)
			{
				Container.ClosedPanelsBarVisibility = ClosedPanelsBarVisibility.Manual;
			}
		}

		public void UpdateItems(IList items)
		{
			EnsureBarInfo();
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in items)
			{
				BarItem link = GetLink(item);
				if (link != null)
				{
					((Collection<IBarItem>)(object)((BarItemLinkHolderBase)this).Items).Remove((IBarItem)(object)link);
				}
				BarInfo.CreateBarButtonItem(item);
			}
		}

		public void AddItems(IList items)
		{
			EnsureBarInfo();
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in items)
			{
				if (GetLink(item) == null)
				{
					BarInfo.CreateBarButtonItem(item);
				}
			}
		}

		public void ClearItems()
		{
			EnsureBarInfo();
			IBarItem[] array = (IBarItem[])(object)new IBarItem[((Collection<IBarItem>)(object)((BarItemLinkHolderBase)this).Items).Count];
			((Collection<IBarItem>)(object)((BarItemLinkHolderBase)this).Items).CopyTo(array, 0);
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				((Collection<IBarItem>)(object)((BarItemLinkHolderBase)this).Items).Remove(array[i]);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveItems(IList items)
		{
			EnsureBarInfo();
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in items)
			{
				BarItem link = GetLink(item);
				if (link != null)
				{
					((Collection<IBarItem>)(object)((BarItemLinkHolderBase)this).Items).Remove((IBarItem)(object)link);
				}
			}
		}

		public void ResetItems(IList items)
		{
			ClearItems();
			AddItems(items);
		}

		protected virtual void OnPanelChanged(ClosedItemsPanel oldValue)
		{
			((Bar)this).DockInfo.Container = (BarContainerControl)(object)Panel;
		}

		public BarButtonItem CreateBarButtonItem(object content)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = content as BaseLayoutItem;
			BarButtonItem val = new BarButtonItem
			{
				CategoryName = Panel.Category.Name,
				Glyph = baseLayoutItem.CaptionImage
			};
			BindingHelper.SetBinding((DependencyObject)(object)val, BarItem.ContentProperty, baseLayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem.ActualCustomizationCaptionProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding((DependencyObject)(object)val, BarItem.ContentTemplateProperty, baseLayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem.ActualCustomizationCaptionTemplateProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding((DependencyObject)(object)val, BarItem.ContentTemplateSelectorProperty, baseLayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem.ActualCustomizationCaptionTemplateSelectorProperty);
			((FrameworkContentElement)(object)val).Tag = baseLayoutItem;
			((Collection<IBarItem>)(object)((BarItemLinkHolderBase)this).Items).Add((IBarItem)(object)val);
			return val;
		}

		private BarItem GetLink(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			foreach (BarItem item2 in (Collection<IBarItem>)(object)((BarItemLinkHolderBase)this).Items)
			{
				BarItem val = item2;
				if (((FrameworkContentElement)(object)val).Tag == item)
				{
					return val;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected void CheckCategory()
		{
			BarManager barManager = BarManager.GetBarManager((DependencyObject)(object)this);
			if (barManager != null && !((Collection<BarManagerCategory>)(object)barManager.Categories).Contains(Panel.Category))
			{
				((Collection<BarManagerCategory>)(object)barManager.Categories).Add(Panel.Category);
			}
		}

		protected virtual ClosedItemsBarInfo CreateBarInfo(DockLayoutManager container)
		{
			return new ClosedItemsBarInfo(this, container);
		}

		internal void InvalidateContainerName()
		{
			((Bar)this).DockInfo.ContainerName = null;
			((Bar)this).DockInfo.ContainerName = ((Panel != null && ((BarItemLinkHolderBase)this).Visible) ? ((FrameworkElement)(object)Panel).Name : null);
		}
	}
	public class ClosedItemsBarInfo
	{
		public ClosedItemsBar Bar { get; private set; }

		public DockLayoutManager Container { get; private set; }

		public ClosedItemsBarInfo(ClosedItemsBar bar, DockLayoutManager container)
		{
			Bar = bar;
			Container = container;
		}

		public void CreateBarButtonItem(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			CreateBarButtonItem(item, DockControllerCommand.Restore);
		}

		protected virtual BarButtonItem CreateBarButtonItem(object content, ICommand command)
		{
			BarButtonItem val = Bar.CreateBarButtonItem(content);
			CustomizationControllerHelper.AssignCommand((BarItem)(object)val, command, Container);
			((BarItem)val).CommandParameter = content;
			return val;
		}
	}

		protected void CreateStandardCustomizationMenuItems(bool beginGroup)
		{
			if (beginGroup)
			{
				CreateBarItemLinkSeparator(MenuItems.CustomizationOperationsSeparator);
			}
			CreateBarButtonItem(MenuItems.EndCustomization, beginGroup: false, CustomizationControllerHelper.CreateCommand<EndCustomizationCommand>(Menu.Container));
			if (Menu.Container.CustomizationController.IsCustomizationFormVisible)
			{
				CreateBarButtonItem(MenuItems.HideCustomizationWindow, beginGroup: false, CustomizationControllerHelper.CreateCommand<HideCustomizationFormCommand>(Menu.Container));
			}
			else
			{
				CreateBarButtonItem(MenuItems.ShowCustomizationWindow, beginGroup: false, CustomizationControllerHelper.CreateCommand<ShowCustomizationFormCommand>(Menu.Container));
			}
		}

		protected void CreateBeginCustomizationMenuItem(bool beginGroup)
		{
			if (Menu.Container.AllowCustomization)
			{
				if (beginGroup)
				{
					CreateBarItemLinkSeparator(MenuItems.CustomizationOperationsSeparator);
				}
				CreateBarButtonItem(MenuItems.BeginCustomization, beginGroup: false, CustomizationControllerHelper.CreateCommand<BeginCustomizationCommand>(Menu.Container));
			}
		}

		}

		public override void Uninitialize()

		private void ExecuteItemCustomizations()
		{
			BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = ((((Popup)(object)Menu).PlacementTarget != null) ? ((((Popup)(object)Menu).PlacementTarget as BaseLayoutItem) ?? DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(((Popup)(object)Menu).PlacementTarget)) : null);

			foreach (IControllerAction action in baseLayoutItem.ContextMenuActionGroup.Actions)
			{
				(action as DependencyObject).Do(delegate(DependencyObject x)
				{
					BarManagerHelper.SetLinksHolder(x, (ILinksHolder)(object)Menu);
				});
			}
			((IControllerAction)baseLayoutItem.ContextMenuActionGroup).Execute((DependencyObject)(object)Menu);
		}

		private void UninitializeItemCustomizations()
		{
			BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = ((((Popup)(object)Menu).PlacementTarget != null) ? ((((Popup)(object)Menu).PlacementTarget as BaseLayoutItem) ?? DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(((Popup)(object)Menu).PlacementTarget)) : null);
			if (baseLayoutItem == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			((DependencyObject)(object)baseLayoutItem.ContextMenuActionGroup).ClearValue(BarManagerHelper.LinksHolderProperty);
			foreach (IControllerAction action in baseLayoutItem.ContextMenuActionGroup.Actions)
			{
				(action as DependencyObject).Do(delegate(DependencyObject x)
				{
					x.ClearValue(BarManagerHelper.LinksHolderProperty);
				});
			}
		}

	public class ItemContextMenuInfo : ItemContextMenuInfoBase
	{
		public ItemContextMenu ItemMenu => base.Menu as ItemContextMenu;

		public override BarManagerMenuController MenuController => base.Menu.With((BaseLayoutElementMenu x) => x.Container).With((DockLayoutManager x) => x.CustomizationController).With((ICustomizationController x) => x.ItemContextMenuController);

		public ItemContextMenuInfo(ItemContextMenu menu, BaseLayoutItem item)
			: base(menu, item)
		{
		}

		protected override void CreateItems()
		{
			DockLayoutManager container = ItemMenu.Container;
			bool isFloating = base.Item.IsFloating;
			bool isAutoHidden = base.Item.IsAutoHidden;
			if (!LayoutItemsHelper.IsDataBound(base.Item) || !DockLayoutManagerParameters.CheckLayoutGroupIsUsingItemsSource)
			{
				ClosingBehavior actualClosingBehavior = DockControllerHelper.GetActualClosingBehavior(container, base.Item);
				CreateBarCheckItem(MenuItems.Dockable, !isFloating && !isAutoHidden, beginGroup: false, DockControllerHelper.CreateCommand<DockCommand>(container, base.Item));
				CreateBarCheckItem(MenuItems.Floating, isFloating, beginGroup: false, DockControllerHelper.CreateCommand<FloatCommand>(container, base.Item));
				CreateBarCheckItem(MenuItems.AutoHide, isAutoHidden, beginGroup: false, DockControllerHelper.CreateCommand<HideCommand>(container, base.Item));
				CreateBarButtonItem((actualClosingBehavior == ClosingBehavior.ImmediatelyRemove) ? MenuItems.Close : MenuItems.Hide, beginGroup: false, DockControllerHelper.CreateCommand<CloseCommand>(container, base.Item));
				LayoutGroup parent = base.Item.Parent;
				if (parent != null && parent.ItemType == LayoutItemType.DocumentPanelGroup)
				{
					CreateBarButtonItem(MenuItems.CloseAllButThis, beginGroup: false, DockControllerHelper.CreateCommand<CloseAllButThisCommand>(container, base.Item));
					CreateBarItemLinkSeparator(MenuItems.TabOperationsSeparator);
					CreateBarCheckItem(MenuItems.PinTab, DocumentGroup.GetPinned(base.Item), beginGroup: false, DockControllerHelper.CreateCommand<PinTabCommand>(container, base.Item));
					bool flag = DockControllerHelper.GetPreviousNotEmptyDocumentGroup(parent) != null;
					bool flag2 = DockControllerHelper.GetNextNotEmptyDocumentGroup(parent) != null;
					if (flag2 || flag || parent.Items.Count > 1)
					{
						CreateBarItemLinkSeparator(MenuItems.DocumentHostOperationsSeparator);
					}
					if (parent.Items.Count > 1)
					{
						bool flag3 = true;
						bool flag4 = true;
						if (flag || flag2)
						{
							flag3 = parent.Parent != null && parent.Parent.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal;
							flag4 = !flag3;
						}
						if (flag4)
						{
							CreateBarButtonItem(MenuItems.NewHorizontalTabbedGroup, beginGroup: false, DockControllerHelper.CreateCommand<NewVerticalDocumentGroupCommand>(container, base.Item));
						}
						if (flag3)
						{
							CreateBarButtonItem(MenuItems.NewVerticalTabbedGroup, beginGroup: false, DockControllerHelper.CreateCommand<NewHorizontalDocumentGroupCommand>(container, base.Item));
						}
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						CreateBarButtonItem(MenuItems.MoveToPreviousTabGroup, beginGroup: false, DockControllerHelper.CreateCommand<MoveToPreviousDocumentGroupCommand>(container, base.Item));
					}
					if (flag2)
					{
						CreateBarButtonItem(MenuItems.MoveToNextTabGroup, beginGroup: false, DockControllerHelper.CreateCommand<MoveToNextDocumentGroupCommand>(container, base.Item));
					}
				}
			}
			if (base.Item is LayoutPanel && ((LayoutPanel)base.Item).Content is LayoutGroup)
			{
				if (container.IsCustomization)
				{
					CreateStandardCustomizationMenuItems(beginGroup: true);
					if (container.RenameHelper.CanRename(base.Item))
					{
						CreateBarButtonItem(MenuItems.Rename, beginGroup: false, LayoutControllerHelper.CreateCommand<RenameCommand>(base.Menu.Container, new BaseLayoutItem[1] { base.Item }));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					CreateBeginCustomizationMenuItem(beginGroup: true);
				}
			}
			if (base.Menu.Container.CustomizationController.ClosedPanelsBarVisibility != ClosedPanelsBarVisibility.Never)
			{
				CreateBarItemLinkSeparator(MenuItems.ClosedPanelsSeparator);
				if (base.Menu.Container.ClosedPanels.Count > 0 || base.Menu.Container.CustomizationController.IsClosedPanelsVisible)
				{
					CreateBarCheckItem(MenuItems.ClosedPanels, base.Menu.Container.CustomizationController.IsClosedPanelsVisible, beginGroup: false, CustomizationControllerHelper.CreateCommand(ItemMenu.Container));
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public class ItemsSelectorMenuInfo : BaseLayoutElementMenuInfo
	{
		public BaseLayoutItem[] Items { get; private set; }

		public ItemsSelectorMenu ItemsMenu => base.Menu as ItemsSelectorMenu;

		public override BarManagerMenuController MenuController => base.Menu.With((BaseLayoutElementMenu x) => x.Container).With((DockLayoutManager x) => x.CustomizationController).With((ICustomizationController x) => x.ItemsSelectorMenuController);

		public ItemsSelectorMenuInfo(ItemsSelectorMenu menu, BaseLayoutItem[] items)
			: base(menu)
		{
			Items = items;
		}

		protected override void CreateItems()
		{
			if (((MenuInfoBase)this).TargetElement is DependencyObject dependencyObject)
			{
				LayoutGroup layoutGroup = DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(dependencyObject) as LayoutGroup;
				bool flag = false;
				if (layoutGroup != null)
				{
					flag = layoutGroup.GetRoot().IsLayoutRoot;
					CreateMenuItemsForGroup(layoutGroup, flag);
				}
				else
				{
					CreateMenuItemsForElement(dependencyObject);
				}
				if (base.Menu.Container.CustomizationController.ClosedPanelsBarVisibility != ClosedPanelsBarVisibility.Never && (base.Menu.Container.ClosedPanels.Count > 0 || base.Menu.Container.CustomizationController.IsClosedPanelsVisible))
				{
					CreateBarCheckItem(MenuItems.ClosedPanels, base.Menu.Container.CustomizationController.IsClosedPanelsVisible, ((Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)((PopupMenu)base.Menu).ItemLinks).Count > 0, CustomizationControllerHelper.CreateCommand(ItemsMenu.Container));
				}
			}
		}

		private void CreateMenuItemsForElement(DependencyObject targetElement)
		{
			if (targetElement is AutoHideTray)
			{
				CreateMenuItems(Items);
			}
		}

		private void CreateMenuItemsForGroup(LayoutGroup group, bool isInLayout)
		{
			if (group == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = group.Parent == null;
			int num = 0;
			if (isInLayout)
			{
				if (base.Menu.Container.IsCustomization)
				{
					CreateStandardCustomizationMenuItems(beginGroup: false);
					if (!flag)
					{
						BaseLayoutItem[] array = base.Menu.Container.LayoutController.Selection.ToArray();
						bool? isChecked = LayoutControllerHelper.GetSameValue(BaseLayoutItem.ShowCaptionProperty, array, LayoutControllerHelper.BoolComparer) as bool?;
						bool? flag2 = LayoutControllerHelper.GetSameValue(BaseLayoutItem.HasCaptionProperty, array, LayoutControllerHelper.BoolComparer) as bool?;
						if (isChecked.HasValue && flag2.HasValue && flag2.Value)
						{
							CreateBarCheckItem(MenuItems.ShowCaption, isChecked, num++ == 0, LayoutControllerHelper.CreateCommand<ShowCaptionCommand>(base.Menu.Container, array));
						}
						if (group.GroupBorderStyle == GroupBorderStyle.Tabbed)
						{
							BarSubItem barSubItem = CreateBarSubItem(MenuItems.CaptionLocation, null, num++ == 0);
							CaptionLocation captionLocation = group.CaptionLocation;
							CreateBarCheckSubItem(barSubItem, MenuItems.Left, captionLocation == CaptionLocation.Left, LayoutControllerHelper.CreateCommand<CaptionLocationLeftCommand>(base.Menu.Container, array));
							CreateBarCheckSubItem(barSubItem, MenuItems.Right, captionLocation == CaptionLocation.Right, LayoutControllerHelper.CreateCommand<CaptionLocationRightCommand>(base.Menu.Container, array));
							CreateBarCheckSubItem(barSubItem, MenuItems.Top, captionLocation == CaptionLocation.Top || captionLocation == CaptionLocation.Default, LayoutControllerHelper.CreateCommand<CaptionLocationTopCommand>(base.Menu.Container, array));
							CreateBarCheckSubItem(barSubItem, MenuItems.Bottom, captionLocation == CaptionLocation.Bottom, LayoutControllerHelper.CreateCommand<CaptionLocationBottomCommand>(base.Menu.Container, array));
						}
						object sameValue = LayoutControllerHelper.GetSameValue(LayoutGroup.OrientationProperty, array, LayoutControllerHelper.CompareOrientation);
						bool flag3 = LayoutControllerHelper.HasOnlyGroups(array);
						if (flag3 && sameValue != null)
						{
							BarSubItem barSubItem2 = CreateBarSubItem(MenuItems.GroupOrientation, null, num++ == 0);
							Orientation orientation = (Orientation)sameValue;
							CreateBarCheckSubItem(barSubItem2, MenuItems.Horizontal, orientation == Orientation.Horizontal, LayoutControllerHelper.CreateCommand<GroupOrientationHorizontalCommand>(base.Menu.Container, array));
							CreateBarCheckSubItem(barSubItem2, MenuItems.Vertical, orientation == Orientation.Vertical, LayoutControllerHelper.CreateCommand<GroupOrientationVerticalCommand>(base.Menu.Container, array));
						}
						sameValue = LayoutControllerHelper.GetSameValue(LayoutGroup.GroupBorderStyleProperty, array, LayoutControllerHelper.CompareGroupBorderStyle);
						if (flag3 && sameValue != null)
						{
							BarSubItem barSubItem3 = CreateBarSubItem(MenuItems.Style, null, num++ == 0);
							GroupBorderStyle groupBorderStyle = (GroupBorderStyle)sameValue;
							CreateBarCheckSubItem(barSubItem3, MenuItems.StyleNoBorder, groupBorderStyle == GroupBorderStyle.NoBorder, LayoutControllerHelper.CreateCommand<SetStyleNoBorderCommand>(base.Menu.Container, array));
							CreateBarCheckSubItem(barSubItem3, MenuItems.StyleGroup, groupBorderStyle == GroupBorderStyle.Group, LayoutControllerHelper.CreateCommand<SetStyleGroupCommand>(base.Menu.Container, array));
							CreateBarCheckSubItem(barSubItem3, MenuItems.StyleGroupBox, groupBorderStyle == GroupBorderStyle.GroupBox, LayoutControllerHelper.CreateCommand<SetStyleGroupBoxCommand>(base.Menu.Container, array));
							CreateBarCheckSubItem(barSubItem3, MenuItems.StyleTabbed, groupBorderStyle == GroupBorderStyle.Tabbed, LayoutControllerHelper.CreateCommand<SetStyleTabbedCommand>(base.Menu.Container, array));
						}
						CreateBarButtonItem(MenuItems.HideItem, beginGroup: true, LayoutControllerHelper.CreateCommand<HideItemCommand>(base.Menu.Container, array));
						if (LayoutItemsHelper.AreInSameGroup(array))
						{
							CreateBarButtonItem(MenuItems.GroupItems, beginGroup: false, LayoutControllerHelper.CreateCommand<GroupCommand>(base.Menu.Container, array));
						}
						if (array.Length == 1)
						{
							CreateBarButtonItem(MenuItems.Ungroup, beginGroup: false, LayoutControllerHelper.CreateCommand<UngroupCommand>(base.Menu.Container, array));
						}
						if (base.Menu.Container.RenameHelper.CanRename(group))
						{
							CreateBarButtonItem(MenuItems.Rename, beginGroup: false, LayoutControllerHelper.CreateCommand<RenameCommand>(base.Menu.Container, new BaseLayoutItem[1] { group }));
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					CreateBeginCustomizationMenuItem(beginGroup: false);
				}
			}
			if (!flag && group.ItemType == LayoutItemType.Group && group.GroupBorderStyle == GroupBorderStyle.GroupBox)
			{
				CreateBarCheckItem(MenuItems.ExpandGroup, group.IsExpanded, beginGroup: false, DockControllerHelper.CreateCommand<ExpandCommand>(ItemsMenu.Container, group));
			}
			if (group.CanShowItemsInSelectorMenu())
			{
				CreateMenuItems(Items);
			}
		}

		private void CreateMenuItems(IEnumerable<BaseLayoutItem> items)
		{
			List<BaseLayoutItem> list = items.Where((BaseLayoutItem x) => x.IsVisibleCore).ToList();
			for (int num = 0; num < list.Count; num++)
			{
				BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = list[num];
				BarCheckItem val = CreateBarCheckItem(baseLayoutItem.CustomizationCaption, baseLayoutItem.IsSelectedItem, num == 0 && ((Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)((PopupMenu)ItemsMenu).ItemLinks).Count > 0, DockControllerHelper.CreateCommand<ActivateCommand>(ItemsMenu.Container, baseLayoutItem));
				((DependencyObject)(object)val).SetCurrentValue(FrameworkContentElement.TagProperty, (object)baseLayoutItem);
				BindingHelper.SetBinding((DependencyObject)(object)val, BarItem.ContentProperty, baseLayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem.ActualCustomizationCaptionProperty);
				FrameworkElementFactory frameworkElementFactory = new FrameworkElementFactory(typeof(ItemsSelectorMenuContentPresenter));
				frameworkElementFactory.SetValue(DockLayoutManager.LayoutItemProperty, new Binding
				{
					Source = baseLayoutItem
				});
				frameworkElementFactory.SetValue(ContentPresenter.ContentProperty, new Binding());
				frameworkElementFactory.SetValue(ContentPresenter.ContentTemplateProperty, new Binding
				{
					Path = new PropertyPath(BaseLayoutItem.ActualCustomizationCaptionTemplateProperty),
					Source = baseLayoutItem
				});
				frameworkElementFactory.SetValue(ContentPresenter.ContentTemplateSelectorProperty, new Binding
				{
					Path = new PropertyPath(BaseLayoutItem.ActualCustomizationCaptionTemplateSelectorProperty),
					Source = baseLayoutItem
				});
				DataTemplate dataTemplate = new DataTemplate
				{
					VisualTree = frameworkElementFactory
				};
				dataTemplate.Seal();
				((BarItem)val).ContentTemplate = dataTemplate;
			}
		}

		public override void Uninitialize()
		{
			((IEnumerable)((PopupMenu)base.Menu).Items).OfType<BarItem>().ForEach(delegate(BarItem x)
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)x).ClearValue(BarItem.ContentProperty);
				((DependencyObject)(object)x).ClearValue(BarItem.ContentTemplateProperty);
			});
			base.Uninitialize();
			Items = null;
		}
	}

	}

	public class ActiveItemHelper : IDisposable
	{
		private IActiveItemOwner Owner;

		private bool isDisposing;

		public ActiveItemHelper(IActiveItemOwner owner)
		{
			Owner = owner;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (!isDisposing)
			{
				isDisposing = true;
				Owner = null;
			}
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		public void ActivateItem(BaseLayoutItem item, bool focus)
		{
			if (item is LayoutGroup)
			{
				LayoutGroup layoutGroup = (LayoutGroup)item;
				item = ((Owner.ActiveItem != null && layoutGroup.GetNestedItems().Contains(Owner.ActiveItem)) ? Owner.ActiveItem : LayoutItemsHelper.GetFirstItemInGroup(layoutGroup));
			}
			Owner.ActiveItem = item;
			if (PopupMenuManager.TopPopup != null)
			{
				focus = false;
			}
			SelectInGroup(item, item.Parent);
			if (focus)
			{
				Owner.Container.FocusItem(item);
			}
		}

		public void SelectInGroup(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item.IsActive)
			{
				if (item is LayoutGroup)
				{
					item = LayoutItemsHelper.GetFirstItemInGroup((LayoutGroup)item);
				}
				if (item != null)
				{
					SelectInGroup(item, item.Parent);
				}
			}
		}

		public void SelectInGroup(BaseLayoutItem item, LayoutGroup group)
		{
			if (group == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DockLayoutManager container = ((Owner != null) ? Owner.Container : null);
			using (new LogicalTreeLocker(container, group.Parent ?? group))
			{
				TrySelectTabPage(item, group);
				TrySelectAutoHidePage(item, group);
			}
		}

		private void TrySelectAutoHidePage(BaseLayoutItem item, LayoutGroup group)
		{
			if (!(group is AutoHideGroup autoHideGroup))
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = autoHideGroup.Items.IndexOf(item);
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return;
			}
			AutoHideTray autoHideTray = LayoutItemsHelper.GetVisualChild<AutoHideTrayHeadersGroup>(group)?.Tray;
			using (autoHideTray?.LockExpanding())
			{
				if (autoHideGroup.SelectedTabIndex != num)
				{
					autoHideGroup.SelectedTabIndex = num;
				}
				if (autoHideTray != null && (!autoHideTray.IsExpanded || autoHideTray.HotItem != item))
				{
					autoHideTray.DoExpand(item);
				}
			}
		}

		private void TrySelectTabPage(BaseLayoutItem item, LayoutGroup group)
		{
			int num = group.Items.IndexOf(item);
			if (group.IsTabHost && num != -1 && group.SelectedTabIndex != num)
			{
				group.SelectedTabIndex = num;
			}
			while (group != null)
			{
				if (group.GroupBorderStyle == GroupBorderStyle.Tabbed)
				{
					group.SelectedTabIndex = group.Items.IndexOf(item);
				}
				item = group;
				group = group.Parent;
			}
		}

		internal void RestoreKeyboardFocus(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			KeyboardFocusHelper.RestoreKeyboardFocus(item);
		}
	}
	public static class DockControllerHelper
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ClosingBehaviorProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("ClosingBehavior", typeof(ClosingBehavior), typeof(DockControllerHelper), new PropertyMetadata(ClosingBehavior.Default));

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		internal static readonly DependencyProperty ForceSizeUpdateProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("ForceSizeUpdate", typeof(bool), typeof(DockControllerHelper));

		public static ClosingBehavior GetClosingBehavior(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (ClosingBehavior)obj.GetValue(ClosingBehaviorProperty);
		}

		public static void SetClosingBehavior(DependencyObject obj, ClosingBehavior value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(ClosingBehaviorProperty, value);
		}

		internal static bool GetForceSizeUpdate(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (bool)obj.GetValue(ForceSizeUpdateProperty);
		}

		internal static void SetForceSizeUpdate(DependencyObject obj, bool value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(ForceSizeUpdateProperty, value);
		}

		internal static bool InsertItemInGroup(LayoutGroup group, BaseLayoutItem item, int index, bool forceSizeUpdate = false)
		{
			bool flag = item.Parent == null || item.Parent.Remove(item);
			if (flag)
			{
				bool flag2 = !group.IgnoreOrientation && group.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal;
				GridLength gridLength = new GridLength(DockPreviewCalculator.GetStarDockSize(group), GridUnitType.Star);
				DockSituation lastDockSituation = item.GetLastDockSituation();
				if (lastDockSituation != null)
				{
					if (lastDockSituation.Width.IsAbsolute)
					{
						item.ItemWidth = lastDockSituation.Width;
					}
					if (lastDockSituation.Height.IsAbsolute)
					{
						item.ItemHeight = lastDockSituation.Height;
					}
					if (lastDockSituation.DockTarget == group && lastDockSituation.TheSameLengths(group))
					{
						gridLength = (flag2 ? lastDockSituation.Width : lastDockSituation.Height);
						forceSizeUpdate = true;
					}
				}
				GridLength gridLength2 = (flag2 ? item.ItemWidth : item.ItemHeight);
				if (!gridLength2.IsAuto)
				{
					if (!gridLength2.IsAbsolute)
					{
						if (forceSizeUpdate || GetForceSizeUpdate(item))
						{
							item.SetValue(flag2 ? BaseLayoutItem.ItemWidthProperty : BaseLayoutItem.ItemHeightProperty, gridLength);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						GridLength gridLength3 = (flag2 ? group.ItemWidth : group.ItemHeight);
						if (gridLength3.IsAbsolute && gridLength3.Value < gridLength2.Value * 1.5)
						{
							group.SetValue(value: new GridLength(gridLength3.Value + gridLength2.Value, GridUnitType.Pixel), dp: flag2 ? BaseLayoutItem.ItemWidthProperty : BaseLayoutItem.ItemHeightProperty);
						}
					}
				}
				group.Items.Insert(Math.Min(index, group.Items.Count), item);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		public static bool CheckHideView(DockLayoutManager container, LayoutGroup group)
		{
			if (container == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = group is AutoHideGroup;
			if (flag)
			{
				container.HideView(group);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		public static bool CheckUpdateView(DockLayoutManager container, LayoutGroup group)
		{
			if (container == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = group is FloatGroup || group is AutoHideGroup;
			if (flag)
			{
				container.InvalidateView(group);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		internal static LayoutGroup Unbox(DockLayoutManager container, LayoutGroup group, Action<LayoutGroup> beforeUnboxing, Action<LayoutGroup> afterUnboxing)
		{
			LayoutGroup parent = group.Parent;
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return UnboxAsRootGroup(group, beforeUnboxing);
			}
			BaseLayoutItem[] items = group.GetItems();
			bool flag = parent.IgnoreOrientation || parent.Orientation == group.Orientation;
			bool flag2 = parent.IsControlItemsHost == group.IsControlItemsHost;
			if ((flag || items.Length == 1) && flag2)
			{
				beforeUnboxing?.Invoke(group);
				UnboxCore(group, parent, items);
				afterUnboxing?.Invoke(group);
				CheckUpdateView(container, parent);
			}
			return parent;
		}

		public static LayoutGroup Unbox(DockLayoutManager container, LayoutGroup group)
		{
			return Unbox(container, group, null, null);
		}

		private static LayoutGroup UnboxAsRootGroup(LayoutGroup group, Action<LayoutGroup> beforeUnboxing)
		{
			if (group.Items.Count == 1 && !group.IsLayoutRoot)
			{
				LayoutGroup layoutGroup = group[0] as LayoutGroup;
				if (CanUnbox(group, layoutGroup))
				{
					if (beforeUnboxing != null)
					{
						beforeUnboxing(group);
						beforeUnboxing(layoutGroup);
					}
					if (group.Orientation != layoutGroup.Orientation)
					{
						group.Orientation = layoutGroup.Orientation;
					}
					UnboxCore(layoutGroup, group, layoutGroup.GetItems());
				}
			}
			return group;
		}

		private static bool CanUnbox(LayoutGroup group, LayoutGroup nestedGroup)
		{
			if (nestedGroup == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = nestedGroup.IsPermanent || nestedGroup.IsControlItemsHost || nestedGroup is TabbedGroup;
			return !flag;
		}

		private static void UnboxCore(LayoutGroup group, LayoutGroup behindGroup, BaseLayoutItem[] nestedItems)
		{
			using (behindGroup.LockVisualTree())
			{
				int num = behindGroup.Items.IndexOf(group);
				for (int i = 0; i < nestedItems.Length; i++)
				{
					group.Remove(nestedItems[i]);
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < nestedItems.Length; j++)
				{
					behindGroup.Insert(j + num, nestedItems[j]);
				}
				behindGroup.Items.Remove(group);
				group.IsUngroupped = true;
				if (behindGroup is FloatGroup && behindGroup.HasSingleItem)
				{
					UpdateFloatGroup(behindGroup[0], (FloatGroup)behindGroup);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void UpdateFloatGroup(BaseLayoutItem item, FloatGroup floatGroup)
		{
			ClearSize(item);
		}

		public static BaseLayoutItem[] Decompose(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			DockLayoutManager container = item.GetRoot().GetDockLayoutManager();
			List<BaseLayoutItem> panels = new List<BaseLayoutItem>();
			List<BaseLayoutItem> items = new List<BaseLayoutItem>();
			List<LayoutGroup> parents = new List<LayoutGroup>();
			item.Accept(delegate(BaseLayoutItem i)
			{
				items.Add(i);
				if (i is LayoutPanel)
				{
					panels.Add(i);
				}
				if (i is LayoutGroup)
				{
					parents.Add((LayoutGroup)i);
				}
			});
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item2 in items)
			{
				if (item2.Parent != null)
				{
					item2.Parent.Remove(item2);
				}
			}
			if (container != null)
			{
				parents.ForEach(delegate(LayoutGroup x)
				{
					if (x.ShouldStayInTree())
					{
						container.DecomposedItems.AddOnce(x);
					}
				});
			}
			return panels.ToArray();
		}

		public static IEnumerable<BaseLayoutItem> GetAffectedItems(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			List<BaseLayoutItem> panels = new List<BaseLayoutItem>();
			item.Accept(delegate(BaseLayoutItem x)
			{
				if (x is LayoutPanel)
				{
					panels.Add(x);
				}
			});
			return panels;
		}

		private static void ClearSize(BaseLayoutItem item, bool force = false)
		{
			if (force)
			{
				if (!item.ItemWidth.IsStar)
				{
					item.ClearValue(BaseLayoutItem.ItemWidthProperty);
				}
				if (!item.ItemHeight.IsStar)
				{
					item.ClearValue(BaseLayoutItem.ItemHeightProperty);
				}
			}
		}

		public static LayoutGroup BoxIntoGroup(BaseLayoutItem[] items, Orientation orientation)
		{
			LayoutGroup layoutGroup = new LayoutGroup
			{
				IsAutoGenerated = true
			};
			((ISupportInitialize)layoutGroup).BeginInit();
			layoutGroup.GroupBorderStyle = GroupBorderStyle.Group;
			layoutGroup.Orientation = orientation;
			((ISupportInitialize)layoutGroup).EndInit();
			BoxIntoGroupCore(items, layoutGroup);
			return layoutGroup;
		}

		private static void BoxIntoGroupCore(BaseLayoutItem[] items, LayoutGroup group)
		{
			group.ItemHeight = items[0].ItemHeight;
			group.ItemWidth = items[0].ItemWidth;
			group.AddRange(items);
		}

		private static void BoxIntoGroupCore(BaseLayoutItem item, LayoutGroup group)
		{
			group.ItemWidth = item.ItemWidth;
			group.ItemHeight = item.ItemHeight;
			ClearSize(item);
			group.Items.Add(item);
		}

		private static void DecomposeAndBoxIntoGroup(BaseLayoutItem item, LayoutGroup group)
		{
			group.ItemWidth = item.ItemWidth;
			group.ItemHeight = item.ItemHeight;
			ClearSize(item);
			group.AddRange(Decompose(item));
		}

		public static LayoutGroup BoxIntoGroup(BaseLayoutItem item, Orientation orientation, DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			LayoutGroup layoutGroup = manager.GenerateGroup<LayoutGroup>();
			layoutGroup.DockLayoutManagerCore = manager;
			((ISupportInitialize)layoutGroup).BeginInit();
			layoutGroup.Orientation = orientation;
			((ISupportInitialize)layoutGroup).EndInit();
			BoxIntoGroupCore(item, layoutGroup);
			return layoutGroup;
		}

		public static LayoutGroup BoxIntoGroup(BaseLayoutItem[] items, Orientation orientation, DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			LayoutGroup layoutGroup = manager.GenerateGroup<LayoutGroup>();
			((ISupportInitialize)layoutGroup).BeginInit();
			layoutGroup.GroupBorderStyle = GroupBorderStyle.Group;
			layoutGroup.Orientation = orientation;
			((ISupportInitialize)layoutGroup).EndInit();
			BoxIntoGroupCore(items, layoutGroup);
			return layoutGroup;
		}

		public static LayoutGroup BoxIntoGroup(BaseLayoutItem item, Orientation orientation, bool allowSplitters, DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			LayoutGroup layoutGroup = BoxIntoGroup(item, orientation, manager);
			if (!DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(layoutGroup))
			{
				layoutGroup.AllowSplitters = allowSplitters;
			}
			return layoutGroup;
		}

		internal static FloatGroup BoxIntoFloatGroup(DockLayoutManager container, BaseLayoutItem item, Rect floatingBounds)
		{
			FloatGroup floatGroup = container.GenerateGroup<FloatGroup>();
			((ISupportInitialize)floatGroup).BeginInit();
			floatGroup.DockLayoutManagerCore = container;
			floatGroup.Items.Add(item);
			floatGroup.FitSizeToContent(floatingBounds.Size);
			floatGroup.FloatLocation = floatingBounds.Location;
			((ISupportInitialize)floatGroup).EndInit();
			ClearSize(item, force: true);
			return floatGroup;
		}

		public static FloatGroup BoxIntoFloatGroup(BaseLayoutItem item, DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			FloatGroup floatGroup = manager.GenerateGroup<FloatGroup>();
			((ISupportInitialize)floatGroup).BeginInit();
			floatGroup.DockLayoutManagerCore = manager;
			floatGroup.Items.Add(item);
			Size screenSize = (MathHelper.IsEmpty(item.FloatSize) ? item.GetSize() : item.FloatSize);
			floatGroup.FitSizeToContent(screenSize);
			((ISupportInitialize)floatGroup).EndInit();
			ClearSize(item, force: true);
			return floatGroup;
		}

		public static TabbedGroup BoxIntoTabbedGroup(BaseLayoutItem item, DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			TabbedGroup tabbedGroup = manager.GenerateGroup<TabbedGroup>();
			((ISupportInitialize)tabbedGroup).BeginInit();
			BoxIntoGroupCore(item, tabbedGroup);
			((ISupportInitialize)tabbedGroup).EndInit();
			return tabbedGroup;
		}

		public static LayoutGroup BoxIntoDocumentHost(BaseLayoutItem item, DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			LayoutGroup layoutGroup = manager.GenerateGroup<LayoutGroup>();
			DocumentGroup documentGroup = manager.GenerateGroup<DocumentGroup>();
			((ISupportInitialize)layoutGroup).BeginInit();
			((ISupportInitialize)documentGroup).BeginInit();
			layoutGroup.DockLayoutManagerCore = manager;
			documentGroup.DockLayoutManagerCore = manager;
			DecomposeAndBoxIntoGroup(item, documentGroup);
			object value = item.GetValue(DocumentGroup.LastClosePageButtonShowModeInternalProperty);
			if (!object.Equals(value, ClosePageButtonShowMode.Default))
			{
				documentGroup.ClosePageButtonShowMode = (ClosePageButtonShowMode)value;
			}
			layoutGroup.Add(documentGroup);
			((ISupportInitialize)documentGroup).EndInit();
			((ISupportInitialize)layoutGroup).EndInit();
			return layoutGroup;
		}

		public static DocumentGroup BoxIntoDocumentGroup(BaseLayoutItem item, DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			DocumentGroup documentGroup = manager.GenerateGroup<DocumentGroup>();
			((ISupportInitialize)documentGroup).BeginInit();
			documentGroup.DockLayoutManagerCore = manager;
			DecomposeAndBoxIntoGroup(item, documentGroup);
			object value = item.GetValue(DocumentGroup.LastClosePageButtonShowModeInternalProperty);
			if (!object.Equals(value, ClosePageButtonShowMode.Default))
			{
				documentGroup.ClosePageButtonShowMode = (ClosePageButtonShowMode)value;
			}
			((ISupportInitialize)documentGroup).EndInit();
			return documentGroup;
		}

		public static AutoHideGroup BoxIntoAutoHideGroup(BaseLayoutItem item, Dock type, DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			AutoHideGroup autoHideGroup = manager.GenerateGroup<AutoHideGroup>();
			((ISupportInitialize)autoHideGroup).BeginInit();
			autoHideGroup.DockLayoutManagerCore = manager;
			autoHideGroup.DockType = type;
			if (item != null)
			{
				PlaceHolderHelper.DecomposeTo(item, autoHideGroup, out var decomposedGroups);
				decomposedGroups.ForEach(delegate(LayoutGroup x)
				{
					if (x.ShouldStayInTree())
					{
						manager.DecomposedItems.AddOnce(x);
					}
				});
				if (item is LayoutGroup)
				{
					AutoHideGroup.SetAutoHideType(autoHideGroup, AutoHideGroup.GetAutoHideType(item));
				}
				ClearSize(item);
			}
			((ISupportInitialize)autoHideGroup).EndInit();
			return autoHideGroup;
		}

		public static T CreateCommand<T>(DockLayoutManager container, BaseLayoutItem item) where T : DockControllerCommand, new()
		{
			IDockController dockController = GetDockController(container);
			if (dockController == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return dockController.CreateCommand<T>(item);
		}

		private static IDockController GetDockController(DockLayoutManager container)
		{
			return container?.DockController;
		}

		public static DockType GetDockTypeInContainer(DockLayoutManager container, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			LayoutGroup root = item.GetRoot();
			if (root is AutoHideGroup autoHideGroup)
			{
				return autoHideGroup.DockType.ToDockType();
			}
			if (root is FloatGroup floatGroup)
			{
				Rect containerRect = CoordinateHelper.GetContainerRect(container);
				Point center = CoordinateHelper.GetCenter(new Rect(floatGroup.FloatLocation, floatGroup.FloatSize));
				return DropTypeHelper.CalcCenterDropInfo(containerRect, center).DockType;
			}
			return DockType.Fill;
		}

		public static DocumentGroup GetPreviousNotEmptyDocumentGroup(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item != null && item.Parent != null)
			{
				LayoutGroup parent = item.Parent;
				int num = parent.Items.IndexOf(item);
				for (int num2 = num - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					if (parent.Items[num2] is DocumentGroup documentGroup && documentGroup.Items.Count > 0)
					{
						return documentGroup;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static DocumentGroup GetNextNotEmptyDocumentGroup(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item != null && item.Parent != null)
			{
				LayoutGroup parent = item.Parent;
				int num = parent.Items.IndexOf(item);
				for (int i = num + 1; i < parent.Items.Count; i++)
				{
					if (parent.Items[i] is DocumentGroup documentGroup && documentGroup.Items.Count > 0)
					{
						return documentGroup;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static bool CanUnboxGroupWithSingleItem(LayoutGroup group, DockLayoutManager manager, bool hasPlaceHolders)
		{
			LayoutGroup parent = group.Parent;
			if ((!group.IsFloating || group.ItemType == LayoutItemType.TabPanelGroup) && (hasPlaceHolders || (parent != null && parent.HasPlaceHolders)))
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = group.IsFloatingRootItem && manager.FloatingDocumentContainer == FloatingDocumentContainer.DocumentHost;
			if (group is DocumentGroup && (!group.IsFloatingRootItem || flag))
			{
				return false;
			}
			BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = group.Items[0];
			if (baseLayoutItem is LayoutControlItem || (baseLayoutItem is DocumentGroup && flag))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static ClosingBehavior GetActualClosingBehavior(DockLayoutManager container, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			ClosingBehavior closingBehavior = GetClosingBehavior(item);
			if (closingBehavior == ClosingBehavior.Default)
			{
				closingBehavior = new HierarchyPropertyValue<ClosingBehavior>(BaseLayoutItem.ClosingBehaviorProperty, ClosingBehavior.Default).Get(item, item.ClosingBehavior);
			}
			if (closingBehavior == ClosingBehavior.Default && container != null)
			{
				return container.ClosingBehavior;
			}
			return closingBehavior;
		}

		internal static BaseLayoutItem GetActualSelectedItem(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item is LayoutGroup layoutGroup)
			{
				BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = layoutGroup.GetNestedItems().FirstOrDefault((BaseLayoutItem x) => x.IsActive);
				if (baseLayoutItem != null)
				{
					item = baseLayoutItem;
				}
			}
			return item;
		}
	}
	public static class DockControllerExtensions
	{
		public static FloatGroup Float(this IDockController controller, BaseLayoutItem item, Rect floatBounds)
		{
			using (new UpdateBatch(controller.Container))
			{
				item.InitialFloatBounds = floatBounds;
				FloatGroup result = controller.Float(item);
				item.InitialFloatBounds = null;
				return result;
			}
		}

		internal static FloatGroup Float(this IDockController controller, BaseLayoutItem item, Size floatSize)
		{
			return controller.Float(item, new Rect(floatSize));
		}

		internal static bool CloseEx(this IDockController controller, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!item.ExecuteCloseCommand())
			{
				return controller.Close(item);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool DockAsDocument(this IDockController2010 controller, BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem target, DockType type)
		{
			return controller.DockAsDocument(item, target, type);
		}

		internal static bool DockAsDocument(this IDockController controller, BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem target, DockType type)
		{
			if (!(controller is IDockController2010))
			{
				return controller.Dock(item, target, type);
			}
			return DockAsDocument((IDockController2010)controller, item, target, type);
		}

		internal static bool Insert(this IDockController controller, LayoutGroup group, BaseLayoutItem item, int index, bool isReordering)
		{
			LayoutPanel layoutPanel = group.ItemFromIndex(index) as LayoutPanel;
			if (isReordering && (item.Parent.IndexFromItem(item) == index || index < 0 || !LayoutItemsHelper.CanReorder(item, layoutPanel)))
			{
				return false;
			}
			DockOperation dockOperation = ((!isReordering) ? DockOperation.Dock : DockOperation.Reorder);
			if (controller.Container.RaiseDockOperationStartingEvent(dockOperation, item, group))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!isReordering && layoutPanel != null && layoutPanel.IsPinnedTab)
			{
				index = ((layoutPanel.TabPinLocation == TabHeaderPinLocation.Far) ? layoutPanel.Parent.Items.Count : 0);
			}
			bool flag = controller.Insert(group, item, index);
			if (flag)
			{
				controller.Container.RaiseDockOperationCompletedEvent(dockOperation, item);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		internal static bool ToggleItemPinStatus(this IDockController controller, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			bool flag = item.IsTabDocument && item.ToggleTabPinStatus();
			if (flag)
			{
				controller.Container.Update(shouldUpdateLayout: false);
			}
			return flag;
		}
	}
	public abstract class DockControllerCommand : ICommand
	{
		private class DockControllerCommandLink : RoutedCommand
		{
			public DockControllerCommand Command { get; private set; }

			public DockControllerCommandLink(string name, DockControllerCommand command)
				: base(name, typeof(DockControllerCommand))
			{
				Command = command;
			}
		}

		protected internal IDockController Controller { get; set; }

		protected internal BaseLayoutItem Item { get; set; }

		public static RoutedCommand Activate { get; private set; }

		public static RoutedCommand Close { get; private set; }

		public static RoutedCommand Dock { get; private set; }

		public static RoutedCommand Float { get; private set; }

		public static RoutedCommand Hide { get; private set; }

		public static RoutedCommand Restore { get; private set; }

		internal static RoutedCommand CloseActive { get; private set; }

		private event EventHandler CanExecuteChangedCore;

		event EventHandler ICommand.CanExecuteChanged
		{
			add
			{
				CanExecuteChangedCore += value;
			}
			remove
			{
				CanExecuteChangedCore -= value;
			}
		}

		internal DockControllerCommand()
		{
		}

		protected abstract void ExecuteCore(IDockController controller, BaseLayoutItem item);

		protected abstract bool CanExecuteCore(BaseLayoutItem item);

		protected void RaiseCanExecuteChanged()
		{
			if (this.CanExecuteChangedCore != null)
			{
				this.CanExecuteChangedCore(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		bool ICommand.CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (Controller == null || Item == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return CanExecuteCore(Item);
		}

		void ICommand.Execute(object parameter)
		{
			if (Controller != null)
			{
				ExecuteCore(Controller, Item);
			}
		}

		static DockControllerCommand()
		{
			Activate = new DockControllerCommandLink("Activate", new ActivateCommand());
			Close = new DockControllerCommandLink("Close", new CloseCommand());
			Dock = new DockControllerCommandLink("Dock", new DockCommand());
			Float = new DockControllerCommandLink("Float", new FloatCommand());
			Hide = new DockControllerCommandLink("Hide", new HideCommand());
			Restore = new DockControllerCommandLink("Restore", new RestoreCommand());
			CloseActive = new DockControllerCommandLink("CloseActive", new CloseActiveCommand());
		}

		internal static void CanExecute(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			IDockController dockController = GetDockController(DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager(sender as DependencyObject));
			BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = e.Parameter as BaseLayoutItem;
			DockControllerCommand command = ((DockControllerCommandLink)e.Command).Command;
			e.CanExecute = dockController != null && baseLayoutItem != null && command.CanExecuteCore(baseLayoutItem);
		}

		internal static void Executed(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			IDockController dockController = GetDockController(DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager(sender as DependencyObject));
			BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = e.Parameter as BaseLayoutItem;
			if (dockController != null && baseLayoutItem != null)
			{
				DockControllerCommand command = ((DockControllerCommandLink)e.Command).Command;
				command.ExecuteCore(dockController, baseLayoutItem);
			}
		}

		private static IDockController GetDockController(DockLayoutManager container)
		{
			return container?.DockController;
		}
	}

	public class DockCommand : DockControllerCommand
	{
		protected override bool CanExecuteCore(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (!item.IsFloating)
			{
				if (item.IsAutoHidden)
				{
					return item.AllowDock;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void ExecuteCore(IDockController controller, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (CanDock(controller.Container, item))
			{
				controller.Dock(item);
			}
		}

		protected bool CanDock(DockLayoutManager container, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			DockSituation lastDockSituation = item.GetLastDockSituation();
			DockType type = DockControllerHelper.GetDockTypeInContainer(container, item);
			BaseLayoutItem target = container.LayoutRoot;
			if (lastDockSituation != null && lastDockSituation.DockTarget != null)
			{
				LayoutGroup root = lastDockSituation.DockTarget.GetRoot();
				bool flag = lastDockSituation.Root == root && container.IsViewCreated(root);
				LayoutGroup root2 = item.GetRoot();
				if (root != root2 && flag)
				{
					type = lastDockSituation.Type;
					target = lastDockSituation.DockTarget;
				}
			}
			return !container.RaiseItemDockingEvent(DockLayoutManager.DockItemStartDockingEvent, item, CoordinateHelper.ZeroPoint, target, type, isHiding: false);
		}
	}
	public class FloatCommand : DockControllerCommand
	{
		protected override bool CanExecuteCore(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (!item.IsFloating)
			{
				return item.AllowFloat;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void ExecuteCore(IDockController controller, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			DockLayoutManager container = controller.Container;
			IView view = container.GetView(item.GetRoot());
			ILayoutElement viewElement = container.GetViewElement(item);
			if (container != null)
			{
				container.ViewAdapter.ContextActionService.Execute(view, viewElement, ContextAction.Float);
			}
			else
			{
				controller.Float(item);
			}
		}
	}
