	internal class DockControllerImpl : DockControllerImplBase
	{
		public DockControllerImpl(DockLayoutManager container)
			: base(container)
		{
		}

		internal override FloatGroup BoxToFloatGroupCore(BaseLayoutItem item, Rect floatingBounds)
		{
			using (item.LockCanMerge())
			{
				if (base.Container.FloatingDocumentContainer == FloatingDocumentContainer.DocumentHost && item is DocumentPanel)
				{
					item = DockControllerHelper.BoxIntoDocumentHost(item, base.Container);
				}
				return base.BoxToFloatGroupCore(item, floatingBounds);
			}
		}

		protected bool BoxAndDockInNewGroup(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem target, DockType type)
		{
			using (new LogicalTreeLocker(base.Container, item, target))
			{
				LayoutGroup parent = target.Parent;
				BoxGroupItemsInNewGroup(parent, type.ToOrientation(), base.Container);
				return InsertItemInGroup(parent, item, (type.ToInsertType() != InsertType.Before) ? parent.Items.Count : 0);
			}
		}

		protected override bool DockToSideCore(BaseLayoutItem itemToDock, BaseLayoutItem target, DockType type)
		{
			if (target is LayoutGroup target2 && !(target is TabbedGroup))
			{
				return DockInExistingGroup(itemToDock, target2, type);
			}
			LayoutGroup parent = target.Parent;
			Orientation orientation = type.ToOrientation();
			if (parent.GetIsDocumentHost() && itemToDock.ItemType != LayoutItemType.DocumentPanelGroup)
			{
				return BoxAndDockInNewGroup(itemToDock, target, type);
			}
			if ((!parent.IgnoreOrientation && parent.Orientation != orientation) || target.IsFloatingRootItem || parent.IsControlItemsHost)
			{
				return DockInNewGroup(itemToDock, target, type);
			}
			int num = parent.Items.IndexOf(target);
			int num2 = ((type.ToInsertType() == InsertType.Before) ? num : (num + 1));
			if (itemToDock.Parent == parent && itemToDock.Parent.Items.IndexOf(itemToDock) < num2)
			{
				num2--;
			}
			return DockInExistingGroup(itemToDock, parent, num2, orientation);
		}

		private bool DockInExistingGroup(BaseLayoutItem item, LayoutGroup targetGroup, int targetPosition, Orientation neededOrientation)
		{
			using (new LogicalTreeLocker(base.Container, item, targetGroup))
			{
				if (item is DocumentPanel)
				{
					item = DockControllerHelper.BoxIntoDocumentGroup(item, base.Container);
				}
				return targetGroup != null && InsertItemInGroup(targetGroup, item, targetPosition);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class DockControllerImplBase : IActiveItemOwner, ILockOwner
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsRestoringProperty;

		private ActiveItemHelper ActivationHelper;

		private BaseLayoutItem activeItemCore;

		private DockLayoutManager containerCore;

		private int lockActivateCounter;

		public BaseLayoutItem ActiveItem
		{
			get
			{
				return activeItemCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ActiveItem != value)
				{
					SetActiveItemCore(value);
				}
			}
		}

		public DockLayoutManager Container => containerCore;

		public DockControllerImplBase(DockLayoutManager container)
		{
			containerCore = container;
			ActivationHelper = new ActiveItemHelper(this);
		}

		static DockControllerImplBase()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DockControllerImpl>.New().RegisterAttached<DependencyObject, bool>("GetIsRestoring", ref IsRestoringProperty, false, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		public static bool GetIsRestoring(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (bool)d.GetValue(IsRestoringProperty);
		}

		public static void SetIsRestoring(DependencyObject d, bool value)
		{
			d.SetValue(IsRestoringProperty, value);
		}

		public void Activate(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			Activate(item, focus: true);
		}

		public void Activate(BaseLayoutItem item, bool focus)
		{
			if (lockActivateCounter > 0 || item == null || !item.AllowActivate || !item.IsVisibleCore || (item is LayoutGroup && ((LayoutGroup)item).IsUngroupped))
			{
				return;
			}
			lockActivateCounter++;
			try
			{
				if (ActiveItem != item && RaiseItemCancelEvent(item, DockLayoutManager.DockItemActivatingEvent))
				{
					item.InvokeCancelActivation(ActiveItem);
				}
				else
				{
					ActivationHelper.ActivateItem(item, focus);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				lockActivateCounter--;
			}
		}

		public DocumentGroup AddDocumentGroup(DockType type)
		{
			DocumentGroup documentGroup = Container.GenerateGroup<DocumentGroup>();
			if (type != DockType.Fill && type != DockType.None)
			{
				DockInExistingGroup(documentGroup, Container.LayoutRoot, type);
				Container.Update();
			}
			return documentGroup;
		}

		public DocumentPanel AddDocumentPanel(DocumentGroup group)
		{
			if (group == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DocumentPanel documentPanel = Container.CreateDocumentPanel();
			group.Items.Add(documentPanel);
			CheckMDIState(group, documentPanel);
			return documentPanel;
		}

		public DocumentPanel AddDocumentPanel(Point floatLocation, Size floatSize)
		{
			DocumentPanel documentPanel = Container.CreateDocumentPanel();
			documentPanel.FloatSize = floatSize;
			FloatGroup floatGroup = DockControllerHelper.BoxIntoFloatGroup(documentPanel, Container);
			floatGroup.FloatLocation = floatLocation;
			Container.FloatGroups.Add(floatGroup);
			return documentPanel;
		}

		public DocumentPanel AddDocumentPanel(DocumentGroup group, Uri uri)
		{
			if (group == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DocumentPanel documentPanel = Container.CreateDocumentPanel();
			documentPanel.Content = uri;
			group.Items.Add(documentPanel);
			CheckMDIState(group, documentPanel);
			return documentPanel;
		}

		public DocumentPanel AddDocumentPanel(Point floatLocation, Size floatSize, Uri uri)
		{
			DocumentPanel documentPanel = Container.CreateDocumentPanel();
			documentPanel.Content = uri;
			documentPanel.FloatSize = floatSize;
			FloatGroup floatGroup = DockControllerHelper.BoxIntoFloatGroup(documentPanel, Container);
			floatGroup.FloatLocation = floatLocation;
			Container.FloatGroups.Add(floatGroup);
			return documentPanel;
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void AddItem(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem target, DockType type)
		{
			if (item == null || target == null || type == DockType.None)
			{
				return;
			}
			using (new NotificationBatch(Container))
			{
				if (type != DockType.Fill)
				{
					if (target.Parent == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					LayoutGroup parent = target.Parent;
					int num = parent.Items.IndexOf(target);
					if (parent.Orientation == type.ToOrientation() || parent.IgnoreOrientation)
					{
						InsertType insertType = type.ToInsertType();
						if (insertType == InsertType.After)
						{
							num++;
						}
						if (!(parent is DocumentGroup) && item is DocumentPanel)
						{
							item = DockControllerHelper.BoxIntoDocumentGroup(item, Container);
						}
						InsertCore(parent, item, num);
					}
					else
					{
						DockInNewGroup(item, target, type);
					}
				}
				if (type == DockType.Fill && target is LayoutGroup)
				{
					if (!(target is DocumentGroup) && item is DocumentPanel)
					{
						item = DockControllerHelper.BoxIntoDocumentGroup(item, Container);
					}
					((LayoutGroup)target).Add(item);
				}
				Container.Update();
				NotificationBatch.Action(Container, item.GetRoot());
			}
		}

		public LayoutPanel AddPanel(DockType type)
		{
			LayoutPanel layoutPanel = Container.CreateLayoutPanel();
			if (type != DockType.Fill && type != DockType.None)
			{
				DockInExistingGroup(layoutPanel, Container.LayoutRoot, type);
				Container.Update();
			}
			return layoutPanel;
		}

		public LayoutPanel AddPanel(Point floatLocation, Size floatSize)
		{
			LayoutPanel layoutPanel = Container.CreateLayoutPanel();
			layoutPanel.FloatSize = floatSize;
			FloatGroup floatGroup = DockControllerHelper.BoxIntoFloatGroup(layoutPanel, Container);
			floatGroup.FloatLocation = floatLocation;
			Container.FloatGroups.Add(floatGroup);
			Container.Update();
			return layoutPanel;
		}

		public bool Close(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			return CloseCore(item);
		}

		public bool CloseAllButThis(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item == null || item.Parent == null || item.Parent.Items.Count <= 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			BaseLayoutItem[] array = new BaseLayoutItem[item.Parent.Items.Count];
			item.Parent.Items.CopyTo(array, 0);
			bool flag = true;
			BaseLayoutItem[] array2 = array;
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem in array2)
			{
				if (baseLayoutItem != item)
				{
					flag &= Container.DockController.CloseEx(baseLayoutItem);
				}
			}
			return flag;
		}

		public bool CreateNewDocumentGroup(DocumentPanel document, Orientation orientation)
		{
			return CreateNewDocumentGroup((LayoutPanel)document, orientation);
		}

		public bool CreateNewDocumentGroup(LayoutPanel document, Orientation orientation)
		{
			if (document == null || !(document.Parent is DocumentGroup) || document.Parent.Items.Count <= 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DocumentGroup documentGroup = (DocumentGroup)document.Parent;
			using (new UpdateBatch(Container))
			{
				using (new LogicalTreeLocker(Container, document, documentGroup))
				{
					DocumentGroup documentGroup2 = DockControllerHelper.BoxIntoDocumentGroup(document, Container);
					DockControllerHelper.SetForceSizeUpdate(documentGroup2, value: true);
					try
					{
						return DockCore(documentGroup2, documentGroup, (orientation == Orientation.Horizontal) ? DockType.Right : DockType.Bottom, shouldRaiseCompleted: false);
					}
					finally
					{
						documentGroup2.ClearValue(DockControllerHelper.ForceSizeUpdateProperty);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public bool Dock(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item == null || !item.AllowDock)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DockLayoutManager linkedManager = GetLinkedManager(item);
			if (linkedManager != Container)
			{
				return linkedManager.DockController.Dock(item);
			}
			if (item is LayoutGroup)
			{
				LayoutGroup ownerGroup = LayoutGroup.GetOwnerGroup(item);
				if (ownerGroup is AutoHideGroup)
				{
					item = ownerGroup;
				}
			}
			if (OnDockOperationStarting(DockOperation.Dock, item))
			{
				return false;
			}
			DockSituation lastDockSituation = item.GetLastDockSituation();
			LayoutGroup root = item.GetRoot();
			DockType type = DockControllerHelper.GetDockTypeInContainer(Container, item);
			BaseLayoutItem target = Container.LayoutRoot;
			BaseLayoutItem itemToDock = GetItemToDock(item);
			LayoutGroup layoutGroup = null;
			PlaceHolder placeHolder = ((itemToDock != null) ? PlaceHolderHelper.GetPlaceHolder(itemToDock) : null);
			if (placeHolder != null && PlaceHolderHelper.CanRestoreLayoutHierarchy(itemToDock))
			{
				type = DockType.None;
				layoutGroup = placeHolder.Parent.GetRoot();
			}
			else if (lastDockSituation != null && lastDockSituation.DockTarget != null)
			{
				layoutGroup = lastDockSituation.DockTarget.GetRoot();
				bool flag = lastDockSituation.Root == layoutGroup && Container.IsViewCreated(layoutGroup);
				if (layoutGroup != root && flag)
				{
					if (lastDockSituation.Type != DockType.None)
					{
						type = lastDockSituation.Type;
					}
					target = lastDockSituation.DockTarget;
				}
			}
			if (root is FloatGroup && lastDockSituation != null && lastDockSituation.Root == layoutGroup)
			{
				if (lastDockSituation.Width.IsAuto)
				{
					item.ItemWidth = GridLength.Auto;
				}
				if (lastDockSituation.Height.IsAuto)
				{
					item.ItemHeight = GridLength.Auto;
				}
			}
			return DockCore(item, target, type);
		}

		public bool Dock(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem target, DockType type)
		{
			if (item == null || target == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!target.GetAllowDockToCurrentItem() && type == DockType.Fill)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DockLayoutManager linkedManager = GetLinkedManager(target);
			if (linkedManager != Container)
			{
				return linkedManager.DockController.Dock(item, target, type);
			}
			if (OnDockOperationStarting(DockOperation.Dock, item, target))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return DockCore(item, target, type);
		}

		public bool DockAsDocument(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem target, DockType type)
		{
			using (new LogicalTreeLocker(Container, item, target))
			{
				using (new ActivateBatch(Container))
				{
					LayoutGroup parent = item.Parent;
					LayoutGroup root = item.GetRoot();
					DocumentGroup item2 = DockControllerHelper.BoxIntoDocumentGroup(item, Container);
					ClearPlaceHolder(item);
					using (target.LockDockingTarget())
					{
						TryUngroupGroup(parent);
						TryUngroupGroup(root);
					}
					return Dock(item2, target, type);
				}
			}
		}

		public FloatGroup Float(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item == null || !item.AllowFloat)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (OnDockOperationStarting(DockOperation.Float, item))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (item.IsClosed && !Restore(item))
			{
				return null;
			}
			LayoutGroup parent = item.Parent;
			if (parent != null)
			{
				return Float(item, parent);
			}
			return FloatWithoutParent(item);
		}

		private FloatGroup Float(BaseLayoutItem item, LayoutGroup parentGroup)
		{
			if (item.IsAutoHidden)
			{
				CheckHideView(item);
			}
			DockSituation dockSituation = DockSituation.GetDockSituation(item);
			LayoutGroup parent = item.Parent;
			BaseLayoutItem firstOtherItem = GetFirstOtherItem(item, parent.GetItems());
			FloatGroup floatGroup = null;
			BaseLayoutItem layout = GetLayout(item);
			BaseLayoutItem[] items = new BaseLayoutItem[3] { item, parent, layout };
			using (new LogicalTreeLocker(Container, items))
			{
				using (new NotificationBatch(Container))
				{
					using (new UpdateBatch(Container))
					{
						using (new ActivateBatch(Container))
						{
							item.BeginFloating();
							bool flag = HasFocus(item);
							int startingIndex = parent.IndexFromItem(item);
							if (!parent.IsFloating)
							{
								AddPlaceHolder(item, parent);
							}
							if (parent.Remove(item))
							{
								BaseLayoutItem itemToFocus = GetItemToFocus(parent, startingIndex);
								if (flag && itemToFocus != null)
								{
									Container.LockItemActivationOnFocus();
									Container.FocusItem(itemToFocus);
								}
								BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = parent;
								NotificationBatch.Action(Container, baseLayoutItem.GetRoot());
								if (TryUngroupGroup(parent) != parent && !(baseLayoutItem is AutoHideGroup))
								{
									baseLayoutItem = firstOtherItem;
								}
								item.UpdateDockSituation(dockSituation, baseLayoutItem);
								DockControllerHelper.CheckUpdateView(Container, dockSituation.Root);
								floatGroup = BoxToFloatGroupCore(item);
								Container.FloatGroups.Add(floatGroup);
								floatGroup.Manager = Container;
								if (flag)
								{
									Container.FocusItem(item, ignoreFocusState: true);
								}
								item.EndFloating();
								Container.Update();
								OnDockOperationComplete(item, DockOperation.Float);
								NotificationBatch.Action(Container, item.GetRoot());
							}
							return floatGroup;
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private FloatGroup FloatWithoutParent(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem layout = GetLayout(item);
			BaseLayoutItem[] items = new BaseLayoutItem[2] { item, layout };
			using (new LogicalTreeLocker(Container, items))
			{
				using (new UpdateBatch(Container))
				{
					using (new ActivateBatch(Container))
					{
						item.BeginFloating();
						FloatGroup floatGroup = BoxToFloatGroupCore(item);
						Container.FloatGroups.Add(floatGroup);
						floatGroup.Manager = Container;
						item.EndFloating();
						Container.Update();
						OnDockOperationComplete(item, DockOperation.Float);
						NotificationBatch.Action(Container, item.GetRoot());
						return floatGroup;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public bool Hide(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			return HideCore(item, System.Windows.Controls.Dock.Left, calcDock: true);
		}

		public bool Hide(BaseLayoutItem item, AutoHideGroup target)
		{
			DockLayoutManager linkedManager = GetLinkedManager(target);
			if (linkedManager != Container)
			{
				return linkedManager.DockController.Hide(item, target);
			}
			if (target != null)
			{
				return HideCore(item, target, target.DockType, calcDock: false);
			}
			return Hide(item);
		}

		public bool Hide(BaseLayoutItem item, Dock dock)
		{
			return HideCore(item, dock, calcDock: false);
		}

		public bool Insert(LayoutGroup group, BaseLayoutItem item, int index)
		{
			return InsertCore(group, item, index);
		}

		public bool MoveToDocumentGroup(DocumentPanel document, bool next)
		{
			return MoveToDocumentGroup((LayoutPanel)document, next);
		}

		public bool MoveToDocumentGroup(LayoutPanel document, bool next)
		{
			if (document == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DocumentGroup documentGroup = (next ? DockControllerHelper.GetNextNotEmptyDocumentGroup(document.Parent) : DockControllerHelper.GetPreviousNotEmptyDocumentGroup(document.Parent));
			if (documentGroup == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Dock(document, documentGroup, DockType.Fill);
			DockControllerHelper.CheckUpdateView(Container, document.GetRoot());
			Container.Update();
			return true;
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void RemoveItem(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			using (new NotificationBatch(Container))
			{
				object target = item;
				LayoutGroup parent = item.Parent;
				if (parent != null)
				{
					target = item.GetRoot();
					parent.Remove(item);
					TryUngroupGroup(parent);
				}
				else if (item is LayoutGroup { ParentPanel: not null } layoutGroup)
				{
					target = layoutGroup.ParentPanel.GetRoot();
					layoutGroup.ParentPanel.Content = null;
				}
				else
				{
					if (item == Container.LayoutRoot)
					{
						target = Container;
						Container.LayoutRoot = null;
					}
					if (item.IsClosed)
					{
						Container.ClosedPanels.Remove(item as LayoutPanel);
					}
					if (item is AutoHideGroup)
					{
						Container.AutoHideGroups.Remove(item as AutoHideGroup);
					}
					if (item is FloatGroup)
					{
						Container.FloatGroups.Remove(item as FloatGroup);
					}
				}
				NotificationBatch.Action(Container, target);
				Container.Update();
			}
		}

		public void RemovePanel(LayoutPanel panel)
		{
			if (panel == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			using (new NotificationBatch(Container))
			{
				LayoutGroup root = panel.GetRoot();
				DockControllerHelper.SetClosingBehavior(panel, ClosingBehavior.ImmediatelyRemove);
				try
				{
					if (!panel.IsClosed)
					{
						CloseCore(panel, remove: true);
					}
					RemovePanelCore(panel);
				}
				finally
				{
					panel.ClearValue(DockControllerHelper.ClosingBehaviorProperty);
				}
				NotificationBatch.Action(Container, root);
			}
		}

		public bool Rename(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			return Container.RenameHelper.Rename(item);
		}

		public bool Restore(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			bool isRestoring = GetIsRestoring(item);
			bool flag = (item.IsClosed || isRestoring) && item is LayoutPanel && item.AllowRestore;
			if (!flag)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (RaiseItemCancelEvent(item, DockLayoutManager.DockItemRestoringEvent) || OnDockOperationStarting(DockOperation.Restore, item))
			{
				return false;
			}
			using (new LogicalTreeLocker(Container, item))
			{
				using (new UpdateBatch(Container))
				{
					if (Container.ClosedPanels.Remove((LayoutPanel)item) || GetIsRestoring(item))
					{
						if (!RestoreToPlaceHolder(item, isRestore: true))
						{
							DockSituation lastDockSituation = item.GetLastDockSituation();
							if (lastDockSituation != null && CanRestoreDockSituation(lastDockSituation) && lastDockSituation.Type != DockType.None)
							{
								DockType type = lastDockSituation.Type;
								BaseLayoutItem dockTarget = lastDockSituation.DockTarget;
								flag = Dock(item, dockTarget, type);
							}
							else
							{
								LayoutPanel layoutPanel = (LayoutPanel)item;
								Size size = ((!MathHelper.IsEmpty(layoutPanel.FloatSizeBeforeClose)) ? layoutPanel.FloatSizeBeforeClose : (MathHelper.IsEmpty(item.FloatSize) ? item.GetSize() : item.FloatSize));
								FloatGroup floatGroup = BoxToFloatGroupCore(item, new Rect(layoutPanel.FloatLocationBeforeClose, size));
								Container.CheckFloatGroupRestoreBounds(floatGroup, layoutPanel.HasFloatOffsetBeforeClose ? layoutPanel.FloatOffsetBeforeClose : Container.GetRestoreOffset());
								Container.FloatGroups.Add(floatGroup);
								PlaceHolderHelper.ClearPlaceHolder(item, PlaceHolderState.Floating);
							}
						}
						RaiseItemEvent(item, DockLayoutManager.DockItemRestoredEvent);
						Container.Update();
						OnDockOperationComplete(item, DockOperation.Restore);
						NotificationBatch.Action(Container, item.GetRoot());
					}
					return flag;
				}
			}
		}

		public bool RestoreGroupAndInsertItem(int index, BaseLayoutItem item, LayoutGroup target)
		{
			if (item == null || item.Parent != null || target == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			using (new UpdateBatch(Container))
			{
				using (new LogicalTreeLocker(Container, item, target))
				{
					SetIsRestoring(item, value: true);
					try
					{
						item.SetValue(DockLayoutManager.LayoutItemProperty, item);
						PlaceHolder placeHolder = target.DockInfo.LastOrDefault();
						if (placeHolder != null)
						{
							PlaceHolderHelper.AddFakePlaceHolderForItem(target, item, index, placeHolder.DockState);
						}
						return Restore(item);
					}
					finally
					{
						item.ClearValue(IsRestoringProperty);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual FloatGroup BoxToFloatGroupCore(BaseLayoutItem item, Rect floatingBounds)
		{
			return DockControllerHelper.BoxIntoFloatGroup(Container, item, floatingBounds);
		}

		protected void BoxGroupItemsInNewGroup(LayoutGroup target, Orientation neededOrientation, DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			LayoutGroup layoutGroup = manager.GenerateGroup<LayoutGroup>();
			((ISupportInitialize)layoutGroup).BeginInit();
			layoutGroup.Orientation = target.Orientation;
			if (DependencyObjectExtensions.IsPropertyAssigned((DependencyObject)target, LayoutGroup.AllowSplittersProperty))
			{
				layoutGroup.AllowSplitters = target.AllowSplitters;
			}
			target.MoveItemsTo(layoutGroup);
			((ISupportInitialize)layoutGroup).EndInit();
			target.Orientation = neededOrientation;
			target.Add(layoutGroup);
			Container.Update();
		}

		protected virtual FloatGroup BoxToFloatGroupCore(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			Rect floatingBounds = item.InitialFloatBounds ?? new Rect(MathHelper.IsEmpty(item.FloatSize) ? item.GetSize() : item.FloatSize);
			return BoxToFloatGroupCore(item, floatingBounds);
		}

		protected bool CanRestoreDockSituation(DockSituation situation)
		{
			if (situation == null || situation.DockTarget == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (situation.Root == situation.DockTarget.GetRoot())
			{
				if (situation.Root is FloatGroup)
				{
					return Container.FloatGroups.Contains((FloatGroup)situation.Root);
				}
				if (situation.Root is AutoHideGroup)
				{
					return Container.AutoHideGroups.Contains((AutoHideGroup)situation.Root);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool CheckHideView(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			DockLayoutManager actualViewOwner = Container.GetActualViewOwner(item);
			return DockControllerHelper.CheckHideView(actualViewOwner, item.GetRoot());
		}

		protected void ClearPlaceHolder(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			List<BaseLayoutItem> list = new List<BaseLayoutItem>();
			item.Accept(list.Add);
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item2 in list)
			{
				LayoutGroup[] affectedGroups = PlaceHolderHelper.GetAffectedGroups(item2);
				PlaceHolderHelper.ClearPlaceHolder(item2);
				Array.ForEach(affectedGroups, delegate(LayoutGroup group)
				{
					TryUngroupGroup(group);
				});
			}
		}

		protected void ClearPlaceHolder(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem dockTarget)
		{
			List<BaseLayoutItem> list = new List<BaseLayoutItem>();
			item.Accept(list.Add);
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item2 in list)
			{
				PlaceHolderState placeHolderState = (dockTarget.IsFloating ? PlaceHolderState.Floating : PlaceHolderState.Docked);
				LayoutGroup affectedGroup = PlaceHolderHelper.GetAffectedGroup(item2, placeHolderState);
				if (placeHolderState == PlaceHolderState.Docked)
				{
					PlaceHolderHelper.ClearPlaceHolder(item2, item);
				}
				else
				{
					PlaceHolderHelper.ClearPlaceHolder(item2, PlaceHolderState.Floating);
				}
				if (affectedGroup != dockTarget)
				{
					using (new LogicalTreeLocker(Container, affectedGroup))
					{
						TryUngroupGroup(affectedGroup);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected bool DockInExistingGroup(BaseLayoutItem item, LayoutGroup target, DockType type)
		{
			if (target == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			using (new LogicalTreeLocker(Container, item, target))
			{
				Orientation orientation = type.ToOrientation();
				int index = ((type.ToInsertType() != InsertType.Before) ? 1 : 0);
				bool flag = target.GetIsDocumentHost() && target.IsRoot();
				if ((target.IgnoreOrientation || target.Orientation == orientation || (target.Items.Count <= 1 && !target.HasPlaceHolders)) && !target.IsControlItemsHost && !flag)
				{
					if (target.Orientation != orientation)
					{
						target.Orientation = orientation;
					}
					index = ((type.ToInsertType() != InsertType.Before) ? target.Items.Count : 0);
				}
				else
				{
					BoxGroupItemsInNewGroup(target, orientation, Container);
				}
				if (item is DocumentPanel)
				{
					item = DockControllerHelper.BoxIntoDocumentGroup(item, Container);
				}
				return InsertItemInGroup(target, item, index);
			}
		}

		protected bool DockInNewGroup(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem target, DockType type)
		{
			using (new LogicalTreeLocker(Container, item, target))
			{
				LayoutGroup parent = target.Parent;
				PlaceHolderHelper.StorePositionAndRemove(parent, target);
				LayoutGroup layoutGroup = DockControllerHelper.BoxIntoGroup(target, type.ToOrientation(), parent.IsSplittersEnabled, Container);
				if (item is DocumentPanel)
				{
					item = DockControllerHelper.BoxIntoDocumentGroup(item, Container);
				}
				bool result = InsertItemInGroup(layoutGroup, item, (type.ToInsertType() != InsertType.Before) ? 1 : 0);
				PlaceHolderHelper.InsertItemToPosition(parent, target, layoutGroup);
				return result;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool DockToFillCore(BaseLayoutItem itemToDock, BaseLayoutItem target)
		{
			LayoutGroup layoutGroup = target as LayoutGroup;
			if (layoutGroup == null && target.Parent is TabbedGroup)
			{
				layoutGroup = target.Parent;
			}
			return (layoutGroup != null && (layoutGroup is TabbedGroup || !layoutGroup.IsControlItemsHost)) ? FillExistingGroup(itemToDock, layoutGroup) : FillNewTabbedGroup(itemToDock, target);
		}

		protected virtual bool DockToPlaceHolder(BaseLayoutItem itemToDock)
		{
			bool flag = RestoreToPlaceHolder(itemToDock);
			if (flag)
			{
				ClearPlaceHolder(itemToDock);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		protected virtual bool DockToSideCore(BaseLayoutItem itemToDock, BaseLayoutItem target, DockType type)
		{
			LayoutGroup layoutGroup = target as LayoutGroup;
			if (layoutGroup == null && target.Parent.Orientation == type.ToOrientation() && target.Parent.Items.Count == 1)
			{
				layoutGroup = target.Parent;
			}
			return (layoutGroup != null && !(layoutGroup is TabbedGroup)) ? DockInExistingGroup(itemToDock, layoutGroup, type) : DockInNewGroup(itemToDock, target, type);
		}

		protected bool HideCore(BaseLayoutItem item, Dock dock, bool calcDock)
		{
			return HideCore(item, null, dock, calcDock);
		}

		protected bool HideCore(BaseLayoutItem item, AutoHideGroup target, Dock dock, bool calcDock)
		{
			if (item == null || (item.IsAutoHidden && item.Parent == target) || !item.AllowHide || item is AutoHideGroup)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (item.IsClosed && !Restore(item))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (item is FloatGroup)
			{
				FloatGroup floatGroup = (FloatGroup)item;
				item = GetFloatGroupContent(item);
				item.FloatSize = floatGroup.FloatSize;
			}
			if (!item.AllowHide || RaiseItemCancelEvent(item, DockLayoutManager.DockItemHidingEvent) || OnDockOperationStarting(DockOperation.Hide, item))
			{
				return false;
			}
			DockSituation dockSituation = (calcDock ? DockSituation.GetDockSituation(item) : DockSituation.GetDockSituation(item, dock));
			LayoutGroup parent = item.Parent;
			BaseLayoutItem firstOtherItem = GetFirstOtherItem(item, parent.GetItems());
			using (new LogicalTreeLocker(Container, item, parent))
			{
				using (new NotificationBatch(Container))
				{
					using (new ActivateBatch(Container))
					{
						using (new UpdateBatch(Container))
						{
							if (calcDock)
							{
								AddPlaceHolder(item, parent);
							}
							else
							{
								ClearPlaceHolder(item);
							}
							AutoHideType autoHideType = AutoHideGroup.GetAutoHideType(item);
							if (parent.Remove(item))
							{
								BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = parent;
								NotificationBatch.Action(Container, baseLayoutItem.GetRoot());
								if (TryUngroupGroup(parent) != parent)
								{
									baseLayoutItem = firstOtherItem;
								}
								item.UpdateDockSituation(dockSituation, baseLayoutItem);
								if (!calcDock)
								{
									item.UpdateAutoHideSituation(dock.ToAutoHideType());
								}
								AutoHideType autoHideType2 = (calcDock ? CalcAutoHideType(item, autoHideType) : AutoHideType.Default);
								Dock type = ((autoHideType2 != AutoHideType.Default) ? autoHideType2.ToDock() : dockSituation.DesiredDock);
								AutoHideGroup autoHideGroup = target;
								if (autoHideGroup != null && !autoHideGroup.IsUngroupped)
								{
									autoHideGroup.Add(item);
								}
								else
								{
									autoHideGroup = DockControllerHelper.BoxIntoAutoHideGroup(item, type, Container);
									autoHideGroup.UpdateDockSituation(dockSituation, baseLayoutItem, item);
									if (item is TabbedGroup tabbedGroup)
									{
										LayoutGroup.SetOwnerGroup(tabbedGroup, autoHideGroup);
										Container.DecomposedItems.AddOnce(tabbedGroup);
										PlaceHolderHelper.AddFakePlaceHolderForItem(tabbedGroup, autoHideGroup);
										autoHideGroup.HasPersistentGroups = !tabbedGroup.DestroyOnClosingChildren;
									}
									Container.AutoHideGroups.Add(autoHideGroup);
								}
								DockControllerHelper.CheckUpdateView(Container, dockSituation.Root);
								DockControllerHelper.CheckUpdateView(Container, autoHideGroup.GetRoot());
								RaiseItemEvent(item, DockLayoutManager.DockItemHiddenEvent);
								Container.Update();
								OnDockOperationComplete(item, DockOperation.Hide);
								NotificationBatch.Action(Container, autoHideGroup);
								return true;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected bool InsertCore(LayoutGroup group, BaseLayoutItem item, int index)
		{
			if (item == null || group == null || index == -1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			LayoutGroup ownerGroup = LayoutGroup.GetOwnerGroup(group);
			if (ownerGroup != null)
			{
				group = ownerGroup;
			}
			LayoutGroup parent = item.Parent;
			LayoutGroup root = group.GetRoot();
			using (new UpdateBatch(Container))
			{
				using (new ActivateBatch(Container))
				{
					if (parent == group)
					{
						bool flag = group.MoveItem(index, item);
						if (flag)
						{
							Container.InvalidateView(root);
							Container.Update();
						}
						return flag;
					}
					if (item.ItemType != LayoutItemType.ControlItem)
					{
						if (!item.AllowDock)
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
					else if (!item.AllowMove)
					{
						return false;
					}
					FloatGroup floatRoot;
					AutoHideGroup autoHideRoot;
					BaseLayoutItem itemToDock = GetItemToDock(item, out floatRoot, out autoHideRoot);
					CheckHideView(parent);
					if (!group.IsFloating)
					{
						ClearPlaceHolder(itemToDock, group);
					}
					bool flag2 = ((group is TabbedGroup && itemToDock is LayoutGroup) ? FillExistingGroup((LayoutGroup)itemToDock, group, index) : InsertItemInGroup(group, itemToDock, index));
					if (flag2)
					{
						TryUngroupGroup(parent);
						if (floatRoot != null)
						{
							TryUngroupGroup(floatRoot);
						}
						if (autoHideRoot != null)
						{
							TryUngroupGroup(autoHideRoot);
						}
						Container.InvalidateView(root);
						Container.Update();
					}
					return flag2;
				}
			}
		}

		protected bool InsertItemInGroup(LayoutGroup group, BaseLayoutItem item, int index, bool forceSizeUpdate = false)
		{
			using (new LogicalTreeLocker(Container, item, group))
			{
				return DockControllerHelper.InsertItemInGroup(group, item, index, forceSizeUpdate);
			}
		}

		protected void OnDisposing()
		{
			Ref.Dispose(ref ActivationHelper);
			containerCore = null;
			activeItemCore = null;
		}

		protected void OnDockComplete(BaseLayoutItem item, DockType type, bool wasHidden)
		{
			if (item.IsClosed)
			{
				using (new LogicalTreeLocker(Container, item))
				{
					Container.ClosedPanels.Remove((LayoutPanel)item);
				}
			}
			item.UpdateDockSituation(item.Parent, type);
			if (!wasHidden)
			{
				item.UpdateAutoHideSituation();
			}
		}

		protected LayoutGroup TryUngroupGroup(LayoutGroup group)
		{
			if (group == null || group.IsPermanent)
			{
				return group;
			}
			if (Container.IsLayoutLocked)
			{
				Container.ExecuteActionOnLayoutUnlocked((object x) => TryUngroupCore(x as LayoutGroup), group);
				return group;
			}
			return TryUngroupCore(group);
		}

		private static void DestroyPanelContent(LayoutPanel panel)
		{
			if (DockLayoutManagerParameters.DisposePanelContentAfterRemovingPanel)
			{
				DisposeHelper.DisposeVisualTree(panel.Content as DependencyObject);
			}
		}

		private void AddPlaceHolder(BaseLayoutItem item, LayoutGroup group)
		{
			if (!group.PlaceHolderHelper.Contains(item))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (item.IsFloating)
			{
				LayoutGroup placeHolderRoot = PlaceHolderHelper.GetPlaceHolderRoot(item, PlaceHolderState.Floating);
				if (group == placeHolderRoot)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			group.PlaceHolderHelper.AddPlaceHolderForItem(item);
		}

		private AutoHideType CalcAutoHideType(BaseLayoutItem item, AutoHideType actualAutoHideType)
		{
			DockSituation lastDockSituation = item.GetLastDockSituation();
			if (actualAutoHideType == AutoHideType.Default)
			{
				return lastDockSituation?.AutoHideType ?? AutoHideType.Default;
			}
			return actualAutoHideType;
		}

		private void CheckMDIState(DocumentGroup dGroup, DocumentPanel panel)
		{
			if (!dGroup.IsTabbed && dGroup.IsMaximized)
			{
				MDIStateHelper.SetMDIState(panel, MDIState.Maximized);
			}
		}

		private bool CloseAutoHideGroup(AutoHideGroup autoHideGroup)
		{
			if (Container.AutoHideGroups.Except(new AutoHideGroup[1] { autoHideGroup }).All((AutoHideGroup x) => x.DockType != autoHideGroup.DockType))
			{
				Container.InvalidateView(autoHideGroup);
			}
			bool flag = Container.AutoHideGroups.Contains(autoHideGroup) && Container.AutoHideGroups.Remove(autoHideGroup);
			if (flag)
			{
				if (autoHideGroup.HasItems)
				{
					AddPlaceHolder(autoHideGroup[0], autoHideGroup);
				}
				SetClosed(autoHideGroup);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private bool CloseCore(BaseLayoutItem item, bool remove = false)
		{
			if (item == null || item.IsClosed || !(item.AllowClose || remove))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!remove && (RaiseItemCancelEvent(item, DockLayoutManager.DockItemClosingEvent) || OnDockOperationStarting(DockOperation.Close, item)))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (item is IClosable && !((IClosable)item).CanClose())
			{
				return false;
			}
			try
			{
				item.IsClosing = true;
				if (item.IsAutoHidden)
				{
					CheckHideView(item);
				}
				IEnumerable<BaseLayoutItem> affectedItems = DockControllerHelper.GetAffectedItems(item);
				bool flag = false;
				using (new LogicalTreeLocker(Container, affectedItems.Concat(new BaseLayoutItem[1] { item.Parent }).ToArray()))
				{
					using (new NotificationBatch(Container))
					{
						NotificationBatch.Action(Container, item.GetRoot());
						if (item is FloatGroup)
						{
							flag = CloseFloatGroup(item as FloatGroup);
						}
						if (item is AutoHideGroup)
						{
							flag = CloseAutoHideGroup(item as AutoHideGroup);
						}
						if (!flag)
						{
							LayoutGroup parent = item.Parent;
							if (parent == null)
							{
								return false;
							}
							LayoutGroup root = item.GetRoot();
							if (parent.Items.Count == 1)
							{
								if (parent is FloatGroup floatGroup)
								{
									flag = parent.DestroyOnClosingChildren && CloseFloatGroup(floatGroup);
								}
								if (parent is AutoHideGroup autoHideGroup)
								{
									flag = !autoHideGroup.HasPersistentGroups && parent.DestroyOnClosingChildren && CloseAutoHideGroup(autoHideGroup);
								}
							}
							flag = flag || CloseItem(item, parent);
							DockControllerHelper.CheckUpdateView(Container, root);
						}
						if (flag)
						{
							Container.RaiseEvent(new DockItemClosedEventArgs(item, affectedItems));
							OnDockOperationComplete(item, DockOperation.Close);
							if (item is IClosable)
							{
								((IClosable)item).OnClosed();
							}
						}
						Container.Update();
						NotificationBatch.Action(Container, item);
						return flag;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				item.IsClosing = false;
			}
		}

		private bool CloseFloatGroup(FloatGroup floatGroup)
		{
			using (new LogicalTreeLocker(Container, floatGroup))
			{
				DockLayoutManager linkedManager = GetLinkedManager(floatGroup);
				if (linkedManager != Container)
				{
					return linkedManager.DockController.Close(floatGroup);
				}
				bool flag = Container.FloatGroups.Contains(floatGroup) && Container.FloatGroups.Remove(floatGroup);
				if (flag)
				{
					IEnumerable<BaseLayoutItem> nestedItems = floatGroup.GetNestedItems();
					List<LayoutPanel> source = Container.GetItems().Except(nestedItems).OfType<LayoutPanel>()
						.ToList();
					BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = source.Where((LayoutPanel x) => x.IsFloating).OrderBy((LayoutPanel x) => x.LastActivationDateTime, ListSortDirection.Descending).FirstOrDefault();
					if (baseLayoutItem == null)
					{
						baseLayoutItem = source.Where((LayoutPanel x) => x.DockItemState == DockItemState.Docked).OrderBy((LayoutPanel x) => x.LastActivationDateTime, ListSortDirection.Descending).FirstOrDefault();
					}
					if (baseLayoutItem != null && baseLayoutItem.IsTabPage && !baseLayoutItem.IsSelectedItem && baseLayoutItem.Parent.SelectedItem != null)
					{
						baseLayoutItem = baseLayoutItem.Parent.SelectedItem;
					}
					SetClosed(floatGroup);
					Container.Activate(baseLayoutItem);
				}
				return flag;
			}
		}

		private bool CloseItem(BaseLayoutItem item, LayoutGroup parentGroup)
		{
			if (parentGroup == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DockSituation dockSituation = DockSituation.GetDockSituation(item);
			BaseLayoutItem firstOtherItem = GetFirstOtherItem(item, parentGroup.GetItems());
			BaseLayoutItem selectedItem = parentGroup.SelectedItem;
			BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = ((selectedItem == null || selectedItem == item) ? GetNextItem(item, parentGroup.GetItems()) : selectedItem);
			bool flag = item.IsActive || (item as LayoutGroup).Return((LayoutGroup x) => x.GetNestedItems().Any((BaseLayoutItem y) => y.IsActive), () => false);
			if (baseLayoutItem == null && item.IsFloating)
			{
				List<BaseLayoutItem> second = new List<BaseLayoutItem> { item };
				baseLayoutItem = (from x in Container.GetItems().Except(second)
					where x is LayoutPanel && x.IsFloating
					select x).OrderBy((BaseLayoutItem x) => ((LayoutPanel)x).LastActivationDateTime, ListSortDirection.Descending).FirstOrDefault();
			}
			bool flag2 = parentGroup.Items.Contains(item);
			if (flag2 && item is LayoutPanel)
			{
				AddPlaceHolder(item, parentGroup);
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				ClosingBehavior actualClosingBehavior = DockControllerHelper.GetActualClosingBehavior(Container, item);
				DockControllerHelper.SetClosingBehavior(item, actualClosingBehavior);
				if (parentGroup.Remove(item))
				{
					SetClosed(item, parentGroup);
					BaseLayoutItem dockTarget = parentGroup;
					if (TryUngroupGroup(parentGroup) != parentGroup)
					{
						dockTarget = firstOtherItem;
					}
					if (item.IsClosed)
					{
						item.UpdateDockSituation(dockSituation, dockTarget);
					}
				}
				if (flag && !(parentGroup is AutoHideGroup))
				{
					Container.Activate(parentGroup.SelectedItem ?? baseLayoutItem);
				}
			}
			return flag2;
		}

		private bool DockCore(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem target, DockType type, bool shouldRaiseCompleted = true)
		{
			if (!item.AllowDock)
			{
				return false;
			}
			LayoutGroup layoutGroup = ((target != null) ? LayoutGroup.GetOwnerGroup(target) : null);
			if (layoutGroup != null)
			{
				target = layoutGroup;
			}
			if (target == null)
			{
				Container.EnsureLayoutRoot();
				target = Container.LayoutRoot;
			}
			using (new NotificationBatch(Container))
			{
				bool flag;
				using (new UpdateBatch(Container))
				{
					using (new ActivateBatch(Container))
					{
						using (new LogicalTreeLocker(Container, item, target))
						{
							EnsureDockItemState(item);
							LayoutGroup parent = item.Parent;
							FloatGroup floatRoot;
							AutoHideGroup autoHideRoot;
							BaseLayoutItem itemToDock = GetItemToDock(item, out floatRoot, out autoHideRoot);
							LayoutGroup root = target.GetRoot();
							LayoutGroup parent2 = target.Parent;
							LayoutGroup affectedGroup = PlaceHolderHelper.GetAffectedGroup(item);
							if (type != DockType.None)
							{
								using (target.LockDockingTarget())
								{
									ClearPlaceHolder(itemToDock, target);
								}
							}
							BaseLayoutItem focusedItem = GetFocusedItem(itemToDock);
							bool wasHidden = CheckHideView(item);
							BaseLayoutItem actualSelectedItem = DockControllerHelper.GetActualSelectedItem(item);
							switch (type)
							{
							case DockType.None:
								flag = DockToPlaceHolder(itemToDock);
								break;
							case DockType.Fill:
								flag = DockToFillCore(itemToDock, target);
								break;
							default:
								UpdateDockTarget(type, target, parent2);
								flag = DockToSideCore(itemToDock, target, type);
								break;
							}
							if (flag)
							{
								if (type == DockType.Fill)
								{
									UpdateDockTarget(type, target, parent2);
								}
								if (actualSelectedItem.Parent != null)
								{
									ActivationHelper.SelectInGroup(actualSelectedItem, actualSelectedItem.Parent);
								}
								NotificationBatch.Action(Container, parent.GetRoot());
								UpdateDecomposedItems();
								if (target != parent)
								{
									TryUngroupGroup(parent);
								}
								if (floatRoot != root)
								{
									TryUngroupGroup(floatRoot);
								}
								if (autoHideRoot != null)
								{
									TryUngroupGroup(autoHideRoot);
									LayoutGroup.SetOwnerGroup(itemToDock, null);
									if (itemToDock is LayoutGroup)
									{
										Container.DecomposedItems.Remove((LayoutGroup)itemToDock);
									}
								}
								if (affectedGroup != null)
								{
									TryUngroupGroup(affectedGroup);
								}
								OnDockComplete(itemToDock, type, wasHidden);
								if (focusedItem != null)
								{
									Container.FocusItem(focusedItem);
								}
								DockControllerHelper.CheckUpdateView(Container, root);
								Container.Update();
								if (shouldRaiseCompleted)
								{
									OnDockOperationComplete(itemToDock, DockOperation.Dock);
								}
								NotificationBatch.Action(Container, itemToDock.GetRoot());
							}
						}
					}
				}
				return flag;
			}
		}

		private bool DockInExistingGroup(BaseLayoutItem item, LayoutGroup target, int targetPosition)
		{
			if (target == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			using (new LogicalTreeLocker(Container, item, target))
			{
				if (item is DocumentPanel && target.ItemType != LayoutItemType.DocumentPanelGroup && !(target is FloatGroup))
				{
					item = DockControllerHelper.BoxIntoDocumentGroup(item, Container);
				}
				return InsertItemInGroup(target, item, targetPosition);
			}
		}

		private void EnsureDockItemState(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item.Closed && !Container.ClosedPanels.Contains(item))
			{
				item.SetCurrentValue(BaseLayoutItem.ClosedProperty, false);
			}
			if (item is LayoutPanel { AutoHidden: not false, IsAutoHidden: false } layoutPanel)
			{
				layoutPanel.AutoHidden = false;
			}
		}

		private bool FillExistingGroup(BaseLayoutItem item, LayoutGroup target)
		{
			using (new LogicalTreeLocker(Container, item, target))
			{
				if (item is LayoutGroup { Parent: not null } layoutGroup && layoutGroup.ShouldStayInTree())
				{
					AddPlaceHolder(layoutGroup, layoutGroup.Parent);
				}
				bool flag = item.Parent == null || item.Parent.Remove(item);
				if (flag)
				{
					if (item is DocumentPanel && target.ItemType == LayoutItemType.Group)
					{
						item = DockControllerHelper.BoxIntoDocumentGroup(item, Container);
						target.Add(item);
					}
					else if (target is TabbedGroup)
					{
						target.AddRange(DockControllerHelper.Decompose(item));
					}
					else
					{
						DockSituation lastDockSituation = item.GetLastDockSituation();
						if (lastDockSituation != null)
						{
							if (lastDockSituation.Width.IsAbsolute)
							{
								item.ItemWidth = lastDockSituation.Width;
							}
							if (lastDockSituation.Height.IsAbsolute)
							{
								item.ItemHeight = lastDockSituation.Height;
							}
						}
						target.Add(item);
					}
				}
				return flag;
			}
		}

		private bool FillExistingGroup(LayoutGroup group, LayoutGroup target, int index)
		{
			using (new LogicalTreeLocker(Container, group, target))
			{
				bool flag = group.Parent == null || group.Parent.Remove(group);
				if (flag)
				{
					BaseLayoutItem selectedItem = group.SelectedItem;
					BaseLayoutItem[] array = DockControllerHelper.Decompose(group);
					BaseLayoutItem[] array2 = array;
					foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in array2)
					{
						target.Insert(index++, item);
					}
					if (selectedItem != null)
					{
						ActivationHelper.SelectInGroup(selectedItem, target);
					}
				}
				return flag;
			}
		}

		private bool FillNewTabbedGroup(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem target)
		{
			using (new LogicalTreeLocker(Container, item, target))
			{
				bool flag = item.Parent == null || item.Parent.Remove(item);
				if (flag)
				{
					LayoutGroup parent = target.Parent;
					PlaceHolderHelper.StorePositionAndRemove(parent, target);
					TabbedGroup tabbedGroup = ((target.ItemType == LayoutItemType.Document) ? DockControllerHelper.BoxIntoDocumentGroup(target, Container) : DockControllerHelper.BoxIntoTabbedGroup(target, Container));
					PlaceHolderHelper.DecomposeTo(item, tabbedGroup, out var decomposedGroups);
					decomposedGroups.ForEach(delegate(LayoutGroup x)
					{
						if (x.ShouldStayInTree())
						{
							Container.DecomposedItems.AddOnce(x);
						}
					});
					PlaceHolderHelper.InsertItemToPosition(parent, target, tabbedGroup);
					ActivationHelper.SelectInGroup(item, tabbedGroup);
				}
				return flag;
			}
		}

		private DockType GetDockType(BaseLayoutItem item, LayoutGroup parentGroup)
		{
			if (parentGroup is TabbedGroup)
			{
				return DockType.Fill;
			}
			bool flag = (double)parentGroup.Items.IndexOf(item) < (double)parentGroup.Items.Count * 0.5;
			bool flag2 = parentGroup.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal;
			if (!flag)
			{
				if (!flag2)
				{
					return DockType.Bottom;
				}
				return DockType.Right;
			}
			if (!flag2)
			{
				return DockType.Top;
			}
			return DockType.Left;
		}

		private BaseLayoutItem GetFirstOtherItem(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem[] itemsBeforeUngroup)
		{
			return Array.Find(itemsBeforeUngroup, (BaseLayoutItem i) => i != item);
		}

		private BaseLayoutItem GetFloatGroupContent(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if ((item.IsFloatingRootItem ? item.GetRoot() : item) is FloatGroup floatGroup)
			{
				if (floatGroup.Items.Count > 1 || floatGroup.HasPlaceHolders)
				{
					BoxGroupItemsInNewGroup(floatGroup, floatGroup.Orientation, Container);
				}
				item = floatGroup.Items[0];
			}
			return item;
		}

		private BaseLayoutItem GetFocusedItem(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (HasFocus(item))
			{
				return item;
			}
			if (item is LayoutGroup layoutGroup)
			{
				IEnumerable<BaseLayoutItem> nestedItems = layoutGroup.GetNestedItems();
				foreach (BaseLayoutItem item2 in nestedItems)
				{
					if (HasFocus(item2))
					{
						return item2;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private BaseLayoutItem GetItemToDock(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem result = item;
			if (item is FloatGroup floatGroup && floatGroup.Items.Count == 1)
			{
				result = floatGroup.Items[0];
			}
			if (item is AutoHideGroup autoHideGroup)
			{
				BaseLayoutItem[] items = autoHideGroup.GetItems();
				BaseLayoutItem originalItemForAutoHideGroup = GetOriginalItemForAutoHideGroup(autoHideGroup);
				if (originalItemForAutoHideGroup is TabbedGroup)
				{
					result = originalItemForAutoHideGroup;
				}
				else if (items.Length == 1)
				{
					result = items[0];
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private BaseLayoutItem GetItemToDock(BaseLayoutItem item, out FloatGroup floatRoot, out AutoHideGroup autoHideRoot)
		{
			using (new LogicalTreeLocker(Container, item))
			{
				BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = item;
				floatRoot = item.GetRoot() as FloatGroup;
				if (floatRoot != null)
				{
					baseLayoutItem = GetFloatGroupContent(item);
					SaveFloatSize(floatRoot, baseLayoutItem);
				}
				autoHideRoot = (item as AutoHideGroup) ?? (LayoutGroup.GetOwnerGroup(item) as AutoHideGroup);
				if (autoHideRoot != null)
				{
					BaseLayoutItem[] items = autoHideRoot.GetItems();
					BaseLayoutItem originalItemForAutoHideGroup = GetOriginalItemForAutoHideGroup(autoHideRoot);
					bool flag = !(originalItemForAutoHideGroup is TabbedGroup);
					if (items.Length == 1 && flag && !autoHideRoot.HasPlaceHolders)
					{
						baseLayoutItem = items[0];
					}
					else
					{
						int selectedTabIndex = autoHideRoot.SelectedTabIndex;
						CheckHideView(autoHideRoot);
						TabbedGroup tabbedGroup = (flag ? Container.GenerateGroup<TabbedGroup>() : ((TabbedGroup)originalItemForAutoHideGroup));
						if (flag)
						{
							((ISupportInitialize)tabbedGroup).BeginInit();
						}
						tabbedGroup.Manager = Container;
						PlaceHolderHelper.DecomposeTo(autoHideRoot, tabbedGroup);
						tabbedGroup.SelectedTabIndex = selectedTabIndex;
						tabbedGroup.UpdateDockSituation(autoHideRoot.GetLastDockSituation(), Container.LayoutRoot);
						AutoHideGroup.SetAutoHideType(tabbedGroup, AutoHideGroup.GetAutoHideType(autoHideRoot));
						if (flag)
						{
							((ISupportInitialize)tabbedGroup).EndInit();
						}
						baseLayoutItem = tabbedGroup;
						PlaceHolderHelper.ClearPlaceHolder(autoHideRoot);
						autoHideRoot.HasPersistentGroups = false;
					}
				}
				return baseLayoutItem;
			}
		}

		private BaseLayoutItem GetItemToFocus(LayoutGroup group, int startingIndex)
		{
			if (group.IsTabHost && group.SelectedItem != null)
			{
				return group.SelectedItem;
			}
			BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = GetItemToFocus(group.Items, startingIndex);
			if (baseLayoutItem == null)
			{
				BaseLayoutItem[] items = Container.GetItems();
				baseLayoutItem = GetItemToFocus(items, Array.IndexOf(items, group));
				if (baseLayoutItem != null && baseLayoutItem.Parent != null && baseLayoutItem.Parent.IsTabHost)
				{
					baseLayoutItem = baseLayoutItem.Parent.SelectedItem;
				}
			}
			return baseLayoutItem;
		}

		private BaseLayoutItem GetItemToFocus(IEnumerable<BaseLayoutItem> items, int startingIndex)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = items.Skip(startingIndex).FirstOrDefault((BaseLayoutItem x) => x is LayoutPanel && !x.IsAutoHidden);
			if (baseLayoutItem == null)
			{
				baseLayoutItem = items.Take(startingIndex).Reverse().FirstOrDefault((BaseLayoutItem x) => x is LayoutPanel && !x.IsAutoHidden);
			}
			return baseLayoutItem;
		}

		private BaseLayoutItem GetLayout(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem panelLayout = GetPanelLayout(item as LayoutPanel);
			if (item is LayoutGroup layoutGroup)
			{
				panelLayout = GetPanelLayout(layoutGroup.SelectedItem as LayoutPanel);
			}
			return panelLayout;
		}

		private DockLayoutManager GetLinkedManager(BaseLayoutItem target)
		{
			DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = target.Return((BaseLayoutItem x) => x.Manager, () => (DockLayoutManager)null);
			if (dockLayoutManager == null || dockLayoutManager.IsDisposing)
			{
				return Container;
			}
			return dockLayoutManager;
		}

		private BaseLayoutItem GetNextItem(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem[] items)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = null;
			BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem2 = null;
			int num = Array.IndexOf(items, item);
			int num2 = num + 1;
			int num3 = num - 1;
			if (items.IsValidIndex(num2))
			{
				baseLayoutItem = items[num2];
			}
			if (items.IsValidIndex(num3))
			{
				baseLayoutItem2 = items[num3];
			}
			return baseLayoutItem2 ?? baseLayoutItem;
		}

		private BaseLayoutItem GetOriginalItemForAutoHideGroup(AutoHideGroup autoHideRoot)
		{
			PlaceHolder placeHolder = PlaceHolderHelper.GetPlaceHolder(autoHideRoot, PlaceHolderState.Unset);
			if (!(placeHolder != null))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return placeHolder.Parent;
		}

		private LayoutGroup GetPanelLayout(LayoutPanel panel)
		{
			if (panel == null || !panel.IsControlItemsHost)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return panel.Layout;
		}

		private bool HasFocus(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (!(item is LayoutPanel layoutPanel))
			{
				return false;
			}
			UIElement uIElement = layoutPanel.Control ?? layoutPanel.ContentPresenter;
			if (uIElement != null)
			{
				if (!KeyboardFocusHelper.IsKeyboardFocused(uIElement))
				{
					return KeyboardFocusHelper.IsKeyboardFocusWithin(uIElement);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void LockActivate()
		{
			lockActivateCounter++;
		}
