		}

		private void RemovePanelCore(LayoutPanel panel)
		{
			Container.ClosedPanels.Remove(panel);
			DockLayoutManager.RemoveLogicalChild(Container, panel);
			panel.Manager = null;
			Container.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				DestroyPanelContent(panel);
			}, DispatcherPriority.Render);
			ClearPlaceHolder(panel);
		}

		private void RestorePlaceHoldersRelations(IEnumerable<LayoutGroup> restoredGroups)
		{
			List<LayoutGroup> list = restoredGroups.ToList();
			LayoutGroup layoutGroup = restoredGroups.FirstOrDefault((LayoutGroup x) => x.Parent is FloatGroup);
			if (layoutGroup != null)
			{
				LayoutGroup root = layoutGroup.GetRoot();
				PlaceHolder[] array = layoutGroup.PlaceHolderHelper.GetPlaceHolders().ToArray();
				PlaceHolder[] array2 = array;
				foreach (PlaceHolder placeHolder in array2)
				{
					if (placeHolder.Owner is LayoutGroup layoutGroup2)
					{
						IEnumerable<BaseLayoutItem> first = from x in layoutGroup2.PlaceHolderHelper.GetPlaceHolders()
							select x.Owner;
						if (first.Intersect(root.Items).Any())
						{
							DockInExistingGroup(layoutGroup2, layoutGroup, PlaceHolderHelper.GetDockIndex(placeHolder));
							PlaceHolderHelper.ClearPlaceHolder(layoutGroup2, placeHolder);
							list.Add(layoutGroup2);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (LayoutGroup item in list)
			{
				PlaceHolder[] array3 = item.PlaceHolderHelper.GetPlaceHolders().ToArray();
				PlaceHolder[] array4 = array3;
				foreach (PlaceHolder placeHolder2 in array4)
				{
					BaseLayoutItem owner = placeHolder2.Owner;
					if (owner.Parent != null && ((owner.IsFloating && owner.Parent == item.GetRoot()) || object.Equals(item.Parent, owner.Parent)))
					{
						DockInExistingGroup(owner, item, PlaceHolderHelper.GetDockIndex(placeHolder2));
						PlaceHolderHelper.ClearPlaceHolder(owner, placeHolder2);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private bool RestoreToFloatingPlaceHolder(BaseLayoutItem item, PlaceHolder placeHolder)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			using (new LogicalTreeLocker(Container, PlaceHolderHelper.GetLayoutHierarchy(placeHolder).ToArray()))
			{
				LayoutGroup targetGroup;
				LayoutGroup[] array = PlaceHolderHelper.RestoreLayoutHierarchy(Container, placeHolder, out targetGroup).ToArray();
				FloatGroup floatGroup = (targetGroup as FloatGroup) ?? (targetGroup.GetRoot() as FloatGroup);
				bool flag2 = floatGroup == null;
				if (flag2)
				{
					floatGroup = Container.GenerateGroup<FloatGroup>();
				}
				bool flag3 = false;
				if (!Container.FloatGroups.Contains(floatGroup))
				{
					flag3 = true;
					Container.DecomposedItems.Remove(floatGroup);
					LayoutPanel layoutPanel = (LayoutPanel)item;
					if (flag2)
					{
						((ISupportInitialize)floatGroup).BeginInit();
					}
					if (layoutPanel.HasFloatLocationBeforeClose)
					{
						floatGroup.FloatLocation = layoutPanel.FloatLocationBeforeClose;
					}
					if (!MathHelper.IsEmpty(layoutPanel.FloatSizeBeforeClose))
					{
						floatGroup.FloatSize = layoutPanel.FloatSizeBeforeClose;
					}
					if (flag2)
					{
						((ISupportInitialize)floatGroup).EndInit();
					}
					if (layoutPanel.HasFloatOffsetBeforeClose)
					{
						Container.CheckFloatGroupRestoreBounds(floatGroup, layoutPanel.FloatOffsetBeforeClose);
					}
					else
					{
						Container.CheckFloatGroupRestoreBounds(floatGroup, floatGroup.FloatOffsetBeforeClose);
					}
					Container.FloatGroups.Add(floatGroup);
				}
				RestorePlaceHoldersRelations(array);
				LayoutGroup layoutGroup = array.FirstOrDefault();
				if (flag2 && layoutGroup == null)
				{
					if (item is DocumentPanel && Container.FloatingDocumentContainer == FloatingDocumentContainer.DocumentHost)
					{
						item = DockControllerHelper.BoxIntoDocumentHost(item, Container);
					}
					floatGroup.Add(item);
				}
				else
				{
					if (flag2)
					{
						floatGroup.Add(layoutGroup);
					}
					flag = RestoreToPlaceHolder(item, placeHolder);
				}
				if (flag && flag3 && floatGroup.FloatState == FloatState.Minimized)
				{
					floatGroup.SetFloatState(FloatState.Normal);
				}
				PlaceHolderHelper.ClearPlaceHolder(item, placeHolder);
				if (flag)
				{
					using (item.GetRoot().LockDockingTarget())
					{
						array.Reverse().ForEach(delegate(LayoutGroup x)
						{
							TryUngroupGroup(x);
						});
					}
				}
				return flag;
			}
		}

		private bool RestoreToPlaceHolder(BaseLayoutItem item, bool isRestore = false)
		{
			PlaceHolder placeHolderForDockOperation = PlaceHolderHelper.GetPlaceHolderForDockOperation(item, isRestore);
			if (placeHolderForDockOperation == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			LayoutGroup parent = placeHolderForDockOperation.Parent;
			PlaceHolder placeHolderRoot = PlaceHolderHelper.GetPlaceHolderRoot(placeHolderForDockOperation);
			return (!parent.IsInTree() && ((placeHolderRoot.Parent != null && placeHolderRoot.Parent.IsInTree()) ? placeHolderRoot.Parent.IsFloating : placeHolderRoot.IsFloating)) ? RestoreToFloatingPlaceHolder(item, placeHolderForDockOperation) : RestoreToPlaceHolder(item, placeHolderForDockOperation);
		}

		private bool RestoreToPlaceHolder(BaseLayoutItem item, PlaceHolder placeHolder)
		{
			using (new LogicalTreeLocker(Container, PlaceHolderHelper.GetLayoutHierarchy(placeHolder).ToArray()))
			{
				LayoutGroup targetGroup;
				IEnumerable<LayoutGroup> restoredGroups = PlaceHolderHelper.RestoreLayoutHierarchy(Container, placeHolder, out targetGroup);
				if (targetGroup is FloatGroup { FloatState: FloatState.Minimized } floatGroup)
				{
					Container.MDIController.Restore(floatGroup);
				}
				int dockIndex = PlaceHolderHelper.GetDockIndex(item, placeHolder);
				bool flag = DockInExistingGroup(item, targetGroup, dockIndex);
				if (flag)
				{
					LayoutGroup root = item.GetRoot();
					if (root is AutoHideGroup item2 && !Container.AutoHideGroups.Contains(item2))
					{
						Container.AutoHideGroups.Add(item2);
						Container.DecomposedItems.Remove(item2);
					}
					if (root is FloatGroup item3 && !Container.FloatGroups.Contains(item3))
					{
						Container.FloatGroups.Add(item3);
						Container.DecomposedItems.Remove(item3);
					}
					item.UpdateDockSituation(item.Parent, DockType.None);
				}
				RestorePlaceHoldersRelations(restoredGroups);
				PlaceHolderHelper.ClearPlaceHolder(item, placeHolder);
				return flag;
			}
		}

		private void SaveFloatSize(FloatGroup floatRoot, BaseLayoutItem itemToDock)
		{
			Thickness thickness = new Thickness(0.0);
			if (Container.GetUIElement(floatRoot) is FloatPanePresenter floatPanePresenter)
			{
				thickness = floatPanePresenter.GetFloatingMargin();
			}
			itemToDock.FloatSize = new Size(Math.Max(1.0, floatRoot.FloatSize.Width - (thickness.Left + thickness.Right)), Math.Max(1.0, floatRoot.FloatSize.Height - (thickness.Top + thickness.Bottom)));
		}

		private void SetActive(bool value)
		{
			if (ActiveItem != null)
			{
				ActiveItem.SetActive(value);
				if (value && lockActivateCounter == 0)
				{
					ActivationHelper.SelectInGroup(ActiveItem);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetActiveItemCore(BaseLayoutItem value)
		{
			SetActive(value: false);
			BaseLayoutItem oldItem = activeItemCore;
			activeItemCore = value;
			SetActive(value: true);
			Container.isDockItemActivation++;
			Container.ActiveDockItem = ActiveItem;
			Container.isDockItemActivation--;
			RaiseActiveItemChanged(value, oldItem);
		}

		private void SetClosed(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			SetClosed(item, item as LayoutGroup);
		}

		private void SetClosed(BaseLayoutItem item, LayoutGroup parent)
		{
			FloatGroup floatGroup = (item as FloatGroup) ?? (parent.GetRoot() as FloatGroup);
			FloatGroup floatGroup2 = (item as FloatGroup) ?? (parent as FloatGroup);
			List<BaseLayoutItem> panels = new List<BaseLayoutItem>();
			List<BaseLayoutItem> items = new List<BaseLayoutItem>();
			item.Accept(delegate(BaseLayoutItem i)
			{
				items.Add(i);
				if (i is LayoutPanel)
				{
					panels.Add(i);
				}
			});
			if (floatGroup2 != null)
			{
				foreach (BaseLayoutItem item3 in items)
				{
					if (item3.Parent != null)
					{
						AddPlaceHolder(item3, item3.Parent);
					}
				}
			}
			Point restoreOffset = Container.GetRestoreOffset();
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item4 in items)
			{
				LayoutPanel layoutPanel = item4 as LayoutPanel;
				bool flag = layoutPanel != null;
				if (layoutPanel != null && floatGroup != null)
				{
					layoutPanel.UpdateDockSituation(null, null);
					layoutPanel.FloatLocationBeforeClose = floatGroup.FloatLocation;
					layoutPanel.FloatSizeBeforeClose = floatGroup.FloatSize;
					layoutPanel.FloatOffsetBeforeClose = restoreOffset;
					flag = !layoutPanel.ExecuteCloseCommand();
				}
				if (item4.Parent != null)
				{
					item4.Parent.Remove(item4);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					if (DockControllerHelper.GetActualClosingBehavior(Container, layoutPanel) == ClosingBehavior.ImmediatelyRemove)
					{
						RemovePanelCore(layoutPanel);
					}
					else
					{
						Container.ClosedPanels.Add(layoutPanel);
					}
				}
			}
			if (floatGroup != null)
			{
				floatGroup.FloatOffsetBeforeClose = restoreOffset;
			}
			(item as LayoutGroup).Do(delegate(LayoutGroup x)
			{
				x.IsUngroupped = true;
			});
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item5 in items)
			{
				if (item5 is LayoutGroup item2)
				{
					Container.DecomposedItems.AddOnce(item2);
				}
			}
			if (panels.Contains(Container.ActiveDockItem))
			{
				Container.ActiveDockItem = null;
			}
			if (panels.Contains(Container.ActiveMDIItem))
			{
				Container.ActiveMDIItem = null;
			}
		}

		private LayoutGroup TryUngroupCore(LayoutGroup group)
		{
			if (group == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (group.IsPermanent)
			{
				return group;
			}
			using (new LogicalTreeLocker(Container, group))
			{
				LayoutGroup parent = group.Parent;
				switch (group.Items.Count)
				{
				case 0:
					if (group is AutoHideGroup autoHideGroup)
					{
						if (autoHideGroup.HasPersistentGroups)
						{
							return group;
						}
						CloseAutoHideGroup(autoHideGroup);
					}
					else if (group is FloatGroup)
					{
						Action action = delegate
						{
							CloseFloatGroup(group as FloatGroup);
						};
						if (Container.ViewAdapter.IsInEvent && Container.IsFloating)
						{
							DelayedExecutionExtension.DelayedExecuteEnqueue((object)Container, action);
						}
						else
						{
							action();
						}
					}
					else
					{
						bool flag = parent != null && group.ShouldStayInTree();
						if (flag)
						{
							AddPlaceHolder(group, parent);
							group.IsUngroupped = true;
						}
						if (!CloseItem(group, parent))
						{
							if (group.Parent == null && flag)
							{
								Container.DecomposedItems.AddOnce(group);
							}
							break;
						}
					}
					return parent;
				case 1:
				{
					if (!DockControllerHelper.CanUnboxGroupWithSingleItem(group, Container, group.HasPlaceHolders))
					{
						return group;
					}
					BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = group.Items[0];
					if (parent != null)
					{
						if (parent.IgnoreOrientation || parent.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
						{
							if (!baseLayoutItem.ItemWidth.IsAbsolute)
							{
								baseLayoutItem.ItemWidth = group.ItemWidth;
							}
						}
						else if (!baseLayoutItem.ItemHeight.IsAbsolute)
						{
							baseLayoutItem.ItemHeight = group.ItemHeight;
						}
					}
					if (baseLayoutItem.ItemType != LayoutItemType.TabPanelGroup)
					{
						TryUngroupGroup(baseLayoutItem as LayoutGroup);
					}
					Action<LayoutGroup> beforeUnboxing = delegate(LayoutGroup x)
					{
						LayoutGroup parent2 = x.Parent;
						if (parent2 != null && x.ShouldStayInTree())
						{
							AddPlaceHolder(x, parent2);
							if (x.HasItems)
							{
								AddPlaceHolder(x.Items[0], x);
							}
							x.IsUngroupped = true;
						}
					};
					Action<LayoutGroup> afterUnboxing = delegate(LayoutGroup x)
					{
						if (x.ShouldStayInTree() && x.Parent == null)
						{
							Container.DecomposedItems.AddOnce(x);
						}
					};
					LayoutGroup layoutGroup = DockControllerHelper.Unbox(Container, group, beforeUnboxing, afterUnboxing);
					if (layoutGroup is FloatGroup && layoutGroup.Items.Count > 0 && layoutGroup[0] is LayoutGroup)
					{
						TryUngroupGroup((LayoutGroup)layoutGroup[0]);
					}
					return layoutGroup;
				}
				}
				return group;
			}
		}

		private void UnlockActivate()
		{
			lockActivateCounter--;
		}

		private void UpdateDecomposedItems()
		{
			Dictionary<LayoutGroup, LayoutGroup[]> dictionary = Container.DecomposedItems.ToDictionary((LayoutGroup x) => x, (LayoutGroup x) => PlaceHolderHelper.GetAffectedGroups(x));
			Container.DecomposedItems.Purge();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<LayoutGroup, LayoutGroup[]> item in dictionary)
			{
				if (!Container.DecomposedItems.Contains(item.Key))
				{
					LayoutGroup[] value = item.Value;
					LayoutGroup[] array = value;
					foreach (LayoutGroup layoutGroup in array)
					{
						TryUngroupGroup(layoutGroup);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateDockTarget(DockType dockType, BaseLayoutItem dockTarget, BaseLayoutItem targetParent)
		{
			if (dockType == DockType.None || !dockTarget.IsFloating || !dockTarget.IsInTree())
			{
				return;
			}
			PlaceHolder placeHolder = PlaceHolderHelper.GetPlaceHolder(dockTarget, PlaceHolderState.Floating);
			if (placeHolder == null || placeHolder.Parent == null || placeHolder.Parent.IsInTree())
			{
				return;
			}
			LayoutGroup parent = placeHolder.Parent;
			LayoutGroup parent2 = dockTarget.Parent;
			if (dockType == DockType.Fill)
			{
				if (targetParent != dockTarget.Parent)
				{
					PlaceHolderHelper.ReplacePlaceHolderOwner(parent, placeHolder, parent2);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				DockInExistingGroup(parent, parent2, parent2.IndexFromItem(dockTarget));
				Container.DecomposedItems.Remove(parent);
				PlaceHolderHelper.ClearPlaceHolder(parent);
				RestoreToPlaceHolder(dockTarget, placeHolder);
			}
		}

		void ILockOwner.Lock()
		{
			LockActivate();
		}

		void ILockOwner.Unlock()
		{
			UnlockActivate();
		}
	}
	public static class DockLayoutManagerExtension
	{
		public static void BeginUpdate(this DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			manager.Do(delegate(ISupportBatchUpdate x)
			{
				x.BeginUpdate();
			});
		}

		public static void EndUpdate(this DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			manager.Do(delegate(ISupportBatchUpdate x)
			{
				x.EndUpdate();
			});
		}

		internal static string GetThemeName(DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			return BarManagerHelper.GetThemeName((DependencyObject)manager);
		}

		public static void Update(this DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			manager?.Update();
		}

		public static void AddToLogicalTree(this DockLayoutManager manager, FloatingContainer container, object content)
		{
			if (manager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DockLayoutManager.AddLogicalChild(manager, (DependencyObject)(object)container);
			DockLayoutManager.AddLogicalChild(manager, content as FrameworkElement);
			if (!(content is IControlHost))
			{
				return;
			}
			FrameworkElement[] children = ((IControlHost)content).GetChildren();
			for (int i = 0; i < children.Length; i++)
			{
				if (children[i] != null)
				{
					DockLayoutManager.AddLogicalChild(manager, children[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void RemoveFromLogicalTree(this DockLayoutManager manager, FloatingContainer container, object content)
		{
			if (manager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DockLayoutManager.RemoveLogicalChild(manager, (DependencyObject)(object)container);
			DockLayoutManager.RemoveLogicalChild(manager, content as FrameworkElement);
			if (!(content is IControlHost))
			{
				return;
			}
			FrameworkElement[] children = ((IControlHost)content).GetChildren();
			for (int i = 0; i < children.Length; i++)
			{
				if (children[i] != null)
				{
					DockLayoutManager.RemoveLogicalChild(manager, children[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static IUIElement FindUIScope(this DependencyObject dObj)
		{
			if (dObj is DockLayoutManager)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (dObj is AutoHideTray)
			{
				return ((IUIElement)dObj).Scope;
			}
			if (dObj is FloatPanePresenter)
			{
				return ((IUIElement)dObj).Scope;
			}
			while (dObj != null)
			{
				dObj = GetVisualOrLogicalParent(dObj);
				if (dObj is IUIElement)
				{
					return dObj as IUIElement;
				}
				if (dObj is FloatPanePresenter.FloatingContentPresenter)
				{
					return ((ManagedContentPresenter)(FloatPanePresenter.FloatingContentPresenter)(object)dObj).Container as IUIElement;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static DependencyObject GetVisualOrLogicalParent(DependencyObject dObj)
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = ((dObj is Visual) ? VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dObj) : null);
			return dependencyObject ?? LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(dObj);
		}

		internal static IUIElement GetRootUIScope(this IUIElement element)
		{
			while (element != null && !(element.Scope is DockLayoutManager))
			{
				element = element.Scope;
			}
			return element;
		}

		internal static void Update(this LayoutGroup group, bool shouldUpdateLayout)
		{
			DockLayoutManager manager = group.GetManager();
			if (manager != null && !manager.IsDisposing)
			{
				manager.Update(shouldUpdateLayout);
			}
		}

		internal static void RebuildLayoutAndUpdate(this LayoutGroup group, bool shouldUpdateLayout = true)
		{
			if (group.ItemType == LayoutItemType.Group && group.GroupBorderStyle != GroupBorderStyle.Tabbed)
			{
				LayoutTreeHelper.GetVisualChildren((DependencyObject)group).OfType<GroupPanel>().FirstOrDefault()
					.Do(delegate(GroupPanel x)
					{
						x.RebuildLayout();
					});
			}
			else if (group.ItemType == LayoutItemType.FloatGroup)
			{
				LayoutTreeHelper.GetVisualChildren((DependencyObject)(((LayoutView)group.Manager.GetView(group))?.RootUIElement)).OfType<GroupPanel>().FirstOrDefault()
					.Do(delegate(GroupPanel x)
					{
						x.RebuildLayout();
					});
			}
			group.Update(shouldUpdateLayout);
		}

		internal static void Update(this LayoutGroup group)
		{
			DockLayoutManager manager = group.GetManager();
			if (manager != null && !manager.IsDisposing)
			{
				manager.Update();
			}
		}

		private static DockLayoutManager GetManager(this LayoutGroup group)
		{
			while (group != null)
			{
				if (group.Manager != null)
				{
					return group.Manager;
				}
				group = group.Parent;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static IUIElement GetManager(this IUIElement element)
		{
			while (element != null && !(element is DockLayoutManager))
			{
				element = ((element.Scope != null) ? element.Scope : (element as DependencyObject).GetParentIUIElement());
			}
			return element;
		}

		internal static IUIElement GetParentIUIElement(this DependencyObject dObj)
		{
			if (dObj != null)
			{
				do
				{
					dObj = GetVisualParent(dObj);
					if (dObj is IUIElement)
					{
						return dObj as IUIElement;
					}
				}
				while (dObj != null);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static DependencyObject GetVisualParent(DependencyObject child)
		{
			if (child is FloatPanePresenter.FloatingContentPresenter)
			{
				child = (DependencyObject)(object)((ManagedContentPresenter)(FloatPanePresenter.FloatingContentPresenter)(object)child).Container;
			}
			return VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(child);
		}

		public static ILayoutElement GetViewElement(this DockLayoutManager container, IUIElement element)
		{
			return container.GetView(element.GetRootUIScope())?.GetElement(element);
		}

		internal static IView GetView(this DockLayoutManager container, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			return container.GetView(item.GetRoot());
		}

		public static IView GetView(this DockLayoutManager container, LayoutGroup group)
		{
			if (group == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IUIElement uIElement = group.GetUIElement<IUIElement>();
			return container.GetView(uIElement.GetRootUIScope());
		}

		public static IView GetView(this DockLayoutManager container, IUIElement element)
		{
			if (element != null && container != null && container.ViewAdapter != null)
			{
				foreach (IView item in (IEnumerable<IView>)container.ViewAdapter.Views)
				{
					if (item.RootKey == element)
					{
						return item;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static UIElement GetUIElement(this DockLayoutManager container, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return item.GetUIElement<IUIElement>() as UIElement;
		}

		public static T GetUIElement<T>(this DockLayoutManager container, BaseLayoutItem item) where T : class
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return item.GetUIElement<T>();
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static UIElement GetLastUIElement(this DockLayoutManager container, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				IUIElement[] elements = item.UIElements.GetElements();
				if (elements == null || elements.Length == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return elements[elements.Length - 1] as UIElement;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static BaseLayoutItem GetItem(this DockLayoutManager container, string name)
		{
			return BaseLayoutItemCollection.FindItem(container.GetItems(), name);
		}

		public static BaseLayoutItem[] GetItems(this DockLayoutManager container)
		{
			if (container == null)
			{
				return EmptyArray<BaseLayoutItem>.Instance;
			}
			List<BaseLayoutItem> items = new List<BaseLayoutItem>();
			if (container.LayoutRoot != null)
			{
				container.LayoutRoot.Accept(items.Add);
			}
			if (container.FloatGroups != null)
			{
				container.FloatGroups.Accept(delegate(FloatGroup fGroup)
				{
					fGroup.Accept(items.Add);
				});
			}
			if (container.AutoHideGroups != null)
			{
				container.AutoHideGroups.Accept(delegate(AutoHideGroup ahGroup)
				{
					ahGroup.Accept(items.Add);
				});
			}
			if (container.ClosedPanels != null)
			{
				container.ClosedPanels.Accept(items.Add);
			}
			if (container.DecomposedItems != null)
			{
				container.DecomposedItems.Accept(items.Add);
			}
			if (container.HiddenItems != null)
			{
				container.HiddenItems.Accept(delegate(BaseLayoutItem hiddenItem)
				{
					hiddenItem.Accept(items.Add);
				});
			}
			List<BaseLayoutItem> list = new List<BaseLayoutItem>();
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in items)
			{
				list.Add(item);
				if (item is LayoutPanel { Layout: not null } layoutPanel)
				{
					layoutPanel.Layout.Accept(list.Add);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public static LayoutElementHitInfo CalcHitInfo(this DockLayoutManager container, Point point)
		{
			if (container == null)
			{
				return LayoutElementHitInfo.Empty;
			}
			LayoutElementHitInfo empty = LayoutElementHitInfo.Empty;
			IView view = container.ViewAdapter.GetView(point);
			if (view != null)
			{
				Point pt = view.ScreenToClient(point);
				return view.Adapter.CalcHitInfo(view, pt);
			}
			return empty;
		}

		public static void InvalidateView(this DockLayoutManager container, LayoutGroup group)
		{
			if (group != null)
			{
				IUIElement element = group.UIElements.GetElement<IUIElement>() ?? group;
				container.GetView(element.GetRootUIScope())?.Invalidate();
			}
		}

		public static void HideView(this DockLayoutManager container, LayoutGroup group)
		{
			container.HideView(group, immediately: true);
		}

		public static void HideView(this DockLayoutManager container, LayoutGroup group, bool immediately)
		{
			if (group == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IUIElement element = group.GetUIElement<IUIElement>() ?? group;
			using (new LogicalTreeLocker(container, group))
			{
				IView view = container.GetView(element.GetRootUIScope());
				if (view != null && view.Type == HostType.AutoHide)
				{
					container.ViewAdapter.ActionService.Hide(view, immediately);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsViewCreated(this DockLayoutManager container, LayoutGroup group)
		{
			if (group == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IUIElement element = group.GetUIElement<IUIElement>() ?? group;
			return container.GetView(element) != null;
		}

		internal static Comparison<FloatGroup> GetFloatGroupComparison(this DockLayoutManager container)
		{
			return delegate(FloatGroup g1, FloatGroup g2)
			{
				if (g1 != g2)
				{
					IView view = container.GetView(g1.UIElements.GetElement<FloatPanePresenter>());
					IView view2 = container.GetView(g2.UIElements.GetElement<FloatPanePresenter>());
					if (view == null || view2 == null)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					return view2.ZOrder.CompareTo(view.ZOrder);
				}
				return 0;
			};
		}

		internal static bool IsInContainer(DependencyObject dObj)
		{
			return LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<DockLayoutManager>(dObj) != null;
		}

		internal static bool IsInFloatingContainer(DependencyObject dObj)
		{
			return LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<FloatPanePresenter.FloatingContentPresenter>(dObj) != null;
		}

		internal static void RaiseShowingDockHintsEvent(this DockLayoutManager container, BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem target, DockHintsConfiguration state = null)
		{
			ShowingDockHintsEventArgs e = new ShowingDockHintsEventArgs(item, target)
			{
				DockHintsConfiguration = (state ?? new DockHintsConfiguration())
			};
			container.RaiseEvent(e);
		}

		internal static bool RaiseShowingTabHintsEvent(this DockLayoutManager container, BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem target, int insertIndex, Rect tab, Rect tabHeader)
		{
			if (target is LayoutGroup layoutGroup && layoutGroup.Items.IsValidIndex(insertIndex))
			{
				target = layoutGroup[insertIndex];
			}
			ShowingDockHintsEventArgs e = new ShowingDockHintsEventArgs(item, target)
			{
				DockHintsConfiguration = new DockHintsConfiguration(),
				Tab = tab,
				TabHeader = tabHeader,
				TabIndex = insertIndex
			};
			container.RaiseEvent(e);
			return e.DockHintsConfiguration.GetIsVisible(DockHint.TabHeader);
		}

		internal static bool RaiseBeforeItemAddedEvent(this DockLayoutManager container, object item, BaseLayoutItem target, out BaseLayoutItem actualTarget)
		{
			BeforeItemAddedEventArgs e = new BeforeItemAddedEventArgs(item, target);
			container.RaiseEvent(e);
			actualTarget = (e.Cancel ? null : e.Target);
			return e.Cancel;
		}

		internal static bool RaiseDockOperationStartingEvent(this DockLayoutManager container, DockOperation dockOperation, BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem target = null)
		{
			DockOperationStartingEventArgs e = new DockOperationStartingEventArgs(item, target, dockOperation)
			{
				Source = container
			};
			container.RaiseEvent(e);
			return e.Cancel;
		}

		internal static void RaiseDockOperationCompletedEvent(this DockLayoutManager container, DockOperation dockOperation, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			DockOperationCompletedEventArgs e = new DockOperationCompletedEventArgs(item, dockOperation)
			{
				Source = container
			};
			container.RaiseEvent(e);
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static void EnsureCustomizationRoot(this DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			if (manager.CustomizationController.CustomizationRoot == null)
			{
				manager.CustomizationController.CustomizationRoot = manager.LayoutRoot;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static void EnsureCustomizationRoot(this DockLayoutManager manager, LayoutGroup root)
		{
			manager.CustomizationController.CustomizationRoot = root;
		}

		internal static bool ProcessPanelNavigation(this DockLayoutManager manager, BaseLayoutItem activeItem, bool forward)
		{
			if (activeItem != null && !(activeItem is LayoutPanel))
			{
				activeItem = activeItem.GetRoot().ParentPanel;
			}
			if (activeItem != null)
			{
				BaseLayoutItem[] items = manager.GetItems();
				ObservableCollection<BaseLayoutItem> observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<BaseLayoutItem>();
				BaseLayoutItem[] array = items;
				foreach (BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem in array)
				{
					if (!baseLayoutItem.IsClosed && (baseLayoutItem.ItemType == LayoutItemType.Document || baseLayoutItem.ItemType == LayoutItemType.Panel))
					{
						observableCollection.Add(baseLayoutItem);
					}
				}
				if (observableCollection.Count > 0)
				{
					int num = observableCollection.IndexOf(activeItem) + (forward ? 1 : (-1));
					if (num >= observableCollection.Count)
					{
						num = 0;
					}
					if (num < 0)
					{
						num = observableCollection.Count - 1;
					}
					manager.Activate(observableCollection[num]);
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static T FindName<T>(this DockLayoutManager manager, string name) where T : class
		{
			return LayoutHelper.FindElementByName((FrameworkElement)manager, name) as T;
		}

		internal static double GetAvailableAutoHideSize(this DockLayoutManager container, bool horz)
		{
			Rect autoHideResizeBounds = container.GetAutoHideResizeBounds();
			if (!autoHideResizeBounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				if (!horz)
				{
					return autoHideResizeBounds.Height;
				}
				return autoHideResizeBounds.Width;
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}

		internal static Rect GetAutoHideResizeBounds(this DockLayoutManager container)
		{
			FrameworkElement autoHideLayer = container.AutoHideLayer;
			if (autoHideLayer == null || autoHideLayer.ActualWidth == 0.0 || autoHideLayer.ActualHeight == 0.0)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			if (container.AutoHideMode == AutoHideMode.Inline)
			{
				Point location = CoordinateHelper.PointToScreen(container, autoHideLayer, default(Point));
				Size size = new Size(autoHideLayer.ActualWidth, autoHideLayer.ActualHeight);
				return new Rect(location, size);
			}
			IView view = container.GetView(container.LayoutRoot);
			if (view == null)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			if (view.LayoutRoot == null)
			{
				view.EnsureLayoutRoot();
			}
			if ((view.LayoutRoot.IsReady && view.LayoutRoot.Size.Height == 0.0) || view.LayoutRoot.Size.Width == 0.0)
			{
				view.LayoutRoot.Invalidate();
			}
			view.LayoutRoot.EnsureBounds();
			Rect screenRect = ElementHelper.GetScreenRect(view);
			RectHelper.Inflate(ref screenRect, -25.0, -12.5);
			return screenRect;
		}

		internal static void Deactivate(this DockLayoutManager container, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (!container.IsActivationLocked)
			{
				if (container.ActiveDockItem == item)
				{
					container.ActiveDockItem = null;
				}
				if (container.ActiveMDIItem == item)
				{
					container.ActiveMDIItem = null;
				}
				if (container.ActiveLayoutItem == item)
				{
					container.ActiveLayoutItem = null;
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public static ICustomizationController GetCustomizationController(this DockLayoutManager container)
		{
			return container.CustomizationController;
		}

		private static ILayoutElement GetViewElementFromUIElements(DockLayoutManager container, BaseLayoutItem context)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return container.GetViewElement(context) ?? container.GetViewElement(context.GetUIElement<IUIElement>(skipSelf: true));
		}

		internal static bool CanExecuteContextAction(this DockLayoutManager container, ContextAction action, BaseLayoutItem context)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DockLayoutManager actualViewOwner = container.GetActualViewOwner(context);
			IView view = actualViewOwner.GetView(context.GetRoot());
			if (view == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ILayoutElement element = GetViewElementFromUIElements(actualViewOwner, context) ?? GetViewElementFromUIElements(actualViewOwner, context.GetRoot());
			return actualViewOwner.ViewAdapter.ContextActionService.CanExecute(view, element, action);
		}

		internal static void ExecuteContextAction(this DockLayoutManager container, ContextAction action, BaseLayoutItem context)
		{
			if (context != null)
			{
				DockLayoutManager actualViewOwner = container.GetActualViewOwner(context);
				IView view = actualViewOwner.GetView(context.GetRoot());
				ILayoutElement element = GetViewElementFromUIElements(actualViewOwner, context) ?? GetViewElementFromUIElements(actualViewOwner, context.GetRoot());
				actualViewOwner.ViewAdapter.ContextActionService.Execute(view, element, action);
			}
		}

		internal static Point GetDragOffset(this DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			FloatPaneElementsThemeKeyExtension obj = new FloatPaneElementsThemeKeyExtension
			{
				ResourceKey = FloatPaneElements.WindowDraggingOffset
			};
			((ThemeKeyExtensionGeneric)obj).ThemeName = GetThemeName(manager);
			object obj2 = ResourceHelper.FindResource((FrameworkElement)manager, (object)obj);
			if (obj2 == null)
			{
				return default(Point);
			}
			return (Point)obj2;
		}

		internal static IEnumerable<Window> GetAffectedWindows(this DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			return manager.GetApplicationWindows() ?? manager.GetOwnedWindows();
		}

		internal static List<Window> GetAllAffectedWindows(this DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			List<Window> applicationWindows = manager.GetApplicationWindows();
			if (applicationWindows != null)
			{
				return applicationWindows;
			}
			List<Window> ownedWindows = manager.GetOwnedWindows();
			return ownedWindows.Concat(((IEnumerable<DockLayoutManager>)manager.Linked).SelectMany(GetOwnedWindows)).Distinct().ToList();
		}

		private static List<Window> GetApplicationWindows(this DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			if (Application.Current == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!manager.Dispatcher.CheckAccess())
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (from x in PresentationSource.CurrentSources.OfType<PresentationSource>()
				select x.RootVisual into x
				where x != null
				where x.Dispatcher.CheckAccess()
				select x).OfType<Window>().ToList();
		}

		private static List<Window> GetOwnedWindows(this DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			List<Window> windows = new List<Window>();
			if (manager != null && manager.Dispatcher.CheckAccess())
			{
				(LayoutHelper.FindRoot((DependencyObject)manager, false) as Window).Do(delegate(Window x)
				{
					windows.Add(x);
				});
				foreach (FloatGroup floatGroup in manager.FloatGroups)
				{
					floatGroup.With((FloatGroup x) => x.Window).Do(delegate(FloatingPaneWindow x)
					{
						windows.Add((Window)(object)x);
					});
				}
			}
			return windows;
		}

		internal static Rect CorrectBoundsInAdorner(this DockLayoutManager container, Rect bounds)
		{
			return GeometryHelper.CorrectBounds(bounds, CoordinateHelper.GetAvailableAdornerRect(container, bounds), WindowHelper.GetActualThreshold(container));
		}

		internal static DockLayoutManager GetActualViewOwner(this DockLayoutManager container, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			LayoutGroup root = item.GetRoot();
			if (root == null)
			{
				return container;
			}
			IView view = container.GetView(root);
			if (view == null)
			{
				foreach (DockLayoutManager item2 in container.Linked)
				{
					view = item2.GetView(root);
					if (view != null)
					{
						container = item2;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return container;
		}

		public static IEnumerable<DockLayoutManager> GetLinkedManagers(this DockLayoutManager layoutManager)
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<DockLayoutManager>)layoutManager.Linked).Select((DockLayoutManager x) => x);
		}
	}
	public abstract class BaseLockableCollection<T> : ObservableCollection<T>, ILockable
	{
		private int lockCount;

		private List<T> lockedItems;

		public bool IsLockUpdate => lockCount != 0;

		public virtual void BeginUpdate()
		{
			lockCount++;
			lockedItems = this.ToList();
		}

		public virtual void EndUpdate()
		{
			CancelUpdate();
			if (!IsLockUpdate)
			{
				if (lockedItems != null && !lockedItems.SequenceEqual(this))
				{
					OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
				}
				lockedItems = null;
			}
		}

		protected internal void CancelUpdate()
		{
			lockCount--;
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!IsLockUpdate)
			{
				OnCollectionChangedOverride(e);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnCollectionChangedOverride(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
		}
	}
	public class ClosedPanelCollection : BaseLockableCollection<LayoutPanel>, IDisposable
	{
		private bool isDisposing;

		private DockLayoutManager Owner;

		public LayoutPanel this[string name]
		{
			get
			{
				foreach (LayoutPanel item in base.Items)
				{
					if (item.Name == name)
					{
						return item;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public ClosedPanelCollection(DockLayoutManager owner)
		{
			Owner = owner;
		}

		public void AddRange(LayoutPanel[] panels)
		{
			Array.ForEach(panels, Add);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (!isDisposing)
			{
				isDisposing = true;
				OnDisposing();
			}
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		public LayoutPanel[] ToArray()
		{
			LayoutPanel[] array = new LayoutPanel[base.Count];
			base.Items.CopyTo(array, 0);
			return array;
		}

		protected override void ClearItems()
		{
			LayoutPanel[] array = new LayoutPanel[base.Items.Count];
			base.Items.CopyTo(array, 0);
			base.ClearItems();
			LayoutPanel[] array2 = array;
			foreach (LayoutPanel item in array2)
			{
				RemoveItemCore(item);
			}
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, LayoutPanel item)
		{
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				if (item.Manager == null)
				{
					item.Manager = Owner;
				}
				DockLayoutManager.AddLogicalChild(Owner, item);
				item.DockLayoutManagerCore = Owner;
			}
			base.InsertItem(index, item);
			item.SetClosed(value: true);
		}

		protected virtual void OnDisposing()
		{
			ClearItems();
		}

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			LayoutPanel item = ((index < 0 || index >= base.Count) ? null : base[index]);
			base.RemoveItem(index);
			RemoveItemCore(item);
		}

		protected override void SetItem(int index, LayoutPanel item)
		{
			item.SetClosed(value: true);
			base.SetItem(index, item);
		}

		private void RemoveItemCore(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				item.SetClosed(value: false);
				if (!Owner.OptimizedLogicalTree)
				{
					DockLayoutManager.RemoveLogicalChild(Owner, item);
				}
				item.DockLayoutManagerCore = null;
			}
		}

		public override void EndUpdate()
		{
			base.EndUpdate();
			this.ToList().ForEach(delegate(LayoutPanel x)
			{
				DockLayoutManager.AddLogicalChild(Owner, x);
			});
		}
	}
	public class AutoHideGroupCollection : BaseLockableCollection<AutoHideGroup>, IDisposable
	{
		private class ahCollectionContainer
		{
			private CollectionContainer bottomContainer;

			private ObservableCollection<AutoHideGroup> extraBottomItems;

			private ObservableCollection<AutoHideGroup> extraLeftItems;

			private ObservableCollection<AutoHideGroup> extraRightItems;

			private ObservableCollection<AutoHideGroup> extraTopItems;

			private CollectionContainer leftContainer;

			private CollectionContainer rightContainer;

			private CollectionContainer topContainer;

			public ahCollectionContainer()
			{
				extraLeftItems = CreateTarget();
				extraRightItems = CreateTarget();
				extraTopItems = CreateTarget();
				extraBottomItems = CreateTarget();
				bottomContainer = new CollectionContainer
				{
					Collection = extraBottomItems
				};
				leftContainer = new CollectionContainer
				{
					Collection = extraLeftItems
				};
				rightContainer = new CollectionContainer
				{
					Collection = extraRightItems
				};
				topContainer = new CollectionContainer
				{
					Collection = extraTopItems
				};
			}

			public CollectionContainer GetContainer(Dock dock)
			{
				CollectionContainer result = leftContainer;
				switch (dock)
				{
				case Dock.Right:
					result = rightContainer;
					break;
				case Dock.Top:
					result = topContainer;
					break;
				case Dock.Bottom:
					result = bottomContainer;
					break;
				}
				return result;
			}

			public ObservableCollection<AutoHideGroup> GetItems(Dock dock)
			{
				ObservableCollection<AutoHideGroup> result = extraLeftItems;
				switch (dock)
				{
				case Dock.Right:
					result = extraRightItems;
					break;
				case Dock.Top:
					result = extraTopItems;
					break;
				case Dock.Bottom:
					result = extraBottomItems;
					break;
				}
				return result;
			}

			protected ObservableCollection<AutoHideGroup> CreateTarget()
			{
				return new ObservableCollection<AutoHideGroup>();
			}
		}

		private readonly CompositeCollection mergedBottomItems;

		private readonly CompositeCollection mergedRightItems;

		private readonly CompositeCollection mergedTopItems;

		private ObservableCollection<AutoHideGroup> bottomItemsCore;

		private bool isDisposing;

		private ObservableCollection<AutoHideGroup> leftItemsCore;

		private CompositeCollection mergedLeftItems;

		private ObservableCollection<AutoHideGroup> rightItemsCore;

		private ObservableCollection<AutoHideGroup> topItemsCore;

		private Dictionary<object, ahCollectionContainer> containers = new Dictionary<object, ahCollectionContainer>();

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public CompositeCollection BottomItems => mergedBottomItems;

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public CompositeCollection LeftItems => mergedLeftItems;

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public CompositeCollection RightItems => mergedRightItems;

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public CompositeCollection TopItems => mergedTopItems;

		internal DockLayoutManager Owner { get; set; }

		public BaseLayoutItem this[string name] => Array.Find(this.GetItems(), (BaseLayoutItem item) => item.Name == name);

		public AutoHideGroupCollection()
		{
			leftItemsCore = CreateTarget();
			rightItemsCore = CreateTarget();
			topItemsCore = CreateTarget();
			bottomItemsCore = CreateTarget();
			mergedLeftItems = CreateMergedTarget(leftItemsCore);
			mergedRightItems = CreateMergedTarget(rightItemsCore);
			mergedTopItems = CreateMergedTarget(topItemsCore);
			mergedBottomItems = CreateMergedTarget(bottomItemsCore);
		}

		public void AddRange(AutoHideGroup[] items)
		{
			Array.ForEach(items, Add);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (!isDisposing)
			{
				isDisposing = true;
				OnDisposing();
			}
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		public AutoHideGroup[] ToArray()
		{
			AutoHideGroup[] array = new AutoHideGroup[base.Count];
			base.Items.CopyTo(array, 0);
			return array;
		}

		internal ObservableCollection<AutoHideGroup> GetXtraTarget(Dock type)
		{
			ObservableCollection<AutoHideGroup> observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<AutoHideGroup>();
			foreach (ahCollectionContainer value in containers.Values)
			{
				ObservableCollection<AutoHideGroup> source = value.GetItems(type);
				source.ForEach(observableCollection.Add);
			}
			return observableCollection;
		}

		protected override void ClearItems()
		{
			AutoHideGroup[] array = ToArray();
			base.ClearItems();
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				OnItemRemoved(array[i]);
			}
		}

		protected virtual ObservableCollection<AutoHideGroup> CreateTarget()
		{
			return new ObservableCollection<AutoHideGroup>();
		}

		protected CompositeCollection GetMergedTarget(Dock type)
		{
			CompositeCollection result = LeftItems;
			switch (type)
			{
			case Dock.Right:
				result = RightItems;
				break;
			case Dock.Top:
				result = TopItems;
				break;
			case Dock.Bottom:
				result = BottomItems;
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected ObservableCollection<AutoHideGroup> GetTarget(Dock type)
		{
			ObservableCollection<AutoHideGroup> result = leftItemsCore;
			switch (type)
			{
			case Dock.Right:
				result = rightItemsCore;
				break;
			case Dock.Top:
				result = topItemsCore;
				break;
			case Dock.Bottom:
				result = bottomItemsCore;
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, AutoHideGroup item)
		{
			base.InsertItem(index, item);
			OnItemAdded(item);
		}

		protected virtual void NotifyItemAdded(AutoHideGroup item)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				if (Owner != null && item.Manager == null)
				{
					item.Manager = Owner;
				}
				item.OnOwnerCollectionChanged();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void NotifyItemRemoved(AutoHideGroup item)
		{
			item?.OnOwnerCollectionChanged();
		}

		protected virtual void OnDisposing()
		{
			ClearItems();
			Clear(ref leftItemsCore);
			Clear(ref rightItemsCore);
			Clear(ref topItemsCore);
			Clear(ref bottomItemsCore);
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemAdded(AutoHideGroup item)
		{
			GetTarget(item.DockType).Add(item);
			Unsubscribe(item);
			Subscribe(item);
			item.IsRootGroup = true;
			item.DockLayoutManagerCore = Owner;
			NotifyItemAdded(item);
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemRemoved(AutoHideGroup item)
		{
			Unsubscribe(item);
			GetTarget(item.DockType).Remove(item);
			item.IsRootGroup = false;
			item.DockLayoutManagerCore = null;
			NotifyItemRemoved(item);
		}

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			AutoHideGroup item = base.Items[index];
			base.RemoveItem(index);
			OnItemRemoved(item);
		}

		protected override void SetItem(int index, AutoHideGroup item)
		{
			AutoHideGroup item2 = base[index];
			base.SetItem(index, item);
			OnItemRemoved(item2);
			OnItemAdded(item);
		}

		private static void Clear(ref ObservableCollection<AutoHideGroup> collection)
		{
			if (collection != null)
			{
				collection.Clear();
			}
			collection = null;
		}

		private void OnItemDockTypeChanged(object sender, DockTypeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			AutoHideGroup item = sender as AutoHideGroup;
			GetTarget(e.PrevValue).Remove(item);
			GetTarget(e.Value).Add(item);
		}

		private void Subscribe(AutoHideGroup item)
		{
			item.DockTypeChanged += OnItemDockTypeChanged;
		}

		private void Unsubscribe(AutoHideGroup item)
		{
			item.DockTypeChanged -= OnItemDockTypeChanged;
		}

		private ahCollectionContainer GetContainer(object key)
		{
			ahCollectionContainer value = null;
			if (!containers.TryGetValue(key, out value))
			{
				value = new ahCollectionContainer();
				containers[key] = value;
				mergedBottomItems.Add(value.GetContainer(Dock.Bottom));
				mergedLeftItems.Add(value.GetContainer(Dock.Left));
				mergedRightItems.Add(value.GetContainer(Dock.Right));
				mergedTopItems.Add(value.GetContainer(Dock.Top));
			}
			return value;
		}

		internal void Merge(object key, AutoHideGroupCollection extraItems)
		{
			extraItems.OnMerge();
			ahCollectionContainer container = GetContainer(key);
			container.GetItems(Dock.Bottom).Clear();
			container.GetItems(Dock.Left).Clear();
			container.GetItems(Dock.Right).Clear();
			container.GetItems(Dock.Top).Clear();
			foreach (AutoHideGroup extraItem in extraItems)
			{
				ObservableCollection<AutoHideGroup> observableCollection = container.GetItems(extraItem.DockType);
				observableCollection.Add(extraItem);
			}
		}

		internal void Unmerge(object key, AutoHideGroupCollection extraItems)
		{
			ahCollectionContainer value = null;
			if (!containers.TryGetValue(key, out value))
			{
				value = new ahCollectionContainer();
				containers[key] = value;
			}
			value.GetItems(Dock.Bottom).Clear();
			value.GetItems(Dock.Left).Clear();
			value.GetItems(Dock.Right).Clear();
			value.GetItems(Dock.Top).Clear();
			extraItems.OnUnmerge();
		}

		private void OnMerge()
		{
			LeftItems.Clear();
			RightItems.Clear();
			TopItems.Clear();
			BottomItems.Clear();
		}

		private void OnUnmerge()
		{
			mergedLeftItems.Add(new CollectionContainer
			{
				Collection = leftItemsCore
			});
			mergedRightItems.Add(new CollectionContainer
			{
				Collection = rightItemsCore
			});
			mergedTopItems.Add(new CollectionContainer
			{
				Collection = topItemsCore
			});
			mergedBottomItems.Add(new CollectionContainer
			{
				Collection = bottomItemsCore
			});
		}

		private CompositeCollection CreateMergedTarget(ObservableCollection<AutoHideGroup> items)
		{
			CompositeCollection compositeCollection = new CompositeCollection();
			compositeCollection.Add(new CollectionContainer
			{
				Collection = items
			});
			return compositeCollection;
		}
	}
	public class AutoHideItemsCollection : BaseLayoutItemCollection
	{
		public AutoHideItemsCollection(AutoHideGroup group)
			: base(group)
		{
		}

		protected override void BeforeItemAdded(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			base.BeforeItemAdded(item);
			item.SetAutoHidden(autoHidden: true);
		}

		protected override void ClearItems()
		{
			BaseLayoutItem[] array = new BaseLayoutItem[base.Items.Count];
			base.Items.CopyTo(array, 0);
			base.ClearItems();
			BaseLayoutItem[] array2 = array;
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem in array2)
			{
				baseLayoutItem.SetAutoHidden(autoHidden: false);
			}
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item is LayoutGroup && !Owner.IsInContainerGeneration)
			{
				BaseLayoutItem[] array = DockControllerHelper.Decompose(item);
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					base.InsertItem(index + i, array[i]);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.InsertItem(index, item);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnItemRemoved(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			base.OnItemRemoved(item);
			item.SetAutoHidden(autoHidden: false);
		}

		protected override void SetItem(int index, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			item.SetAutoHidden(autoHidden: true);
			base.SetItem(index, item);
		}
	}
	public class BaseLayoutItemCollection : BaseItemsCollection<BaseLayoutItem>, ILockable
	{
		protected readonly LayoutGroup Owner;

		private readonly List<NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs> pendingChanges = new List<NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs>();

		private int lockCount;

		private List<BaseLayoutItem> lockedItems;

		private readonly OrderedDictionary collectionHash = new OrderedDictionary();

		private readonly Locker addToItemsSourceLocker = new Locker();

		private readonly Locker removeFromItemsSourceLocker = new Locker();

		public bool IsLockUpdate => lockCount != 0;

		public BaseLayoutItem this[string name] => FindItem(base.Items, name);

		public BaseLayoutItemCollection(LayoutGroup owner)
		{
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Owner = owner;
		}

		public static BaseLayoutItem FindItem(IList<BaseLayoutItem> items, string name)
		{
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in items)
			{
				if (item.Name == name)
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public virtual void BeginUpdate()
		{
			lockCount++;
			lockedItems = this.ToList();
		}

		public virtual void EndUpdate()
		{
			CancelUpdate();
			if (!IsLockUpdate)
			{
				if (lockedItems != null && !lockedItems.SequenceEqual(this))
				{
					OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
				}
				lockedItems = null;
			}
		}

		internal bool AllowDockToDocumentGroup()
		{
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in base.Items)
			{
				if (item is LayoutPanel && !((LayoutPanel)item).AllowDockToDocumentGroup)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (item.ItemType == LayoutItemType.Group)
				{
					LayoutGroup layoutGroup = item as LayoutGroup;
					if (layoutGroup.Items.Count != 0 && !layoutGroup.Items.AllowDockToDocumentGroup())
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void CollectConstraints(out Size[] minSizes, out Size[] maxSizes)
		{
			minSizes = new Size[base.Items.Count];
			maxSizes = new Size[base.Items.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < minSizes.Length; i++)
			{
				if (base.Items[i].IsVisibleCore)
				{
					minSizes[i] = base.Items[i].ActualMinSize;
					maxSizes[i] = base.Items[i].ActualMaxSize;
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool ContainsLayoutControlItem()
		{
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in base.Items)
			{
				if (LayoutItemsHelper.IsLayoutItem(item))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ContainsLayoutControlItemOrGroup()
		{
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in base.Items)
			{
				if (LayoutItemsHelper.IsLayoutItem(item))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (item is LayoutGroup layoutGroup && layoutGroup.Items.Count > 0 && layoutGroup.Items.ContainsLayoutControlItemOrGroup())
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ContainsNestedControlItemHostItems()
		{
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in base.Items)
			{
				if (item.IsControlItemsHost)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (item is LayoutGroup layoutGroup && layoutGroup.Items.Count > 0 && layoutGroup.Items.ContainsNestedControlItemHostItems())
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ContainsNonEmptyDocumentGroups()
		{
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in base.Items)
			{
				if (item.Parent is DocumentGroup)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (item is LayoutGroup && ((LayoutGroup)item).Items.ContainsNonEmptyDocumentGroups())
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ContainsOnlyControlItemsOrItsHosts()
		{
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in base.Items)
			{
				if (LayoutItemsHelper.IsLayoutItem(item))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (item.ItemType == LayoutItemType.Panel)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (item.ItemType == LayoutItemType.Document)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (item.IsControlItemsHost)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (item.ItemType == LayoutItemType.Group)
				{
					LayoutGroup layoutGroup = item as LayoutGroup;
					if (layoutGroup.Items.Count == 0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (layoutGroup.Items.ContainsOnlyControlItemsOrItsHosts())
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool ContainsOnlyLayoutControlItemOrGroup()
		{
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in base.Items)
			{
				if (!LayoutItemsHelper.IsLayoutItem(item) && item.ItemType != LayoutItemType.Group)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal double GetIntervals()
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 1; i < base.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				num += (double)Owner.GetValue(IntervalHelper.GetTargetProperty(base.Items[i - 1], base.Items[i]));
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal bool HasVisibleStarItems()
		{
			bool isHorizontal = Owner.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal;
			return this.Count((BaseLayoutItem x) => LayoutItemsHelper.IsActuallyVisibleInTree(x) && ((!isHorizontal) ? x.ItemHeight.IsStar : x.ItemWidth.IsStar)) != 0;
		}

		internal bool IsDocumentHost()
		{
			bool result = false;
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in base.Items)
			{
				if (item is LayoutPanel)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (item is DocumentGroup)
				{
					result = true;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal bool IsDocumentHost(bool ignoreLayoutPanels)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (ignoreLayoutPanels)
			{
				foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in base.Items)
				{
					if (item is DocumentGroup)
					{
						result = true;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				result = IsDocumentHost();
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal void ProcessRemovedItems()
		{
			if (lockedItems != null && !lockedItems.SequenceEqual(this))
			{
				List<NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs> list = pendingChanges.Where((NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs x) => x.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove).ToList();
				foreach (NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs item in list)
				{
					base.OnCollectionChanged(item);
				}
			}
			pendingChanges.Clear();
		}

		internal void ResetItemsSource()
		{
			OnResetItemsSource();
		}

		protected internal void CancelUpdate()
		{
			lockCount--;
		}

		protected virtual void BeforeItemAdded(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			CheckItemRules(item);
			Owner.BeforeItemAdded(item);
		}

		protected override bool CheckItemCollectionMustBeEmpty()
		{
			if (base.CheckItemCollectionMustBeEmpty())
			{
				return DockLayoutManagerParameters.CheckLayoutGroupIsUsingItemsSource;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual void CheckItemRules(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item.ItemType == LayoutItemType.ControlItem && Owner.ItemType != LayoutItemType.Group)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(DockLayoutManagerHelper.GetRule(DockLayoutManagerRule.ItemCanNotBeHosted));
			}
			if (Owner.IsControlItemsHost)
			{
				if (item.ItemType == LayoutItemType.Panel || item.ItemType == LayoutItemType.Document)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(DockLayoutManagerHelper.GetRule(DockLayoutManagerRule.InconsistentLayout));
				}
				if (item.ItemType == LayoutItemType.DocumentPanelGroup || item.ItemType == LayoutItemType.TabPanelGroup)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(DockLayoutManagerHelper.GetRule(DockLayoutManagerRule.InconsistentLayout));
				}
			}
			if (item.ItemType != LayoutItemType.Panel && Owner.ItemType == LayoutItemType.TabPanelGroup)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(DockLayoutManagerHelper.GetRule(DockLayoutManagerRule.WrongPanel));
			}
			if (Owner.ItemType == LayoutItemType.DocumentPanelGroup && !CanDockToDocumentGroup(item))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(DockLayoutManagerHelper.GetRule(DockLayoutManagerRule.WrongDocument));
			}
			if (item.ItemType == LayoutItemType.FloatGroup)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(DockLayoutManagerHelper.GetRule(DockLayoutManagerRule.FloatGroupsCollection));
			}
			if (item.ItemType == LayoutItemType.AutoHideGroup)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(DockLayoutManagerHelper.GetRule(DockLayoutManagerRule.AutoHideGroupsCollection));
			}
			if (!(item is LayoutPanel) && Owner.ItemType == LayoutItemType.AutoHideGroup)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(DockLayoutManagerHelper.GetRule(DockLayoutManagerRule.WrongAutoHiddenPanel));
			}
		}

		protected override void ClearItems()
		{
			CheckIsUsingItemsSource();
			ClearItemsCore();
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			CheckIsUsingItemsSource();
			InsertItemCore(index, item);
		}

		protected override void MoveItem(int oldIndex, int newIndex)
		{
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				Owner.moveItemLock++;
			}
			base.MoveItem(oldIndex, newIndex);
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				Owner.moveItemLock--;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void NotifyItemInserted(BaseLayoutItem item, int index)
		{
			OnItemAdded(item);
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				Owner.AfterItemAdded(index, item);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void NotifyItemRemoved(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				Owner.AfterItemRemoved(item);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsLockUpdate)
			{
				pendingChanges.Add(e);
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemAdded(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			item.Parent = Owner;
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemRemoved(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			item.Parent = null;
			Owner.AfterItemRemoved(item);
		}

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			CheckIsUsingItemsSource();
			RemoveItemAt(index);
		}

		private bool CanDockToDocumentGroup(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item is LayoutPanel)
			{
				return ((LayoutPanel)item).AllowDockToDocumentGroup;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ClearItemsCore()
		{
			BaseLayoutItem[] array = base.Items.ToArray();
			base.ClearItems();
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				OnItemRemoved(array[i]);
			}
		}

		private DockLayoutManager GetManager()
		{
			if (Owner == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Owner.GetRoot().Manager;
		}

		private void InsertItemCore(int index, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (Contains(item))
			{
				return;
			}
			DockLayoutManager manager = GetManager();
			using (new UpdateBatch(manager))
			{
				using (item.ParentLockHelper.Lock())
				{
					BeforeItemAdded(item);
					base.InsertItem(index, item);
					NotifyItemInserted(item, index);
				}
			}
		}

		private void RemoveItemAt(int index)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = ((index < 0 || index >= base.Count) ? null : base[index]);
			if (baseLayoutItem != null)
			{
				baseLayoutItem.ParentLockHelper.Lock();
				baseLayoutItem.LockInLogicalTree();
			}
			base.RemoveItem(index);
			if (baseLayoutItem != null)
			{
				OnItemRemoved(baseLayoutItem);
				NotifyItemRemoved(baseLayoutItem);
				baseLayoutItem.UnlockItemInLogicalTree();
				baseLayoutItem.ParentLockHelper.Unlock();
			}
		}

		private void RemoveItemCore(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(item);
			if (num != -1)
			{
				RemoveItemAt(num);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnItemsSourceCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			using (new UpdateBatch(Owner.Manager))
			{
				Owner.BeginUpdate();
				base.OnItemsSourceCollectionChanged(sender, e);
				Owner.EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		private int GetActualStartingIndex(int startingIndex)
		{
			if (startingIndex >= base.Count)
			{
				return base.Count;
			}
			int num = -1;
			List<object> list = collectionHash.Values.OfType<object>().ToList();
			for (int num2 = startingIndex - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
			{
				if (Contains((BaseLayoutItem)list[num2]))
				{
					num = IndexOf((BaseLayoutItem)list[num2]) + 1;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (num == -1 && !Owner.IsInTree())
			{
				for (int num3 = startingIndex - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
				{
					BaseLayoutItem item = (BaseLayoutItem)list[num3];
					PlaceHolder placeHolder = Owner.PlaceHolderHelper.GetPlaceHolders().FirstOrDefault((PlaceHolder x) => x.Owner == item);
					if (placeHolder != null)
					{
						num = Owner.PlaceHolderHelper.IndexOf(placeHolder) + 1;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return Math.Max(num, 0);
		}

		protected override void OnAddToItemsSource(IEnumerable newItems, int startingIndex = 0)
		{
			if (newItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Locker val = addToItemsSourceLocker.Lock();
			try
			{
				int num = GetActualStartingIndex(startingIndex);
				using (new UpdateBatch(Owner.GetDockLayoutManager()))
				{
					foreach (object newItem in newItems)
					{
						DependencyObject value = ((IGeneratorHost)Owner).GenerateContainerForItem(newItem, num, (DataTemplate)null, (DataTemplateSelector)null);
						collectionHash.Insert(num, newItem, value);
						num++;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnRemoveFromItemsSource(IEnumerable oldItems)
		{
			foreach (object oldItem in oldItems)
			{
				if (collectionHash.Contains(oldItem))
				{
					BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = collectionHash[oldItem] as BaseLayoutItem;
					Locker val = removeFromItemsSourceLocker.Lock();
					try
					{
						Owner.ClearContainerForItem(baseLayoutItem, oldItem);
					}
					finally
					{
						((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
					}
					RemoveItemCore(baseLayoutItem);
					collectionHash.Remove(oldItem);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void InvalidateItemsSource()
		{
			foreach (DictionaryEntry item in collectionHash)
			{
				BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = item.Value as BaseLayoutItem;
				object key = item.Key;
				Locker val = removeFromItemsSourceLocker.Lock();
				try
				{
					Owner.ClearContainerForItem(baseLayoutItem, key);
					OnItemRemoved(baseLayoutItem);
				}
				finally
				{
					((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
				}
			}
			collectionHash.Clear();
		}

		protected override void OnResetItemsSource()
		{
			InvalidateItemsSource();
			OnAddToItemsSource(base.ItemsSource);
		}

		protected override void OnItemReplacedInItemsSource(IList oldItems, IList newItems, int newStartingIndex)
		{
			OnRemoveFromItemsSource(oldItems);
			OnAddToItemsSource(newItems, newStartingIndex);
		}

		protected override void OnItemMovedInItemsSource(int oldStartingIndex, int newStartingIndex)
		{
			MoveHashEntry(oldStartingIndex, newStartingIndex);
			Move(oldStartingIndex, newStartingIndex);
		}

		protected override void OnCurrentChanged(object sender)
		{
		}

		private void CheckIsUsingItemsSource()
		{
			if (base.IsUsingItemsSource && !Locker.op_Implicit(removeFromItemsSourceLocker) && DockLayoutManagerParameters.CheckLayoutGroupIsUsingItemsSource && !Locker.op_Implicit(addToItemsSourceLocker))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(DockLayoutManagerHelper.GetRule(DockLayoutManagerRule.ItemsSourceInUse));
			}
		}

		private void MoveHashEntry(int oldIndex, int newIndex)
		{
			DictionaryEntry dictionaryEntry = collectionHash.Cast<DictionaryEntry>().ElementAt(oldIndex);
			collectionHash.Remove(dictionaryEntry.Key);
			collectionHash.Insert(newIndex, dictionaryEntry.Key, dictionaryEntry.Value);
		}
	}
	[ContentProperty("Content")]
	public abstract class ContentItem : BaseLayoutItem, IItemContainer
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ContentProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsDataBoundProperty;

		internal static readonly DependencyPropertyKey IsDataBoundPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ContentTemplateProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty FocusContentOnActivatingProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ContentTemplateSelectorProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ActivateOnFocusingProperty;

		private BindingExpressionBase DataContextBinding;

		[Description("Gets or sets whether the content item is activated on getting logical or keyboard focus. This is a dependency property.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public ActivateOnFocusing ActivateOnFocusing
		{
			get
			{
				return (ActivateOnFocusing)GetValue(ActivateOnFocusingProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ActivateOnFocusingProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the item’s content. This is a dependency property.")]
		[Category("Content")]
		public object Content
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(ContentProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ContentProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the template used to display the item’s ContentItem.Content. This is a dependency property.")]
		public DataTemplate ContentTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return (DataTemplate)GetValue(ContentTemplateProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ContentTemplateProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets an object that chooses the item’s ContentItem.ContentTemplate based on custom logic.")]
		public DataTemplateSelector ContentTemplateSelector
		{
			get
			{
				return (DataTemplateSelector)GetValue(ContentTemplateSelectorProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ContentTemplateSelectorProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets whether the ContentItem‘s content should be focused on ContentItem activation.")]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public bool FocusContentOnActivating
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(FocusContentOnActivatingProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(FocusContentOnActivatingProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool IsDataBound
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsDataBoundProperty);
			}
			private set
			{
				SetValue(IsDataBoundPropertyKey, value);
			}
		}

		internal bool SetDataContextBinding { get; set; } = true;

		static ContentItem()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<ContentItem> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<ContentItem>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<object>("Content", ref ContentProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((ContentItem)dObj).OnContentChanged(e.NewValue, e.OldValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("IsDataBound", ref IsDataBoundPropertyKey, ref IsDataBoundProperty, defValue: false, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((ContentItem)dObj).OnIsDataBoundChanged((bool)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplate>("ContentTemplate", ref ContentTemplateProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplateSelector>("ContentTemplateSelector", ref ContentTemplateSelectorProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("FocusContentOnActivating", ref FocusContentOnActivatingProperty, defValue: true);
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<ContentItem>.New().Register<ActivateOnFocusing>("ActivateOnFocusing", ref ActivateOnFocusingProperty, ActivateOnFocusing.Keyboard, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		public ContentItem()
		{
			base.GotKeyboardFocus += delegate(object s, KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				OnGotKeyboardOrLogicalFocus(ActivateOnFocusing.Keyboard, e);
			};
			base.GotFocus += delegate(object s, RoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				OnGotKeyboardOrLogicalFocus(ActivateOnFocusing.Logical, e);
			};
		}

		internal virtual void Control_GotFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		protected virtual DependencyObject GetDataBoundContainer()
		{
			ContentPresenter contentPresenter = new ContentPresenter();
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(contentPresenter, ContentPresenter.ContentProperty, this, ContentProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(contentPresenter, ContentPresenter.ContentTemplateProperty, this, ContentTemplateProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(contentPresenter, ContentPresenter.ContentTemplateSelectorProperty, this, ContentTemplateSelectorProperty);
			return contentPresenter;
		}

		protected virtual void OnContentChanged(object content, object oldContent)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsDataBoundChanged(bool value)
		{
			if (!SetDataContextBinding)
			{
				return;
			}
			BindingExpression bindingExpression = GetBindingExpression(ContentProperty);
			if (bindingExpression != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = DependencyObjectExtensions.IsPropertySet((DependencyObject)this, FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty);
			BindingExpression bindingExpression2 = GetBindingExpression(FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty);
			if (!flag || (bindingExpression2 != null && bindingExpression2 == DataContextBinding))
			{
				if (value)
				{
					DataContextBinding = BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty, this, "Content");
				}
				else
				{
					BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty);
				}
			}
		}

		void IItemContainer.ClearContainer(object item)
		{
			if (DockLayoutManagerParameters.DisposePanelContentAfterRemovingPanel)
			{
				DisposeHelper.DisposeVisualTree(Content as DependencyObject);
			}
			ClearValue(ContentProperty);
		}

		private void OnGotKeyboardOrLogicalFocus(ActivateOnFocusing reason, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (reason == ActivateOnFocusing)
			{
				Control_GotFocus(this, e);
			}
		}

		void IItemContainer.PrepareContainer(object item)
		{
			if (this != item)
			{
				Content = item;
				if (item is FrameworkElement)
				{
					base.DataContext = ((FrameworkElement)item).DataContext;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class FloatGroupCollection : BaseLockableCollection<FloatGroup>, IDisposable
	{
		private bool isDisposing;

		public BaseLayoutItem this[string name] => Array.Find(this.GetItems(), (BaseLayoutItem item) => item.Name == name);

		internal DockLayoutManager Owner { get; set; }

		public void AddRange(FloatGroup[] items)
		{
			Array.ForEach(items, Add);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (!isDisposing)
			{
				isDisposing = true;
				OnDisposing();
			}
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		public FloatGroup[] ToArray()
		{
			FloatGroup[] array = new FloatGroup[base.Count];
			base.Items.CopyTo(array, 0);
			return array;
		}

		protected override void ClearItems()
		{
			FloatGroup[] array = new FloatGroup[base.Count];
			base.Items.CopyTo(array, 0);
			base.ClearItems();
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				OnItemRemoved(array[i]);
			}
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, FloatGroup item)
		{
			base.InsertItem(index, item);
			OnItemAdded(item);
		}

		protected virtual void OnDisposing()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				base.Items[i].IsOpen = false;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemAdded(FloatGroup item)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				if (Owner != null)
				{
					item.Manager = Owner;
				}
				item.OnOwnerCollectionChanged();
				item.IsRootGroup = true;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemRemoved(FloatGroup item)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				item.OnOwnerCollectionChanged();
				item.IsRootGroup = false;
			}
		}

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			FloatGroup item = base.Items[index];
			base.RemoveItem(index);
			OnItemRemoved(item);
		}

		protected override void SetItem(int index, FloatGroup item)
		{
			base.SetItem(index, item);
			OnItemAdded(item);
		}
	}

	{
		public void AddOnce(LayoutGroup item)

				Add(item);
			}
		}
	}

		private void UnMerge()
		{
			if (fMergingRequested)
			{
				fMergingRequested = false;
			}
			UnmergeCore();
		}

		private void Merge()
		{
			if (fMergingRequested && !DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(this))
			{
				MergeCore();
				fMergingRequested = false;
			}
		}

		private void BeginMerge()
		{
			if (!fMergingRequested)
			{
				fMergingRequested = true;
				MergingHelper.AddMergingClient(this);
				item.InvalidateArrange();
			}
		}

		private void UnmergeCore()
		{
			MDIControllerHelper.DoUnMerge(item);
		}

		private void MergeCore()
		{
			MDIControllerHelper.DoMerge(item);
		}

			}
			return GetIsChildMenuVisibleForFloatingElement(!item.IsMaximized);
		}

			{
				CheckIsChildMenuVisible();
				ProcessMergeActions();
			}
		}
