	internal static class AccessKeyHelper
	{
		private const char _accessKeyMarker = '_';

		private const string _doubleAccessKeyMarker = "__";

		public static string RemoveAccessKeyMarker(string text)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				int num = FindAccessKeyMarker(text);
				if (num >= 0 && num < text.Length - 1)
				{
					text = text.Remove(num, 1);
				}
				text = text.Replace("__", '_'.ToString());
			}
			return text;
		}

		private static int FindAccessKeyMarker(string text)
		{
			int length = text.Length;
			int num = 0;
			while (num < length)
			{
				int num2 = text.IndexOf('_', num);
				if (num2 == -1)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (num2 + 1 < length && text[num2 + 1] != '_')
				{
					return num2;
				}
				num = num2 + 2;
			}
			return -1;
		}
	}
	internal static class CommandHelper
	{
		internal static bool CanExecuteCommand(ICommandSource commandSource)
		{
			ICommand command = commandSource.Command;
			if (command != null)
			{
				object commandParameter = commandSource.CommandParameter;
				IInputElement inputElement = commandSource.CommandTarget;
				if (command is RoutedCommand routedCommand)
				{
					if (inputElement == null)
					{
						inputElement = commandSource as IInputElement;
					}
					return routedCommand.CanExecute(commandParameter, inputElement);
				}
				return command.CanExecute(commandParameter);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static void ExecuteCommand(ICommandSource commandSource)
		{
			ICommand command = commandSource.Command;
			RoutedCommand routedCommand = command as RoutedCommand;
			if (command != null)
			{
				if (routedCommand != null && routedCommand.CanExecute(commandSource.CommandParameter, commandSource.CommandTarget))
				{
					routedCommand.Execute(commandSource.CommandParameter, commandSource.CommandTarget);
				}
				else if (command.CanExecute(commandSource.CommandParameter))
				{
					command.Execute(commandSource.CommandParameter);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal enum DelayedActionPriority
	{
		Default,
		Delayed
	}
	internal class DelayedActionsHelper : DependencyObject, IDisposable
	{
		private class DelayedAction
		{
			private readonly int _hash;

			public Action Action { get; set; }

			public DelayedActionPriority Priority { get; set; }

			public DelayedAction(Action action, DelayedActionPriority priority)
			{
				Action = action;
				Priority = priority;
				_hash = action.Method.GetHashCode();
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				if (!(obj is DelayedAction delayedAction))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return delayedAction.Action == Action;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return _hash;
			}

			public static bool operator ==(DelayedAction left, DelayedAction right)
			{
				return object.Equals(left, right);
			}

			public static bool operator !=(DelayedAction left, DelayedAction right)
			{
				return !object.Equals(left, right);
			}
		}

		private List<DelayedAction> delayedActions = new List<DelayedAction>();

		public void AddDelayedAction(Action action, DelayedActionPriority priority)
		{
			DelayedAction item = new DelayedAction(action, priority);
			if (delayedActions.Contains(item))
			{
				delayedActions.Remove(item);
			}
			delayedActions.Add(item);
		}

		public void AddDelayedAction(Action action)
		{
			AddDelayedAction(action, DelayedActionPriority.Default);
		}

		public void DoDelayedActions()
		{
			DelayedAction[] array = delayedActions.ToArray();
			delayedActions.Clear();
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if (array[i] != null)
				{
					if (array[i].Priority == DelayedActionPriority.Delayed)
					{
						base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(array[i].Action);
					}
					else
					{
						array[i].Action();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			delayedActions.Clear();
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}
	}
	public delegate object PendingActionCallback(object arg);
	internal class PendingActionsHelper : Locker
	{
		private class PendingAction
		{
			private PendingActionCallback _callback;

			private object _arg;

			public PendingAction(PendingActionCallback callback, object arg)
			{
				_callback = callback;
				_arg = arg;
			}

			public void Execute()
			{
				if (_callback != null)
				{
					_callback(_arg);
				}
			}
		}

		private readonly List<PendingAction> _actions = new List<PendingAction>();

		public PendingActionsHelper()
		{
			((Locker)this).Unlocked += PendingActionsHelper_Unlocked;
		}

		public void AddPendingAction(PendingActionCallback callback, object arg)
		{
			_actions.Add(new PendingAction(callback, arg));
		}

		public void ExecutePendingActions()
		{
			PendingAction[] array = _actions.ToArray();
			_actions.Clear();
			PendingAction[] array2 = array;
			foreach (PendingAction pendingAction in array2)
			{
				pendingAction.Execute();
			}
		}

		private void PendingActionsHelper_Unlocked(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ExecutePendingActions();
		}
	}
	internal class DelayedActivation
	{
		private readonly WeakReference itemRef;

		public bool Delayed { get; private set; }

		public bool Focus { get; private set; }

		public BaseLayoutItem Item => itemRef.Target as BaseLayoutItem;

		public DelayedActivation(BaseLayoutItem item, bool focus, bool delayed)
		{
			itemRef = new WeakReference(item);
			Focus = focus;
			Delayed = delayed;
		}
	}
	internal class DelayedActivationHelper : DependencyObject
	{
		public delegate void DelayedActivationCallback(DelayedActivation arg);

		private readonly DelayedActivationCallback callback;

		private DispatcherOperation _operation;

		public DelayedActivationHelper(DelayedActivationCallback callback)
		{
			this.callback = callback;
		}

		private void Activate(DelayedActivation delayedActivation)
		{
			if (_operation != null)
			{
				_operation.Abort();
			}
			if (delayedActivation.Delayed)
			{
				_operation = base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(callback, delayedActivation);
			}
			else
			{
				callback(delayedActivation);
			}
		}

		internal void Activate(BaseLayoutItem item, bool focus, bool delayed)
		{
			Activate(new DelayedActivation(item, focus, delayed));
		}
	}

	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class DockLayoutManagerThemeDependentValuesProvider : FrameworkElement
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty Win32ResourcePathProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsDarkThemeProperty;

		public bool IsDarkTheme
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsDarkThemeProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsDarkThemeProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public Uri Win32ResourcePath
		{
			get
			{
				return (Uri)GetValue(Win32ResourcePathProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(Win32ResourcePathProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected DockLayoutManager Manager { get; private set; }

		public DockLayoutManagerThemeDependentValuesProvider(DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			Manager = manager;
		}

		static DockLayoutManagerThemeDependentValuesProvider()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<DockLayoutManagerThemeDependentValuesProvider>();
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DockLayoutManagerThemeDependentValuesProvider>.New().Register<bool>("IsDarkTheme", ref IsDarkThemeProperty, false, (Action<DockLayoutManagerThemeDependentValuesProvider, bool, bool>)delegate(DockLayoutManagerThemeDependentValuesProvider d, bool oldValue, bool newValue)
			{
				d.OnIsDarkThemeChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null).Register<Uri>("Win32ResourcePath", ref Win32ResourcePathProperty, (Uri)null, (Action<DockLayoutManagerThemeDependentValuesProvider, Uri, Uri>)delegate(DockLayoutManagerThemeDependentValuesProvider d, Uri oldValue, Uri newValue)
			{
				d.OnWin32ResourcePathChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsDarkThemeChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			Manager.IsDarkTheme = newValue;
		}

		protected virtual void OnWin32ResourcePathChanged(Uri oldValue, Uri newValue)
		{
			Manager.InvokeUpdateFloatingPaneResources();
		}
	}
	internal static class HierarchyHelper
	{
		public static T FindCommonAncestor<T>(this T obj1, T obj2, Func<T, T> parentEvaluator) where T : class
		{
			if (obj1 == null || obj2 == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			HashSet<T> hashSet = new HashSet<T>();
			while (obj1 != null)
			{
				hashSet.Add(obj1);
				obj1 = parentEvaluator(obj1);
			}
			while (obj2 != null)
			{
				if (hashSet.Contains(obj2))
				{
					return obj2;
				}
				obj2 = parentEvaluator(obj2);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static int FindAncestorIndex<T>(this T item, T ancestor, Func<T, T> parentEvaluator) where T : class
		{
			int num = 0;
			while (item != ancestor)
			{
				num++;
				item = parentEvaluator(item);
				if (item == null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public static T FindAmongParents<T>(this T item, Func<T, bool> condition, Func<T, T> parentEvaluator) where T : class
		{
			while (item != null && !condition(item))
			{
				item = parentEvaluator(item);
			}
			return item;
		}
	}
	public abstract class BaseItemsCollection<T> : ObservableCollection<T>, IDisposable, IWeakEventListener
	{
		private bool isDisposing;

		private IEnumerable itemsSource;

		private ICollectionView collectionViewCore;

		protected IEnumerable ItemsSource => itemsSource;

		internal bool IsUsingItemsSource => itemsSource != null;

		public object CurrentItem
		{
			get
			{
				if (collectionViewCore == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return collectionViewCore.CurrentItem;
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (!isDisposing)
			{
				isDisposing = true;
				OnDisposing();
			}
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		protected virtual void OnDisposing()
		{
			ClearItemsSource();
			ClearItems();
		}

		public void ClearItemsSource()
		{
			if (IsUsingItemsSource)
			{
				UnsubscribeSource(itemsSource);
				itemsSource = null;
				InvalidateItemsSource();
			}
		}

		public void SetItemsSource(IEnumerable value)
		{
			if (CheckItemCollectionMustBeEmpty())
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(DockLayoutManagerHelper.GetRule(DockLayoutManagerRule.ItemCollectionMustBeEmpty));
			}
			SetItemsSourceCore(value);
		}

		protected virtual bool CheckItemCollectionMustBeEmpty()
		{
			if (!IsUsingItemsSource)
			{
				return base.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SetItemsSourceCore(IEnumerable value)
		{
			UnsubscribeSource(itemsSource);
			itemsSource = value;
			SubscribeSource(itemsSource);
			InvalidateItemsSource();
			OnAddToItemsSource(value);
		}

		private void collectionView_CurrentChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			OnCurrentChanged(sender);
		}

		public void MoveCurrentTo(object item)
		{
			if (collectionViewCore != null)
			{
				collectionViewCore.MoveCurrentTo(item);
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeSource(IEnumerable Source)
		{
			if (Source is INotifyCollectionChanged source)
			{
				CollectionChangedEventManager.AddListener(source, this);
			}
			collectionViewCore = CollectionViewSource.GetDefaultView(Source);
			if (collectionViewCore != null)
			{
				CurrentChangedEventManager.AddListener(collectionViewCore, this);
			}
		}

		private void UnsubscribeSource(IEnumerable Source)
		{
			if (Source is INotifyCollectionChanged source)
			{
				CollectionChangedEventManager.RemoveListener(source, this);
			}
			if (collectionViewCore != null)
			{
				CurrentChangedEventManager.RemoveListener(collectionViewCore, this);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemsSourceCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
				OnAddToItemsSource(e.NewItems, e.NewStartingIndex);
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
				OnRemoveFromItemsSource(e.OldItems);
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
				OnItemReplacedInItemsSource(e.OldItems, e.NewItems, e.NewStartingIndex);
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
				OnItemMovedInItemsSource(e.OldStartingIndex, e.NewStartingIndex);
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
				OnResetItemsSource();
				break;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemReplacedInItemsSource(IList oldItems, IList newItems, int newStartingIndex)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemMovedInItemsSource(int oldStartingIndex, int newStartingIndex)
		{
		}

		protected abstract void OnAddToItemsSource(IEnumerable newItems, int startingIndex = 0);

		protected abstract void OnRemoveFromItemsSource(IEnumerable oldItems);

		protected abstract void OnResetItemsSource();

		protected abstract void OnCurrentChanged(object sender);

		protected virtual void InvalidateItemsSource()
		{
		}

		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (managerType == typeof(CollectionChangedEventManager))
			{
				NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e2 = (NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs)e;
				OnItemsSourceCollectionChanged(sender, e2);
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(managerType == typeof(CurrentChangedEventManager)))
				{
					return false;
				}
				collectionView_CurrentChanged(sender, e);
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class DockLayoutManagerItemsCollection : BaseItemsCollection<BaseLayoutItem>
	{
		protected readonly DockLayoutManager Owner;

		public DockLayoutManagerItemsCollection(DockLayoutManager owner)
		{
			Owner = owner;
		}

		protected override void OnAddToItemsSource(IEnumerable newItems, int startingIndex = 0)
		{
			Owner.OnAddToItemsSource(newItems, startingIndex);
		}

		protected override void OnRemoveFromItemsSource(IEnumerable oldItems)
		{
			Owner.OnRemoveFromItemsSource(oldItems);
		}

		protected override void OnItemReplacedInItemsSource(IList oldItems, IList newItems, int newStartingIndex)
		{
			Owner.OnItemReplacedInItemsSource(oldItems, newItems, newStartingIndex);
		}

		protected override void InvalidateItemsSource()
		{
			Owner.OnResetItemsSource(null);
		}

		protected override void OnResetItemsSource()
		{
			Owner.OnResetItemsSource(base.ItemsSource);
		}

		protected override void OnCurrentChanged(object sender)
		{
			Owner.OnCurrentChanged(sender);
		}
	}

	internal static class SizeToContentHelper
	{
		public static Size FitSizeToContent(SizeToContent sizeToContent, Size prevSize, Size newSize)
		{
			Size result;
			switch (sizeToContent)
			{
			case SizeToContent.Height:
				result = new Size(newSize.Width, prevSize.Height);
				break;
			case SizeToContent.Width:
				result = new Size(prevSize.Width, newSize.Height);
				break;
			case SizeToContent.WidthAndHeight:
				result = new Size(prevSize.Width, prevSize.Height);
				break;
			default:
				return newSize;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	internal static class EnvironmentHelper
	{
		private static readonly Version version = Environment.OSVersion.Version;

		public static bool IsWinSevenOrLater
		{
			get
			{
				if (version.Major <= 6)
				{
					if (version.Major == 6)
					{
						return version.Minor > 0;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public static bool IsWinXP
		{
			get
			{
				if (version.Major == 5)
				{
					return version.Minor == 1;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public static bool IsNet45OrNewer => Net45Detector.IsNet45();

		public static bool IsEightOneOrNewer
		{
			get
			{
				if (version.Major != 6 || version.Minor <= 3)
				{
					return version.Major > 7;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public static bool IsRedstoneOneOrNewer => version > new Version(10, 0, 14393);
	}
	public class LogicalContainer<T> : FrameworkElement where T : DependencyObject
	{
		private readonly List<T> Children;

		protected override IEnumerator LogicalChildren => Children.GetEnumerator();

		public LogicalContainer()
		{
			Children = new List<T>();
		}

		public void Add(T item)
		{
			if (IsNotInTree(item))
			{
				if (!Children.Contains(item))
				{
					Children.Add(item);
				}
				AddCore(item);
			}
		}

		public void Remove(T item)
		{
			Children.Remove(item);
			RemoveCore(item);
		}

		private bool IsNotInTree(T item)
		{
			return LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(item) == null;
		}

		private void AddCore(T item)
		{
			AddLogicalChild(item);
		}

		private void RemoveCore(T item)
		{
			RemoveLogicalChild(item);
		}
	}
	public class RenameHelper : IDisposable
	{
		private DockLayoutManager Manager;

		private BaseLayoutItem lastClickedItem;

		public RenameHelper(DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			Manager = manager;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			lastClickedItem = null;
			Manager = null;
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		public bool Rename(IDockLayoutElement element)
		{
			if (element == null || element.Item == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			BaseLayoutItem item = element.Item;
			ResetClickedState();
			if (Manager.RaiseItemCancelEvent(item, DockLayoutManager.LayoutItemStartRenamingEvent))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Manager.GetView(item.GetRoot()) is LayoutView layoutView)
			{
				layoutView.AdornerHelper.TryShowAdornerWindow(forceUpdateAdornerBounds: true);
				DockingHintAdornerBase selectionAdorner = layoutView.AdornerHelper.GetSelectionAdorner();
				if (selectionAdorner != null && CanRename(item))
				{
					((BaseSurfacedAdorner)selectionAdorner).Update(true);
					selectionAdorner.RenameController.StartRenaming(element);
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Rename(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			IUIElement iUIElement = item.GetUIElement<ITabHeader>() as IUIElement;
			IDockLayoutElement dockLayoutElement = null;
			if (iUIElement != null)
			{
				dockLayoutElement = Manager.GetViewElement(iUIElement) as IDockLayoutElement;
			}
			if (dockLayoutElement == null)
			{
				dockLayoutElement = Manager.GetViewElement(item) as IDockLayoutElement;
			}
			return Rename(dockLayoutElement);
		}

		public bool CancelRenamingAndResetClickedState()
		{
			ResetClickedState();
			return CancelRenaming();
		}

		public bool CancelRenaming()
		{
			if (!Manager.IsRenaming)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return TryCancelRenaming();
		}

		public bool EndRenaming()
		{
			if (!Manager.IsRenaming)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ResetClickedState();
			return TryEndRenaming();
		}

		public bool RenameByClick(IDockLayoutElement layoutElement)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem item = layoutElement.Item;
			if (!CanRename(item))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (item == lastClickedItem)
			{
				Rename(layoutElement);
				return true;
			}
			lastClickedItem = item;
			return false;
		}

		public void ResetClickedState()
		{
			lastClickedItem = null;
		}

		private bool TryEndRenaming()
		{
			foreach (LayoutView item in (IEnumerable<IView>)Manager.ViewAdapter.Views)
			{
				RenameController renameController = item.AdornerHelper.GetRenameController();
				if (renameController != null && renameController.IsRenamingStarted)
				{
					renameController.EndRenaming();
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool TryCancelRenaming()
		{
			foreach (LayoutView item in (IEnumerable<IView>)Manager.ViewAdapter.Views)
			{
				RenameController renameController = item.AdornerHelper.GetRenameController();
				if (renameController != null && renameController.IsRenamingStarted)
				{
					renameController.CancelRenaming();
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool CanRename(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (Manager.IsInDesignTime)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (item == null || !item.AllowRename)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool? flag = (LayoutItemsHelper.IsDockItem(item) ? Manager.AllowDockItemRename : Manager.AllowLayoutItemRename);
			if (!flag.HasValue)
			{
				return Manager.IsCustomization;
			}
			return flag.Value;
		}
	}

	internal class LogicalTreeLocker : IDisposable
	{
		private DockLayoutManager Container;

		private List<BaseLayoutItem> Items;

		private List<BaseLayoutItem> CollectLayoutItems(BaseLayoutItem[] items)
		{
			List<BaseLayoutItem> list = new List<BaseLayoutItem>();
			if (items == null)
			{
				return list;
			}
			items.Accept(delegate(BaseLayoutItem item)
			{
				item.Do(delegate(BaseLayoutItem x)
				{
					x.Accept(list.Add);
				});
			});
			return list.Distinct().ToList();
		}

		public LogicalTreeLocker(DockLayoutManager container, params BaseLayoutItem[] items)
		{
			Container = container;
			if (Container != null)
			{
				Container.LockLogicalTreeChanging(this);
			}
			Items = CollectLayoutItems(items);
			Items.Accept(delegate(BaseLayoutItem item)
			{
				item.LockInLogicalTree();
			});
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (Container != null)
			{
				Container.UnlockLogicalTreeChanging(this);
			}
			Items.Accept(delegate(BaseLayoutItem item)
			{
				item.UnlockItemInLogicalTree();
			});
			Container = null;
			Items = null;
		}

		internal bool IsLocked(DependencyObject element)
		{
			if (element is BaseLayoutItem item)
			{
				return Items.Contains(item);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	internal static class DesiredSizeHelper
	{
		private static readonly Dictionary<Type, bool> standardControlsList;

		private static readonly bool defaultValue;

		private static void InitControlsList()
		{
			standardControlsList.Add(typeof(ItemsControl), value: false);
			standardControlsList.Add(typeof(Image), value: false);
			standardControlsList.Add(typeof(TextBlock), value: true);
			standardControlsList.Add(typeof(TextBox), value: true);
			standardControlsList.Add(typeof(ImageEdit), value: false);
			standardControlsList.Add(typeof(DockLayoutManager), value: false);
			standardControlsList.Add(typeof(IRibbonControl), value: false);
		}

		static DesiredSizeHelper()
		{
			standardControlsList = new Dictionary<Type, bool>();
			defaultValue = false;
			InitControlsList();
		}

		public static bool CanUseDesiredSizeAsMinSize(Type type)
		{
			KeyValuePair<Type, bool> keyValuePair = standardControlsList.FirstOrDefault((KeyValuePair<Type, bool> pair) => object.Equals(pair.Key, type) || pair.Key.IsAssignableFrom(type));
			if (!(keyValuePair.Key == null))
			{
				return keyValuePair.Value;
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}

		public static bool CanUseDesiredSizeAsMinSize(UIElement control)
		{
			if (control == null)
			{
				return defaultValue;
			}
			return CanUseDesiredSizeAsMinSize(control.GetType());
		}
	}
	internal static class SelectionModeHelper
	{
		public static DevExpress.Xpf.Layout.Core.SelectionMode GetActualSelectionMode()
		{
			if (KeyHelper.IsCtrlPressed)

				return DevExpress.Xpf.Layout.Core.SelectionMode.MultipleItems;
			}
			if (KeyHelper.IsShiftPressed)
			{
				return DevExpress.Xpf.Layout.Core.SelectionMode.ItemRange;
			}
			return DevExpress.Xpf.Layout.Core.SelectionMode.SingleItem;
		}
	}
	internal static class DisposeHelper
	{
		public static void DisposeVisualTree(DependencyObject treeRoot)
		{
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0010: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (treeRoot == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<IDisposable> list = new List<IDisposable>();
			VisualTreeEnumerator val = new VisualTreeEnumerator(treeRoot);
			while (((NestedObjectEnumeratorBase)val).MoveNext())
			{
				if (val.Current is IDisposable item)
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			foreach (IDisposable item2 in list)
			{
				item2.Dispose();
			}
		}
	}
	internal static class TargetFramework
	{
		public static Version GetFrameworkVersion()
		{
			Assembly entryAssembly = Assembly.GetEntryAssembly();
			return GetFrameworkVersion(entryAssembly);
		}

		public static Version GetFrameworkVersion(Assembly assembly)
		{
			if (assembly == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object[] customAttributes = assembly.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(TargetFrameworkAttribute), inherit: false);
			if (customAttributes == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(customAttributes.FirstOrDefault() is TargetFrameworkAttribute targetFrameworkAttribute))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new FrameworkName(targetFrameworkAttribute.FrameworkName).Version;
		}
	}

		public override object ProvideValue(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			string themeName = ThemeNameHelper.GetThemeName(serviceProvider);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(themeName))

				Assembly assembly = ((((DynamicThemeResourceExtension)this).TypeInTargetAssembly != null) ? ((DynamicThemeResourceExtension)this).TypeInTargetAssembly.Assembly : Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly());
				string text = (((DynamicThemeResourceExtension)this).UseGeneric ? "IndependentParts" : Theme.DeepBlue.Name);
				return new Uri($"/{assembly.GetName().Name};component/{((DynamicThemeResourceExtension)this).ResourcePath}/{text}/{((DynamicThemeResourceExtension)this).ResourceName}".Replace("//", "/"), UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute);
			}
			string text2 = (((DynamicThemeResourceExtension)this).UseGeneric ? "Generic" : themeName);
			return new Uri(string.Format("/DevExpress.Xpf.Themes.{0}{1};component/{2}/{3}/{4}", themeName, ".v23.2", ((DynamicThemeResourceExtension)this).ResourcePathInTheme, text2, ((DynamicThemeResourceExtension)this).ResourceName).Replace("//", "/"), UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute);
		}

		}

		}

			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("HasContent", ref HasContentPropertyKey, ref HasContentProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ContentHorizontalAlignment", ref ContentHorizontalAlignmentProperty, HorizontalAlignment.Stretch);

			SetValue(HasContentPropertyKey, Content != null);
		}

		private void SetDesiredSize(Size value)
		{
			if (!(desiredSizeCore == value))
			{
				desiredSizeCore = value;
			}
		}

		protected virtual object CoerceDesiredSize(Size value)
		{
			if (HasDesiredSize)
			{
				return desiredSizeCore;
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected override Size CalcMinSizeValue(Size value)
		{
			if (HasDesiredSize)
			{
				return MathHelper.MeasureMinSize(new Size[2] { DesiredSizeInternal, value });
			}
			return base.CalcMinSizeValue(value);
		}

	public class LayoutSplitter : FixedItem
	{
		internal static int LayoutSplitterHeight;

		internal static int LayoutSplitterWidth;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty OrientationProperty;

		internal static readonly DependencyPropertyKey OrientationPropertyKey;

		public Orientation Orientation
		{
			get
			{
				return (Orientation)GetValue(OrientationProperty);

			internal set

			}
		}

		protected override bool IsEnabledCore => CoerceIsEnabled(base.IsEnabledCore);

		static LayoutSplitter()
		{
			LayoutSplitterHeight = 8;
			LayoutSplitterWidth = 8;
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<LayoutSplitter> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<LayoutSplitter>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<GridLength>(BaseLayoutItem.ItemWidthProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<GridLength>(BaseLayoutItem.ItemHeightProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("Orientation", ref OrientationPropertyKey, ref OrientationProperty, Orientation.Horizontal, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)

		}

		{
			if (base.Manager != null)
			{
				return base.Manager.IsCustomization;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override void OnIsCustomizationChanged(bool isCustomization)
		{
			base.OnIsCustomizationChanged(isCustomization);
			CoerceValue(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty);
		}

		protected override Size CalcMaxSizeValue(Size value)
		{
			if (Orientation != Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				return new Size(value.Width, LayoutSplitterHeight);
			}
			return new Size(LayoutSplitterWidth, value.Height);
		}

		protected virtual bool CoerceIsEnabled(bool value)
		{
			return (base.Manager == null || !base.Manager.IsCustomization) && value;
		}

		protected virtual object CoerceOrientation(Orientation value)
		{
			return (base.Parent != null) ? base.Parent.Orientation : value;
		}

		protected override LayoutItemType GetLayoutItemTypeCore()
		{
			return LayoutItemType.LayoutSplitter;
		}

		protected override void OnParentChanged()
		{
			base.OnParentChanged();
			CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.ActualMaxSizeProperty);
			CoerceValue(OrientationProperty);
		}
	}
	internal static class BindingHelper
	{
		public static void SetBinding(DependencyObject target, DependencyProperty property, object source, DependencyProperty path = null, BindingMode mode = BindingMode.OneWay)
		{
			if (target != null)
			{
				if (path == null)
				{
					path = property;
				}
				BindingOperations.SetBinding(target, property, new Binding
				{
					Path = new PropertyPath(path),
					Source = source,
					Mode = mode
				});
			}
		}

		public static void SetBinding(DependencyObject target, DependencyProperty property, object source, DependencyProperty path, IValueConverter converter)
		{
			if (target != null)
			{
				if (path == null)
				{
					path = property;
				}
				BindingOperations.SetBinding(target, property, new Binding
				{
					Path = new PropertyPath(path),
					Source = source,
					Converter = converter
				});
			}
		}

		public static BindingExpressionBase SetBinding(DependencyObject target, DependencyProperty property, object source, string path)
		{
			if (target != null)
			{
				return BindingOperations.SetBinding(target, property, new Binding(path)
				{
					Source = source
				});
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static void ClearBinding(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyProperty property)
		{
			if (dObj != null)
			{
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(dObj, property);
			}
		}

		public static BindingBase CloneBinding(BindingBase bindingBase, object source)
		{
			if (bindingBase is Binding binding)
			{
				Binding binding2 = new Binding
				{
					Source = source,
					AsyncState = binding.AsyncState,
					BindingGroupName = binding.BindingGroupName,
					XPath = binding.XPath,
					IsAsync = binding.IsAsync,
					NotifyOnSourceUpdated = binding.NotifyOnSourceUpdated,
					NotifyOnTargetUpdated = binding.NotifyOnTargetUpdated,
					UpdateSourceExceptionFilter = binding.UpdateSourceExceptionFilter,
					BindsDirectlyToSource = binding.BindsDirectlyToSource,
					Converter = binding.Converter,
					ConverterCulture = binding.ConverterCulture,
					ConverterParameter = binding.ConverterCulture,
					FallbackValue = binding.FallbackValue,
					Mode = binding.Mode,
					NotifyOnValidationError = binding.NotifyOnValidationError,
					Path = binding.Path,
					StringFormat = binding.StringFormat,
					TargetNullValue = binding.TargetNullValue,
					UpdateSourceTrigger = binding.UpdateSourceTrigger,
					ValidatesOnDataErrors = binding.ValidatesOnDataErrors,
					ValidatesOnExceptions = binding.ValidatesOnExceptions
				};
				{
					foreach (ValidationRule validationRule in binding.ValidationRules)
					{
						binding2.ValidationRules.Add(validationRule);
					}
					return binding2;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static bool IsDataBound(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyProperty property)
		{
			return BindingOperations.IsDataBound(dObj, property);
		}
	}
	public static class CaptionAlignHelper
	{
		public static bool HasAffectedItems(LayoutControlItem item, CaptionAlignMode mode)
		{
			if (item.Parent != null)
			{
				if (mode != CaptionAlignMode.AlignInGroup)
				{
					return mode == CaptionAlignMode.Default;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static double GetActualCaptionWidth(LayoutControlItem item)
		{
			double desiredCaptionWidth = item.DesiredCaptionWidth;
			if (item.CaptionAlignMode == CaptionAlignMode.AutoSize || item.CaptionLocation == CaptionLocation.Top || item.CaptionLocation == CaptionLocation.Bottom)
			{
				return desiredCaptionWidth;
			}
			if (item.CaptionAlignMode == CaptionAlignMode.Custom)
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(item.CaptionWidth))
				{
					return item.CaptionWidth;
				}
				return desiredCaptionWidth;
			}
			if (item.Parent != null)
			{
				return GetActualCaptionWidth(GetAffectedItems(item, item.CaptionAlignMode), desiredCaptionWidth);
			}
			return desiredCaptionWidth;
		}

		internal static LayoutControlItem[] GetAllAffectedItems(LayoutControlItem item, CaptionAlignMode mode)
		{
			LayoutGroup alignRoot = GetAlignRoot(item);
			List<LayoutControlItem> list = new List<LayoutControlItem>();
			using (IEnumerator<BaseLayoutItem> enumerator = LayoutItemsHelper.GetEnumerator(alignRoot))
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					if (enumerator.Current is LayoutControlItem { IsVisibleCore: not false } layoutControlItem)
					{
						list.Add(layoutControlItem);
					}
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private static LayoutControlItem[] GetAffectedItems(LayoutControlItem item, CaptionAlignMode mode)
		{
			if (!HasAffectedItems(item, mode))
			{
				return EmptyArray<LayoutControlItem>.Instance;
			}
			LayoutGroup alignRoot = GetAlignRoot(item);
			List<LayoutControlItem> list = new List<LayoutControlItem>();
			Predicate<BaseLayoutItem> filter = (BaseLayoutItem itemToAlign) => itemToAlign.CaptionAlignMode == mode;
			using (IEnumerator<BaseLayoutItem> enumerator = LayoutItemsHelper.GetEnumerator(alignRoot, filter))
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					if (enumerator.Current is LayoutControlItem { IsVisibleCore: not false } layoutControlItem)
					{
						list.Add(layoutControlItem);
					}
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private static LayoutGroup GetAlignRoot(LayoutControlItem item)
		{
			LayoutGroup parent = item.Parent;
			while (parent != null && parent.CaptionAlignMode == CaptionAlignMode.Default)
			{
				parent = parent.Parent;
			}
			return parent ?? item.GetRoot();
		}

		private static double GetActualCaptionWidth(LayoutControlItem[] items, double value)
		{
			double num = value;
			foreach (LayoutControlItem layoutControlItem in items)
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(layoutControlItem.CaptionWidth))
				{
					num = Math.Max(num, layoutControlItem.CaptionWidth);
				}
				if (layoutControlItem.HasDesiredCaptionWidth)
				{
					num = Math.Max(num, layoutControlItem.DesiredCaptionWidth);
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public static double GetCaptionWidth(BaseLayoutItem item, double value)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(value) && item.Parent != null)
			{
				return GetCaptionWidth(item.Parent);
			}
			return value;
		}

		internal static double GetCaptionWidth(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			return GetCaptionWidth(item, item.CaptionWidth);
		}

		public static double GetTabCaptionWidth(BaseLayoutItem item, double value)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(value) && item.Parent != null)
			{
				return GetTabCaptionWidth(item.Parent);
			}
			return value;
		}

		internal static double GetTabCaptionWidth(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			return GetTabCaptionWidth(item, item.TabCaptionWidth);
		}

		public static void UpdateAffectedItems(LayoutControlItem item, CaptionAlignMode mode)
		{
			if (HasAffectedItems(item, mode))
			{
				UpdateAffectedItemsCore(GetAllAffectedItems(item, mode));
			}
		}

		public static void UpdateAffectedItems(LayoutControlItem item, CaptionAlignMode oldMode, CaptionAlignMode newMode)
		{
			LayoutControlItem[] affectedItems = GetAffectedItems(item, oldMode);
			UpdateAffectedItemsCore(affectedItems);
			LayoutControlItem[] affectedItems2 = GetAffectedItems(item, newMode);
			foreach (LayoutControlItem layoutControlItem in affectedItems2)
			{
				if (Array.IndexOf(affectedItems, layoutControlItem) == -1)
				{
					layoutControlItem.CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.ActualCaptionWidthProperty);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void UpdateAffectedItemsCore(LayoutControlItem[] affectedItems)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < affectedItems.Length; i++)
			{
				if (affectedItems[i].HasDesiredCaptionWidth)
				{
					affectedItems[i].CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.ActualCaptionWidthProperty);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public class AppearanceHelper
	{
		internal static Appearance UpdateAppearance(Appearance result, Appearance parentAppearance, Appearance appearance)
		{
			if (parentAppearance == null)
			{
				parentAppearance = new Appearance();
			}
			if (appearance == null)
			{
				appearance = new Appearance();
			}
			Update(result.Normal, parentAppearance.Normal, appearance.Normal);
			Update(result.Active, parentAppearance.Active, appearance.Active);
			return result;
		}

		internal static AppearanceObject Update(AppearanceObject result, AppearanceObject parentAppearance, AppearanceObject appearance)
		{
			List<DependencyProperty> mergedProperties = AppearanceObject.MergedProperties;
			foreach (DependencyProperty item in mergedProperties)
			{
				object value = parentAppearance.GetValue(item);
				object value2 = appearance.GetValue(item);
				result.SetValue(item, Merge(value, value2));
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static Appearance GetActualAppearance(Appearance parentAppearance, Appearance appearance)
		{
			if (parentAppearance == null)
			{
				parentAppearance = new Appearance();
			}
			if (appearance == null)
			{
				appearance = new Appearance();
			}
			Appearance appearance2 = new Appearance();
			appearance2.Normal = Merge(parentAppearance.Normal, appearance.Normal);
			appearance2.Active = Merge(parentAppearance.Active, appearance.Active);
			return appearance2;
		}

		public static AppearanceObject Merge(AppearanceObject parentAppearance, AppearanceObject appearance)
		{
			AppearanceObject appearanceObject = new AppearanceObject();
			List<DependencyProperty> mergedProperties = AppearanceObject.MergedProperties;
			foreach (DependencyProperty item in mergedProperties)
			{
				object value = parentAppearance.GetValue(item);
				object value2 = appearance.GetValue(item);
				appearanceObject.SetValue(item, Merge(value, value2));
			}
			return appearanceObject;
		}

		internal static object Merge(object parentValue, object value)
		{
			if (parentValue is double)
			{
				return Merge((double)parentValue, (double)value);
			}
			if (parentValue is Color)
			{
				return Merge((Color)parentValue, (Color)value);
			}
			return value ?? parentValue;
		}

		internal static object Merge(double parentValue, double value)
		{
			return double.IsNaN(value) ? parentValue : value;
		}

		internal static object Merge(Color parentValue, Color value)
		{
			return (Colors.Transparent == value) ? parentValue : value;
		}
	}

		private static int lockCounter;

		public void Register<T>(string name, ref DependencyProperty property, T defValue, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions options, PropertyChangedCallback changed = null, CoerceValueCallback coerce = null)

		}

		{

		}

		{

		}

			propertyKey.OverrideMetadata(typeof(OwnerType), new PropertyMetadata(defValue, changed, coerce));

		}

		{
			property.OverrideMetadata(typeof(OwnerType), new UIPropertyMetadata(defValue, changed, coerce));
		}

		{
			routedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent(name, RoutingStrategy.Direct, typeof(THandler), typeof(OwnerType));
		}

		public void OverrideFrameworkMetadata<T>(DependencyProperty property, T defValue = default(T), PropertyChangedCallback changed = null, CoerceValueCallback coerce = null)
		{
			property.OverrideMetadata(typeof(OwnerType), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(defValue, changed, coerce));
		}

		public DependencyProperty OverrideFrameworkMetadata<T>(string name, DependencyProperty property, T defValue = default(T), PropertyChangedCallback changed = null, CoerceValueCallback coerce = null)
		{
			property.OverrideMetadata(typeof(OwnerType), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(defValue, changed, coerce));
			return property;
		}

		private static void PropertyChanged(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyProperty property, object value, CoerceValueCallback coerce)
		{
			if (lockCounter <= 0)
			{
				lockCounter++;
				object obj = coerce(dObj, value);
				if (!object.Equals(obj, value))
				{
					dObj.SetValue(property, obj);
				}
				lockCounter--;
			}
		}

		public void OverrideMetadataNotDataBindable<T>(DependencyProperty property, T defValue = default(T), PropertyChangedCallback changed = null, CoerceValueCallback coerce = null)
		{
			property.OverrideMetadata(typeof(OwnerType), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(defValue, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.NotDataBindable, changed, coerce));
		}

		public void RegisterClassCommandBinding(ICommand command, ExecutedRoutedEventHandler executed, CanExecuteRoutedEventHandler canExecute)
		{
			CommandManager.RegisterClassCommandBinding(typeof(OwnerType), new CommandBinding(command, executed, canExecute));
		}
	}
	public static class DockExtensions
	{
		public static Cursor ToCursor(this Dock dock)
		{
			switch (dock)
			{
			case Dock.Left:
			case Dock.Right:
				return Cursors.SizeWE;
			case Dock.Top:
			case Dock.Bottom:
				return Cursors.SizeNS;
			default:
				return Cursors.Arrow;
			}
		}

		public static BarContainerType ToBarContainerType(this Dock dock)
		{
			return (BarContainerType)(dock switch
			{
				Dock.Right => 3, 
				Dock.Left => 1, 
				Dock.Top => 2, 
				Dock.Bottom => 4, 
				_ => 0, 
			});
		}

		public static HorizontalAlignment ToHorizontalAlignment(Dock dock, bool IsInverted = false)
		{
			return dock switch
			{
				Dock.Left => IsInverted ? HorizontalAlignment.Right : HorizontalAlignment.Left, 
				Dock.Right => (!IsInverted) ? HorizontalAlignment.Right : HorizontalAlignment.Left, 
				_ => HorizontalAlignment.Stretch, 
			};
		}

		public static VerticalAlignment ToVerticalAlignment(Dock dock, bool IsInverted = false)
		{
			return dock switch
			{
				Dock.Top => IsInverted ? VerticalAlignment.Bottom : VerticalAlignment.Top, 
				Dock.Bottom => (!IsInverted) ? VerticalAlignment.Bottom : VerticalAlignment.Top, 
				_ => VerticalAlignment.Stretch, 
			};
		}

		internal static Thickness RotateThickness(this Dock dock, Thickness arg)
		{
			double left;
			double top;
			double right;
			double bottom;
			switch (dock)
			{
			case Dock.Left:
				left = arg.Top;
				top = arg.Right;
				right = arg.Bottom;
				bottom = arg.Left;
				break;
			case Dock.Right:
				left = arg.Bottom;
				top = arg.Left;
				right = arg.Top;
				bottom = arg.Right;
				break;
			case Dock.Bottom:
				left = arg.Right;
				top = arg.Bottom;
				right = arg.Left;
				bottom = arg.Top;
				break;
			default:
				left = arg.Left;
				top = arg.Top;
				right = arg.Right;
				bottom = arg.Bottom;
				break;
			}
			return new Thickness(left, top, right, bottom);
		}

		internal static Thickness ToThickness(this Dock dock, Thickness arg)
		{
			Thickness result = default(Thickness);
			switch (dock)
			{
			case Dock.Left:
				result.Left = arg.Left;
				break;
			case Dock.Top:
				result.Top = arg.Top;
				break;
			case Dock.Right:
				result.Right = arg.Right;
				break;
			case Dock.Bottom:
				result.Bottom = arg.Bottom;
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal static Dock Invert(this Dock dock)
		{
			return dock switch
			{
				Dock.Left => Dock.Right, 
				Dock.Top => Dock.Bottom, 
				Dock.Right => Dock.Left, 
				Dock.Bottom => Dock.Top, 
				_ => dock, 
			};
		}
	}
	internal static class MDIMergeStyleExtensions
	{
		internal static bool IsDefault(this MDIMergeStyle value)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0005: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)value != 0)
			{
				return (int)value == 1;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal static class IDictionaryExtensions
	{
		public static TKey GetKeyByValue<TKey, TValue>(this IDictionary<TKey, TValue> dictionary, TValue value)
		{
			if (dictionary == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("dictionary");
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> item in dictionary)
			{
				if (value.Equals(item.Value))
				{
					return item.Key;
				}
			}
			throw new ArgumentException("value");
		}
	}
	internal static class EnumerableEx
	{
		public static T FirstOrDefault<T>(this IEnumerable<T> enumerable, Func<T, bool> predicate, T defaultValue)
		{
			if (enumerable == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("enumerable");
			}
			if (predicate == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("predicate");
			}
			foreach (T item in enumerable)
			{
				if (predicate(item))
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}
	}
	internal static class HitTestTypeExtensions
	{
		public static SizingAction ToSizingAction(object hitTestType)
		{
			return ((hitTestType as HitTestType?) ?? HitTestType.Undefined).ToSizingAction();
		}

		public static SizingAction ToSizingAction(this HitTestType hitTestType)
		{
			SizingAction result = SizingAction.None;
			switch (hitTestType)
			{
			case HitTestType.SizeE:
				result = SizingAction.East;
				break;
			case HitTestType.SizeN:
				result = SizingAction.North;
				break;
			case HitTestType.SizeS:
				result = SizingAction.South;
				break;
			case HitTestType.SizeW:
				result = SizingAction.West;
				break;
			case HitTestType.SizeNE:
				result = SizingAction.NorthEast;
				break;
			case HitTestType.SizeNW:
				result = SizingAction.NorthWest;
				break;
			case HitTestType.SizeSE:
				result = SizingAction.SouthEast;
				break;
			case HitTestType.SizeSW:
				result = SizingAction.SouthWest;
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

	{
		public static DispatcherOperation BeginInvoke(DispatcherObject d, Func<bool> condition, Action action, DispatcherPriority priority = DispatcherPriority.Normal)
		{
			DispatcherOperation result = null;
			if (condition())
			{
				result = d.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(action, priority);
			}
			else
			{
				action();
			}
			return result;
		}

		}

		}

	[Browsable(false)]

	public class DockHintsConfiguration
	{
		private class DockHintState
		{
			private bool _IsEnabled = true;

			private bool _IsVisible = true;

			public bool IsEnabled
			{
				get
				{
					return _IsEnabled;
				}
				set
				{
					_IsEnabled = value;
				}
			}

			public bool IsVisible
			{
				get
				{
					return _IsVisible;
				}
				set
				{
					_IsVisible = value;
				}
			}
		}

		private Dictionary<object, DockHintState> Hints;

		public bool DisableAll { get; set; }

		public bool HideAll { get; set; }

		public bool ShowSideDockHints { get; set; }

		public bool ShowSelfDockHint { get; set; }

		public DockGuidDisplayMode DisplayMode { get; set; }

		public DockHintsConfiguration()
		{
			Hints = new Dictionary<object, DockHintState>();
		}

		internal bool GetSideIsEnabled(DevExpress.Xpf.Docking.Platform.DockVisualizerElement element)
		{
			return GetIsEnabled(element.ToSideDockHint());
		}

		internal bool GetSideIsVisible(DevExpress.Xpf.Docking.Platform.DockVisualizerElement element)
		{
			return GetIsVisible(element.ToSideDockHint());
		}

		internal bool GetAutoHideIsEnabled(DevExpress.Xpf.Docking.Platform.DockVisualizerElement element)

		internal bool GetAutoHideIsVisible(DevExpress.Xpf.Docking.Platform.DockVisualizerElement element)

		internal bool GetGuideIsVisible(DevExpress.Xpf.Docking.Platform.DockVisualizerElement element)

		public void Hide(object hint)
		{
			DockHintState dockHintState = GetDockHintState(hint);
			dockHintState.IsVisible = false;
		}

		public void Disable(object hint)
		{
			DockHintState dockHintState = GetDockHintState(hint);
			dockHintState.IsEnabled = false;
		}

		public bool GetIsVisible(object hint)
		{
			DockHintState dockHintState = GetDockHintState(hint);
			if (dockHintState.IsVisible)
			{
				return !HideAll;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool GetIsEnabled(object hint)
		{
			DockHintState dockHintState = GetDockHintState(hint);
			if (dockHintState.IsEnabled)
			{
				return !DisableAll;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private DockHintState GetDockHintState(object hint)
		{
			if (!Hints.TryGetValue(hint, out var value))
			{
				value = new DockHintState();
				Hints[hint] = value;
			}
			return value;
		}

		public void SetCanHide(bool canHide)
		{
			DockHintState dockHintState = GetDockHintState(DockHint.AutoHideBottom);
			DockHintState dockHintState2 = GetDockHintState(DockHint.AutoHideLeft);
			DockHintState dockHintState3 = GetDockHintState(DockHint.AutoHideRight);
			bool flag = (GetDockHintState(DockHint.AutoHideTop).IsEnabled = canHide);
			bool flag3 = (dockHintState3.IsEnabled = flag);
			bool isEnabled = (dockHintState2.IsEnabled = flag3);
			dockHintState.IsEnabled = isEnabled;
		}

		internal void SetCanDockCenter(bool canDock)
		{
			DockHintState dockHintState = GetDockHintState(DockHint.CenterLeft);
			DockHintState dockHintState2 = GetDockHintState(DockHint.CenterRight);
			DockHintState dockHintState3 = GetDockHintState(DockHint.CenterTop);
			bool flag = (GetDockHintState(DockHint.CenterBottom).IsEnabled = canDock);
			bool flag3 = (dockHintState3.IsEnabled = flag);
			bool isEnabled = (dockHintState2.IsEnabled = flag3);
			dockHintState.IsEnabled = isEnabled;
		}

		internal void SetCanDockToSide(bool canDock)
		{
			DockHintState dockHintState = GetDockHintState(DockHint.SideLeft);
			DockHintState dockHintState2 = GetDockHintState(DockHint.SideRight);
			DockHintState dockHintState3 = GetDockHintState(DockHint.SideTop);
			bool flag = (GetDockHintState(DockHint.SideBottom).IsEnabled = canDock);
			bool flag3 = (dockHintState3.IsEnabled = flag);
			bool isEnabled = (dockHintState2.IsEnabled = flag3);
			dockHintState.IsEnabled = isEnabled;
		}

		internal void SetCanDockToTab(bool canDock)
		{
			DockHintState dockHintState = GetDockHintState(DockHint.TabBottom);
			DockHintState dockHintState2 = GetDockHintState(DockHint.TabLeft);
			DockHintState dockHintState3 = GetDockHintState(DockHint.TabRight);
			bool flag = (GetDockHintState(DockHint.TabTop).IsEnabled = canDock);
			bool flag3 = (dockHintState3.IsEnabled = flag);
			bool isEnabled = (dockHintState2.IsEnabled = flag3);
			dockHintState.IsEnabled = isEnabled;
		}

		internal void SetCanFill(bool canFill)
		{
			DockHintState dockHintState = GetDockHintState(DockHint.Center);
			bool isVisible = (dockHintState.IsEnabled = canFill);
			dockHintState.IsVisible = isVisible;
		}

		internal void SetSideGuidsVisibility(bool isVisible)
		{
			DockHintState dockHintState = GetDockHintState(DockGuide.Left);
			DockHintState dockHintState2 = GetDockHintState(DockGuide.Right);
			DockHintState dockHintState3 = GetDockHintState(DockGuide.Top);
			bool flag = (GetDockHintState(DockGuide.Bottom).IsVisible = isVisible);
			bool flag3 = (dockHintState3.IsVisible = flag);
			bool isVisible2 = (dockHintState2.IsVisible = flag3);
			dockHintState.IsVisible = isVisible2;
		}

		internal void SetCenterGuidVisibility(bool isVisible)
		{
			GetDockHintState(DockGuide.Center).IsVisible = isVisible;
		}

		public void Invalidate()
		{
			Hints.Clear();
			DisableAll = false;
			HideAll = false;
			ShowSideDockHints = false;
			ShowSelfDockHint = false;
		}

		public void SetConfiguration(DockLayoutManager manager, DockLayoutElementDragInfo dragInfo)
		{
			if (manager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ShowSideDockHints = dragInfo.View.Type == HostType.Layout;
			ShowSelfDockHint = dragInfo.AcceptSelfDock();
			bool flag = dragInfo.AcceptDockCenter();
			bool flag2 = dragInfo.AcceptFill();
			bool canDock = dragInfo.CanDock;
			bool canDockToTab = dragInfo.CanDockToTab;
			bool canDockToSide = dragInfo.CanDockToSide;
			bool canHide = dragInfo.CanHide;
			SetCanHide(canHide);
			SetCanDockCenter(canDock);
			SetCanDockToTab(canDockToTab);
			SetCanDockToSide(canDockToSide);
			SetCanFill(flag2);
			SetSideGuidsVisibility(ShowSideDockHints && (canDockToSide || canHide));
			SetCenterGuidVisibility(ShowSelfDockHint && flag && (flag2 || canDock || canDockToTab));
			BaseLayoutItem target = dragInfo.Target;
			if (target.GetIsDocumentHost())
			{
				if (manager.DockingStyle == DockingStyle.VS2010 && dragInfo.Item.GetAllowDockToDocumentGroup())
				{
					DisplayMode = DockGuidDisplayMode.Full;
				}
				else
				{
					DisplayMode = DockGuidDisplayMode.DockOnly;
				}
				BaseLayoutItem item = dragInfo.Item;
				if (item.ItemType == LayoutItemType.Document)
				{
					DisplayMode = DockGuidDisplayMode.TabOnly;
				}
				if (item is FloatGroup && ((FloatGroup)item).IsDocumentHost)
				{
					DisplayMode = DockGuidDisplayMode.TabOnly;
				}
				LayoutGroup layoutGroup = target.Parent ?? ((LayoutGroup)target);
				int num = layoutGroup.Items.Count((BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem) => baseLayoutItem is DocumentGroup && ((DocumentGroup)baseLayoutItem).Items.Count > 0);
				if (num <= 1)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (layoutGroup.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
				{
					Disable(DockHint.TabTop);
					Disable(DockHint.TabBottom);
					if (DockControllerHelper.GetNextNotEmptyDocumentGroup(target) != null)
					{
						Disable(DockHint.CenterRight);
					}
					if (DockControllerHelper.GetPreviousNotEmptyDocumentGroup(target) != null)
					{
						Disable(DockHint.CenterLeft);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Disable(DockHint.TabLeft);
					Disable(DockHint.TabRight);
					if (DockControllerHelper.GetNextNotEmptyDocumentGroup(target) != null)
					{
						Disable(DockHint.CenterBottom);
					}
					if (DockControllerHelper.GetPreviousNotEmptyDocumentGroup(target) != null)
					{
						Disable(DockHint.CenterTop);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				DisplayMode = DockGuidDisplayMode.DockOnly;
			}
		}
	}
	public class DockSituation
	{
		private BaseLayoutItem dockTargetCore;

		private GridLength[] Lengths;

		private Orientation? LengthsOrientation;

		private readonly WeakReference rootReference;

		public Point FloatLocation { get; set; }

		public GridLength Width { get; set; }

		public GridLength Height { get; set; }

		public Dock DesiredDock { get; private set; }

		public AutoHideType AutoHideType { get; internal set; }

		public DockType Type { get; internal set; }

		public BaseLayoutItem DockTarget
		{
			get
			{
				return dockTargetCore;
			}
			internal set
			{
				dockTargetCore = value;
				LayoutGroup layoutGroup = value as LayoutGroup;
				Lengths = GetLengths(layoutGroup);
				LengthsOrientation = ((Lengths != null) ? new Orientation?(layoutGroup.Orientation) : ((Orientation?)null));
			}
		}

		public LayoutGroup Root
		{
			get
			{
				if (!rootReference.IsAlive)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return rootReference.Target as LayoutGroup;
			}
		}

		public DockSituation(DockType type, BaseLayoutItem target)
			: this(type, target, Dock.Left)
		{
		}

		public DockSituation(DockType type, BaseLayoutItem target, Dock desiredDock)
		{
			Type = type;
			DesiredDock = desiredDock;
			DockTarget = target;
			rootReference = new WeakReference(target.GetRoot());
			Width = (Height = new GridLength(1.0, GridUnitType.Star));
		}

		private GridLength[] GetLengths(LayoutGroup group)
		{
			GridLength[] array = null;
			if (group != null && group.ItemType == LayoutItemType.Group)
			{
				array = new GridLength[group.Items.Count];
				bool flag = group.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal;
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					array[i] = (flag ? group[i].ItemWidth : group[i].ItemHeight);
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		public bool TheSameLengths(LayoutGroup group)
		{
			GridLength[] lengths = GetLengths(group);
			if (lengths == null || Lengths == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (lengths.Length != Lengths.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (LengthsOrientation.HasValue && LengthsOrientation.Value != group.Orientation)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Lengths.Length; i++)
			{
				if (Lengths[i] != lengths[i])
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static DockSituation GetDockSituation(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			return GetDockSituation(item, GetDesiredDock(item));
		}

		public static DockSituation GetDockSituation(BaseLayoutItem item, Dock dock)
		{
			DockSituation dockSituation = new DockSituation(GetDockType(item), item.Parent, dock);
			dockSituation.Width = item.ItemWidth;
			dockSituation.Height = item.ItemHeight;
			return dockSituation;
		}

		internal static Dock GetDesiredDock(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			Dock? autoHideCenterDock = LayoutItemsHelper.GetAutoHideCenterDock(item);
			if (autoHideCenterDock.HasValue)
			{
				return autoHideCenterDock.Value;
			}
			Rect rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);
			Stack<Dock> stack = new Stack<Dock>(4);
			while (item.Parent != null)
			{
				LayoutGroup parent = item.Parent;
				if (!parent.IgnoreOrientation && parent.GetVisibleItemsCount() > 1)
				{
					stack.Push(GetDockInGroup(item, parent));
				}
				item = item.Parent;
			}
			Dock dock = Dock.Left;
			while (stack.Count > 0)
			{
				dock = stack.Pop();
				switch (dock)
				{
				case Dock.Left:
					rect = new Rect(rect.Left, rect.Top, rect.Width * 0.5, rect.Height);
					break;
				case Dock.Right:
					rect = new Rect(rect.Left + rect.Width * 0.5, rect.Top, rect.Width * 0.5, rect.Height);
					break;
				case Dock.Top:
					rect = new Rect(rect.Left, rect.Top, rect.Width, rect.Height * 0.5);
					break;
				case Dock.Bottom:
					rect = new Rect(rect.Left, rect.Top + rect.Height * 0.5, rect.Width, rect.Height * 0.5);
					break;
				}
			}
			double x = rect.Left + rect.Width * 0.5;
			double y = rect.Top + rect.Height * 0.5;
			return Calc(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0), new Point(x, y), dock);
		}

		private static Dock GetDockInGroup(BaseLayoutItem item, LayoutGroup group)
		{
			bool flag = IsOneOfFirstItems(item, group);
			bool flag2 = group.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal;
			if (!flag)
			{
				if (!flag2)
				{
					return Dock.Bottom;
				}
				return Dock.Right;
			}
			if (!flag2)
			{
				return Dock.Top;
			}
			return Dock.Left;
		}

		private static bool IsOneOfFirstItems(BaseLayoutItem item, LayoutGroup group)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem[] visibleItems = group.GetVisibleItems();
			return (double)Array.IndexOf(visibleItems, item) < (double)visibleItems.Length * 0.5;
		}

		internal static DockType GetDockType(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			LayoutGroup parent = item.Parent;
			if (parent is TabbedGroup)
			{
				return DockType.Fill;
			}
			bool flag = IsOneOfFirstItems(item, parent);
			bool flag2 = parent.IgnoreOrientation || parent.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal;
			if (!flag)
			{
				if (!flag2)
				{
					return DockType.Bottom;
				}
				return DockType.Right;
			}
			if (!flag2)
			{
				return DockType.Top;
			}
			return DockType.Left;
		}

		private static Dock Calc(Rect r, Point p, Dock lastDockType)
		{
			Dock result = lastDockType;
			if (r.Contains(p))
			{
				if (p.X == p.Y || p.X == 1.0 - p.Y)
				{
					return lastDockType;
				}
				bool flag = p.Y - p.X < r.Top - r.Left;
				bool flag2 = p.Y + p.X < r.Top + r.Right;
				bool flag3 = p.Y - p.X > r.Bottom - r.Right;
				bool flag4 = p.Y + p.X > r.Bottom + r.Left;
				if (flag && flag2 && p.Y < r.Top + r.Height * 0.5)
				{
					result = Dock.Top;
				}
				if (flag3 && flag4 && p.Y > r.Top + r.Height * 0.5)
				{
					result = Dock.Bottom;
				}
				if (!flag && !flag4 && p.X < r.Left + r.Width * 0.5)
				{
					result = Dock.Left;
				}
				if (!flag2 && !flag3 && p.X > r.Left + r.Width * 0.5)
				{
					result = Dock.Right;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	internal static class KeyboardFocusHelper
	{
		public static DependencyObject FocusedElement => Keyboard.FocusedElement as DependencyObject;

		public static void RestoreKeyboardFocus(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			DependencyObject element2 = (FocusManager.GetIsFocusScope(element) ? element : FocusManager.GetFocusScope(element));
			IInputElement focusedElement = FocusManager.GetFocusedElement(element2);
			if (focusedElement != null)
			{
				FocusElement(focusedElement as UIElement);
			}
		}

		public static void FocusElement(UIElement element, bool ignoreCurrentFocusState = false)
		{
			if (element != null && (ignoreCurrentFocusState || !IsKeyboardFocusWithin(element)))
			{
				if (InvokePostFocusRequired(element))
				{
					InvokeHelper.BeginInvoke(element, new Action<UIElement>(PostFocus), DispatcherPriority.Loaded, element);
				}
				else
				{
					PostFocus(element);
				}
			}
		}

		private static DependencyObject GetElementToFocus(UIElement element)
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = element;
			DependencyObject element2 = (FocusManager.GetIsFocusScope(element) ? element : FocusManager.GetFocusScope(element));
			if (FocusManager.GetFocusedElement(element2) is DependencyObject dependencyObject2 && LayoutHelper.IsChildElement((DependencyObject)element, dependencyObject2) && (!(dependencyObject2 is FrameworkElement frameworkElement) || (frameworkElement.IsVisible && frameworkElement.IsLoaded)))
			{
				dependencyObject = dependencyObject2;
			}
			if (dependencyObject != null)
			{
				dependencyObject = LayoutItemsHelper.FindElementInVisualTree(dependencyObject, CanFocusSkipCallback, CanFocusResultCallback);
			}
			if (dependencyObject == null)
			{
				BaseLayoutItem layoutItem = DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(element);
				if (layoutItem != null)
				{
					dependencyObject = layoutItem.GetUIElement<psvSelectorItem>();
				}
			}
			return dependencyObject;
		}

		private static bool InvokePostFocusRequired(DependencyObject dObj)
		{
			if (!WindowHelper.IsXBAP)
			{
				return InvokePostFocusRequiredCore(dObj);
			}
			return LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<Page>(dObj) == null;
		}

		private static bool InvokePostFocusRequiredCore(DependencyObject dObj)
		{
			return PresentationSource.FromDependencyObject(dObj) == null;
		}

		private static void PostFocus(UIElement element)
		{
			if (!element.Return((UIElement x) => x.IsKeyboardFocusWithin, () => false))
			{
				DependencyObject elementToFocus = GetElementToFocus(element);
				if (elementToFocus != null)
				{
					PostFocusCore(elementToFocus);
				}
			}
		}

		private static bool CanFocusSkipCallback(DependencyObject d)
		{
			if (d is UIElement { IsVisible: false })
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(d is Menu) && !(d is BarItemLinkInfo) && !(d is ToolBar) && !(d is IRibbonStatusBarControl))
			{
				return d is IRibbonControl;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool CanFocusResultCallback(DependencyObject e)
		{
			if (e is BarManager)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (e is IInputElement inputElement)
			{
				return inputElement.Focusable;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static void PostFocusCore(DependencyObject elementToFocus)
		{
			UIElement uIElement = elementToFocus as UIElement;
			IInputElement input = elementToFocus as IInputElement;
			if (uIElement != null)
			{
				if (!uIElement.IsKeyboardFocusWithin && uIElement.IsVisible)
				{
					uIElement.Focus();
				}
				return;
			}
			input.If((IInputElement x) => !x.IsKeyboardFocusWithin).Do(delegate(IInputElement x)
			{
				Keyboard.Focus(x);
			});
		}

		public static void SetFocus(UIElement element)
		{
			element.Focus();
		}

		public static bool Focusable(UIElement element)
		{
			return element.Focusable;
		}

		public static bool IsKeyboardFocused(UIElement element)
		{
			return element.IsKeyboardFocused;
		}

		public static bool IsKeyboardFocusWithin(UIElement element)
		{
			return element.IsKeyboardFocusWithin;
		}

		public static IInputElement Convert(UIElement element)
		{
			return element;
		}
	}
	public class GridLengthAnimation : AnimationTimeline
	{
		public static readonly GridLength ZeroStar;

		public static readonly GridLength Zero;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ToProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty FromProperty;

		public GridLength To
		{
			get
			{
				return (GridLength)GetValue(ToProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ToProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public GridLength From
		{
			get
			{
				return (GridLength)GetValue(FromProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(FromProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public override Type TargetPropertyType => typeof(GridLength);

		static GridLengthAnimation()
		{
			ZeroStar = new GridLength(0.0, GridUnitType.Star);
			Zero = new GridLength(0.0, GridUnitType.Pixel);
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<GridLengthAnimation> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<GridLengthAnimation>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("To", ref ToProperty, ZeroStar);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("From", ref FromProperty, ZeroStar);
		}

		internal static GridLength CalcCurrentValue(double from, double to, double progress, bool isStar)
		{
			double num = ((from > to) ? (1.0 - progress) : progress);
			double num2 = Math.Max(from, to);
			double num3 = Math.Min(from, to);
			return new GridLength(num * (num2 - num3) + num3, (!isStar) ? GridUnitType.Pixel : GridUnitType.Star);
		}

		protected override Freezable CreateInstanceCore()
		{
			return new GridLengthAnimation();
		}

		public override object GetCurrentValue(object defaultOriginValue, object defaultDestinationValue, AnimationClock animationClock)
		{
			return CalcCurrentValue(From.Value, To.Value, animationClock.CurrentProgress.Value, To.IsStar);
		}
	}
	public class HierarchyPropertyValue<T>
	{
		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private DependencyProperty property;

		private readonly T DefaultValue;

		public DependencyProperty Property
		{
			get
			{
				return property;
			}
			set
			{
				property = value;
			}
		}

		public HierarchyPropertyValue(DependencyProperty property, T defaultValue)
		{
			Property = property;
			DefaultValue = defaultValue;
		}

		internal T Get(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			return Get(item, item.GetValue(Property));
		}

		internal T Get(BaseLayoutItem item, object value)
		{
			if (object.Equals(value, DefaultValue) && item.Parent != null)
			{
				return Get(item.Parent);
			}
			return (T)value;
		}
	}
	public static class IntervalHelper
	{
		public static DependencyProperty GetTargetProperty(BaseLayoutItem item1, BaseLayoutItem item2)
		{
			if (item1 != null && item2 != null)
			{
				if (item1.ItemType == LayoutItemType.Group && item2.ItemType == LayoutItemType.Group)
				{
					if ((HasAccent(item1) && (item1.IsControlItemsHost || ContainsControlItemsHosts(item1 as LayoutGroup))) || (HasAccent(item2) && (item2.IsControlItemsHost || ContainsControlItemsHosts(item2 as LayoutGroup))))
					{
						return LayoutGroup.ActualLayoutGroupIntervalProperty;
					}
					return LayoutGroup.ActualDockItemIntervalProperty;
				}
				if (item1.ItemType == LayoutItemType.Panel || item2.ItemType == LayoutItemType.Panel)
				{
					return LayoutGroup.ActualDockItemIntervalProperty;
				}
				if (item1.ItemType == LayoutItemType.ControlItem && item2.ItemType == LayoutItemType.Group)
				{
					if (!HasAccent(item2))
					{
						return LayoutGroup.ActualLayoutItemIntervalProperty;
					}
					return LayoutGroup.ActualLayoutGroupIntervalProperty;
				}
				if (item2.ItemType == LayoutItemType.ControlItem && item1.ItemType == LayoutItemType.Group)
				{
					if (!HasAccent(item1))
					{
						return LayoutGroup.ActualLayoutItemIntervalProperty;
					}
					return LayoutGroup.ActualLayoutGroupIntervalProperty;
				}
				if (item1.ItemType == LayoutItemType.ControlItem && item2.ItemType == LayoutItemType.ControlItem)
				{
					return LayoutGroup.ActualLayoutItemIntervalProperty;
				}
				if (item1.ItemType == LayoutItemType.ControlItem && IsFixed(item2))
				{
					return LayoutGroup.ActualLayoutItemIntervalProperty;
				}
				if (item2.ItemType == LayoutItemType.ControlItem && IsFixed(item1))
				{
					return LayoutGroup.ActualLayoutItemIntervalProperty;
				}
				if (IsFixed(item1) && IsFixed(item2))
				{
					return LayoutGroup.ActualLayoutItemIntervalProperty;
				}
			}
			return LayoutGroup.ActualDockItemIntervalProperty;
		}

		private static bool IsFixed(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item is FixedItem)
			{
				if (!(item is SeparatorItem))
				{
					return !(item is LayoutSplitter);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool ContainsControlItemsHosts(LayoutGroup group)
		{
			return group?.Items.ContainsOnlyControlItemsOrItsHosts() ?? false;
		}

		private static bool HasAccent(BaseLayoutItem group)
		{
			bool? flag = (bool?)group.GetValue(LayoutGroup.HasAccentProperty);
			if (flag.HasValue)
			{
				return flag.Value;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public static class LayoutItemsHelper
	{
		private class LayoutEnumerator : IEnumerator<BaseLayoutItem>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
		{
			private LayoutGroup Root;

			private Stack<BaseLayoutItem> Stack;

			private Predicate<BaseLayoutItem> Filter;

			private BaseLayoutItem current;

			object IEnumerator.Current => current;

			public BaseLayoutItem Current => current;

			public LayoutEnumerator(LayoutGroup rootGroup, Predicate<BaseLayoutItem> filter)
			{
				Stack = new Stack<BaseLayoutItem>(8);
				Filter = filter;
				Root = rootGroup;
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				Reset();
				Stack = null;
				Filter = null;
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				if (current == null)
				{
					current = Root;
				}
				else
				{
					if (current is LayoutGroup layoutGroup)
					{
						BaseLayoutItem[] items = layoutGroup.GetItems();
						if (items.Length != 0)
						{
							for (int i = 0; i < items.Length; i++)
							{
								BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = items[items.Length - 1 - i];
								if (Filter == null || Filter(baseLayoutItem))
								{
									Stack.Push(baseLayoutItem);
								}
							}
						}
					}
					current = ((Stack.Count > 0) ? Stack.Pop() : null);
				}
				return current != null;
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				Stack.Clear();
				current = null;
			}
		}

		private class IUIElementVisualTreeEnumerator : IEnumerator<DependencyObject>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
		{
			private DependencyObject Root;

			private Stack<DependencyObject> Stack;

			private Predicate<DependencyObject> Filter;

			private DependencyObject current;

			object IEnumerator.Current => current;

			public DependencyObject Current => current;

			public IUIElementVisualTreeEnumerator(DependencyObject root, Predicate<DependencyObject> filter)
			{
				Stack = new Stack<DependencyObject>(16);
				Filter = filter;
				Root = root;
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				Reset();
				Stack = null;
				Filter = null;
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				if (current == null)
				{
					current = Root;
				}
				else
				{
					int childrenCount = VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(current);
					DependencyObject[] array = new DependencyObject[childrenCount];
					for (int i = 0; i < childrenCount; i++)
					{
						array[i] = VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(current, i);
					}
					if (array.Length != 0)
					{
						for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
						{
							DependencyObject dependencyObject = array[array.Length - 1 - j];
							if (!(dependencyObject is IUIElement) && (Filter == null || Filter(dependencyObject)))
							{
								Stack.Push(dependencyObject);
							}
						}
					}
					current = ((Stack.Count > 0) ? Stack.Pop() : null);
				}
				return current != null;
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				Stack.Clear();
				current = null;
			}
		}

		private class PathNode
		{
			public int Index = -1;

			public Type Type;

			public static PathNode FromItem(BaseLayoutItem item)

				return new PathNode
				{
					Type = item.GetType()
				};
			}
		}

		internal static int FindSubtreeIndex(LayoutGroup rootElement, BaseLayoutItem subtreeElement)
		{
			while (subtreeElement.Parent != null && subtreeElement.Parent != rootElement)
			{
				subtreeElement = subtreeElement.Parent;
			}
			return rootElement.Items.IndexOf(subtreeElement);
		}

		internal static BaseLayoutItem GetActualLayoutItem(this FloatGroup floatGroup)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem result = floatGroup;
			if (floatGroup.HasSingleItem)
			{
				result = ((!(floatGroup.Items[0] is TabbedGroup tabbedGroup)) ? floatGroup.Items[0] : (tabbedGroup.SelectedItem ?? floatGroup));
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal static Size GetAutoHideRenderSize(this BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item == null || !item.IsAutoHidden)
			{
				return Size.Empty;
			}
			AutoHideGroup autoHideGroup = (AutoHideGroup)item.GetRoot();
			AutoHideTray autoHideTray = autoHideGroup.GetRootUIScope() as AutoHideTray;
			Size actualAutoHideSize = autoHideGroup.GetActualAutoHideSize(item);
			bool flag = autoHideGroup.DockType == Dock.Left || autoHideGroup.DockType == Dock.Right;
			if (autoHideTray == null)
			{
				return Size.Empty;
			}
			return new Size(flag ? actualAutoHideSize.Width : autoHideTray.RenderSize.Width, flag ? autoHideTray.RenderSize.Height : actualAutoHideSize.Height);
		}

		internal static int GetIndexFromItem(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item == null || item.Parent == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return item.Parent.IndexFromItem(item);
		}

		internal static int GetTabIndexFromItem(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item == null || item.Parent == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return item.Parent.TabIndexFromItem(item);
		}

		internal static bool CanReorder(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem target)
		{
			LayoutPanel layoutPanel = item as LayoutPanel;
			LayoutPanel layoutPanel2 = target as LayoutPanel;
			if (layoutPanel == null || layoutPanel2 == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (layoutPanel.Parent == layoutPanel2.Parent)
			{
				return layoutPanel.IsPinnedTab == layoutPanel2.IsPinnedTab;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool IsFloatingRootItem(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				if (!item.IsFloatingRootItem)
				{
					return (item.Parent as TabbedGroup).Return((TabbedGroup x) => x.IsFloatingRootItem, () => false);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static Size GetResizingMinSize(FloatGroup fGroup)
		{
			Size size = new Size(82.0, 42.0);
			if (fGroup.Items.Count > 0 && fGroup[0] is LayoutGroup { IgnoreOrientation: false } layoutGroup)
			{
				bool flag = layoutGroup.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal;
				size = new Size(flag ? (42 * layoutGroup.Items.Count + 16) : 82, flag ? 42 : (42 * layoutGroup.Items.Count + 32));
			}
			return MathHelper.MeasureMinSize(new Size[2] { size, fGroup.ActualMinSize });
		}

		internal static Size GetResizingMaxSize(FloatGroup fGroup)
		{
			return new Size(double.IsNaN(fGroup.ActualMaxSize.Width) ? double.PositiveInfinity : fGroup.ActualMaxSize.Width, double.IsNaN(fGroup.ActualMaxSize.Height) ? double.PositiveInfinity : fGroup.ActualMaxSize.Height);
		}

		internal static bool IsActuallyVisibleInTree(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DefinitionBase definition = DefinitionsHelper.GetDefinition(item);
			if (definition != null)
			{
				return !DefinitionsHelper.IsZero(definition);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static DependencyObject FindElementInVisualTree(DependencyObject root, Predicate<DependencyObject> filter, Predicate<DependencyObject> result)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Expected O, but got Unknown
			VisualTreeEnumeratorWithConditionalStop val = new VisualTreeEnumeratorWithConditionalStop(root, filter);
			try
			{
				while (val.MoveNext())
				{
					DependencyObject current = val.Current;
					if (result != null && result(current))
					{
						return current;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static bool IsInTree(this BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			LayoutGroup root = item.GetRoot();
			if (root != null && root.ParentPanel != null)
			{
				root = root.ParentPanel.GetRoot();
			}
			if (root.IsRoot())
			{
				return !root.IsUngroupped;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static void UpdateZIndexes(DocumentGroup dGroup)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem[] items = dGroup.GetItems();
			BaseLayoutItem selectedItem = dGroup.SelectedItem;
			if (items.Length != 0 && selectedItem != null)
			{
				UpdateZIndexes(items, selectedItem);
			}
		}

		public static void UpdateZIndexes(BaseLayoutItem[] items, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			items = SortByZIndex(items);
			int num = Array.IndexOf(items, item);
			int num2 = items.Length - 1;
			if (num < num2)
			{
				Array.Copy(items, num + 1, items, num, num2 - num);
				items[num2] = item;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < items.Length; i++)
			{
				items[i].ZIndex = i;
			}
		}

		internal static BaseLayoutItem[] SortByZIndex(BaseLayoutItem[] items)
		{
			return items.OrderBy((BaseLayoutItem item) => item.ZIndex).ToArray();
		}

		}
