		public static LayoutGroup GetRoot(this BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = item;
			while (baseLayoutItem.Parent != null)
			{
				baseLayoutItem = baseLayoutItem.Parent;
			}
			return baseLayoutItem as LayoutGroup;
		}

		internal static Size GetSize(this BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			return item.GetSize(new Size(200.0, 200.0));
		}

		internal static Size GetSize(this BaseLayoutItem item, Size defaultSize)
		{
			double width = (item.ItemWidth.IsAbsolute ? item.ItemWidth.Value : defaultSize.Width);
			double height = (item.ItemHeight.IsAbsolute ? item.ItemHeight.Value : defaultSize.Height);
			return MathHelper.MeasureSize(item.ActualMinSize, item.ActualMaxSize, new Size(width, height));
		}

		public static bool IsParent(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem parent)
		{
			if (item != null && parent != null)
			{
				for (BaseLayoutItem parent2 = item.Parent; parent2 != null; parent2 = parent2.Parent)
				{
					if (parent2 == parent)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static BaseLayoutItem GetNextItem(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item == null || item.Parent == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			BaseLayoutItemCollection items = item.Parent.Items;
			BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = null;
			BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem2 = null;
			int num = items.IndexOf(item);
			if (num - 1 >= 0)
			{
				baseLayoutItem2 = items[num - 1];
			}
			if (num + 1 < items.Count)
			{
				baseLayoutItem = items[num + 1];
			}
			return baseLayoutItem2 ?? baseLayoutItem;
		}

		internal static bool? IsNextNeighbour(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem next)
		{
			if (next == null || item == null || next.Parent == null || item.Parent == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (next == item || next.Parent != item.Parent)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LayoutGroup parent = next.Parent;
			int num = parent.Items.IndexOf(next);
			int num2 = parent.Items.IndexOf(item);
			if (Math.Abs(num - num2) == 1)
			{
				return num - num2 == 1;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static bool AreInSameGroup(BaseLayoutItem item1, BaseLayoutItem item2)
		{
			if (item1 != null && item2 != null && item1.Parent != null && item2.Parent != null)
			{
				return item1.Parent == item2.Parent;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool AreInSameGroup(BaseLayoutItem[] items)
		{
			if (items == null || items.Length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			BaseLayoutItem item = items[0];
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item2 in items)
			{
				if (!AreInSameGroup(item, item2))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static DockLayoutManager GetDockLayoutManager(this BaseLayoutItem item)

		}

		internal static DockLayoutManager FindDockLayoutManager(this BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item.Manager != null)
			{
				return item.Manager;
			}
			LayoutGroup root = item.GetRoot();
			if (root != null)
			{
				DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = root.Manager;
				if (dockLayoutManager == null)
				{
					if (root.ParentPanel == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					dockLayoutManager = root.ParentPanel.FindDockLayoutManager();
				}
				return dockLayoutManager;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static T GetChild<T>(DependencyObject element) where T : DependencyObject
		{
			if (element != null && VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(element) == 1)
			{
				return VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(element, 0) as T;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static T GetTemplateChild<T>(DependencyObject element) where T : DependencyObject
		{
			T result = null;
			using (IEnumerator<DependencyObject> enumerator = GetEnumerator(element, null))
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					if (enumerator.Current is T)
					{
						result = (T)enumerator.Current;
						return result;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static T GetTemplateChild<T>(DependencyObject element, bool acceptRoot) where T : DependencyObject
		{
			T result = null;
			using (IEnumerator<DependencyObject> enumerator = GetEnumerator(element, null))
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					if (enumerator.Current is T && (acceptRoot || enumerator.Current != element))
					{
						result = (T)enumerator.Current;
						return result;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static T GetVisualChild<T>(DependencyObject element) where T : DependencyObject
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			T result = null;
			VisualTreeEnumerator val = new VisualTreeEnumerator(element);
			while (((NestedObjectEnumeratorBase)val).MoveNext())
			{
				if (val.Current is T)
				{
					return (T)val.Current;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static IUIElement GetIUIParent(DependencyObject dObj)
		{
			if (dObj == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DependencyObject visualParent = GetVisualParent(dObj);
			while (visualParent != null && !(visualParent is IUIElement))
			{
				visualParent = GetVisualParent(visualParent);
			}
			return (IUIElement)visualParent;
		}

		public static T GetTemplateParent<T>(DependencyObject dObj) where T : DependencyObject
		{
			if (dObj == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DependencyObject visualParent = GetVisualParent(dObj);
			while (visualParent != null && !(visualParent is T) && !(visualParent is IUIElement))
			{
				visualParent = GetVisualParent(visualParent);
			}
			return visualParent as T;
		}

		}

		}

			LayoutItemType itemType = item.ItemType;
			if (itemType == LayoutItemType.Panel || itemType == LayoutItemType.Document || itemType == LayoutItemType.AutoHidePanel)

				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsLayoutItem(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			switch (item.ItemType)
			{
			case LayoutItemType.ControlItem:
			case LayoutItemType.FixedItem:
			case LayoutItemType.LayoutSplitter:
			case LayoutItemType.EmptySpaceItem:
			case LayoutItemType.Separator:
			case LayoutItemType.Label:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsDataBound(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			LayoutGroup parent = item.Parent;
			if (parent != null)
			{
				if (parent.ItemsSource == null)
				{
					return BindingOperations.IsDataBound(parent, LayoutGroup.ItemsSourceProperty);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool CanRecognizeAccessKey(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			return item is LayoutControlItem;
		}

		internal static LayoutGroup GetFirstNoBorderParent(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LayoutGroup parent = item.Parent;
			while (parent != null && parent.GroupBorderStyle != GroupBorderStyle.NoBorder)
			{
				parent = parent.Parent;
			}
			return parent;
		}

		internal static bool IsResizable(BaseLayoutItem item, bool isHorizontal = true)
		{
			bool flag = item.AllowSizing && !(item is LayoutSplitter) && !(item is SeparatorItem) && (isHorizontal ? (item.ActualMinSize.Width != item.ActualMaxSize.Width) : (item.ActualMinSize.Height != item.ActualMaxSize.Height));
			if (flag && item is LayoutGroup)
			{
				flag = IsResizableGroup((LayoutGroup)item, isHorizontal);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private static bool IsResizableGroup(LayoutGroup group, bool isHorizontal)
		{
			if (group == null || IsEmptyGroup(group) || !IsActuallyVisibleInTree(group))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (group is DocumentGroup && !((DocumentGroup)group).IsTabbed)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (group.GroupBorderStyle == GroupBorderStyle.Tabbed && (group.IsControlItemsHost || group.Items.ContainsNestedControlItemHostItems()))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!isHorizontal && group.GroupBorderStyle == GroupBorderStyle.GroupBox && !group.IsExpanded)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in group.Items)
			{
				if (IsResizable(item))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return !group.HasItems;
		}

		private static bool IsEmptyGroup(LayoutGroup group)
		{
			if (group == null || group.HasNotCollapsedItems)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (group.ItemType != LayoutItemType.TabPanelGroup)
			{
				if (group.ItemType == LayoutItemType.Group)
				{
					return group.GroupBorderStyle == GroupBorderStyle.NoBorder;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static void BeginWidthAnimation(this BaseLayoutItem layoutItem, GridLength from, GridLength to, TimeSpan duration, EventHandler completed = null)
		{
			BeginGridLengthAnimation(layoutItem, BaseLayoutItem.ItemWidthProperty, from, to, duration, completed);
		}

		public static void BeginHeightAnimation(this BaseLayoutItem layoutItem, GridLength from, GridLength to, TimeSpan duration, EventHandler completed = null)
		{
			BeginGridLengthAnimation(layoutItem, BaseLayoutItem.ItemHeightProperty, from, to, duration, completed);
		}

		private static void BeginGridLengthAnimation(BaseLayoutItem layoutItem, DependencyProperty property, GridLength from, GridLength to, TimeSpan duration, EventHandler completed)
		{
			GridLengthAnimation gridLengthAnimation = CreateAnimation(from, to, duration);
			gridLengthAnimation.Completed += delegate
			{
				layoutItem.BeginAnimation(property, null);
				layoutItem.SetValue(property, to);
			};
			if (completed != null)
			{
				gridLengthAnimation.Completed += completed;
			}
			layoutItem.BeginAnimation(property, gridLengthAnimation);
		}

		private static GridLengthAnimation CreateAnimation(GridLength from, GridLength to, TimeSpan duration)
		{
			return new GridLengthAnimation
			{
				From = from,
				To = to,
				Duration = new Duration(duration),
				FillBehavior = FillBehavior.Stop
			};
		}

		public static bool AreTreePathEqual(BaseLayoutItem item1, BaseLayoutItem item2)
		{
			if (item1 == item2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return AreEqual(GetPath(item1), GetPath(item2));
		}

		private static bool AreEqual(PathNode[] path1, PathNode[] path2)
		{
			if (path1 == null || path2 == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (path1.Length != path2.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int num = path1.Length - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (path1[num].Type != path2[num].Type)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (path1[num].Index != path2[num].Index)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static PathNode[] GetPath(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			List<PathNode> list = new List<PathNode>();
			while (item != null)
			{
				PathNode pathNode = PathNode.FromItem(item);
				list.Add(pathNode);
				LayoutGroup parent = item.Parent;
				if (parent != null)
				{
					pathNode.Index = parent.Items.IndexOf(item);
				}
				else if (item is LayoutGroup layoutGroup)
				{
					item = layoutGroup.ParentPanel;
					continue;
				}
				item = parent;
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal static bool IsItemWithRestrictedFloating(this BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item is LayoutPanel || item is TabbedGroup || item is FloatGroup)
			{
				if (item.AllowFloat)
				{
					return !item.GetDockLayoutManager().Return((DockLayoutManager x) => x.ShowContentWhenDragging, () => true);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static Thickness GetFloatingBorderMargin(this BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (!item.AllowFloat)
			{
				return new Thickness(12.0);
			}
			DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = item.GetDockLayoutManager();
			if ((item.IsFloatingRootItem || item is FloatGroup) && !dockLayoutManager.ShowContentWhenDragging)
			{
				return item.GetBorderMargin();
			}
			return new Thickness(6.0);
		}

		internal static Thickness GetBorderMargin(this BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = item.GetDockLayoutManager();
			if (dockLayoutManager == null)
			{
				return default(Thickness);
			}
			string themeName = DockLayoutManagerExtension.GetThemeName(dockLayoutManager);
			FloatPaneElements resourceKey = ((item is DocumentPanel) ? FloatPaneElements.FormBorderMargin : FloatPaneElements.BorderMargin);
			FloatPaneElementsThemeKeyExtension obj = new FloatPaneElementsThemeKeyExtension
			{
				ResourceKey = resourceKey
			};
			((ThemeKeyExtensionGeneric)obj).ThemeName = themeName;
			return (Thickness)ResourceHelper.FindResource((FrameworkElement)dockLayoutManager, (object)obj);
		}

		internal static Dock? GetAutoHideCenterDock(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			Tuple<BaseLayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem> tuple = (from x in item.Manager.GetItems()
				where AutoHideGroup.GetIsAutoHideCenter(x) && IsActuallyVisibleInTree(x) && item.FindAmongParents((BaseLayoutItem y) => y == x, (BaseLayoutItem y) => y.Parent) == null
				select new Tuple<BaseLayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem>(x, item.FindCommonAncestor(x, (BaseLayoutItem y) => y.Parent)) into x
				where x.Item2 != null
				orderby item.FindAncestorIndex(x.Item2, (BaseLayoutItem y) => y.Parent)
				select x).FirstOrDefault();
			if (tuple != null)
			{
				BaseLayoutItem item2 = tuple.Item1;
				LayoutGroup layoutGroup = (tuple.Item2 as LayoutGroup) ?? tuple.Item2.Parent;
				if (layoutGroup != null)
				{
					int num = FindSubtreeIndex(layoutGroup, item2);
					int num2 = FindSubtreeIndex(layoutGroup, item);
					return (layoutGroup.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal) ? ((num2 >= num) ? Dock.Right : Dock.Left) : ((num2 < num) ? Dock.Top : Dock.Bottom);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static BaseLayoutItem GetFirstItemInGroup(LayoutGroup group)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem result = group;
			while (group != null && group.Items.Count > 0)
			{
				if (group.Items[0] is LayoutGroup layoutGroup && group.GroupBorderStyle != GroupBorderStyle.Tabbed)
				{
					group = layoutGroup;
					continue;
				}
				if (group is TabbedGroup || group.GroupBorderStyle == GroupBorderStyle.Tabbed)
				{
					if (group.SelectedItem != null)
					{
						result = group.SelectedItem;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					result = group.Items[0];
				}
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal static bool ShouldStayInTree(this LayoutGroup group)
		{
			if ((group.Manager == null || !group.Manager.IsContainerHost(group)) && !group.HasPlaceHolders)
			{
				return group.ReadLocalValue(LayoutGroup.ItemsSourceProperty) != DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal static class ILayoutControllerHelper
	{
		internal static LayoutGroup GetRestoreRoot(this ILayoutController controller, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item == null || !item.IsHidden || !item.AllowRestore)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LayoutGroup layoutGroup = item.Parent;
			if (layoutGroup == null)
			{
				if (!controller.Container.LayoutRoot.IsLayoutRoot)
				{
					return null;
				}
				layoutGroup = controller.Container.LayoutRoot;
			}
			return layoutGroup;
		}
	}

		}

	public enum DockLayoutManagerRule
	{
		WrongLayoutRoot,
		WrongContent,
		InconsistentLayout,
		ItemCanNotBeHidden,
		ItemCanNotBeHosted,
		WrongDocument,
		WrongAutoHiddenPanel,
		WrongPanel,
		FloatGroupsCollection,
		AutoHideGroupsCollection,
		ItemsSourceInUse,
		ItemCollectionMustBeEmpty,
		WidthIsNotSupported,
		HeightIsNotSupported
	}
	public static class DockLayoutManagerHelper
	{
		private static Dictionary<DockLayoutManagerRule, string> errors;

		static DockLayoutManagerHelper()
		{
			errors = new Dictionary<DockLayoutManagerRule, string>();
			errors.Add(DockLayoutManagerRule.WrongLayoutRoot, "Only LayoutGroup can be root of layout");
			errors.Add(DockLayoutManagerRule.WrongContent, "Only LayoutGroup or UIElement can be used as content");
			errors.Add(DockLayoutManagerRule.InconsistentLayout, "Only LayoutControlItem or LayoutGroup can be hosted within layout");
			errors.Add(DockLayoutManagerRule.ItemCanNotBeHidden, "Only LayoutControlItem or LayoutGroup can be hidden from layout to customization window");
			errors.Add(DockLayoutManagerRule.ItemCanNotBeHosted, "LayoutControlItem can be hosted only in LayoutGroup");
			errors.Add(DockLayoutManagerRule.WrongDocument, "Only DocumentPanel can be hosted within DocumentGroup");
			errors.Add(DockLayoutManagerRule.WrongAutoHiddenPanel, "AutoHideGroup's elements must be LayoutPanel objects");
			errors.Add(DockLayoutManagerRule.WrongPanel, "TabbedGroup's elements must be LayoutPanel objects");
			errors.Add(DockLayoutManagerRule.FloatGroupsCollection, "FloatGroup can be added only to DockLayoutManager.FloatGroups collection");
			errors.Add(DockLayoutManagerRule.AutoHideGroupsCollection, "AutoHideGroup can be added only to DockLayoutManager.AutoHideGroups collection");
			errors.Add(DockLayoutManagerRule.ItemsSourceInUse, "Operation is not valid while ItemsSource is in use. Access and modify elements with LayoutGroup.ItemsSource instead.");
			errors.Add(DockLayoutManagerRule.ItemCollectionMustBeEmpty, "Items collection must be empty before using ItemsSource.");
			errors.Add(DockLayoutManagerRule.WidthIsNotSupported, "The BaseLayoutItem.Width property is not supported. Use the BaseLayoutItem.ItemWidth property instead.");
			errors.Add(DockLayoutManagerRule.HeightIsNotSupported, "The BaseLayoutItem.Height property is not supported. Use the BaseLayoutItem.ItemHeight property instead.");
		}

		public static string GetRule(DockLayoutManagerRule rule)
		{
			if (!errors.TryGetValue(rule, out var value))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return value;
		}

		public static bool IsPopupRoot(object obj)
		{
			return obj?.GetType().Name.EndsWith("PopupRoot") ?? false;
		}

		public static bool IsPopup(object obj)
		{
			if (obj != null)
			{
				return obj is Popup;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class DefaultItemTemplateSelectorWrapper : DataTemplateSelector
	{
		internal abstract class DefaultItemTemplateSelector : DataTemplateSelector
		{
		}

		private DataTemplateSelector selector;

		private DataTemplate template;

		public DefaultItemTemplateSelectorWrapper(DataTemplateSelector selector, DataTemplate template)
		{
			this.selector = selector;
			this.template = template;
		}

		public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
		{
			if (selector == null)
			{
				return template;
			}
			if (template != null && selector is DefaultItemTemplateSelector)
			{
				return template;
			}
			return selector.SelectTemplate(item, container) ?? template;
		}
	}
	public static class VisibilityHelper
	{
		public static bool GetIsVisible(BaseLayoutItem item, bool isVisible)
		{
			if (isVisible && item.Parent != null)
			{
				return GetIsVisible(item.Parent);
			}
			if (isVisible && item is LayoutGroup && ((LayoutGroup)item).ParentPanel != null)
			{
				return GetIsVisible(item as LayoutGroup);
			}
			return isVisible;
		}

		public static bool GetIsVisible(LayoutGroup group)
		{
			if (group.ParentPanel != null)
			{
				return group.ParentPanel.IsVisibleCore;
			}
			return GetIsVisible(group, group.IsVisibleCore);
		}

		public static bool GetIsVisible(UIElement element)
		{
			return element.IsVisible;
		}

		public static bool ContainsNotCollapsedItems(LayoutGroup group)
		{
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in group.Items)
			{
				if (item.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (item is LayoutGroup)
				{
					LayoutGroup layoutGroup = (LayoutGroup)item;
					if ((layoutGroup.ItemType == LayoutItemType.Group && layoutGroup.GroupBorderStyle == GroupBorderStyle.NoBorder && !layoutGroup.HasNotCollapsedItems && !layoutGroup.GetIsDocumentHost()) || (layoutGroup.ItemType == LayoutItemType.TabPanelGroup && !layoutGroup.HasNotCollapsedItems) || (layoutGroup.ItemType == LayoutItemType.DocumentPanelGroup && !layoutGroup.HasNotCollapsedItems && !layoutGroup.GetIsDocumentHost() && !((DocumentGroup)layoutGroup).ShowWhenEmpty))
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool HasVisibleItems(LayoutGroup group)
		{
			if (group == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in group.Items)
			{
				if (item.IsVisibleCore)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static Visibility Convert(bool isVisible, Visibility invisibleValue = Visibility.Collapsed)
		{
			if (!isVisible)
			{
				return invisibleValue;
			}
			return Visibility.Visible;
		}
	}
	internal static class XamlLoaderHelper
	{
		private static void TryPreventWindowShowing(ContentControl control)
		{
			if (control is Window window)
			{
				window.Close();
			}
		}

		public static object LoadContentFromUri(Uri uri)
		{
			object obj = null;
			object obj2 = Application.LoadComponent(uri);
			if (obj2 is ContentControl contentControl)
			{
				if (!WindowHelper.IsXBAP)
				{
					TryPreventWindowShowing(contentControl);
				}
				if (contentControl is UserControl)
				{
					obj = contentControl;
				}
				else
				{
					obj = contentControl.Content;
					contentControl.Content = null;
				}
			}
			if (obj2 is Page page)
			{
				obj = page.Content;
				page.Content = null;
			}
			if (obj != obj2 && obj is DependencyObject && obj2 is DependencyObject)
			{
				NameScope.SetNameScope((DependencyObject)obj, NameScope.GetNameScope((DependencyObject)obj2));
			}
			return obj;
		}
	}
	[SupportDXTheme(TypeInAssembly = typeof(DockLayoutManager))]
	[DXToolboxBrowsable]
	[ContentProperty("LayoutRoot")]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_LeftAutoHideTray", Type = typeof(AutoHideTray))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_RightAutoHideTray", Type = typeof(AutoHideTray))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_TopAutoHideTray", Type = typeof(AutoHideTray))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_BottomAutoHideTray", Type = typeof(AutoHideTray))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_LeftAutoHideTrayPanel", Type = typeof(AutoHidePane))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_RightAutoHideTrayPanel", Type = typeof(AutoHidePane))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_TopAutoHideTrayPanel", Type = typeof(AutoHidePane))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_BottomAutoHideTrayPanel", Type = typeof(AutoHidePane))]
	[LicenseProvider(typeof(DX_WPF_ControlRequiredForReports_LicenseProvider))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_ClosedItemsPanel", Type = typeof(ClosedItemsPanel))]
	public class DockLayoutManager : psvControl, IWeakEventListener, IUIElement, ISupportBatchUpdate, ILogicalOwner, IInputElement
	{
		private enum LayoutItemState
		{
			Close,
			AutoHide
		}

		private class ThemeTreeWalkerHelper
		{
			private readonly DependencyObject Owner;

			private WeakReference walker;

			public ThemeTreeWalkerHelper(DependencyObject owner)
			{
				Owner = owner;
			}

			public bool IsThemeChanging()
			{
				if (CommonThemeHelper.UseLightweightThemes)
				{
					return false;
				}
				bool result = false;
				string text = null;
				if (walker != null)
				{
					object target = walker.Target;
					ThemeTreeWalker val = (ThemeTreeWalker)((target is ThemeTreeWalker) ? target : null);
					if (val != null)
					{
						text = val.ThemeName;
					}
				}
				ThemeTreeWalker treeWalker = ThemeManager.GetTreeWalker(Owner);
				if (treeWalker != null)
				{
					if (treeWalker.ThemeName != text)
					{
						result = true;
						walker = new WeakReference(treeWalker);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					walker = null;
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		private class LayoutItemStateHelper
		{
			private readonly DockLayoutManager Owner;

			public LayoutItemStateHelper(DockLayoutManager owner)
			{
				Owner = owner;
			}

			public void QueueCheckLayoutItemState(BaseLayoutItem item, LayoutItemState state)
			{
				Action<BaseLayoutItem, LayoutItemState> action = UpdateLayoutItemState;
				if (Owner.GetIsLogicalChildrenIterationInProgress() || item.IsLayoutTreeChangeInProgress)
				{
					Owner.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(action, item, state);
				}
				else
				{
					action(item, state);
				}
			}

			private void UpdateAutoHiddenState(BaseLayoutItem item)
			{
				if (!(item is LayoutPanel layoutPanel))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (layoutPanel.AutoHidden)
				{
					if (item.Parent != null)
					{
						Owner.DockController.Hide(item);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Owner.DockController.Dock(item);
				}
				item.SetAutoHidden(item.IsAutoHidden);
			}

			private void UpdateClosedState(BaseLayoutItem item)
			{
				if (item.Closed)
				{
					if (item.Parent != null)
					{
						item.SetCurrentValue(BaseLayoutItem.ClosedProperty, Owner.DockController.Close(item));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Owner.DockController.Restore(item);
				}
			}

			private void UpdateLayoutItemState(BaseLayoutItem item, LayoutItemState state)
			{
				switch (state)
				{
				case LayoutItemState.Close:
					UpdateClosedState(item);
					break;
				case LayoutItemState.AutoHide:
					UpdateAutoHiddenState(item);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private class ContainerGenerator
		{
			private readonly Dictionary<DependencyObject, IGeneratorHost> containerHash = new Dictionary<DependencyObject, IGeneratorHost>();

			private readonly Dictionary<object, DependencyObject> itemsHash = new Dictionary<object, DependencyObject>();

			public virtual void ClearContainerForItem(object item)
			{
				if (itemsHash.ContainsKey(item))
				{
					DependencyObject dependencyObject = itemsHash[item];
					if (containerHash.ContainsKey(dependencyObject))
					{
						containerHash[dependencyObject]?.ClearContainer(dependencyObject, item);
						containerHash.Remove(dependencyObject);
					}
					itemsHash.Remove(item);
				}
			}

			public DependencyObject GetContainerForItem(object item)
			{
				itemsHash.TryGetValue(item, out var value);
				return value;
			}

			public DependencyObject GetContainerForItem(IGeneratorHost generatorHost, object item, DataTemplate itemTemplate, DataTemplateSelector itemTemplateSelector)
			{
				if (generatorHost == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = generatorHost.GenerateContainerForItem(item, itemTemplate, itemTemplateSelector);
				itemsHash.Add(item, dependencyObject);
				containerHash.Add(dependencyObject, generatorHost);
				return dependencyObject;
			}

			public object GetItemForContainer(DependencyObject container)
			{
				if (!itemsHash.ContainsValue(container))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return itemsHash.GetKeyByValue(container);
			}

			public IEnumerable GetItems()
			{
				return itemsHash.Keys.ToList();
			}

			public bool IsContainerHost(IGeneratorHost generatorHost)
			{
				return containerHash.ContainsValue(generatorHost);
			}

			public DependencyObject LinkContainerToItem(object oldValue, object newValue, int newStartingIndex, DataTemplate itemTemplate, DataTemplateSelector itemTemplateSelector)
			{
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = itemsHash[oldValue];
				if (containerHash.ContainsKey(dependencyObject))
				{
					IGeneratorHost generatorHost = containerHash[dependencyObject];
					if (generatorHost != null)
					{
						containerHash.Remove(dependencyObject);
						itemsHash.Remove(oldValue);
						DependencyObject dependencyObject2 = generatorHost.LinkContainerToItem(dependencyObject, newValue, itemTemplate, itemTemplateSelector);
						itemsHash.Add(newValue, dependencyObject2);
						containerHash.Add(dependencyObject2, generatorHost);
						return dependencyObject2;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				object[] array = itemsHash.Keys.ToArray();
				object[] array2 = array;
				foreach (object item in array2)
				{
					ClearContainerForItem(item);
				}
				itemsHash.Clear();
				containerHash.Clear();
			}
		}

		private class DecomposedItemsCollection : LayoutGroupCollection
		{
			private readonly DockLayoutManager Owner;

			public DecomposedItemsCollection(DockLayoutManager owner)
			{
				if (owner == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("owner");
				}
				Owner = owner;
			}

			protected override void InsertItem(int index, LayoutGroup item)
			{
				if (item.Manager == null)
				{
					item.Manager = Owner;
				}
				AddLogicalChild(Owner, item);
				item.DockLayoutManagerCore = Owner;
				base.InsertItem(index, item);
			}

			protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
			{
				RemoveLogicalChild(Owner, base[index]);
				base.RemoveItem(index);
			}

			protected override void SetItem(int index, LayoutGroup item)
			{
				RemoveLogicalChild(Owner, base[index]);
				base.SetItem(index, item);
				AddLogicalChild(Owner, item);
			}
		}

		private class DisableFloatingPanelTransparencyBehavior : Behavior<DockLayoutManager>
		{
			private ResourceDictionary floatPaneStyles;

			private ResourceDictionary FloatPaneStyles => floatPaneStyles ?? (floatPaneStyles = new ResourceDictionary());

			protected override void OnAttached()
			{
				((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnAttached();
				Uri win32ResourcePath = base.AssociatedObject.ValuesProvider.Win32ResourcePath;
				if (win32ResourcePath != null)
				{
					FloatPaneStyles.Source = win32ResourcePath;
					if (!base.AssociatedObject.Resources.MergedDictionaries.Contains(FloatPaneStyles))
					{
						base.AssociatedObject.Resources.MergedDictionaries.Add(FloatPaneStyles);
					}
				}
			}

			protected override void OnDetaching()
			{
				if (base.AssociatedObject != null)
				{
					base.AssociatedObject.Resources.MergedDictionaries.Remove(FloatPaneStyles);
				}
				((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnDetaching();
			}
		}

		private class LogicalChildrenCollection : List<object>
		{
			public void AddOnce(object item)
			{
				if (!Contains(item))
				{
					Add(item);
				}
			}
		}

		private class FocusLocker
		{
			private readonly Locker _focusLocker = new Locker();

			private readonly List<BaseLayoutItem> lockedItems = new List<BaseLayoutItem>();

			public void Lock()
			{
				_focusLocker.Lock();
			}

			public void QueueFocus(BaseLayoutItem item)
			{
				if (Locker.op_Implicit(_focusLocker))
				{
					AddItem(item);
				}
				else
				{
					FocusItem(item);
				}
			}

			public void Unlock()
			{
				_focusLocker.Unlock();
				if (!Locker.op_Implicit(_focusLocker))
				{
					OnUnlock();
				}
			}

			private void AddItem(BaseLayoutItem item)
			{
				lockedItems.Remove(item);
				lockedItems.Add(item);
			}

			private void FocusItem(BaseLayoutItem item)
			{
				(item as LayoutPanel).Do(delegate(LayoutPanel x)
				{
					x.ProcessFocus();
				});
			}

			private void OnUnlock()
			{
				List<BaseLayoutItem> source = lockedItems.Where((BaseLayoutItem x) => (!x.IsTabPage || x.IsSelectedItem) && x.IsInTree()).ToList();
				lockedItems.Clear();
				BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = source.FirstOrDefault((BaseLayoutItem x) => x.IsKeyboardFocusWithin || x.IsKeyboardFocused);
				if (baseLayoutItem == null)
				{
					baseLayoutItem = source.LastOrDefault();
				}
				FocusItem(baseLayoutItem);
			}
		}

		private class DisplaySettingsListener : IDisposable
		{
			private readonly WeakReference containerRef;

			private bool isDisposed;

			public DisplaySettingsListener(DockLayoutManager container)
			{
				containerRef = new WeakReference(container);
				try
				{
					SystemEvents.DisplaySettingsChanged += SystemEventsOnDisplaySettingsChanged;
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				if (!isDisposed)
				{
					isDisposed = true;
					try
					{
						SystemEvents.DisplaySettingsChanged -= SystemEventsOnDisplaySettingsChanged;
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
				GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
			}

			private void SystemEventsOnDisplaySettingsChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
			{
				if (containerRef.Target is DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager)
				{
					dockLayoutManager.OnSystemEventsDisplaySettingsChanged(sender, e);
				}
				else
				{
					Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool EnableNativeDragging
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if (AllowAeroSnap && (int)GetRealFloatingMode() == 1 && EnvironmentHelper.IsWinSevenOrLater)
				{
					return ShowContentWhenDragging;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsActivationLocked => activationLockCount > 0;

		internal bool IsClosedPanelsVisibilityLocked => Locker.op_Implicit(closedPanelsLocker);

		internal bool IsDragging
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.IsDisposing)
				{
					return ViewAdapter.DragService.DragItem != null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsInDesignTime => DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(this);

		internal bool IsTransparencyDisabled

					return !AllowFloatGroupTransparency;

				return true;
			}
		}

		protected override IEnumerator LogicalChildren
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.IsDisposing)
				{
					return Enumerable.Empty<object>().GetEnumerator();
				}
				return new MergedEnumerator(new IEnumerator[3]
				{
					new CustomizationEnumerator(this),
					logicalChildrenCore.ToList().GetEnumerator(),
					internalElements.GetEnumerator()
				});
			}
		}

		private InputBinding CloseMDIItemCommandBinding
		{
			get
			{
				if (closeMDIItemCommandBinding == null)
				{
					closeMDIItemCommandBinding = new InputBinding(DockControllerCommand.CloseActive, new KeyGesture(Key.F4, ModifierKeys.Control));
					BindingHelper.SetBinding(closeMDIItemCommandBinding, InputBinding.CommandParameterProperty, this, ActiveMDIItemProperty);
					BindingHelper.SetBinding(closeMDIItemCommandBinding, InputBinding.CommandTargetProperty, this, DockLayoutManagerProperty);
				}
				return closeMDIItemCommandBinding;
			}
		}

		private DockLayoutManager MergedParent { get; set; }

		private DockLayoutManagerMergingHelper MergingHelper => mergingHelper;

		private LayoutPanel MergingTarget
		{
			get
			{
				return mergingTarget;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!object.Equals(mergingTarget, value))
				{
					if (mergingTarget != null)
					{
						mergingTarget.IsMergingTarget = false;
					}
					mergingTarget = value;
					if (mergingTarget != null)
					{
						mergingTarget.IsMergingTarget = true;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private Point SavedRestoreOffset
		{
			get
			{
				if (!effectiveRestoreOffset.HasValue)
				{
					return default(Point);
				}
				return effectiveRestoreOffset.Value;
			}
		}

		private Window TopLevelWindow
		{
			get
			{
				return topLevelWindow;
			}
			set
			{
				if (topLevelWindow != value)
				{
					topLevelWindow = value;
					if (topLevelWindow != null)
					{
						OnTopLevelWindowChanged();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool CanShowFloatGroup
		{
			get
			{
				return _canShowFloatGroup;
			}
			set
			{
				_canShowFloatGroup = value;
				if (value)
				{
					FloatGroups.ForEach(delegate(FloatGroup x)
					{
						x.EnsureActualVisibility();
					});
				}
			}
		}

		internal static DockLayoutManager Ensure(DependencyObject dObj, bool forceFind = false)
		{
			DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = (dObj as DockLayoutManager) ?? GetDockLayoutManager(dObj);
			if (dockLayoutManager == null || forceFind)
			{
				dockLayoutManager = FindManager(dObj);
			}
			return EnsureManager(dObj, dockLayoutManager);
		}

		internal static DockLayoutManager FindManager(DependencyObject dObj)
		{
			DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = dObj as DockLayoutManager;
			if (dockLayoutManager == null)
			{
				IUIElement iUIElement = (dObj as IUIElement) ?? dObj.GetParentIUIElement();
				if (iUIElement != null)
				{
					dockLayoutManager = iUIElement.GetManager() as DockLayoutManager;
				}
			}
			return dockLayoutManager;
		}

		private static DockLayoutManager EnsureManager(DependencyObject dObj, DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			dObj.SetValue(DockLayoutManagerProperty, manager);
			return manager;
		}

		internal static void Release(DependencyObject dObj)
		{
			if (dObj != null)
			{
				dObj.ClearValue(DockLayoutManagerProperty);
				dObj.ClearValue(LayoutItemProperty);
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public static DockLayoutManager GetDockLayoutManager(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (DockLayoutManager)obj.GetValue(DockLayoutManagerProperty);
		}

		public static void SetDockLayoutManager(DependencyObject obj, DockLayoutManager value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(DockLayoutManagerProperty, value);
		}

		private static BaseLayoutItem FindLayoutItem(DependencyObject dObj)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = GetLayoutItem(dObj);
			if (baseLayoutItem == null && dObj is psvContentControl psvContentControl)
			{
				baseLayoutItem = psvContentControl.Content as BaseLayoutItem;
			}
			return baseLayoutItem;
		}

		private static void OnLayoutRootChanged(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(dObj is DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager))
			{
				return;
			}
			dockLayoutManager.InvalidateMeasure();
			dockLayoutManager.InvalidateArrange();
			LayoutGroup layoutGroup = e.NewValue as LayoutGroup;
			if (layoutGroup != null && layoutGroup.ItemType != LayoutItemType.Group)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(DockLayoutManagerHelper.GetRule(DockLayoutManagerRule.WrongLayoutRoot));
			}
			if (layoutGroup != null)
			{
				layoutGroup.DockLayoutManagerCore = dockLayoutManager;
				layoutGroup.IsRootGroup = true;
				if (!dockLayoutManager.OptimizedLogicalTree)
				{
					dockLayoutManager.AddLogicalChild(layoutGroup);
				}
				layoutGroup.Manager = dockLayoutManager;
				layoutGroup.SelectTemplate();
			}
			if (e.OldValue is LayoutGroup layoutGroup2)
			{
				layoutGroup2.DockLayoutManagerCore = null;
				layoutGroup2.IsRootGroup = false;
				if (!dockLayoutManager.OptimizedLogicalTree)
				{
					dockLayoutManager.RemoveLogicalChild(layoutGroup2);
				}
				layoutGroup2.ClearTemplate();
			}
		}

		private static void OnDockLayoutManagerChanged(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (dObj is IDockLayoutManagerListener)
			{
				NotifyListener((IDockLayoutManagerListener)dObj, e);
			}
			if (e.NewValue == null)
			{
				ClearItemsControlPanel(dObj as UIElement);
			}
			if (!(dObj is IUIElement element))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (e.OldValue != null)
			{
				DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = (DockLayoutManager)e.OldValue;
				dockLayoutManager.ResetView(element);
				dockLayoutManager.UnRegisterView(element);
				if (!(dObj is BaseLayoutItem))
				{
					dObj.ClearValue(UIScopeProperty);
					FindLayoutItem(dObj)?.UIElements.Remove(element);
				}
			}
			if (e.NewValue != null)
			{
				DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = (DockLayoutManager)e.NewValue;
				IUIElement iUIElement = ((dObj is BaseLayoutItem) ? null : dObj.FindUIScope());
				if (iUIElement is DockLayoutManager)
				{
					dockLayoutManager.RegisterView(element);
				}
				if (!(dObj is BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem))
				{
					dObj.SetValue(UIScopeProperty, iUIElement);
					dockLayoutManager.ResetView(element);
				}
				else if (dockLayoutManager.IsInitialized && baseLayoutItem.Manager != dockLayoutManager && dockLayoutManager.GetItems().Contains(baseLayoutItem))
				{
					baseLayoutItem.Manager = dockLayoutManager;
				}
			}
		}

		private static object CoerceLayoutItem(DependencyObject dObj, object value)
		{
			if (dObj is DockLayoutManager)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static void OnLayoutItemChanged(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem oldValue = e.OldValue as BaseLayoutItem;
			BaseLayoutItem newValue = e.NewValue as BaseLayoutItem;
			OnLayoutItemChanged(dObj, oldValue, newValue);
		}

		private static void OnLayoutItemChanged(DependencyObject dObj, BaseLayoutItem oldValue, BaseLayoutItem newValue)
		{
			if (!(dObj is IUIElement element) || dObj is Splitter)
			{
				return;
			}
			DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = FindManager(dObj);
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = oldValue;
				baseLayoutItem.UIElements.Remove(element);
				if (baseLayoutItem.Manager != dockLayoutManager)
				{
					DockLayoutManager manager = baseLayoutItem.Manager;
					if ((manager == null || !manager.IsLogicalTreeChangingLocked(baseLayoutItem)) && ((IUIElement)baseLayoutItem).Scope == null)
					{
						baseLayoutItem.Manager = null;
					}
				}
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = newValue;
				BaseLayoutItem[] items = dockLayoutManager.GetItems();
				if (Array.IndexOf(items, baseLayoutItem) != -1)
				{
					baseLayoutItem.UIElements.Add(element);
					baseLayoutItem.Manager = dockLayoutManager;
				}
			}
			dockLayoutManager?.ResetView(element);
		}

		private static void OnUIScopeChanged(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (dObj is IUIElement element)
			{
				if (e.OldValue != null)
				{
					((IUIElement)e.OldValue).Children.Remove(element);
				}
				if (e.NewValue != null)
				{
					((IUIElement)e.NewValue).Children.Add(element);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void NotifyListener(IDockLayoutManagerListener listener, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OldValue != null)
			{
				listener.Unsubscribe((DockLayoutManager)e.OldValue);
			}
			if (e.NewValue != null)
			{
				listener.Subscribe((DockLayoutManager)e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		private static void ClearItemsControlPanel(UIElement uiElement)
		{
			if (uiElement is BaseHeadersPanel baseHeadersPanel)
			{
				UIElement[] array = new UIElement[baseHeadersPanel.Children.Count];
				baseHeadersPanel.Children.CopyTo(array, 0);
				baseHeadersPanel.IsItemsHost = false;
				baseHeadersPanel.Children.Clear();
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					array[i].ClearValue(DockLayoutManagerProperty);
				}
			}
			if (uiElement is DockBarContainerControl dockBarContainerControl)
			{
				BarManagerPropertyHelper.ClearBarManager((DependencyObject)(object)dockBarContainerControl);
				BarContainerControlPropertyAccessor.GetBars((BarContainerControl)(object)dockBarContainerControl).Clear();
			}
		}

		private static void OnAllowMergingAutoHidePanelsChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			DockLayoutManager input = d as DockLayoutManager;
			input.Do(delegate(DockLayoutManager x)
			{
				x.OnAllowMergingAutoHidePanelsChanged((bool)e.OldValue, (bool)e.NewValue);
			});
		}

		private static DocumentPanel GetDocument(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			DocumentPanel documentPanel = item as DocumentPanel;
			if (item is DocumentGroup documentGroup)
			{
				documentPanel = documentGroup.SelectedItem as DocumentPanel;
			}
			if (item is FloatGroup { HasItems: not false } floatGroup)
			{
				documentPanel = floatGroup[0] as DocumentPanel;
			}
			if (documentPanel == null || !documentPanel.IsMDIChild)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return documentPanel;
		}

		public bool BringToFront(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (!(item.GetRoot() is FloatGroup { IsOpen: not false } floatGroup))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (floatGroup.UIElements.Count == 0)
			{
				UpdateLayout();
			}
			IView view = this.GetView(floatGroup.UIElements.GetElement<FloatPanePresenter>());
			if (view != null)
			{
				ViewAdapter.UIInteractionService.Activate(view);
			}
			return view != null;
		}

		public bool Collapse(bool immediately)
		{
			bool result = false;
			foreach (IView item in (IEnumerable<IView>)ViewAdapter.Views)
			{
				if (item.Type == HostType.AutoHide)
				{
					ViewAdapter.ActionService.Hide(item, immediately);
					result = true;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

			SetAutoHideTrayAffinity(Dock.Right, ref PartRightAutoHideTray, ref PartRightAutoHidePane);

			SetClosedItemsPanelAffinity();

		}

		public bool SelectItem(BaseLayoutItem item, DevExpress.Xpf.Layout.Core.SelectionMode mode)
		{
			if (base.IsDisposing || !IsCustomization || item == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			LayoutGroup root = item.GetRoot();
			IView view = this.GetView(root);
			bool result = false;
			if (view != null)
			{
				ILayoutElement element = view.GetElement(item);
				ViewAdapter.SelectionService.Select(view, element, mode);
				ActiveLayoutItem = item;
				CustomizationController.CustomizationRoot = root;
				result = true;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal bool CheckAutoHideExpandState(LayoutPanel panel)
		{
			if (panel == null || !panel.IsAutoHidden || base.IsDisposing)
			{
				return false;
			}
			AutoHideTray tray = panel.Parent.GetRootUIScope() as AutoHideTray;
			if (tray == null || !tray.HasItems)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (panel.AutoHideExpandState)
			{
			case AutoHideExpandState.Visible:
				tray.DoRestore(panel);
				break;
			case AutoHideExpandState.Hidden:
				if (tray.HotItem == panel)
				{
					tray.DoCollapseIfPossible(force: true);
				}
				break;
			case AutoHideExpandState.Expanded:
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					tray.DoMaximize(panel);
				}, DispatcherPriority.Render);
				break;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void CheckClosedState(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			CheckLayoutItemState(item, LayoutItemState.Close);
		}

		internal void CheckFloatGroupRestoreBounds(FloatGroup floatGroup, Point savedOffset)
		{
			Point offset = CalcRestoreOffset(savedOffset);
			floatGroup.EnsureFloatLocation(CheckFloatGroupRestoreBounds(floatGroup.FloatBounds, offset));
		}

		internal void CheckMergingTarget(LayoutPanel documentPanel)
		{
			bool canMerge = documentPanel.CanMerge;
			if (object.Equals(MergingTarget, documentPanel))
			{
				if (!canMerge)
				{
					MergingTarget = null;
				}
				return;
			}
			if (canMerge && (MergingTarget == null || documentPanel.IsActive))
			{
				MergingTarget = documentPanel;
			}
			if (MergingTarget == null && (ActiveDockItem ?? ActiveMDIItem) is DocumentPanel { CanMerge: not false } documentPanel2)
			{
				MergingTarget = documentPanel2;
			}
		}

		}

		internal void CollapseOtherViews(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (!(item is LayoutPanel { IsAutoHidden: not false } layoutPanel) || base.IsDisposing || !(layoutPanel.Parent.GetRootUIScope() is AutoHideTray autoHideTray))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (AutoHideTray item2 in autoHideTrayCollection)
			{
				if (autoHideTray != item2)
				{
					item2.DoCollapse();
				}
			}
		}

		{
			activationLockCount++;
			if (DockController is ILockOwner)
			{
				((ILockOwner)DockController).Lock();
			}
			if (MDIController is ILockOwner)
			{
				((ILockOwner)MDIController).Lock();
			}
		}

		}

		internal void LockLogicalTreeChanging(LogicalTreeLocker logicalLocker)
		{
			LockItemToLinkBinderService();

				logicalTreeLocks.Add(logicalLocker);
			}
		}

		internal void OnGroupNameChanged(LayoutGroup layoutGroup)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(layoutGroup.Name) || !pendingItems.TryGetValue(layoutGroup.Name, out var value))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (object item in ((IEnumerable<object>)value).ToList())
			{
				PrepareItemCore(item);
			}
		}

		internal void OnLayoutRestored()
		{
			EnsureLogicalTree();
			UpdateClosedPanelsBar();
			Update();
			foreach (IView item in (IEnumerable<IView>)ViewAdapter.Views)
			{
				item.Invalidate();
			}
			CustomizationController.ClearSelection();
			Action action = RequestCheckFloatGroupRestoreBounds;
			Window window = WindowServiceHelper.GetWindow(this);
			if (ScreenHelper.IsAttachedToPresentationSource((FrameworkElement)this) && base.IsLoaded)
			{
				RestoreFloatingWindows();
			}
			else
			{
				loadedActionsHelper.AddDelayedAction(RestoreFloatingWindows);
			}
			if (window is DXWindow)
			{
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(action);
			}
			else
			{
				action();
			}
			InvokeHelper.BeginInvoke(this, new Action(RestoreFloatGroupOrder), DispatcherPriority.Loaded);
		}

		internal void OnMerge(DockLayoutManager child)
		{
			if (!base.IsDisposing)
			{
				DockLayoutManagerLinker.Link(this, child);
				child.MergedParent = this;
				if (AllowMergingAutoHidePanels && child.AllowMergingAutoHidePanels && child.IsVisible)
				{
					AutoHideGroups.Merge(child, child.AutoHideGroups);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnThemeChanged(RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			this.GetItems().ForEach(delegate(BaseLayoutItem x)
			{
				x.OnThemeChanged(e);
			});
			string treeWalkerThemeName = CommonThemeHelper.GetTreeWalkerThemeName((DependencyObject)this);
			if (!(_previousTheme == treeWalkerThemeName))
			{
				_previousTheme = treeWalkerThemeName;
				OnThemeChanged();
			}
		}

		internal void OnThemeChanging(RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			this.GetItems().ForEach(delegate(BaseLayoutItem x)
			{
				x.OnThemeChanging(e);
			});
		}

		internal void OnUnmerge(DockLayoutManager child)
		{
			if (!base.IsDisposing)
			{
				DockLayoutManagerLinker.Unlink(this, child);
				AutoHideGroups.Unmerge(child, child.AutoHideGroups);
			}
		}

		internal void PurgeLogicalChildren()
		{
			object[] array = (from x in logicalChildrenCore.Except(this.GetItems())
				where x is BaseLayoutItem
				select x).ToArray();
			object[] array2 = array;
			foreach (object obj in array2)
			{
				if (!IsLogicalTreeChangingLocked(obj as DependencyObject))
				{
					RemoveLogicalChild(obj);
				}
			}
		}

		}

		internal void RaiseDockItemActivatedEvent(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem oldItem)
		{
			if (DockLayoutManagerParameters.SquashDockItemActivatedEvents)
			{
				if (dockItemActivatedOperation == null)
				{
					previousActiveItem = oldItem;
				}
				else
				{
					oldItem = previousActiveItem ?? oldItem;
				}
				dockItemActivatedOperation.Do(delegate(DispatcherOperation x)
				{
					x.Abort();
				});
			}
			DockItemActivatedEventArgs e = new DockItemActivatedEventArgs(item, oldItem);
			dockItemActivatedOperation = InvokeHelper.BeginInvoke(this, (Action<DockItemActivatedEventArgs>)delegate(DockItemActivatedEventArgs x)
			{
				if (x.Item != x.OldItem)
				{
					RaiseEvent(x);
				}
				dockItemActivatedOperation = null;
				previousActiveItem = null;
			}, DispatcherPriority.Normal, e);
		}

		internal void ResetView(IUIElement element)
		{
			if (!base.IsDisposing)
			{
				IUIElement rootUIScope = element.GetRootUIScope();
				((ViewAdapter != null) ? ViewAdapter.GetView(rootUIScope) : null)?.Invalidate();
			}
		}

		internal bool TryRegisterView(IUIElement element)
		{
			if (!base.IsDisposing)
			{
				IView view = ViewAdapter.GetView(element);
				if (view == null)
				{
					RegisterView(element);
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal LayoutGroup ActivateCore(BaseLayoutItem itemToActivate)
		{
			return ActivateCore(itemToActivate, focus: true);
		}

		protected internal LayoutGroup ActivateCore(BaseLayoutItem itemToActivate, bool focus)
		{
			if (itemToActivate == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LockItemActivationOnFocus();
			LayoutGroup root = itemToActivate.GetRoot();
			if ((LayoutItemsHelper.IsLayoutItem(itemToActivate) || itemToActivate.ItemType == LayoutItemType.Group) && root != null && root.IsLayoutRoot)
			{
				if (root.ParentPanel != null)
				{
					DocumentPanel document = GetDocument(root.ParentPanel);
					if ((document == null || TryActivate(MDIController, document, focus: false)) && !TryActivate(DockController, root.ParentPanel, focus: false))
					{
						return root;
					}
				}
				LayoutController.Activate(itemToActivate, focus);
			}
			else if (!(itemToActivate is AutoHideGroup))
			{
				DocumentPanel document2 = GetDocument(itemToActivate);
				if (document2 == null || TryActivate(MDIController, document2, focus: false))
				{
					DockController.Activate(itemToActivate, focus);
				}
			}
			return root;
		}

		{
			FloatGroup[] array = FloatGroups.ToArray();
			FloatGroup[] array2 = array;
			foreach (FloatGroup floatGroup in array2)

				floatGroup.UIElements.GetElement<FloatPanePresenter>()?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		}

		{

				item.Manager = this;
			});

		protected internal FloatingMode GetRealFloatingMode()
		{
			if (!WindowHelper.IsXBAP && !IsInDesignTime)
			{
				return (FloatingMode)FloatingMode;
			}
			return (FloatingMode)0;
		}

		protected internal virtual void HideCustomization()
		{
			if (IsCustomization)
			{
				ViewAdapter.ProcessAction(ViewAction.HideSelection);
				ShouldRestoreCustomizationForm = CustomizationController.CustomizationForm != null && ((UIElement)(object)CustomizationController.CustomizationForm).Visibility == Visibility.Visible;
				CustomizationController.HideCustomizationForm();
				RenameHelper.CancelRenaming();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void HideFloatingWindows()
		{
			CanShowFloatGroup = false;
			CustomizationController.CloseMenu();
			foreach (FloatGroup floatGroup in FloatGroups)
			{
				if (floatGroup.IsOpen)
				{
					floatGroup.ShouldRestoreOnActivate = true;
					floatGroup.IsOpen = false;
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnThemeChanged()
		{
			PrepareLayoutForModification();
			if (IsDesktopFloatingMode && (CanGetRestoreOffset() || effectiveRestoreOffset.HasValue))
			{
				themeChangedLocker.Lock();
				Point restoreOffset = GetRestoreOffset();
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action<IEnumerable<FloatGroup>, Point>(OnThemeChangedAsync), DispatcherPriority.Normal, FloatGroups.ToArray(), restoreOffset);
			}
		}

		protected internal void PrepareLayoutForModification()
		{
			if (SerializationController.IsDeserializing)
			{
				EnsureLayoutRoot();
			}
			PrepareViews();
			PrepareItems();
		}

		protected internal virtual void RequestCheckFloatGroupRestoreBounds()
		{
			if (!base.IsDisposing)
			{
				FloatGroups.Accept(delegate(FloatGroup x)
				{
					x.FloatStateLockHelper.Lock();
				});
				Window window = WindowServiceHelper.GetWindow(this);
				AddDelayedAction(CheckFloatGroupRestoreBounds, DelayedActionPriority.Default);
			}
		}

		protected internal void ResetMDIChildrenTitle()
		{
			lockOwnerWindowTitleChanged++;
			if (OwnerWindow != null && Locker.op_Implicit(windowTitleLocker) && OwnerWindow.GetBindingExpression(Window.TitleProperty) == null)
			{
				OwnerWindow.Title = OwnerWindowTitle;
			}
			windowTitleLocker.Unlock();
			lockOwnerWindowTitleChanged--;
		}

		protected internal virtual void RestoreCustomization()
		{
			if (IsCustomization)
			{
				ViewAdapter.ProcessAction(ViewAction.ShowSelection);
				if (ShouldRestoreCustomizationForm)
				{
					CustomizationController.ShowCustomizationForm();
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void RestoreFloatingWindows()
		{
			if (!base.IsVisible)
			{
				return;
			}
			CanShowFloatGroup = true;
			if (!ShouldRestoreOnActivate && !ShouldRestoreOnIsVisibleChanged)
			{
				return;
			}
			FloatGroup[] floatGroups = GetFloatGroups(getSorted: true);
			foreach (FloatGroup floatGroup in floatGroups)
			{
				if (floatGroup.ShouldRestoreOnActivate)
				{
					floatGroup.ShouldRestoreOnActivate = false;
					if (!floatGroup.IsOpen)
					{
						floatGroup.IsOpen = true;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal void SetMDIChildrenTitle(string title)
		{
			lockOwnerWindowTitleChanged++;
			if (OwnerWindow != null && OwnerWindow.GetBindingExpression(Window.TitleProperty) == null)
			{
				windowTitleLocker.LockOnce();
				OwnerWindow.Title = string.Format(WindowTitleFormat, OwnerWindowTitle, title);
			}
			lockOwnerWindowTitleChanged--;
		}

		protected internal void Update()
		{
			Update(shouldUpdateLayout: true);
		}

		protected internal void Update(bool shouldUpdateLayout)
		{
			if (base.IsDisposing)
			{
				return;
			}
			updatesCount++;
			HitTestHelper.ResetCache();
			if (!base.IsInitialized || SerializationController.IsDeserializing)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (IsUpdateLocked)
			{
				if (!this.shouldUpdateLayout)
				{
					this.shouldUpdateLayout = shouldUpdateLayout;
				}
				return;
			}
			lockUpdateCounter++;
			try
			{
				BeginUpdate();
				UpdateMergingTarget();
				if (shouldUpdateLayout && base.IsLoaded)
				{
					UpdateLayout();
				}
				this.InvalidateView(LayoutRoot);
				if (LayoutLayer != null && LayoutLayer.Parent != null)
				{
					((UIElement)LayoutLayer.Parent).InvalidateMeasure();
				}
				CheckCustomizationRoot(LayoutRoot);
				UpdateSelection();
				UpdateActiveItems();
				DecomposedItems.Purge();
				PurgeLogicalChildren();
			}
			finally
			{
				this.shouldUpdateLayout = false;
				lockUpdateCounter--;
				updatesCount = 0;
				EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		}

		}

				Ref.Dispose(ref refToDispose2);

			}
			autoHideTrayCollection.Clear();
		}

		protected virtual void FloatingWindowsReposition()
		{
			if (IsDesktopFloatingMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (FloatGroup floatGroup in FloatGroups)
			{
				if (floatGroup.IsOpen)
				{
					FloatPanePresenter element = floatGroup.UIElements.GetElement<FloatPanePresenter>();
					if (element != null)
					{
						((BaseFloatingContainer)element).CheckBoundsInContainer();
					}
				}
				floatGroup.UpdateMaximizedBounds();
			}
		}

		protected FloatGroup[] GetFloatGroups(bool getSorted)
		{
			FloatGroup[] array = new FloatGroup[FloatGroups.Count];
			if (array.Length != 0)
			{
				FloatGroups.CopyTo(array, 0);
				if (getSorted)
				{
					Array.Sort(array, this.GetFloatGroupComparison());
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

				return base.GetVisualChild(index);
			}
			return visualChildrenCore[index - base.VisualChildrenCount];
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			HwndHostEventAccumulator.Unregister(this);
			HitTestHelper.ResetCache();
			ThemeChangedEventManager.RemoveListener(this, this);
			ensureAdornerVisibilityOperation?.Abort();
			restoreCustomizationOperation?.Abort();
			base.IsVisibleChanged -= OnIsVisibleChanged;
			UnsubscribeSystemEvents();
			UnSubscribeOwnerWindowEvents();
			if (VisualRoot != null)
			{
				UnsubscribeVisualRootEvents();
			}
			VisualRoot = null;
			Ref.Dispose(ref itemsInternal);
			DisposeFloatContainers();
			DisposeAutoHideTrays();
			DisposeClosedPanel();
			DisposeLayoutLayer();
			DisposeFloatingLayer();
			Ref.Dispose(ref serializationControllerCore);
			Ref.Dispose(ref customizationControllerCore);
			Ref.Dispose(ref dockControllerCore);
			Ref.Dispose(ref layoutControllerCore);
			Ref.Dispose(ref mdiControllerCore);
			Ref.Dispose(ref closedPanelsCore);
			Ref.Dispose(ref mergingHelper);
			Ref.Dispose(ref floatGroupsCore);
			autoHideGroupsCore.CollectionChanged -= OnAutoHideGroupsCollectionChanged;
			Ref.Dispose(ref autoHideGroupsCore);
			Ref.Dispose(ref viewAdapterCore);
			Ref.Dispose(ref renameHelperCore);
			Ref.Dispose(ref loadedActionsHelper);
			Ref.Dispose(ref initilizedActionsHelper);
			Ref.Dispose(ref adornerWindowProvider);
			DisposeVisualTreeHost();
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized()
		{
			base.OnInitialized();
			mergingHelper = new DockLayoutManagerMergingHelper(this);
			AddLogicalChild(mergingHelper);
			BarNameScope.EnsureRegistrator((DependencyObject)this);
			EnsureLogicalTree();
			initilizedActionsHelper.DoDelayedActions();
			AddValuesProvider();
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsCustomizationChanged(bool newValue)
		{
			RenameHelper.CancelRenamingAndResetClickedState();
			ViewAdapter.ProcessAction(newValue ? ViewAction.ShowSelection : ViewAction.HideSelection);
			BaseLayoutItem[] items = this.GetItems();
			BaseLayoutItem[] array = items;
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem in array)
			{
				baseLayoutItem.OnIsCustomizationChanged(newValue);
			}
			Update();
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsEnabledChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			FloatGroups.ForEach(delegate(FloatGroup x)
			{
				x.CoerceValue(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty);
			});
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsVisibleChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = (bool)e.NewValue;
			ShouldRestoreOnIsVisibleChanged = flag;
			restoreCustomizationOperation?.Abort();
			ensureAdornerVisibilityOperation?.Abort();
			if (flag)
			{
				loadedActionsHelper.AddDelayedAction(RestoreFloatingWindows);
				ensureAdornerVisibilityOperation = base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					VisualizerAdornerHelper.EnsureAdornerActivated((BaseSurfacedAdorner)(object)DragAdorner);
				});
				restoreCustomizationOperation = InvokeHelper.BeginInvoke(this, new Action(RestoreCustomization), DispatcherPriority.Render);
				if (ScreenHelper.IsAttachedToPresentationSource((FrameworkElement)this) && base.IsLoaded)
				{
					loadedActionsHelper.DoDelayedActions();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				CustomizationController.HideDocumentSelectorForm();
				HideFloatingWindows();
				HideCustomization();
				ResetAdorners();
			}
			MergingHelper.Do(delegate(DockLayoutManagerMergingHelper x)
			{
				x.Changed();
			});
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key == Key.Tab && (Keyboard.Modifiers & ModifierKeys.Control) != ModifierKeys.None && !AllowDocumentSelector)
			{
				e.Handled = Navigate(!KeyHelper.IsShiftPressed);
			}
			base.OnKeyDown(e);
		}

		protected override void OnLoaded()
		{
			base.OnLoaded();
			EnsureLayoutRoot();
			if (!WindowHelper.IsXBAP)
			{
				EnsureSystemEventsSubscriptions();
				EnsureOwnerWindowSubscriptions();
				EnsureIsCustomizationInDesignTime();
				SaveRestoreOffset();
			}
			CheckFloatGroupsFloatState();
			if (ScreenHelper.IsAttachedToPresentationSource((FrameworkElement)this))
			{
				loadedActionsHelper.DoDelayedActions();
			}
			if (HandleHwndHostMouseEvents)
			{
				HwndHostEventAccumulator.Register(this);
			}
		}

				.ForEach(delegate(LayoutGroup x)
				{

				});
		}

		protected virtual void OwnerWindowClosed(object sender)

				Window window = WindowServiceHelper.GetWindow(this);
				if (window == sender)
				{

				}
			}
			FloatingLayer.Do(delegate(LayoutItemsControl x)
			{
				x.PrepareForWindowClosing();
			});
		}

		protected virtual void OwnerWindowPreviewKeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Handled)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (e.Key == Key.Tab && (Keyboard.Modifiers & ModifierKeys.Control) != ModifierKeys.None)
			{
				DependencyObject eventProcessor = LayoutHelper.FindLayoutOrVisualParentObject(e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject, (Predicate<DependencyObject>)((DependencyObject fe) => fe is DockLayoutManager && ((DockLayoutManager)fe).AllowDocumentSelector), false, (DependencyObject)null);
				if (CanProcessKey(eventProcessor) && CanShowDocumentSelector())
				{
					CustomizationController.ShowDocumentSelectorForm();
					e.Handled = CustomizationController.IsDocumentSelectorVisible;
				}
			}
			if (!(LayoutHelper.FindLayoutOrVisualParentObject(e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject, (Predicate<DependencyObject>)((DependencyObject fe) => fe is DockLayoutManager), true, (DependencyObject)null) is DockLayoutManager eventProcessor2) || !CanProcessKey(eventProcessor2))
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (e.Key)
			{
			case Key.Return:
				RenameHelper.EndRenaming();
				break;
			case Key.Escape:
				if (!RenameHelper.CancelRenamingAndResetClickedState())
				{
					ExtendSelectionToParent();
				}
				break;
			case Key.Delete:
				if (!IsRenaming)
				{
					LayoutController.HideSelectedItems();
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OwnerWindowPreviewKeyUp(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (KeyboardHelper.IsControlPressed && CustomizationController.IsDocumentSelectorVisible)
			{
				CustomizationController.HideDocumentSelectorForm();
			}
		}

		protected void ResetAdorners()
		{
			InvokeHelper.BeginInvoke(this, (Action)delegate
			{
				if (!base.IsVisible && !base.IsDisposing)
				{
					IView[] array = ViewAdapter.Views.ToArray();
					for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
					{
						LayoutView layoutView = (LayoutView)array[i];
						if (layoutView != null && layoutView.IsAdornerHelperInitialized)
						{
							layoutView.AdornerHelper.Reset();
						}
					}
					if (((BaseSurfacedAdorner)DragAdorner).IsActivated)
					{
						((BaseSurfacedAdorner)DragAdorner).Deactivate();
					}
				}
			});
		}

		protected virtual void SubscribeOwnerWindowEvents()
		{
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, OwnerWindowTitleProperty, OwnerWindow, "Title");
			OwnerWindowClosedEventManager.AddListener(OwnerWindow, this);
			OwnerWindowBoundsChangedEventManager.AddListener(OwnerWindow, this);
			if (TopLevelWindow != null && TopLevelWindow != OwnerWindow)
			{
				OwnerWindowBoundsChangedEventManager.AddListener(TopLevelWindow, this);
			}
		}

		protected void SubscribeVisualRootEvents()
		{
			VisualRootPreviewKeyDownEventManager.AddListener(VisualRoot, this);
			VisualRootPreviewKeyUpEventManager.AddListener(VisualRoot, this);
		}

		protected void UnlockUpdate()
		{
			if (--lockUpdateCounter == 0 && updatesCount > 0)
			{
				Update(shouldUpdateLayout);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UnRegisterInputBindings()
		{
			base.InputBindings.Remove(CloseMDIItemCommandBinding);
		}

		protected virtual void UnSubscribeOwnerWindowEvents(bool keepWindowClosedListener = false)
		{
			Window window = OwnerWindow ?? (ownerWindowRef?.Target as Window);
			if (window != null)
			{
				ResetMDIChildrenTitle();
				BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, OwnerWindowTitleProperty);
				if (!keepWindowClosedListener)
				{
					OwnerWindowClosedEventManager.RemoveListener(window, this);
				}
				OwnerWindowBoundsChangedEventManager.RemoveListener(window, this);
				OwnerWindow = null;
				if (TopLevelWindow != null)
				{
					OwnerWindowBoundsChangedEventManager.RemoveListener(TopLevelWindow, this);
					TopLevelWindow = null;
				}
			}
		}

		protected void UnsubscribeVisualRootEvents()
		{
			VisualRootPreviewKeyDownEventManager.RemoveListener(VisualRoot, this);
			VisualRootPreviewKeyUpEventManager.RemoveListener(VisualRoot, this);
		}

			}

		{

				action();
			}
			else

				loadedActionsHelper.AddDelayedAction(action, priority);
			}
		}

		private Point CalcRestoreOffset()
		{
			return CalcRestoreOffset(RestoreLayoutOptions.GetFloatPanelsRestoreOffset(this));
		}

		private Point CalcRestoreOffset(Point savedOffset)
		{
			Point result = new Point(0.0, 0.0);
			if (IsDesktopFloatingMode && !double.IsNaN(savedOffset.X) && !double.IsNaN(savedOffset.Y))
			{
				Point restoreOffsetCore = GetRestoreOffsetCore();
				result = new Point(savedOffset.X - restoreOffsetCore.X, savedOffset.Y - restoreOffsetCore.Y);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private bool CanGetRestoreOffset()
		{
			if (!base.IsDisposing && ScreenHelper.IsAttachedToPresentationSource((FrameworkElement)this) && (OwnerWindow == null || OwnerWindow.WindowState != WindowState.Minimized))
			{
				return base.IsMeasureValid;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool CanProcessKey(DependencyObject eventProcessor)
		{
			if (ViewAdapter.DragService.OperationType == OperationType.Regular && base.IsVisible)
			{
				if (eventProcessor != this)
				{
					if (eventProcessor == null)
					{
						return FrameworkElementExtensions.IsInVisualTree((FrameworkElement)this);
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool CanShowDocumentSelector()
		{
			if (AllowDocumentSelector)
			{
				return !CustomizationController.IsDocumentSelectorVisible;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void CheckCustomizationRoot(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			LayoutGroup customizationRoot = CustomizationController.CustomizationRoot;
			if (item.GetRoot() != customizationRoot)
			{
				CustomizationController.CustomizationRoot = ((customizationRoot == null || customizationRoot.IsInTree()) ? customizationRoot : LayoutRoot);
			}
		}

		private void CheckFloatGroupRestoreBounds()
		{
			Point offset = CalcRestoreOffset();
			foreach (FloatGroup floatGroup in FloatGroups)
			{
				floatGroup?.FloatingWindowLock?.Lock(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.CheckFloatBounds);
				try
				{
					Point point = CheckFloatGroupRestoreBounds(floatGroup.FloatBounds, offset);
					if (floatGroup.FloatLocation == point)
					{
						floatGroup.FloatLocation = new Point(floatGroup.FloatLocation.X + 1.0, floatGroup.FloatLocation.Y);
					}
					floatGroup.FloatLocation = point;
				}
				finally
				{
					floatGroup?.FloatingWindowLock?.Unlock(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.CheckFloatBounds);
				}
				if (floatGroup.FloatState != FloatState.Normal)
				{
					Rect restoreBounds = DocumentPanel.GetRestoreBounds(floatGroup);
					Point location = CheckFloatGroupRestoreBounds(restoreBounds, offset);
					DocumentPanel.SetRestoreBounds(floatGroup, new Rect(location, RectHelper.Size(restoreBounds)));
				}
				floatGroup.FloatStateLockHelper.Unlock();
			}
		}

		private Point CheckFloatGroupRestoreBounds(Rect restorebounds, Point offset)
		{
			Point result = RectHelper.Location(restorebounds);
			if (!WindowHelper.IsXBAP)
			{
				Rect rect = restorebounds;
				int num = ((base.FlowDirection != FlowDirection.RightToLeft) ? 1 : (-1));
				rect = new Rect(rect.X + (double)num * offset.X, rect.Y + offset.Y, rect.Width, rect.Height);
				rect = WindowHelper.CheckScreenBounds(this, rect);
				result = new Point(rect.Left, rect.Top);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void CheckFloatGroupsFloatState()
		{
			FloatGroups.ForEach(delegate(FloatGroup x)
			{
				x.CheckFloatState();
			});
		}

		private IView CreateView(IUIElement element)
		{
			if (element is AutoHideTray)
			{
				return CreateAutoHideView(element);
			}
			if (element is FloatPanePresenter)
			{
				return CreateFloatingView(element);
			}
			if (element is LayoutGroup && ((LayoutGroup)element).ItemType == LayoutItemType.Group)
			{
				return CreateLayoutView(element);
			}
			if (element is CustomizationControl)
			{
				return CreateCustomizationView(element);
			}
			return null;
		}

			}
		}

		private void EnsureCustomization()
		{
			if (CommonThemeHelper.UseLightweightThemes)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = null;
			if (walker != null)
			{
				object target = walker.Target;
				ThemeTreeWalker val = (ThemeTreeWalker)((target is ThemeTreeWalker) ? target : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					text = val.ThemeName;
				}
			}
			ThemeTreeWalker treeWalker = ThemeManager.GetTreeWalker((DependencyObject)this);
			if (treeWalker != null && treeWalker.ThemeName != text)
			{
				if (walker != null)
				{
					EndCustomization();
				}
				walker = new WeakReference(treeWalker);
			}
			else
			{
				walker = null;
			}
		}

		private void EnsureIsCustomizationInDesignTime()
		{
			if (IsInDesignTime)
			{
				InvokeHelper.BeginInvoke(this, new Action(EnsureIsCustomizationInDesignTimeCore), DispatcherPriority.Render);
			}
		}

		private void EnsureIsCustomizationInDesignTimeCore()
		{
			((CustomizationController)CustomizationController).CoerceValue(DevExpress.Xpf.Docking.Customization.CustomizationController.IsCustomizationProperty);
		}

		private void EnsureOwnerWindowSubscriptions()
		{
			UnSubscribeOwnerWindowEvents();
			OwnerWindow = WindowServiceHelper.GetWindow(this);
			if (OwnerWindow != null)
			{
				ownerWindowRef = new WeakReference(OwnerWindow);
			}
			TopLevelWindow = LayoutHelper.FindRoot((DependencyObject)this, false) as Window;
			if (OwnerWindow != null)
			{
				OwnerWindowTitle = OwnerWindow.Title;
				SubscribeOwnerWindowEvents();
			}
			if (VisualRoot != null)
			{
				UnsubscribeVisualRootEvents();
			}
			VisualRoot = OwnerWindow ?? LayoutHelper.GetTopLevelVisual((DependencyObject)this);
			if (VisualRoot != null)
			{
				SubscribeVisualRootEvents();
			}
		}

		private void EnsureSystemEventsSubscriptions()
		{
			UnsubscribeSystemEvents();
			SubscribeSystemEvents();
		}

		private void OnFloatGroupsCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset;
			IList list;
			if (!flag && e.OldItems != null)
			{
				list = e.OldItems;
			}
			else
			{
				IList instance = EmptyArray<FloatGroup>.Instance;
				list = instance;
			}
			IEnumerable enumerable = list;
			IList list2;
			if (!flag && e.NewItems != null)
			{
				list2 = e.NewItems;
			}
			else
			{
				IList instance = FloatGroups;
				list2 = instance;
			}
			IEnumerable enumerable2 = list2;
			foreach (object item in enumerable)
			{
				FloatGroup floatGroup = (FloatGroup)item;
				floatGroup.DockLayoutManagerCore = null;
				if (MinimizedItems.Contains(floatGroup))
				{
					MinimizedItems.Remove(floatGroup);
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				MinimizedItems.Clear();
			}
			foreach (object item2 in enumerable2)
			{
				FloatGroup floatGroup2 = (FloatGroup)item2;
				floatGroup2.DockLayoutManagerCore = this;
				if (floatGroup2.FloatState == FloatState.Minimized && !MinimizedItems.Contains(floatGroup2))
				{
					MinimizedItems.Add(floatGroup2);
				}
			}
		}

		private void FocusLayoutItem(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item is LayoutControlItem { FocusContentOnActivating: not false } layoutControlItem && !IsCustomization)
			{
				KeyboardFocusHelper.FocusElement(layoutControlItem.Control);
			}
		}

		private void FocusPanelItem(LayoutPanel panelItem, bool ignoreFocusState)
		{
			if (panelItem == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!panelItem.IsControlItemsHost)
			{
				if (panelItem.FocusContentOnActivating)
				{
					KeyboardFocusHelper.FocusElement(panelItem.Control ?? panelItem.ContentPresenter, ignoreFocusState || IsFloating);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				FocusLayoutItem(LayoutItemsHelper.GetFirstItemInGroup(panelItem.Layout));
			}
		}

		private void OnThemeChangedAsync(IEnumerable<FloatGroup> affectedItems, Point prevOffset)
		{
			themeChangedLocker.Unlock();
			if (!CanGetRestoreOffset())
			{
				return;
			}
			Point restoreOffset = GetRestoreOffset();
			foreach (FloatGroup affectedItem in affectedItems)
			{
				affectedItem.EnsureFloatLocation(prevOffset, restoreOffset);
			}
			SaveRestoreOffset();
		}

		private void PrepareViews()
		{
			foreach (IView item in (IEnumerable<IView>)ViewAdapter.Views)
			{

		internal void RegisterView(IUIElement element)
		{
			if (!base.IsDisposing)
			{
				IView refToDispose = ViewAdapter.GetView(element);
				if (refToDispose != null)
				{
					ViewAdapter.Views.Remove(refToDispose);
					Ref.Dispose(ref refToDispose);
				}
				IView view = CreateView(element);
				if (view != null)
				{
					ViewAdapter.Views.Add(view);
				}
			}
		}

		private void RestoreFloatGroupOrder()
		{
			if (base.IsDisposing)
			{
				return;
			}
			IOrderedEnumerable<FloatGroup> orderedEnumerable = FloatGroups.OrderBy((FloatGroup x) => x.GetSerializableZOrder());
			foreach (FloatGroup item in orderedEnumerable)
			{
				item.FloatingWindowLock.Do(delegate(FloatingWindowLock x)
				{
					x.Lock(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.Focus);
				});
				BringToFront(item);
				item.FloatingWindowLock.Do(delegate(FloatingWindowLock x)
				{
					x.Unlock(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.Focus);
				});
			}
		}

		private void SaveRestoreOffset()
		{

			{
				effectiveRestoreOffset = GetRestoreOffset();
			}
		}

		private void SetAffinity(AutoHideTray tray, AutoHidePane panel, Dock dock)
		{
			tray.DockType = dock;
			panel.DockType = dock;
			tray.EnsureAutoHidePanel(panel);
		}

		private void SetAutoHideTrayAffinity(Dock dock, ref AutoHideTray partAutoHideTray, ref AutoHidePane partTrayPanel)
		{
			string text = dock.ToString();
			if (partAutoHideTray != null && !LayoutItemsHelper.IsTemplateChild(partAutoHideTray, this))
			{
				partAutoHideTray.Dispose();
			}
			if (partTrayPanel != null && !LayoutItemsHelper.IsTemplateChild(partTrayPanel, this))
			{
				partTrayPanel.Dispose();
			}
			partAutoHideTray = GetTemplateChild("PART_" + text + "AutoHideTray") as AutoHideTray;
			if (partAutoHideTray != null)
			{
				partTrayPanel = GetTemplateChild("PART_" + text + "AutoHideTrayPanel") as AutoHidePane;
				if (partTrayPanel != null)
				{
					SetAffinity(partAutoHideTray, partTrayPanel, dock);
				}
				autoHideTrayCollection.Add(partAutoHideTray);
			}
			AutoHideLayer = GetTemplateChild("AutoHideLayer") as FrameworkElement;
		}

		private void SetClosedItemsPanelAffinity()
		{
			if (ClosedItemsPanel != null && !LayoutItemsHelper.IsTemplateChild((DependencyObject)(object)ClosedItemsPanel, this))
			{
				ClosedItemsPanel.Dispose();
			}
			ClosedItemsPanel = GetTemplateChild("PART_ClosedItemsPanel") as ClosedItemsPanel;
		}

		private void SetFloatingLayerAffinity()
		{
			if (FloatingLayer != null && !LayoutItemsHelper.IsTemplateChild(FloatingLayer, this))
			{
				FloatingLayer.Dispose();
			}
			FloatingLayer = GetTemplateChild("FloatingLayer") as LayoutItemsControl;
		}

			}
		}

		private void UpdateActiveItems()
		{
			BaseLayoutItem[] items = this.GetItems();
			BaseLayoutItem activeDockItem = ActiveDockItem;
			if (activeDockItem != null && !items.Contains(activeDockItem))
			{
				this.Deactivate(activeDockItem);
			}
			BaseLayoutItem activeMDIItem = ActiveMDIItem;
			if (activeMDIItem != null && !items.Contains(activeMDIItem))
			{
				this.Deactivate(activeMDIItem);
			}
			BaseLayoutItem activeLayoutItem = ActiveLayoutItem;
			if (activeLayoutItem != null && !items.Contains(activeLayoutItem))
			{
				this.Deactivate(activeLayoutItem);
			}
		}
