		{
			BaseLayoutItem[] items = this.GetItems();
			BaseLayoutItem[] array = items;
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem in array)
			{
				baseLayoutItem.CoerceValue(UIElement.VisibilityProperty);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateMergingTarget()
		{
			if (MergingTarget != null && !this.GetItems().Contains(MergingTarget))
			{
				MergingTarget = null;
			}
			if (MergingTarget == null)
			{
				LayoutPanel layoutPanel = (LayoutPanel)(from x in this.GetItems()
					where x is LayoutPanel
					select x).FirstOrDefault((BaseLayoutItem x) => ((LayoutPanel)x).CanMerge);
				if (layoutPanel != null)
				{
					MergingTarget = layoutPanel;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSelection()
		{

				ViewAdapter.ProcessAction(ViewAction.ShowSelection);
			}
		}

		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (managerType == typeof(OwnerWindowBoundsChangedEventManager))
			{
				OwnerWindowBoundsChanged();
				return true;
			}
			if (managerType == typeof(OwnerWindowClosedEventManager))
			{
				OwnerWindowClosed(sender);
				return true;
			}
			if (managerType == typeof(VisualRootPreviewKeyDownEventManager))
			{
				OwnerWindowPreviewKeyDown(sender, e as KeyEventArgs);
				return true;
			}
			if (managerType == typeof(VisualRootPreviewKeyUpEventManager))
			{
				OwnerWindowPreviewKeyUp(sender, e as KeyEventArgs);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void RestoreLayoutCore(object path)
		{
			using (new NotificationBatch(this))
			{
				SerializationController.RestoreLayout(path);
				NotificationBatch.Action(this, this);
			}
		}

		protected virtual ILayoutAdapter ResolveLayoutAdapter()
		{
			return MVVMHelper.GetLayoutAdapter(this) ?? LayoutAdapter.Instance;
		}

		private void AddToPending(object item, string targetName)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(targetName))
			{
				if (!pendingItems.TryGetValue(targetName, out var value))
				{
					value = (pendingItems[targetName] = new WeakList<object>());
				}
				if (!value.Contains(item))
				{
					value.Add(item);
				}
			}
		}

		private void RemoveFromPending(object item, string targetName)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(targetName) && pendingItems.TryGetValue(targetName, out var value))
			{
				value.Remove(item);
			}
		}

		private void PrepareItemCore(object obj)
		{
			ILayoutAdapter layoutAdapter = ResolveLayoutAdapter();
			string text = layoutAdapter.Resolve(this, obj);
			(obj as INotifyPropertyChanged).Do(delegate(INotifyPropertyChanged x)
			{
				x.PropertyChanged += OnItemTargetNameChanged;
			});
			if (!this.RaiseBeforeItemAddedEvent(obj, string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) ? null : this.GetItem(text), out var actualTarget))
			{
				if (actualTarget == null)
				{
					AddToPending(obj, text);
					return;
				}
				RemoveFromPending(obj, text);
				GetContainerForItem(obj, actualTarget);
			}
		}

		private void ClearItemCore(object obj)
		{
			ClearContainerForItem(obj);
			(obj as INotifyPropertyChanged).Do(delegate(INotifyPropertyChanged x)
			{
				x.PropertyChanged -= OnItemTargetNameChanged;
			});
		}

		private void OnItemTargetNameChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.PropertyName == "TargetName")
			{
				ClearItemCore(sender);
				PrepareItemCore(sender);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnAddToItemsSource(IEnumerable newItems, int startingIndex = 0)
		{
			using (new UpdateBatch(this))
			{
				if (newItems == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (object newItem in newItems)
				{
					PrepareItemCore(newItem);
				}
				Update();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnRemoveFromItemsSource(IEnumerable oldItems)
		{
			using (new UpdateBatch(this))
			{
				if (oldItems == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (object oldItem in oldItems)
				{
					ClearItemCore(oldItem);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnItemReplacedInItemsSource(IList oldItems, IList newItems, int newStartingIndex)
		{
			containerGenerator.LinkContainerToItem(oldItems[0], newItems[0], newStartingIndex, ItemTemplate, ItemTemplateSelector);
		}

		protected virtual object GetContainerForItem(object item, BaseLayoutItem target)
		{
			return containerGenerator.GetContainerForItem(target as IGeneratorHost, item, ItemTemplate, ItemTemplateSelector);
		}

		protected virtual void ClearContainerForItem(object item)
		{
			containerGenerator.ClearContainerForItem(item);
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnResetItemsSource(IEnumerable newItems)
		{
			ResetItemsSource(newItems);
		}

		protected virtual void ResetItemsSource()
		{
			ResetItemsSource(null);
		}

		protected virtual void ResetItemsSource(IEnumerable newItems)
		{
			using (new UpdateBatch(this))
			{
				Locker val = ((Locker)_layoutLocker).Lock();
				try
				{
					IEnumerable items = containerGenerator.GetItems();
					OnRemoveFromItemsSource(items);
					containerGenerator.Reset();
					OnAddToItemsSource(newItems);
				}
				finally
				{
					((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnCurrentChanged(object sender)
		{
			if (sender is ICollectionView collectionView)
			{
				OnCurrentCollectionItemChanged(collectionView.CurrentItem);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnCurrentCollectionItemChanged(object value)
		{
			if (IsSynchronizedWithCurrentItem && value != null)
			{
				BaseLayoutItem item = containerGenerator.GetContainerForItem(value) as BaseLayoutItem;
				Activate(item);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsSynchronizedWithCurrentItemChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			OnCurrentCollectionItemChanged(itemsInternal.CurrentItem);
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemsSourceChanged(IEnumerable oldValue, IEnumerable newValue, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.IsDisposing)
			{
				return;
			}
			using (new UpdateBatch(this))
			{
				ResetItemsSource();
				if (base.IsInitialized || newValue == null)
				{
					itemsInternal.SetItemsSource(newValue);
					return;
				}
				initilizedActionsHelper.AddDelayedAction(delegate
				{
					itemsInternal.SetItemsSource(ItemsSource);
				});
			}
		}

		private void SynchronizeWithCurrentItem(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item != null && IsSynchronizedWithCurrentItem)
			{
				object itemForContainer = containerGenerator.GetItemForContainer(item);
				if (itemForContainer != null)
				{
					itemsInternal.MoveCurrentTo(itemForContainer);
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsContainerHost(LayoutGroup group)
		{
			if (!containerGenerator.IsContainerHost(group))
			{
				return ((IEnumerable<DockLayoutManager>)Linked).Any((DockLayoutManager x) => x.containerGenerator.IsContainerHost(group));
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected new void AddLogicalChild(object child)
		{
			DependencyObject current = child as DependencyObject;
			if (LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(current) == null)
			{
				if (child is BaseLayoutItem item)
				{
					logicalChildrenCore.AddOnce(item);
				}
				else
				{
					internalElements.AddOnce(child);
				}
				base.AddLogicalChild(child);
			}
		}

		protected new void RemoveLogicalChild(object child)
		{
			DependencyObject current = child as DependencyObject;
			logicalChildrenCore.Remove(child);
			internalElements.Remove(child);
			if (LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(current) == this)
			{
				Action<object> action = delegate(object x)
				{
					base.RemoveLogicalChild(x);
				};
				if (this.GetIsLogicalChildrenIterationInProgress())
				{
					base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(action, child);
				}
				else
				{
					action(child);
				}
			}
		}

		void ILogicalOwner.AddChild(object child)
		{
			AddLogicalChild(child);
		}

		void ILogicalOwner.RemoveChild(object child)
		{
			RemoveLogicalChild(child);
		}

		void ISupportBatchUpdate.BeginUpdate()
		{
			LockUpdate();
		}

		void ISupportBatchUpdate.EndUpdate()
		{
			UnlockUpdate();
		}

		[SpecialName]
		bool ILogicalOwner.get_IsLoaded()
		{
			return base.IsLoaded;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		void ILogicalOwner.add_Loaded(RoutedEventHandler value)
		{
			base.Loaded += value;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		void ILogicalOwner.remove_Loaded(RoutedEventHandler value)
		{
			base.Loaded -= value;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		double ILogicalOwner.get_ActualWidth()
		{
			return base.ActualWidth;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		double ILogicalOwner.get_ActualHeight()
		{
			return base.ActualHeight;
		}
	}
	internal class DockLayoutManagerMergingHelper : FrameworkContentElement, IMergingSupport, IMultipleElementRegistratorSupport, IBarNameScopeSupport, IInputElement, IDisposable
	{
		private static readonly Action<DependencyObject, bool> setForceElementMerging;

		private readonly ObservableCollection<DockLayoutManagerMergingHelper> mergedChildren;

		private readonly DockLayoutManager owner;

		private bool isDisposed;

		private MergingSupportNameStorage msNameStorage;

		private const string MergingID = "0C082948-C6A4-4274-BF91-A3039EF0092F";

		internal DockLayoutManagerMergingHelper MergedParent { get; private set; }

		bool IMergingSupport.IsAutomaticallyMerged
		{
			get
			{
				return true;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		bool IMergingSupport.IsMerged => MergedParent != null;

		private ObservableCollection<DockLayoutManagerMergingHelper> MergedChildren => mergedChildren;

		object IMergingSupport.MergingKey => typeof(DockLayoutManager);

		MergingSupportNameStorage IMergingSupport.NameStorage
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0030: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0032: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_0037: Expected O, but got Unknown
				MergingSupportNameStorage obj = msNameStorage;
				if (obj == null)
				{
					MergingSupportNameStorage val = new MergingSupportNameStorage((DependencyObject)this, (Func<DependencyObject, object>)((DependencyObject x) => "0C082948-C6A4-4274-BF91-A3039EF0092F"));
					MergingSupportNameStorage val2 = val;
					msNameStorage = val;
					obj = val2;
				}
				return obj;
			}
		}

		private DockLayoutManager Owner => owner;

		IEnumerable<object> IMultipleElementRegistratorSupport.RegistratorKeys
		{
			get
			{
				yield return typeof(IMergingSupport);
			}
		}

		internal DockLayoutManagerMergingHelper(DockLayoutManager owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
			mergedChildren = new ObservableCollection<DockLayoutManagerMergingHelper>();
			mergedChildren.CollectionChanged += OnMergedChildrenCollectionChanged;
			BarNameScope.SetIsScopeOwner((DependencyObject)this, false);
			Changed();
		}

		static DockLayoutManagerMergingHelper()
		{
			setForceElementMerging = ReflectionHelper.CreateInstanceMethodHandler<Action<DependencyObject, bool>>((object)null, "SetForceElementMerging", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.NonPublic, typeof(MergingProperties), (int?)null, (Type[])null, true);
		}

		public void Changed()
		{
			bool flag = Owner.AllowMergingAutoHidePanels && Owner.IsVisible;
			MergingProperties.SetElementMergingBehavior((DependencyObject)this, (ElementMergingBehavior)(flag ? 4 : 3));
			setForceElementMerging(this, flag);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (!isDisposed)
			{
				isDisposed = true;
				OnDisposing();
			}
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		protected virtual void OnDisposing()
		{
			((IMergingSupport)(object)MergedParent).Do(delegate(IMergingSupport x)
			{
				x.Unmerge((IMergingSupport)(object)this);
			});
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
			MergingPropertiesHelper.OnPropertyChanged((DependencyObject)this, e, (DependencyProperty)null);
		}

		bool IMergingSupport.CanMerge(IMergingSupport second)
		{
			return true;
		}

		bool IMergingSupport.IsMergedParent(IMergingSupport second)
		{
			return (object)MergedParent == second;
		}

		void IMergingSupport.Merge(IMergingSupport second)
		{
			if (second is DockLayoutManagerMergingHelper item && !MergedChildren.Contains(item))
			{
				MergedChildren.Add(item);
			}
		}

		private void OnMergedChildrenCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OldItems != null)
			{
				foreach (DockLayoutManagerMergingHelper oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					oldItem.MergedParent = null;
					Owner.OnUnmerge(oldItem.Owner);
				}
			}
			if (e.NewItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (DockLayoutManagerMergingHelper newItem in e.NewItems)
			{
				newItem.MergedParent = this;
				Owner.OnMerge(newItem.Owner);
			}
		}

		void IMergingSupport.Unmerge(IMergingSupport second)
		{
			if (second is DockLayoutManagerMergingHelper item)
			{
				MergedChildren.Remove(item);
			}
		}

		object IMultipleElementRegistratorSupport.GetName(object registratorKey)
		{
			if (object.Equals(registratorKey, typeof(IMergingSupport)))
			{
				return ((IMergingSupport)this).NameStorage.CurrentValue;
			}
			throw new ArgumentException("registratorKey");
		}
	}
	public static class DockLayoutManagerLinker
	{
		public static void Link(DockLayoutManager first, DockLayoutManager second)
		{
			if (first != null && second != null && first != second)
			{
				if (!first.Linked.Contains(second))
				{
					first.Linked.Add(second);
				}
				if (!second.Linked.Contains(first))
				{
					second.Linked.Add(first);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void Unlink(DockLayoutManager first, DockLayoutManager second)
		{
			if (first != null && second != null && first != second)
			{
				if (first.Linked.Contains(second))
				{
					first.Linked.Remove(second);
				}
				if (second.Linked.Contains(first))
				{
					second.Linked.Remove(first);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class LayoutGroupGenerator
	{
		private delegate LayoutGroup CreateInstance();

		private readonly Dictionary<Type, CreateInstance> initializers = new Dictionary<Type, CreateInstance>();

		private readonly DockLayoutManager owner;

		public LayoutGroupGenerator(DockLayoutManager owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
			initializers[typeof(LayoutGroup)] = () => owner.CreateLayoutGroup();
			initializers[typeof(TabbedGroup)] = () => owner.CreateTabbedGroup();
			initializers[typeof(DocumentGroup)] = () => owner.CreateDocumentGroup();
			initializers[typeof(AutoHideGroup)] = () => owner.CreateAutoHideGroup();
			initializers[typeof(FloatGroup)] = () => owner.CreateFloatGroup();
		}

		public TGroup GetGroup<TGroup>() where TGroup : LayoutGroup
		{
			LayoutGroup layoutGroup = null;
			if (initializers.TryGetValue(typeof(TGroup), out var value))
			{
				layoutGroup = value();
			}
			if (!(layoutGroup is TGroup result))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("type");
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public class Selection : BaseReadOnlyList<BaseLayoutItem>
	{
		protected internal void ProcessSelectionChanged(BaseLayoutItem item, bool selected)
		{
			if (selected)
			{
				if (!base.List.Contains(item))
				{
					base.List.Add(item);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.List.Remove(item);
			}
		}

		public BaseLayoutItem[] ToArray()
		{
			BaseLayoutItem[] array = new BaseLayoutItem[base.List.Count];
			base.List.CopyTo(array, 0);
			return array;
		}
	}
	public class LayoutController : ILayoutController, IActiveItemOwner, IDisposable
	{
		private bool isDisposingCore;

		private DockLayoutManager containerCore;

		private Selection selectionCore;

		private ActiveItemHelper ActivationHelper;

		private BaseLayoutItem activeItemCore;

		private int lockActivateCounter;

		private HiddenItemsCollection hiddenItemsCore;

		private ReadOnlyCollection<BaseLayoutItem> fixedItemsCore;

		protected bool IsDisposing => isDisposingCore;

		[Description("Gets the DockLayoutManager container whose dock functionality is controlled by the current LayoutController.")]
		public DockLayoutManager Container => containerCore;

		[Description("Gets the active layout item.")]
		public BaseLayoutItem ActiveItem
		{
			get
			{
				return activeItemCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ActiveItem != value)
				{
					SetActiveItemCore(value);
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets whether Customization Mode is enabled.")]
		public bool IsCustomization => Container.CustomizationController.IsCustomization;

		[Description("Gets a list of items that are selected in Customization Mode.")]
		public Selection Selection => selectionCore;

		[Description("Gets the collection of hidden items.")]
		public HiddenItemsCollection HiddenItems => hiddenItemsCore;

		[Description("Gets a collection of the items that are always available in the Customization Window.")]
		public IEnumerable<BaseLayoutItem> FixedItems
		{
			get
			{
				if (fixedItemsCore == null && !IsDisposing)
				{
					fixedItemsCore = CreateFixedItemsCollection();
				}
				return fixedItemsCore;
			}
		}

		public LayoutController(DockLayoutManager container)
		{
			containerCore = container;
			ActivationHelper = new ActiveItemHelper(this);
			selectionCore = CreateSelection();
			hiddenItemsCore = CreateHiddenItemsCollection();
			Container.LayoutItemSelectionChanged += OnItemSelectionChanged;
		}

		void IDisposable.Dispose()
		{
			if (!IsDisposing)
			{
				isDisposingCore = true;
				OnDisposing();
			}
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		protected virtual Selection CreateSelection()
		{
			return new Selection();
		}

		protected void OnDisposing()
		{
			Ref.Dispose(ref selectionCore);
			Ref.Dispose(ref hiddenItemsCore);
			Ref.Dispose(ref ActivationHelper);
			activeItemCore = null;
			Container.LayoutItemSelectionChanged -= OnItemSelectionChanged;
			containerCore = null;
		}

		private void OnItemSelectionChanged(object sender, LayoutItemSelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			Selection.ProcessSelectionChanged(e.Item, e.Selected);
		}

		public void Activate(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			Activate(item, focus: true);
		}

		public void Activate(BaseLayoutItem item, bool focus)
		{
			if (lockActivateCounter > 0 || item == null || !item.AllowActivate || item.IsClosed || (item is LayoutGroup && ((LayoutGroup)item).IsUngroupped))
			{
				return;
			}
			lockActivateCounter++;
			try
			{
				if (RaiseItemCancelEvent(item, DockLayoutManager.LayoutItemActivatingEvent))
				{
					item.InvokeCancelActivation(ActiveItem);
				}
				else
				{
					ActivationHelper.ActivateItem(item, focus);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				lockActivateCounter--;
			}
		}

		private void SetActiveItemCore(BaseLayoutItem value)
		{
			SetActive(value: false);
			BaseLayoutItem oldItem = activeItemCore;
			activeItemCore = value;
			SetActive(value: true);
			Container.isLayoutItemActivation++;
			Container.ActiveLayoutItem = ActiveItem;
			Container.isLayoutItemActivation--;
			RaiseActiveItemChanged(value, oldItem);
		}

		private void SetActive(bool value)
		{
			if (ActiveItem != null)
			{
				ActiveItem.SetActive(value);
				if (value && lockActivateCounter == 0)
				{
					ActivationHelper.SelectInGroup(ActiveItem);
				}
			}
		}

		private void RaiseActiveItemChanged(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem oldItem)
		{
			Container.RaiseEvent(new LayoutItemActivatedEventArgs(item, oldItem)
			{
				Source = Container
			});
		}

		private bool RaiseItemCancelEvent(BaseLayoutItem item, RoutedEvent routedEvent)
		{
			return Container.RaiseItemCancelEvent(item, routedEvent);
		}

		public T CreateCommand<T>(BaseLayoutItem[] items) where T : LayoutControllerCommand, new()
		{
			return new T
			{
				Controller = this,
				Items = items
			};
		}

		private LayoutGroup TryUngroupGroup(LayoutGroup group, ref BaseLayoutItem nestedItem, ref int index)
		{
			if (group == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!group.DestroyOnClosingChildren)
			{
				return group;
			}
			LayoutGroup parent = group.Parent;
			switch (group.Items.Count)
			{
			case 0:
				nestedItem = null;
				if (parent != null)
				{
					index = parent.Items.IndexOf(group);
					if (parent.Items.Remove(group))
					{
						group.IsUngroupped = true;
						return TryUngroupGroup(parent, ref nestedItem, ref index);
					}
				}
				break;
			case 1:
				nestedItem = group.Items[0];
				TryUngroupGroup(nestedItem as LayoutGroup, ref nestedItem, ref index);
				if (parent != null)
				{
					index = parent.Items.IndexOf(group);
				}
				return DockControllerHelper.Unbox(Container, group);
			}
			return group;
		}

		public bool Hide(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (item.IsHidden && item.IsSelected)
			{
				item.SetSelected(Container, value: false);
			}
			if (item.IsHidden || !item.AllowHide || item.Parent == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (item.IsSelected)
			{
				item.SetSelected(Container, value: false);
			}
			bool result = false;
			LayoutGroup root = item.GetRoot();
			using (new UpdateBatch(Container))
			{
				if (root != null)
				{
					LayoutGroup parent = item.Parent;
					BaseLayoutItem nextItem = LayoutItemsHelper.GetNextItem(item);
					if (parent.Remove(item))
					{
						BaseLayoutItem nestedItem = null;
						int index = -1;
						LayoutGroup layoutGroup = TryUngroupGroup(parent, ref nestedItem, ref index);
						HiddenItems.Add(item, root);
						if (ActiveItem != null && ActiveItem.IsHidden)
						{
							Activate(nextItem ?? layoutGroup);
						}
						Container.CustomizationController.ClearSelection();
						Container.RaiseEvent(new LayoutItemHiddenEventArgs(item));
						Container.Update();
						result = true;
					}
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		public bool Restore(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			LayoutGroup restoreRoot = this.GetRestoreRoot(item);
			if (restoreRoot == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			using (new UpdateBatch(Container))
			{
				if (HiddenItems.Remove(item))
				{
					restoreRoot.Add(item);
					Container.RaiseEvent(new LayoutItemRestoredEventArgs(item));
					Container.Update();
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private void MoveCore(BaseLayoutItem item, LayoutGroup target)
		{
			MoveCore(item, target, -1);
		}

		private void MoveCore(BaseLayoutItem item, LayoutGroup target, int index)
		{
			if (item.IsHidden)
			{
				HiddenItems.Remove(item);
			}
			if (index != -1)
			{
				target.Insert(index, item);
			}
			else
			{
				target.Add(item);
			}
		}

		private bool CanMove(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem target, MoveType type)
		{
			if (item == null || target == null || item == target || type == MoveType.None)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!item.AllowMove || (item.IsHidden && !item.AllowRestore))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (type == MoveType.InsideGroup && (!(target is LayoutGroup) || (item.Parent == target && !item.IsHidden)))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (type != MoveType.InsideGroup && target.Parent == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (item is LayoutGroup && (LayoutItemsHelper.IsParent(target, item) || ((LayoutGroup)item).IsLayoutRoot) && !item.IsHidden)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool Move(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem target, MoveType type, int insertIndex)
		{
			if (!CanMove(item, target, type))
			{
				return false;
			}
			Container.CustomizationController.ClearSelection();
			LayoutGroup parent = item.Parent;
			bool isHidden = item.IsHidden;
			using (new NotificationBatch(Container))
			{
				using (new UpdateBatch(Container))
				{
					NotificationBatch.Action(Container, item.GetRoot());
					if (parent != null)
					{
						parent.Remove(item);
						BaseLayoutItem nestedItem = null;
						int index = -1;
						LayoutGroup layoutGroup = TryUngroupGroup(parent, ref nestedItem, ref index);
						if (target is LayoutGroup && ((LayoutGroup)target).IsUngroupped && layoutGroup != parent)
						{
							if (nestedItem == null)
							{
								if (index != -1)
								{
									MoveCore(item, layoutGroup, index);
								}
								else
								{
									MoveCore(item, layoutGroup);
								}
								OnMoveComplete(item, target, type, isHidden);
								return true;
							}
							target = nestedItem;
						}
					}
					if (type == MoveType.InsideGroup)
					{
						MoveCore(item, (LayoutGroup)target, insertIndex);
					}
					else
					{
						LayoutGroup parent2 = target.Parent;
						if (parent2 == null)
						{
							return false;
						}
						Orientation orientation = type.ToOrientation();
						int num = parent2.Items.IndexOf(target);
						if (!parent2.IgnoreOrientation && parent2.Orientation != orientation)
						{
							parent2.Remove(target);
							LayoutGroup layoutGroup2 = DockControllerHelper.BoxIntoGroup(target, orientation, Container);
							if (!target.ItemHeight.IsAuto && !item.ItemHeight.IsAuto)
							{
								target.ItemHeight = item.ItemHeight;
							}
							MoveCore(item, layoutGroup2, (type.ToInsertType() != InsertType.Before) ? 1 : 0);
							item = layoutGroup2;
						}
						else
						{
							num += ((type.ToInsertType() != InsertType.Before) ? 1 : 0);
						}
						MoveCore(item, parent2, num);
					}
					OnMoveComplete(item, target, type, isHidden);
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool Move(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem target, MoveType type)
		{
			return Move(item, target, type, -1);
		}

		private void OnMoveComplete(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem target, MoveType type, bool isHidden)
		{
			NotificationBatch.Action(Container, item.GetRoot());
			Container.Update();
			RaiseItemMovedEvent(item, target, type, isHidden);
		}

		private void RaiseItemMovedEvent(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem target, MoveType type, bool isHidden)
		{
			if (isHidden)
			{
				Container.RaiseEvent(new LayoutItemRestoredEventArgs(item));
			}
			else
			{
				Container.RaiseEvent(new LayoutItemMovedEventArgs(item, target, type));
			}
		}

		public bool Group(BaseLayoutItem[] items)
		{
			if (!LayoutItemsHelper.AreInSameGroup(items))
			{
				return false;
			}
			using (new UpdateBatch(Container))
			{
				using (new NotificationBatch(Container))
				{
					LayoutGroup parent = items[0].Parent;
					int num = parent.Items.IndexOf(items[0]);
					foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in items)
					{
						num = Math.Min(num, parent.Items.IndexOf(item));
					}
					using (new LogicalTreeLocker(Container, items))
					{
						foreach (BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem in items)
						{
							baseLayoutItem.SetSelected(Container, value: false);
							parent.Remove(baseLayoutItem);
						}
						LayoutGroup layoutGroup = DockControllerHelper.BoxIntoGroup(items, parent.Orientation, Container);
						layoutGroup.Caption = DockingLocalizer.GetString(DockingStringId.NewGroupCaption);
						layoutGroup.ShowCaption = true;
						parent.Insert(num, layoutGroup);
						Activate(layoutGroup);
					}
					Container.Update();
					NotificationBatch.Action(Container, parent.GetRoot());
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public bool ChangeGroupOrientation(LayoutGroup group, Orientation orientation)
		{
			if (group == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			group.Orientation = orientation;
			Container.Update();
			return true;
		}

		public bool Rename(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			return Container.RenameHelper.Rename(item);
		}

		public bool CancelRenaming()
		{
			return Container.RenameHelper.CancelRenamingAndResetClickedState();
		}

		public bool EndRenaming()
		{
			return Container.RenameHelper.EndRenaming();
		}

		public bool SetGroupBorderStyle(LayoutGroup group, GroupBorderStyle style)
		{
			if (group == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			group.GroupBorderStyle = style;
			Container.Update();
			return true;
		}

		public void HideSelectedItems()
		{
			BaseLayoutItem[] array = Selection.ToArray();
			BaseLayoutItem[] array2 = array;
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in array2)
			{
				Hide(item);
			}
		}

		protected virtual HiddenItemsCollection CreateHiddenItemsCollection()
		{
			return new HiddenItemsCollection(Container, null);
		}

		protected virtual ReadOnlyCollection<BaseLayoutItem> CreateFixedItemsCollection()
		{
			return new ReadOnlyCollection<BaseLayoutItem>(new BaseLayoutItem[4]
			{
				FixedItemFactory.CreateFixedItem(LayoutItemType.EmptySpaceItem),
				FixedItemFactory.CreateFixedItem(LayoutItemType.Label),
				FixedItemFactory.CreateFixedItem(LayoutItemType.Separator),
				FixedItemFactory.CreateFixedItem(LayoutItemType.LayoutSplitter)
			});
		}

		public bool Ungroup(LayoutGroup group)
		{
			using (new UpdateBatch(Container))
			{
				if (group == null || group.Parent == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				group.SetSelected(Container, value: false);
				LayoutGroup parent = group.Parent;
				int num = parent.Items.IndexOf(group);
				BaseLayoutItem[] array = new BaseLayoutItem[group.Items.Count];
				group.Items.CopyTo(array, 0);
				BaseLayoutItem[] array2 = array;
				foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in array2)
				{
					group.Remove(item);
					parent.Insert(num++, item);
				}
				parent.Remove(group);
				Container.Update();
				return true;
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class LayoutControllerCommand : ICommand
	{
		private class LayoutControllerCommandLink : RoutedCommand
		{
			public LayoutControllerCommand Command { get; private set; }

			public LayoutControllerCommandLink(string name, LayoutControllerCommand command)
				: base(name, typeof(LayoutControllerCommand))
			{
				Command = command;
			}
		}

		protected internal ILayoutController Controller { get; set; }

		protected internal BaseLayoutItem[] Items { get; set; }

		public static RoutedCommand ShowCaption { get; private set; }

		public static RoutedCommand ShowControl { get; private set; }

		public static RoutedCommand ShowCaptionImageBeforeText { get; private set; }

		public static RoutedCommand ShowCaptionImageAfterText { get; private set; }

		public static RoutedCommand ShowCaptionOnLeft { get; private set; }

		public static RoutedCommand ShowCaptionOnRight { get; private set; }

		public static RoutedCommand ShowCaptionAtTop { get; private set; }

		public static RoutedCommand ShowCaptionAtBottom { get; private set; }

		private event EventHandler CanExecuteChangedCore;

		event EventHandler ICommand.CanExecuteChanged
		{
			add
			{
				CanExecuteChangedCore += value;
			}
			remove
			{
				CanExecuteChangedCore -= value;
			}
		}

		internal LayoutControllerCommand()
		{
		}

		protected abstract void ExecuteCore(ILayoutController controller, BaseLayoutItem[] items);

		protected abstract bool CanExecuteCore(ILayoutController controller, BaseLayoutItem[] items);

		protected void RaiseCanExecuteChanged()
		{
			if (this.CanExecuteChangedCore != null)
			{
				this.CanExecuteChangedCore(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		bool ICommand.CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (Items == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return CanExecuteCore(Controller, Items);
		}

		void ICommand.Execute(object parameter)
		{
			ExecuteCore(Controller, Items);
		}

		static LayoutControllerCommand()
		{
			ShowCaption = new LayoutControllerCommandLink("ShowCaption", new ShowCaptionCommand());
			ShowControl = new LayoutControllerCommandLink("ShowControl", new ShowControlCommand());
			ShowCaptionImageBeforeText = new LayoutControllerCommandLink("ShowCaptionImageBeforeText", new CaptionImageBeforeTextCommand());
			ShowCaptionImageAfterText = new LayoutControllerCommandLink("ShowCaptionImageAfterText", new CaptionImageAfterTextCommand());
			ShowCaptionOnLeft = new LayoutControllerCommandLink("ShowCaptionOnLeft", new CaptionLocationLeftCommand());
			ShowCaptionOnRight = new LayoutControllerCommandLink("ShowCaptionOnRight", new CaptionLocationRightCommand());
			ShowCaptionAtTop = new LayoutControllerCommandLink("ShowCaptionAtTop", new CaptionLocationTopCommand());
			ShowCaptionAtBottom = new LayoutControllerCommandLink("ShowCaptionAtBottom", new CaptionLocationBottomCommand());
		}

		internal static void CanExecute(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			ILayoutController layoutController = LayoutControllerHelper.GetLayoutController(sender);
			BaseLayoutItem[] array = e.Parameter as BaseLayoutItem[];
			if (e.Parameter is BaseLayoutItem)
			{
				array = new BaseLayoutItem[1] { (BaseLayoutItem)e.Parameter };
			}
			LayoutControllerCommand command = ((LayoutControllerCommandLink)e.Command).Command;
			e.CanExecute = layoutController != null && array != null && command.CanExecuteCore(layoutController, array);
		}

		internal static void Executed(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			ILayoutController layoutController = LayoutControllerHelper.GetLayoutController(sender);
			BaseLayoutItem[] array = e.Parameter as BaseLayoutItem[];
			if (e.Parameter is BaseLayoutItem)
			{
				array = new BaseLayoutItem[1] { (BaseLayoutItem)e.Parameter };
			}
			if (layoutController != null && array != null)
			{
				LayoutControllerCommand command = ((LayoutControllerCommandLink)e.Command).Command;
				command.ExecuteCore(layoutController, array);
			}
		}
	}

	public static class LayoutControllerHelper
	{
		public static T CreateCommand<T>(DockLayoutManager container, BaseLayoutItem[] items) where T : LayoutControllerCommand, new()
		{
			ILayoutController layoutController = GetLayoutController(container);
			if (layoutController == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return layoutController.CreateCommand<T>(items);
		}

		private static ILayoutController GetLayoutController(DockLayoutManager container)
		{
			return container?.LayoutController;
		}

		public static ILayoutController GetLayoutController(object obj)
		{
			DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = obj as DockLayoutManager;
			if (dockLayoutManager == null)
			{
				dockLayoutManager = ((obj is DependencyObject obj2) ? DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager(obj2) : null);
			}
			return GetLayoutController(dockLayoutManager);
		}

		public static object GetSameValue(DependencyProperty property, BaseLayoutItem[] items, Comparison<object> match)
		{
			if (items == null || items.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object value = items[0].GetValue(property);
			for (int i = 1; i < items.Length; i++)
			{
				if (match(items[i].GetValue(property), value) != 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		public static int CompareImageLocation(object imageLocation1, object imageLocation2)
		{
			bool flag = (ImageLocation)imageLocation1 == ImageLocation.AfterText;
			bool flag2 = (ImageLocation)imageLocation2 == ImageLocation.AfterText;
			if (flag != flag2)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public static int CompareCaptionLocation(object captionLocation1, object captionLocation2)
		{
			bool flag = (CaptionLocation)captionLocation1 == CaptionLocation.Default || (CaptionLocation)captionLocation1 == CaptionLocation.Left;
			bool flag2 = (CaptionLocation)captionLocation2 == CaptionLocation.Default || (CaptionLocation)captionLocation2 == CaptionLocation.Left;
			if (!(flag && flag2))
			{
				if (!object.Equals(captionLocation1, captionLocation2))
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return 0;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public static int BoolComparer(object value1, object value2)
		{
			if ((bool)value1 != (bool)value2)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public static int CompareOrientation(object orientation1, object orientation2)
		{
			bool flag = (Orientation)orientation1 == Orientation.Horizontal;
			bool flag2 = (Orientation)orientation2 == Orientation.Horizontal;
			if (flag != flag2)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public static int CompareGroupBorderStyle(object style1, object style2)
		{
			if ((GroupBorderStyle)style1 != (GroupBorderStyle)style2)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public static int CompareObjects(object ha1, object ha2)
		{
			if (ha1 != ha2)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public static bool HasOnlyGroups(BaseLayoutItem[] items)
		{
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem in items)
			{
				if (!(baseLayoutItem is LayoutGroup))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class AutoHideGroup : LayoutGroup
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty DockTypeProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty AutoHideSizeProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty AutoHideSpeedProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty AutoHideTypeProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SizeToContentProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsAutoHideCenterProperty;

		private static readonly RoutedEvent DockTypeChangedEvent;

		internal bool HasPersistentGroups;

		[Description("Gets or sets the size of panels belonging to the current AutoHideGroup, in pixels.\nThis is a dependency property.")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[Category("Layout")]
		public Size AutoHideSize
		{
			get
			{
				return (Size)GetValue(AutoHideSizeProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(AutoHideSizeProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the time, in milliseconds, required to open/close an auto-hidden panel belonging to the current group. This is a dependency property.")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int AutoHideSpeed
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(AutoHideSpeedProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(AutoHideSpeedProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the DockLayoutManager‘s side to which the AutoHideGroup is docked. This is a dependency property.")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[Category("Layout")]
		public Dock DockType
		{
			get
			{
				return (Dock)GetValue(DockTypeProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DockTypeProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool IgnoreOrientation => true;

		public event DockTypeChangedEventHandler DockTypeChanged;

		static AutoHideGroup()
		{
			DockingStrategyRegistrator.RegisterAutoHideGroupStrategy();
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<AutoHideGroup> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<AutoHideGroup>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata(BaseLayoutItem.AllowSelectionProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata(LayoutGroup.AllowExpandProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata(LayoutGroup.IsExpandedPropertyKey, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("DockType", ref DockTypeProperty, Dock.Left, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((AutoHideGroup)dObj).OnDockTypeChanged((Dock)e.OldValue, (Dock)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttached("AutoHideSize", ref AutoHideSizeProperty, new Size(150.0, 150.0), null, CoerceAutoHideSize);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("AutoHideSpeed", ref AutoHideSpeedProperty, 150);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttached("AutoHideType", ref AutoHideTypeProperty, AutoHideType.Default);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttached("SizeToContent", ref SizeToContentProperty, SizeToContent.Manual);
			DockTypeChanged = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("DockTypeChanged", RoutingStrategy.Direct, typeof(DockTypeChangedEventHandler), typeof(AutoHideGroup));
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<AutoHideGroup>.New().RegisterAttached<DependencyObject, bool>("GetIsAutoHideCenter", ref IsAutoHideCenterProperty, false, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedPropertyOwnerType(AutoHideTypeProperty.OwnerType);
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedPropertyType(AutoHideTypeProperty);
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedPropertyType(SizeToContentProperty);
		}

		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public static Size GetAutoHideSize(DependencyObject target)
		{
			return (Size)target.GetValue(AutoHideSizeProperty);
		}

		public static void SetAutoHideSize(DependencyObject target, Size value)
		{
			target.SetValue(AutoHideSizeProperty, value);
		}

		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public static AutoHideType GetAutoHideType(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (AutoHideType)obj.GetValue(AutoHideTypeProperty);
		}

		public static void SetAutoHideType(DependencyObject obj, AutoHideType value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(AutoHideTypeProperty, value);
		}

		private static object CoerceAutoHideSize(DependencyObject dObj, object value)
		{
			if (!(dObj is BaseLayoutItem))
			{
				return value;
			}
			BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = (BaseLayoutItem)dObj;
			return MathHelper.MeasureSize(baseLayoutItem.ActualMinSize, baseLayoutItem.ActualMaxSize, (Size)value);
		}

		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public static SizeToContent GetSizeToContent(DependencyObject target)
		{
			return (SizeToContent)target.GetValue(SizeToContentProperty);
		}

		public static void SetSizeToContent(DependencyObject target, SizeToContent value)
		{
			target.SetValue(SizeToContentProperty, value);
		}

		public static bool GetIsAutoHideCenter(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (bool)d.GetValue(IsAutoHideCenterProperty);
		}

		public static void SetIsAutoHideCenter(DependencyObject d, bool value)
		{
			d.SetValue(IsAutoHideCenterProperty, value);
		}

		public AutoHideGroup()
			: this(EmptyArray<BaseLayoutItem>.Instance)
		{
		}

		internal AutoHideGroup(params BaseLayoutItem[] items)
			: base(items)
		{
			base.IsEnabledChanged += OnIsEnabledChanged;
		}

		internal Size GetActualAutoHideSize(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (DependencyPropertyHelper.GetValueSource(item, AutoHideSizeProperty).BaseValueSource == BaseValueSource.Default || !IsAutoHideSizeValid(item))
			{
				Size size = ((item is LayoutPanel layoutPanel) ? layoutPanel.LayoutSizeBeforeHide : Size.Empty);
				if (!MathHelper.IsEmpty(size))
				{
					return size;
				}
				return item.GetSize(AutoHideSize);
			}
			return GetAutoHideSize(item);
		}

		internal void OnOwnerCollectionChanged()
		{
			if (base.Manager != null && !base.Manager.AutoHideGroups.Contains(this))
			{
				DockLayoutManager.RemoveLogicalChild(base.Manager, this);
			}
		}

		protected override Size CalcMaxSizeValue(Size value)
		{
			return value;
		}

		protected override Size CalcMinSizeValue(Size value)
		{
			return value;
		}

		protected override bool CanCreateItemsInternal()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override BaseLayoutItem CoerceSelectedItem(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (!IsValid(base.SelectedTabIndex))
			{
				return item;
			}
			return base.Items[base.SelectedTabIndex];
		}

		protected override void CoerceSizes()
		{
			base.CoerceSizes();
			CoerceValue(AutoHideSizeProperty);
		}

		protected override BaseLayoutItemCollection CreateItems()
		{
			return new AutoHideItemsCollection(this);
		}

		protected override LayoutItemType GetLayoutItemTypeCore()
		{
			return LayoutItemType.AutoHideGroup;
		}

		protected override void OnAllowDockChanged(bool value)
		{
			base.OnAllowDockChanged(value);
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in base.Items)
			{
				item.CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsPinButtonVisibleProperty);
			}
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return (AutomationPeer)(object)new AutoHideGroupAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected override void OnDockLayoutManagerChanged(DockLayoutManager oldValue, DockLayoutManager newValue)
		{
			base.OnDockLayoutManagerChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				DockLayoutManager.AddLogicalChild(newValue, this);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnDockTypeChanged(Dock prev, Dock value)
		{
			AutoHideTray.SetDock(this, value);
			if (this.DockTypeChanged != null)
			{
				this.DockTypeChanged(this, new DockTypeChangedEventArgs(value, prev)
				{
					RoutedEvent = DockTypeChanged,
					Source = this
				});
			}
		}

		protected override void OnIsExpandedChanged(bool expanded)
		{
			base.OnIsExpandedChanged(expanded);
			if (base.Manager != null)
			{
				ItemEventArgs e = (expanded ? ((ItemEventArgs)new DockItemExpandedEventArgs(this)) : ((ItemEventArgs)new DockItemCollapsedEventArgs(this)));
				base.Manager.RaiseEvent(e);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnItemsCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnItemsCollectionChanged(sender, e);
			if (e.OldItems != null)
			{
				e.OldItems.Cast<DependencyObject>().ForEach(delegate(DependencyObject x)
				{
					AutoHideTray.ClearDock(x);
				});
			}
			if (e.NewItems != null)
			{
				e.NewItems.Cast<DependencyObject>().ForEach(delegate(DependencyObject x)
				{
					AutoHideTray.SetDock(x, DockType);
				});
			}
			if (base.IsExpanded && (base.SelectedItem == null || !base.Items.Contains(base.SelectedItem)))
			{
				DockControllerHelper.CheckHideView(base.Manager, this);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnVisualParentChanged(DependencyObject oldParent)
		{
			base.OnVisualParentChanged(oldParent);
			if (base.VisualParent != null)
			{
				base.Items.OfType<LayoutPanel>().ForEach(delegate(LayoutPanel x)
				{
					x.ApplyExpandState();
				});
			}
		}

		private bool IsAutoHideSizeValid(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			Size autoHideSize = GetAutoHideSize(item);
			if (DockType != Dock.Top && DockType != Dock.Bottom)
			{
				return MathHelper.IsConstraintValid(autoHideSize.Height);
			}
			return MathHelper.IsConstraintValid(autoHideSize.Width);
		}

		private void OnIsEnabledChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.Items.ForEach(delegate(BaseLayoutItem x)
			{
				x.CoerceValue(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty);
			});
		}
	}

		[Description("Gets the item’s parent group.")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public new LayoutGroup Parent
		{
			get
			{
				return parentCore;
			}
			internal set
			{
				if (parentCore != value)
				{
					LayoutGroup oldParent = parentCore;
					if (parentCore != null && parentCore.Items.Contains(this))
					{
						parentCore.Items.Remove(this);
					}
					parentCore = value;
					if (parentCore != null && !parentCore.Items.Contains(this))
					{
						parentCore.Items.Add(this);
					}
					OnParentChanged(oldParent, parentCore);
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool ShouldUseCaptionTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				if (Caption == null || Caption is string || Caption.GetType().IsPrimitive)
				{
					return HasCaptionTemplate;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal bool ShouldUseTabCaptionTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				if ((TabCaption == null || TabCaption is string || TabCaption.GetType().IsPrimitive) && !HasCaptionTemplate)
				{
					return HasTabCaptionTemplate;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsEnabledCore
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.IsEnabledCore)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!SupportsOptimizedLogicalTree)
				{
					return Parent?.IsEnabled ?? true;
				}
				return ((UIElement)(((object)Manager) ?? ((object)Parent)))?.IsEnabled ?? true;
			}
		}

		private static bool IsStringOrPrimitive(object caption)
		{
			if (caption != null)
			{
				if (!(caption is string))
				{
					return caption.GetType().IsPrimitive;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected BaseLayoutItem()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0037: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0042: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_006c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0076: Expected O, but got Unknown
			SerializationInfo = CreateSerializationInfo();
			LayoutItemData = new LayoutItemData(this);
			dockingTargetLocker = new Locker();
			OnCreate();
			SetIsVisible(value: true);
			if (!IsInDesignTime)
			{
				CoerceValue(CaptionFormatProperty);
				CoerceValue(TabCaptionFormatProperty);
			}
			CoerceValue(CustomizationCaptionProperty);
			CoerceValue(ActualMarginProperty);
			CoerceValue(ActualPaddingProperty);
			CoerceValue(IsCloseButtonVisibleProperty);
			CoerceValue(IsPinButtonVisibleProperty);
			CoerceValue(IsMinimizeButtonVisibleProperty);
			CoerceValue(IsMaximizeButtonVisibleProperty);
			CoerceValue(IsRestoreButtonVisibleProperty);
			CoerceValue(IsDropDownButtonVisibleProperty);
			CoerceValue(IsScrollNextButtonVisibleProperty);
			CoerceValue(IsScrollPrevButtonVisibleProperty);
			CoerceValue(IsControlBoxVisibleProperty);
		}

		public override void BeginInit()
		{
			base.BeginInit();
			initCounter++;
		}

		public override void EndInit()
		{
			if (--initCounter == 0 && !isInitializedCore)
			{
				isInitializedCore = true;
				OnInitialized();
			}
			base.EndInit();
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			IsTemplateApplied = true;
			if (PartMultiTemplateControl != null && !LayoutItemsHelper.IsTemplateChild(PartMultiTemplateControl, this))
			{
				PartMultiTemplateControl.Dispose();
			}
			PartMultiTemplateControl = LayoutItemsHelper.GetTemplateChild<MultiTemplateControl>(this);
			SelectTemplate();
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		internal bool ExecuteCloseCommand()
		{
			if (Locker.op_Implicit(closeCommandLocker))
			{
				return false;
			}
			Locker val = closeCommandLocker.Lock();
			try
			{
				ICommand closeCommand = CloseCommand;
				object parameter = (DependencyObjectExtensions.IsPropertySet((DependencyObject)this, CloseCommandParameterProperty) ? CloseCommandParameter : this);
				RoutedCommand routedCommand = closeCommand as RoutedCommand;
				if (closeCommand != null)
				{
					if (routedCommand != null && routedCommand.CanExecute(parameter, this))
					{
						routedCommand.Execute(parameter, this);
						return true;
					}
					if (closeCommand.CanExecute(parameter))
					{
						closeCommand.Execute(parameter);
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		internal T GetUIElement<T>(bool skipSelf) where T : class
		{
			IUIElement[] elements = UIElements.GetElements();
			return elements.FirstOrDefault((IUIElement element) => element is T && (!skipSelf || !object.Equals(element, this))) as T;
		}

		internal void InvokeCancelActivation(BaseLayoutItem activeItem)
		{
			isActivationCancelledLocker.Lock();
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action<BaseLayoutItem>(TryCancelActivation), activeItem);
		}

		internal virtual DockLayoutManager OnCoerceDockLayoutManagerCore(DockLayoutManager value)
		{
			if (AreInheritablePropertiesLocked)
			{
				return _DockLayoutManagerCached;
			}
			return value;
		}

		internal virtual void OnDockLayoutManagerCoreChanged(DockLayoutManager oldValue, DockLayoutManager newValue)
		{
			_DockLayoutManagerCached = newValue;
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				SetBinding(ViewStyleInternalProperty, new Binding
				{
					Source = newValue,
					Path = new PropertyPath(DockLayoutManager.ViewStyleProperty)
				});
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(ViewStyleInternalProperty);
			}
		}

		protected internal Size CheckSize(Size layoutSize)
		{
			if (DependencyPropertyHelper.GetValueSource(this, FloatSizeProperty).BaseValueSource != BaseValueSource.Default)
			{
				return FloatSize;
			}
			if (Parent is FloatGroup floatGroup && floatGroup.TryGetActualAutoSize(out var autoSize))
			{
				return autoSize;
			}
			return layoutSize;
		}

		protected internal virtual void ClearTemplate()
		{
			ClearTemplateCore();
		}

		protected internal virtual void ClearTemplateCore()
		{
			if (PartMultiTemplateControl != null)
			{
				PartMultiTemplateControl.LayoutItem = null;
			}
			ClearValue(DockLayoutManager.UIScopeProperty);
			ClearValue(DockLayoutManager.DockLayoutManagerProperty);
		}

		protected internal virtual void EndFloating()
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual IUIElement FindUIScopeCore()
		{
			IUIElement iUIElement;
			if (Parent != null && !(Parent is FloatGroup) && !(Parent is AutoHideGroup))
			{
				IUIElement parent = Parent;
				iUIElement = parent;
			}
			else
			{
				iUIElement = this.FindUIScope();
			}
			IUIElement result = iUIElement;
			if (IsTabPage)
			{
				if (!IsSelectedItem)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return result;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected internal void InvalidateTabHeader()
		{
			TabbedPaneItem element = UIElements.GetElement<TabbedPaneItem>();
			if (element != null)
			{
				BaseHeadersPanel.Invalidate(element);
			}
		}

		protected internal void InvokeCoerceDockItemState()
		{
			if (!IsDockItemStateLocked)
			{
				InvokeCoerceDockItemStateCore();
				lockDockItemStateCount = 0;
			}
			else
			{
				lockDockItemStateCount++;
			}
		}

		protected internal void InvokeCoerceInheritableProperties()
		{
			if (!AreInheritablePropertiesLocked)
			{
				CoerceValue(DockLayoutManagerCoreProperty);
				CoerceValue(FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty);
				CoerceValue(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty);
				lockInheritablePropertiesCount = 0;
			}
			else
			{
				lockInheritablePropertiesCount++;
			}
		}

			LogicalTreeLockHelper.Lock();
			LockInheritableProperties();
			LockDockItemState();
		}

		protected virtual void OnRootGroupChanged(LayoutGroup oldValue, LayoutGroup newValue)
		{

		protected internal virtual void OnThemeChanged(RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			themeChangedLocker.Unlock();
			if (!EnvironmentHelper.IsNet45OrNewer)
			{
				LockInLogicalTree();
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(UnlockItemInLogicalTree), DispatcherPriority.Loaded);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnThemeChanging(RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			themeChangedLocker.Lock();
		}

		protected internal void SetActive(bool value)
		{
			lockActivation++;
			if (IsActive != value)
			{
				IsActive = value;
			}
			lockActivation--;
		}

		protected internal virtual void SetSelected(DockLayoutManager manager, bool value)
		{
			bool flag = Manager == null;
			if (flag)

			if (flag)
			{
				Manager = null;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void UnlockInheritableProperties()
		{
			inheritablePropertiesLocker.Unlock();
			if (!Locker.op_Implicit(inheritablePropertiesLocker) && lockInheritablePropertiesCount > 0)
			{
				InvokeCoerceInheritableProperties();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void UnlockItemInLogicalTree()

			UnlockInheritableProperties();
			UnlockDockItemState();
			LogicalTreeLockHelper.Unlock();
		}

		{
		}

		protected internal void UpdateDockSituation(BaseLayoutItem dockTarget, DockType type)
		{
			if (DockSituation == null)
			{
				DockSituation = new DockSituation(type, dockTarget);
				return;
			}
			DockSituation.Type = type;
			DockSituation.DockTarget = dockTarget;
		}

		protected internal void UpdateDockSituation(DockSituation situation, BaseLayoutItem dockTarget, BaseLayoutItem originalItem = null)
		{
			if (DockSituation == null || situation == null)
			{
				DockSituation = situation;
			}
			else
			{
				DockSituation.Type = situation.Type;
				if (!DockSituation.Width.IsAbsolute || situation.Width.IsAbsolute)
				{
					DockSituation.Width = situation.Width;
				}
				if (!DockSituation.Height.IsAbsolute || situation.Height.IsAbsolute)
				{
					DockSituation.Height = situation.Height;
				}
			}
			if (DockSituation != null)
			{
				DockSituation.DockTarget = dockTarget;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateFloatState()
		{
			ParentLockHelper.DoWhenUnlocked(delegate
			{
				(this.GetRoot() as FloatGroup).Do(delegate(FloatGroup x)
				{
					x.UpdateFloatState();
				});
			});
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateSizeToContent()
		{
			ParentLockHelper.DoWhenUnlocked(delegate
			{
				(this.GetRoot() as FloatGroup).Do(delegate(FloatGroup x)
				{
					x.UpdateSizeToContent();
				});
			});
		}

		protected virtual string CoerceActualCaption(string value)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(CaptionFormat) && IsStringOrPrimitive(Caption))
			{
				return string.Format(CaptionFormat, Caption);
			}
			return Caption as string;
		}

		{
			return value;
		}

		protected virtual Thickness CoerceActualMargin(Thickness value)
		{
			if (!MathHelper.AreEqual(Margin, new Thickness(double.NaN)))
			{
				return Margin;
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected virtual Size CoerceActualMaxSize()
		{
			Size value = new Size(MathHelper.IsConstraintValid(base.MaxWidth) ? base.MaxWidth : double.PositiveInfinity, MathHelper.IsConstraintValid(base.MaxHeight) ? base.MaxHeight : double.PositiveInfinity);
			Size size = CalcMaxSizeValue(value);
			double width = Math.Max(ActualMinSize.Width, size.Width);
			double height = Math.Max(ActualMinSize.Height, size.Height);
			return new Size(width, height);
		}

		protected virtual Size CoerceActualMinSize()
		{
			Size value = new Size(MathHelper.IsConstraintValid(base.MinWidth) ? base.MinWidth : 0.0, MathHelper.IsConstraintValid(base.MinHeight) ? base.MinHeight : 0.0);
			return CalcMinSizeValue(value);
		}

		protected virtual Thickness CoerceActualPadding(Thickness value)
		{
			if (!MathHelper.AreEqual(Padding, new Thickness(double.NaN)))
			{
				return Padding;
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected virtual object CoerceActualTabCaption(string captionFormat)
		{
			object obj = TabCaption ?? Caption;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(TabCaptionFormat) && IsStringOrPrimitive(obj))
			{
				return string.Format(TabCaptionFormat, obj);
			}
			return obj as string;
		}

		protected virtual ImageSource CoerceCaptionImage(ImageSource value)
		{
			DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = this.FindDockLayoutManager();
			if (dockLayoutManager == null)
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (value == null && (Caption == null || (Caption is string && string.IsNullOrEmpty((string)Caption))) && !HasCaptionTemplate)
			{
				if (IsTabPage)
				{
					return dockLayoutManager.DefaultTabPageCaptionImage;
				}
				if (IsAutoHidden)
				{
					return dockLayoutManager.DefaultAutoHidePanelCaptionImage;
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected virtual double CoerceCaptionWidth(double value)
		{
			return CaptionAlignHelper.GetCaptionWidth(this, value);
		}

		protected virtual string CoerceCustomizationCaption(string value)
		{
			string text = Caption as string;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return text;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.Name))
			{
				return base.Name;
			}
			return TypeName;
		}

		protected virtual Size CoerceFloatSize(Size value)
		{
			return MathHelper.MeasureSize(ActualMinSize, ActualMaxSize, value);
		}

		protected virtual GridLength CoerceHeight(GridLength value)
		{
			if (value.IsAbsolute)
			{
				double value2 = MathHelper.MeasureDimension(ActualMinSize.Height, ActualMaxSize.Height, value.Value);
				value = new GridLength(value2, GridUnitType.Pixel);
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected virtual Visibility CoerceVisibility(Visibility visibility)
		{
			DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = this.FindDockLayoutManager();
			if (dockLayoutManager == null)
			{
				return visibility;
			}
			bool? showInvisibleItems = dockLayoutManager.ShowInvisibleItems;
			bool isVisible = (showInvisibleItems.HasValue ? showInvisibleItems.Value : (IsInDesignTime ? dockLayoutManager.IsCustomization : (dockLayoutManager.IsCustomization && dockLayoutManager.ShowInvisibleItemsInCustomizationForm)));
			return VisibilityHelper.Convert(isVisible, visibility);
		}

				value = new GridLength(value2, GridUnitType.Pixel);
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			if (IsAutoHidden)
			{
				return (AutomationPeer)(object)new AutoHideItemAutomationPeer(this);
			}
			if (IsClosed)
			{
				return (AutomationPeer)(object)new ClosedPanelItemAutomationPeer(this);
			}
			if (IsTabPage)
			{
				return (AutomationPeer)(object)new TabbedItemAutomationPeer(this);
			}
			return (AutomationPeer)(object)new BaseLayoutItemAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsActiveChanged(bool value)
		{
			if (ParentLockHelper.IsLocked)
			{
				ParentLockHelper.AddUnlockAction(OnIsActiveChangedCore);
			}
			else if (LogicalTreeLockHelper.IsLocked && value)
			{
				LogicalTreeLockHelper.AddUnlockAction(OnIsActiveChangedCore);
			}
			else
			{
				OnIsActiveChangedCore();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsActiveChangedCore()
		{
			if (!activationCancelLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				TryToActivate();
			}
			CoerceValue(ActualAppearanceObjectProperty);
			RaiseVisualChanged();
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected void TryToActivate()
		{
			DockLayoutManager dockManager = Manager;
			if (dockManager == null)
			{
				LayoutGroup layoutGroup = Parent ?? (LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(this) as LayoutGroup);
				if (layoutGroup != null)
				{
					dockManager = layoutGroup.GetRoot().GetDockLayoutManager();
				}
			}
			if (IsActivationLocked || dockManager == null || LogicalTreeLockHelper.IsLocked)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (IsActive)
			{
				dockManager.Activate(this);
				if (IsFloating)
				{
					Action action = delegate
					{
						dockManager.BringToFront(this);
					};
					InvokeHelper.BeginInvoke(this, () => !base.IsLoaded, action);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				dockManager.Deactivate(this);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UnlockLogicalTreeCore()
		{
		}

		protected void UpdateActualCustomizationCaption()
		{
			bool flag = DependencyObjectExtensions.IsPropertySet((DependencyObject)this, CustomizationCaptionProperty);
			if (flag || !ShouldUseCaptionTemplate)
			{
				ActualCustomizationCaption = ((flag || string.IsNullOrEmpty(ActualCaption)) ? CustomizationCaption : ActualCaption);
				ActualCustomizationCaptionTemplate = null;
				ActualCustomizationCaptionTemplateSelector = null;
			}
			else
			{
				ActualCustomizationCaption = GetActualCustomizationCaption();
				ActualCustomizationCaptionTemplate = GetActualCustmizationCaptionTemplate();
				ActualCustomizationCaptionTemplateSelector = GetActualCustomizationCaptionTemplateSelector();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateHideFromSearch()
		{
			BarItemSearchSettings.SetHideFromSearch((DependencyObject)this, IsClosed || (IsTabPage && !IsSelectedItem));
		}

		protected void UpdateIsFloatingRootItem()
		{
			IsFloatingRootItem = Parent is FloatGroup && Parent.Items.Count == 1;
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateVisualState()
		{
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, IsActive ? "Active" : "Inactive", useTransitions: false);
		}

		private void CheckClosedState()
		{
			ParentLockHelper.DoWhenUnlocked(CheckClosedStateCore);
		}

		private void CheckClosedStateCore()
		{
			DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = this.FindDockLayoutManager();
			if (dockLayoutManager == null || Closed == IsClosed || IsInDesignTime || IsInitializing || IsDeserializing)
			{
				return;
			}
			using (LockCloseCommand())
			{
				dockLayoutManager.CheckClosedState(this);
			}
		}

		private object CoerceStyle(Style value)
		{
			if (AreInheritablePropertiesLocked)
			{
				return _Style;
			}
			return value;
		}

		}

		private ActionGroup EnsureContextMenuActionGroup()
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ActionGroup val = new ActionGroup();
			BindingHelper.SetBinding((DependencyObject)(object)val, ActionGroup.ActionsTemplateProperty, this, ContextMenuCustomizationsTemplateProperty);
			AddLogicalChild(val);
			return val;
		}

		private IUIElement EnsureUIScope()
		{
			IUIElement iUIElement = FindUIScopeCore();
			SetValue(DockLayoutManager.UIScopeProperty, iUIElement);
			if (iUIElement != null)
			{
				SetValue(DockLayoutManager.LayoutItemProperty, this);
				UIElements.Add(this);
			}
			return iUIElement;
		}

		private bool GetIsLayoutTreeChangeInProgress()
		{
			List<BaseLayoutItem> list = new List<BaseLayoutItem>();
			for (BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = this; baseLayoutItem != null; baseLayoutItem = baseLayoutItem.Parent)
			{
				list.Add(baseLayoutItem);
			}
			return list.Any((BaseLayoutItem x) => x.IsLayoutChangeInProgress || x.GetIsLogicalChildrenIterationInProgress());
		}

		private void LockDockItemState()
		{
			lockDockItemState++;
		}

		private void SetIsVisible(bool value)
		{
			if (isVisibleCore != value)
			{
				isVisibleCore = value;
				CoerceValue(IsVisibleCoreProperty);
			}
		}

		private void TryCancelActivation(BaseLayoutItem activeItem)
		{
			try
			{
				if (IsActive)
				{
					activationCancelLocker.Lock();
					if (activeItem != this)
					{
						SetCurrentValue(IsActiveProperty, false);
					}
					activationCancelLocker.Unlock();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				isActivationCancelledLocker.Unlock();
			}
		}

		private void UnlockDockItemState()
		{
			if (--lockDockItemState == 0 && lockDockItemStateCount > 0)
			{
				InvokeCoerceDockItemState();
			}
		}

		}

	internal class LockHelper : IDisposable
	{
		public delegate void LockHelperDelegate();

		private LockHelperDelegate UnlockDelegate;

		private int lockCount;

		private readonly Stack<LockHelperDelegate> actions = new Stack<LockHelperDelegate>();

		public bool IsLocked => lockCount > 0;

		public LockHelper(LockHelperDelegate unlockDelegate)
		{
			UnlockDelegate = unlockDelegate;
		}

		public LockHelper()
		{
		}

		public void AddUnlockAction(LockHelperDelegate action)
		{
			if (IsLocked && actions != null && !actions.Contains(action))
			{
				actions.Push(action);
			}
		}

		public LockHelper Lock()
		{
			lockCount++;
			return this;
		}

		public LockHelper LockOnce()
		{
			if (!IsLocked)
			{
				Lock();
			}
			return this;
		}

		public void Unlock()
		{
			if (!IsLocked)
			{
				return;
			}
			lockCount--;
			if (!IsLocked)
			{
				while (actions.Count > 0)
				{
					LockHelperDelegate lockHelperDelegate = actions.Pop();
					lockHelperDelegate();
				}
				if (UnlockDelegate != null)
				{
					UnlockDelegate();
				}
			}
		}

		public void DoWhenUnlocked(LockHelperDelegate action)
		{
			if (IsLocked)
			{
				AddUnlockAction(action);
			}
			else
			{
				action();
			}
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			actions.Clear();
			UnlockDelegate = null;
			Unlock();
		}

		void IDisposable.Dispose()
		{
			Unlock();
		}

		public static implicit operator bool(LockHelper locker)
		{
			return locker.IsLocked;
		}
	}
	public class HiddenItemsCollection : BaseLayoutItemCollection
	{
		private LayoutGroup currentParent;

		private DockLayoutManager Manager;

		public HiddenItemsCollection(DockLayoutManager owner, LayoutGroup customizationRoot)
			: base(customizationRoot)
		{
			Manager = owner;
		}

		public new void Add(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			Add(item, null);
		}

		public void Add(BaseLayoutItem item, LayoutGroup currentParent)
		{
			if (!(item is FixedItem))
			{
				this.currentParent = currentParent;
				base.Add(item);
			}
		}

		protected override void BeforeItemAdded(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			CheckItemRules(item);
		}

		protected override void CheckItemRules(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item.ItemType != LayoutItemType.ControlItem && item.ItemType != LayoutItemType.Group && !(item is FixedItem))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(DockLayoutManagerHelper.GetRule(DockLayoutManagerRule.ItemCanNotBeHidden));
			}
		}

		protected override void OnItemAdded(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				item.Manager = Manager;
			}
			item.SetHidden(value: true, currentParent);
		}

		protected override void OnItemRemoved(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			item.SetHidden(value: false, null);
		}
	}
	public class DocumentGroup : TabbedGroup
	{
		private class DefaultTemplateSelector : DefaultItemTemplateSelectorWrapper.DefaultItemTemplateSelector
		{
			public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
			{
				DocumentPaneContentPresenter documentPaneContentPresenter = container as DocumentPaneContentPresenter;
				if (item is DocumentGroup documentGroup && documentPaneContentPresenter != null && documentPaneContentPresenter.Owner != null)
				{
					switch (documentGroup.MDIStyle)
					{
					case MDIStyle.Default:
					case MDIStyle.Tabbed:
						return documentPaneContentPresenter.Owner.TabbedTemplate;
					case MDIStyle.MDI:
						return documentPaneContentPresenter.Owner.MDITemplate;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public new static readonly DependencyProperty ShowPinButtonProperty;

		static DocumentGroup()
		{
			DockingStrategyRegistrator.RegisterDocumentGroupStrategy();
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DocumentGroup> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DocumentGroup>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<DocumentGroup>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata(BaseLayoutItem.AllowFloatProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("MDIStyle", ref MDIStyleProperty, MDIStyle.Default, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DocumentGroup)dObj).OnMDIStyleChanged((MDIStyle)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ClosePageButtonShowMode", ref ClosePageButtonShowModeProperty, ClosePageButtonShowMode.Default, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DocumentGroup)dObj).OnClosePageButtonShowModeChanged((ClosePageButtonShowMode)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttached("LastClosePageButtonShowModeInternal", ref LastClosePageButtonShowModeInternalProperty, ClosePageButtonShowMode.Default);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata(LayoutGroup.GroupTemplateSelectorProperty, (DataTemplateSelector)new DefaultTemplateSelector(), (PropertyChangedCallback)delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DocumentGroup)dObj).OnGroupTemplateChanged();
			}, (CoerceValueCallback)null);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ShowWhenEmpty", ref ShowWhenEmptyProperty, defValue: false, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DocumentGroup)dObj).OnShowEmptyChanged((bool)e.OldValue, (bool)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("TabbedGroupDisplayMode", ref TabbedGroupDisplayModeProperty, TabbedGroupDisplayMode.Default);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttached("PinLocation", ref PinLocationProperty, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.BindsTwoWayByDefault, TabHeaderPinLocation.Default);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttached("Pinned", ref PinnedProperty, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.BindsTwoWayByDefault, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttached("ShowPinButton", ref ShowPinButtonProperty, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.BindsTwoWayByDefault, defValue: false);
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedPropertyOwnerType(PinLocationProperty.OwnerType);
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedPropertyType(PinLocationProperty);
		}
