		public DocumentGroup()
			: this(EmptyArray<BaseLayoutItem>.Instance)
		{
		}

		internal DocumentGroup(params BaseLayoutItem[] items)
			: base(items)
		{
			this.Forward(this, LayoutGroup.TabbedGroupDisplayModeCoreProperty, TabbedGroupDisplayModeProperty);
		}

		internal override ContentItem CreateContentItem(object content)
		{
			if (base.IsControlItemsHost)
			{
				return base.CreateContentItem(content);
			}
			return (base.Manager != null) ? base.Manager.CreateDocumentPanel() : new DocumentPanel();
		}

		protected internal override void AfterItemAdded(int index, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			base.AfterItemAdded(index, item);
			if (!IsTabbed && base.IsMaximized)
			{
				if (item is DocumentPanel)
				{
					DocumentPanel.SetMDIState(item, MDIState.Maximized);
				}
				LayoutItemsHelper.UpdateZIndexes(this);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void AfterItemRemoved(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			base.AfterItemRemoved(item);
			item.SetValue(LastClosePageButtonShowModeInternalProperty, ClosePageButtonShowMode);
			if (item is DocumentPanel documentPanel)
			{
				documentPanel.IsMDIChild = false;
			}
			if (base.IsMaximized && !ContainsMaximizedDocument())
			{
				base.IsMaximized = false;
			}
		}

		protected internal override void BeforeItemAdded(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			base.BeforeItemAdded(item);
			if (item is DocumentPanel documentPanel)
			{
				documentPanel.IsMDIChild = MDIStyle == MDIStyle.MDI;
			}
		}

		protected internal void ChangeMDIStyle()
		{
			if (IsTabbed)
			{
				MDIStyle = MDIStyle.MDI;
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(MDIStyleProperty);
			}
			LayoutItemsHelper.UpdateZIndexes(this);
		}

		protected internal override bool GetIsDocumentHost()
		{
			if (base.Manager != null && base.Manager.DockingStyle != DockingStyle.Default && IsTabbed)
			{
				return base.Parent != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateButtons()
		{
			base.UpdateButtons();
			CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsRestoreButtonVisibleProperty);
			CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsDropDownButtonVisibleProperty);
		}

		protected override Size CalcMaxSizeValue(Size value)
		{
			if (!IsTabbed)
			{
				return value;
			}
			return base.CalcMaxSizeValue(value);
		}

		protected override Size CalcMinSizeValue(Size value)
		{
			if (!IsTabbed)
			{
				return value;
			}
			return base.CalcMinSizeValue(value);
		}

		protected bool CanShowCloseButtonForSelectedItem()
		{
			if (base.SelectedItem != null && base.SelectedItem.AllowClose)
			{
				return base.SelectedItem.ShowCloseButton;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool CanShowRestoreButtonForSelectedItem()
		{
			if (base.SelectedItem is DocumentPanel)
			{
				return ((DocumentPanel)base.SelectedItem).ShowRestoreButton;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool CoerceDestroyOnClosingChildren(bool value)
		{
			return IsTabbed && value;
		}

		protected override bool CoerceIsCloseButtonVisible(bool value)
		{
			if (IsTabbed)
			{
				switch (ClosePageButtonShowMode)
				{
				case ClosePageButtonShowMode.InAllTabPageHeaders:
				case ClosePageButtonShowMode.InActiveTabPageHeader:
				case ClosePageButtonShowMode.NoWhere:
					return false;
				default:
					return CanShowCloseButtonForSelectedItem();
				}
			}
			if (ContainsMaximizedDocument())
			{
				return CanShowCloseButtonForSelectedItem();
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool CoerceIsDropDownButtonVisible(bool visible)
		{
			if (HasTabHeader() && base.Items.Count > 0)
			{
				return ShowDropDownButton;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool CoerceIsRestoreButtonVisible(bool visible)
		{
			if (!IsTabbed && ContainsMaximizedDocument() && CanShowRestoreButtonForSelectedItem())
			{
				return ShowRestoreButton;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override TabHeaderLayoutType CoerceTabHeaderLayoutType(TabHeaderLayoutType value)
		{
			if (value != TabHeaderLayoutType.Default)
			{
				return value;
			}
			return TabHeaderLayoutType.Scroll;
		}

		protected override LayoutGroup GetContainerHost(BaseLayoutItem container)
		{
			LayoutGroup layoutGroup = null;
			if (!base.HasNotCollapsedItems && base.Parent != null && base.Parent.Items.IsDocumentHost(ignoreLayoutPanels: true))
			{
				BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = (from item in base.Parent.GetNestedItems()
					where item is LayoutPanel && item.Parent is DocumentGroup
					orderby ((LayoutPanel)item).LastActivationDateTime
					select item).LastOrDefault();
				if (baseLayoutItem != null && baseLayoutItem.Parent is DocumentGroup { IsAutoGenerated: not false })
				{
					layoutGroup = baseLayoutItem.Parent;
				}
			}
			return layoutGroup ?? this;
		}

		protected override LayoutItemType GetLayoutItemTypeCore()
		{
			return LayoutItemType.DocumentPanelGroup;
		}

		protected override bool HasTabHeader()
		{
			return IsTabbed;
		}

		protected override bool IsItemItsOwnContainer(object item)
		{
			return item is LayoutPanel;
		}

		protected virtual void OnClosePageButtonShowModeChanged(ClosePageButtonShowMode style)
		{
			OnLayoutChanged();
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in base.Items)
			{
				item.CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsCloseButtonVisibleProperty);
			}
		}

		protected override void BeforeItemRemoved(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (MDIStyle == MDIStyle.MDI)
			{
				BaseLayoutItem[] array = base.Items.OrderBy((BaseLayoutItem x) => x.ZIndex).ToArray();
				item.TabIndexBeforeRemove = Array.IndexOf(array, item);
			}
			else
			{
				base.BeforeItemRemoved(item);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnIsMaximizedChanged(bool maximized)
		{
			CoerceValue(LayoutGroup.SelectedItemProperty);
		}

		protected virtual void OnMDIStyleChanged(MDIStyle style)
		{
			CoerceValue(LayoutGroup.DestroyOnClosingChildrenProperty);
			CoerceValue(LayoutGroup.SelectedItemProperty);
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in base.Items)
			{
				item.CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsTabPageProperty);
			}
			if (IsTabbed)
			{
				DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = this.FindDockLayoutManager();
				if (dockLayoutManager != null && dockLayoutManager.ActiveMDIItem != null)
				{
					if (base.Items.Contains(dockLayoutManager.ActiveMDIItem))
					{
						dockLayoutManager.ActiveMDIItem = null;
					}
					if (base.Items.Contains(dockLayoutManager.ActiveDockItem))
					{
						dockLayoutManager.ActiveDockItem = null;
					}
				}
			}
			OnLayoutChanged();
			this.Update();
		}

		protected override void OnParentChanged()
		{
			base.OnParentChanged();
			base.Parent.Do(delegate(LayoutGroup x)
			{
				x.CoerceValue(LayoutGroup.HasNotCollapsedItemsProperty);
			});
		}

		protected override void OnSelectedItemChanged(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem oldItem)
		{
			base.OnSelectedItemChanged(item, oldItem);
			CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsRestoreButtonVisibleProperty);
			if (ContainsMaximizedDocument() && item != null && !item.AllowMaximize)
			{
				MDIControllerHelper.Restore(item);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnShowEmptyChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			base.Parent.Do(delegate(LayoutGroup x)
			{
				x.CoerceValue(LayoutGroup.HasNotCollapsedItemsProperty);
			});
		}

		private bool ContainsMaximizedDocument()
		{
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in base.Items)
			{
				if (MDIStateHelper.GetMDIState(item) == MDIState.Maximized)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override int GetNextTabIndex(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (MDIStyle == MDIStyle.MDI)
			{
				return TabIndexFromItem(GetNextTabItem(base.Items.ToArray(), item));
			}
			return base.GetNextTabIndex(item);
		}

		private BaseLayoutItem GetNextTabItem(BaseLayoutItem[] items, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			items = (from x in items.Concat(item.Yield())
				orderby x.ZIndex
				select x).ToArray();
			int num = Array.IndexOf(items, item) - 1;
			if (!items.IsValidIndex(num))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return items[num];
		}
	}
	public abstract class FixedItem : BaseLayoutItem, IUIElement
	{
		static FixedItem()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<FixedItem> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<FixedItem>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata(BaseLayoutItem.AllowFloatProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata(BaseLayoutItem.AllowDockProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata(BaseLayoutItem.AllowCloseProperty, defValue: false);
		}

		public FixedItem()
		{
		}

		internal override UIChildren CreateUIChildren()
		{
			return new EmptyUIChildrenCollection();
		}
	}
	[Browsable(false)]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public static class FixedItemFactory
	{
		public static FixedItem CreateFixedItem(LayoutItemType type)
		{
			FixedItem fixedItem = null;
			switch (type)
			{
			case LayoutItemType.EmptySpaceItem:
				fixedItem = new EmptySpaceItem();
				fixedItem.Caption = DockingLocalizer.GetString(DockingStringId.DefaultEmptySpaceContent);
				break;
			case LayoutItemType.Label:
				fixedItem = new LabelItem();
				fixedItem.Caption = DockingLocalizer.GetString(DockingStringId.DefaultLabelContent);
				break;
			case LayoutItemType.Separator:
				fixedItem = new SeparatorItem();
				fixedItem.Caption = DockingLocalizer.GetString(DockingStringId.DefaultSeparatorContent);
				break;
			case LayoutItemType.LayoutSplitter:
				fixedItem = new LayoutSplitter();
				fixedItem.Caption = DockingLocalizer.GetString(DockingStringId.DefaultSplitterContent);
				break;
			default:
				return null;
			}
			((ISupportInitialize)fixedItem).BeginInit();
			((ISupportInitialize)fixedItem).EndInit();
			return fixedItem;
		}

		public static FixedItem CreateFixedItem(FixedItem item)
		{
			return CreateFixedItem(item.ItemType);
		}
	}

		static FloatGroup()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<FloatGroup> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<FloatGroup>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<FloatGroup>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata(BaseLayoutItem.AllowSelectionProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("IsOpen", ref IsOpenProperty, defValue: true, null, CoerceIsOpen);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("FloatLocation", ref FloatLocationProperty, new Point(0.0, 0.0), OnFloatLocationChanged);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("BorderStyle", ref BorderStylePropertyKey, ref BorderStyleProperty, FloatGroupBorderStyle.Empty, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((FloatGroup)dObj).OnBorderStyleChanged();
			}, (DependencyObject dObj, object value) => ((FloatGroup)dObj).CoerceBorderStyle((FloatGroupBorderStyle)value));
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("IsMaximized", ref IsMaximizedPropertyKey, ref IsMaximizedProperty, defValue: false, null, (DependencyObject dObj, object value) => ((FloatGroup)dObj).CoerceIsMaximized((bool)value));
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttached("FloatState", ref FloatStateProperty, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.BindsTwoWayByDefault, FloatState.Normal, OnFloatStateChanged, CoerceFloatState);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ActualVisibility", ref ActualVisibilityProperty, Visibility.Visible, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((FloatGroup)dObj).OnActualVisibilityChanged((Visibility)e.OldValue, (Visibility)e.NewValue);
			}, (DependencyObject dObj, object value) => ((FloatGroup)dObj).CoerceActualVisibility((Visibility)value));
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("IsActuallyVisible", ref IsActuallyVisiblePropertyKey, ref IsActuallyVisibleProperty, defValue: true);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("CanMaximize", ref CanMaximizePropertyKey, ref CanMaximizeProperty, defValue: true, null, (DependencyObject dObj, object value) => ((FloatGroup)dObj).CoerceCanMaximize((bool)value));
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("CanMinimize", ref CanMinimizePropertyKey, ref CanMinimizeProperty, defValue: true, null, (DependencyObject dObj, object value) => ((FloatGroup)dObj).CoerceCanMinimize((bool)value));
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttached("SizeToContent", ref SizeToContentProperty, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.BindsTwoWayByDefault, SizeToContent.Manual, OnSizeToContentChanged, CoerceSizeToContent);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<Style>("WindowStyle", ref WindowStyleProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((FloatGroup)dObj).OnWindowStyleChanged((Style)e.NewValue);
			});
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<FloatGroup>.New().RegisterAttached<DependencyObject, ImageSource>("GetWindowTaskbarIcon", ref WindowTaskbarIconProperty, (ImageSource)null, (Action<DependencyObject, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				OnWindowTaskbarIconChanged(d, e);
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null).RegisterAttached<DependencyObject, string>("GetWindowTaskbarTitle", ref WindowTaskbarTitleProperty, string.Empty, (Action<DependencyObject, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				OnWindowTaskbarTitleChanged(d, e);
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<ImageSource>("ActualWindowTaskbarIcon", ref ActualWindowTaskbarIconProperty, (ImageSource)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<string>("ActualWindowTaskbarTitle", ref ActualWindowTaskbarTitleProperty, string.Empty, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedProperty(FloatStateProperty);
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedPropertyType(FloatStateProperty);
		}

			target.SetValue(SizeToContentProperty, value);
		}

		private static void OnSizeToContentChanged(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (dObj is FloatGroup floatGroup)
			{
				floatGroup.OnSizeToContentChanged((SizeToContent)e.OldValue, (SizeToContent)e.NewValue);
				return;
			}
			(dObj as BaseLayoutItem).Do(delegate(BaseLayoutItem x)
			{
				x.UpdateSizeToContent();
			});
		}

		private static object CoerceSizeToContent(DependencyObject dObj, object baseValue)
		{
			if (!(dObj is FloatGroup floatGroup))
			{
				return baseValue;
			}
			return floatGroup.CoerceSizeToContent((SizeToContent)baseValue);
		}

		{
			target.SetValue(FloatStateProperty, value);

		{
			if (dObj is FloatGroup floatGroup)
			{
				floatGroup.OnFloatStateChanged((FloatState)e.OldValue, (FloatState)e.NewValue);
				return;
			}
			(dObj as BaseLayoutItem).Do(delegate(BaseLayoutItem x)
			{
				x.UpdateFloatState();
			});
		}

		private static object CoerceFloatState(DependencyObject dObj, object baseValue)
		{
			if (!(dObj is FloatGroup floatGroup))
			{
				return baseValue;
			}
			return floatGroup.CoerceFloatState((FloatState)baseValue);
		}

		{
			if (!(dObj is FloatGroup floatGroup))

				return baseValue;
			}
			return floatGroup.CoerceIsOpen((bool)baseValue);
		}

		internal override bool AllowSerializeProperty(AllowPropertyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (((PropertyEventArgs)e).Property.Name != "SerializableIsMaximized")
			{
				return base.AllowSerializeProperty(e);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override void ApplySerializationInfo()
		{
			base.ApplySerializationInfo();
			_PreviousFloatState = FloatGroupSerializationInfo.PreviousFloatState;
			FloatState = FloatGroupSerializationInfo.FloatState;
			Rect windowRestoreBounds = FloatGroupSerializationInfo.WindowRestoreBounds;
			if (!windowRestoreBounds.IsEmpty && windowRestoreBounds.Size != default(Size) && FloatGroupSerializationInfo.FloatState == FloatState.Normal)
			{
				FloatLocation = windowRestoreBounds.Location;
				base.FloatSize = windowRestoreBounds.Size;
				FloatOffsetBeforeClose = FloatGroupSerializationInfo.FloatOffsetBeforeClose;
			}
		}

		internal void CheckFloatState()
		{
			if (base.Manager != null && ScreenHelper.IsAttachedToPresentationSource((FrameworkElement)base.Manager) && Locker.op_Implicit(checkFloatStateLocker))
			{
				checkFloatStateLocker.Unlock();
				if (_PreviousFloatState != FloatState)
				{
					OnFloatStateChangedCore(_PreviousFloatState, FloatState);
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void CollectSerializationInfo()
		{
			base.CollectSerializationInfo();
			FloatGroupSerializationInfo.FloatState = FloatState;
			FloatGroupSerializationInfo.PreviousFloatState = _PreviousFloatState;
			FloatGroupSerializationInfo.WindowRestoreBounds = ((Window != null) ? Window.RestoreBoundsToFloatBounds() : Rect.Empty);
			FloatGroupSerializationInfo.FloatOffsetBeforeClose = FloatOffsetBeforeClose;
		}

		internal void DisableSizeToContent()
		{
			if (SizeToContent != SizeToContent.Manual)
			{
				SetCurrentValue(SizeToContentProperty, SizeToContent.Manual);
			}
		}

		internal void EnsureActualVisibility()
		{
			CoerceValue(ActualVisibilityProperty);
		}

		internal void EnsureFloatLocation(Point floatLocation)
		{
			Point point = new Point(FloatLocation.X - floatLocation.X, FloatLocation.Y - floatLocation.Y);
			if (IsMaximized || (IsMinimized && _PreviousFloatState != FloatState.Maximized))
			{
				Rect restoreBounds = DocumentPanel.GetRestoreBounds(this);
				Point location = restoreBounds.Location;
				restoreBounds.Location = new Point(location.X - point.X, location.Y - point.Y);
				DocumentPanel.SetRestoreBounds(this, restoreBounds);
			}
			FloatLocation = floatLocation;
		}

		internal void EnsureFloatLocation(Point prevOffset, Point newOffset)
		{
			int num = ((base.FlowDirection != FlowDirection.RightToLeft) ? 1 : (-1));
			EnsureFloatLocation(new Point(FloatLocation.X - (double)num * (newOffset.X - prevOffset.X), FloatLocation.Y - (newOffset.Y - prevOffset.Y)));
		}

		internal void FitSizeToContent(Size screenSize)
		{
			base.FloatSize = SizeToContentHelper.FitSizeToContent(SizeToContent, base.FloatSize, screenSize);
		}

		internal void OnOwnerCollectionChanged()
		{
			OnParentChanged();
			if (base.Manager != null)
			{
				if (base.Manager.FloatGroups.Contains(this))
				{
					DockLayoutManager.AddLogicalChild(base.Manager, this);
				}
				else if (!base.LogicalTreeLockHelper)
				{
					DockLayoutManager.RemoveLogicalChild(base.Manager, this);
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void PrepareForModification(bool isDeserializing)
		{
			base.PrepareForModification(isDeserializing);
			if (isDeserializing)
			{
				LockInheritableProperties();
				base.Manager = null;
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(UnlockInheritableProperties), DispatcherPriority.Loaded);
			}
		}

		internal bool RequestFloatingBoundsUpdate()
		{
			FloatingWindowPresenter element = base.UIElements.GetElement<FloatingWindowPresenter>();
			bool flag = element != null && element.Window != null;
			if (flag)
			{
				element.Window.UpdateFloatGroupBounds();
			}
			return flag;
		}

		internal override void SetFloatState(FloatState state)
		{
			if (FloatState != state)
			{
				FloatState = ((state != FloatState.Normal) ? state : ((_PreviousFloatState == FloatState.Maximized) ? FloatState.Maximized : FloatState.Normal));
			}
		}

		internal bool TryGetActualAutoSize(out Size autoSize)
		{
			autoSize = default(Size);
			FloatPanePresenter uIElement = GetUIElement<FloatPanePresenter>();
			if (SizeToContent == SizeToContent.Manual || FloatState != FloatState.Normal || uIElement == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return uIElement.TryGetActualRenderSize(out autoSize);
		}

		internal void UpdateAutoFloatingSize(Size floatSize)

				{
					base.FloatSize = floatSize;
				}
				finally
				{
					((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal void ResetMaximized()
		{
			if (base.Items.Count == 1 && base.Items[0] is DocumentPanel)
			{
				DocumentPanel.SetRestoreBounds(this, default(Rect));
				MDIStateHelper.SetMDIState(base.Items[0], MDIState.Normal);
				CoerceValue(IsMaximizedProperty);
			}
		}

		protected internal void ResetMaximized(Point location)
		{
			if (IsMaximized)
			{
				Rect restoreBounds = DocumentPanel.GetRestoreBounds(this);
				DocumentPanel.SetRestoreBounds(this, new Rect(new Point(location.X - 15.0, location.Y - 15.0), MathHelper.IsEmpty(RectHelper.Size(restoreBounds)) ? base.FloatSize : RectHelper.Size(restoreBounds)));
				if (base.Items.Count == 1 && base.Items[0] is DocumentPanel)
				{
					MDIStateHelper.SetMDIState(base.Items[0], MDIState.Normal);
				}
				using (Window.With((FloatingPaneWindow x) => x.LockHelper.Lock(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.ResetMaximized)))
				{
					SetFloatState(FloatState.Normal);
				}
				CoerceValue(IsMaximizedProperty);
				this.Update();
			}
			else
			{
				ResetMaximized();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateFloatState()
		{
			if (base.HasSingleItem && (GetFloatState(base.Items[0]) != FloatState.Normal || !Locker.op_Implicit(floatStateLocker)))
			{
				FloatState = GetFloatState(base.Items[0]);
			}
			else
			{
				CoerceValue(FloatStateProperty);
			}
		}

		protected internal void UpdateMaximizedBounds()
		{
			if (IsMaximized)
			{
				Rect rect = CalcMaximizedBounds(DocumentPanel.GetRestoreBounds(this));
				FloatLocation = new Point(rect.X, rect.Y);
				base.FloatSize = new Size(rect.Width, rect.Height);
			}
		}

			}
		}

		protected virtual Visibility CoerceActualVisibility(Visibility visibility)
		{
			//IL_005d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = base.Manager ?? (base.ManagerReference.Return((WeakReference x) => x.Target, () => (object)null) as DockLayoutManager);
			if (dockLayoutManager != null && (((int)dockLayoutManager.GetRealFloatingMode() == 0 && FloatState == FloatState.Minimized) || (!dockLayoutManager.IsVisible && !dockLayoutManager.CanShowFloatGroup)))
			{
				return Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			if (!HasItems || !base.HasVisibleItems || !base.HasNotCollapsedItems)
			{
				return Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			return base.Visibility;
		}

		{

		protected override void OnFloatSizeChanged(Size oldValue, Size newValue)
		{
			base.OnFloatSizeChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			if (!Locker.op_Implicit(AutoSizeLocker) && SizeToContent != SizeToContent.Manual && !FloatingWindowLock.Return((FloatingWindowLock x) => x.IsLocked(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.FloatingBounds), () => false) && (SizeToContent == SizeToContent.WidthAndHeight || (oldValue.Width != newValue.Width && SizeToContent == SizeToContent.Width) || (oldValue.Height != newValue.Height && SizeToContent == SizeToContent.Height)))
			{
				DisableSizeToContent();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnFloatStateChanged(FloatState oldState, FloatState newState)
		{
			DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = base.Manager ?? (base.ManagerReference.Return((WeakReference x) => x.Target, () => (object)null) as DockLayoutManager);
			bool flag = dockLayoutManager?.SerializationController.IsDeserializing ?? false;
			if (!Locker.op_Implicit(checkFloatStateLocker) && !flag)
			{
				_PreviousFloatState = oldState;
			}
			if (newState == FloatState.Maximized)
			{
				DisableSizeToContent();
			}
			SetValue(IsMaximizedPropertyKey, newState == FloatState.Maximized);
			UpdateSingleItemState();
			if (!FloatStateLockHelper.IsLocked)
			{
				if (dockLayoutManager == null || !ScreenHelper.IsAttachedToPresentationSource((FrameworkElement)dockLayoutManager))
				{
					checkFloatStateLocker.LockOnce();
				}
				else
				{
					OnFloatStateChangedCore(oldState, newState);
				}
			}
			if (oldState == FloatState.Minimized)
			{
				OnLayoutChanged();
			}
		}

			CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsMaximizeButtonVisibleProperty);
			UpdateWindowTaskbarIcon();
			UpdateWindowTaskbarTitle();
			UpdateSizeToContent();
			Locker val = floatStateLocker.Lock();
			try
			{
				UpdateFloatState();
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private Rect CalcMaximizedBounds(DockLayoutManager manager, Rect restoreBounds)
		{
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			Rect maximizeBounds = WindowHelper.GetMaximizeBounds(manager, restoreBounds);
			if (manager != null && manager.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft && (int)manager.GetRealFloatingMode() == 1)
			{
				maximizeBounds.X = 0.0 - maximizeBounds.X - maximizeBounds.Width;
			}
			return maximizeBounds;
		}

		private Size CalcMinSizeWithBorderMargin(Size minSize)
		{
			if (BorderStyle == FloatGroupBorderStyle.Single)
			{
				return new Size(minSize.Width + 14.0, minSize.Height + 14.0);
			}
			return new Size(minSize.Width + 22.0, minSize.Height + 31.0);
		}

		private void OnFloatStateChangedCore(FloatState oldState, FloatState newState)
		{
			DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = base.Manager ?? (base.ManagerReference.Return((WeakReference x) => x.Target, () => (object)null) as DockLayoutManager);
			if (dockLayoutManager == null || !ScreenHelper.IsAttachedToPresentationSource((FrameworkElement)dockLayoutManager))
			{
				return;
			}
			CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsMaximizeButtonVisibleProperty);
			CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsMinimizeButtonVisibleProperty);
			CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsRestoreButtonVisibleProperty);
			Rect restoreBounds = DocumentPanel.GetRestoreBounds(this);
			if (oldState == FloatState.Minimized)
			{
				UpdateAutoFloatingSize(restoreBounds.Size);
				FloatLocation = RectHelper.Location(restoreBounds);
				if (dockLayoutManager.MinimizedItems.Contains(this))
				{
					dockLayoutManager.MinimizedItems.Remove(this);
				}
			}
			Rect rect = ((restoreBounds == default(Rect)) ? new Rect(FloatLocation, base.FloatSize) : restoreBounds);
			switch (newState)
			{
			case FloatState.Minimized:
				DocumentPanel.SetRestoreBounds(this, rect);
				dockLayoutManager.MinimizedItems.Add(this);
				break;
			case FloatState.Maximized:
				restoreBounds = CalcMaximizedBounds(dockLayoutManager, rect);
				DocumentPanel.SetRestoreBounds(this, rect);
				FloatLocation = restoreBounds.Location;
				base.FloatSize = restoreBounds.Size;
				break;
			case FloatState.Normal:
				DocumentPanel.SetRestoreBounds(this, default(Rect));
				FloatLocation = restoreBounds.Location;
				UpdateAutoFloatingSize(restoreBounds.Size);
				break;
			}
			EnsureActualVisibility();
		}

		private void OnFloatStateUnlock()
		{
			if (IsMaximized)
			{
				OnFloatStateChangedCore(FloatState.Normal, FloatState);
			}
		}

		private void SetSerializableIsMaximized()
		{
			DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = base.Manager ?? (base.ManagerReference.Return((WeakReference x) => x.Target, () => (object)null) as DockLayoutManager);
			if (dockLayoutManager != null && !dockLayoutManager.IsDisposing)
			{
				if (_SerializableIsMaximized)
				{
					dockLayoutManager.MDIController.Maximize(this);
				}
				else
				{
					dockLayoutManager.MDIController.Restore(this);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSingleItemState()
		{
			if (base.IsDeserializing)
			{
				UpdateHasSingleItemProperty();
			}
			if (base.HasSingleItem)
			{
				base.Items[0].SetFloatState(FloatState);
				(base.Items[0] as LayoutPanel).Do(delegate(LayoutPanel x)
				{
					x.SetCurrentValue(FloatStateProperty, FloatState);
				});
			}
		}

		internal void RaiseWindowLoaded()
		{
			this.WindowLoaded?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		void IClosable.OnClosed()
		{
			OnClosed();
		}

		bool IClosable.CanClose()
		{
			CancelEventArgs e = new CancelEventArgs();
			OnClosing(e);
			return !e.Cancel;
		}
	}

		static LayoutControlItem()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<LayoutControlItem> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<LayoutControlItem>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata(BaseLayoutItem.AllowFloatProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata(BaseLayoutItem.AllowDockProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata(BaseLayoutItem.AllowCloseProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata(BaseLayoutItem.ItemHeightProperty, new GridLength(1.0, GridUnitType.Auto));
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata(ContentItem.ActivateOnFocusingProperty, ActivateOnFocusing.Logical);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly<UIElement>("Control", ref ControlPropertyKey, ref ControlProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((LayoutControlItem)dObj).OnControlChanged((UIElement)e.NewValue, (UIElement)e.OldValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ShowControl", ref ShowControlProperty, defValue: true, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((LayoutControlItem)dObj).OnShowControlChanged((bool)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("HasControl", ref HasControlPropertyKey, ref HasControlProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("CaptionToControlDistance", ref CaptionToControlDistanceProperty, double.NaN, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((LayoutControlItem)dObj).OnCaptionToControlDistanceChanged((double)e.NewValue);
			}, (DependencyObject dObj, object value) => ((LayoutControlItem)dObj).CoerceCaptionToControlDistance((double)value));
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("DesiredSizeInternal", ref DesiredSizeInternalProperty, Size.Empty, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((LayoutControlItem)dObj).OnDesiredSizeChanged((Size)e.NewValue);
			}, (DependencyObject dObj, object value) => ((LayoutControlItem)dObj).CoerceDesiredSize((Size)value));
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("HasDesiredSize", ref HasDesiredSizePropertyKey, ref HasDesiredSizeProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("ActualCaptionMargin", ref ActualCaptionMarginPropertyKey, ref ActualCaptionMarginProperty, new Thickness(double.NaN), null, (DependencyObject dObj, object value) => ((LayoutControlItem)dObj).CoerceActualCaptionMargin((Thickness)value));
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ControlHorizontalAlignment", ref ControlHorizontalAlignmentProperty, HorizontalAlignment.Stretch);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ControlVerticalAlignment", ref ControlVerticalAlignmentProperty, VerticalAlignment.Stretch);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("HasVisibleCaption", ref HasVisibleCaptionProperty, defValue: false, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((LayoutControlItem)dObj).OnHasVisibleCaptionChanged((bool)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly<UIElement>("ContentPresenter", ref ContentPresenterPropertyKey, ref ContentPresenterProperty);
		}

		public LayoutControlItem()
		{
			if (!base.IsInDesignTime)
			{
				CoerceValue(CaptionToControlDistanceProperty);
			}
			CoerceValue(ActualCaptionMarginProperty);
			Presenter = CreatePresenter();
		}

		internal override void Control_GotFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.Manager != null && !base.IsActive)
			{
				ActivateItemCore();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void OnParentItemsChanged()
		{
			base.OnParentItemsChanged();
			CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.ActualCaptionWidthProperty);
		}

		protected virtual void ActivateItemCore()
		{
			if (!base.Manager.IsDisposing)
			{
				base.Manager.LayoutController.Activate(this, setFocus: false);
			}
		}

		protected override Size CalcMinSizeValue(Size value)
		{
			if (SizeHelper.IsZero(value) && HasDesiredSize && DesiredSizeHelper.CanUseDesiredSizeAsMinSize(Control))
			{
				return MathHelper.MeasureMinSize(new Size[2] { DesiredSizeInternal, value });
			}
			return base.CalcMinSizeValue(value);
		}

		protected virtual void CheckContent(object content)
		{
			if (content is UIElement)
			{
				SetValue(ControlPropertyKey, content);
			}
			else
			{
				SetValue(ContentItem.IsDataBoundPropertyKey, content != null);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ClearContent(object oldContent)
		{
			ClearValue(ControlPropertyKey);
			ClearValue(ContentItem.IsDataBoundPropertyKey);
		}

		protected virtual Thickness CoerceActualCaptionMargin(Thickness value)
		{
			if (!HasVisibleCaption)
			{
				return default(Thickness);
			}
			if (!MathHelper.AreEqual(value, new Thickness(double.NaN)))
			{
				return value;
			}
			double num = (double.IsNaN(CaptionToControlDistance) ? 0.0 : CaptionToControlDistance);
			return base.CaptionLocation switch
			{
				CaptionLocation.Top => new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, num), 
				CaptionLocation.Right => new Thickness(num, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0), 
				CaptionLocation.Bottom => new Thickness(0.0, num, 0.0, 0.0), 
				_ => new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, num, 0.0), 
			};
		}

		protected override double CoerceActualCaptionWidth(double value)
		{
			if (!base.HasDesiredCaptionWidth)
			{
				return value;
			}
			return CaptionAlignHelper.GetActualCaptionWidth(this);
		}

		protected override string CoerceCaptionFormat(string captionFormat)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(captionFormat))
			{
				return captionFormat;
			}
			return DockLayoutManagerParameters.LayoutControlItemCaptionFormat;
		}

		protected virtual double CoerceCaptionToControlDistance(double value)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return base.CaptionLocation switch
			{
				CaptionLocation.Top => DockLayoutManagerParameters.CaptionToControlDistanceTop, 
				CaptionLocation.Right => DockLayoutManagerParameters.CaptionToControlDistanceRight, 
				CaptionLocation.Bottom => DockLayoutManagerParameters.CaptionToControlDistanceBottom, 
				_ => DockLayoutManagerParameters.CaptionToControlDistanceLeft, 
			};
		}

		protected virtual object CoerceDesiredSize(Size value)
		{
			if (HasDesiredSize)
			{
				return desiredSizeCore;
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected virtual ContentPresenter CreatePresenter()
		{
			ContentPresenter contentPresenter = new ContentPresenter();
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(contentPresenter, System.Windows.Controls.ContentPresenter.ContentTemplateProperty, this, ContentItem.ContentTemplateProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(contentPresenter, System.Windows.Controls.ContentPresenter.ContentTemplateSelectorProperty, this, ContentItem.ContentTemplateSelectorProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(contentPresenter, FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty, this, FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(contentPresenter, System.Windows.Controls.ContentPresenter.ContentProperty, this, ContentItem.ContentProperty);
			SetValue(ContentPresenterPropertyKey, contentPresenter);
			return contentPresenter;
		}

		protected override LayoutItemType GetLayoutItemTypeCore()
		{
			return LayoutItemType.ControlItem;
		}

			CoerceValue(ActualCaptionMarginProperty);
			CaptionAlignHelper.UpdateAffectedItems(this, oldValue, value);
		}

			ClearValue(HasDesiredSizePropertyKey);
		}

		protected override void OnCaptionTemplateChanged(DataTemplate oldValue, DataTemplate newValue)

			UpdateHasVisibleCaptionProperty();
		}

			base.OnCaptionTemplateSelectorChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			UpdateHasVisibleCaptionProperty();
		}

		protected virtual void OnCaptionToControlDistanceChanged(double value)
		{
			CoerceValue(ActualCaptionMarginProperty);
		}

		protected override void OnCaptionWidthChanged(double value)
		{
			CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.ActualCaptionWidthProperty);
			CoerceValue(ActualCaptionMarginProperty);
		}

		protected override void OnContentChanged(object content, object oldContent)
		{
			base.OnContentChanged(content, oldContent);
			ClearContent(oldContent);
			CheckContent(content);
		}

		protected virtual void OnControlChanged(UIElement control, UIElement oldControl)
		{
			SetValue(HasControlPropertyKey, control != null);
			if (oldControl != null)
			{
				RemoveLogicalChild(oldControl);
				oldControl.ClearValue(DockLayoutManager.LayoutItemProperty);
			}
			if (control != null)
			{
				AddLogicalChild(control);
				control.SetValue(DockLayoutManager.LayoutItemProperty, this);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDesiredCaptionWidthChanged(double value)
		{
			base.OnDesiredCaptionWidthChanged(value);
			CaptionAlignHelper.UpdateAffectedItems(this, base.CaptionAlignMode);
		}

		protected virtual void OnDesiredSizeChanged(Size value)
		{
			SetDesiredSize(value);
			SetValue(HasDesiredSizePropertyKey, !value.IsEmpty);
			CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.ActualMinSizeProperty);
		}

		protected virtual void OnHasVisibleCaptionChanged(bool newValue)
		{
			CoerceValue(ActualCaptionMarginProperty);
		}

		protected override void OnIsDataBoundChanged(bool value)
		{
			base.OnIsDataBoundChanged(value);
			if (value)
			{
				SetValue(ControlPropertyKey, GetDataBoundContainer());
			}
		}

		protected override void OnParentChanged()
		{
			base.OnParentChanged();
			CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.ActualCaptionWidthProperty);
		}

		protected override void OnShowCaptionChanged(bool value)
		{
			base.OnShowCaptionChanged(value);
			ClearValue(DesiredSizeInternalProperty);
		}

		protected virtual void OnShowControlChanged(bool showControl)
		{
			ClearValue(DesiredSizeInternalProperty);
		}

		private void SetDesiredSize(Size value)
		{
			if (!(desiredSizeCore == value))
			{
				desiredSizeCore = value;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateHasVisibleCaptionProperty()
		{
			bool flag = base.Caption != null || base.CaptionTemplate != null || base.CaptionTemplateSelector != null || base.CaptionImage != null;
			SetValue(HasVisibleCaptionProperty, flag);
		}

		internal override UIChildren CreateUIChildren()
		{
			return new EmptyUIChildrenCollection();
		}
	}
	[ContentProperty("Items")]
	public class LayoutGroup : BaseLayoutItem, IGeneratorHost, ILogicalOwner, IInputElement, ISupportOriginalSerializableName, IItemContainer
	{
		private class DefaultTemplateSelector : DefaultItemTemplateSelectorWrapper.DefaultItemTemplateSelector
		{
			public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
			{
				GroupPaneContentPresenter groupPaneContentPresenter = container as GroupPaneContentPresenter;
				if (item is LayoutGroup layoutGroup && groupPaneContentPresenter != null && groupPaneContentPresenter.Owner != null)
				{
					switch (layoutGroup.GroupBorderStyle)
					{
					case GroupBorderStyle.Group:
						return groupPaneContentPresenter.Owner.GroupTemplate;
					case GroupBorderStyle.GroupBox:
						return groupPaneContentPresenter.Owner.GroupBoxTemplate;
					case GroupBorderStyle.NoBorder:
						return groupPaneContentPresenter.Owner.NoBorderTemplate;
					case GroupBorderStyle.Tabbed:
						return groupPaneContentPresenter.Owner.TabbedTemplate;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		private class RebuildQueryLocker : Locker
		{
			private RebuildLayoutOptions _options;

			private readonly LayoutGroup _owner;

			private int _rebuildQueryCount;

			public RebuildQueryLocker(LayoutGroup owner)
			{
				_owner = owner;
				((Locker)this).Unlocked += OnRebuildQueryLockerUnlocked;
			}

			public void QueryRebuildLayout(RebuildLayoutOptions options = RebuildLayoutOptions.None)
			{
				_options = options;
				RebuildLayoutCore();
			}

			public void RebuildLayout(RebuildLayoutOptions options = RebuildLayoutOptions.None)
			{
				if (_rebuildQueryCount > 0)
				{
					QueryRebuildLayout(options);
				}
			}

			private void OnRebuildQueryLockerUnlocked(object sender, EventArgs e)
			{
				if (_rebuildQueryCount > 0)
				{
					RebuildLayoutCore();
				}
			}

			private void RebuildLayoutCore()
			{
				_rebuildQueryCount++;
				if (((Locker)this).IsLocked || _owner.IsLogicalTreeLocked)
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					_owner.RebuildLayoutAndUpdate((_options & RebuildLayoutOptions.UpdateLayout) != 0);
				}
				finally
				{
					_options = RebuildLayoutOptions.None;
					_rebuildQueryCount = 0;
				}
			}
		}

		[Flags]
		private enum RebuildLayoutOptions
		{
			None = 0,
			UpdateLayout = 1
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public DataTemplateSelector ActualGroupTemplateSelector
		{
			get
			{
				return (DataTemplateSelector)GetValue(ActualGroupTemplateSelectorProperty);
			}
			private set

		internal bool AcceptDock
		{
			get
			{
				if (HasNotCollapsedItems)
				{
					return !Items.HasVisibleStarItems();
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal Appearance ActualItemsAppearance
		{
			get
			{
				if (actualItemsAppearance == null)
				{
					actualItemsAppearance = new Appearance();
					actualItemsAppearance.Changed += OnActualItemsAppearanceChanged;
				}
				return actualItemsAppearance;
			}
		}

		internal Appearance DefaultItemsAppearance => _DefaultItemsAppearance ?? (_DefaultItemsAppearance = new Appearance());

		internal virtual bool HasPlaceHolders
		{
			get
			{
				if (PlaceHolderHelper != null)
				{
					return PlaceHolderHelper.HasPlaceHolders;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		static LayoutGroup()
		{
			DockingStrategyRegistrator.RegisterLayoutGroupStrategy();
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<LayoutGroup> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<LayoutGroup>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<LayoutGroup>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata(BaseLayoutItem.ShowCaptionProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata(BaseLayoutItem.AllowFloatProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttached<LayoutGroup>("OwnerGroup", ref OwnerGroupProperty);

		internal static LayoutGroup GetOwnerGroup(DependencyObject target)
		{
			return (LayoutGroup)target.GetValue(OwnerGroupProperty);
		}

		internal static void SetOwnerGroup(DependencyObject target, LayoutGroup value)
		{
			target.SetValue(OwnerGroupProperty, value);
		}

		public LayoutGroup()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_004e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0058: Expected O, but got Unknown
			rebuildQueryLocker = new RebuildQueryLocker(this);
			BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, IsTouchEnabledProperty, new Binding
			{
				Path = new PropertyPath(ThemeManager.IsTouchEnabledProperty),
				Source = this
			});
			CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsCaptionVisibleProperty);
			CoerceValue(DestroyOnClosingChildrenProperty);
			CoerceValue(ActualLayoutItemIntervalProperty);
			CoerceValue(ActualLayoutGroupIntervalProperty);
			CoerceValue(ActualDockItemIntervalProperty);
			CoerceValue(AllowExpandProperty);
			if (!base.IsInDesignTime)
			{
				CoerceValue(TabHeaderLayoutTypeProperty);
			}
		}

		internal LayoutGroup(params BaseLayoutItem[] items)
			: this()
		{
			Add(items);
		}

		public override void Accept(IVisitor<BaseLayoutItem> visitor)
		{
			base.Accept(visitor);
			AcceptItems(visitor.Visit);
		}

		public override void Accept(VisitDelegate<BaseLayoutItem> visit)
		{
			base.Accept(visit);
			AcceptItems(visit);
		}

		public void Add(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			Items.Add(item);
		}

		public void Add(params BaseLayoutItem[] items)
		{
			AddRange(items);
		}

		public void AddRange(BaseLayoutItem[] items)
		{
			DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = this.GetDockLayoutManager();
			using (new UpdateBatch(dockLayoutManager))
			{
				using (SelectedTabIndexLocker.Lock())
				{
					Array.ForEach(items, Add);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void BeginInit()
		{
			base.BeginInit();
			BeginUpdate();
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			BaseLayoutItem[] array = Items.ToArray();
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				Remove(array[i]);
			}
		}

		public override void EndInit()
		{
			initilizedActionsHelper.DoDelayedActions();
			base.EndInit();
			EndUpdate();
		}

		public int GetChildrenCount()
		{
			int result = 0;
			AcceptItems(delegate
			{
				result++;
			});
			return result;
		}

		public void Insert(int index, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			Items.Insert(index, item);
		}

		public bool Remove(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			BeforeItemRemoved(item);
			return Items.Remove(item);
		}

		public bool ScrollNext()
		{
			if (!TabHeaderHasScroll)
			{
				return false;
			}
			TabHeaderScrollIndex = Math.Min(VisiblePagesCount, TabHeaderScrollIndex + 1);
			return true;
		}

		public bool ScrollPrev()
		{
			if (!TabHeaderHasScroll)
			{
				return false;
			}
			TabHeaderScrollIndex = Math.Max(-1, TabHeaderScrollIndex - 1);
			return true;
		}

		internal void AddContainer(int index, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			AddContainerCore(index, item);
		}

		internal override void ApplySerializationInfo()
		{
			base.ApplySerializationInfo();
			IsAutoGenerated = !((LayoutGroupSerializationInfo)base.SerializationInfo).IsUserDefined;
		}

		internal void BeginUpdate()
		{
			updateCount++;
		}

		internal override void CollectSerializationInfo()
		{
			base.CollectSerializationInfo();
			((LayoutGroupSerializationInfo)base.SerializationInfo).IsUserDefined = !IsAutoGenerated;
		}

		internal bool ContainsPinnedItem(LayoutPanel panel)
		{
			if (!PinnedLeftItems.Contains(panel))
			{
				return PinnedRightItems.Contains(panel);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal virtual ContentItem CreateContentItem(object content)
		{
			if (base.IsControlItemsHost)
			{
				return (base.Manager != null) ? base.Manager.CreateLayoutControlItem() : new LayoutControlItem();
			}
			return (base.Manager != null) ? base.Manager.CreateLayoutPanel() : new LayoutPanel();
		}

		internal void EndUpdate()
		{
			updateCount--;
		}

		internal void EnsureTabHeaderScrollIndex(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				if (!item.IsPinnedTab)
				{
					TabHeaderScrollIndex = Items.Where((BaseLayoutItem x) => !x.IsPinnedTab).ToList().IndexOf(item);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				TabHeaderScrollIndex = -1;
			}
		}

		internal override bool GetAllowDockToCurrentItem()
		{
			if (base.GetAllowDockToCurrentItem())
			{
				return SelectedItem.Return((BaseLayoutItem x) => x.GetAllowDockToCurrentItem(), () => true);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal int IndexFromItem(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			return Items.IndexOf(item);
		}

		internal void InvalidateActualItemsAppearance()
		{
			LockItemsAppearanceUpdate();
			AppearanceHelper.UpdateAppearance(ActualItemsAppearance, (base.Parent != null) ? base.Parent.ItemsAppearance : null, ItemsAppearance);
			UnlockItemsAppearanceUpdate();
		}

		internal BaseLayoutItem ItemFromIndex(int index)
		{
			if (!IsValid(index))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Items[index];
		}

		internal BaseLayoutItem ItemFromTabIndex(int tabIndex)
		{
			if (!IsValid(tabIndex))
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<BaseLayoutItem> list = PinnedLeftItems.Concat(Items.Where((BaseLayoutItem x) => !x.IsPinnedTab)).Concat(PinnedRightItems).ToList();
			return list[tabIndex];
		}

		internal virtual IDisposable LockVisualTree()
		{
			return null;
		}

		internal bool MoveItem(int index, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item is LayoutPanel { IsPinnedTab: not false } layoutPanel)
			{
				LayoutPanel layoutPanel2 = ItemFromIndex(index) as LayoutPanel;
				if (layoutPanel2 != null && layoutPanel2.IsPinnedTab && layoutPanel2.TabPinLocation == layoutPanel.TabPinLocation)
				{
					return MovePinnedPanel(index, layoutPanel);
				}
				layoutPanel.ToggleTabPinStatus();
				index = ((layoutPanel2 != null) ? IndexFromItem(layoutPanel2) : (Items.Count - 1));
			}
			int num = Items.IndexOf(item);
			if (num != index && Items.Count > 1)
			{
				if (index == Items.Count)
				{
					index = Items.Count - 1;
				}
				Items.Move(num, index);
				PlaceHolderHelper.MoveItem(index, item);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void MoveItemsTo(LayoutGroup group)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem[] items = this.GetItems();
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in items)
			{
				Items.Remove(item);
				group.Items.Add(item);
			}
			PlaceHolderHelper.MoveItemsTo(group);
		}

		internal override void OnDockLayoutManagerCoreChanged(DockLayoutManager oldValue, DockLayoutManager newValue)
		{
			base.OnDockLayoutManagerCoreChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			SyncLogicalTreeWithManager(oldValue, newValue);
			Items.ToList().ForEach(delegate(BaseLayoutItem x)
			{
				x.DockLayoutManagerCore = newValue;
			});
		}

		internal override void OnIsCustomizationChanged(bool isCustomization)
		{
			base.OnIsCustomizationChanged(isCustomization);
			if (!base.IsInDesignTime)
			{
				CoerceValue(AllowSplittersProperty);
			}
		}

		internal void OnItemPinStatusChanged(LayoutPanel panel)
		{
			if (panel.Pinned)
			{
				AddToPinned(panel);
				return;
			}
			RemoveFromPinned(panel);
			if (Items.Contains(panel))
			{
				Items.Move(Items.IndexOf(panel), (panel.TabPinLocation == TabHeaderPinLocation.Far) ? (Items.Count - 1) : 0);
			}
		}

		internal override void OnUIChildrenCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnUIChildrenCollectionChanged(sender, e);
			if (base.IsSelectedItem || this.GetRoot().ParentPanel.Return((LayoutPanel x) => x.IsSelectedItem, () => false))
			{
				base.Manager.Do(delegate(DockLayoutManager x)
				{
					x.InvalidateView(this);
				});
			}
		}

		internal void PrepareContainerForItemCore(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item.CaptionTemplate == null && ItemCaptionTemplate != null)
			{
				item.CaptionTemplate = ItemCaptionTemplate;
			}
			if (item.CaptionTemplateSelector == null && ItemCaptionTemplateSelector != null)
			{
				item.CaptionTemplateSelector = ItemCaptionTemplateSelector;
			}
			if (item is ContentItem contentItem)
			{
				if (contentItem.ContentTemplate == null && ItemContentTemplate != null)
				{
					contentItem.ContentTemplate = ItemContentTemplate;
				}
				if (contentItem.ContentTemplateSelector == null && ItemContentTemplateSelector != null)
				{
					contentItem.ContentTemplateSelector = ItemContentTemplateSelector;
				}
			}
			if (ItemStyle != null)
			{
				item.Style = ItemStyle;
			}
		}

		internal override void PrepareForModification(bool isDeserializing)
		{
			base.PrepareForModification(isDeserializing);
			if (base.IsTemplateApplied && !EnvironmentHelper.IsNet45OrNewer)
			{
				RemoveLogicalChildren(Items);
			}
		}

		internal void SetSelection(BaseLayoutItem item, bool selected)
		{
			if (selected)
			{
				int num = Items.IndexOf(item);
				if (SelectedTabIndex != num)
				{
					SetCurrentValue(SelectedTabIndexProperty, Items.IndexOf(item));
				}
			}
			else if (SelectedItem == item)
			{
				Locker val = setSelectionLocker.Lock();
				try
				{
					CoerceValue(SelectedTabIndexProperty);
				}
				finally
				{
					((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SyncLogicalTreeWithManager(DockLayoutManager oldValue, DockLayoutManager newValue)
		{
			using (SuspendLayoutChange())
			{
				if (oldValue != null && oldValue.OptimizedLogicalTree)
				{
					Items.ToList().ForEach(delegate(BaseLayoutItem x)
					{
						DockLayoutManager.RemoveLogicalChild(oldValue, x);
					});
				}
				if (newValue != null && newValue.OptimizedLogicalTree)
				{
					Items.ToList().ForEach(delegate(BaseLayoutItem x)
					{
						if (x.SupportsOptimizedLogicalTree)
						{
							RemoveLogicalChild(x);
							DockLayoutManager.AddLogicalChild(newValue, x);
						}
					});
				}
				else
				{
					AddLogicalChildren(Items);
				}
			}
		}

		internal int TabIndexFromItem(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (!Items.Contains(item))
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (item is LayoutPanel { IsPinnedTab: not false } layoutPanel)
			{
				if (layoutPanel.TabPinLocation == TabHeaderPinLocation.Far)
				{
					return Items.Count((BaseLayoutItem x) => !x.IsPinnedTab) + PinnedLeftItems.Count + PinnedRightItems.IndexOf(layoutPanel);
				}
				return PinnedLeftItems.IndexOf(layoutPanel);
			}
			return Items.Where((BaseLayoutItem x) => !x.IsPinnedTab).ToList().IndexOf(item) + PinnedLeftItems.Count;
		}

		protected internal virtual void AddContainer(ContentItem item)
		{
			AddContainerCore(item);
		}

		protected internal virtual void AddContainer(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			AddContainerCore(item);
		}

		protected internal virtual void AfterItemAdded(int index, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item.LogicalParent == null)
			{
				AddLogicalChild(item);
			}
			PlaceHolderHelper.InsertItem(index, item);
			UpdateIsTouchEnabled(item, IsTouchEnabled);
		}

		protected internal virtual void AfterItemRemoved(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			RemoveLogicalChild(item);
			item.DockLayoutManagerCore = null;
			PlaceHolderHelper.Remove(item);
			ClearIsTouchEnabled(item);
		}

		protected internal virtual void BeforeItemAdded(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			item.DockLayoutManagerCore = base.DockLayoutManagerCore;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool CanShowItemsInSelectorMenu()
		{
			if (base.ItemType != LayoutItemType.Group && base.ItemType != LayoutItemType.FloatGroup)
			{
				return IsExpanded;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal virtual void ClearContainerForItem(BaseLayoutItem container, object item)
		{
			if (container == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Locker val = clearContainerLocker.Lock();
			try
			{
				if (container is LayoutPanel panel)
				{
					base.Manager?.DockController?.RemovePanel(panel);
				}
				container.Parent?.Remove(container);
				ClearContainerCore(item, container);
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ClearTemplate()
		{
			if (fClearTemplateRequested)
			{
				return;
			}
			fClearTemplateRequested = true;
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				if (fClearTemplateRequested)
				{
					ClearTemplateCore();
				}
			});
			if (base.VisualParent == null)
			{
				ClearValue(DockLayoutManager.UIScopeProperty);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ClearTemplateCore()
		{
			fClearTemplateRequested = false;
			base.ClearTemplateCore();
		}

		protected internal override IUIElement FindUIScopeCore()
		{
			IUIElement parentPanel = ParentPanel;
			return parentPanel ?? base.FindUIScopeCore();
		}

		protected internal virtual BaseLayoutItem GetContainerForItem(object item, DataTemplate itemTemplate = null, DataTemplateSelector itemTemplateSelector = null)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = null;
			if (IsItemItsOwnContainer(item))
			{
				baseLayoutItem = item as BaseLayoutItem;
			}
			if (ItemTemplate != null || ItemTemplateSelector != null)
			{
				itemTemplate = ItemTemplate;
				itemTemplateSelector = ItemTemplateSelector;
			}
			if (baseLayoutItem == null && (itemTemplate != null || itemTemplateSelector != null))
			{
				baseLayoutItem = CreateItem(item, itemTemplate, itemTemplateSelector);
			}
			if (baseLayoutItem == null)
			{
				baseLayoutItem = GetContainerForItemCore(item, itemTemplate, itemTemplateSelector);
			}
			PrepareContainerForItem(baseLayoutItem, item);
			return baseLayoutItem;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool GetIsDocumentHost()
		{
			if (base.Manager != null && base.Manager.DockingStyle != DockingStyle.Default)
			{
				return Items.IsDocumentHost(ignoreLayoutPanels: true);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal virtual BaseLayoutItem[] GetVisibleItems()

			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in Items)

				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		protected internal virtual int GetVisibleItemsCount()
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in Items)
			{
				if (item.IsVisibleCore)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		}

		protected internal virtual void OnItemVisibilityChanged(BaseLayoutItem item, Visibility oldVisibility, Visibility newVisibility)
		{
			if (IsTabHost)
			{
				int num = VisiblePages.IndexOf(item);
				UpdateVisiblePages();
				if (selectedTabIndexLockHelper.IsLocked)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (item.Visibility != Visibility.Visible)
				{
					if (SelectedItem == item)
					{
						if (num > 0)
						{
							num--;
						}
						BaseLayoutItem item2 = ((VisiblePagesCount > 0) ? VisiblePages[num] : null);
						SelectedTabIndex = Items.IndexOf(item2);
					}
				}
				else if (VisiblePagesCount == 1)
				{
					SelectedTabIndex = Items.IndexOf(VisiblePages[0]);
				}
				CoerceValue(SelectedItemProperty);
			}
			else if (NeedRebuildLayout(oldVisibility, newVisibility))
			{
				RebuildLayout();
			}
		}

		}

		protected internal override void SelectTemplate()
		{
			if (fClearTemplateRequested)
			{
				if (base.PartMultiTemplateControl != null && base.PartMultiTemplateControl.LayoutItem == this)
				{
					base.PartMultiTemplateControl.ClearTemplateIfNeeded(this);
				}
				fClearTemplateRequested = false;
			}
			base.SelectTemplate();
		}

		}

		protected void AddItemInItemsInternal(BaseLayoutItem item, int index)
		{
			if (ItemsInternal.Contains(item))
			{
				return;
			}
			int indexInItemsInternal = GetIndexInItemsInternal(index);
			if (indexInItemsInternal >= ItemsInternal.Count)
			{
				ItemsInternal.Add(item);
			}
			else
			{
				ItemsInternal.Insert(indexInItemsInternal, item);
			}
			if (indexInItemsInternal - 1 >= 0 && !(ItemsInternal[indexInItemsInternal - 1] is Splitter))
			{
				Splitter splitter = CreateSplitterItem(this);
				if (!IsSplittersEnabled)
				{
					splitter.IsEnabled = false;
				}
				ItemsInternal.Insert(indexInItemsInternal, splitter);
			}
			else if (indexInItemsInternal + 1 <= ItemsInternal.Count - 1 && !(ItemsInternal[indexInItemsInternal + 1] is Splitter))
			{
				Splitter splitter2 = CreateSplitterItem(this);
				if (!IsSplittersEnabled)
				{
					splitter2.IsEnabled = false;
				}
				ItemsInternal.Insert(indexInItemsInternal + 1, splitter2);
			}
		}

		protected void AddLogicalChildren(IEnumerable children)
		{
			//IL_00a9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!CanAddLogicalChild || children == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (DependencyObject child in children)
			{
				if ((child as BaseLayoutItem).Return((BaseLayoutItem x) => x.SupportsOptimizedLogicalTree, () => false) && base.DockLayoutManagerCore != null && base.DockLayoutManagerCore.OptimizedLogicalTree)
				{
					DockLayoutManager.AddLogicalChild(base.DockLayoutManagerCore, child);
					continue;
				}
				DependencyObject parent = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(child);
				if (parent != null)
				{
					if (!(parent is ILogicalOwner) || parent == this)
					{
						continue;
					}
					((ILogicalOwner)parent).RemoveChild((object)child);
				}
				AddLogicalChild(child);
			}
		}

		protected virtual Size CalcGroupMinSize(Size[] minSizes, bool fHorz)
		{
			Size minSize = MathHelper.MeasureMinSize(minSizes, fHorz);
			minSize = CalcMinSizeWitnIntervals(fHorz, minSize);
			return CalcMinSizeWitnMargins(minSize, base.ActualMargin);
		}

		protected override Size CalcMaxSizeValue(Size value)
		{
			Items.CollectConstraints(out var minSizes, out var maxSizes);
			bool fHorz = Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal;
			Size minSize = (IgnoreOrientation ? CalcGroupMinSize(minSizes) : CalcGroupMinSize(minSizes, fHorz));
			Size maxSize = MathHelper.MeasureMaxSize(maxSizes, fHorz);
			return MathHelper.MeasureSize(minSize, maxSize, value);
		}

		protected override Size CalcMinSizeValue(Size value)
		{
			if (!IsExpanded)
			{
				return value;
			}
			Items.CollectConstraints(out var minSizes, out var _);
			bool fHorz = Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal;
			Size size = (IgnoreOrientation ? CalcGroupMinSize(minSizes) : CalcGroupMinSize(minSizes, fHorz));
			return new Size(Math.Max(size.Width, value.Width), Math.Max(size.Height, value.Height));
		}

		protected virtual double CoerceActualDockItemInterval(double value)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(DockItemInterval))
			{
				return DockItemInterval;
			}
			if (base.DockingViewStyle == DockingViewStyle.Light && (!(this is FloatGroup) || !HasSingleItem))
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			if (Orientation != Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				return DockLayoutManagerParameters.DockingItemIntervalVert;
			}
			return DockLayoutManagerParameters.DockingItemIntervalHorz;
		}

		protected override Thickness CoerceActualMargin(Thickness value)
		{
			if (MathHelper.AreEqual(base.Margin, new Thickness(double.NaN)))
			{
				if (IsControlItemsRoot() && GroupBorderStyle == GroupBorderStyle.NoBorder)
				{
					return DockLayoutManagerParameters.LayoutRootMargin;
				}
				if (IsDockingItemsRoot() && GroupBorderStyle == GroupBorderStyle.NoBorder)
				{
					if (IsMDIItemsRoot())
					{
						return default(Thickness);
					}
					if (base.DockingViewStyle == DockingViewStyle.Light && (!(this is FloatGroup) || !HasSingleItem))
					{
						return default(Thickness);
					}
					return DockLayoutManagerParameters.DockingRootMargin;
				}
				return default(Thickness);
			}
			return base.Margin;
		}

		protected virtual bool? CoerceAllowSplitters(bool? value)
		{
			LayoutGroup root = this.GetRoot();
			DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = this.FindDockLayoutManager();
			if (dockLayoutManager != null && dockLayoutManager.IsCustomization)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (value.HasValue)
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (root != null && !root.Items.ContainsLayoutControlItemOrGroup())
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual object CoerceSelectedTabIndex(int index)
		{
			if (!IsTabHost)
			{
				return index;
			}
			if (Locker.op_Implicit(setSelectionLocker))
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (IsValid(index) && Items[index].Visibility == Visibility.Visible && moveItemLock == 0)
			{
				return index;
			}
			BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = ((SelectedItem != null && SelectedItem.Visibility == Visibility.Visible) ? SelectedItem : null);
			return (baseLayoutItem != null && Items.Contains(baseLayoutItem)) ? Items.IndexOf(baseLayoutItem) : ((VisiblePagesCount > 0) ? Items.IndexOf(VisiblePages[0]) : (-1));
		}

		protected virtual DependencyObject GenerateContainerForItem(object item, DataTemplate itemTemplate = null, DataTemplateSelector itemTemplateSelector = null)
		{
			BeginContainerGeneration();
			BaseLayoutItem containerForItem = GetContainerForItem(item, itemTemplate, itemTemplateSelector);
			if (containerForItem != null)
			{
				if (containerForItem is ContentItem item2)
				{
					AddContainer(item2);
				}
				else
				{
					AddContainer(containerForItem);
				}
			}
			EndContainerGeneration();
			return containerForItem;
		}

				AddContainer(index, containerForItem);
			}
			EndContainerGeneration();

		protected int GetIndexInItemsInternal(int index)
		{
			switch (index)
			{
			case 0:
				return 0;
			case 1:
				if (ItemsInternal.Count == 1)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				break;
			}
			return index * 2 - 1;
		}

		protected virtual int GetNextTabIndex(BaseLayoutItem removedItem)
		{
			int tabIndexBeforeRemove = removedItem.TabIndexBeforeRemove;
			int tabIndex = ((tabIndexBeforeRemove > 0) ? (tabIndexBeforeRemove - 1) : 0);
			if (SelectionOnTabRemoval == SelectionOnTabRemoval.Following)
			{
				tabIndex = ((tabIndexBeforeRemove < Items.Count) ? tabIndexBeforeRemove : (--tabIndexBeforeRemove));
			}
			if (SelectionOnTabRemoval == SelectionOnTabRemoval.PreviousSelection)
			{
				BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = Items.OrderBy((BaseLayoutItem x) => x.LastSelectionDateTime, ListSortDirection.Descending).FirstOrDefault();
				if (baseLayoutItem != null && baseLayoutItem.LastSelectionDateTime != DateTime.MinValue)
				{
					tabIndex = TabIndexFromItem(baseLayoutItem);
				}
			}
			BaseLayoutItem item = ItemFromTabIndex(tabIndex);
			return IndexFromItem(item);
		}

		}

		}

		protected virtual void OnItemsCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateHasSingleItemProperty();
			EnsureLogicalChildren(e, onAdd: true);
			UpdateItemsInternal(e);
			QueryRebuildLayout();
			CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsControlItemsHostProperty);
			this.GetRoot().NotifyItems();
			OnLayoutChanged();
			bool flag = e.NewStartingIndex == 0 && e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add && IsTabHost;
			if (IsTabHost)
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					UpdateVisiblePages();
				}
				switch (e.Action)
				{
				case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
					if (base.IsInitializing || (SelectedTabIndex < e.NewStartingIndex && SelectedTabIndex >= 0))
					{
						break;
					}
					if (!SelectedTabIndexLocker)
					{
						SelectedTabIndex++;
						break;
					}
					SelectedTabIndexLocker.AddUnlockAction(delegate
					{
						CoerceValue(SelectedTabIndexProperty);
					});
					break;
				case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
					if (e.OldItems == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (!base.IsDeserializing)
					{
						foreach (object oldItem in e.OldItems)
						{
							RemoveFromPinned(oldItem as LayoutPanel);
						}
					}
					if (SelectedTabIndex != e.OldStartingIndex)
					{
						if (SelectedTabIndex > e.OldStartingIndex && SelectedTabIndex > 0)
						{
							SelectedTabIndex--;
						}
					}
					else if (e.OldItems.Cast<object>().FirstOrDefault() is BaseLayoutItem removedItem)
					{
						SelectedTabIndex = GetNextTabIndex(removedItem);
					}
					break;
				case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
					CoerceValue(SelectedTabIndexProperty);
					UpdateVisiblePages();
					return;
				case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
					CoerceValue(SelectedTabIndexProperty);
					break;
				default:
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
				case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
					break;
				}
				CoerceValue(SelectedItemProperty);
			}
			if (IsUpdating && e.NewItems != null)
			{
				foreach (BaseLayoutItem newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					PrepareContainerForItem(newItem);
				}
			}
			e.NewItems.Do(delegate(IList x)
			{
				x.Cast<BaseLayoutItem>().ForEach(delegate(BaseLayoutItem y)
				{
					y.Parent = this;
				});
			});
			RaiseWeakItemsChanged(e);
			EnsureLogicalChildren(e, onAdd: false);
			if (flag)
			{
				UpdateVisiblePages();
			}
		}

		protected void OnLayoutChanged()
		{
			base.LogicalTreeLockHelper.DoWhenUnlocked(OnLayoutChangedAsync);

		protected void OnLayoutChangedAsync()
		{
			if (!base.IsInitializing && lockLayoutChanging <= 0)
			{
				lockLayoutChanging++;
				OnLayoutChangedCore();
				if (base.Parent != null)
				{
					base.Parent.OnLayoutChanged();
				}
				else
				{
					RaiseLayoutChangedCore();
				}
				lockLayoutChanging--;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnLayoutChangedCore()
		{
			Locker val = ((Locker)rebuildQueryLocker).Lock();
			try
			{
				CoerceValue(IsLayoutRootProperty);
				CoerceValue(GroupBorderStyleProperty);
				CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.ActualMarginProperty);
				CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.ActualMinSizeProperty);
				CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.ActualMaxSizeProperty);
				CoerceValue(HasNotCollapsedItemsProperty);
				CoerceValue(HasVisibleItemsProperty);
				UpdateButtons();
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		protected void RemoveItemFromItemsInternal(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			int num = ItemsInternal.IndexOf(item);
			Splitter splitter = GetSplitter(num - 1);
			Splitter splitter2 = GetSplitter(num + 1);
			if (splitter != null || splitter2 != null)
			{
				ItemsInternal.Remove((num == 0) ? splitter2 : splitter);
			}
			ItemsInternal.Remove(item);
			RemoveLogicalChild(item);
		}

		protected void RemoveLogicalChildren(IEnumerable children)
		{
			if (children == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (DependencyObject child in children)
			{
				RemoveLogicalChild(child);
			}
		}

		}

		protected void UpdateHasSingleItemProperty()
		{
			HasSingleItem = Items.Count == 1 && (Items[0].ItemType == LayoutItemType.TabPanelGroup || Items[0] is LayoutPanel);
		}

		protected void UpdateItemsInternal(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ItemsInternal == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Items.IsLockUpdate && e.OldItems != null && e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove)
			{
				foreach (BaseLayoutItem oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					if (!Items.Contains(oldItem))
					{
						RemoveItemFromItemsInternal(oldItem);
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			if (e != null)
			{
				if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset)
				{
					ItemsInternal.Clear();
				}
				if (e.OldItems != null)
				{
					bool flag = e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move || e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace;
					foreach (BaseLayoutItem oldItem2 in e.OldItems)
					{
						if (!Items.Contains(oldItem2) || flag)
						{
							RemoveItemFromItemsInternal(oldItem2);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Items.Count; i++)
			{
				AddItemInItemsInternal(Items[i], i);
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateVisiblePages()
		{
			VisiblePages.Clear();
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in Items)
			{
				if (item.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					VisiblePages.Add(item);
				}
			}
			CoerceValue(VisiblePagesCountProperty);
		}

		}

		private void AddContainerCore(BaseLayoutItem container)
		{
			LayoutGroup containerHost = GetContainerHost(container);
			if (containerHost.Manager != null && !containerHost.IsInTree())
			{
				containerHost.Manager.DockControllerImpl.RestoreGroupAndInsertItem(PlaceHolderHelper.Count, container, containerHost);
			}
			else
			{
				containerHost.Add(container);
			}
		}

		private void AddContainerCore(int index, BaseLayoutItem container)
		{
			LayoutGroup containerHost = GetContainerHost(container);
			if (containerHost.Manager != null && !containerHost.IsInTree())
			{
				containerHost.Manager.DockControllerImpl.RestoreGroupAndInsertItem(index, container, containerHost);
			}
			else
			{
				containerHost.Insert(index, container);
			}
		}

		private void AddToPinned(LayoutPanel panel)
		{
			RemoveFromPinned(panel);
			bool flag = panel.TabPinLocation != TabHeaderPinLocation.Far;
			bool flag2 = panel.TabPinLocation == TabHeaderPinLocation.Far;
			if (flag)
			{
				PinnedLeftItems.Add(panel);
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				PinnedRightItems.Add(panel);
			}
		}

		private bool CalcIsLayoutRoot()
		{

		}

		private Size CalcMinSizeWitnIntervals(bool fHorz, Size minSize)
		{
			double intervals = GetIntervals();
			return new Size(fHorz ? (minSize.Width + intervals) : minSize.Width, fHorz ? minSize.Height : (minSize.Height + intervals));
		}

		private Size CalcMinSizeWitnMargins(Size minSize, Thickness margin)
		{
			return new Size(margin.Left + minSize.Width + margin.Right, margin.Top + minSize.Height + margin.Bottom);
		}

			}
		}

		private BaseLayoutItem CreateItem(object item, DataTemplate itemTemplate, DataTemplateSelector itemTemplateSelector)
		{
			DataTemplate dataTemplate = ((itemTemplateSelector != null) ? itemTemplateSelector.SelectTemplate(item, this) : itemTemplate);
			if (dataTemplate == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			BaseLayoutItem result = null;
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = dataTemplate.LoadContent();
			if (dependencyObject != null)
			{
				if (dependencyObject is BaseLayoutItem)
				{
					result = (BaseLayoutItem)dependencyObject;
				}
				else if (dependencyObject is ContentControl)
				{
					result = ((ContentControl)dependencyObject).Content as BaseLayoutItem;
					((ContentControl)dependencyObject).Content = null;
				}
				else if (dependencyObject is ContentPresenter)
				{
					result = ((ContentPresenter)dependencyObject).Content as BaseLayoutItem;
					((ContentPresenter)dependencyObject).Content = null;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void EnsureItemsAppearance()

		}

		private void EnsureLogicalChildren(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e, bool onAdd)
		{
			bool flag = e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset;
			IList list;
			if (!flag)
			{
				list = e.OldItems;
			}
			else
			{
				IList list2 = GetLogicalChildren().OfType<BaseLayoutItem>().Except(Items).ToList();
				list = list2;
			}
			IEnumerable enumerable = list;
			IList list3;
			if (!flag)
			{
				list3 = e.NewItems;
			}
			else
			{
				IList list2 = Items;
				list3 = list2;
			}
			IEnumerable enumerable2 = list3;
			if (!onAdd)
			{
				RemoveLogicalChildren(enumerable);
			}
			if (onAdd)
			{
				AddLogicalChildren(enumerable2);
			}
		}

		private double GetIntervals()
		{
			List<BaseLayoutItem> list = Items.Where((BaseLayoutItem x) => x.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed).ToList();
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int num2 = 1; num2 < list.Count; num2++)
			{
				num += (double)GetValue(IntervalHelper.GetTargetProperty(list[num2 - 1], list[num2]));
			}
			return num;
		}

		private Splitter GetSplitter(int index)
		{
			if (index >= 0 && index < ItemsInternal.Count)
			{
				return ItemsInternal[index] as Splitter;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private DependencyObject LinkContainerToItem(DependencyObject oldContainer, object item, DataTemplate itemTemplate, DataTemplateSelector itemTemplateSelector)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = null;
			if (oldContainer is BaseLayoutItem { Parent: not null, Parent: var parent } baseLayoutItem2)
			{
				BeginContainerGeneration();
				parent.BeginContainerGeneration();
				int index = parent.Items.IndexOf(baseLayoutItem2);
				baseLayoutItem = GetContainerForItem(item, itemTemplate, itemTemplateSelector);
				if (baseLayoutItem != null)
				{
					parent.InsertContainer(index, baseLayoutItem);
					ClearContainerForItem(baseLayoutItem2, item);
				}
				parent.EndContainerGeneration();
				EndContainerGeneration();
			}
			return baseLayoutItem;
		}

		private void LockItemsAppearanceUpdate()
		{
			if (!IsItemsAppearanceUpdateLocked)
			{
				itemsAppearanceUpdatesCount = 0;
			}
			lockItemsAppearanceUpdateCounter++;
		}

		private bool MovePinnedPanel(int index, LayoutPanel panel)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = Items[index];
			if (panel == null || !panel.IsPinnedTab || panel == baseLayoutItem)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = TabIndexFromItem(baseLayoutItem);
			bool flag = panel.TabPinLocation != TabHeaderPinLocation.Far;
			int num2 = (flag ? num : (num - Items.Count((BaseLayoutItem x) => !x.IsPinnedTab) - PinnedLeftItems.Count));
			ObservableCollection<BaseLayoutItem> observableCollection = (flag ? PinnedLeftItems : PinnedRightItems);
			if (observableCollection.IsValidIndex(num2))
			{
				int num3 = observableCollection.IndexOf(panel);
				if (num2 == num3)
				{
					return false;
				}
				observableCollection.Move(num3, num2);
				panel.NotifyViewPinStatusChanged();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool NeedRebuildLayout(Visibility oldVisibility, Visibility newVisibility)
		{
			if (oldVisibility != Visibility.Visible)
			{
				return newVisibility != Visibility.Visible;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void OnActualItemsAppearanceChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			itemsAppearanceUpdatesCount++;
			if (IsItemsAppearanceUpdateLocked)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				OnActualItemsAppearanceChanged();
			}
			finally
			{
				itemsAppearanceUpdatesCount = 0;
			}
		}

		private void QueryRebuildLayout(RebuildLayoutOptions options = RebuildLayoutOptions.None)
		{
			rebuildQueryLocker.QueryRebuildLayout(options);
		}

		private void RaiseSelectedItemChanged(SelectedItemChangedEventArgs ea)
		{
			RaiseEvent(ea);
		}

		private void RaiseWeakItemsChanged(EventArgs args)
		{
			foreach (EventHandler item in handlersWeakItemsChanged)
			{
				item(this, args);
			}
		}

		private void RaiseViewRegistered(EventArgs args)
		{
			foreach (EventHandler item in handlersViewRegistered)
			{
				item(this, args);
			}
		}

		private void RaiseWeakSelectedItemChanged(EventArgs args)
		{
			foreach (EventHandler item in handlersWeakSelectedItemChanged)
			{
				item(this, args);
			}
		}

		private void RebuildLayout()
		{
			Locker val = ((Locker)rebuildQueryLocker).Lock();
			try
			{
				OnLayoutChanged();
				this.GetRoot().NotifyItems();
				QueryRebuildLayout();
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private void RemoveFromPinned(LayoutPanel panel)
		{
			PinnedLeftItems.Remove(panel);
			PinnedRightItems.Remove(panel);
		}

		private void ResetItemsSource()
		{
			if (ItemsSource != null)
			{
				BeginUpdate();
				Items.ResetItemsSource();
				EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		private void SetItemsSourceCore()
		{
			BeginUpdate();
			using (SelectedTabIndexLocker.Lock())
			{
				Items.SetItemsSource(ItemsSource);
			}
			EndUpdate();
		}

		private void UnlockItemsAppearanceUpdate()
		{
			if (--lockItemsAppearanceUpdateCounter == 0 && itemsAppearanceUpdatesCount > 0)
			{
				OnActualItemsAppearanceChanged();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateIsTouchEnabled(DependencyObject target, bool isTouchEnabled)
		{
			if (IsTouchEnabledPropertyKey != null)
			{
				target.SetValue(IsTouchEnabledPropertyKey, isTouchEnabled);
			}
		}
