		void IItemContainer.PrepareContainer(object item)
		{
			BindingExpression bindingExpression = GetBindingExpression(FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty);
			if (!DependencyObjectExtensions.IsPropertySet((DependencyObject)this, FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty) || (bindingExpression != null && bindingExpression == DataContextBinding))
			{
				DataContextBinding = BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty, item, string.Empty);
			}
		}

		void IItemContainer.ClearContainer(object item)
		{
			BindingExpression bindingExpression = GetBindingExpression(FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty);
			BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty);
			if (bindingExpression != null && bindingExpression == DataContextBinding)
			{
				BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty);
			}
			DataContextBinding = null;
		}

		{
			private static Action<WeakEventHandler<TOwner, PropertyChangedEventArgs, PropertyChangedEventHandler>, object> action = delegate(WeakEventHandler<TOwner, PropertyChangedEventArgs, PropertyChangedEventHandler> h, object o)
			{
				((DockLayoutManager)o).AutoHideDisplayModeChanged -= h.Handler;
			};

			private static Func<WeakEventHandler<TOwner, PropertyChangedEventArgs, PropertyChangedEventHandler>, PropertyChangedEventHandler> create = (WeakEventHandler<TOwner, PropertyChangedEventArgs, PropertyChangedEventHandler> h) => h.OnEvent;

			public AutoHideDisplayModePropertyChangedWeakEventHandler(TOwner owner, Action<TOwner, object, PropertyChangedEventArgs> onEventAction)
				: base(owner, onEventAction, action, create)
			{
			}
		}

		private class LayoutPanelContentPresenter : ContentPresenter, ILogicalOwner, IInputElement
		{
			[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
			internal static readonly DependencyProperty ContentInternalProperty;

			private readonly List<object> logicalChildren = new List<object>();

			protected override IEnumerator LogicalChildren => logicalChildren.GetEnumerator();

			static LayoutPanelContentPresenter()
			{
				DependencyPropertyRegistrator<LayoutPanelContentPresenter> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<LayoutPanelContentPresenter>();
				dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<object>("ContentInternal", ref ContentInternalProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
				{
					((LayoutPanelContentPresenter)dObj).OnContentChanged(e.NewValue, e.OldValue);
				});
			}

			public LayoutPanelContentPresenter()
			{
				base.Focusable = false;
				this.StartListen(ContentInternalProperty, "Content");
			}

			public void AddChild(object child)
			{
				if ((child as DependencyObject).Return((DependencyObject x) => LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(x) == null, () => false) && !logicalChildren.Contains(child))
				{
					logicalChildren.Add(child);
					AddLogicalChild(child);
				}
			}

			public void RemoveChild(object child)
			{
				logicalChildren.Remove(child);
				RemoveLogicalChild(child);
			}

			protected virtual void OnContentChanged(object content, object oldContent)
			{
				RemoveChild(oldContent);
				AddChild(content);
			}

			[SpecialName]
			bool ILogicalOwner.get_IsLoaded()
			{
				return base.IsLoaded;
			}

			[SpecialName]
			void ILogicalOwner.add_Loaded(RoutedEventHandler value)

				base.Loaded += value;
			}

			}

			{
				return base.ActualHeight;
			}

		private AutoHideDisplayModePropertyChangedWeakEventHandler<LayoutPanel> AutoHideDisplayModePropertyChangedHandler
		{
			get
			{
				if (autoHideDisplayModePropertyChangedHandler == null)
				{
					autoHideDisplayModePropertyChangedHandler = new AutoHideDisplayModePropertyChangedWeakEventHandler<LayoutPanel>(this, delegate(LayoutPanel owner, object o, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
					{
						owner.OnManagerAutoHideDisplayModeChanged(o, e);
					});
				}
				return autoHideDisplayModePropertyChangedHandler;
			}
		}

		private bool IsInlineMode => autoHideDisplayMode == AutoHideMode.Inline;

		private bool IsTouchEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsTouchEnabledProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsTouchEnabledProperty, value);
			}
		}

			{

				.Register<bool>("IsMergingTarget", ref IsMergingTargetProperty, false, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.RegisterAttached<DependencyObject, MDIMergeStyle>("GetMDIMergeStyle", ref MDIMergeStyleProperty, (MDIMergeStyle)3, (Action<DependencyObject, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)OnMDIMergeStyleChanged, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);

		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public static MDIMergeStyle GetMDIMergeStyle(DependencyObject target)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return (MDIMergeStyle)target.GetValue(MDIMergeStyleProperty);
		}

		public static void SetMDIMergeStyle(DependencyObject target, MDIMergeStyle value)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			target.SetValue(MDIMergeStyleProperty, value);
		}

		private static void OnMDIMergeStyleChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			(d as IMDIMergeStyleListener)?.OnMDIMergeStyleChanged((MDIMergeStyle)e.OldValue, (MDIMergeStyle)e.NewValue);
			(d as LayoutPanel)?.OnMDIMergeStyleChanged((MDIMergeStyle)e.OldValue);
		}

		public LayoutPanel()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00df: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e9: Expected O, but got Unknown
			BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, IsTouchEnabledProperty, new Binding
			{
				Path = new PropertyPath(ThemeManager.IsTouchEnabledProperty),
				Source = this
			});
			SetBinding(TabPinLocationProperty, new Binding
			{
				Path = new PropertyPath(DocumentGroup.PinLocationProperty),
				Source = this,
				Mode = BindingMode.TwoWay
			});
			SetBinding(PinnedProperty, new Binding
			{
				Path = new PropertyPath(DocumentGroup.PinnedProperty),
				Source = this,
				Mode = BindingMode.TwoWay
			});
			SetBinding(ShowPinButtonInTabProperty, new Binding
			{
				Path = new PropertyPath(DocumentGroup.ShowPinButtonProperty),
				Source = this,
				Mode = BindingMode.TwoWay
			});
			Presenter = CreatePresenter();
			mergingClient = new MergingClient(this);
			canMergeLocker = new Locker();
			canMergeLocker.Unlocked += OnUnlockMergingTarget;
		}

		internal double GetCollapsedItemWidth()
		{
			if (ExpandableChild == null)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			return base.ActualWidth - Presenter.Return((LayoutPanelContentPresenter x) => x.RenderSize.Width, () => base.ActualWidth) + ExpandableChild.CollapseWidth;
		}

		internal void ApplyExpandState()
		{
			ExpandStateLocker.LockOnce();
			CheckExpandState();
		}

		internal virtual bool CoerceCanMerge(bool value)
		{
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (DockItemState == DockItemState.Docked && (!base.IsTabPage || base.IsSelectedItem))
			{
				return (int)GetMDIMergeStyle(this) != 3;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override void Control_GotFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!base.IsActivationCancelled)
			{
				base.Manager.Do(delegate(DockLayoutManager x)
				{
					x.QueueFocus(this);
				});
			}
		}

		internal virtual bool GetIsMaximized()
		{
			return FloatState == FloatState.Maximized;
		}

		internal virtual bool GetIsMinimized()
		{
			return FloatState == FloatState.Minimized;
		}

		internal override IDisposable LockCanMerge()
		{
			return (IDisposable)canMergeLocker.Lock();
		}

		internal void NotifyViewPinStatusChanged()
		{
			RaiseVisualChanged();
			InvalidateTabHeader();
			if (base.Manager != null)
			{
				base.Manager.InvalidateView(base.Parent);
			}
		}

		internal virtual void OnControlGotFocus()
		{
			if (!base.IsActive && base.Manager != null)
			{
				base.Manager.Activate(this, focus: false, delayed: true);
			}
			CoerceCanMerge();
		}

		internal void ProcessFocus()
		{
			OnControlGotFocus();
		}

		internal override void SetFloatState(FloatState state)
		{
			if (FloatState != state)
			{
				SetValue(FloatStatePropertyKey, state);
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateMinMaxState()
		{
			UpdateIsMinimized();
			UpdateIsMaximized();
		}

		protected internal override void ClearTemplate()
		{
			if (!EnvironmentHelper.IsNet45OrNewer)
			{
				base.ClearTemplate();
			}
			else
			{
				if (fClearTemplateRequested)
				{
					return;
				}
				fClearTemplateRequested = true;
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					if (fClearTemplateRequested)
					{
						ClearTemplateCore();
					}
				});
				ClearValue(DockLayoutManager.UIScopeProperty);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ClearTemplateCore()
		{
			fClearTemplateRequested = false;
			base.ClearTemplateCore();
			if (Layout != null)
			{
				Layout.ClearTemplateCore();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void EndFloating()
		{
			Pinned = false;
		}

		protected internal override IUIElement FindUIScopeCore()
		{
			IUIElement iUIElement = base.FindUIScopeCore();
			if (iUIElement is LayoutPanel)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return iUIElement;
		}

		protected internal override void OnDeserializationComplete()
		{
			base.OnDeserializationComplete();
			CheckAutoHiddenState();
		}

		protected internal override void OnParentItemsChanged()
		{
			base.OnParentItemsChanged();
			InvokeCoerceDockItemState();
			if (base.IsFloating)
			{
				UpdateButtons();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnRootGroupChanged(LayoutGroup oldValue, LayoutGroup newValue)
		{
			if (newValue is FloatGroup)
			{
				SetBinding(WindowServiceHelper.IWindowServiceProperty, new Binding
				{
					Path = new PropertyPath(WindowServiceHelper.IWindowServiceProperty),
					Source = newValue
				});
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(WindowServiceHelper.IWindowServiceProperty);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void SelectTemplate()
		{
			if (fClearTemplateRequested)
			{
				if (base.PartMultiTemplateControl != null && base.PartMultiTemplateControl.LayoutItem == this)
				{
					base.PartMultiTemplateControl.LayoutItem = null;
				}
				fClearTemplateRequested = false;
			}
			base.SelectTemplate();
			if (Layout != null)
			{
				Layout.SelectTemplate();
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateVisualState()
		{
			base.UpdateVisualState();
			UpdateSvgPaletteState();
		}

		protected internal override void SelectTemplateIfNeeded()
		{
			if (fClearTemplateRequested || (base.PartMultiTemplateControl != null && base.PartMultiTemplateControl.LayoutItem == null))
			{
				SelectTemplate();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void SetAutoHidden(bool autoHidden)
		{
			AutoHidden = autoHidden;
		}

		protected internal override void SetSelected(DockLayoutManager manager, bool value)
		{
		}

		protected internal override bool ToggleTabPinStatus()
		{
			Pinned = !Pinned;
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateButtons()
		{
			CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsMaximizeButtonVisibleProperty);
			CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsMinimizeButtonVisibleProperty);
			CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsPinButtonVisibleProperty);
			CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsRestoreButtonVisibleProperty);
		}

		protected virtual void ActivateItemCore()
		{
			if (!base.Manager.IsDisposing)
			{
				base.Manager.DockController.Activate(this, setFocus: false);
			}
		}

		protected override Size CalcMinSizeValue(Size value)
		{
			Size result = base.CalcMinSizeValue(value);
			if (ExpandableChild == null || double.IsNaN(ExpandableChild.CollapseWidth))
			{
				return result;
			}
			return new Size(Math.Max(result.Width, GetCollapsedItemWidth()), result.Height);
		}

		protected virtual void CheckContent(object content)
		{
			content = CheckContentAsUri(content);
			if (content is LayoutGroup layoutGroup)
			{
				layoutGroup.ParentPanel = this;
				layoutGroup.Accept(delegate(BaseLayoutItem item)
				{
					item.CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsControlItemsHostProperty);
				});
				SetValue(LayoutPropertyKey, layoutGroup);
			}
			else if (content is UIElement)
			{
				SetValue(ControlPropertyKey, content);
			}
			else
			{
				SetValue(ContentItem.IsDataBoundPropertyKey, content != null);
			}
			SetContentPresenterContainer(content);
		}

		protected virtual void ClearContent(object oldContent)
		{
			if (oldContent is UIElement uIElement)
			{
				uIElement.ClearValue(DockLayoutManager.LayoutItemProperty);
			}
			ClearValue(UriPropertyKey);
			ClearValue(LayoutPropertyKey);
			ClearValue(ControlPropertyKey);
			ClearValue(ContentItem.IsDataBoundPropertyKey);
			if (oldContent is LayoutGroup layoutGroup)
			{
				layoutGroup.ParentPanel = null;
			}
		}

		protected virtual Color CoerceActualTabBackgroundColor(Color value)
		{
			if (TabBackgroundColor != Colors.Transparent)
			{
				return TabBackgroundColor;
			}
			if (base.ActualAppearanceObject != null)
			{
				return base.ActualAppearanceObject.TabBackgroundColor;
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected override string CoerceCaptionFormat(string captionFormat)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(captionFormat))
			{
				return captionFormat;
			}
			return DockLayoutManagerParameters.LayoutPanelCaptionFormat;
		}

		protected virtual DockItemState CoerceDockItemState(DockItemState dockItemState)
		{
			DockItemState result = ((base.Parent != null) ? DockItemState.Docked : DockItemState.Undefined);
			if (base.IsFloating)
			{
				result = DockItemState.Floating;
			}
			if (base.IsAutoHidden)
			{
				result = DockItemState.AutoHidden;
			}
			if (base.IsClosed)
			{
				result = DockItemState.Closed;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual bool CoerceHasBackground(bool value)
		{
			return base.Background != null;
		}

		protected virtual bool CoerceHasBorder(bool value)
		{
			return ShowBorder;
		}

		protected override bool CoerceIsCaptionVisible(bool visible)
		{
			if (!(base.Parent is DocumentGroup))
			{
				return base.CoerceIsCaptionVisible(visible);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool CoerceIsCollapseButtonVisible(object baseValue)
		{
			if (IsInlineMode && ShowCollapseButton && base.IsAutoHidden)
			{
				return AutoHideExpandState == AutoHideExpandState.Expanded;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool CoerceIsControlItemsHost(bool value)
		{
			return Layout != null;
		}

		protected virtual bool CoerceIsExpandButtonVisible(object baseValue)
		{
			if (IsInlineMode && ShowExpandButton && base.IsAutoHidden)
			{
				return AutoHideExpandState != AutoHideExpandState.Expanded;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual object CoerceIsHideButtonVisible(object baseValue)
		{
			return IsInlineMode && ShowHideButton && base.IsAutoHidden;
		}

		protected override bool CoerceIsMaximizeButtonVisible(bool visible)
		{
			if (IsMaximizable && base.AllowMaximize && ShowMaximizeButton)
			{
				return !IsMaximized;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool CoerceIsMinimizeButtonVisible(bool visible)
		{
			if (IsMinimizable && base.AllowMinimize && ShowMinimizeButton)
			{
				return !IsMinimized;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool CoerceIsPinButtonVisible(bool visible)
		{
			if (base.IsTabDocument)
			{
				return ShowPinButtonInTab;
			}
			if (ShowPinButton)
			{
				bool num;
				if (!base.IsAutoHidden)
				{
					num = base.AllowHide;
				}
				else
				{
					if (!base.AllowDock)
					{
						goto IL_0049;
					}
					num = base.Parent.AllowDock;
				}
				if (num)
				{
					return !base.IsFloating;
				}
			}
			goto IL_0049;
			IL_0049:
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool CoerceIsRestoreButtonVisible(bool visible)
		{
			if (IsMaximizable && ShowRestoreButton)
			{
				if (!IsMinimized)
				{
					return IsMaximized;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool CoerceIsTabPage(bool value)
		{
			return base.Parent is TabbedGroup;
		}

		protected virtual string GetSvgPaletteState()
		{
			if (base.IsSelected)
			{
				if (!base.IsActive)
				{
					return "Inactive";
				}
				return "Selected";
			}
			if (!base.IsMouseOver)
			{
				return "Normal";
			}
			return "Hover";
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateSvgPaletteState()
		{
			SvgImageHelper.SetState((DependencyObject)this, GetSvgPaletteState());
		}

		protected override LayoutItemType GetLayoutItemTypeCore()
		{
			return LayoutItemType.Panel;
		}

		protected override BaseLayoutItem[] GetNodesCore()
		{
			LayoutGroup layout = Layout;
			if (layout == null)
			{
				return BaseLayoutItem.EmptyNodes;
			}
			return new BaseLayoutItem[1] { layout };
		}

		protected override void InvokeCoerceDockItemStateCore()
		{
			CoerceValue(DockItemStateProperty);
		}

		protected override void OnActualAppearanceObjectChanged(AppearanceObject newValue)
		{
			CoerceValue(ActualTabBackgroundColorProperty);
			base.OnActualAppearanceObjectChanged(newValue);
		}

		protected override void OnActualCaptionChanged(string value)
		{
			base.OnActualCaptionChanged(value);
			if (base.Parent is FloatGroup)
			{
				CoerceParentProperty(BaseLayoutItem.ActualCaptionProperty);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnAllowCloseChanged(bool value)
		{
			bool isCloseButtonVisible = base.IsCloseButtonVisible;
			base.OnAllowCloseChanged(value);
			if (base.IsCloseButtonVisible == isCloseButtonVisible && base.Parent != null)
			{
				base.Parent.CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsCloseButtonVisibleProperty);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnAllowMaximizeChanged(bool value)
		{
			base.OnAllowMaximizeChanged(value);
			if (base.Parent is FloatGroup)
			{
				base.Parent.CoerceValue(FloatGroup.CanMaximizeProperty);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnAllowMinimizeChanged(bool value)
		{
			base.OnAllowMinimizeChanged(value);
			if (base.Parent is FloatGroup)
			{
				base.Parent.CoerceValue(FloatGroup.CanMinimizeProperty);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnAllowSizingChanged(bool value)
		{
			base.OnAllowSizingChanged(value);
			if (base.Parent is FloatGroup)
			{
				CoerceParentProperty(BaseLayoutItem.AllowSizingProperty);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnAutoHiddenChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			if (base.IsStyleUpdateInProgress)
			{
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(CheckAutoHiddenState));
			}
			else
			{
				CheckAutoHiddenState();
			}
			InvokeCoerceInheritableProperties();
		}

		protected virtual void OnAutoHideExpandStateChanged(AutoHideExpandState oldValue, AutoHideExpandState newValue)
		{
			if (!Locker.op_Implicit(ExpandAnimationLocker))
			{
				ApplyExpandState();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnClosed()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnClosing(CancelEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		protected override void OnContentChanged(object content, object oldContent)
		{
			ClearContent(oldContent);
			CheckContent(content);
		}

		protected virtual void OnControlPropertyChanged(UIElement control, UIElement oldControl)
		{
			OnControlRemoved(oldControl);
			OnControlAdded(control);
		}

		protected virtual void OnDockItemStateChanged(DockItemState oldState, DockItemState newState)
		{
			UpdateMinMaxState();
			UpdateButtons();
			CoerceCanMerge();
		}

		protected override void OnDockLayoutManagerChanged()
		{
			base.OnDockLayoutManagerChanged();
			CheckAutoHiddenState();
			CheckExpandState();
		}

		protected override void OnDockLayoutManagerChanged(DockLayoutManager oldValue, DockLayoutManager newValue)
		{
			base.OnDockLayoutManagerChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			UnsubscribeAutoHideDisplayModeChanged(oldValue);
			SubscribeAutoHideDisplayModeChanged(newValue);
			autoHideDisplayMode = newValue.Return((DockLayoutManager x) => x.AutoHideMode, () => AutoHideMode.Default);
			CheckIsMergingTarget();
		}

		protected virtual void OnFloatStateChanged(FloatState oldState, FloatState newState)
		{
			UpdateMinMaxState();
			UpdateButtons();
			RaiseVisualChanged();
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized()
		{
			base.OnInitialized();
			if (ExpandableChild != null)
			{
				CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.ActualMinSizeProperty);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnIsActiveChanged(bool value)
		{
			base.OnIsActiveChanged(value);
			if (value)
			{
				LastActivationDateTime = DateTime.Now;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnIsActiveChangedCore()
		{
			base.OnIsActiveChangedCore();
			if (base.IsActive && base.Parent != null)
			{
				CheckIsMergingTarget();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnIsCloseButtonVisibleChanged(bool visible)
		{
			base.OnIsCloseButtonVisibleChanged(visible);
			if (base.Parent != null)
			{
				base.Parent.CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsCloseButtonVisibleProperty);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnIsMaximizeButtonVisibleChanged(bool visible)
		{
			base.OnIsMaximizeButtonVisibleChanged(visible);
			if (base.Parent != null)
			{
				base.Parent.CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsMaximizeButtonVisibleProperty);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsMaximizedChanged(bool maximized)
		{
			RaiseVisualChanged();
			CoerceCanMerge();
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsMinimizedChanged(bool minimized)
		{
			RaiseVisualChanged();
		}

		protected override void OnIsRestoreButtonVisibleChanged(bool visible)
		{
			base.OnIsRestoreButtonVisibleChanged(visible);
			if (base.Parent != null)
			{
				base.Parent.CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsRestoreButtonVisibleProperty);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnIsSelectedItemChanged()
		{
			base.OnIsSelectedItemChanged();
			RaiseVisualChanged();
			if (base.IsAutoHidden && !base.IsSelectedItem && !base.IsThemeChangeInProgress)
			{
				SetCurrentValue(AutoHideExpandStateProperty, AutoHideExpandState.Hidden);
			}
			CoerceCanMerge();
		}

		protected override void OnIsTabPageChanged()
		{
			base.OnIsTabPageChanged();
			CoerceCanMerge();
		}

		protected override void OnIsVisibleChanged(bool isVisible)
		{
			base.OnIsVisibleChanged(isVisible);
			if (base.IsControlItemsHost)
			{
				Layout.CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsVisibleCoreProperty);
			}
			if (!isVisible)
			{
				if (base.IsAutoHidden && base.Manager != null)
				{
					base.Manager.HideView(base.Parent);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				CheckExpandState();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnLayoutPropertyChanged(LayoutGroup oldValue, LayoutGroup newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				RemoveLogicalChild(oldValue);
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				AddLogicalChild(newValue);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnLoaded()
		{
			base.OnLoaded();
			CheckExpandState();
			if (ExpandableChild != null)
			{
				CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.ActualMinSizeProperty);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnMDIMergeStyleChanged(MDIMergeStyle mDIMergeStyle)
		{
			CoerceCanMerge();
		}

		protected override void OnParentChanged()
		{
			base.OnParentChanged();
			CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsCaptionVisibleProperty);
			if (base.Parent != null)
			{
				base.LogicalTreeLockHelper.DoWhenUnlocked(UpdateButtons);
				(base.Parent as FloatGroup).Do(delegate(FloatGroup x)
				{
					x.CoerceValue(FloatGroup.CanMaximizeProperty);
					x.CoerceValue(FloatGroup.CanMinimizeProperty);
				});
			}
			LayoutSizeBeforeHide = (base.IsDeserializing ? default(Size) : ((base.Parent is AutoHideGroup) ? base.LayoutSize : Size.Empty));
			CheckAutoHiddenState();
			CheckExpandState();
			CoerceCanMerge();
		}

		protected override void OnParentChanged(LayoutGroup oldParent, LayoutGroup newParent)
		{
			base.OnParentChanged(oldParent, newParent);
			CheckPinStatusOnParentChanged();
			InvokeCoerceDockItemState();
		}

		protected internal override void OnParentLoaded()
		{
			base.OnParentLoaded();
			CheckExpandState();
			((IMergingClient)mergingClient)?.QueueMerge();
		}

		protected internal override void OnParentUnloaded()
		{
			base.OnParentUnloaded();
			((IMergingClient)mergingClient)?.QueueUnmerge();
		}

		protected virtual void OnPinnedChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			if (base.IsTabDocument)
			{
				NotifyParentPinStatusChanged();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnRenderSizeChangedCore(SizeChangedInfo sizeInfo)
		{
			base.OnRenderSizeChangedCore(sizeInfo);
			if (ExpandableChild == null || !base.IsVisibleCore)
			{
				return;
			}
			double value = sizeInfo.NewSize.Width;
			if (base.ItemWidth.IsAuto && !ExpandableChild.IsExpanded)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool isLocked = base.ResizeLockHelper.IsLocked;
			if (value > GetCollapsedItemWidth())
			{
				if (!ExpandableChild.IsExpanded)
				{
					if (!base.IsAutoHidden || isLocked)
					{
						ExpandableChild.IsExpanded = true;
					}
					return;
				}
				if (isLocked)
				{
					ExpandableChild.ExpandedWidth = Presenter.Return((LayoutPanelContentPresenter x) => x.RenderSize.Width, () => value);
				}
				if (base.IsAutoHidden)
				{
					UpdateDockSituationWidth(new GridLength(value));
				}
			}
			else if (ExpandableChild.IsExpanded && (!base.IsAutoHidden || isLocked))
			{
				ExpandableChild.IsExpanded = false;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnShowBorderChanged()
		{
			CoerceValue(HasBorderProperty);
			RaiseGeometryChanged();
		}

		protected override void OnShowCaptionChanged(bool value)
		{
			base.OnShowCaptionChanged(value);
			if (base.Parent is FloatGroup)
			{
				CoerceParentProperty(BaseLayoutItem.ShowCaptionProperty);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnShowCloseButtonChanged(bool show)
		{
			base.OnShowCloseButtonChanged(show);
			if (base.Parent != null)
			{
				base.Parent.CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsCloseButtonVisibleProperty);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnShowCollapseButtonChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			CoerceValue(IsCollapseButtonVisibleProperty);
		}

		protected virtual void OnShowExpandButtonChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			CoerceValue(IsExpandButtonVisibleProperty);
		}

		protected virtual void OnShowHideButtonChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			CoerceValue(IsHideButtonVisibleProperty);
		}

		protected virtual void OnShowPinButtonInTabChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsPinButtonVisibleProperty);
		}

		protected virtual void OnTabBackgroundColorChanged(Color oldValue, Color newValue)
		{
			CoerceValue(ActualTabBackgroundColorProperty);
		}

		protected virtual void OnTabPinLocationChanged(TabHeaderPinLocation oldValue, TabHeaderPinLocation newValue)
		{
			if (IsPinnedTab)
			{
				NotifyParentPinStatusChanged();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnUnloaded()
		{
			if (fClearTemplateRequested)
			{
				ClearTemplateCore();
			}
			base.OnUnloaded();
		}

		protected override void OnVisibilityChangedOverride(Visibility oldVisibility, Visibility newVisibility)
		{
			base.OnVisibilityChangedOverride(oldVisibility, newVisibility);
			if (base.IsControlItemsHost)
			{
				Layout.CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsVisibleCoreProperty);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SubscribeAutoHideDisplayModeChanged(DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			manager.Do(delegate(DockLayoutManager x)
			{
				x.AutoHideDisplayModeChanged += ((WeakEventHandler<LayoutPanel, PropertyChangedEventArgs, PropertyChangedEventHandler>)AutoHideDisplayModePropertyChangedHandler).Handler;
			});
		}

		protected virtual void UnsubscribeAutoHideDisplayModeChanged(DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			manager.Do(delegate(DockLayoutManager x)
			{
				x.AutoHideDisplayModeChanged -= ((WeakEventHandler<LayoutPanel, PropertyChangedEventArgs, PropertyChangedEventHandler>)AutoHideDisplayModePropertyChangedHandler).Handler;
			});
		}

		private void CheckAutoHiddenState()
		{
			base.ParentLockHelper.DoWhenUnlocked(CheckAutoHiddenStateCore);
		}

		private void CheckAutoHiddenStateCore()
		{
			DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = this.FindDockLayoutManager();
			if (dockLayoutManager != null && base.Parent != null && AutoHidden != base.IsAutoHidden && !base.IsInDesignTime && !base.IsInitializing && !base.IsDeserializing)
			{
				dockLayoutManager.CheckAutoHiddenState(this);
			}
		}

		private object CheckContentAsUri(object content)
		{
			Uri uri = content as Uri;
			if (uri != null)
			{
				SetValue(UriPropertyKey, uri);
				object obj = XamlLoaderHelper.LoadContentFromUri(uri);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					content = obj;
				}
			}
			return content;
		}

		private void CheckExpandState()
		{
			if (base.IsVisibleCore && base.Manager != null)
			{
				if (base.ParentLockHelper.IsLocked)
				{
					base.ParentLockHelper.AddUnlockAction(CheckExpandStateCore);
				}
				else if (base.Parent != null)
				{
					CheckExpandStateCore();
				}
			}
		}

		private void CheckExpandStateCore()
		{
			if (ExpandStateLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				DockLayoutManager input = this.FindDockLayoutManager();
				if (input.Return((DockLayoutManager x) => x.CheckAutoHideExpandState(this), () => false))
				{
					ExpandStateLocker.Unlock();
				}
			}
			if (AutoHideExpandState != AutoHideExpandState.Hidden)
			{
				UpdateAutoHideButtons();
				return;
			}
			base.Parent.With((LayoutGroup x) => x.IsAnimatedLockHelper).Do(delegate(LockHelper x)
			{
				x.DoWhenUnlocked(UpdateAutoHideButtons);
			});
		}

		private void CheckIsMergingTarget()
		{
			DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = base.Manager;
			if (dockLayoutManager == null)
			{
				LayoutGroup layoutGroup = base.Parent ?? (LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(this) as LayoutGroup);
				if (layoutGroup != null)
				{
					dockLayoutManager = layoutGroup.GetRoot().GetDockLayoutManager();
				}
			}
			dockLayoutManager?.CheckMergingTarget(this);
		}

		private void CheckPinStatusOnParentChanged()
		{
			if (!Pinned)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (base.IsTabDocument)
			{
				checkPinStatusOperation.Do(delegate(DispatcherOperation x)
				{
					x.Abort();
				});
				checkPinStatusOperation = null;
				NotifyParentPinStatusChanged();
			}
			else
			{
				checkPinStatusOperation = base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					checkPinStatusOperation = null;
					Pinned = false;
				});
			}
		}

		private void CoerceCanMerge()
		{
			if (Locker.op_Implicit(canMergeLocker))
			{
				canMergeCount++;
				return;
			}
			canMergeCount = 0;
			CoerceValue(CanMergeProperty);
		}

		private LayoutPanelContentPresenter CreatePresenter()
		{
			LayoutPanelContentPresenter layoutPanelContentPresenter = new LayoutPanelContentPresenter();
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(layoutPanelContentPresenter, System.Windows.Controls.ContentPresenter.ContentTemplateProperty, this, ContentItem.ContentTemplateProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(layoutPanelContentPresenter, System.Windows.Controls.ContentPresenter.ContentTemplateSelectorProperty, this, ContentItem.ContentTemplateSelectorProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(layoutPanelContentPresenter, FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty, this, FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty);
			SetValue(ContentPresenterPropertyKey, layoutPanelContentPresenter);
			return layoutPanelContentPresenter;
		}

		private void NotifyParentPinStatusChanged()
		{
			base.ParentLockHelper.DoWhenUnlocked(delegate
			{
				if (base.Parent != null)
				{
					base.Parent.OnItemPinStatusChanged(this);
				}
			});
			NotifyViewPinStatusChanged();
		}

		private void OnCanMergeChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			if (!Locker.op_Implicit(canMergeLocker))
			{
				CheckIsMergingTarget();
			}
		}

		private void OnControlAdded(UIElement control)
		{
			if (control == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			control.SetValue(DockLayoutManager.LayoutItemProperty, this);
			if (base.IsInDesignTime)
			{
				return;
			}
			ExpandableChild = (IExpandableChild)(object)((control is IExpandableChild) ? control : null);
			if (ExpandableChild != null)
			{
				ExpandableChild.IsExpandedChanged += OnExpandableChildIsExpandedChanged;
				if (!ExpandableChild.IsExpanded)
				{
					SetCurrentValue(BaseLayoutItem.ItemWidthProperty, GridLength.Auto);
				}
				CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.ActualMinSizeProperty);
			}
		}

		private void OnControlChanged(UIElement control, UIElement oldControl)
		{
			CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsControlItemsHostProperty);
			if (!base.IsControlItemsHost)
			{
				OnControlPropertyChanged(control, oldControl);
			}
		}

		private void OnControlRemoved(UIElement oldControl)
		{
			oldControl?.ClearValue(DockLayoutManager.LayoutItemProperty);
			if (ExpandableChild != null)
			{
				ExpandableChild.IsExpandedChanged -= OnExpandableChildIsExpandedChanged;
				ExpandableChild = null;
				CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.ActualMinSizeProperty);
			}
		}

		private void OnExpandableChildIsExpandedChanged(object sender, ValueChangedEventArgs<bool> e)
		{
			if (!e.NewValue)
			{
				GridLength gridLength = ((ExpandableChild != null) ? new GridLength(ExpandableChild.CollapseWidth) : GridLength.Auto);
				SetCurrentValue(BaseLayoutItem.ItemWidthProperty, gridLength);
				if (base.IsAutoHidden)
				{
					UpdateDockSituationWidth(gridLength);
				}
				return;
			}
			if (!base.ResizeLockHelper.IsLocked || base.IsAutoHidden)
			{
				SetCurrentValue(BaseLayoutItem.ItemWidthProperty, GridLength.Auto);
				if (base.IsAutoHidden)
				{
					UpdateDockSituationWidth(GridLength.Auto);
				}
			}
			ExpandableChild.Do(delegate(IExpandableChild x)
			{
				x.ExpandedWidth = double.NaN;
			});
		}

		private void OnIsTouchEnabledChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			if (IsTouchEnabledPropertyKey != null)
			{
				Presenter.SetValue(IsTouchEnabledPropertyKey, newValue);
			}
		}

		private void OnLayoutChanged(LayoutGroup group, LayoutGroup oldGroup)
		{
			CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsControlItemsHostProperty);
			oldGroup?.ClearValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsControlItemsHostPropertyKey);
			if (group != null)
			{
				group.SetValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsControlItemsHostPropertyKey, true);
				if (group.ItemType != LayoutItemType.Group)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(DockLayoutManagerHelper.GetRule(DockLayoutManagerRule.WrongLayoutRoot));
				}
			}
			OnLayoutPropertyChanged(oldGroup, group);
		}

		private void OnManagerAutoHideDisplayModeChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			autoHideDisplayMode = base.Manager.Return((DockLayoutManager x) => x.AutoHideMode, () => AutoHideMode.Default);
			CoerceValue(IsHideButtonVisibleProperty);
			CoerceValue(IsExpandButtonVisibleProperty);
			CoerceValue(IsCollapseButtonVisibleProperty);
		}

		private void OnUnlockMergingTarget(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (canMergeCount > 0)
			{
				CoerceCanMerge();
			}
		}

		private void SetContentPresenterContainer(object content)
		{
			if (content != null)
			{
				if (!base.IsControlItemsHost)
				{
					if (LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(Presenter) == null)
					{
						AddLogicalChild(Presenter);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					RemoveLogicalChild(Presenter);
				}
			}
			Presenter.Content = content;
		}

		private void UpdateAutoHideButtons()
		{
			CoerceValue(IsHideButtonVisibleProperty);
			CoerceValue(IsExpandButtonVisibleProperty);
			CoerceValue(IsCollapseButtonVisibleProperty);
		}

		private void UpdateDockSituationWidth(GridLength newWidth)
		{
			base.DockSituation.Do(delegate(DockSituation x)
			{
				x.Width = newWidth;
			});
		}

		private void UpdateIsMaximized()
		{
			IsMaximized = GetIsMaximized();
		}

		private void UpdateIsMinimized()
		{
			IsMinimized = GetIsMinimized();
		}

		DependencyObject IGeneratorHost.GenerateContainerForItem(object item, DataTemplate itemTemplate, DataTemplateSelector itemTemplateSelector)
		{
			SetValue(ContentItem.ContentProperty, item);
			return this;
		}

		DependencyObject IGeneratorHost.GenerateContainerForItem(object item, int index, DataTemplate itemTemplate, DataTemplateSelector itemTemplateSelector)
		{
			SetValue(ContentItem.ContentProperty, item);
			return this;
		}

		DependencyObject IGeneratorHost.LinkContainerToItem(DependencyObject container, object item, DataTemplate itemTemplate, DataTemplateSelector itemTemplateSelector)
		{
			SetValue(ContentItem.ContentProperty, item);
			return this;
		}

		void IGeneratorHost.ClearContainer(DependencyObject container, object item)
		{
			if (object.Equals(this, container))
			{
				ClearValue(ContentItem.ContentProperty);
			}
		}

		void IClosable.OnClosed()
		{
			OnClosed();
		}

		bool IClosable.CanClose()
		{
			CancelEventArgs e = new CancelEventArgs();
			OnClosing(e);
			return !e.Cancel;
		}
	}
	public class DocumentPanel : LayoutPanel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty MDILocationProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MDISizeProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MDIStateProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RestoreBoundsProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty EnableMouseHoverWhenInactiveProperty;

		internal static Size DefaultMDISize;

		private bool isMDIChildCore;

		private LockHelper mdiStateLockHelper;

		public ICommand ActivateCommand { get; private set; }

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public bool EnableMouseHoverWhenInactive
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(EnableMouseHoverWhenInactiveProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(EnableMouseHoverWhenInactiveProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public Point MDILocation
		{
			get
			{
				return (Point)GetValue(MDILocationProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MDILocationProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public Size MDISize
		{
			get
			{
				return (Size)GetValue(MDISizeProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MDISizeProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public MDIState MDIState
		{
			get
			{
				return (MDIState)GetValue(MDIStateProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MDIStateProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[XtraSerializableProperty(1)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public Rect SerializableMDIBounds
		{
			get
			{
				if (MDIState != MDIState.Normal)
				{
					return GetRestoreBounds(this);
				}
				return new Rect(MDILocation, MDISize);
			}
			set
			{
				if (MDIState == MDIState.Normal)
				{
					MDILocation = RectHelper.Location(value);
					MDISize = RectHelper.Size(value);
				}
				else
				{
					SetRestoreBounds(this, value);
				}
			}
		}

		internal override bool SupportsFloatOrMDIState
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsMDIChild)
				{
					return base.SupportsFloatOrMDIState;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected internal bool IsMDIChild
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(base.Parent is DocumentGroup documentGroup))
				{
					return isMDIChildCore;
				}
				return !documentGroup.IsTabbed;
			}
			set
			{
				isMDIChildCore = value;
			}
		}

		protected internal bool IsMinimizedBeforeMaximize { get; set; }

		protected internal Size MDIDocumentSize { get; set; }

		protected internal Point? MinimizeLocation { get; set; }

		private LockHelper MdiStateLockHelper => mdiStateLockHelper ?? (mdiStateLockHelper = new LockHelper());

		static DocumentPanel()
		{
			DefaultMDISize = new Size(double.NaN, double.NaN);
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DocumentPanel> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DocumentPanel>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<DocumentPanel>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata(BaseLayoutItem.AllowHideProperty, defValue: false, null, CoerceAllowHide);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttached("MDILocation", ref MDILocationProperty, new Point(0.0, 0.0), OnMDILocationChanged, CoerceMDILocation);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttached("MDISize", ref MDISizeProperty, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.BindsTwoWayByDefault, DefaultMDISize, OnMDISizeChanged, CoerceMDISize);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttached("MDIState", ref MDIStateProperty, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.BindsTwoWayByDefault, MDIState.Normal, OnMDIStateChanged);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttached<Rect>("RestoreBounds", ref RestoreBoundsProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("EnableMouseHoverWhenInactive", ref EnableMouseHoverWhenInactiveProperty, defValue: false);
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DocumentPanel>.New().OverrideMetadata(LayoutPanel.MDIMergeStyleProperty, (object)(MDIMergeStyle)0, (Action<DocumentPanel>)null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None);
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedPropertyOwnerType(RestoreBoundsProperty.OwnerType);
			AttachedPropertyInfo.RegisterKnownAttachedPropertyType(MDIStateProperty);
		}

		private static object CoerceMDILocation(DependencyObject dObj, object value)
		{
			Point point = (Point)value;
			return new Point(Math.Max(0.0, point.X), Math.Max(0.0, point.Y));
		}

		private static object CoerceMDISize(DependencyObject dObj, object baseValue)
		{
			if (!(dObj is DocumentPanel))
			{
				return baseValue;
			}
			return ((DocumentPanel)dObj).CoerceMDISize((Size)baseValue);
		}

		internal override bool CoerceCanMerge(bool value)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (base.IsFloating || (int)base.MDIMergeStyle == 3)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.IsSelectedItem)
			{
				if (IsMDIChild)
				{
					return base.IsMaximized;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool CoerceIsCloseButtonVisible(bool value)
		{
			value = base.CoerceIsCloseButtonVisible(value);
			if (base.Parent is DocumentGroup documentGroup && base.IsTabPage)
			{
				switch (documentGroup.ClosePageButtonShowMode)
				{
				case ClosePageButtonShowMode.Default:
				case ClosePageButtonShowMode.InTabControlHeader:
				case ClosePageButtonShowMode.NoWhere:
					value = false;
					break;
				case ClosePageButtonShowMode.InActiveTabPageHeader:
				case ClosePageButtonShowMode.InActiveTabPageAndTabControlHeader:
					value &= documentGroup.SelectedItem == this;
					break;
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

			return false;
		}

				return;
			}
			BaseLayoutItem[] items = documentGroup.GetItems();
			if (items.Length != 0)

				if (base.Manager != null)
				{
					IUIElement iUIElement = documentGroup;
					iUIElement.Children.MakeLast(GetUIElement<IUIElement>());

		}

		private void ApplyMDIState(MDIState state)
		{
			DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = this.FindDockLayoutManager();
			if (dockLayoutManager == null || dockLayoutManager.IsDisposing)
			{
				MDIStateHelper.SetMDIState(this, state);
				return;
			}
			MDIState mDIState = MDIStateHelper.GetMDIState(this);
			switch (state)
			{
			case MDIState.Normal:
				if (mDIState != MDIState.Normal)
				{
					dockLayoutManager.MDIController.Restore(this);
				}
				break;
			case MDIState.Minimized:
				if (mDIState != MDIState.Minimized)
				{
					dockLayoutManager.MDIController.Minimize(this);
				}
				break;
			case MDIState.Maximized:
				if (mDIState != MDIState.Maximized)
				{
					dockLayoutManager.MDIController.Maximize(this);
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private void EnsureMDIState()
		{
			base.ParentLockHelper.DoWhenUnlocked(delegate
			{
				ApplyMDIState(MDIState);
				UpdateMinMaxState();
				UpdateButtons();
			});
		}
	}
	internal class MDIStateHelper
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty MDIStateProperty;

		static MDIStateHelper()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<MDIStateHelper> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<MDIStateHelper>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttached("MDIState", ref MDIStateProperty, MDIState.Normal, OnMDIStateChanged);
		}

		public static MDIState GetMDIState(DependencyObject target)
		{
			return (MDIState)target.GetValue(MDIStateProperty);
		}

		public static void SetMDIState(DependencyObject target, MDIState value)
		{
			target.SetValue(MDIStateProperty, value);
		}

		private static void OnMDIStateChanged(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			InvalidateMDIPanel(dObj);
			InvalidateMDIContainer(dObj);
			if (!(dObj is DocumentPanel documentPanel))
			{
				return;
			}
			MDIState mDIState = (MDIState)e.NewValue;
			bool flag = mDIState == MDIState.Minimized;
			bool flag2 = mDIState == MDIState.Maximized;
			if (flag || flag2)
			{
				if ((MDIState)e.OldValue == MDIState.Normal)
				{
					documentPanel.SetValue(DocumentPanel.RestoreBoundsProperty, GetMDIBounds(documentPanel));
					documentPanel.SetCurrentValue(DocumentPanel.MDISizeProperty, DocumentPanel.DefaultMDISize);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Rect restoreBounds = DocumentPanel.GetRestoreBounds(documentPanel);
				documentPanel.SetValue(DocumentPanel.MDILocationProperty, new Point(restoreBounds.X, restoreBounds.Y));
				if (MathHelper.IsEmpty(restoreBounds.Size))
				{
					Size mDISize = DocumentPanel.GetMDISize(dObj);
					restoreBounds.Width = mDISize.Width;
					restoreBounds.Height = mDISize.Height;
				}
				documentPanel.SetValue(DocumentPanel.MDISizeProperty, new Size(restoreBounds.Width, restoreBounds.Height));
				documentPanel.ClearValue(DocumentPanel.RestoreBoundsProperty);
			}
			if (documentPanel.Parent is DocumentGroup documentGroup)
			{
				documentGroup.IsMaximized = flag2;
			}
			if (documentPanel.MDIState != mDIState)
			{
				documentPanel.MDIState = mDIState;
			}
		}

		private static Rect GetMDIBounds(DependencyObject dObj)
		{
			return new Rect(DocumentPanel.GetMDILocation(dObj), DocumentPanel.GetMDISize(dObj));
		}

		public static void InvalidateMDIPanel(DependencyObject dObj)
		{
			if (VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dObj) is Panel panel)
			{
				panel.InvalidateMeasure();
			}
		}

		public static void InvalidateMDIContainer(DependencyObject dObj)
		{
			if (dObj != null)
			{
				LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<DocumentMDIContainer>(dObj)?.CoerceValue(DocumentMDIContainer.HasMaximizedDocumentsProperty);
			}
		}
	}
	public class MDIController : IMDIController, IActiveItemOwner, IDisposable, ILockOwner

		internal static class CascadeHelper
		{
			private static readonly double minWidth = 200.0;

			private static readonly double minHeight = 100.0;

			public static Rect[] GetBounds(Size size, int count, double offset)
			{
				Rect[] array = new Rect[count];
				double width = Math.Max(size.Width - (double)count * offset, minWidth);
				double height = Math.Max(size.Height - (double)count * offset, minHeight);
				Rect rect = new Rect(size);
				Point location = default(Point);
				int num = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					array[i] = new Rect(location, new Size(width, height));
					if (!rect.Contains(array[i]))
					{
						location = new Point((double)num++ * offset + offset / 2.0, 0.0);
						array[i].Location = location;
					}
					location.Offset(offset, offset);
				}
				return array;
			}

			public static BaseLayoutItem[] GetItemsToCascade(DocumentGroup group, bool f = false)
			{
				if (group == null)
				{
					return new BaseLayoutItem[0];
				}
				BaseLayoutItem[] items = group.GetItems();
				int num = items.Length - 1;
				if (f && group.SelectedItem != null)
				{
					int num2 = group.Items.IndexOf(group.SelectedItem);
					if (num2 < num)
					{
						Array.Copy(items, num2 + 1, items, num2, num - num2);
						items[num] = group.SelectedItem;
					}
				}
				return items;
			}
		}

		internal static class TileHelper
		{
			private static int GetColumnCount(int childrenCount, bool isHorizontal)
			{
				if (isHorizontal)
				{
					return (int)Math.Sqrt(childrenCount);
				}
				return childrenCount / (int)Math.Sqrt(childrenCount);
			}

			public static Rect[] TileLayout(int childrenCount, Rect bounds, bool isHorizontal)
			{
				Rect[] array = new Rect[childrenCount];
				double num = bounds.Width;
				double num2 = bounds.Height;
				Point location = bounds.Location;
				Size size = default(Size);
				int num3 = 0;
				if (isHorizontal)
				{
					int columnCount = GetColumnCount(childrenCount, isHorizontal);
					for (int num4 = columnCount; num4 > 0; num4--)
					{
						size.Width = num / (double)num4;
						num -= size.Width;
						int num5 = (childrenCount - num3) / num4;
						num2 = bounds.Height;
						for (int i = num3; i < num5 + num3; i++)
						{
							size.Height = num2 / (double)(num5 + num3 - i);
							num2 -= size.Height;
							array[i] = new Rect(location, size);
							location.Y += size.Height;
						}
						num3 += num5;
						location.X += size.Width;
						location.Y = bounds.Y;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					int columnCount2 = GetColumnCount(childrenCount, !isHorizontal);
					for (int num6 = columnCount2; num6 > 0; num6--)
					{
						size.Height = num2 / (double)num6;
						num2 -= size.Height;
						int num7 = (childrenCount - num3) / num6;
						num = bounds.Width;
						for (int j = num3; j < num7 + num3; j++)
						{
							size.Width = num / (double)(num7 + num3 - j);
							num -= size.Width;
							array[j] = new Rect(location, size);
							location.X += size.Width;
						}
						num3 += num7;
						location.Y += size.Height;
						location.X = bounds.X;
					}
				}
				return array;
			}

			public static Rect[] GetTiles(Size size, int count, bool horz)
			{
				Rect[] array = new Rect[count];
				if (size.Width * size.Height <= 0.0)
				{
					return array;
				}
				if (count < 4)
				{
					double num = 0.0;
					double num2 = 0.0;
					double num3 = (horz ? size.Width : size.Height) / (double)count;
					for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
					{
						array[i] = new Rect(num, num2, horz ? num3 : size.Width, horz ? size.Height : num3);
						if (horz)
						{
							num += num3;
						}
						else
						{
							num2 += num3;
						}
					}
					return array;
				}
				int num4 = (int)(Math.Sqrt(count) + 0.5);
				int num5 = (int)(Math.Sqrt((double)count * size.Width / size.Height) + 0.5);
				int num6 = (int)((double)count / (double)num5 + 0.5);
				if (num4 * num4 == count)
				{
					num5 = (num6 = num4);
				}
				double num7 = 0.0;
				double num8 = 0.0;
				double num9 = size.Width / (double)num5;
				double num10 = size.Height / (double)num6;
				int num11 = (horz ? num5 : num6);
				for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
				{
					array[j] = new Rect(num7, num8, num9, num10);
					if (horz)
					{
						num7 += num9;
						if ((j + 1) % num5 == 0)
						{
							num7 = 0.0;
							num8 += num10;
						}
						if (num6 > 1 && (j + 1) / num5 + 1 == num6)
						{
							num9 = size.Width / (double)(count - num5 * (num6 - 1));
						}
					}
					else
					{
						num8 += num10;
						if ((j + 1) % num6 == 0)
						{
							num8 = 0.0;
							num7 += num9;
						}
						if (num5 > 1 && (j + 1) / num6 + 1 == num5)
						{
							num10 = size.Height / (double)(count - num6 * (num5 - 1));
						}
					}
				}
				return array;
			}
		}

		private static void ApplyState(DocumentGroup documentGroup, DocumentPanel document, MDIState state)
		{
			if (documentGroup != null && (documentGroup.IsMaximized || state != MDIState.Normal))
			{
				foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in documentGroup.Items)
				{
					if (item is DocumentPanel documentPanel)
					{
						if (state == MDIState.Maximized)
						{
							documentPanel.IsMinimizedBeforeMaximize = documentPanel.IsMinimized;
						}
						MDIStateHelper.SetMDIState(documentPanel, GetActualMdiState(documentPanel, state));
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			MDIStateHelper.SetMDIState(document, GetActualMdiState(document, state));
		}

		private static MDIState GetActualMdiState(DocumentPanel document, MDIState state)
		{
			if (state == MDIState.Normal && document.IsMaximized && document.IsMinimizedBeforeMaximize)
			{
				state = MDIState.Minimized;
			}
			return state;
		}

		public MDIController(DockLayoutManager container)
		{
			containerCore = container;
			ActivationHelper = new ActiveItemHelper(this);
		}

		public void Activate(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			Activate(item, focus: true);
		}

		public void Activate(BaseLayoutItem item, bool focus)
		{
			if (lockActivateCounter > 0 || !(item is DocumentPanel) || !item.AllowActivate || item.IsClosed)
			{
				return;
			}
			lockActivateCounter++;
			try
			{
				if (RaiseItemCancelEvent(item, DockLayoutManager.MDIItemActivatingEvent))
				{
					item.InvokeCancelActivation(ActiveItem);
				}
				else
				{
					ActivationHelper.ActivateItem(item, focus);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				lockActivateCounter--;
			}
		}

		public bool ArrangeIcons(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item == null || item.IsClosed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DocumentGroup documentGroup = GetDocumentGroup(item);
			if (documentGroup != null && !documentGroup.IsUngroupped)
			{
				lockMinimizeBoundsCalculation++;
				BaseLayoutItem[] items = documentGroup.GetItems();
				for (int i = 0; i < items.Length; i++)
				{
					if (items[i] is DocumentPanel { IsMinimized: false } documentPanel)
					{
						Minimize(documentPanel);
					}
				}
				UpdateLayout(documentGroup);
				double num = 0.0;
				double num2 = 0.0;
				double height = GetMDIAreaSize(documentGroup).Height;
				for (int j = 0; j < items.Length; j++)
				{
					if (items[j] is DocumentPanel documentPanel2)
					{
						num2 = height - documentPanel2.MDIDocumentSize.Height;
						DocumentPanel.SetMDILocation(documentPanel2, new Point(num, num2));
						num += documentPanel2.MDIDocumentSize.Width;
					}
				}
				lockMinimizeBoundsCalculation--;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Cascade(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item == null || item.IsClosed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DocumentGroup documentGroup = GetDocumentGroup(item);
			if (documentGroup != null && !documentGroup.IsUngroupped)
			{
				UpdateLayout(documentGroup);
				BaseLayoutItem[] itemsToCascade = CascadeHelper.GetItemsToCascade(documentGroup, ActiveItem == documentGroup.SelectedItem);
				itemsToCascade = LayoutItemsHelper.SortByZIndex(itemsToCascade);
				double mDIDocumentHeaderHeight = GetMDIDocumentHeaderHeight(documentGroup);
				Size mDIAreaSize = GetMDIAreaSize(documentGroup);
				Rect[] bounds = CascadeHelper.GetBounds(mDIAreaSize, itemsToCascade.Length, mDIDocumentHeaderHeight);
				for (int i = 0; i < itemsToCascade.Length; i++)
				{
					if (itemsToCascade[i] is DocumentPanel documentPanel)
					{
						if (MDIStateHelper.GetMDIState(documentPanel) != MDIState.Normal)
						{
							Restore(documentPanel);
						}
						DocumentPanel.SetMDISize(documentPanel, RectHelper.Size(bounds[i]));
						DocumentPanel.SetMDILocation(documentPanel, RectHelper.Location(bounds[i]));
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool ChangeMDIStyle(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item == null || item.IsClosed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DocumentGroup documentGroup = GetDocumentGroup(item);
			if (documentGroup != null && !documentGroup.IsUngroupped)
			{
				documentGroup.ChangeMDIStyle();
				UpdateLayout(documentGroup);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public T CreateCommand<T>(BaseLayoutItem[] items) where T : MDIControllerCommand, new()
		{
			return new T
			{
				Controller = this,
				Items = items
			};
		}

		public bool Maximize(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (!CanMaximizeItem(item))
			{
				return false;
			}
			FloatGroup floatGroup = item.GetRoot() as FloatGroup;
			floatGroup.With((FloatGroup x) => x.FloatingWindowLock).Do(delegate(FloatingWindowLock x)
			{
				x.Lock(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.WindowState);
			});
			try
			{
				if (item is DocumentPanel)
				{
					return Maximize((DocumentPanel)item);
				}
				BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = floatGroup ?? item;
				baseLayoutItem.SetFloatState(FloatState.Maximized);
				Container.InvalidateView(item.GetRoot());
				return true;
			}
			finally
			{
				floatGroup.With((FloatGroup x) => x.FloatingWindowLock).Do(delegate(FloatingWindowLock x)
				{
					x.Unlock(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.WindowState);
				});
			}
		}

		public bool Maximize(DocumentPanel document)
		{
			if (!CanMaximizeItem(document))
			{
				return false;
			}
			FloatingWindowLock input = ((document.GetRoot() is FloatGroup floatGroup) ? floatGroup.FloatingWindowLock : null);
			input.Do(delegate(FloatingWindowLock x)
			{
				x.Lock(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.WindowState);
			});
			try
			{
				DocumentGroup documentGroup = document.Parent as DocumentGroup;
				FloatGroup floatGroup2 = document.Parent as FloatGroup;
				if (floatGroup2 != null || documentGroup != null)
				{
					ApplyState(documentGroup, document, MDIState.Maximized);
					if (floatGroup2 != null)
					{
						floatGroup2.SetFloatState(FloatState.Maximized);
						Container.InvalidateView(floatGroup2);
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			finally
			{
				input.Do(delegate(FloatingWindowLock x)
				{
					x.Unlock(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.WindowState);
				});
			}
		}

		public bool Minimize(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (!CanMinimizeItem(item))
			{
				return false;
			}
			FloatGroup floatGroup = item.GetRoot() as FloatGroup;
			floatGroup.With((FloatGroup x) => x.FloatingWindowLock).Do(delegate(FloatingWindowLock x)
			{
				x.Lock(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.WindowState);
			});
			try
			{
				if (item is DocumentPanel)
				{
					return Minimize((DocumentPanel)item);
				}
				BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = floatGroup ?? item;
				baseLayoutItem.SetFloatState(FloatState.Minimized);
				Container.InvalidateView(item.GetRoot());
				return true;
			}
			finally
			{
				floatGroup.With((FloatGroup x) => x.FloatingWindowLock).Do(delegate(FloatingWindowLock x)
				{
					x.Unlock(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.WindowState);
				});
			}
		}

		public bool Minimize(DocumentPanel document)
		{
			if (!CanMinimizeItem(document))
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = MDIStateHelper.GetMDIState(document) == MDIState.Maximized;
			if (flag && document.IsMinimizedBeforeMaximize)
			{
				return Restore(document);
			}
			DocumentGroup documentGroup = document.Parent as DocumentGroup;
			if (documentGroup != null)
			{
				if (documentGroup.IsTabbed)
				{
					return false;
				}
				Size mdiArea = Size.Empty;
				if (lockMinimizeBoundsCalculation == 0 || !document.MinimizeLocation.HasValue)
				{
					UpdateLayout(documentGroup);
					mdiArea = GetMDIAreaSize(documentGroup);
				}
				MDIStateHelper.SetMDIState(document, MDIState.Minimized);
				if (lockMinimizeBoundsCalculation == 0)
				{
					UpdateLayout(document);
					Action action = delegate
					{
						MinimizeCore(document, documentGroup, mdiArea);
					};
					if (flag)
					{
						InvokeHelper.BeginInvoke(document, action, DispatcherPriority.Render);
					}
					else
					{
						action();
					}
					RestoreOtherDocuments(documentGroup, document);
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (!document.IsMinimizable)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (document.Parent is FloatGroup floatGroup)
			{
				ApplyState(null, document, MDIState.Minimized);
				floatGroup.SetFloatState(FloatState.Minimized);
				Container.InvalidateView(floatGroup);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool Restore(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item == null || item.IsClosed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			FloatGroup floatGroup = item.GetRoot() as FloatGroup;
			if (LayoutItemsHelper.IsFloatingRootItem(item) || item is FloatGroup || item is DocumentPanel)
			{
				floatGroup.With((FloatGroup x) => x.FloatingWindowLock).Do(delegate(FloatingWindowLock x)
				{
					x.Lock(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.WindowState);
				});
				try
				{
					if (item is DocumentPanel)
					{
						return Restore((DocumentPanel)item);
					}
					BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = floatGroup ?? item;
					baseLayoutItem.SetFloatState(FloatState.Normal);
					Container.InvalidateView(item.GetRoot());
					return true;
				}
				finally
				{
					floatGroup.With((FloatGroup x) => x.FloatingWindowLock).Do(delegate(FloatingWindowLock x)
					{
						x.Unlock(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.WindowState);
					});
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Restore(DocumentPanel document)
		{
			if (document == null || document.IsClosed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			FloatingWindowLock input = ((document.GetRoot() is FloatGroup floatGroup) ? floatGroup.FloatingWindowLock : null);
			input.Do(delegate(FloatingWindowLock x)
			{
				x.Lock(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.WindowState);
			});
			try
			{
				if (!document.SupportsFloatOrMDIState)
				{
					return false;
				}
				DocumentGroup documentGroup = document.Parent as DocumentGroup;
				FloatGroup floatGroup2 = document.Parent as FloatGroup;
				if (floatGroup2 != null || documentGroup != null)
				{
					ApplyState(documentGroup, document, MDIState.Normal);
					if (floatGroup2 != null)
					{
						floatGroup2.SetFloatState(FloatState.Normal);
						Container.InvalidateView(floatGroup2);
					}
					ActivationHelper.RestoreKeyboardFocus(document);
				}
				return true;
			}
			finally
			{
				input.Do(delegate(FloatingWindowLock x)
				{
					x.Unlock(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.WindowState);
				});
			}
		}

		public bool TileHorizontal(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item == null || item.IsClosed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DocumentGroup documentGroup = GetDocumentGroup(item);
			if (documentGroup != null && !documentGroup.IsUngroupped)
			{
				BaseLayoutItem[] items = documentGroup.GetItems();
				Size mDIAreaSize = GetMDIAreaSize(documentGroup);
				Rect[] array = TileHelper.TileLayout(items.Length, new Rect(default(Point), mDIAreaSize), isHorizontal: true);
				for (int i = 0; i < items.Length; i++)
				{
					if (items[i] is DocumentPanel documentPanel)
					{
						if (MDIStateHelper.GetMDIState(documentPanel) != MDIState.Normal)
						{
							Restore(documentPanel);
						}
						DocumentPanel.SetMDILocation(documentPanel, RectHelper.Location(array[i]));
						DocumentPanel.SetMDISize(documentPanel, RectHelper.Size(array[i]));
					}
				}
				UpdateLayout(documentGroup);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool TileVertical(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item == null || item.IsClosed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DocumentGroup documentGroup = GetDocumentGroup(item);
			if (documentGroup != null && !documentGroup.IsUngroupped)
			{
				BaseLayoutItem[] items = documentGroup.GetItems();
				Size mDIAreaSize = GetMDIAreaSize(documentGroup);
				Rect[] array = TileHelper.TileLayout(items.Length, new Rect(default(Point), mDIAreaSize), isHorizontal: false);
				for (int i = 0; i < items.Length; i++)
				{
					if (items[i] is DocumentPanel documentPanel)
					{
						if (MDIStateHelper.GetMDIState(documentPanel) != MDIState.Normal)
						{
							Restore(documentPanel);
						}
						DocumentPanel.SetMDILocation(documentPanel, RectHelper.Location(array[i]));
						DocumentPanel.SetMDISize(documentPanel, RectHelper.Size(array[i]));
					}
				}
				UpdateLayout(documentGroup);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected void OnDisposing()
		{
			Ref.Dispose(ref ActivationHelper);
			activeItemCore = null;
			containerCore = null;
			mdiMenuManagerCore = null;
			mdiMenuBarCore = null;
		}

		private Point CalcMinimizeLocation(DocumentGroup dGroup, DocumentPanel document, Size mdiArea)
		{
			if (document.MinimizeLocation.HasValue)
			{
				return document.MinimizeLocation.Value;
			}
			BaseLayoutItem[] items = dGroup.GetItems();
			List<Rect> list = new List<Rect>();
			for (int i = 0; i < items.Length; i++)
			{
				if (items[i] is DocumentPanel { IsMinimized: not false } documentPanel && documentPanel != document && !documentPanel.MinimizeLocation.HasValue)
				{
					list.Add(new Rect(documentPanel.MDILocation, documentPanel.MDIDocumentSize));
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return new Point(0.0, mdiArea.Height - document.MDIDocumentSize.Height);
			}
			return CalcMinimizeLocationCore(list, document.MDIDocumentSize, mdiArea);
		}

		private Point CalcMinimizeLocationCore(List<Rect> rects, Size docSize, Size mdiArea)
		{
			rects.Sort((Rect a, Rect b) => a.Left.CompareTo(b.Left));
			double y = mdiArea.Height - docSize.Height;
			Rect test = new Rect(new Point(0.0, y), docSize);
			if (IsMinimizeLocationValid(test, rects, mdiArea))
			{
				return test.TopLeft;
			}
			foreach (Rect rect in rects)
			{
				test = new Rect(new Point(rect.Right, y), docSize);
				if (IsMinimizeLocationValid(test, rects, mdiArea))
				{
					return test.TopLeft;
				}
				test = new Rect(new Point(rect.Left - docSize.Width, y), docSize);
				if (IsMinimizeLocationValid(test, rects, mdiArea))
				{
					return test.TopLeft;
				}
			}
			return rects.Last().TopRight;
		}

		private bool IsMinimizeLocationValid(Rect test, List<Rect> rects, Size mdiArea)
		{
			if (test.Left < 0.0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (Rect rect in rects)
			{
				if (IsRectsIntersect(test, rect))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsRectsIntersect(Rect a, Rect b)
		{
			a.Intersect(b);
			if (!a.IsEmpty && !MathHelper.IsZero(a.Width))
			{
				return !MathHelper.IsZero(a.Height);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool CanMaximizeItem(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item != null && !item.IsClosed && item.AllowMaximize)
			{
				return item.IsMaximizable;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool CanMinimizeItem(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item != null && !item.IsClosed && item.AllowMinimize)
			{
				return item.IsMinimizable;
			}
			return false;
		}

		void IDisposable.Dispose()
		{
			if (!IsDisposing)
			{
				isDisposingCore = true;
				OnDisposing();
			}
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		private DocumentGroup GetDocumentGroup(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			DocumentPanel documentPanel = item as DocumentPanel;
			DocumentGroup documentGroup = item as DocumentGroup;
			if (documentGroup == null && documentPanel != null)
			{
				documentGroup = documentPanel.Parent as DocumentGroup;
			}
			return documentGroup;
		}

		private Size GetMDIAreaSize(DocumentGroup dGroup)
		{
			return dGroup.MDIAreaSize;
		}

		private double GetMDIDocumentHeaderHeight(DocumentGroup dGroup)
		{
			double mDIDocumentHeaderHeight = dGroup.MDIDocumentHeaderHeight;
			if (!double.IsNaN(mDIDocumentHeaderHeight))
			{
				return mDIDocumentHeaderHeight;
			}
			return 24.0;
		}

		private void LockActivate()
		{
			lockActivateCounter++;
		}

		private void MinimizeCore(DocumentPanel document, DocumentGroup documentGroup, Size mdiArea)
		{
			Point value = CalcMinimizeLocation(documentGroup, document, mdiArea);
			DocumentPanel.SetMDILocation(document, value);
		}

		private void OnMDIMenuBarItemLinksCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (((IMergingSupport)MDIMenuBar).IsMerged)
			{
				MDIControllerHelper.UnMergeMDIMenuItems((DependencyObject)(object)MDIMenuBar);
				MDIControllerHelper.MergeMDIMenuItems((DependencyObject)(object)MDIMenuBar);
			}
		}

		private void RaiseActiveItemChanged(DocumentPanel item, DocumentPanel oldItem)
		{
			Container.RaiseEvent(new MDIItemActivatedEventArgs(item, oldItem)
			{
				Source = Container
			});
		}

		private bool RaiseItemCancelEvent(BaseLayoutItem item, RoutedEvent routedEvent)
		{
			return Container.RaiseItemCancelEvent(item, routedEvent);
		}

		private void RestoreOtherDocuments(DocumentGroup dGroup, DocumentPanel document)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem[] items = dGroup.GetItems();
			for (int i = 0; i < items.Length; i++)
			{
				if (items[i] is DocumentPanel documentPanel && documentPanel != document && documentPanel.IsMaximized)
				{
					Restore(documentPanel);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetActive(bool value)
		{
			if (ActiveItem != null)
			{
				ActiveItem.SetActive(value);
				if (value && lockActivateCounter == 0)
				{
					ActivationHelper.SelectInGroup(ActiveItem);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetActiveItemCore(DocumentPanel value)
		{
			SetActive(value: false);
			DocumentPanel oldItem = activeItemCore;
			activeItemCore = value;
			SetActive(value: true);
			Container.isMDIItemActivation++;
			Container.ActiveMDIItem = ActiveItem;
			Container.isMDIItemActivation--;
			RaiseActiveItemChanged(value, oldItem);
		}

		private void UnlockActivate()
		{
			lockActivateCounter--;
		}

		void ILockOwner.Lock()
		{
			LockActivate();
		}

		void ILockOwner.Unlock()
		{
			UnlockActivate();
		}
	}
	public abstract class MDIControllerCommand : ICommand
	{
		private class MDIControllerCommandLink : RoutedCommand
		{
			public MDIControllerCommand Command { get; private set; }

			public MDIControllerCommandLink(string name, MDIControllerCommand command)
				: base(name, typeof(MDIControllerCommand))
			{
				Command = command;
			}
		}

		protected internal IMDIController Controller { get; set; }

		protected internal BaseLayoutItem[] Items { get; set; }

		public static RoutedCommand Maximize { get; private set; }

		public static RoutedCommand Minimize { get; private set; }

		public static RoutedCommand Restore { get; private set; }

		public static RoutedCommand TileVertical { get; private set; }

		public static RoutedCommand TileHorizontal { get; private set; }

		public static RoutedCommand Cascade { get; private set; }

		public static RoutedCommand ArrangeIcons { get; private set; }

		public static RoutedCommand ChangeMDIStyle { get; private set; }

		private event EventHandler CanExecuteChangedCore;

		event EventHandler ICommand.CanExecuteChanged
		{
			add
			{
				CanExecuteChangedCore += value;
			}
			remove
			{
				CanExecuteChangedCore -= value;
			}
		}

		internal MDIControllerCommand()
		{
		}

		protected abstract void ExecuteCore(IMDIController controller, BaseLayoutItem[] items);

		protected abstract bool CanExecuteCore(IMDIController controller, BaseLayoutItem[] items);

		protected void RaiseCanExecuteChanged()
		{
			if (this.CanExecuteChangedCore != null)
			{
				this.CanExecuteChangedCore(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		bool ICommand.CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (Items == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return CanExecuteCore(Controller, Items);
		}

		void ICommand.Execute(object parameter)
		{
			ExecuteCore(Controller, Items);
		}

		static MDIControllerCommand()
		{
			Maximize = new MDIControllerCommandLink("Maximize", new MaximizeDocumentCommand());
			Minimize = new MDIControllerCommandLink("Minimize", new MinimizeDocumentCommand());
			Restore = new MDIControllerCommandLink("Restore", new RestoreDocumentCommand());
			TileVertical = new MDIControllerCommandLink("TileVertical", new TileVerticalCommand());
			TileHorizontal = new MDIControllerCommandLink("TileHorizontal", new TileHorizontalCommand());
			Cascade = new MDIControllerCommandLink("Cascade", new CascadeCommand());
			ArrangeIcons = new MDIControllerCommandLink("ArrangeIcons", new ArrangeIconsCommand());
			ChangeMDIStyle = new MDIControllerCommandLink("ChangeMDIStyle", new ChangeMDIStyleCommand());
		}

		internal static void CanExecute(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			IMDIController mDIController = MDIControllerHelper.GetMDIController(sender);
			BaseLayoutItem[] array = e.Parameter as BaseLayoutItem[];
			if (e.Parameter is BaseLayoutItem)
			{
				array = new BaseLayoutItem[1] { (BaseLayoutItem)e.Parameter };
			}
			MDIControllerCommand command = ((MDIControllerCommandLink)e.Command).Command;
			e.CanExecute = mDIController != null && array != null && command.CanExecuteCore(mDIController, array);
		}

		internal static void Executed(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			IMDIController mDIController = MDIControllerHelper.GetMDIController(sender);
			BaseLayoutItem[] array = e.Parameter as BaseLayoutItem[];
			if (e.Parameter is BaseLayoutItem)
			{
				array = new BaseLayoutItem[1] { (BaseLayoutItem)e.Parameter };
			}
			if (mDIController != null && array != null)
			{
				MDIControllerCommand command = ((MDIControllerCommandLink)e.Command).Command;
				command.ExecuteCore(mDIController, array);
			}
		}
	}
	public class MaximizeDocumentCommand : MDIControllerCommand
	{
		protected override bool CanExecuteCore(IMDIController controller, BaseLayoutItem[] items)
		{
			if (items.Length == 1)
			{
				return items[0].AllowMaximize;
			}
			return items.Length != 0;
		}

		protected override void ExecuteCore(IMDIController controller, BaseLayoutItem[] items)
		{
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem in items)
			{
				controller.Maximize(baseLayoutItem as DocumentPanel);
			}
		}
	}

	public class ChangeMDIStyleCommand : MDIControllerCommand
	{
		protected override bool CanExecuteCore(IMDIController controller, BaseLayoutItem[] items)
		{
			return items.Length != 0;
		}

		protected override void ExecuteCore(IMDIController controller, BaseLayoutItem[] items)
		{
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in items)
			{
				controller.ChangeMDIStyle(item);
			}
		}
	}
	public static class MDIControllerHelper
	{
		internal static void Restore(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item is DocumentPanel)
			{
				DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = item.FindDockLayoutManager() ?? DockLayoutManager.FindManager(item);
				if (dockLayoutManager != null && !dockLayoutManager.IsDisposing)
				{
					dockLayoutManager.MDIController.Restore((DocumentPanel)item);
				}
			}
		}

		public static T CreateCommand<T>(DockLayoutManager container, BaseLayoutItem[] items) where T : MDIControllerCommand, new()
		{
			IMDIController mDIController = GetMDIController(container);
			if (mDIController == null)

		}

		}

			if (dockLayoutManager == null)

				dockLayoutManager = ((obj is DependencyObject obj2) ? DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager(obj2) : null);
