			return GetMDIController(dockLayoutManager);
		}

		public static void MergeMDITitles(DependencyObject dObj)
		{
			if (dObj == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager(dObj);
			if (dockLayoutManager != null && dockLayoutManager.ShowMaximizedDocumentCaptionInWindowTitle)
			{
				BaseLayoutItem layoutItem = DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(dObj);
				if (layoutItem != null)
				{
					dockLayoutManager.SetMDIChildrenTitle(layoutItem.Caption as string);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void UnMergeMDITitles(DependencyObject dObj)
		{
			if (dObj != null)
			{
				DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager(dObj)?.ResetMDIChildrenTitle();
			}
		}

		internal static void DoMerge(BaseLayoutItem document)
		{
			DoMergeOrUnMerge(document, merge: true);
		}

		internal static void DoUnMerge(BaseLayoutItem document)
		{
			DoMergeOrUnMerge(document, merge: false);
		}

		private static void DoMergeOrUnMerge(BaseLayoutItem document, bool merge)
		{
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0010: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (document == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ElementMergingBehavior elementMergingBehavior = GetElementMergingBehavior(document);
			if (!merge && (int)elementMergingBehavior != 4)
			{
				return;
			}
			DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = document.GetDockLayoutManager();
			if (dockLayoutManager != null)
			{
				BarManager barManager = BarManager.GetBarManager((DependencyObject)dockLayoutManager);
				BarManager val = FindChildBarManager(document);
				if (val == null || (merge ? RaiseMerge(dockLayoutManager, barManager, val) : RaiseUnMerge(dockLayoutManager, barManager, val)))
				{
					SetElementMergingBehavior(document, (ElementMergingBehavior)(merge ? 4 : 3));
				}
			}
		}

		private static ElementMergingBehavior GetElementMergingBehavior(BaseLayoutItem document)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return MergingProperties.GetElementMergingBehavior((DependencyObject)document);
		}

		private static void SetElementMergingBehavior(BaseLayoutItem document, ElementMergingBehavior value)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!DependencyObjectExtensions.IsPropertySet((DependencyObject)document, MergingProperties.ElementMergingBehaviorProperty))
			{
				document.SetCurrentValue(MergingProperties.ElementMergingBehaviorProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public static bool MergeMDIMenuItems(DependencyObject dObj)
		{
			MDIMenuBar mDIMenuBar = dObj.With(DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager).With(GetMDIController).With((IMDIController x) => x.MDIMenuBar);
			if (mDIMenuBar == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			MergingProperties.SetElementMergingBehavior((DependencyObject)(object)mDIMenuBar, (ElementMergingBehavior)2);
			return ((IMergingSupport)mDIMenuBar).IsMerged;
		}

		public static void UnMergeMDIMenuItems(DependencyObject dObj)
		{
			MDIMenuBar mDIMenuBar = dObj.With(DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager).With(GetMDIController).With((IMDIController x) => x.MDIMenuBar);
			if (mDIMenuBar != null)
			{
				MergingProperties.SetElementMergingBehavior((DependencyObject)(object)mDIMenuBar, (ElementMergingBehavior)1);
			}
		}

		private static bool RaiseMerge(DockLayoutManager manager, BarManager parent, BarManager child)
		{
			BarMergeEventArgs e = new BarMergeEventArgs(parent, child)
			{
				RoutedEvent = DockLayoutManager.MergeEvent
			};
			manager.RaiseEvent(e);
			return !e.Cancel;
		}

		private static bool RaiseUnMerge(DockLayoutManager manager, BarManager parent, BarManager child)
		{
			BarMergeEventArgs e = new BarMergeEventArgs(parent, child)
			{
				RoutedEvent = DockLayoutManager.UnMergeEvent
			};
			manager.RaiseEvent(e);
			return !e.Cancel;
		}

		public static BarManager FindChildBarManager(DependencyObject element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			using (IEnumerator<DependencyObject> enumerator = LayoutItemsHelper.GetEnumerator(element, null))
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					if (enumerator.Current is BarManager)
					{
						DependencyObject current = enumerator.Current;
						return (BarManager)(object)((current is BarManager) ? current : null);
					}
					if (enumerator.Current is IUIElement && enumerator.Current != element)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static MDIMergeStyle GetActualMDIMergeStyle(DockLayoutManager manager, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			MDIMergeStyle mDIMergeStyle = LayoutPanel.GetMDIMergeStyle(item);
			if ((int)mDIMergeStyle == 0 && manager != null)
			{
				return manager.MDIMergeStyle;
			}
			return mDIMergeStyle;
		}
	}

	internal static class MergingHelper
	{
		private static readonly object syncObj = new object();

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static IList<WeakReference> clients;

		private static IList<WeakReference> Clients => clients ?? (clients = new List<WeakReference>());

		public static void AddMergingClient(IMergingClient client)
		{
			lock (syncObj)
			{
				object[] array = Purge();
				if (Array.IndexOf(array, client) == -1)
				{
					_ = Clients.Count;
					Clients.Add(new WeakReference(client));
				}
			}
		}

		public static void RemoveClient(IMergingClient client)
		{
			lock (syncObj)
			{
				WeakReference[] array = new WeakReference[Clients.Count];
				Clients.CopyTo(array, 0);
				foreach (WeakReference weakReference in array)
				{
					object target = weakReference.Target;
					if (target == null || target == client)
					{
						Clients.Remove(weakReference);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public static void DoMerging()
		{
			lock (syncObj)
			{
				object[] array = Purge();
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					if (array[i] is IMergingClient mergingClient)
					{
						mergingClient.Merge();
						RemoveClient(mergingClient);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private static object[] Purge()
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			WeakReference[] array = new WeakReference[Clients.Count];
			Clients.CopyTo(array, 0);
			foreach (WeakReference weakReference in array)
			{
				object target = weakReference.Target;
				if (target == null)
				{
					Clients.Remove(weakReference);
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(target);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}
	}
	public interface IResizeCalculator
	{
		Orientation Orientation { get; set; }

		void Resize(BaseLayoutItem item1, BaseLayoutItem item2, double change);

		void Init(SplitBehavior splitBehavior);
	}
	public enum SplitBehavior
	{
		Split,
		Resize1,
		Resize2,
		PixelSplit
	}
	internal class ResizeData
	{
		public DefinitionBase Definition1;

		public int Definition1Index;

		public DefinitionBase Definition2;

		public int Definition2Index;

		public Grid Grid;

		public double OriginalDefinition1ActualLength;

		public GridLength OriginalDefinition1Length;

		public double OriginalDefinition2ActualLength;

		public GridLength OriginalDefinition2Length;

		public GridResizeDirection ResizeDirection;

		public SplitBehavior SplitBehavior;

		public int SplitterIndex;

		public double SplitterLength;
	}
	internal abstract class BaseResizeCalculator : IResizeCalculator
	{
		public SplitBehavior SplitBehavior { get; set; }

		public Orientation Orientation { get; set; }

		public abstract void Resize(BaseLayoutItem item1, BaseLayoutItem item2, double change);

		public virtual void Init(SplitBehavior splitBehavior)
		{
			SplitBehavior = splitBehavior;
		}

		protected virtual double GetMin(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			bool flag = Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal;
			if (item is FixedItem)
			{
				return 5.0;
			}
			if (item is LayoutPanel)
			{
				return flag ? 12 : 18;
			}
			if (item is TabbedGroup)
			{
				return 24.0;
			}
			if (item is LayoutControlItem)
			{
				return flag ? 24 : 10;
			}
			return 12.0;
		}

		protected double GetActualLength(DefinitionBase definition)
		{
			if (definition is ColumnDefinition columnDefinition)
			{
				return columnDefinition.ActualWidth;
			}
			return ((RowDefinition)definition).ActualHeight;
		}
	}
	internal class RecursiveResizeCalculator : BaseResizeCalculator
	{
		public class ResizeInfo
		{
			public double Length { get; set; }

			public GridUnitType GridUnitType { get; set; }

			public BaseLayoutItem Item { get; set; }

			public GridLength ToRoundedGridLength()
			{
				return new GridLength(Math.Round(Length, 5, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero), GridUnitType);
			}
		}

		protected List<ResizeInfo> Infos = new List<ResizeInfo>();

		private Dictionary<object, double> StarsHash = new Dictionary<object, double>();

		private Dictionary<object, double> PixelHash = new Dictionary<object, double>();

		private static double AbsMin(double value1, double value2)
		{
			return Math.Min(Math.Abs(value1), Math.Abs(value2));
		}

		private double MeasureChange(BaseLayoutItem def1, BaseLayoutItem def2, double change)
		{
			double num = change;
			if (def1 is LayoutGroup)
			{
				LayoutGroup layoutGroup = (LayoutGroup)def1;
				if (CanMeasureRecursively(layoutGroup))
				{
					BaseLayoutItem itemToResize = GetItemToResize(layoutGroup, first: false);
					if (itemToResize != null)
					{
						num = AbsMin(num, MeasureChangeRecursive(itemToResize, def2, change));
					}
				}
			}
			if (def2 is LayoutGroup)
			{
				LayoutGroup layoutGroup2 = (LayoutGroup)def2;
				if (CanMeasureRecursively(layoutGroup2))
				{
					BaseLayoutItem itemToResize2 = GetItemToResize(layoutGroup2, first: true);
					if (itemToResize2 != null)
					{
						num = AbsMin(num, MeasureChangeRecursive(itemToResize2, def1, 0.0 - change, first: false));
					}
				}
			}
			DefinitionBase definition = DefinitionsHelper.GetDefinition(def1);
			DefinitionBase definition2 = DefinitionsHelper.GetDefinition(def2);
			double effectiveLength = GetEffectiveLength(definition);
			double effectiveLength2 = GetEffectiveLength(definition2);
			double num2 = effectiveLength + effectiveLength2;
			double val = Math.Min(GetMin(def1) + GetMin(def2), num2 * 0.5);
			double max;
			if (change < 0.0)
			{
				val = Math.Max(val, DefinitionsHelper.UserMinSizeValueCache(definition));
				max = Math.Max(num2 - val, DefinitionsHelper.UserMinSizeValueCache(definition2));
			}
			else
			{
				val = Math.Max(val, DefinitionsHelper.UserMinSizeValueCache(definition2));
				max = Math.Max(num2 - val, DefinitionsHelper.UserMinSizeValueCache(definition));
			}
			double num3 = MathHelper.MeasureDimension(val, max, effectiveLength + change);
			double num4 = MathHelper.MeasureDimension(val, max, effectiveLength2 - change);
			num = AbsMin(num3 - effectiveLength, num);
			num = AbsMin(num4 - effectiveLength2, num);
			if (!(change < 0.0))
			{
				return num;
			}
			return 0.0 - num;
		}

		private double MeasureChangeRecursive(BaseLayoutItem def1, BaseLayoutItem def2, double change, bool first = true)
		{
			DefinitionBase definition = DefinitionsHelper.GetDefinition(def1);
			DefinitionBase definition2 = DefinitionsHelper.GetDefinition(def2);
			double actualLength = GetActualLength(definition);
			double actualLength2 = GetActualLength(definition2);
			double num = actualLength + actualLength2;
			double val = Math.Min(GetMin(def1) + GetMin(def2), num * 0.5);
			val = Math.Max(val, DefinitionsHelper.UserMinSizeValueCache(definition));
			double max = Math.Min(num - val, DefinitionsHelper.UserMaxSizeValueCache(definition));
			double num2 = MathHelper.MeasureDimension(val, max, actualLength + change);
			double value = change;
			if (def1 is LayoutGroup)
			{
				LayoutGroup layoutGroup = (LayoutGroup)def1;
				if (CanMeasureRecursively(layoutGroup))
				{
					BaseLayoutItem itemToResize = GetItemToResize(layoutGroup, first);
					if (itemToResize != null)
					{
						value = AbsMin(value, MeasureChangeRecursive(itemToResize, def2, change));
					}
				}
			}
			return AbsMin(value, actualLength - num2);
		}

		protected virtual bool CanMeasureRecursively(LayoutGroup group)
		{
			if (group.Orientation == base.Orientation && !group.IgnoreOrientation)
			{
				return !group.IsControlItemsHost;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private BaseLayoutItem GetItemToResize(LayoutGroup group, bool first)
		{
			IEnumerable<BaseLayoutItem> enumerable;
			if (!first)
			{
				enumerable = group.Items.Reverse();
			}
			else
			{
				IEnumerable<BaseLayoutItem> enumerable2 = group.Items.ToArray();
				enumerable = enumerable2;
			}
			IEnumerable<BaseLayoutItem> enumerable3 = enumerable;
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in enumerable3)
			{
				if (LayoutItemsHelper.IsResizable(item, group.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal))
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private double GetHashedPixelValue(LayoutGroup parent)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			if (!PixelHash.Keys.Contains(parent))
			{
				foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in parent.Items)
				{
					DefinitionBase definition = DefinitionsHelper.GetDefinition(item);
					if (DefinitionsHelper.IsStar(definition))
					{
						num += DefinitionsHelper.UserActualSizeValueCache(definition);
					}
				}
				PixelHash.Add(parent, num);
			}
			else
			{
				num = PixelHash[parent];
			}
			return num;
		}

		private double GetHashedStarValue(LayoutGroup parent)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			if (!StarsHash.Keys.Contains(parent))
			{
				foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in parent.Items)
				{
					DefinitionBase definition = DefinitionsHelper.GetDefinition(item);
					if (DefinitionsHelper.IsStar(definition))
					{
						num += DefinitionsHelper.UserSizeValueCache(definition).Value;
					}
				}
				StarsHash.Add(parent, num);
			}
			else
			{
				num = StarsHash[parent];
			}
			return num;
		}

		private void Measure(BaseLayoutItem def1, BaseLayoutItem def2, double change)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			if (def1 is LayoutGroup)
			{
				LayoutGroup layoutGroup = (LayoutGroup)def1;
				if (CanMeasureRecursively(layoutGroup))
				{
					BaseLayoutItem itemToResize = GetItemToResize(layoutGroup, first: false);
					if (itemToResize != null)
					{
						flag = MeasureRecursive(itemToResize, def2, change);
					}
				}
			}
			if (flag && def2 is LayoutGroup)
			{
				LayoutGroup layoutGroup2 = (LayoutGroup)def2;
				if (CanMeasureRecursively(layoutGroup2))
				{
					BaseLayoutItem itemToResize2 = GetItemToResize(layoutGroup2, first: true);
					if (itemToResize2 != null)
					{
						flag = MeasureRecursive(itemToResize2, def1, 0.0 - change, first: false);
					}
				}
			}
			DefinitionBase definition = DefinitionsHelper.GetDefinition(def1);
			DefinitionBase definition2 = DefinitionsHelper.GetDefinition(def2);
			change = GetChange(definition, definition2, change);
			double effectiveLength = GetEffectiveLength(definition);
			double effectiveLength2 = GetEffectiveLength(definition2);
			double num = effectiveLength + change;
			double num2 = effectiveLength2 - change;
			if (effectiveLength == num || effectiveLength2 == num2 || !flag)
			{
				Infos.Clear();
				return;
			}
			switch (base.SplitBehavior)
			{
			case SplitBehavior.Split:
			{
				if (!StarsHash.Keys.Contains(definition))
				{
					StarsHash.Add(definition, DefinitionsHelper.UserSizeValueCache(definition).Value);
				}
				if (!StarsHash.Keys.Contains(definition2))
				{
					StarsHash.Add(definition2, DefinitionsHelper.UserSizeValueCache(definition2).Value);
				}
				double num3 = num / (num + num2);
				double num4 = StarsHash[definition] + StarsHash[definition2];
				num = num3 * num4;
				num2 = (1.0 - num3) * num4;
				Infos.Add(new ResizeInfo
				{
					Length = num,
					GridUnitType = GridUnitType.Star,
					Item = def1
				});
				Infos.Add(new ResizeInfo
				{
					Length = num2,
					GridUnitType = GridUnitType.Star,
					Item = def2
				});
				break;
			}
			case SplitBehavior.Resize1:
			{
				LayoutGroup parent2 = def1.Parent;
				double hashedStarValue2 = GetHashedStarValue(parent2);
				double hashedPixelValue2 = GetHashedPixelValue(parent2);
				num2 = num2 / hashedPixelValue2 * hashedStarValue2;
				Infos.Add(new ResizeInfo
				{
					Length = num,
					GridUnitType = GridUnitType.Pixel,
					Item = def1
				});
				Infos.Add(new ResizeInfo
				{
					Length = num2,
					GridUnitType = GridUnitType.Star,
					Item = def2
				});
				break;
			}
			case SplitBehavior.Resize2:
			{
				LayoutGroup parent = def1.Parent;
				double hashedStarValue = GetHashedStarValue(parent);
				double hashedPixelValue = GetHashedPixelValue(parent);
				num = num / hashedPixelValue * hashedStarValue;
				Infos.Add(new ResizeInfo
				{
					Length = num2,
					GridUnitType = GridUnitType.Pixel,
					Item = def2
				});
				Infos.Add(new ResizeInfo
				{
					Length = num,
					GridUnitType = GridUnitType.Star,
					Item = def1
				});
				break;
			}
			case SplitBehavior.PixelSplit:
				Infos.Add(new ResizeInfo
				{
					Length = num,
					GridUnitType = GridUnitType.Pixel,
					Item = def1
				});
				Infos.Add(new ResizeInfo
				{
					Length = num2,
					GridUnitType = GridUnitType.Pixel,
					Item = def2
				});
				break;
			}
		}

		private bool MeasureRecursive(BaseLayoutItem def1, BaseLayoutItem def2, double change, bool first = true)
		{
			DefinitionBase definition = DefinitionsHelper.GetDefinition(def1);
			DefinitionBase definition2 = DefinitionsHelper.GetDefinition(def2);
			change = GetChange(definition, definition2, change);
			double actualLength = GetActualLength(definition);
			double actualLength2 = GetActualLength(definition2);
			double num = actualLength + actualLength2;
			double num2 = Math.Min(GetMin(def1) + GetMin(def2), num * 0.5);
			double num3 = actualLength + change;
			if (actualLength + change < num2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (def1 is LayoutGroup && ((LayoutGroup)def1).Orientation == base.Orientation && !((LayoutGroup)def1).IgnoreOrientation)
			{
				LayoutGroup layoutGroup = (LayoutGroup)def1;
				BaseLayoutItem itemToResize = GetItemToResize(layoutGroup, first);
				if (itemToResize != null)
				{
					MeasureRecursive(itemToResize, def2, change);
				}
			}
			if (DefinitionsHelper.IsStar(definition))
			{
				LayoutGroup parent = def1.Parent;
				double hashedStarValue = GetHashedStarValue(parent);
				double hashedPixelValue = GetHashedPixelValue(parent);
				num3 = num3 / hashedPixelValue * hashedStarValue;
				Infos.Add(new ResizeInfo
				{
					Length = num3,
					GridUnitType = GridUnitType.Star,
					Item = def1
				});
			}
			if (DefinitionsHelper.IsAbsolute(definition))
			{
				Infos.Add(new ResizeInfo
				{
					Length = num3,
					GridUnitType = GridUnitType.Pixel,
					Item = def1
				});
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual void ApplyMeasure()
		{
			foreach (ResizeInfo info in Infos)
			{
				if (MathHelper.IsConstraintValid(info.Length))
				{
					info.Item.ResizeLockHelper.Lock();
					info.Item.SetValue((base.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal) ? BaseLayoutItem.ItemWidthProperty : BaseLayoutItem.ItemHeightProperty, info.ToRoundedGridLength());
				}
			}
			Infos.Clear();
		}

		private double GetChange(DefinitionBase def1, DefinitionBase def2, double change)
		{
			GetDeltaConstraints(def1, def2, out var minDelta, out var maxDelta);
			return Math.Min(Math.Max(change, minDelta), maxDelta);
		}

		private void GetDeltaConstraints(DefinitionBase def1, DefinitionBase def2, out double minDelta, out double maxDelta)
		{
			double actualLength = GetActualLength(def1);
			double actualLength2 = GetActualLength(def2);
			double num = DefinitionsHelper.UserMinSizeValueCache(def1);
			double num2 = DefinitionsHelper.UserMaxSizeValueCache(def1);
			double num3 = DefinitionsHelper.UserMinSizeValueCache(def2);
			double num4 = DefinitionsHelper.UserMaxSizeValueCache(def2);
			minDelta = 0.0 - Math.Min(actualLength - num, num4 - actualLength2);
			maxDelta = Math.Min(num2 - actualLength, actualLength2 - num3);
		}

		public override void Resize(BaseLayoutItem def1, BaseLayoutItem def2, double change)
		{
			double change2 = MeasureChange(def1, def2, change);
			Measure(def1, def2, change2);
			ApplyMeasure();
		}

		public override void Init(SplitBehavior splitBehavior)
		{
			base.Init(splitBehavior);
			StarsHash.Clear();
			PixelHash.Clear();
			Infos.Clear();
		}

		private double GetEffectiveLength(DefinitionBase definition)
		{
			GridLength length = definition.GetLength();
			double actualLength = definition.GetActualLength();
			if (!length.IsAbsolute)
			{
				return actualLength;
			}
			return Math.Min(actualLength, length.Value);
		}
	}
	internal class LayoutResizeCalculator : RecursiveResizeCalculator
	{
		protected override bool CanMeasureRecursively(LayoutGroup group)
		{
			return false;
		}
	}
	public static class DefinitionsHelper
	{
		internal static GridLength ZeroLength = new GridLength(0.0);

		internal static GridLength ZeroStarLength = new GridLength(0.0, GridUnitType.Star);

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DefinitionProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("Definition", typeof(DefinitionBase), typeof(DefinitionsHelper), null);

		internal static bool IsZero(DefinitionBase definition)
		{
			return UserSizeValueCache(definition).Equals(ZeroLength);
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public static DefinitionBase GetDefinition(DependencyObject target)
		{
			return (DefinitionBase)target.GetValue(DefinitionProperty);
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public static void SetDefinition(DependencyObject target, DefinitionBase value)
		{
			target.SetValue(DefinitionProperty, value);
		}

		private static bool IsColumnDefinition(DefinitionBase def)
		{
			return def is ColumnDefinition;
		}

		public static double UserMinSizeValueCache(DefinitionBase def)
		{
			return (double)def.GetValue(IsColumnDefinition(def) ? ColumnDefinition.MinWidthProperty : RowDefinition.MinHeightProperty);
		}

		public static double UserMaxSizeValueCache(DefinitionBase def)
		{
			return (double)def.GetValue(IsColumnDefinition(def) ? ColumnDefinition.MaxWidthProperty : RowDefinition.MaxHeightProperty);
		}

		public static bool IsStar(DefinitionBase def)
		{
			return UserSizeValueCache(def).IsStar;
		}

		public static bool IsAbsolute(DefinitionBase def)
		{
			return UserSizeValueCache(def).IsAbsolute;
		}

		public static GridLength UserSizeValueCache(DefinitionBase def)
		{
			return (GridLength)def.GetValue(IsColumnDefinition(def) ? ColumnDefinition.WidthProperty : RowDefinition.HeightProperty);
		}

		public static double UserActualSizeValueCache(DefinitionBase def)
		{
			if (!IsColumnDefinition(def))
			{
				return ((RowDefinition)def).ActualHeight;
			}
			return ((ColumnDefinition)def).ActualWidth;
		}

		public static double GetActualLength(this DefinitionBase def)
		{
			return UserActualSizeValueCache(def);
		}

		public static GridLength GetLength(this DefinitionBase def)
		{
			return UserSizeValueCache(def);
		}

		internal static double GetMaxLength(this DefinitionBase def)
		{
			return (double)def.GetValue(IsColumnDefinition(def) ? ColumnDefinition.MaxWidthProperty : RowDefinition.MaxHeightProperty);
		}

		internal static double GetMinLength(this DefinitionBase def)
		{
			return (double)def.GetValue(IsColumnDefinition(def) ? ColumnDefinition.MinWidthProperty : RowDefinition.MinHeightProperty);
		}

		internal static void SetMaxSize(this DefinitionBase def, Size maxSize)
		{
			bool flag = IsColumnDefinition(def);
			DependencyProperty dp = (flag ? ColumnDefinition.MaxWidthProperty : RowDefinition.MaxHeightProperty);
			double num = (flag ? maxSize.Width : maxSize.Height);
			if (IsConstraintValid(num))
			{
				def.SetValue(dp, num);
			}
			else
			{
				def.ClearValue(dp);
			}
		}

		internal static void SetMinSize(this DefinitionBase def, Size minSize)
		{
			bool flag = IsColumnDefinition(def);
			DependencyProperty dp = (flag ? ColumnDefinition.MinWidthProperty : RowDefinition.MinHeightProperty);
			double num = (flag ? minSize.Width : minSize.Height);
			if (IsConstraintValid(num))
			{
				def.SetValue(dp, num);
			}
		}

		private static bool IsConstraintValid(double value)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(value))
			{
				return !double.IsInfinity(value);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public class TabbedGroup : LayoutGroup
	{
		private class DefaultTemplateSelector : DefaultItemTemplateSelectorWrapper.DefaultItemTemplateSelector
		{
			public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
			{
				TabbedPaneContentPresenter tabbedPaneContentPresenter = container as TabbedPaneContentPresenter;
				if (item is TabbedGroup && tabbedPaneContentPresenter != null && tabbedPaneContentPresenter.Owner != null)
				{
					return tabbedPaneContentPresenter.Owner.TabbedTemplate;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowTabForSinglePageProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsMaximizedProperty;

		protected internal static readonly DependencyPropertyKey IsMaximizedPropertyKey;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey FloatStatePropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty FloatStateProperty;

		public FloatState FloatState
		{
			get
			{
				return (FloatState)GetValue(FloatStateProperty);
			}
			private set
			{
				SetValue(FloatStatePropertyKey, value);
			}
		}

		[Category("Layout")]
		public bool IsMaximized
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsMaximizedProperty);
			}
			internal set
			{
				SetValue(IsMaximizedPropertyKey, value);
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool SerializableIsMaximized
		{
			get
			{
				return IsMaximized;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public bool ShowTabForSinglePage
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(ShowTabForSinglePageProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ShowTabForSinglePageProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal override bool SupportsFloatOrMDIState => LayoutItemsHelper.IsFloatingRootItem(this);

		protected internal override bool IgnoreOrientation => true;

		protected internal override bool IsTabHost => true;

		static TabbedGroup()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<TabbedGroup> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<TabbedGroup>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<TabbedGroup>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata(BaseLayoutItem.AllowFloatProperty, defValue: true);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata(BaseLayoutItem.AllowSelectionProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata(LayoutGroup.GroupTemplateSelectorProperty, (DataTemplateSelector)new DefaultTemplateSelector(), (PropertyChangedCallback)delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((TabbedGroup)dObj).OnGroupTemplateChanged();
			}, (CoerceValueCallback)null);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ShowTabForSinglePage", ref ShowTabForSinglePageProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("IsMaximized", ref IsMaximizedPropertyKey, ref IsMaximizedProperty, defValue: false, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((TabbedGroup)dObj).OnIsMaximizedChanged((bool)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("FloatState", ref FloatStatePropertyKey, ref FloatStateProperty, FloatState.Normal, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((TabbedGroup)dObj).OnFloatStateChanged((FloatState)e.OldValue, (FloatState)e.NewValue);
			});
		}

		public TabbedGroup()
			: this(EmptyArray<BaseLayoutItem>.Instance)
		{
		}

		internal TabbedGroup(params BaseLayoutItem[] items)
			: base(items)
		{
		}

		internal override void PrepareForModification(bool isDeserializing)
		{
			base.PrepareForModification(isDeserializing);
			if (isDeserializing)
			{
				LayoutGroup.SetOwnerGroup(this, null);
			}
		}

		internal override void SetFloatState(FloatState state)
		{
			if (FloatState != state)
			{
				SetValue(FloatStatePropertyKey, state);
			}
		}

		protected override Size CalcMaxSizeValue(Size value)
		{
			base.Items.CollectConstraints(out var minSizes, out var maxSizes);
			Size minSize = MathHelper.MeasureMinSize(minSizes);
			Size maxSize = MathHelper.MeasureMaxSize(maxSizes);
			return MathHelper.MeasureSize(minSize, maxSize, value);
		}

		protected override Size CalcMinSizeValue(Size value)
		{
			base.Items.CollectConstraints(out var minSizes, out var _);
			Size size = MathHelper.MeasureMinSize(minSizes);
			return new Size(Math.Max(size.Width, value.Width), Math.Max(size.Height, value.Height));
		}

		protected override bool CanCreateItemsInternal()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override LayoutGroup GetContainerHost(BaseLayoutItem container)
		{
			LayoutGroup ownerGroup = LayoutGroup.GetOwnerGroup(this);
			if (!base.IsAutoHidden || ownerGroup == null)
			{
				return base.GetContainerHost(container);
			}
			return ownerGroup;
		}

		protected override bool GetIsAutoHidden()
		{
			if (!base.GetIsAutoHidden())
			{
				if (base.Parent == null)
				{
					return LayoutGroup.GetOwnerGroup(this) is AutoHideGroup;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override LayoutItemType GetLayoutItemTypeCore()
		{
			return LayoutItemType.TabPanelGroup;
		}

		protected override bool HasTabHeader()
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual void OnFloatStateChanged(FloatState oldState, FloatState newState)
		{
			SetValue(IsMaximizedPropertyKey, newState == FloatState.Maximized);
			if (base.IsFloatingRootItem)
			{
				base.Items.Accept(delegate(BaseLayoutItem x)
				{
					x.SetFloatState(FloatState);
				});
			}
		}

		protected override void OnIsFloatingRootItemChanged(bool newValue)
		{
			base.OnIsFloatingRootItemChanged(newValue);
			base.Items.Accept(delegate(BaseLayoutItem x)
			{
				x.SetFloatState(FloatState);
				x.UpdateButtons();
			});
			(base.SelectedItem as LayoutPanel).Do(delegate(LayoutPanel x)
			{
				x.IsFloatingRootInTabbedGroup = newValue;
			});
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsMaximizedChanged(bool maximized)
		{
		}

		protected override void OnItemsCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnItemsCollectionChanged(sender, e);
			if (base.IsFloatingRootItem)
			{
				base.Items.Accept(delegate(BaseLayoutItem x)
				{
					x.SetFloatState(FloatState);
				});
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSelectedItemChanged(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem oldItem)
		{
			base.OnSelectedItemChanged(item, oldItem);
			if (base.IsFloatingRootItem)
			{
				this.GetRoot().Do(delegate(LayoutGroup x)
				{
					x.UpdateWindowTaskbarIcon();
					x.UpdateWindowTaskbarTitle();
				});
			}
			(oldItem as LayoutPanel).Do(delegate(LayoutPanel x)
			{
				x.IsFloatingRootInTabbedGroup = false;
			});
			(base.SelectedItem as LayoutPanel).Do(delegate(LayoutPanel x)
			{
				x.IsFloatingRootInTabbedGroup = base.IsFloatingRootItem;
			});
		}

		protected override void OnTabHeaderHasScrollChanged(bool hasScroll)
		{
			OnLayoutChanged();
		}

		protected override void OnTabHeaderLayoutTypeChanged(TabHeaderLayoutType type)
		{
			CoerceValue(LayoutGroup.TabHeadersAutoFillProperty);
			OnLayoutChanged();
		}

		protected override void OnTabHeadersAutoFillChanged(bool autoFill)
		{
			OnLayoutChanged();
		}
	}
	public static class DockPreviewCalculator
	{
		private class Space : FrameworkElement
		{
			public readonly GridLength Length;

			public Space(GridLength length)
			{
				Length = length;
			}
		}

		public static Size DockPreviewGroup(Rect bounds, BaseLayoutItem dockItem, LayoutGroup targetGroup, DockType type)
		{
			bool flag = type.ToOrientation() == Orientation.Horizontal;
			Space[] panels = ((!targetGroup.IgnoreOrientation && type.ToOrientation() == targetGroup.Orientation) ? CreateGroupSpaces(targetGroup, flag) : new Space[1] { CreateSpace(targetGroup, flag) });
			return MeasureSpaces(bounds, panels, CreateSpace(dockItem, flag), type);
		}

		public static Size DockPreviewItem(Rect bounds, BaseLayoutItem dockItem, BaseLayoutItem targetItem, DockType type)
		{
			bool horz = type.ToOrientation() == Orientation.Horizontal;
			Space[] panels = CreateItemSpaces(targetItem);
			return MeasureSpaces(bounds, panels, CreateSpace(dockItem, horz), type);
		}

		public static double GetStarDockSize(LayoutGroup group)
		{
			if (group.Items.Count == 0)
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			bool flag = group.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal;
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < group.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				GridLength gridLength = (flag ? group[i].ItemWidth : group[i].ItemHeight);
				if (gridLength.IsStar)
				{
					num += gridLength.Value;
					continue;
				}
				num = group.Items.Count;
				break;
			}
			return num / (double)group.Items.Count;
		}

		private static Space[] CreateGroupSpaces(LayoutGroup group, bool fHorz)
		{
			Space[] array = new Space[group.Items.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = group[i];
				array[i] = new Space(fHorz ? baseLayoutItem.ItemWidth : baseLayoutItem.ItemHeight);
			}
			return array;
		}

		private static Space[] CreateItemSpaces(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (LayoutItemsHelper.IsEmptyLayoutGroup(item))
			{
				return EmptyArray<Space>.Instance;
			}
			return new Space[1] { CreateSpace(item) };
		}

		private static Space CreateSpace(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			double value = 1.0;
			if (item is LayoutGroup)
			{
				value = GetStarDockSize(item as LayoutGroup);
			}
			return new Space(new GridLength(value, GridUnitType.Star));
		}

		private static Space CreateSpace(BaseLayoutItem item, bool horz)
		{
			GridLength length = (horz ? item.ItemWidth : item.ItemHeight);
			DockSituation lastDockSituation = item.GetLastDockSituation();
			if (lastDockSituation != null)
			{
				GridLength gridLength = (horz ? lastDockSituation.Width : lastDockSituation.Height);
				if (gridLength.IsAbsolute)
				{
					length = gridLength;
				}
			}
			return new Space(length);
		}

		private static Size MeasureSpaces(Rect bounds, Space[] panels, Space measuredPanel, DockType type)
		{
			Grid grid = new Grid();
			int num = ((type.ToInsertType() != InsertType.Before) ? panels.Length : 0);
			if (type.ToOrientation() == Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				int num2 = ((num == 0) ? 1 : 0);
				for (int i = 0; i < panels.Length; i++)
				{
					grid.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition
					{
						Width = panels[i].Length
					});
					Grid.SetColumn(panels[i], num2++);
					grid.Children.Add(panels[i]);
				}
				grid.ColumnDefinitions.Insert(num, new ColumnDefinition
				{
					Width = measuredPanel.Length
				});
				Grid.SetColumn(measuredPanel, num);
			}
			else
			{
				int num3 = ((num == 0) ? 1 : 0);
				for (int j = 0; j < panels.Length; j++)
				{
					grid.RowDefinitions.Add(new RowDefinition
					{
						Height = panels[j].Length
					});
					Grid.SetRow(panels[j], num3++);
					grid.Children.Add(panels[j]);
				}
				grid.RowDefinitions.Insert(num, new RowDefinition
				{
					Height = measuredPanel.Length
				});
				Grid.SetRow(measuredPanel, num);
			}
			grid.Children.Add(measuredPanel);
			grid.Arrange(bounds);
			return new Size(measuredPanel.ActualWidth, measuredPanel.ActualHeight);
		}
	}
	internal static class DockPreviewAdvCalculator
	{
		public static Rect DockPreviewItem(BaseLayoutItem dockItem, BaseLayoutItem targetItem, DockType type)
		{
			if (type == DockType.Fill && (targetItem is LayoutPanel || targetItem is TabbedGroup))
			{
				return ElementHelper.GetRect(GetManager(targetItem).GetViewElement(targetItem));
			}
			LayoutGroup actualTargetGroup = GetActualTargetGroup(targetItem, type);
			Orientation orientation = ((type == DockType.Fill && actualTargetGroup != null) ? actualTargetGroup.Orientation : type.ToOrientation());
			List<GridLength> list = new List<GridLength>();
			if (actualTargetGroup != null)
			{
				if (NeedResetSingleNestedItemLength(dockItem, actualTargetGroup))
				{
					list.Add(GetSingleNestedItemLength(actualTargetGroup, orientation));
				}
				else
				{
					list.AddRange(CreateGroupSpaces(actualTargetGroup, orientation));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				GridLength item = ((orientation == Orientation.Horizontal) ? targetItem.ItemWidth : targetItem.ItemHeight);
				list.Add(item);
			}
			Rect bounds = GetBounds(actualTargetGroup ?? targetItem);
			GridLength item2 = CreateSpaceForDockItem(dockItem, orientation);
			int num = CalcInsertIndex(actualTargetGroup, targetItem, type.ToInsertType());
			list.Insert(num, item2);
			Rect rect = MeasureSpaces(bounds, list, orientation, num);
			return InflateInvisibleRect(rect, type, bounds);
		}

		private static Rect InflateInvisibleRect(Rect rect, DockType type, Rect targetBounds)
		{
			if (rect.Width == 0.0 && type.ToOrientation() == Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				rect.Width = 10.0;
				if (type == DockType.Right)
				{
					rect.X = targetBounds.Right - 10.0;
				}
			}
			if (rect.Height == 0.0 && type.ToOrientation() == Orientation.Vertical)
			{
				rect.Height = 10.0;
				if (type == DockType.Bottom)
				{
					rect.Y = targetBounds.Bottom - 10.0;
				}
			}
			return rect;
		}

		private static bool NeedResetSingleNestedItemLength(BaseLayoutItem dockItem, LayoutGroup group)
		{
			if (group.IsPermanent || group.Items.Count != 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			LayoutGroup affectedGroup = PlaceHolderHelper.GetAffectedGroup(dockItem);
			if (affectedGroup != group)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool hasPlaceHolders = group.PlaceHolderHelper.GetPlaceHolders().FirstOrDefault((PlaceHolder x) => x.Owner != dockItem, null) != null;
			return DockControllerHelper.CanUnboxGroupWithSingleItem(group, GetManager(group), hasPlaceHolders);
		}

		private static GridLength GetSingleNestedItemLength(LayoutGroup group, Orientation actualOrientation)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = group.Items[0];
			GridLength itemWidth = baseLayoutItem.ItemWidth;
			GridLength itemHeight = baseLayoutItem.ItemHeight;
			LayoutGroup parent = group.Parent;
			if (parent != null)
			{
				if (parent.IgnoreOrientation || parent.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
				{
					if (!itemWidth.IsAbsolute)
					{
						itemWidth = group.ItemWidth;
					}
				}
				else if (!itemHeight.IsAbsolute)
				{
					itemHeight = group.ItemHeight;
				}
			}
			if (actualOrientation != Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				return itemHeight;
			}
			return itemWidth;
		}

		private static int CalcInsertIndex(LayoutGroup targetGroup, BaseLayoutItem targetItem, InsertType insertType)
		{
			if (targetGroup == null)
			{
				if (insertType != InsertType.Before)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return 0;
			}
			List<BaseLayoutItem> list = new List<BaseLayoutItem>();
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in targetGroup.Items)
			{
				if (LayoutItemsHelper.IsActuallyVisibleInTree(item))
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			if (targetGroup == targetItem)
			{
				if (insertType != InsertType.Before)
				{
					return list.Count;
				}
				return 0;
			}
			return list.IndexOf(targetItem) + ((insertType == InsertType.After) ? 1 : 0);
		}

		private static List<GridLength> CreateGroupSpaces(LayoutGroup group, Orientation orientation)
		{
			List<GridLength> list = new List<GridLength>();
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in group.Items)
			{
				if (LayoutItemsHelper.IsActuallyVisibleInTree(item))
				{
					list.Add((orientation == Orientation.Horizontal) ? item.ItemWidth : item.ItemHeight);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static GridLength CreateSpaceForDockItem(BaseLayoutItem item, Orientation orientation)
		{
			bool flag = orientation == Orientation.Horizontal;
			GridLength result = (flag ? item.ItemWidth : item.ItemHeight);
			DockSituation lastDockSituation = item.GetLastDockSituation();
			if (lastDockSituation != null)
			{
				GridLength gridLength = (flag ? lastDockSituation.Width : lastDockSituation.Height);
				if (gridLength.IsAbsolute)
				{
					result = gridLength;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static LayoutGroup GetActualTargetGroup(BaseLayoutItem targetItem, DockType dockType)
		{
			LayoutGroup layoutGroup = targetItem as LayoutGroup;
			if (layoutGroup == null || (layoutGroup.IgnoreOrientation && dockType != DockType.Fill))
			{
				layoutGroup = targetItem.Parent;
			}
			return GetGroupToDock(layoutGroup, dockType);
		}

		private static Rect GetBounds(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			Thickness thickness = default(Thickness);
			IUIElement iUIElement = item;
			if (item is FloatGroup floatGroup)
			{
				iUIElement = floatGroup.GetUIElement<FloatPanePresenter>();
				thickness = ((FloatPanePresenter)iUIElement).GetFloatingMargin();
			}
			ILayoutElement viewElement = GetManager(item).GetViewElement(iUIElement);
			Rect rect = ElementHelper.GetRect(viewElement);
			RectHelper.Deflate(ref rect, thickness);
			return rect;
		}

		private static LayoutGroup GetGroupToDock(LayoutGroup targetGroup, DockType dockType)
		{
			if (targetGroup == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (targetGroup.Orientation != dockType.ToOrientation() && dockType != DockType.Fill)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return targetGroup;
		}

		private static Rect MeasureSpaces(Rect bounds, List<GridLength> gridLengths, Orientation orientation, int dockIndex)
		{
			Grid grid = new Grid();
			for (int i = 0; i < gridLengths.Count; i++)
			{
				FrameworkElement element = new FrameworkElement();
				if (orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
				{
					grid.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition
					{
						Width = gridLengths[i]
					});
					Grid.SetColumn(element, i);
				}
				else
				{
					grid.RowDefinitions.Add(new RowDefinition
					{
						Height = gridLengths[i]
					});
					Grid.SetRow(element, i);
				}
				grid.Children.Add(element);
			}
			grid.Arrange(bounds);
			if (orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				bounds.X += grid.ColumnDefinitions[dockIndex].Offset;
				bounds.Width = Math.Min(grid.ColumnDefinitions[dockIndex].ActualWidth, bounds.Width);
			}
			else
			{
				bounds.Y += grid.RowDefinitions[dockIndex].Offset;
				bounds.Height = Math.Min(grid.RowDefinitions[dockIndex].ActualHeight, bounds.Height);
			}
			return bounds;
		}

		private static DockLayoutManager GetManager(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			return item.GetDockLayoutManager();
		}
	}
	internal abstract class BaseWeakEventManager<T> : WeakEventManager where T : WeakEventManager, new()
	{
		protected static T GetManager()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(T);
			T val = (T)WeakEventManager.GetCurrentManager(typeFromHandle);
			if (val == null)
			{
				val = new T();
				WeakEventManager.SetCurrentManager(typeFromHandle, val);
			}
			return val;
		}
	}
	internal class ThemeChangedEventManager : BaseWeakEventManager<ThemeChangedEventManager>
	{
		public static void AddListener(UIElement source, IWeakEventListener listener)
		{
			BaseWeakEventManager<ThemeChangedEventManager>.GetManager().ProtectedAddListener(source, listener);
		}

		public static void RemoveListener(UIElement source, IWeakEventListener listener)
		{
			BaseWeakEventManager<ThemeChangedEventManager>.GetManager().ProtectedRemoveListener(source, listener);
		}

		protected override void StartListening(object source)
		{
			if (source is DependencyObject)
			{
				CommonThemeHelper.AddThemeChangedHandler((DependencyObject)source, (RoutedEventHandler)ThemeManager_ThemeChanged);
				CommonThemeHelper.AddThemeChangingHandler((DependencyObject)source, (RoutedEventHandler)ThemeManager_ThemeChanging);
			}
		}

		protected override void StopListening(object source)
		{
			if (source is DependencyObject)
			{
				CommonThemeHelper.RemoveThemeChangedHandler((DependencyObject)source, (RoutedEventHandler)ThemeManager_ThemeChanged);
				CommonThemeHelper.RemoveThemeChangingHandler((DependencyObject)source, (RoutedEventHandler)ThemeManager_ThemeChanging);
			}
		}

		private void ThemeManager_ThemeChanged(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager)
			{
				dockLayoutManager.OnThemeChanged(e);
			}
		}

		private void ThemeManager_ThemeChanging(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager)
			{
				dockLayoutManager.OnThemeChanging(e);
			}
		}
	}

	internal static class WindowServiceHelper
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty IWindowServiceProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RootWindowProperty;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty _IWindowServiceProperty;

		static WindowServiceHelper()
		{
			IWindowServiceProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("IWindowService", typeof(object), typeof(WindowServiceHelper), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnIWindowServiceChanged));
			RootWindowProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("RootWindow", typeof(Window), typeof(WindowServiceHelper));
			FieldInfo field = typeof(Window).GetField("IWindowServiceProperty", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
			_IWindowServiceProperty = field.GetValue(null) as DependencyProperty;
		}

		public static object GetIWindowService(DependencyObject target)
		{
			return target.GetValue(IWindowServiceProperty);
		}

		public static Window GetRootWindow(DependencyObject target)
		{
			return (Window)target.GetValue(RootWindowProperty);
		}

		public static Window GetWindow(DependencyObject dObj)
		{
			Window window = Window.GetWindow(dObj);
			if (window == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetRootWindow(window) ?? window;
		}

		public static void SetIWindowService(DependencyObject target, object value)
		{
			target.SetValue(IWindowServiceProperty, value);
		}

		public static void SetRootWindow(DependencyObject target, Window value)
		{
			target.SetValue(RootWindowProperty, value);
		}

		private static void OnIWindowServiceChanged(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnIWindowServiceChanged(o, e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
		}

		private static void OnIWindowServiceChanged(DependencyObject o, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (_IWindowServiceProperty != null)
			{
				if (newValue != null)
				{
					o.SetValue(_IWindowServiceProperty, newValue);
				}
				else
				{
					o.ClearValue(_IWindowServiceProperty);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public static class UniqueNameHelper
	{
		private static readonly string mdiBarManagerName = "internalMDIBarManager";

		private static readonly string mdiBarName = "MDIMenuBar";

		private static int mdiBarManagerCount = 0;

		private static int mdiBarCount;

		public static string GetUniqueName(string prefix, ICollection<string> names, int initialValue)
		{
			int num = initialValue;
			string text;
			do
			{
				text = prefix + num++;
			}
			while (names.Contains(text));
			return text;
		}

		public static string GetMDIBarManagerName()
		{
			return mdiBarManagerName + ++mdiBarManagerCount;
		}

		public static string GetMDIBarName()
		{
			return mdiBarName + ++mdiBarCount;
		}
	}
