	public class SerializationController : ISerializationController, IDisposable
	{
		private bool isDisposingCore;

		private DockLayoutManager containerCore;

		public const string SpecialNameSignature = "$";

		public const string HiddenItemsSignature = "$HiddenItems";

		public const string ClosedPanelsSignature = "$ClosedPanels";

		public const string FloatGroupsSignature = "$FloatGroups";

		public const string AutoHideGroupsSignature = "$AutoHideGroups";

		public const string DecomposedItemsSignature = "$DecomposedItems";

		private int startDeserializing;

		public const string DefaultID = "DockLayoutManager";

		protected bool IsDisposing => isDisposingCore;

		public bool IsDeserializing => startDeserializing > 0;

		public DockLayoutManager Container => containerCore;

		public SerializableItemCollection Items { get; set; }

		internal Dictionary<string, ISerializableItem> NamedItems { get; private set; }

		private Dictionary<string, ISerializableItem> LinkedItems { get; set; }

		internal Dictionary<string, object> NamedControls { get; private set; }

		internal List<ISerializableItem> NewItems { get; private set; }

		protected Dictionary<LayoutGroup, int> TabIndexes { get; private set; }

		public SerializationController(DockLayoutManager container)
		{
			containerCore = container;
			SubscribeEvents();
		}

		void IDisposable.Dispose()
		{
			if (!IsDisposing)
			{
				isDisposingCore = true;
				OnDisposing();
			}
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		private void SubscribeEvents()
		{
			//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0048: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0056: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0060: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DXSerializer.AddStartSerializingHandler((DependencyObject)Container, (RoutedEventHandler)OnStartSerializing);
			DXSerializer.AddEndSerializingHandler((DependencyObject)Container, (RoutedEventHandler)OnEndSerializing);
			DXSerializer.AddStartDeserializingHandler((DependencyObject)Container, new StartDeserializingEventHandler(OnStartDeserializing));
			DXSerializer.AddEndDeserializingHandler((DependencyObject)Container, new EndDeserializingEventHandler(OnEndDeserializing));
		}

		private void UnSubscribeEvents()
		{
			//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0048: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0056: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0060: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DXSerializer.RemoveStartSerializingHandler((DependencyObject)Container, (RoutedEventHandler)OnStartSerializing);
			DXSerializer.RemoveEndSerializingHandler((DependencyObject)Container, (RoutedEventHandler)OnEndSerializing);
			DXSerializer.RemoveStartDeserializingHandler((DependencyObject)Container, new StartDeserializingEventHandler(OnStartDeserializing));
			DXSerializer.RemoveEndDeserializingHandler((DependencyObject)Container, new EndDeserializingEventHandler(OnEndDeserializing));
		}

		protected void OnDisposing()
		{
			UnSubscribeEvents();
			ResetSerializableItems();
			containerCore = null;
		}

		protected virtual string GetAppName()
		{
			return "DockLayoutManager";
		}

		public void SaveLayout(object path)
		{
			DXSerializer.SerializeSingleObject((DependencyObject)Container, path, GetAppName());
		}

		public void RestoreLayout(object path)
		{
			DXSerializer.DeserializeSingleObject((DependencyObject)Container, path, GetAppName());
		}

		protected virtual void OnStartSerializing(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			BeginSaveLayout();
		}

		protected virtual void OnEndSerializing(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			EndSaveLayout();
		}

		protected virtual void OnStartDeserializing(object sender, StartDeserializingEventArgs e)
		{
			BeginRestoreLayout();
		}

		protected virtual void OnEndDeserializing(object sender, EndDeserializingEventArgs e)
		{
			EndRestoreLayout();
		}

		internal void BeginSaveLayout()
		{
			CollectSerializableItems();
			SaveFloatPanelsRestoreOffset();
			BeginSerializeItems(Items);
		}

		internal void EndSaveLayout()
		{
			EndSerializeItems(Items);
			ResetSerializableItems();
		}

		internal void BeginRestoreLayout()
		{
			startDeserializing++;
			Container.PrepareLayoutForModification();
			CollectSerializableItems();
			SaveOldPanelsFloatingBounds();
			Items.Clear();
		}

		internal void EndRestoreLayout()
		{
			using (new LogicalTreeLocker(Container, Container.GetItems()))
			{
				RestoreItems();
			}
			RestoreSelectedTabs(TabIndexes);
			startDeserializing--;
			UpdateContainer();
			ResetSerializableItems();
		}

		internal void SaveOldPanelsFloatingBounds()
		{
			if (!RestoreLayoutOptions.GetAddNewPanels(Container))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, ISerializableItem> namedItem in NamedItems)
			{
				if (namedItem.Value is LayoutPanel { Parent: not null } layoutPanel)
				{
					layoutPanel.UpdateDockSituation(layoutPanel.Parent, DockSituation.GetDockType(layoutPanel));
					if (layoutPanel.GetRoot() is FloatGroup floatGroup)
					{
						layoutPanel.FloatLocationBeforeClose = floatGroup.FloatLocation;
						layoutPanel.FloatSizeBeforeClose = floatGroup.FloatSize;
						layoutPanel.FloatOffsetBeforeClose = Container.GetRestoreOffset();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateContainer()
		{
			Container.OnLayoutRestored();
		}

		private void SaveFloatPanelsRestoreOffset()
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)Container.GetRealFloatingMode() == 1)
			{
				SaveFloatPanelsRestoreOffsetCore();
			}
		}

		private void SaveFloatPanelsRestoreOffsetCore()
		{
			Point restoreOffset = Container.GetRestoreOffset();
			RestoreLayoutOptions.SetFloatPanelsRestoreOffset(Container, restoreOffset);
		}

		protected void CollectSerializableItems()
		{
			Items = new SerializableItemCollection();
			if (Container.LayoutRoot != null)
			{
				Container.LayoutRoot.Accept(GetPrepareParentCollectionName<BaseLayoutItem>(null));
			}
			Container.ClosedPanels.Accept(GetPrepareParentCollectionName<LayoutPanel>("$ClosedPanels"));
			Container.LayoutController.HiddenItems.Accept(GetPrepareHiddenItem("$HiddenItems"));
			Container.FloatGroups.Accept(GetPrepareGroupItems<FloatGroup>("$FloatGroups"));
			Container.AutoHideGroups.Accept(GetPrepareGroupItems<AutoHideGroup>("$AutoHideGroups"));
			Container.DecomposedItems.Accept(GetPrepareDecomposedItem("$DecomposedItems"));
			PrepareSerializableItems();
		}

		protected void ResetSerializableItems()
		{
			Items = null;
			NamedItems = null;
			LinkedItems = null;
			NamedControls = null;
			NewItems = null;
			TabIndexes = null;
		}

		private VisitDelegate<T> GetPrepareGroupItems<T>(string collectionName) where T : LayoutGroup
		{
			VisitDelegate<BaseLayoutItem> visit = GetPrepareParentCollectionName<BaseLayoutItem>(collectionName);
			return delegate(T group)
			{
				group.Accept(visit);
			};
		}

		private VisitDelegate<BaseLayoutItem> GetPrepareHiddenItem(string collectionName)
		{
			return delegate(BaseLayoutItem item)
			{
				item.Accept(GetPrepareParentCollectionName<BaseLayoutItem>(null));
				item.ParentCollectionName = collectionName;
			};
		}

		private VisitDelegate<LayoutGroup> GetPrepareDecomposedItem(string collectionName)
		{
			return delegate(LayoutGroup item)
			{
				item.Accept(GetPrepareParentCollectionName<BaseLayoutItem>(null));
				item.ParentCollectionName = collectionName;
			};
		}

		private VisitDelegate<T> GetPrepareParentCollectionName<T>(string collectionName) where T : class, ISerializableItem
		{
			return delegate(T item)
			{
				item.ParentCollectionName = collectionName;
				if (item is LayoutPanel { Layout: not null } layoutPanel)
				{
					layoutPanel.Layout.Accept(GetPrepareParentCollectionName<BaseLayoutItem>(null));
				}
				Items.Add(item);
			};
		}

		protected void RestoreItems()
		{
			BeginDeserializeItems(Items);
			LockItemsUpdate();
			SerializationControllerHelper.ClearLayoutRoot(Container);
			SerializationControllerHelper.ClearItemsCollection(Container.ClosedPanels);
			SerializationControllerHelper.ClearHiddenItemsCollection(Container.LayoutController.HiddenItems);
			SerializationControllerHelper.ClearGroupsCollection(Container.FloatGroups);
			SerializationControllerHelper.ClearGroupsCollection(Container.AutoHideGroups);
			SerializationControllerHelper.ClearGroupsCollection(Container.DecomposedItems);
			BeginInitItems(NewItems);
			ProcessNewlyCreatedItems(NewItems);
			TabIndexes = SaveSelectedTabs();
			RestoreControls();
			RestoreLayoutRelations();
			UnlockItemsUpdate();
			InvalidateLayoutItems();
			RestorePlaceHolders();
			EndInitItems(NewItems);
			EndDeserializeItems(Items);
		}

		private void LockItemsUpdate()
		{
			Items.OfType<LayoutGroup>().ToList().ForEach(delegate(LayoutGroup x)
			{
				x.Items.BeginUpdate();
			});
			Container.FloatGroups.BeginUpdate();
			Container.ClosedPanels.BeginUpdate();
		}

		private void UnlockItemsUpdate()
		{
			List<LayoutGroup> list = Items.OfType<LayoutGroup>().ToList();
			list.ForEach(delegate(LayoutGroup x)
			{
				x.Items.ProcessRemovedItems();
			});
			list.ForEach(delegate(LayoutGroup x)
			{
				x.Items.EndUpdate();
			});
			Container.FloatGroups.EndUpdate();
			Container.ClosedPanels.EndUpdate();
		}

		private void RestoreOwnedGroupRelations(PlaceHolder ph)
		{
			TabbedGroup tabbedGroup = ph.Parent as TabbedGroup;
			AutoHideGroup autoHideGroup = ph.Owner as AutoHideGroup;
			if (tabbedGroup != null && autoHideGroup != null)
			{
				LayoutGroup.SetOwnerGroup(tabbedGroup, autoHideGroup);
				autoHideGroup.HasPersistentGroups = !tabbedGroup.DestroyOnClosingChildren;
			}
		}

		private void RestorePlaceHolders()
		{
			IEnumerable<ISerializableItem> enumerable = from x in Items
				where x is PlaceHolder
				orderby ((PlaceHolder)x).Index
				select x;
			foreach (ISerializableItem item in enumerable)
			{
				PlaceHolder placeHolder = item as PlaceHolder;
				placeHolder.BeginInit();
				ISerializableItem value = null;
				ISerializableItem value2 = null;
				int index = placeHolder.Index;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(placeHolder.OwnerName) && !NamedItems.TryGetValue(placeHolder.OwnerName, out value))
				{
					LinkedItems.TryGetValue(placeHolder.OwnerName, out value);
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(placeHolder.ParentName) && !NamedItems.TryGetValue(placeHolder.ParentName, out value2))
				{
					LinkedItems.TryGetValue(placeHolder.ParentName, out value2);
				}
				if (value is BaseLayoutItem)
				{
					placeHolder.Owner = (BaseLayoutItem)value;
					if (value2 is LayoutGroup)
					{
						placeHolder.UpdateParent((LayoutGroup)value2);
					}
					PlaceHolderHelper.AddPlaceHolderForItem(value2 as LayoutGroup, (BaseLayoutItem)value, placeHolder, index);
					if (placeHolder.DockState == PlaceHolderState.Unset)
					{
						RestoreOwnedGroupRelations(placeHolder);
					}
				}
				placeHolder.EndInit();
			}
		}

		private void BeginInitItems(List<ISerializableItem> newItems)
		{
			if (newItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ISerializableItem newItem in newItems)
			{
				if (newItem is ISupportInitialize)
				{
					((ISupportInitialize)newItem).BeginInit();
				}
			}
		}

		private void EndInitItems(List<ISerializableItem> newItems)
		{
			if (newItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ISerializableItem newItem in newItems)
			{
				if (newItem is ISupportInitialize)
				{
					((ISupportInitialize)newItem).EndInit();
				}
			}
		}

		private void BeginDeserializeItems(List<ISerializableItem> items)
		{
			if (items == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ISerializableItem item in items)
			{
				if (item is BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem)
				{
					baseLayoutItem.OnDeserializationStarted();
				}
			}
		}

		private void EndDeserializeItems(List<ISerializableItem> items)
		{
			if (items == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ISerializableItem item in items)
			{
				if (item is BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem)
				{
					baseLayoutItem.OnDeserializationComplete();
					baseLayoutItem.AttachedSerializationController = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private void BeginSerializeItems(List<ISerializableItem> items)
		{
			if (items == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ISerializableItem item in items)
			{
				if (item is BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem)
				{
					baseLayoutItem.OnSerializationStarted();
				}
			}
		}

		private void EndSerializeItems(List<ISerializableItem> items)
		{
			if (items == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ISerializableItem item in items)
			{
				if (item is BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem)
				{
					baseLayoutItem.OnSerializationComplete();
				}
			}
		}

		protected void PrepareSerializableItems()
		{
			NamedItems = new Dictionary<string, ISerializableItem>();
			LinkedItems = new Dictionary<string, ISerializableItem>();
			List<ISerializableItem> list = new List<ISerializableItem>();
			foreach (ISerializableItem item in Items)
			{
				if (IsInvalidName(item.Name) || FindItemName(item))
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
				else
				{
					NamedItems.Add(item.Name, item);
				}
			}
			foreach (ISerializableItem item2 in list)
			{
				EnsureUniqueName(item2);
			}
			UpdateParentNames();
			CollectControls();
		}

		private bool FindItemName(ISerializableItem item)
		{
			if (NamedItems.ContainsKey(item.Name))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return Container.FindItemNameInLinked(item.Name);
		}

		protected void UpdateParentNames()
		{
			foreach (ISerializableItem item in Items)
			{
				ISerializableItem serializableParent = GetSerializableParent(item);
				item.ParentName = serializableParent?.Name;
				if (serializableParent != null && item.ParentCollectionName != "$HiddenItems")
				{
					item.ParentCollectionName = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private ISerializableItem GetSerializableParent(ISerializableItem item)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = item as BaseLayoutItem;
			LayoutGroup layoutGroup = item as LayoutGroup;
			ISerializableItem serializableItem = null;
			if (baseLayoutItem != null)
			{
				serializableItem = baseLayoutItem.Parent;
				if (layoutGroup != null && serializableItem == null && layoutGroup.ParentPanel != null)
				{
					serializableItem = layoutGroup.ParentPanel;
				}
			}
			return serializableItem;
		}

		protected void CollectControls()
		{
			NamedControls = new Dictionary<string, object>();
			foreach (ISerializableItem item in Items)
			{
				if (item is ILayoutContent)
				{
					NamedControls.Add(item.Name, ((ILayoutContent)item).Control);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void RestoreControls()
		{
			foreach (ISerializableItem item in Items)
			{
				if (item is ILayoutContent layoutContent && NamedControls.TryGetValue(item.Name, out var value))
				{
					UIElement uIElement = value as UIElement;
					if (layoutContent.Control != uIElement)
					{
						layoutContent.Content = uIElement;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected void InvalidateLayoutItems()
		{
			foreach (ISerializableItem item in Items)
			{
				if (item is BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem)
				{
					baseLayoutItem.ClearValue(BaseLayoutItem.HasDesiredCaptionWidthPropertyKey);
					baseLayoutItem.ClearValue(BaseLayoutItem.DesiredCaptionWidthPropertyKey);
					if (item is LayoutControlItem layoutControlItem)
					{
						layoutControlItem.CoerceValue(LayoutControlItem.CaptionToControlDistanceProperty);
						layoutControlItem.CoerceValue(LayoutControlItem.ActualCaptionMarginProperty);
					}
					if (item is LayoutGroup layoutGroup)
					{
						layoutGroup.CoerceValue(LayoutGroup.ActualDockItemIntervalProperty);
						layoutGroup.CoerceValue(LayoutGroup.ActualLayoutItemIntervalProperty);
						layoutGroup.CoerceValue(LayoutGroup.ActualLayoutGroupIntervalProperty);
						layoutGroup.CoerceValue(LayoutGroup.TabHeaderLayoutTypeProperty);
						layoutGroup.CoerceValue(LayoutGroup.AllowSplittersProperty);
					}
					if (item is FloatGroup floatGroup)
					{
						floatGroup.ScreenLocationBeforeClose = null;
					}
					if (item is LayoutPanel { AutoHidden: not false, IsAutoHidden: false, Parent: not null } layoutPanel)
					{
						layoutPanel.SetCurrentValue(LayoutPanel.AutoHiddenProperty, false);
					}
					baseLayoutItem.CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.CaptionFormatProperty);
					baseLayoutItem.CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.ActualCaptionProperty);
					baseLayoutItem.CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.TabCaptionProperty);
					baseLayoutItem.CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.AppearanceProperty);
					PlaceHolderHelper.ClearPlaceHolder(baseLayoutItem);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void RestoreLayoutRelations()
		{
			List<ISerializableItem> list = new List<ISerializableItem>();
			List<ISerializableItem> list2 = new List<ISerializableItem>();
			LayoutGroup layoutGroup = null;
			foreach (ISerializableItem item in Items)
			{
				if (item is FloatGroup && item.ParentCollectionName == "$FloatGroups")
				{
					Container.FloatGroups.Add((FloatGroup)item);
					list.Add(item);
					continue;
				}
				if (item is AutoHideGroup && item.ParentCollectionName == "$AutoHideGroups")
				{
					Container.AutoHideGroups.Add((AutoHideGroup)item);
					list.Add(item);
					continue;
				}
				if (item.ParentCollectionName == "$HiddenItems" && item is BaseLayoutItem)
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.ParentName) && NamedItems.TryGetValue(item.ParentName, out var value))
					{
						Container.LayoutController.HiddenItems.Add((BaseLayoutItem)item, (LayoutGroup)value);
					}
					else
					{
						Container.LayoutController.HiddenItems.Add((BaseLayoutItem)item);
					}
					list.Add(item);
					continue;
				}
				if (item.ParentCollectionName == "$ClosedPanels" && item is LayoutPanel)
				{
					Container.ClosedPanels.Add((LayoutPanel)item);
					list.Add(item);
					continue;
				}
				if (item.ParentCollectionName == "$DecomposedItems" && item is LayoutGroup)
				{
					Container.DecomposedItems.Add((LayoutGroup)item);
					list.Add(item);
					continue;
				}
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.ParentCollectionName))
				{
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.ParentName))
					{
						if (layoutGroup == null && item is LayoutGroup)
						{
							layoutGroup = (LayoutGroup)item;
							list.Add(item);
							continue;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (!NamedItems.TryGetValue(item.ParentName, out var value2))
						{
							value2 = (ISerializableItem)Items.OfType<ISupportOriginalSerializableName>().FirstOrDefault((ISupportOriginalSerializableName x) => x.OriginalName == item.ParentName);
						}
						if (value2 != null)
						{
							if (value2 is LayoutGroup && item is BaseLayoutItem)
							{
								((LayoutGroup)value2).Add((BaseLayoutItem)item);
								list.Add(item);
								continue;
							}
							if (value2 is LayoutPanel && item is LayoutGroup)
							{
								((LayoutPanel)value2).Content = item;
								list.Add(item);
								continue;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				list2.Add(item);
			}
			ProcessNotRestoredItems(list2);
			Container.LayoutRoot = layoutGroup;
			CheckRestoredItems(list);
		}

		private Dictionary<LayoutGroup, int> SaveSelectedTabs()
		{
			Dictionary<LayoutGroup, int> tabIndexes = new Dictionary<LayoutGroup, int>();
			Items.Accept(delegate(ISerializableItem item)
			{
				if (item is LayoutGroup { IsTabHost: not false } layoutGroup)
				{
					tabIndexes.Add(layoutGroup, layoutGroup.GetSerializableSelectedTabPageIndex());
				}
			});
			return tabIndexes;
		}

		private void RestoreSelectedTabs(Dictionary<LayoutGroup, int> tabIndexes)
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<LayoutGroup, int> tabIndex in tabIndexes)
			{
				if (tabIndex.Key.IsTabHost)
				{
					tabIndex.Key.SelectedTabIndex = tabIndex.Value;
				}
			}
		}

		protected void ProcessNewlyCreatedItems(List<ISerializableItem> newItems)
		{
			if (newItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ISerializableItem newItem in newItems)
			{
				EnsureUniqueName(newItem);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void CheckRestoredItems(List<ISerializableItem> restored)
		{
			if (Container.IsInDesignTime)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool addNewPanels = RestoreLayoutOptions.GetAddNewPanels(Container);
			bool addNewLayoutControlItems = RestoreLayoutOptions.GetAddNewLayoutControlItems(Container);
			bool addNewLayoutGroups = RestoreLayoutOptions.GetAddNewLayoutGroups(Container);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, ISerializableItem> namedItem in NamedItems)
			{
				if (namedItem.Value is LayoutPanel item && !restored.Contains(item))
				{
					if (addNewPanels)
					{
						Container.ClosedPanels.Add(item);
					}
				}
				else if (namedItem.Value is LayoutControlItem item2 && !restored.Contains(item2))
				{
					if (addNewLayoutControlItems)
					{
						Container.LayoutController.HiddenItems.Add(item2);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (!(namedItem.Value is LayoutGroup layoutGroup) || restored.Contains(layoutGroup))
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (addNewLayoutGroups)
					{
						if (layoutGroup.ItemType == LayoutItemType.Group)
						{
							Container.HiddenItems.Add(layoutGroup);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						layoutGroup.IsUngroupped = true;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ProcessNotRestoredItems(List<ISerializableItem> notRestored)
		{
		}

		protected bool IsInvalidName(string name)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
			{
				return name.StartsWith("$");
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected void EnsureUniqueName(ISerializableItem item)
		{
			string name = item.Name;
			if (IsInvalidName(name) || FindItemName(item))
			{
				AssignUniqueName(item, NamedItems.Keys.Union(Container.LinkedItemNames).ToList());
			}
			NamedItems.Add(item.Name, item);
		}

		protected void AssignUniqueName(ISerializableItem item, ICollection<string> names)
		{
			Container.RaiseEvent(new RequestUniqueNameEventArgs(item, names)
			{
				Source = Container
			});
			string name = item.Name;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name) || names.Contains(name))
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.Name) && item is ISupportOriginalSerializableName)
				{
					((ISupportOriginalSerializableName)item).OriginalName = item.Name;
				}
				item.Name = UniqueNameHelper.GetUniqueName("dockItem", names, 1);
			}
		}

		public virtual void OnClearCollection(XtraItemRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		public virtual object OnCreateCollectionItem(XtraCreateCollectionItemEventArgs e)
		{
			ISerializableItem serializableItem = null;
			if (e.CollectionName == "SerializableDockSituation")
			{
				serializableItem = new PlaceHolder();
				Items.Add(serializableItem);
			}
			if (e.CollectionName == "Items")
			{
				XtraPropertyInfo val = ((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Item.ChildProperties["Name"];
				XtraPropertyInfo val2 = ((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Item.ChildProperties["TypeName"];
				if (val == null || val2 == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				serializableItem = CreateItem(val, val2);
				if (serializableItem != null)
				{
					if (NewItems == null)
					{
						NewItems = new List<ISerializableItem>();
					}
					NewItems.Add(serializableItem);
					Items.Add(serializableItem);
				}
			}
			return serializableItem;
		}

		public virtual object OnFindCollectionItem(XtraFindCollectionItemEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.CollectionName != "Items")
			{
				return null;
			}
			XtraPropertyInfo val = ((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Item.ChildProperties["Name"];
			XtraPropertyInfo val2 = ((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Item.ChildProperties["TypeName"];
			if (val == null || val2 == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ISerializableItem serializableItem = FindItem(NamedItems, (string)val.Value, (string)val2.Value);
			if (serializableItem != null)
			{
				Items.Add(serializableItem);
				return serializableItem;
			}
			XtraPropertyInfo val3 = ((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Item.ChildProperties["Name"];
			BaseLayoutItem baseItem = FindItemInLinkedManagers(val3.Value.ToString()) as BaseLayoutItem;
			if (baseItem is LayoutGroup)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (baseItem != null)
			{
				baseItem.GetDockLayoutManager().Do(delegate(DockLayoutManager x)
				{
					x.DockController.RemoveItem(baseItem);
				});
				baseItem.AttachedSerializationController = new WeakReference(this);
				Items.Add(baseItem);
				LinkedItems.Add(baseItem.Name, baseItem);
				return baseItem;
			}
			return serializableItem;
		}

		private object FindItemInLinkedManagers(string name)
		{
			foreach (DockLayoutManager item in Container.Linked)
			{
				BaseLayoutItem[] items = item.GetItems();
				BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = items.FirstOrDefault((BaseLayoutItem x) => x.Name == name);
				if (baseLayoutItem != null)
				{
					return baseLayoutItem;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected ISerializableItem FindItem(Dictionary<string, ISerializableItem> namedItems, string name, string type)
		{
			if (namedItems.TryGetValue(name, out var value) && value.TypeName != type)
			{
				namedItems.Remove(name);
				return null;
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected ISerializableItem CreateItem(XtraPropertyInfo info, XtraPropertyInfo infoType)
		{
			string text = (string)infoType.Value;
			string text2 = "DevExpress.Xpf.Docking.";
			if (text.StartsWith(text2))
			{
				text = text.Remove(0, text2.Length);
			}
			if (CanRemoveOldItem(info, text))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return CreateItemCore(info, text);
		}

		protected virtual bool CanRemoveOldItem(XtraPropertyInfo info, string typeStr)
		{
			if (Container.IsInDesignTime)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (typeStr)
			{
			case "LayoutPanel":
			case "DocumentPanel":
				return RestoreLayoutOptions.GetRemoveOldPanels(Container);
			case "LayoutControlItem":
				return RestoreLayoutOptions.GetRemoveOldLayoutControlItems(Container);
			case "LayoutGroup":
				return RestoreLayoutOptions.GetRemoveOldLayoutGroups(Container);
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private BaseLayoutItem CreateItemCore(XtraPropertyInfo info, string typeStr)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = CreateItemByType(info, typeStr);
			if (baseLayoutItem != null)
			{
				baseLayoutItem.AttachedSerializationController = new WeakReference(this);
				baseLayoutItem.Manager = Container;
				baseLayoutItem.PrepareForModification(isDeserializing: true);
			}
			return baseLayoutItem;
		}

		protected virtual BaseLayoutItem CreateItemByType(XtraPropertyInfo info, string typeStr)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem result = null;
			switch (typeStr)
			{
			case "LayoutControlItem":
				result = Container.CreateLayoutControlItem();
				break;
			case "LayoutPanel":
				result = Container.CreateLayoutPanel();
				break;
			case "LayoutGroup":
				result = Container.GenerateGroup<LayoutGroup>();
				break;
			case "FloatGroup":
				result = Container.GenerateGroup<FloatGroup>();
				break;
			case "AutoHideGroup":
				result = Container.GenerateGroup<AutoHideGroup>();
				break;
			case "TabbedGroup":
				result = Container.GenerateGroup<TabbedGroup>();
				break;
			case "DocumentGroup":
				result = Container.GenerateGroup<DocumentGroup>();
				break;
			case "DocumentPanel":
				result = Container.CreateDocumentPanel();
				break;
			case "LayoutSplitter":
				result = Container.CreateLayoutSplitter();
				break;
			case "LabelItem":
				result = Container.CreateLabelItem();
				break;
			case "EmptySpaceItem":
				result = Container.CreateEmptySpaceItem();
				break;
			case "SeparatorItem":
				result = Container.CreateSeparatorItem();
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public T CreateCommand<T>(object path) where T : SerializationControllerCommand, new()
		{
			return new T
			{
				Controller = this,
				Path = path
			};
		}
	}
	public class BaseLayoutItemSerializationProvider : SerializationProvider
	{
		protected override void OnCustomGetSerializableProperties(DependencyObject dObj, CustomGetSerializablePropertiesEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			((SerializationProvider)this).OnCustomGetSerializableProperties(dObj, e);
			DXSerializable val = new DXSerializable();
			e.SetPropertySerializable("Name", val);
			e.SetPropertySerializable("MinHeight", val);
			e.SetPropertySerializable("MinWidth", val);
			e.SetPropertySerializable("MaxWidth", val);
			e.SetPropertySerializable("MaxHeight", val);
			e.SetPropertySerializable("Tag", val);
			e.SetPropertySerializable("Visibility", val);
			if (((BaseLayoutItem)dObj).PreventCaptionSerialization)
			{
				e.SetPropertySerializable("Caption", (DXSerializable)null);
			}
		}
	}
	public class DXDockingSerializationProvider : SerializationProvider
	{
		protected override void OnCustomGetSerializableChildren(DependencyObject dObj, CustomGetSerializableChildrenEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(dObj is DockLayoutManager container))
			{
				return;
			}
			BaseLayoutItem[] items = container.GetItems();
			BaseLayoutItem[] array = items;
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem in array)
			{
				if (baseLayoutItem is ILayoutContent layoutContent)
				{
					UIElement uIElement = layoutContent.Control ?? layoutContent.ContentPresenter;
					if (uIElement != null)
					{
						e.Children.Add(uIElement);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnClearCollection(XtraItemRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			ISerializationController controller = GetController(((RoutedEventArgs)(object)e).Source);
			controller.OnClearCollection(e);
		}

		protected override object OnCreateCollectionItem(XtraCreateCollectionItemEventArgs e)
		{
			ISerializationController controller = GetController(((RoutedEventArgs)(object)e).Source);
			return controller.OnCreateCollectionItem(e);
		}

		protected override object OnFindCollectionItem(XtraFindCollectionItemEventArgs e)
		{
			ISerializationController controller = GetController(((RoutedEventArgs)(object)e).Source);
			return controller.OnFindCollectionItem(e);
		}

		private static ISerializationController GetController(object obj)
		{
			return SerializationControllerHelper.GetSerializationController(obj as DependencyObject);
		}

		private void RaiseEvent(RoutedEventArgs e, object source)
		{
			GetController(source)?.Container.RaiseEvent(e);
		}

		protected override bool OnAllowProperty(AllowPropertyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (((RoutedEventArgs)(object)e).Source is BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem)
			{
				if (e.IsSerializing)
				{
					e.Allow = baseLayoutItem.AllowSerializeProperty(e);
				}
				RaiseEvent((RoutedEventArgs)(object)e, ((RoutedEventArgs)(object)e).Source);
				return e.Allow;
			}
			if (((RoutedEventArgs)(object)e).Source is BaseLayoutItemSerializationInfo)
			{
				RaiseEvent((RoutedEventArgs)(object)e, ((BaseLayoutItemSerializationInfo)((RoutedEventArgs)(object)e).Source).Owner);
				return e.Allow;
			}
			return ((SerializationProvider)this).OnAllowProperty(e);
		}
	}
	public abstract class SerializationControllerCommand : ICommand
	{
		private class SerializationControllerCommandLink : RoutedCommand
		{
			public SerializationControllerCommand Command { get; private set; }

			public SerializationControllerCommandLink(string name, SerializationControllerCommand command)
				: base(name, typeof(SerializationControllerCommand))
			{
				Command = command;
			}
		}

		protected internal ISerializationController Controller { get; set; }

		protected internal object Path { get; set; }

		public static RoutedCommand SaveLayout { get; private set; }

		public static RoutedCommand RestoreLayout { get; private set; }

		private event EventHandler CanExecuteChangedCore;

		event EventHandler ICommand.CanExecuteChanged
		{
			add
			{
				CanExecuteChangedCore += value;
			}
			remove
			{
				CanExecuteChangedCore -= value;
			}
		}

		internal SerializationControllerCommand()
		{
		}

		protected abstract void ExecuteCore(ISerializationController controller, object path);

		protected abstract bool CanExecuteCore(object path);

		protected void RaiseCanExecuteChanged()
		{
			if (this.CanExecuteChangedCore != null)
			{
				this.CanExecuteChangedCore(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		bool ICommand.CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (Controller == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return CanExecuteCore(Path);
		}

		void ICommand.Execute(object parameter)
		{
			if (Controller != null)
			{
				ExecuteCore(Controller, Path);
			}
		}

		static SerializationControllerCommand()
		{
			SaveLayout = new SerializationControllerCommandLink("SaveLayout", new SaveLayoutCommand());
			RestoreLayout = new SerializationControllerCommandLink("RestoreLayout", new RestoreLayoutCommand());
		}

		internal static void CanExecute(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			ISerializationController serializationController = GetSerializationController(DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager(sender as DependencyObject));
			SerializationControllerCommand command = ((SerializationControllerCommandLink)e.Command).Command;
			e.CanExecute = serializationController != null && e.Parameter != null && command.CanExecuteCore(e.Parameter);
		}

		internal static void Executed(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			ISerializationController serializationController = GetSerializationController(DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager(sender as DependencyObject));
			if (serializationController != null && e.Parameter != null)
			{
				SerializationControllerCommand command = ((SerializationControllerCommandLink)e.Command).Command;
				command.ExecuteCore(serializationController, e.Parameter);
			}
		}

		private static ISerializationController GetSerializationController(DockLayoutManager container)
		{
			return container?.SerializationController;
		}
	}
	public class SaveLayoutCommand : SerializationControllerCommand
	{
		protected override bool CanExecuteCore(object path)
		{
			return path != null;
		}

		protected override void ExecuteCore(ISerializationController controller, object path)
		{
			controller.SaveLayout(path);
		}
	}
	public class RestoreLayoutCommand : SerializationControllerCommand
	{
		protected override bool CanExecuteCore(object path)
		{
			return path != null;
		}

		protected override void ExecuteCore(ISerializationController controller, object path)
		{
			controller.RestoreLayout(path);
		}
	}
	public static class SerializationControllerHelper
	{
		public static ISerializationController GetSerializationController(DependencyObject dObj)
		{
			ISerializationController serializationController = GetSerializationController(dObj as BaseLayoutItem);
			if (serializationController != null)
			{
				return serializationController;
			}
			DockLayoutManager container = GetContainer(dObj);
			return GetSerializationController(container);
		}

		private static DockLayoutManager GetContainer(DependencyObject dObj)
		{
			DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = dObj as DockLayoutManager;
			if (dockLayoutManager == null)
			{
				if (dObj is BaseLayoutItem)
				{
					dockLayoutManager = ((BaseLayoutItem)dObj).FindDockLayoutManager();
				}
				if (dockLayoutManager == null)
				{
					dockLayoutManager = ((dObj != null) ? DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager(dObj) : null);
				}
			}
			return dockLayoutManager;
		}

		private static ISerializationController GetSerializationController(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (item.AttachedSerializationController == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return item.AttachedSerializationController.Target as ISerializationController;
		}

		private static ISerializationController GetSerializationController(DockLayoutManager container)
		{
			return container?.SerializationController;
		}

		public static T CreateCommand<T>(DockLayoutManager container, object path) where T : SerializationControllerCommand, new()
		{
			ISerializationController serializationController = GetSerializationController(container);
			if (serializationController == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return serializationController.CreateCommand<T>(path);
		}

		public static void ClearLayoutRoot(DockLayoutManager container)
		{
			List<BaseLayoutItem> list = new List<BaseLayoutItem>();
			container.LayoutRoot.Accept(list.Add);
			Decompose(list);
		}

		public static void ClearHiddenItemsCollection(HiddenItemsCollection collection)
		{
			List<BaseLayoutItem> items = new List<BaseLayoutItem>();
			collection.Accept(delegate(BaseLayoutItem item)
			{
				item.Accept(items.Add);
			});
			collection.Clear();
			Decompose(items);
		}

		public static void ClearItemsCollection<T>(ObservableCollection<T> collection) where T : BaseLayoutItem
		{
			List<BaseLayoutItem> list = new List<BaseLayoutItem>();
			collection.Accept(list.Add);
			collection.Clear();
			Decompose(list);
		}

		public static void ClearGroupsCollection<T>(ObservableCollection<T> collection) where T : LayoutGroup
		{
			List<BaseLayoutItem> items = new List<BaseLayoutItem>();
			collection.Accept(delegate(T group)
			{
				group.Accept(items.Add);
			});
			collection.Clear();
			Decompose(items);
		}

		private static void Decompose(List<BaseLayoutItem> items)
		{
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in items)
			{
				if (item.Parent != null)
				{
					item.Parent.Remove(item);
				}
				if (item is LayoutPanel { Layout: not null } layoutPanel)
				{
					ClearLayoutGroup(layoutPanel.Layout);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void ClearLayoutGroup(LayoutGroup group)
		{
			List<BaseLayoutItem> list = new List<BaseLayoutItem>();
			group.Accept(list.Add);
			Decompose(list);
		}
	}

	internal static class AutomationIdHelper
	{
		public static string GetId(string prefix, object owner)
		{
			return $"{prefix}_{GetId(owner)}";
		}

		public static string GetId(object owner)
		{
			if (ClearAutomationEventsHelper.UITestingEnabled)
			{
				return (owner as DependencyObject).With(AutomationProperties.GetAutomationId);
			}
			return $"{owner.GetType().Name}({owner.GetHashCode()})";
		}

		public static string GetIdByLayoutItem(DependencyObject dObject)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = (dObject as BaseLayoutItem) ?? DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(dObject);
			if (baseLayoutItem != null)
			{
				string automationId = AutomationProperties.GetAutomationId(baseLayoutItem);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(automationId))
				{
					return automationId;
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(baseLayoutItem.Name))
				{
					return baseLayoutItem.Name;
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(baseLayoutItem.ActualCaption))
				{
					return baseLayoutItem.ActualCaption;
				}
				return GetId(dObject.GetType().Name, baseLayoutItem);
			}
			return GetId(dObject);
		}

		public static string GetLayoutItemName(BaseLayoutItem item, string defaultName)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return defaultName;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.ActualCaption))
			{
				return item.ActualCaption;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.Name))
			{
				return item.Name;
			}
			return defaultName;
		}
	}
	public abstract class BaseAutomationPeer<T> : BaseNavigationAutomationPeer where T : FrameworkElement
	{
		public T Owner => (T)((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner;

		protected BaseAutomationPeer(T owner)
			: base((FrameworkElement)owner)
		{
		}

		protected override string GetNameCore()
		{
			string nameImpl = GetNameImpl();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(nameImpl))
			{
				return nameImpl;
			}
			return Owner.Name;
		}

		protected virtual string GetNameImpl()
		{
			string nameCore = ((BaseNavigationAutomationPeer)this).GetNameCore();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(nameCore))
			{
				bool flag = default(bool);
				object obj = ((BaseNavigationAutomationPeer)this).TryGetAutomationPropertyValue(AutomationProperties.NameProperty, ref flag);
				if (flag)
				{
					return (string)obj;
				}
			}
			return nameCore;
		}

		protected sealed override string GetAutomationIdCore()
		{
			string automationIdImpl = GetAutomationIdImpl();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(automationIdImpl))
			{
				return automationIdImpl;
			}
			return Owner.GetType().Name;
		}

		protected virtual string GetAutomationIdImpl()
		{
			string automationIdCore = ((BaseNavigationAutomationPeer)this).GetAutomationIdCore();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(automationIdCore))
			{
				bool flag = default(bool);
				object obj = ((BaseNavigationAutomationPeer)this).TryGetAutomationPropertyValue(AutomationProperties.AutomationIdProperty, ref flag);
				if (flag)
				{
					return (string)obj;
				}
			}
			return automationIdCore;
		}

		protected override string GetClassNameCore()
		{
			return Owner.GetType().Name;
		}
	}
	public class BaseLayoutItemAutomationPeer<T> : BaseAutomationPeer<T> where T : BaseLayoutItem
	{
		public BaseLayoutItemAutomationPeer(T item)
			: base(item)
		{
		}

		protected override string GetNameImpl()
		{
			string nameImpl = base.GetNameImpl();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(nameImpl))
			{
				return nameImpl;
			}
			return AutomationIdHelper.GetLayoutItemName(base.Owner, string.Empty);
		}

		protected override string GetAutomationIdImpl()
		{
			string automationIdImpl = base.GetAutomationIdImpl();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(automationIdImpl))
			{
				return automationIdImpl;
			}
			return AutomationIdHelper.GetIdByLayoutItem(base.Owner);
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.Group;
		}

		protected override void SetFocusCore()
		{
			base.Owner.Manager.Activate(base.Owner);
		}
	}

	public class AutoHideItemAutomationPeer : BaseLayoutItemAutomationPeer, IExpandCollapseProvider
	{
		public ExpandCollapseState ExpandCollapseState
		{
			get
			{
				AutoHideTray autoHideTray = GetAutoHideTray();
				if (autoHideTray == null || autoHideTray.Items.Count == 0)
				{
					return ExpandCollapseState.LeafNode;
				}
				if (autoHideTray.IsAnimated)
				{
					return ExpandCollapseState.PartiallyExpanded;
				}
				if (autoHideTray.IsExpanded)
				{
					return ExpandCollapseState.Expanded;
				}
				return ExpandCollapseState.Collapsed;
			}
		}

		public AutoHideItemAutomationPeer(BaseLayoutItem frameworkElement)
			: base(frameworkElement)
		{
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface == PatternInterface.ExpandCollapse)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return ((UIElementAutomationPeer)(object)this).GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}

		public void Collapse()
		{
			AutoHideTray autoHideTray = GetAutoHideTray();
			if (autoHideTray.Items.Count == 0)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			autoHideTray.DoCollapse();
		}

		public void Expand()
		{
			AutoHideTray autoHideTray = GetAutoHideTray();
			if (autoHideTray != null)
			{
				if (autoHideTray.Items.Count == 0)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException();
				}
				autoHideTray.DoExpand(base.Owner);
			}
		}

		protected internal void RaiseExpandCollapseAutomationEvent(bool value)
		{
			((AutomationPeer)(object)this).RaisePropertyChangedEvent(ExpandCollapsePatternIdentifiers.ExpandCollapseStateProperty, (object)((!value) ? ExpandCollapseState.Expanded : ExpandCollapseState.Collapsed), (object)(value ? ExpandCollapseState.Expanded : ExpandCollapseState.Collapsed));
		}

		private AutoHideTray GetAutoHideTray()
		{
			return base.Owner.GetUIElement<AutoHidePaneHeaderItem>()?.HeadersGroup.Tray;
		}
	}
	public class MDIDocumentAutomationPeer : BaseLayoutItemAutomationPeer, IWindowProvider, ITransformProvider
	{
		public DocumentGroup DocumentGroup => Owner.Parent as DocumentGroup;

		protected internal DockLayoutManager Manager => Owner.Manager;

		public new DocumentPanel Owner => base.Owner as DocumentPanel;

		public WindowInteractionState InteractionState
		{
			get
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

		public bool IsModal => false;

		public bool IsTopmost => false;

		public bool Maximizable => true;

		public bool Minimizable => true;

		public WindowVisualState VisualState
		{
			get
			{
				if (Owner.IsMaximized)
				{
					return WindowVisualState.Maximized;
				}
				if (Owner.IsMinimized)
				{
					return WindowVisualState.Minimized;
				}
				return WindowVisualState.Normal;
			}
		}

		public bool CanMove => true;

		public bool CanResize => true;

		public bool CanRotate => false;

		public MDIDocumentAutomationPeer(BaseLayoutItem frameworkElement)
			: base(frameworkElement)
		{
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			return patternInterface switch
			{
				PatternInterface.Window => this, 
				PatternInterface.Transform => this, 
				_ => ((UIElementAutomationPeer)(object)this).GetPattern(patternInterface), 
			};
		}

		public void Close()
		{
			Manager.DockController.Close(Owner);
		}

		public void SetVisualState(WindowVisualState state)
		{
			switch (state)
			{
			case WindowVisualState.Maximized:
				Manager.MDIController.Maximize(Owner);
				break;
			case WindowVisualState.Minimized:
				Manager.MDIController.Minimize(Owner);
				break;
			case WindowVisualState.Normal:
				Manager.MDIController.Restore(Owner);
				break;
			}
		}

		public bool WaitForInputIdle(int milliseconds)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		protected override Rect GetBoundingRectangleCore()
		{
			MDIPanel mDIPanel = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<MDIPanel>((DependencyObject)Owner);
			if (mDIPanel != null)
			{
				Point mDILocation = DocumentPanel.GetMDILocation(Owner);
				Size mDISize = DocumentPanel.GetMDISize(Owner);
				Point location = TransformProviderHelper.PointToScreen(mDIPanel, mDILocation);
				Size size = (MathHelper.IsEmpty(mDISize) ? Owner.RenderSize : mDISize);
				return new Rect(location, size);
			}
			return ((UIElementAutomationPeer)(object)this).GetBoundingRectangleCore();
		}

		public void Move(double x, double y)
		{
			MDIPanel target = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<MDIPanel>((DependencyObject)Owner);
			Point value = TransformProviderHelper.PointFromScreen(target, new Point(x, y));
			DocumentPanel.SetMDILocation(Owner, value);
		}

		public void Resize(double width, double height)
		{
			DocumentPanel.SetMDISize(Owner, new Size(width, height));
		}

		public void Rotate(double degrees)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

	public class AutoHideGroupAutomationPeer : LayoutGroupAutomationPeer, IDockProvider
	{
		public DockPosition DockPosition => ((AutoHideGroup)base.Owner).DockType switch
		{
			Dock.Left => DockPosition.Left, 
			Dock.Top => DockPosition.Top, 
			Dock.Right => DockPosition.Right, 
			Dock.Bottom => DockPosition.Bottom, 
			_ => DockPosition.None, 
		};

		public AutoHideGroupAutomationPeer(LayoutGroup element)
			: base(element)
		{
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface == PatternInterface.Dock)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return base.GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}

		protected override void SetFocusCore()
		{
			if (base.Owner.SelectedItem != null)
			{
				base.Owner.Manager.Activate(base.Owner.SelectedItem);
			}
			else if (base.Owner.Items.Count > 0)
			{
				base.Owner.Manager.Activate(base.Owner.Items[0]);
			}
			else
			{
				base.SetFocusCore();
			}
		}

		public void SetDockPosition(DockPosition dockPosition)
		{
			AutoHideGroup autoHideGroup = (AutoHideGroup)base.Owner;
			if (autoHideGroup != null)
			{
				switch (dockPosition)
				{
				case DockPosition.Left:
					autoHideGroup.DockType = Dock.Left;
					break;
				case DockPosition.Top:
					autoHideGroup.DockType = Dock.Top;
					break;
				case DockPosition.Right:
					autoHideGroup.DockType = Dock.Right;
					break;
				case DockPosition.Bottom:
					autoHideGroup.DockType = Dock.Bottom;
					break;
				default:
					throw new InvalidOperationException();
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class LayoutGroupAutomationPeer : BaseLayoutItemAutomationPeer<LayoutGroup>, ISelectionProvider
	{
		private readonly EventHandler weakItemsChangedHandler;

		private readonly EventHandler weakSelectedItemChangedHandler;

		public bool CanSelectMultiple => false;

		public bool IsSelectionRequired => true;

		public LayoutGroupAutomationPeer(LayoutGroup group)
			: base(group)
		{
			if (group != null)
			{
				weakItemsChangedHandler = OnGroupItemsChanged;
				group.WeakItemsChanged += weakItemsChangedHandler;
				weakSelectedItemChangedHandler = OnGroupSelectedItemChanged;
				group.WeakSelectedItemChanged += weakSelectedItemChangedHandler;
			}
		}

		private void ResetHeadersPanel()
		{
			if (base.Owner != null)
			{
				BaseHeadersPanel templateChild = LayoutItemsHelper.GetTemplateChild<BaseHeadersPanel>(base.Owner);
				if (templateChild != null)
				{
					UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(templateChild)?.ResetChildrenCache();
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnGroupItemsChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((DispatcherObject)(object)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				ResetHeadersPanel();
				((AutomationPeer)(object)this).ResetChildrenCache();
			});
		}

		private void OnGroupSelectedItemChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((DispatcherObject)(object)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(ResetSelectedItemCache), DispatcherPriority.Loaded);
		}

		private void ResetSelectedItemCache()
		{
			LayoutGroup owner = base.Owner;
			if (owner != null)
			{
				BaseLayoutItem selectedItem = owner.SelectedItem;
				if (selectedItem != null)
				{
					UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(selectedItem)?.ResetChildrenCache();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			List<AutomationPeer> list = new List<AutomationPeer>();
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in base.Owner.Items)
			{
				list.Add(UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(item));
			}
			BaseHeadersPanel templateChild = LayoutItemsHelper.GetTemplateChild<BaseHeadersPanel>(base.Owner);
			if (templateChild != null)
			{
				list.Add(UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(templateChild));
			}
			GroupBoxControlBoxControl templateChild2 = LayoutItemsHelper.GetTemplateChild<GroupBoxControlBoxControl>(base.Owner);
			if (templateChild2 != null && templateChild2.PartExpandButton != null)
			{
				list.Add(UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(templateChild2.PartExpandButton));
			}
			TabHeaderControlBoxControl templateChild3 = LayoutItemsHelper.GetTemplateChild<TabHeaderControlBoxControl>(base.Owner);
			if (templateChild3 != null)
			{
				if (templateChild3.PartCustomContent != null)
				{
					list.Add(UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(templateChild3.PartCustomContent));
				}
				if (templateChild3.PartCloseButton != null)
				{
					list.Add(UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(templateChild3.PartCloseButton));
				}
				if (templateChild3.PartScrollPrevButton != null)
				{
					list.Add(UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(templateChild3.PartScrollPrevButton));
				}
				if (templateChild3.PartScrollNextButton != null)
				{
					list.Add(UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(templateChild3.PartScrollNextButton));
				}
				if (templateChild3.PartDropDownButton != null)
				{
					list.Add(UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(templateChild3.PartDropDownButton));
				}
				if (templateChild3.PartRestoreButton != null)
				{
					list.Add(UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(templateChild3.PartRestoreButton));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			if (!base.Owner.IsTabHost)
			{
				return AutomationControlType.Group;
			}
			return AutomationControlType.Tab;
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (base.Owner.IsTabHost && patternInterface == PatternInterface.Selection)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return ((UIElementAutomationPeer)(object)this).GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}

		public IRawElementProviderSimple[] GetSelection()
		{
			List<IRawElementProviderSimple> list = new List<IRawElementProviderSimple>();
			if (base.Owner.SelectedItem != null)
			{
				AutomationPeer peer = UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(base.Owner.SelectedItem);
				list.Add(((AutomationPeer)(object)this).ProviderFromPeer(peer));
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}
	}
	public class DockLayoutManagerAutomationPeer : BaseAutomationPeer<DockLayoutManager>
	{
		public DockLayoutManagerAutomationPeer(DockLayoutManager control)
			: base(control)
		{
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.Group;
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			List<AutomationPeer> list = new List<AutomationPeer>();
			if (base.Owner == null || base.Owner.IsDisposing)
			{
				return list;
			}
			foreach (AutoHideGroup autoHideGroup in base.Owner.AutoHideGroups)
			{
				list.Add(UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(autoHideGroup));
			}
			foreach (LayoutPanel closedPanel in base.Owner.ClosedPanels)
			{
				list.Add(UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(closedPanel));
			}
			if (base.Owner.LayoutRoot != null)
			{
				list.Add(UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(base.Owner.LayoutRoot));
			}
			foreach (AutoHidePane autoHidePane in base.Owner.AutoHidePanes)
			{
				if (autoHidePane != null)
				{
					list.Add(UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(autoHidePane));
				}
			}
			if (ClearAutomationEventsHelper.UITestingEnabled && base.Owner.ClosedItemsPanel != null)
			{
				AutomationPeer automationPeer = UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement((UIElement)(object)base.Owner.ClosedItemsPanel);
				if (automationPeer != null)
				{
					list.Add(automationPeer);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
	}

	{
		public ControlBoxButtonPresenterAutomationPeer(ControlBoxButtonPresenter controlBoxButtonPresenter)
			: base(controlBoxButtonPresenter)
		{
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.Button;
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface == PatternInterface.Invoke)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return ((UIElementAutomationPeer)(object)this).GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}

		protected override void SetFocusCore()
		{
			DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager(base.Owner);
			BaseLayoutItem layoutItem = DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(base.Owner);
			if (layoutItem != null)
			{
				dockLayoutManager.DockController.Activate(layoutItem);
			}
		}

		void IInvokeProvider.Invoke()
		{
			if (!((AutomationPeer)(object)this).IsEnabled())
			{
				throw new ElementNotEnabledException();
			}
			InvokeHelper.BeginInvoke(base.Owner, new Action(InvokeClick), DispatcherPriority.Input);
		}

		protected override bool IsEnabledCore()
		{
			return base.Owner.PartButton != null;
		}

		private void InvokeClick()
		{
			if (base.Owner.AutomationClick())
			{
				((AutomationPeer)(object)this).RaiseAutomationEvent(AutomationEvents.InvokePatternOnInvoked);
			}
		}

		protected override string GetAutomationIdImpl()
		{
			string text = base.GetAutomationIdImpl();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				text = AutomationIdHelper.GetIdByLayoutItem(base.Owner);
			}
			return text;
		}
	}

		{
			string text = base.GetNameImpl();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				BaseLayoutItem layoutItem = DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(base.Owner);
				text = AccessKeyHelper.RemoveAccessKeyMarker(AutomationIdHelper.GetLayoutItemName(layoutItem, base.Owner.Name));
			}
			return text;

		{

			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))

			BaseLayoutItem layoutItem = DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(base.Owner);
			if (layoutItem != null)
			{
				dockLayoutManager.DockController.Activate(layoutItem);
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsEnabledCore()
		{
			return DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(base.Owner)?.IsEnabled ?? false;
		}

		private void Select(bool isSelected)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem layoutItem = DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(base.Owner);
			if (layoutItem != null)
			{
				layoutItem.IsSelectedItem = isSelected;
			}
		}

		public void Select()
		{

		}

		public void AddToSelection()
		{
			Select();

		public void RemoveFromSelection()

		}
	}
	public class BaseFloatingPaneAutomationPeer : FrameworkElementAutomationPeer, IWindowProvider, ITransformProvider
	{

		public bool CanMove => true;

		public bool CanResize => true;

		public bool CanRotate => false;

		public BaseFloatingPaneAutomationPeer(FrameworkElement element)
			: base(element)

		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			return patternInterface switch
			{
				PatternInterface.Window => this, 
				PatternInterface.Transform => this, 
				_ => base.GetPattern(patternInterface), 
			};
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()

			return AutomationControlType.Window;

		protected override string GetAutomationIdCore()

			return string.Empty;
		}

		protected override void SetFocusCore()
		{

		public void Close()
		{
			Manager.DockController.Close(FloatGroup);
		}

		public void SetVisualState(WindowVisualState state)
		{
			switch (state)
			{
			case WindowVisualState.Maximized:
				Manager.MDIController.Maximize(FloatGroup);
				break;
			case WindowVisualState.Minimized:
				Manager.MDIController.Minimize(FloatGroup);
				break;
			case WindowVisualState.Normal:
				Manager.MDIController.Restore(FloatGroup);
				break;
			}
		}

		public bool WaitForInputIdle(int milliseconds)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		protected override Rect GetBoundingRectangleCore()
		{
			Point location = TransformProviderHelper.PointToScreen(Manager, FloatGroup.FloatLocation);
			return new Rect(location, FloatGroup.FloatSize);
		}

		public void Move(double x, double y)
		{
			FloatGroup.FloatLocation = TransformProviderHelper.PointFromScreen(Manager, new Point(x, y));
		}

		public void Resize(double width, double height)
		{
			FloatGroup.FloatSize = new Size(width, height);
		}

		public void Rotate(double degrees)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException();
		}
	}

	public class AutoHidePaneAutomationPeer : BaseAutomationPeer<AutoHidePane>, IExpandCollapseProvider
	{
		private readonly EventHandler weakItemsChangedHandler;

		public ExpandCollapseState ExpandCollapseState
		{
			get
			{
				AutoHideTray autoHideTray = base.Owner.With((AutoHidePane x) => x.AutoHideTray);
				if (autoHideTray == null || autoHideTray.Items.Count == 0)
				{
					return ExpandCollapseState.LeafNode;
				}
				if (autoHideTray.IsAnimated)
				{
					return ExpandCollapseState.PartiallyExpanded;
				}
				if (autoHideTray.IsExpanded)
				{
					return ExpandCollapseState.Expanded;
				}
				return ExpandCollapseState.Collapsed;
			}
		}

		public AutoHidePaneAutomationPeer(AutoHidePane owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
			if (owner != null)
			{
				weakItemsChangedHandler = OnLayoutItemChanged;
				owner.LayoutItemChanged += weakItemsChangedHandler;
			}
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface == PatternInterface.ExpandCollapse)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return ((UIElementAutomationPeer)(object)this).GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}

		private void OnLayoutItemChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((AutomationPeer)(object)this).ResetChildrenCache();
		}

		public void Collapse()
		{
			AutoHideTray autoHideTray = base.Owner.With((AutoHidePane x) => x.AutoHideTray);
			if (autoHideTray.Items.Count == 0)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			autoHideTray.DoCollapse();
		}

		public void Expand()
		{
			AutoHideTray autoHideTray = base.Owner.With((AutoHidePane x) => x.AutoHideTray);
			if (autoHideTray != null)
			{
				if (autoHideTray.Items.Count == 0)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException();
				}
				autoHideTray.DoExpand(base.Owner.LayoutItem);
			}
		}

		protected override void SetFocusCore()
		{
			base.Owner.With((AutoHidePane x) => x.LayoutItem).Do(delegate(BaseLayoutItem x)
			{
				x.Focus();
			});
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			List<AutomationPeer> list = new List<AutomationPeer>();
			if (base.Owner.LayoutItem != null)
			{
				list.Add(UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(base.Owner.LayoutItem));
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	public class ControlBoxCustomContentPresenterPeer : BaseAutomationPeer<ContentPresenter>
	{
		public ControlBoxCustomContentPresenterPeer(ContentPresenter contentPresenter)
			: base(contentPresenter)
		{
		}

		protected override bool IsOffscreenCore()
		{
			return base.Owner.Content == null;
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Xpf.Docking.Native
{
	public abstract class DockingDocumentUIServiceBase<TPanel, TGroup> : DocumentUIServiceBase, IDocumentManagerService, IDocumentOwner where TPanel : LayoutPanel where TGroup : LayoutGroup
	{
		public class Document : BindableBase, IDocument, IDocumentInfo
		{
			private DocumentState state = DocumentState.Hidden;

			private bool destroyOnClose = true;

			public DockingDocumentUIServiceBase<TPanel, TGroup> Owner { get; private set; }

			public TPanel DocumentPanel { get; private set; }

			public bool DestroyOnClose
			{
				get
				{
					return destroyOnClose;
				}
				set
				{
					destroyOnClose = value;
				}
			}

			public object Title
			{
				get
				{
					return DocumentPanel.Caption;
				}
				set
				{
					DocumentPanel.Caption = value;
				}
			}

			public object Content => GetContent();

			public object Id
			{
				get
				{
					return BindableId;
				}
				set
				{
					BindableId = value;
				}
			}

			DocumentState IDocumentInfo.State => state;

			public string DocumentType { get; private set; }

			public object BindableId
			{
				get
				{
					return GetProperty(() => BindableId);
				}
				set
				{
					SetProperty(() => BindableId, value);
				}
			}

			public event EventHandler RemoveDocumentPanel;

			public event EventHandler HideDocumentPanel;

			public Document(DockingDocumentUIServiceBase<TPanel, TGroup> owner, TPanel documentPanel, string type)
			{
				Owner = owner;
				DocumentPanel = documentPanel;
				DocumentType = type;
				DocumentUIServiceBase.SetDocument((DependencyObject)documentPanel, (IDocument)this);
				UpdateCloseCommand();
			}

			void IDocument.Close(bool force)
			{
				CloseCore(force);
			}

			private void RemoveFromItems()
			{
				DocumentViewModelHelper.OnDestroy(GetContent());
				if (this.RemoveDocumentPanel != null)
				{
					this.RemoveDocumentPanel(this, EventArgs.Empty);
				}
				DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = DocumentPanel.GetDockLayoutManager();
				if (dockLayoutManager != null && dockLayoutManager.DockController != null)
				{
					dockLayoutManager.DockController.RemovePanel(DocumentPanel);
				}
				else
				{
					DocumentPanel.Parent.Items.Remove(DocumentPanel);
				}
				Owner.DocumentsCollection.Remove(this);
				(GetContent() as IDocumentContent).Do(delegate(IDocumentContent x)
				{
					x.DocumentOwner = null;
				});
				DocumentPanel.Content = null;
				DocumentPanel = null;
				Owner = null;
			}

			void IDocument.Show()
			{
				DocumentPanel.Closed = false;
				DocumentPanel.IsActive = true;
				state = DocumentState.Visible;
			}

			void IDocument.Hide()
			{
				HidePanel();
				state = DocumentState.Hidden;
			}

			private void UpdateCloseCommand()
			{
				DocumentPanel.CloseCommand = DelegateCommandFactory.Create(delegate
				{
					CloseCore(force: false);
				}, CanClose, useCommandManager: false);
			}

			private void HidePanel()
			{
				DocumentPanel.Closed = true;
				DocumentPanel.IsActive = false;
				state = DocumentState.Hidden;
			}

			private bool CanClose()
			{
				return DocumentPanel.AllowClose;
			}

			private void CloseCore(bool force)
			{
				using (DocumentPanel.LockCloseCommand())
				{
					if (!force)
					{
						CancelEventArgs e = new CancelEventArgs();
						DocumentViewModelHelper.OnClose(GetContent(), e);
						if (e.Cancel)
						{
							return;
						}
					}
					if (destroyOnClose)
					{
						RemoveFromItems();
						state = DocumentState.Destroyed;
						return;
					}
					if (this.HideDocumentPanel != null)
					{
						this.HideDocumentPanel(this, EventArgs.Empty);
					}
					HidePanel();
				}
			}

			private object GetContent()
			{
				return ViewHelper.GetViewModelFromView(DocumentPanel.Content);
			}
		}

		private class IgnoreIncorrectNameValuesConverter : IValueConverter
		{
			public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				if (!(value is string text))
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (!Regex.IsMatch(text, "^[_a-zA-Z][_a-zA-Z0-9]*$"))
				{
					string format = "'{0}' is not a valid value for the {1}.{2} property. Docking Document Services use {1}.{2} as a Name for created DocumentPanels and LayoutPanels. So, Document.Id must be defined in accordance with XamlName Grammar: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/desktop-wpf/xaml-services/xamlname-grammar";
					Trace.WriteLine(string.Format(format, text, "IDocument", "Id"));
					return null;
				}
				return value;
			}

			public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ActiveDocumentProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ActiveDocument", typeof(IDocument), typeof(DockingDocumentUIServiceBase<TPanel, TGroup>), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.BindsTwoWayByDefault, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((DockingDocumentUIServiceBase<TPanel, TGroup>)(object)d).OnActiveDocumentChanged(e.OldValue as IDocument, e.NewValue as IDocument);
		}));

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey ActiveViewPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("ActiveView", typeof(object), typeof(DockingDocumentUIServiceBase<TPanel, TGroup>), new PropertyMetadata(null));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ActiveViewProperty = ActiveViewPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey DocumentsPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("Documents", typeof(IEnumerable<IDocument>), typeof(DockingDocumentUIServiceBase<TPanel, TGroup>), new PropertyMetadata(null));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DocumentsProperty = DocumentsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;

		private Dictionary<TPanel, FloatGroup> removingPanelsCollection;

		private List<TPanel> floatGroupPanelsCollection;

		private bool activeDocumentChangeEnabled = true;

		public IDocument ActiveDocument
		{
			get
			{
				return (IDocument)((DependencyObject)this).GetValue(ActiveDocumentProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)this).SetValue(ActiveDocumentProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		public object ActiveView
		{
			get
			{
				return ((DependencyObject)this).GetValue(ActiveViewProperty);
			}
			private set
			{
				((DependencyObject)this).SetValue(ActiveViewPropertyKey, value);
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<IDocument> Documents
		{
			get
			{
				return (IEnumerable<IDocument>)((DependencyObject)this).GetValue(DocumentsProperty);
			}
			private set
			{
				((DependencyObject)this).SetValue(DocumentsPropertyKey, (object)value);
			}
		}

		private ObservableCollection<IDocument> DocumentsCollection => (ObservableCollection<IDocument>)Documents;

		public event ActiveDocumentChangedEventHandler ActiveDocumentChanged;

		public DockingDocumentUIServiceBase()
		{
			Documents = new ObservableCollection<IDocument>();
			removingPanelsCollection = new Dictionary<TPanel, FloatGroup>();
			floatGroupPanelsCollection = new List<TPanel>();
		}

		protected abstract TGroup GetActualDocumentGroup();

		protected abstract TPanel CreateDocumentPanel();

		protected abstract Style GetDocumentPanelStyle(TPanel documentPanel, object documentContentView);

		IDocument IDocumentManagerService.CreateDocument(string documentType, object viewModel, object parameter, object parentViewModel)
		{
			TGroup actualDocumentGroup = GetActualDocumentGroup();
			if (actualDocumentGroup == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (actualDocumentGroup.Manager != null)
			{
				actualDocumentGroup.Manager.DockItemActivated -= DocumentItemActivated;
				actualDocumentGroup.Manager.DockItemActivated += DocumentItemActivated;
				actualDocumentGroup.Manager.DockItemClosing -= DockItemClosing;
				actualDocumentGroup.Manager.DockItemClosing += DockItemClosing;
			}
			object obj = ((ViewServiceBase)this).CreateAndInitializeView(documentType, viewModel, parameter, parentViewModel, (IDocumentOwner)this);
			TPanel val = CreateDocumentPanel();
			((ViewServiceBase)this).InitializeDocumentContainer((FrameworkElement)val, ContentItem.ContentProperty, GetDocumentPanelStyle(val, obj));
			Document document = new Document(this, val, documentType);
			BindingOperations.SetBinding(val, BaseLayoutItem.BindableNameProperty, new Binding("BindableId")
			{
				Source = document,
				Converter = new IgnoreIncorrectNameValuesConverter()
			});
			if (obj is DependencyObject)
			{
				DXSerializer.SetEnabled((DependencyObject)obj, false);
			}
			DocumentUIServiceBase.SetTitleBinding(obj, BaseLayoutItem.CaptionProperty, (DependencyObject)val, false);
			val.PreventCaptionSerialization = true;
			val.Content = obj;
			actualDocumentGroup.Items.Add(val);
			document.RemoveDocumentPanel += RemoveDocumentPanel;
			document.HideDocumentPanel += HideDocumentPanel;
			DocumentsCollection.Add(document);
			return document;
		}

		private void DockItemClosing(object sender, ItemCancelEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Item is FloatGroup floatGroup)
			{
				e.Cancel = !DocumentsClose(floatGroup);
				if (!e.Cancel)
				{
					floatGroupPanelsCollection.Clear();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool DocumentsClose(FloatGroup floatGroup)
		{
			bool result = true;
			foreach (TPanel item in GetItemsOfFloatGroup(floatGroup))
			{
				item.ExecuteCloseCommand();
				if (((Document)DocumentUIServiceBase.GetDocument((DependencyObject)item)).DocumentPanel != null)
				{
					result = false;
					if (!removingPanelsCollection.ContainsKey(item))
					{
						removingPanelsCollection.Add(item, floatGroup);
						item.Unloaded += PanelUnloaded;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void PanelUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			TPanel val = (TPanel)sender;
			val.Unloaded -= PanelUnloaded;
			FloatGroup floatGroup = removingPanelsCollection[val];
			if (floatGroup != null)
			{
				removingPanelsCollection.Remove(val);
				if (GetItemsOfFloatGroup(floatGroup).Count() == 0)
				{
					floatGroup.Manager.DockController.Close(floatGroup);
				}
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<TPanel> GetItemsOfFloatGroup(FloatGroup floatGroup)
		{
			floatGroupPanelsCollection.Clear();
			if (floatGroup.Items.FirstOrDefault() is LayoutGroup layoutGroup)
			{
				GetDocumentPanels(layoutGroup);
			}
			return floatGroupPanelsCollection.OrderBy((TPanel x) => x.IsActive);
		}

		private void GetDocumentPanels(LayoutGroup group)
		{
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in group.Items)
			{
				if (item is LayoutGroup layoutGroup)
				{
					GetDocumentPanels(layoutGroup);
				}
				if (!(item is TGroup val))
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (BaseLayoutItem item2 in val.Items)
				{
					floatGroupPanelsCollection.Add((TPanel)item2);
				}
			}
		}

		void IDocumentOwner.Close(IDocumentContent documentContent, bool force)
		{
			DocumentUIServiceBase.CloseDocument((IDocumentManagerService)this, documentContent, force);
		}

		private bool ActiveDocumentChangeEnabled()
		{
			if (activeDocumentChangeEnabled)
			{
				return true;
			}
			activeDocumentChangeEnabled = true;
			return false;
		}

		private void HideDocumentPanel(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Document document = (Document)sender;
			ActivateAfterRemoveOrHidePanelGroup(document);
		}

		private void RemoveDocumentPanel(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Document document = (Document)sender;
			document.RemoveDocumentPanel -= RemoveDocumentPanel;
			document.HideDocumentPanel -= HideDocumentPanel;
			ActivateAfterRemoveOrHidePanelGroup(document);
		}

		private void ActivateAfterRemovePanel(Document document)
		{
			if (document != ActiveDocument || GetCountOfOpenDocuments(document) <= 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			IEnumerable<TPanel> enumerable = document.DocumentPanel.Parent.Items.Where((BaseLayoutItem x) => x as TPanel != null && !x.Closed).Cast<TPanel>();
			int num = 0;
			foreach (TPanel item in enumerable)
			{
				if (ActiveDocument == DocumentUIServiceBase.GetDocument((DependencyObject)item) && enumerable.Count() > 1)
				{
					TPanel val = ((num != 0) ? enumerable.ElementAt(num - 1) : enumerable.ElementAt(num + 1));
					IDocument document2 = DocumentUIServiceBase.GetDocument((DependencyObject)val);
					((DependencyObject)this).SetCurrentValue(ActiveDocumentProperty, (object)((document2 != null && Documents.Contains(document2)) ? document2 : null));
					break;
				}
				num++;
			}
		}

		private void ActivateAfterRemoveOrHidePanelGroup(Document document)
		{
			ActivateAfterRemovePanel(document);
			if (document != ActiveDocument)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (GetCountOfOpenDocuments(document) == 1 && DocumentsCollection.Count > 1)
			{
				IEnumerable<TPanel> enumerable = from x in DocumentsCollection.OfType<Document>()
					select x.DocumentPanel into y
					where y != document.DocumentPanel && !y.Closed
					select y;
				bool flag = enumerable.Any((TPanel x) => x.IsSelectedItem);
				foreach (TPanel item in enumerable)
				{
					if (!item.IsTabPage || !flag || item.IsSelectedItem)
					{
						activeDocumentChangeEnabled = false;
						((DependencyObject)this).SetCurrentValue(ActiveDocumentProperty, (object)DocumentUIServiceBase.GetDocument((DependencyObject)item));
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			if (DocumentsCollection.Count((IDocument x) => !((Document)x).DocumentPanel.Closed) == 1)
			{
				((DependencyObject)this).SetCurrentValue(ActiveDocumentProperty, (object)null);
			}
		}

		private int GetCountOfOpenDocuments(Document document)
		{
			return document.DocumentPanel.Parent?.Items.Count((BaseLayoutItem x) => !x.Closed) ?? 0;
		}

		private void DocumentItemActivated(object sender, DockItemActivatedEventArgs e)
		{
			TPanel val = e.Item as TPanel;
			TPanel val2 = e.OldItem as TPanel;
			bool flag = ActiveDocumentChangeEnabled();
			if (val != null && val.IsActive && flag)
			{
				IDocument document = DocumentUIServiceBase.GetDocument((DependencyObject)val);
				if (document != null && Documents.Contains(document) && ActiveDocument != document)
				{
					activeDocumentChangeEnabled = false;
					((DependencyObject)this).SetCurrentValue(ActiveDocumentProperty, (object)document);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnActiveDocumentChanged(IDocument oldValue, IDocument newValue)
		{
			Document document = (Document)newValue;
			bool flag = ActiveDocumentChangeEnabled();
			if (document != null && flag)
			{
				activeDocumentChangeEnabled = false;
				document.DocumentPanel.Closed = false;
				document.DocumentPanel.IsActive = true;
			}
			ActiveView = document.With((Document x) => x.DocumentPanel.Content);
			if (this.ActiveDocumentChanged != null)
			{
				this.ActiveDocumentChanged(this, new ActiveDocumentChangedEventArgs(oldValue, newValue));
			}
		}
	}

		private static Dictionary<string, BitmapImage> Images

		private static BitmapImage LoadImage(string imageName)
		{
			string name = $"DevExpress.Xpf.Docking.Images.{imageName}.png";
			Assembly executingAssembly = Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly();
			using Stream streamSource = executingAssembly.GetManifestResourceStream(name);
			BitmapImage bitmapImage = new BitmapImage();
			bitmapImage.BeginInit();
			bitmapImage.CacheOption = BitmapCacheOption.OnLoad;
			bitmapImage.StreamSource = streamSource;
			bitmapImage.EndInit();
			bitmapImage.Freeze();
			return bitmapImage;
		}

		public static BitmapImage GetImage(string imageName)
		{
			if (!Images.TryGetValue(imageName, out var value))
			{
				value = LoadImage(imageName);
				Images.Add(imageName, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		public static ImageSource GetImageForItem(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item == null)

				return null;
			}
			ImageSource result = null;
			switch (item.ItemType)
			{
			case LayoutItemType.ControlItem:
				result = GetImage("LayoutControlItem");
				break;
			case LayoutItemType.Group:
				result = GetImage("LayoutGroup");
				break;
			case LayoutItemType.Panel:
				result = GetImage("LayoutPanel");
				break;
			case LayoutItemType.TabPanelGroup:
				result = GetImage("TabbedGroup");
				break;
			case LayoutItemType.Document:
				result = GetImage("DocumentPanel");
				break;
			case LayoutItemType.DocumentPanelGroup:

				break;
			case LayoutItemType.FloatGroup:

			case LayoutItemType.LayoutSplitter:
				result = GetImage("Splitter");
				break;
			case LayoutItemType.Separator:
