				break;
			case LayoutItemType.EmptySpaceItem:
				result = GetImage("EmptySpaceItem");
				break;
			case LayoutItemType.Label:
				result = GetImage("Label");
				break;
			}

		}

	internal class TabHeaderInsertHelper
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<Rect, IDockLayoutElement> elementMap = new Dictionary<Rect, IDockLayoutElement>();

		private readonly bool isHorizontal;

		private readonly double length;

		private readonly Rect[] rects;

		public Rect Header { get; private set; }

		public Rect HeaderPanel { get; private set; }

		public int Index { get; private set; }

		public Rect Tab { get; private set; }

		public int TabIndex { get; private set; }

		public TabHeaderInsertHelper(IDockLayoutContainer container, Point point, bool canInsertAfterAll)
		{
			if (container != null && container.HasHeadersPanel)
			{
				isHorizontal = container.IsHorizontalHeaders;
				HeaderPanel = MathHelper.Round(container.GetHeadersPanelBounds());
				Tab = MathHelper.Round(container.GetSelectedPageBounds());
				Tab = MathHelper.Edge(Tab, HeaderPanel, !isHorizontal);
				rects = GetRects(container);
				Rect[] array = rects;
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					Rect rect = array[i];
					length = Math.Max(length, isHorizontal ? rect.Right : rect.Bottom);
				}
				Header = GetInsertRect(point);
			}
		}

		private int Compare(Rect x, Rect y)
		{
			double num = (isHorizontal ? x.Top : x.Left);
			double num2 = (isHorizontal ? x.Right : x.Bottom);
			double value = (isHorizontal ? y.Top : y.Left);
			double value2 = (isHorizontal ? y.Right : y.Bottom);
			int num3 = num.CompareTo(value);
			if (num3 != 0)
			{
				return num3;
			}
			return num2.CompareTo(value2);
		}

		private Rect GetInsertRect(Point point)
		{
			TabIndex = -1;
			Index = -1;
			if (HeaderPanel.Contains(point) && rects.Any())
			{
				Point point2 = new Point(point.X, point.Y);
				for (int i = 0; i < rects.Length; i++)
				{
					if (rects[i].Contains(point2))
					{
						IDockLayoutElement dockLayoutElement = elementMap[rects[i]];
						TabIndex = LayoutItemsHelper.GetTabIndexFromItem(dockLayoutElement.Item);
						Index = LayoutItemsHelper.GetIndexFromItem(dockLayoutElement.Item);
						return MathHelper.Round(GetRect(isHorizontal ? rects[i].Left : rects[i].Top, isHorizontal ? rects[i].Width : rects[i].Height));
					}
				}
				double start = (isHorizontal ? point.X : point.Y);
				Rect rect;
				if (start > length)
				{
					rect = rects.Last();
					int index = (TabIndex = rects.Length);
					Index = index;
				}
				else
				{
					if (!rects.Any((Rect x) => (isHorizontal ? x.Right : x.Bottom) < start))
					{
						TabIndex = 0;
						Index = TabIndex;
						return MathHelper.Round(GetRect(isHorizontal ? HeaderPanel.Left : HeaderPanel.Top, isHorizontal ? rects.First().Width : rects.First().Height));
					}
					rect = rects.Last((Rect x) => (isHorizontal ? x.Right : x.Bottom) < start);
					int index = (TabIndex = rects.Length);
					Index = index;
				}
				return MathHelper.Round(GetRect(isHorizontal ? rect.Right : rect.Bottom, isHorizontal ? rect.Width : rect.Height));
			}
			return default(Rect);
		}

		private Rect GetRect(double start, double length)
		{
			return new Rect(isHorizontal ? start : HeaderPanel.Left, isHorizontal ? HeaderPanel.Top : start, isHorizontal ? length : HeaderPanel.Width, isHorizontal ? HeaderPanel.Height : length);
		}

		private Rect[] GetRects(ILayoutContainer container)
		{
			List<Rect> list = new List<Rect>();
			for (int i = 0; i < container.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				if (container.Items[i] is IDockLayoutElement { IsPageHeader: not false } dockLayoutElement)
				{
					Rect rect = ElementHelper.GetRect(dockLayoutElement);
					list.Add(rect);
					elementMap[rect] = dockLayoutElement;
				}
			}
			list.Sort(Compare);
			return list.ToArray();
		}
	}

	public class DockLayoutElementDragInfo
	{
		private bool isSplitter;

		private Point splitterItemPoint;

		public IView View { get; private set; }

		public Point Point { get; private set; }

		public IDockLayoutElement Element { get; private set; }

		protected LayoutElementHitInfo HitInfo { get; private set; }

		protected BaseDropInfo DropInfo { get; private set; }

		public IDragSource DragSource { get; private set; }

		public IDropTarget DropTarget { get; private set; }

		public IDropTarget OriginalDropTarget { get; private set; }

		public BaseLayoutItem Item { get; private set; }

		public BaseLayoutItem Target { get; private set; }

		public BaseLayoutItem OriginalTarget { get; private set; }

		public DropType DropType { get; private set; }

		public MoveType MoveType { get; private set; }

		public Rect TargetRect { get; private set; }

		public int InsertIndex { get; private set; }

		public bool CanDockToSide
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Item.AllowDock)
				{
					return false;
				}
				DockLayoutManager container = ((LayoutView)View).Container;
				bool flag = Item is FloatGroup && ((FloatGroup)Item).IsDocumentHost;
				if ((Item.ItemType == LayoutItemType.Document && container.DockingStyle != DockingStyle.Default) || Item.GetRoot().GetIsDocumentHost())
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (container.DockingStyle != DockingStyle.Default && flag)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return !LayoutItemsHelper.IsEmptyLayoutGroup(Target.GetRoot());
			}
		}

		public bool CanDockToTab
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Item.AllowDock || !Item.GetAllowDockToDocumentGroup())
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Target is LayoutGroup && Target.GetIsDocumentHost())
				{
					return ((LayoutGroup)Target).HasNotCollapsedItems;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool CanDock
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Item.AllowDock)
				{
					return false;
				}
				DockLayoutManager container = ((LayoutView)View).Container;
				bool flag = Item.ItemType == LayoutItemType.Document;
				bool flag2 = Item is FloatGroup && ((FloatGroup)Item).IsDocumentHost;
				if (flag || flag2)
				{
					if (container.DockingStyle != DockingStyle.Default)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (Target is DocumentGroup { HasNotCollapsedItems: false })
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				if (LayoutItemsHelper.IsEmptyLayoutGroup(Target))
				{
					return Target.GetIsDocumentHost();
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public bool CanHide
		{
			get
			{
				bool flag = Item is FloatGroup && ((FloatGroup)Item).IsDocumentHost;
				if (Item.AllowHide && !Item.GetRoot().GetIsDocumentHost())
				{
					return !flag;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool CanFill => Item.AllowDock;

		public DockLayoutElementDragInfo(IView view, Point point, ILayoutElement dragElement)
		{
			View = view;
			Element = CheckDragElement((IDockLayoutElement)dragElement);
			Item = Element.Item;
			HitInfo = View.Adapter.CalcHitInfo(view, point);
			DragSource = dragElement as IDragSource;
			OriginalDropTarget = HitInfo.Element as IDropTarget;
			DropTarget = CheckDropTarget();
			Point = CheckClientPoint(point);
			if (OriginalDropTarget != null)
			{
				OriginalTarget = ((IDockLayoutElement)OriginalDropTarget).Item;
			}
			if (DropTarget != null)
			{
				Target = ((IDockLayoutElement)DropTarget).Item;
				DropInfo = ((IDockLayoutElement)DropTarget).CalcDropInfo(Item, Point);
			}
			if (DropInfo != null)
			{
				DropType = DropInfo.Type;
				MoveType = DropInfo.MoveType;
				TargetRect = DropInfo.ItemRect;
				InsertIndex = DropInfo.InsertIndex;
			}
		}

		public bool AcceptSelfDock()
		{
			if (DropTarget != DragSource && DropTarget != null)
			{
				return Item != Target;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool AcceptFill()
		{
			if (DragSource == null || DropTarget == null || !Item.AllowDock || (Target != null && !Target.GetAllowDockToCurrentItem()))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (AcceptSelfDock())
			{
				return DropTarget.AcceptFill(this);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool AcceptHide()
		{
			if (DragSource == null || DropTarget == null || !Item.AllowHide || LayoutItemsHelper.IsLayoutItem(Item))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (AcceptSelfDock() && DropTarget.AcceptDockSource(this, null))
			{
				return CanHide;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool AcceptDockCenter()
		{
			if (DragSource == null || DropTarget == null || !Item.AllowDock)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (DragSource.AcceptDockTarget(this, null))
			{
				return DropTarget.AcceptDockSource(this, null);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool AcceptDocking(DockHintHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			if (hitInfo.DockType == DockType.None || DragSource == null || DropTarget == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (hitInfo.DockType == DockType.Fill && !DropTarget.AcceptFill(this))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!hitInfo.IsHideButton && !Item.AllowDock)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (hitInfo.IsHideButton)
			{
				return CanHide;
			}
			if (!hitInfo.IsCenter)
			{
				return CanDockToSide;
			}
			if (DragSource.AcceptDockTarget(this, hitInfo))
			{
				return DropTarget.AcceptDockSource(this, hitInfo);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool AcceptDragDrop()
		{
			if (DragSource == null || DropTarget == null || DragSource == DropTarget)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!Item.AllowMove || (Item.IsHidden && !Item.AllowRestore))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (DragSource.AcceptDropTarget(this))
			{
				return DropTarget.AcceptDragSource(this);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool AcceptReordering()
		{
			if (DropTarget != null)
			{
				return DropTarget.AcceptReordering(this);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public Point CheckClientPoint(Point point)
		{
			if (!isSplitter)
			{
				return point;
			}
			return splitterItemPoint;
		}

		public IDockLayoutElement CheckDragElement(IDockLayoutElement dragElement)
		{
			return dragElement.CheckDragElement();
		}

		public IDropTarget CheckDropTarget()
		{
			IDockLayoutElement dockLayoutElement = HitInfo.Element as IDockLayoutElement;
			if (dockLayoutElement == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (dockLayoutElement.Type == LayoutItemType.Splitter)
			{
				ILayoutContainer container = dockLayoutElement.Container;
				LayoutGroup layoutGroup = dockLayoutElement.Item as LayoutGroup;
				int num = layoutGroup.ItemsInternal.IndexOf(dockLayoutElement.Element);
				BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = layoutGroup.ItemsInternal[num - 1] as BaseLayoutItem;
				foreach (IDockLayoutElement item in (IEnumerable<ILayoutElement>)container.Items)
				{
					if (item.Item == baseLayoutItem)
					{
						dockLayoutElement = item;
						isSplitter = true;
						if (layoutGroup.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
						{
							splitterItemPoint = new Point(dockLayoutElement.Location.X + dockLayoutElement.Size.Width - 1.0, HitInfo.HitPoint.Y);
						}
						else
						{
							splitterItemPoint = new Point(HitInfo.HitPoint.X, dockLayoutElement.Location.Y + dockLayoutElement.Size.Height - 1.0);
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			IDropTarget dropTarget = null;
			if (!IsControlItemsHost(dockLayoutElement) || LayoutItemsHelper.IsLayoutItem(Item) || (Item.ItemType == LayoutItemType.Group && Item.GetRoot().IsLayoutRoot))
			{
				dropTarget = CheckNestedItem(dockLayoutElement) as IDropTarget;
			}
			if (dropTarget == null)
			{
				dropTarget = FindNonControlItemHostTarget(dockLayoutElement) as IDropTarget;
			}
			if (dropTarget is IDockLayoutElement { Item: not null } dockLayoutElement3 && dockLayoutElement3.Item.Parent != null)
			{
				LayoutGroup parent = dockLayoutElement3.Item.Parent;
				if (LayoutItemsHelper.IsLayoutItem(dockLayoutElement3.Item) && parent.GroupBorderStyle == GroupBorderStyle.NoBorder && !parent.IsLayoutRoot && !isSplitter)
				{
					Rect rect = ElementHelper.GetRect(dropTarget as ILayoutElement);
					RectHelper.Inflate(ref rect, (double)MovingHelper.NoBorderMarginHorizontal, (double)MovingHelper.NoBorderMarginVertical);
					if (!rect.Contains(HitInfo.HitPoint))
					{
						dropTarget = dockLayoutElement3.Container as IDropTarget;
					}
				}
			}
			return dropTarget;
		}

		private bool IsControlItemsHost(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)element).Item;
			if (item != null)
			{
				if (!item.IsControlItemsHost)
				{
					return LayoutItemsHelper.IsLayoutItem(item);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private ILayoutElement CheckNestedItem(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			if (element.Container is TabbedLayoutGroupElement)
			{
				return element.Container;
			}
			if (element.Container is TabbedPaneElement)
			{
				return element.Container;
			}
			if (element.Container is DocumentPaneElement)
			{
				return element.Container;
			}
			if (element.Container is AutoHideTrayHeadersGroupElement)
			{
				return element.Container;
			}
			return element;
		}

		private ILayoutElement FindNonControlItemHostTarget(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			while (element.Parent != null && IsControlItemsHost(element.Parent))
			{
				element = element.Parent;
			}
			return CheckNestedItem(element);
		}

		public static DragInfo CalcDragInfo(IView view, Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			DockLayoutElementDragInfo dockLayoutElementDragInfo = new DockLayoutElementDragInfo(view, point, element);
			if (dockLayoutElementDragInfo.Item != null)
			{
				bool flag = dockLayoutElementDragInfo.AcceptDragDrop();
				return new DragInfo(dockLayoutElementDragInfo.Item, dockLayoutElementDragInfo.Target, flag ? dockLayoutElementDragInfo.DropType : DropType.None);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal class LocationHelper
	{
		private Point startLocation;

		private Point startPoint;

		public LocationHelper(IView view, ILayoutElement element, Point dragOffset)
		{
			startLocation = view.ClientToScreen(element.Location);
			startPoint = view.Adapter.DragService.DragOrigin;
			startPoint.X -= dragOffset.X;
			startPoint.Y -= dragOffset.Y;
		}

		public Point CalcLocation(Point screenPoint)
		{
			double num = screenPoint.X - startPoint.X;
			double num2 = screenPoint.Y - startPoint.Y;
			return new Point(startLocation.X + num, startLocation.Y + num2);
		}
	}

		}

		public Point CalcLocation(Point screenPoint)
		{
			double num = screenPoint.X - startPoint.X;
			double num2 = screenPoint.Y - startPoint.Y;

		}
	}
	internal class BoundsHelper
	{
		internal Rect startRect;

		internal Point startPoint;

		private Rect effectiveRect;

		private Thickness margin;

		private Size MinSize;

		private Size MaxSize;

		private bool rightToLeft;

		private SizingAction sizingAction;

		public BoundsHelper(IView view, ILayoutElement element, Size minSize, Size maxSize, SizingAction sizingAction)
			: this(view, element, minSize, maxSize)
		{
			this.sizingAction = sizingAction;
		}

		public BoundsHelper(IView view, ILayoutElement element, Size minSize, Size maxSize)
			: this(view, element, minSize)
		{
			MaxSize = maxSize;
			MaxSize.Width -= margin.Left + margin.Right;
			MaxSize.Height -= margin.Top + margin.Bottom;
		}

		public BoundsHelper(IView view, ILayoutElement element, Size minSize)
		{
			MinSize = minSize;
			rightToLeft = ((LayoutView)view).Container.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft;
			startRect = ElementHelper.GetScreenRect(view, element);
			startPoint = view.Adapter.DragService.DragOrigin;
			effectiveRect = GetEffectiveRect(element, startRect);
			margin = GetMargin(effectiveRect, startRect);
			MinSize.Width -= margin.Left + margin.Right;
			MinSize.Height -= margin.Top + margin.Bottom;
		}

		public Rect CalcBounds(Point screenPoint)
		{
			return GetRealRect(ResizeHelper.CalcResizing(effectiveRect, startPoint, screenPoint, MinSize, MaxSize, sizingAction), margin);
		}

		public Cursor GetCursor()
		{
			if (sizingAction == SizingAction.None)
			{
				return ResizeHelper.GetResizeCursor(effectiveRect, startPoint, rightToLeft);
			}
			return sizingAction.ToCursor();
		}

		public SizingAction GetSizingAction()
		{
			return ResizeHelper.GetSizingAction(effectiveRect, startPoint, rightToLeft);
		}

		private static Rect GetEffectiveRect(ILayoutElement element, Rect real)
		{
			if (element is FloatPanePresenterElement)
			{
				RectHelper.Inflate(ref real, -5.0, -5.0);
			}
			return real;
		}

		private static Rect GetRealRect(Rect effective, Thickness margin)
		{
			return new Rect(effective.Left - margin.Left, effective.Top - margin.Top, effective.Width + (margin.Left + margin.Right), effective.Height + (margin.Top + margin.Bottom));
		}

		private static Thickness GetMargin(Rect effective, Rect real)
		{
			return new Thickness(effective.Left - real.Left, effective.Top - real.Top, real.Right - effective.Right, real.Bottom - effective.Bottom);
		}
	}
	internal class MDIBoundsHelper
	{
		private Rect startRect;

		private Point startPoint;

		private Size MinSize;

		private Size MaxSize;

		private Point startLocation;

		private bool rightToLeft;

		public MDIBoundsHelper(IView view, IDockLayoutElement element, Size minSize)
		{
			MinSize = minSize;
			rightToLeft = ((LayoutView)view).Container.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft;
			startLocation = DocumentPanel.GetMDILocation(element.Item);
			startRect = ElementHelper.GetScreenRect(view, element);
			startPoint = view.Adapter.DragService.DragOrigin;
		}

		public MDIBoundsHelper(IView view, IDockLayoutElement element, Size minSize, Size maxSize)
			: this(view, element, minSize)
		{
			MaxSize = maxSize;
		}

		public Rect CalcBounds(Point screenPoint)
		{
			Rect rect = ResizeHelper.CalcResizing(startRect, startPoint, screenPoint, MinSize, MaxSize);
			double num = rect.X - startRect.X;
			double num2 = rect.Y - startRect.Y;
			return new Rect(new Point(startLocation.X + num, startLocation.Y + num2), RectHelper.Size(rect));
		}

		public Cursor GetCursor()
		{
			return ResizeHelper.GetResizeCursor(startRect, startPoint, rightToLeft);
		}
	}
	internal class MarginHelper
	{
		private Thickness margin;

		public MarginHelper(LayoutView view)
		{
			margin = GetContentMargin(view.RootUIElement);
		}

		public MarginHelper(Thickness margin)
		{
			this.margin = margin;
		}

		public Rect Correct(Rect bounds)
		{
			return new Rect(CorrectLocation(margin, RectHelper.Location(bounds)), CorrectSize(margin, RectHelper.Size(bounds)));
		}

		public Point Correct(Point location)
		{
			return CorrectLocation(margin, location);
		}

		private Thickness GetContentMargin(object element)
		{
			if (!(element is FloatPanePresenter.FloatingContentPresenter floatingContentPresenter))
			{
				return default(Thickness);
			}
			FloatPanePresenter floatPanePresenter = (FloatPanePresenter)(object)((ManagedContentPresenter)floatingContentPresenter).Container;
			return floatPanePresenter.GetFloatingMargin();
		}

		private Point CorrectLocation(Thickness margins, Point floatLocation)
		{
			return new Point(floatLocation.X - margins.Left, floatLocation.Y - margins.Top);
		}

		private Size CorrectSize(Thickness margins, Size floatSize)
		{
			return new Size(floatSize.Width + margins.Left + margins.Right, floatSize.Height + margins.Top + margins.Bottom);
		}
	}
	internal class HintRectCalculator
	{
		private abstract class BaseCalcStrategy
		{
			public abstract Rect Calc(DockLayoutElementDragInfo dragInfo, DockHintHitInfo hitInfo);
		}

		private class RootHint : BaseCalcStrategy
		{
			public override Rect Calc(DockLayoutElementDragInfo dragInfo, DockHintHitInfo hitInfo)
			{
				if (DockLayoutManagerParameters.UseLegacyDockPreviewCalculator)
				{
					Rect rect = ElementHelper.GetRect(dragInfo.View.LayoutRoot);
					Size preferredSize = DockPreviewCalculator.DockPreviewGroup(rect, dragInfo.Item, dragInfo.Target.GetRoot(), hitInfo.DockType);
					return DockHelper.GetDockRect(rect, preferredSize, hitInfo.DockType);
				}
				return DockPreviewAdvCalculator.DockPreviewItem(dragInfo.Item, dragInfo.Target.GetRoot(), hitInfo.DockType);
			}
		}

		private class CenterHint : BaseCalcStrategy
		{
			public override Rect Calc(DockLayoutElementDragInfo dragInfo, DockHintHitInfo hitInfo)
			{
				BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = dragInfo.Target;
				Rect rect;
				if (baseLayoutItem.GetIsDocumentHost() && !hitInfo.IsTabButton && hitInfo.DockType != DockType.Fill && ((LayoutGroup)baseLayoutItem).HasNotCollapsedItems && baseLayoutItem.Parent != null)
				{
					baseLayoutItem = baseLayoutItem.Parent;
					IDockLayoutElement dockLayoutElement = (IDockLayoutElement)dragInfo.DropTarget;
					rect = ElementHelper.GetRect(dockLayoutElement.Container);
				}
				else
				{
					rect = dragInfo.TargetRect;
				}
				if (DockLayoutManagerParameters.UseLegacyDockPreviewCalculator)
				{
					Size preferredSize = DockPreviewCalculator.DockPreviewItem(rect, dragInfo.Item, baseLayoutItem, hitInfo.DockType);
					return DockHelper.GetDockRect(rect, preferredSize, hitInfo.DockType);
				}
				return DockPreviewAdvCalculator.DockPreviewItem(dragInfo.Item, baseLayoutItem, hitInfo.DockType);
			}
		}

		private class HideHint : BaseCalcStrategy
		{
			public override Rect Calc(DockLayoutElementDragInfo dragInfo, DockHintHitInfo hitInfo)
			{
				Rect rect = ElementHelper.GetRect(dragInfo.View.LayoutRoot);
				bool flag = hitInfo.DockType.ToOrientation() != Orientation.Horizontal;
				Size preferredSize = new Size(flag ? rect.Width : 20.0, flag ? 20.0 : rect.Height);
				return DockHelper.GetDockRect(rect, preferredSize, hitInfo.DockType);
			}
		}

		public static Rect Calc(DockLayoutElementDragInfo dragInfo, DockHintHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			if (hitInfo == null || dragInfo.Item == null)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			if (dragInfo.DropTarget is AutoHideTrayElement)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			if (dragInfo.DropTarget is AutoHidePaneElement)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			return SelectStrategy(hitInfo).Calc(dragInfo, hitInfo);
		}

		private static BaseCalcStrategy SelectStrategy(DockHintHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			if (hitInfo.IsCenter)
			{
				return new CenterHint();
			}
			if (hitInfo.IsHideButton)
			{
				return new HideHint();
			}
			return new RootHint();
		}
	}
	public class FloatingHelper : IFloatingHelper
	{
		public LayoutView View { get; private set; }

		public FloatingHelper(LayoutView view)
		{
			View = view;
		}

		public virtual IView GetFloatingView(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			IDockLayoutElement dockLayoutElement = (IDockLayoutElement)element;
			BaseLayoutItem item = dockLayoutElement.Item;
			DockLayoutManager container = View.Container;
			try
			{
				container.BeginFloating();
				Rect itemScreenRect = GetItemScreenRect(dockLayoutElement);
				Rect itemContainerScreenRect = GetItemContainerScreenRect(dockLayoutElement);
				FloatGroup floatGroup = container.DockController.Float(item, GetFloatingBounds(dockLayoutElement, itemScreenRect, itemContainerScreenRect));
				FloatingView floatingView = container.GetView(floatGroup) as FloatingView;
				if (floatingView != null)
				{
					floatingView.SetFloatingBounds(GetFloatingBounds(dockLayoutElement, itemScreenRect, itemContainerScreenRect));
					NotificationBatch.Action(floatingView.Container, floatingView.FloatGroup);
				}
				return floatingView;
			}
			finally
			{
				container.EndFloating();
			}
		}

		public Rect GetDragCursorBounds(IDockLayoutElement element)
		{
			Point dragOrigin = View.Adapter.DragService.DragOrigin;
			BaseLayoutItem item = element.Item;
			Thickness floatingBorderMargin = item.GetFloatingBorderMargin();
			Rect itemScreenRect = GetItemScreenRect(element);
			Rect itemContainerScreenRect = GetItemContainerScreenRect(element);
			Rect floatingBounds = GetFloatingBounds(element, itemScreenRect, itemContainerScreenRect, needCheck: false);
			UIElement relativeTo = (element.Element as FloatPanePresenter).Return((FloatPanePresenter x) => x.Element, () => element.Element);
			Point location = item.GetDockLayoutManager().TranslatePoint(dragOrigin, relativeTo);
			if (!floatingBounds.Contains(dragOrigin))
			{
				location = new Point(15.0, 15.0);
			}
			Size size = default(Size);
			if (item.IsFloatingRootItem || item is FloatGroup)
			{
				Rect rect = (element.IsPageHeader ? itemContainerScreenRect : (itemContainerScreenRect.IsEmpty ? itemScreenRect : itemContainerScreenRect));
				RectHelper.Deflate(ref rect, floatingBorderMargin);
				size = rect.Size;
				FloatGroup floatGroup = item.GetRoot() as FloatGroup;
				FrameworkElement uIElement = floatGroup.UIElement;
				location = item.GetDockLayoutManager().TranslatePoint(dragOrigin, uIElement);
				location.X -= floatingBorderMargin.Left;
				location.Y -= floatingBorderMargin.Top;
				if (floatGroup.FloatState == FloatState.Maximized)
				{
					Rect restoreBounds = DocumentPanel.GetRestoreBounds(floatGroup);
					RectHelper.Deflate(ref restoreBounds, floatingBorderMargin);
					restoreBounds.Location = floatingBounds.Location;
					size = restoreBounds.Size;
					location.X += floatingBorderMargin.Left;
					location.Y += floatingBorderMargin.Top;
					if (!restoreBounds.Contains(dragOrigin))
					{
						location = new Point(15.0, 15.0);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				size = floatingBounds.Size;
				location.X += floatingBorderMargin.Left;
				location.Y += floatingBorderMargin.Top;
			}
			if (element is AutoHidePaneHeaderItemElement)
			{
				location = new Point(15.0, 15.0);
			}
			return new Rect(location, size);
		}

		internal virtual Rect Check(Rect screenRect, Point startPoint)
		{
			if (!screenRect.Contains(startPoint))
			{
				RectHelper.Offset(ref screenRect, startPoint.X - 15.0 - screenRect.X, startPoint.Y - 15.0 - screenRect.Y);
			}
			return screenRect;
		}

		protected virtual Rect GetItemContainerScreenRect(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			if (element.Container != null)
			{
				return ElementHelper.GetScreenRect(View, element.Container);
			}
			return Rect.Empty;
		}

		protected virtual Rect GetItemScreenRect(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			return ElementHelper.GetScreenRect(View, element);
		}

		private Rect GetFloatingBounds(IDockLayoutElement dockLayoutElement, Rect itemScreenRect, Rect itemContainerScreenRect, bool needCheck = true)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem item = dockLayoutElement.Item;
			Size size = (dockLayoutElement.IsPageHeader ? RectHelper.Size(itemContainerScreenRect) : RectHelper.Size(itemScreenRect));
			if (needCheck || !item.IsFloatingRootItem)
			{
				size = item.CheckSize(size);
			}
			Point startPoint = (MathHelper.IsEmpty(View.Adapter.DragService.DragOrigin) ? default(Point) : View.Adapter.DragService.DragOrigin);
			Rect rect = new Rect(RectHelper.Location(itemScreenRect), size);
			if (needCheck)
			{
				rect = Check(rect, startPoint);
				return new MarginHelper(item.GetFloatingBorderMargin()).Correct(rect);
			}
			return rect;
		}

		public static Rect GetDragCursorBounds(LayoutView view, IDockLayoutElement dockLayoutElement)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem item = dockLayoutElement.Item;
			FloatingHelper floatingHelper = (item.IsAutoHidden ? new AutoHideFloatingHelper(view) : new FloatingHelper(view));
			return floatingHelper.GetDragCursorBounds(dockLayoutElement);
		}
	}
	public class AutoHideFloatingHelper : FloatingHelper
	{
		public AutoHideFloatingHelper(LayoutView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		private Rect GetScreenRect(ILayoutElement element, Rect itemScreenRect)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)element).Item;
			Point location = RectHelper.Location(itemScreenRect);
			if (base.View.Adapter.DragService.DragItem is AutoHidePaneHeaderItemElement)
			{
				location = new Point(base.View.Adapter.DragService.DragOrigin.X - 15.0, base.View.Adapter.DragService.DragOrigin.Y - 15.0);
			}
			return new Rect(location, item.GetAutoHideRenderSize());
		}

		protected override Rect GetItemContainerScreenRect(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			return GetScreenRect(element, base.GetItemScreenRect(element));
		}

		protected override Rect GetItemScreenRect(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			return GetScreenRect(element, base.GetItemScreenRect(element));
		}
	}
	internal class MovingHelper
	{
		public static readonly int NoBorderMarginHorizontal = -3;

		public static readonly int NoBorderMarginVertical = -3;

		public LayoutView View { get; private set; }

		public MovingHelper(LayoutView view)
		{
			View = view;
		}

		public bool CanMove(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			DockLayoutElementDragInfo dockLayoutElementDragInfo = new DockLayoutElementDragInfo(View, point, element);
			if (dockLayoutElementDragInfo.Item != null)
			{
				return dockLayoutElementDragInfo.AcceptDragDrop();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Move(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			View.Adapter.SelectionService.ClearSelection(View);
			DockLayoutElementDragInfo dragInfo = new DockLayoutElementDragInfo(View, point, element);
			MoveItemCore(dragInfo);
		}

		protected bool MoveItemCore(DockLayoutElementDragInfo dragInfo)
		{
			bool flag = dragInfo.Element is HiddenItemElement && dragInfo.Item is FixedItem;
			return View.Container.LayoutController.Move(flag ? FixedItemFactory.CreateFixedItem(dragInfo.Item as FixedItem) : dragInfo.Item, dragInfo.Target, dragInfo.MoveType, dragInfo.InsertIndex);
		}
	}
	internal class DockingHelper
	{
		public LayoutView View { get; private set; }

		public DockingHelper(LayoutView view)
		{
			View = view;
		}

		public bool CanDrop(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			DockLayoutElementDragInfo dockLayoutElementDragInfo = new DockLayoutElementDragInfo(View, point, element);
			DockingHintAdornerBase dockingHintAdorner = View.AdornerHelper.GetDockingHintAdorner();
			if (dockingHintAdorner == null || dockLayoutElementDragInfo.Item == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DockHintHitInfo dockHintHitInfo = dockingHintAdorner.HitTest(point);
			if (dockHintHitInfo.InButton)
			{
				return dockLayoutElementDragInfo.AcceptDocking(dockHintHitInfo);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Drop(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			bool result = true;
			DockLayoutElementDragInfo dockLayoutElementDragInfo = new DockLayoutElementDragInfo(View, point, element);
			DockingHintAdornerBase dockingHintAdorner = View.AdornerHelper.GetDockingHintAdorner();
			DockHintHitInfo dockHintHitInfo = dockingHintAdorner.HitTest(point);
			if (dockHintHitInfo.IsCenter)
			{
				if (dockHintHitInfo.IsTabButton)
				{
					DockItemAsTabCore(dockLayoutElementDragInfo.Item, dockLayoutElementDragInfo.Point, dockLayoutElementDragInfo.Target, dockHintHitInfo.DockType);
				}
				else
				{
					result = DockItemCore(dockLayoutElementDragInfo.Item, dockLayoutElementDragInfo.Point, dockLayoutElementDragInfo.Target, dockHintHitInfo.DockType);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				bool flag = View.Type == HostType.AutoHide && dockLayoutElementDragInfo.DropTarget is AutoHideTrayElement;
				if (dockHintHitInfo.IsHideButton || flag)
				{
					HideItemCore(dockLayoutElementDragInfo.Item, dockLayoutElementDragInfo.Point, flag ? (dockLayoutElementDragInfo.DropTarget as AutoHideTrayElement).Tray.DockType : dockHintHitInfo.Dock);
				}
				else
				{
					result = DockItemCore(dockLayoutElementDragInfo.Item, dockLayoutElementDragInfo.Point, dockLayoutElementDragInfo.Target.GetRoot(), dockHintHitInfo.DockType);
				}
			}
			if (!View.IsDisposing)
			{
				View.AdornerHelper.ResetDockingHints();
				View.AdornerHelper.TryHideAdornerWindow();
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected bool HideItemCore(BaseLayoutItem item, Point pt, Dock dock)
		{
			if (!View.Container.RaiseItemDockingEvent(DockLayoutManager.DockItemEndDockingEvent, item, pt, null, dock.ToDockType(), isHiding: true))
			{
				return View.Container.DockController.Hide(item, dock);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool DockItemCore(BaseLayoutItem item, Point pt, BaseLayoutItem target, DockType type)
		{
			if (!View.Container.RaiseItemDockingEvent(DockLayoutManager.DockItemEndDockingEvent, item, pt, target, type, isHiding: false) && View.Container != null)
			{
				return View.Container.DockController.Dock(item, target, type);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool DockItemAsTabCore(BaseLayoutItem item, Point pt, BaseLayoutItem target, DockType type)
		{
			if (!View.Container.RaiseItemDockingEvent(DockLayoutManager.DockItemEndDockingEvent, item, pt, target, type, isHiding: false))
			{
				return View.Container.DockController.DockAsDocument(item, target, type);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class LayoutViewRegularDragListener : RegularListener
	{
		private Point? lastDraggingPoint;

		private Point? lastCanDragPoint;

		public LayoutView View => base.ServiceProvider as LayoutView;

		public override void OnEnter()
		{
			base.OnEnter();
			if (!KeyHelper.IsCtrlPressed)
			{
				ILayoutElement layoutElement = View.Adapter.DragService.DragItem ?? View.Container.LinkedDragService.Return((IDragService x) => x.DragItem, () => (ILayoutElement)null);
				Point? point = lastDraggingPoint ?? lastCanDragPoint;
				if (CanShowDockHints(layoutElement) && point.HasValue)
				{
					DockLayoutElementDragInfo dragInfo = new DockLayoutElementDragInfo(View, point.Value, layoutElement);
					View.AdornerHelper.UpdateDockingHints(dragInfo, forceUpdateAdornerBounds: true);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void OnLeave()
		{
			View.AdornerHelper.BeginHideAdornerWindowAndResetDockingHints();
			View.AdornerHelper.BeginHideAdornerWindowAndResetTabHeadersHints();
		}

		public override void OnCancel()
		{
			View.AdornerHelper.ResetDockingHints();
			View.AdornerHelper.TryHideAdornerWindow();
		}

		private static bool IsLayoutPanelWithRestrictedFloating(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)element).Item;
			if (item is LayoutPanel || item is TabbedGroup || item is FloatGroup)
			{
				if (item.AllowFloat)
				{
					return !item.Manager.ShowContentWhenDragging;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsOnCurrentVirtualDesktop(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)element).Item;
			return item.Manager.GetView(item).IsOnCurrentVirtualDesktop;
		}

		private bool CanShowDockHints(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			if (View.Adapter.DragService.OperationType != OperationType.ClientDragging || IsLayoutPanelWithRestrictedFloating(element))
			{
				return IsOnCurrentVirtualDesktop(element);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void OnDragging(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			if (!KeyHelper.IsCtrlPressed && CanShowDockHints(element))
			{
				DockLayoutElementDragInfo dragInfo = new DockLayoutElementDragInfo(View, point, element);
				View.AdornerHelper.UpdateDockingHints(dragInfo);
			}
			lastDraggingPoint = point;
		}

		public override void OnDrop(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			new DockingHelper(View).Drop(point, element);
		}

		public override bool CanDrop(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			if (View.Adapter.DragService.OperationType != OperationType.ClientDragging)
			{
				return new DockingHelper(View).CanDrop(point, element);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool CanDrag(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			lastCanDragPoint = point;
			return base.CanDrag(point, element);
		}
	}
	public class AutoHideViewRegularDragListener : RegularListener
	{
		public LayoutView View => base.ServiceProvider as LayoutView;

		public override void OnLeave()
		{
			View.AdornerHelper.BeginHideAdornerWindowAndResetTabHeadersHints();
		}

	public class LayoutViewFloatingDragListener : FloatingListener
	{
		public LayoutView View => base.ServiceProvider as LayoutView;

		protected override IFloatingHelper CreateFloatingHelper()
		{
			return new FloatingHelper(View);
		}

		protected override ILayoutElement EnsureElementForFloating(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			ILayoutElement layoutElement = base.EnsureElementForFloating(element);
			if (!layoutElement.IsDisposing)
			{
				return layoutElement;
			}
			IDockLayoutElement dockLayoutElement = (IDockLayoutElement)element;
			return View.Container.GetViewElement(dockLayoutElement.Element as IUIElement) ?? layoutElement;
		}

		protected override void EnsureFloatingView(IView floatingView)
		{
			base.EnsureFloatingView(floatingView);
			(floatingView as FloatingView).Do(delegate(FloatingView x)
			{
				x.BeginFloating();
			});
		}
	}

		{
			return new AutoHideFloatingHelper(base.View);
		}
	}
	public class FloatingViewFloatingMovingListener : FloatingMovingListener
	{
		private LocationHelper helper;

		public FloatingView View => base.ServiceProvider as FloatingView;

		public override void OnBegin(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			if (View.FloatGroup.IsMaximized)
			{
				View.FloatGroup.ResetMaximized(new MarginHelper(View).Correct(point));
			}
			helper = new LocationHelper(View, ElementHelper.GetRoot(element), View.IsFloating ? View.Container.GetDragOffset() : default(Point));
			View.EndFloating();
		}

		public override void OnDragging(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			Point screenPoint = View.ClientToScreen(point);
			View.SetFloatLocation(helper.CalcLocation(screenPoint));
			NotificationBatch.Action(View.Container, View.FloatGroup, FloatGroup.FloatLocationProperty);
		}

		public override bool CanDrop(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override void OnDrop(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			RaiseDockOperationCompleted(element);
		}

		private void RaiseDockOperationCompleted(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)element).CheckDragElement().Item;
			View.Container.RaiseDockOperationCompletedEvent(DockOperation.Move, item);
		}

		public override void OnCancel()
		{
			View.EndFloating();
			base.OnCancel();
		}
	}
	public class FloatingViewNativeFloatingMovingListener : FloatingViewFloatingMovingListener
	{
		public override void OnBegin(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			base.OnBegin(point, element);
			UpdateFloatGroupBounds();
		}

		public override void OnDragging(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			if (!UpdateFloatGroupBounds())
			{
				base.OnDragging(point, element);
			}
		}

		private bool UpdateFloatGroupBounds()
		{
			return base.View.FloatGroup.RequestFloatingBoundsUpdate();
		}
	}
	public class FloatingViewFloatingResizingListener : FloatingResizingListener
	{
		private IResizingPreviewHelper resizeHelper;

		private BoundsHelper boundsHelper;

		private bool ShowPreview;

		public FloatingView View => base.ServiceProvider as FloatingView;

		public override void OnInitialize(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			LayoutElementHitInfo layoutElementHitInfo = View.Adapter.CalcHitInfo(View, point);
			SizingAction sizingAction = HitTestTypeExtensions.ToSizingAction(layoutElementHitInfo.HitResult);
			Size resizingMaxSize = LayoutItemsHelper.GetResizingMaxSize(View.FloatGroup);
			boundsHelper = new BoundsHelper(View, element, CalcResizingMinSize(View.FloatGroup), resizingMaxSize, sizingAction);
			View.RootUIElement.SetValue(FrameworkElement.CursorProperty, boundsHelper.GetCursor());
			View.Container.Win32DragService.SizingAction = sizingAction;
		}

		public override void OnBegin(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			View.FloatGroup.ResetMaximized();
			ShowPreview = !View.Container.RedrawContentWhenResizing;
			if (ShowPreview)
			{
				resizeHelper = new FloatingResizingPreviewHelper(View)
				{
					MinSize = CalcResizingMinSize(View.FloatGroup),
					BoundsHelper = boundsHelper
				};
				resizeHelper.InitResizing(point, element);
			}
		}

		public override void OnDragging(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			if (ShowPreview)
			{
				resizeHelper.Resize(point);
			}
			else
			{
				ResizeCore(point);
			}
		}

		public override bool CanDrop(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override void OnCancel()
		{
			if (ShowPreview)
			{
				resizeHelper.EndResizing();
			}
			View.RootUIElement.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.CursorProperty);
		}

		public override void OnDrop(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			if (ShowPreview)
			{
				ResizeCore(point);
				resizeHelper.EndResizing();
			}
			RaiseDockOperationCompleted(element);
			View.RootUIElement.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.CursorProperty);
		}

		private void RaiseDockOperationCompleted(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)element).CheckDragElement().Item;
			View.Container.RaiseDockOperationCompletedEvent(DockOperation.Resize, item);
		}

		private Size CalcResizingMinSize(FloatGroup fGroup)
		{
			return LayoutItemsHelper.GetResizingMinSize(fGroup);
		}

		private void ResizeCore(Point point)
		{
			Point screenPoint = View.ClientToScreen(point);
			View.FloatGroup.DisableSizeToContent();
			View.SetFloatingBounds(boundsHelper.CalcBounds(screenPoint));
			NotificationBatch.Action(View.Container, View.FloatGroup, FloatGroup.FloatLocationProperty);
			NotificationBatch.Action(View.Container, View.FloatGroup, BaseLayoutItem.FloatSizeProperty);
		}
	}
	public class AutoHideViewResizingListener : ResizingListener
	{
		private BoundsHelper boundsHelper;

		private IResizingPreviewHelper resizeHelper;

		private bool ShowPreview;

		private readonly Size minSize = new Size(50.0, 25.0);

		public AutoHideView View => base.ServiceProvider as AutoHideView;

		public override bool CanDrag(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			Point point2 = View.ClientToScreen(point);
			return View.Container.GetAutoHideResizeBounds().Contains(point2);
		}

		public override void OnBegin(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			boundsHelper = new BoundsHelper(View, element, minSize);
			View.RootUIElement.SetValue(FrameworkElement.CursorProperty, boundsHelper.GetCursor());
			ShowPreview = !View.Container.RedrawContentWhenResizing;
			if (ShowPreview)
			{
				resizeHelper = new AutoHideResizingPreviewHelper(View)
				{
					MinSize = minSize,
					BoundsHelper = boundsHelper
				};
				resizeHelper.InitResizing(point, element);
			}
		}

		public override void OnDragging(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			if (ShowPreview)
			{
				resizeHelper.Resize(point);
				return;
			}
			Point screenPoint = View.ClientToScreen(point);
			View.SetPanelBounds(boundsHelper.CalcBounds(screenPoint));
		}

		public override void OnCancel()
		{
			if (ShowPreview)
			{
				resizeHelper.EndResizing();
			}
			View.RootUIElement.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.CursorProperty);
		}

		public override void OnDrop(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			if (ShowPreview)
			{
				Point screenPoint = View.ClientToScreen(point);
				View.SetPanelBounds(boundsHelper.CalcBounds(screenPoint));
				resizeHelper.EndResizing();
			}
			RaiseDockOperationCompleted(element);
			View.RootUIElement.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.CursorProperty);
		}

		public override void OnInitialize(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			base.OnInitialize(point, element);
			View.RootUIElement.SetValue(FrameworkElement.CursorProperty, new BoundsHelper(View, element, minSize).GetCursor());
		}

		private void RaiseDockOperationCompleted(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)element).Item;
			View.Container.RaiseDockOperationCompletedEvent(DockOperation.Resize, item);
		}

		public override bool CanDrop(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class AutoHideViewReorderingListener : LayoutViewReorderingListener
	{
		public override bool CanDrag(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			return new DockLayoutElementDragInfo(base.View, point, element).AcceptHide();
		}

		public override bool CanDrop(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			return new DockLayoutElementDragInfo(base.View, point, element).AcceptHide();
		}
	}
	public class LayoutViewReorderingListener : ReorderingListener
	{
		private class InsertionHelper
		{
			private int _InsertionIndex;

			private bool _IsStartedAsReordering;

			private Point _Point;

			private int currentIndex;

			private int diffIndex;

			private double difX;

			private double difY;

			private int Index { get; set; }

			private int TabIndex
			{
				get
				{
					return _InsertionIndex;
				}
				set
				{
					if (_InsertionIndex != value)
					{
						diffIndex = _InsertionIndex - value;
						_InsertionIndex = value;
					}
				}
			}

			private Point Point
			{
				get
				{
					return _Point;
				}
				set
				{
					if (!(_Point == value))
					{
						difX = Point.X - value.X;
						difY = Point.Y - value.Y;
						_Point = value;
					}
				}
			}

			public bool CanInsert()
			{
				if (_IsStartedAsReordering)
				{
					if ((Math.Sign(diffIndex) == Math.Sign(difX) && Math.Abs(difX) > 0.0) || (Math.Sign(diffIndex) == Math.Sign(difY) && Math.Abs(difY) > 0.0))
					{
						return TabIndex != currentIndex;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}

			public int GetIndex()
			{
				if (!CanInsert())
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return Index;
			}

			public void Update(DockLayoutElementDragInfo dragInfo, bool isStartedAsReordering)
			{
				IDockLayoutContainer dockLayoutContainer = dragInfo.DropTarget as IDockLayoutContainer;
				BaseLayoutItem item = dragInfo.Item;
				if (item != null && dockLayoutContainer != null)
				{
					TabHeaderInsertHelper tabHeaderInsertHelper = new TabHeaderInsertHelper(dockLayoutContainer, dragInfo.Point, item.Parent != dockLayoutContainer.Item);
					TabIndex = tabHeaderInsertHelper.TabIndex;
					Index = tabHeaderInsertHelper.Index;
					Point = dragInfo.Point;
					_IsStartedAsReordering = isStartedAsReordering;
					currentIndex = (dockLayoutContainer.Item as LayoutGroup).Return((LayoutGroup x) => x.TabIndexFromItem(dragInfo.Item), () => -1);
				}
			}
		}

		private readonly InsertionHelper insertionHelper;

		private Point? lastDraggingPoint;

		private Point? lastCanDragPoint;

		private bool IsStartedAsReordering;

		public LayoutView View => base.ServiceProvider as LayoutView;

		public LayoutViewReorderingListener()
		{
			insertionHelper = new InsertionHelper();
		}

		public override void OnEnter()
		{
			base.OnEnter();
			ILayoutElement dragElement = View.Adapter.DragService.DragItem ?? View.Container.LinkedDragService.Return((IDragService x) => x.DragItem, () => (ILayoutElement)null);
			GetDragView()?.EnterReordering();
			Point? point = lastDraggingPoint ?? lastCanDragPoint;
			if (point.HasValue)
			{
				UpdateHints(new DockLayoutElementDragInfo(View, point.Value, dragElement), forceUpdateAdornerBounds: true);
			}
			IsStartedAsReordering = false;
		}

		private void UpdateHints(DockLayoutElementDragInfo dragInfo, bool forceUpdateAdornerBounds = false)
		{
			if (!KeyHelper.IsCtrlPressed)
			{
				View.AdornerHelper.UpdateTabHeadersHint(dragInfo, forceUpdateAdornerBounds);
			}
		}

		public override void OnLeave()
		{
			View.AdornerHelper.BeginHideAdornerWindowAndResetTabHeadersHints();
			GetDragView()?.LeaveReordering();
			IsStartedAsReordering = false;
		}

		public override void OnCancel()
		{
			View.AdornerHelper.ResetTabHeadersHints();
			View.AdornerHelper.TryHideAdornerWindow();
			IsStartedAsReordering = false;
		}

		public override void OnDragging(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			if (IsStartedAsReordering)
			{
				DockLayoutElementDragInfo dragInfo = new DockLayoutElementDragInfo(View, point, element);
				InsertTabPageCore(dragInfo);
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateHints(new DockLayoutElementDragInfo(View, point, element));
			}
			lastDraggingPoint = point;
		}

		public override void OnBegin(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			base.OnBegin(point, element);
			IsStartedAsReordering = true;
			IDockLayoutElement dockLayoutElement = (IDockLayoutElement)element;
			BaseLayoutItem item = dockLayoutElement.Item;
			if (item.IsItemWithRestrictedFloating())
			{
				item.DragCursorBounds = FloatingHelper.GetDragCursorBounds(View, dockLayoutElement);
			}
		}

		public override void OnDrop(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			if (!IsStartedAsReordering)
			{
				DockLayoutElementDragInfo dragInfo = new DockLayoutElementDragInfo(View, point, element);
				InsertTabPageCore(dragInfo);
				View.AdornerHelper.ResetDockingHints();
				View.AdornerHelper.ResetTabHeadersHints();
				View.AdornerHelper.ResetDragVisualization();
				View.AdornerHelper.BeginHideAdornerWindow();
			}
			else
			{
				View.AdornerHelper.TryHideAdornerWindow();
				NotificationBatch.Action(View.Container, ((IDockLayoutElement)element).Item);
			}
			IsStartedAsReordering = false;
		}

		public override bool CanDrag(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			lastCanDragPoint = point;
			DockLayoutElementDragInfo dockLayoutElementDragInfo = new DockLayoutElementDragInfo(View, point, element);
			DockHintHitInfo hitInfo = View.AdornerHelper.GetHitInfo(dockLayoutElementDragInfo.Point);
			bool flag = IsStartedAsReordering || dockLayoutElementDragInfo.AcceptFill();
			if (dockLayoutElementDragInfo.AcceptReordering() && flag)
			{
				if (hitInfo != null)
				{
					return !hitInfo.InHint;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool CanDrop(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			DockLayoutElementDragInfo dockLayoutElementDragInfo = new DockLayoutElementDragInfo(View, point, element);
			DockHintHitInfo hitInfo = View.AdornerHelper.GetHitInfo(dockLayoutElementDragInfo.Point);
			if (dockLayoutElementDragInfo.AcceptFill())
			{
				if (hitInfo != null)
				{
					return !hitInfo.InButton;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool CanInsert(BaseLayoutItem item, Point pt, BaseLayoutItem target, DockType type)
		{
			if (!insertionHelper.CanInsert())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((IsStartedAsReordering && item.Parent == target) || View.AdornerHelper.GetTabHeadersAdorner().IsTabHeaderHintEnabled)
			{
				return !RaiseItemDocking(DockLayoutManager.DockItemEndDockingEvent, item, pt, target, type, isHiding: false);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool RaiseItemDocking(RoutedEvent e, BaseLayoutItem item, Point pt, BaseLayoutItem target, DockType dockType, bool isHiding)
		{
			return View.Container.RaiseItemDockingEvent(e, item, pt, target, dockType, isHiding);
		}

		protected void InsertTabPageCore(DockLayoutElementDragInfo dragInfo)
		{
			IDockLayoutContainer dockLayoutContainer = dragInfo.DropTarget as IDockLayoutContainer;
			if (dragInfo.Item == null || dockLayoutContainer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			FloatingView dragView = GetDragView();
			insertionHelper.Update(dragInfo, IsStartedAsReordering);
			if (CanInsert(dragInfo.Item, dragInfo.Point, dockLayoutContainer.Item, DockType.Fill))
			{
				BaseLayoutItem actualSelectedItem = DockControllerHelper.GetActualSelectedItem(dragInfo.Item);
				if (View.Container.DockController.Insert((LayoutGroup)dockLayoutContainer.Item, dragInfo.Item, insertionHelper.GetIndex(), IsStartedAsReordering))
				{
					View.Container.DockController.Activate(actualSelectedItem);
				}
			}
			dragView?.LeaveReordering();
		}

		public override void OnComplete()
		{
			base.OnComplete();
			View.AdornerHelper.ResetTabHeadersHints();
			View.AdornerHelper.TryHideAdornerWindow();
			IsStartedAsReordering = false;
		}

		public override bool CancelReordering(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			if (!IsStartedAsReordering)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DockLayoutElementDragInfo dockLayoutElementDragInfo = new DockLayoutElementDragInfo(View, point, element);
			return !LayoutItemsHelper.CanReorder(dockLayoutElementDragInfo.Item, dockLayoutElementDragInfo.OriginalTarget);
		}

		private FloatingView GetDragView()
		{
			ILayoutElement layoutElement = View.Adapter.DragService.DragItem ?? View.Container.LinkedDragService.Return((IDragService x) => x.DragItem, () => (ILayoutElement)null);
			FloatingView floatingView = View.Adapter.GetView(layoutElement) as FloatingView;
			if (floatingView == null)
			{
				floatingView = View.Container.GetView((layoutElement as IDockLayoutElement)?.Item) as FloatingView;
			}
			return floatingView;
		}
	}
	public class LayoutViewMDIReorderingListener : ReorderingListener
	{
		private MDILocationHelper helper;

		private MDIDocumentElement document;

		public LayoutView View => base.ServiceProvider as LayoutView;

		public override void OnBegin(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			document = (MDIDocumentElement)element;
			helper = new MDILocationHelper(View, document);
		}

		public override void OnDragging(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			Point screenPoint = View.ClientToScreen(point);
			Point value = helper.CalcLocation(screenPoint);
			DocumentPanel.SetMDILocation(document.Item, value);
			if (((DocumentPanel)document.Item).IsMinimized)
			{
				((DocumentPanel)document.Item).MinimizeLocation = value;
			}
			NotificationBatch.Action(View.Container, document.Item, DocumentPanel.MDILocationProperty);
		}

		public override bool CanDrop(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override void OnCancel()
		{
			helper = null;
			document = null;
		}

		public override void OnDrop(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			RaiseDockOperationCompleted(element);
			helper = null;
			document = null;
		}

		private void RaiseDockOperationCompleted(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)element).Item;
			View.Container.RaiseDockOperationCompletedEvent(DockOperation.Move, item);
		}
	}
	public class LayoutViewMDIResizingListener : ResizingListener
	{
		private static readonly Size DefaultMinSize = new Size(82.0, 42.0);

		private bool ShowPreview;

		private MDIBoundsHelper boundsHelper;

		private MDIDocumentElement document;

		private IResizingPreviewHelper resizeHelper;

		public LayoutView View => base.ServiceProvider as LayoutView;

		public override void OnBegin(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			document = (MDIDocumentElement)element;
			Size minSize = MathHelper.MeasureMinSize(new Size[2]
			{
				DefaultMinSize,
				document.Item.ActualMinSize
			});
			Size actualMaxSize = document.Item.ActualMaxSize;
			boundsHelper = new MDIBoundsHelper(View, document, minSize, actualMaxSize);
			View.RootUIElement.SetValue(FrameworkElement.CursorProperty, boundsHelper.GetCursor());
			ShowPreview = !View.Container.RedrawContentWhenResizing;
			if (ShowPreview)
			{
				resizeHelper = new MDIDocumentResizingPreviewHelper(View)
				{
					MinSize = minSize,
					MaxSize = actualMaxSize
				};
				resizeHelper.InitResizing(point, element);
			}
		}

		public override void OnDragging(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			if (ShowPreview)
			{
				resizeHelper.Resize(point);
			}
			else
			{
				ResizeCore(point);
			}
		}

		public override bool CanDrop(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override void OnCancel()
		{
			if (ShowPreview)
			{
				resizeHelper.EndResizing();
			}
			Reset();
		}

		public override void OnDrop(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			if (ShowPreview)
			{
				ResizeCore(point);
				resizeHelper.EndResizing();
			}
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)element).Item;
			View.Container.RaiseDockOperationCompletedEvent(DockOperation.Resize, item);
			Reset();
		}

		private void Reset()
		{
			View.RootUIElement.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.CursorProperty);
			boundsHelper = null;
			document = null;
		}

		private void ResizeCore(Point point)
		{
			Point screenPoint = View.ClientToScreen(point);
			Rect rect = boundsHelper.CalcBounds(screenPoint);
			DocumentPanel.SetMDISize(document.Item, RectHelper.Size(rect));
			DocumentPanel.SetMDILocation(document.Item, RectHelper.Location(rect));
			NotificationBatch.Action(View.Container, document.Item, DocumentPanel.MDILocationProperty);
			NotificationBatch.Action(View.Container, document.Item, DocumentPanel.MDISizeProperty);
		}
	}
	public class LayoutViewClientDraggingListener : ClientDraggingListener
	{
		public LayoutView View => base.ServiceProvider as LayoutView;

		public override void OnBegin(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			IDockLayoutElement dockLayoutElement = (IDockLayoutElement)element;
			BaseLayoutItem item = dockLayoutElement.Item;
			if (item.IsItemWithRestrictedFloating())
			{
				item.DragCursorBounds = FloatingHelper.GetDragCursorBounds(View, dockLayoutElement);
			}
			Point point2 = View.ClientToScreen(point);
			View.Container.CustomizationController.ShowDragCursor(point2, item);
			View.Adapter.SelectionService.ClearSelection(View);
			View.AdornerHelper.TryShowAdornerWindow(forceUpdateAdornerBounds: true);
		}

		public override void OnDragging(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)element).Item;
			if (item.IsItemWithRestrictedFloating())
			{
				DockHintHitInfo dockHintHitInfo = null;
				Point point2 = View.ClientToScreen(point);
				LayoutView layoutView = View.Adapter.GetBehindView(View, point2) as LayoutView;
				if (layoutView != null && layoutView != View)
				{
					Point behindViewPoint = View.Adapter.GetBehindViewPoint(View, layoutView, point2);
					DockLayoutElementDragInfo dockLayoutElementDragInfo = new DockLayoutElementDragInfo(layoutView, behindViewPoint, element);
					dockHintHitInfo = layoutView.AdornerHelper.GetHitInfo(dockLayoutElementDragInfo.Point);
				}
				else
				{
					DockLayoutElementDragInfo dockLayoutElementDragInfo2 = new DockLayoutElementDragInfo(View, point, element);
					dockHintHitInfo = View.AdornerHelper.GetHitInfo(dockLayoutElementDragInfo2.Point);
				}
				if (!View.Container.ShowContentWhenDragging && (dockHintHitInfo.Return((DockHintHitInfo x) => x.DockType != DockType.None, () => false) || View.AdornerHelper.IsTabHeadersHintEnabled || (layoutView != null && layoutView.AdornerHelper.IsTabHeadersHintEnabled)))
				{
					View.Container.CustomizationController.HideDragCursor();
				}
				else
				{
					UpdateDragCursor(element, point);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateDragCursor(element, point);
				DragInfo info = DockLayoutElementDragInfo.CalcDragInfo(View, point, element);
				View.Container.CustomizationController.UpdateDragInfo(info);
			}
		}

		public override bool CanDrop(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)element).Item;
			if (!View.Container.ShowContentWhenDragging)
			{
				if (!item.AllowFloat)
				{
					return item.AllowMove;
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (item.IsItemWithRestrictedFloating())
			{
				return new DockingHelper(View).CanDrop(point, element);
			}
			return new MovingHelper(View).CanMove(point, element);
		}

		public override void OnDrop(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			ResetVisualization();
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)element).Item;
			if (item.IsItemWithRestrictedFloating())
			{
				BaseLayoutItem item2 = ((IDockLayoutElement)element).CheckDragElement().Item;
				if (item2.AllowFloat)
				{
					RaiseDockOperationCompleted(element);
				}
				Vector vector = new Vector(item.DragCursorBounds.Location.X, item.DragCursorBounds.Location.Y);
				Point point2 = View.ClientToScreen(point);
				LayoutView layoutView = View.Adapter.GetBehindView(View, point2) as LayoutView;
				FloatGroup floatGroup = item.GetRoot() as FloatGroup;
				bool flag = item.IsFloatingRootItem || item is FloatGroup;
				if (flag && floatGroup.IsMaximized)
				{
					floatGroup.ResetMaximized(point2 - vector);
				}
				bool flag2 = false;
				if (layoutView != null)
				{
					Point behindViewPoint = View.Adapter.GetBehindViewPoint(View, layoutView, point2);
					flag2 = new DockingHelper(layoutView).CanDrop(behindViewPoint, element);
					if (flag2)
					{
						flag2 = new DockingHelper(layoutView).Drop(behindViewPoint, element);
					}
				}
				if (!View.IsDisposing && !flag2 && !View.AdornerHelper.IsTabHeadersHintEnabled && (layoutView == null || !layoutView.AdornerHelper.IsTabHeadersHintEnabled))
				{
					Thickness borderMargin = item.GetBorderMargin();
					vector.X += borderMargin.Left;
					vector.Y += borderMargin.Top;
					if (flag)
					{
						floatGroup.FloatLocation = point2 - vector;
					}
					else
					{
						InitFloating(element, point - vector);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				new MovingHelper(View).Move(point, element);
			}
		}

		public override void OnEnter()
		{
			View.AdornerHelper.TryShowAdornerWindow(forceUpdateAdornerBounds: true);
		}

		public override void OnCancel()
		{
			View.Adapter.SelectionService.ClearSelection(View);
			ResetVisualization();
		}

		protected void ResetVisualization()
		{
			View.Container.CustomizationController.HideDragCursor();
			View.Container.CustomizationController.UpdateDragInfo(null);
		}

		protected void UpdateDragCursor(ILayoutElement element, Point point)
		{
			ICustomizationController customizationController = View.Container.CustomizationController;
			Point point2 = View.ClientToScreen(point);
			if (!customizationController.IsDragCursorVisible)
			{
				customizationController.ShowDragCursor(point2, ((IDockLayoutElement)element).Item);
			}
			else
			{
				customizationController.SetDragCursorPosition(point2);
			}
		}

		private void InitFloating(ILayoutElement element, Point point)
		{
			if (GetFloatingView(element) is FloatingView floatingView)
			{
				Point floatLocation = View.ClientToScreen(point);
				floatingView.FloatGroup.FloatLocation = floatLocation;
			}
		}

		protected override IFloatingHelper CreateFloatingHelper()
		{
			if (!(View.Adapter.DragService.DragItem is AutoHidePaneHeaderItemElement))
			{
				return new FloatingHelper(View);
			}
			return new AutoHideFloatingHelper(View);
		}

		public override bool CanDrag(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			bool flag = base.CanDrag(point, element);
			return ((IDockLayoutElement)element).Item is FloatGroup || flag;
		}

		private void RaiseDockOperationCompleted(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)element).CheckDragElement().Item;
			View.Container.RaiseDockOperationCompletedEvent(DockOperation.Move, item);
		}
	}
	public class LayoutViewNonClientDraggingListener : NonClientDraggingListener
	{
		public LayoutView View => base.ServiceProvider as LayoutView;

		public override void OnDragging(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			UpdateDragCursor(element, point);
		}

		public override void OnCancel()
		{
			View.Container.CustomizationController.HideDragCursor();
			ResetVisualization();
		}

		public override void OnDrop(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			View.Container.CustomizationController.HideDragCursor();
			ResetVisualization();
		}

		protected void ResetVisualization()
		{
			View.Container.CustomizationController.HideDragCursor();
			View.Container.CustomizationController.UpdateDragInfo(null);
		}

		protected void UpdateDragCursor(ILayoutElement element, Point point)
		{
			ICustomizationController customizationController = View.Container.CustomizationController;
			Point point2 = View.ClientToScreen(point);
			if (!customizationController.IsDragCursorVisible)
			{
				customizationController.ShowDragCursor(point2, ((IDockLayoutElement)element).Item);
			}
			else
			{
				customizationController.SetDragCursorPosition(point2);
			}
		}

		public override bool CanDrop(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)element).Item;
			if (!View.Container.ShowContentWhenDragging)
			{
				return item.AllowFloat;
			}
			return base.CanDrop(point, element);
		}
	}

	public enum DockVisualizerElement
	{
		None,
		Left,
		Right,
		Top,
		Bottom,
		Center,
		Selection,
		DockZone,
		HideLeft,
		HideRight,
		HideTop,
		HideBottom,
		RenameHint
	}
	public static class DockHintElementFactory
	{
		public static DockHintElement Make(DockVisualizerElement type)
		{
			switch (type)
			{
			case DockVisualizerElement.Center:
				return new CenterDockHintElement();
			case DockVisualizerElement.Left:
			case DockVisualizerElement.Right:
			case DockVisualizerElement.Top:
			case DockVisualizerElement.Bottom:
				return new SideDockHintElement(type);
			case DockVisualizerElement.DockZone:
				return new RectangleDockHint();
			case DockVisualizerElement.Selection:
				return new SelectionHint();
			case DockVisualizerElement.RenameHint:
				return new RenameHint();
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}
	}
	[DXToolboxBrowsable(false)]
	public abstract class DockHintElement : psvControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty DockTypeProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowShadowProperty;

		public bool ShowShadow
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(ShowShadowProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ShowShadowProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public DockVisualizerElement Type { get; private set; }

		static DockHintElement()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DockHintElement> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DockHintElement>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttachedInherited("DockType", ref DockTypeProperty, DockType.None);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ShowShadow", ref ShowShadowProperty, defValue: true);
		}

		public static DockType GetDockType(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (DockType)obj.GetValue(DockTypeProperty);
		}

		public static void SetDockType(DependencyObject obj, DockType value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(DockTypeProperty, value);
		}

		public DockHintElement(DockVisualizerElement type)
		{
			Type = type;
		}

		public virtual void UpdateAvailableState(bool dock, bool hide, bool fill)
		{
		}

		public virtual void UpdateHotTrack(DockHintButton hotButton)
		{
		}

		public virtual void UpdateAvailableState(DockingHintAdornerBase adorner)
		{
		}

		public virtual void UpdateEnabledState(DockingHintAdornerBase adorner)
		{
		}

		public virtual void UpdateState(DockingHintAdornerBase adorner)
		{
		}

		protected void UpdateHotTrack(DockHintButton button, DockHintButton hotButton)
		{
			if (button != null)
			{
				button.IsHot = CalcHotTrack(button, hotButton);
			}
		}

		protected bool UpdateVisibility(DockingHintAdornerBase adorner)
		{
			bool flag = CalcVisibleState(adorner);
			base.Visibility = ((!flag) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			return flag;
		}

		public void Arrange(DockingHintAdornerBase adorner, DockingHintAdornerBase.ElementInfo info)
		{
			if (UpdateVisibility(adorner))
			{
				Rect finalRect = info.CalcPlacement(CalcBounds(adorner), VisualizerAdornerHelper.GetAdornerWindowIndent((UIElement)(object)adorner));
				if (!finalRect.IsEmpty)
				{
					Arrange(finalRect);
				}
			}
		}

		protected abstract bool CalcVisibleState(DockingHintAdornerBase adorner);

		protected abstract Rect CalcBounds(DockingHintAdornerBase adorner);

		private bool CalcHotTrack(DockHintButton button, DockHintButton hotButton)
		{
			if (button.IsAvailable)
			{
				return button == hotButton;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_Dock", Type = typeof(DockHintButton))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_Hide", Type = typeof(DockHintButton))]
	public class SideDockHintElement : DockHintElement
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty LeftTemplateProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RightTemplateProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty TopTemplateProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty BottomTemplateProperty;

		public ControlTemplate LeftTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return (ControlTemplate)GetValue(LeftTemplateProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LeftTemplateProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public ControlTemplate RightTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return (ControlTemplate)GetValue(RightTemplateProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(RightTemplateProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public ControlTemplate TopTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return (ControlTemplate)GetValue(TopTemplateProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(TopTemplateProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public ControlTemplate BottomTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return (ControlTemplate)GetValue(BottomTemplateProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(BottomTemplateProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected DockHintButton DockButton { get; private set; }

		protected DockHintButton HideButton { get; private set; }

		public bool IsHorizontal { get; private set; }

		static SideDockHintElement()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<SideDockHintElement> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<SideDockHintElement>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<SideDockHintElement>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<ControlTemplate>("LeftTemplate", ref LeftTemplateProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((SideDockHintElement)dObj).OnHintTemplateChanged();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<ControlTemplate>("RightTemplate", ref RightTemplateProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((SideDockHintElement)dObj).OnHintTemplateChanged();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<ControlTemplate>("TopTemplate", ref TopTemplateProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((SideDockHintElement)dObj).OnHintTemplateChanged();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<ControlTemplate>("BottomTemplate", ref BottomTemplateProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((SideDockHintElement)dObj).OnHintTemplateChanged();
			});
		}

		protected virtual void OnHintTemplateChanged()
		{
			if (LeftTemplate != null && RightTemplate != null && TopTemplate != null && BottomTemplate != null)
			{
				SelectTemplate(base.Type);
			}
		}

		public SideDockHintElement(DockVisualizerElement type)
			: base(type)
		{
			IsHorizontal = base.Type == DockVisualizerElement.Left || base.Type == DockVisualizerElement.Right;
		}

		public override void UpdateState(DockingHintAdornerBase adorner)
		{
			DockHintsConfiguration dockHintsConfiguration = adorner.DockHintsConfiguration;
			UpdateAvailableState(dockHintsConfiguration);
			UpdateEnabledState(dockHintsConfiguration);
		}

		public override void UpdateAvailableState(bool dock, bool hide, bool fill)
		{
			if (DockButton != null)
			{
				DockButton.IsAvailable = dock;
			}
			if (HideButton != null)
			{
				HideButton.IsAvailable = hide;
				HideButton.Visibility = ((!hide) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			}
		}

		public void UpdateAvailableState(DockHintsConfiguration configuration)
		{
			bool sideIsEnabled = configuration.GetSideIsEnabled(base.Type);
			bool autoHideIsEnabled = configuration.GetAutoHideIsEnabled(base.Type);
			if (DockButton != null)
			{
				DockButton.IsAvailable = sideIsEnabled;
			}
			if (HideButton != null)
			{
				HideButton.IsAvailable = autoHideIsEnabled;
				HideButton.Visibility = ((!autoHideIsEnabled) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			}
		}

		public override void UpdateAvailableState(DockingHintAdornerBase adorner)
		{
			DockHintsConfiguration dockHintsConfiguration = adorner.DockHintsConfiguration;
			UpdateAvailableState(dockHintsConfiguration);
		}

		private void UpdateEnabledState(DockHintsConfiguration configuration)
		{
			bool sideIsVisible = configuration.GetSideIsVisible(base.Type);
			bool autoHideIsVisible = configuration.GetAutoHideIsVisible(base.Type);
			if (DockButton != null)
			{
				DockButton.IsEnabled = sideIsVisible;
			}
			if (HideButton != null)
			{
				HideButton.IsEnabled = autoHideIsVisible;
			}
		}

		public override void UpdateEnabledState(DockingHintAdornerBase adorner)
		{
			DockHintsConfiguration dockHintsConfiguration = adorner.DockHintsConfiguration;
			UpdateEnabledState(dockHintsConfiguration);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			DockButton = GetTemplateChild("PART_Dock") as DockHintButton;
			HideButton = GetTemplateChild("PART_Hide") as DockHintButton;
		}

		public override void UpdateHotTrack(DockHintButton hotButton)
		{
			UpdateHotTrack(DockButton, hotButton);
			UpdateHotTrack(HideButton, hotButton);
		}

		protected override bool CalcVisibleState(DockingHintAdornerBase adorner)
		{
			DockHintsConfiguration dockHintsConfiguration = adorner.DockHintsConfiguration;
			if (dockHintsConfiguration.GetGuideIsVisible(base.Type))
			{
				return dockHintsConfiguration.ShowSideDockHints;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override Rect CalcBounds(DockingHintAdornerBase adorner)
		{
			return adorner.SurfaceRect;
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized()
		{
			base.OnInitialized();
			SelectTemplate(base.Type);
		}

		protected virtual void SelectTemplate(DockVisualizerElement type)
		{
			if (!base.IsDisposing)
			{
				switch (type)
				{
				case DockVisualizerElement.Left:
					base.Template = LeftTemplate;
					break;
				case DockVisualizerElement.Right:
					base.Template = RightTemplate;
					break;
				case DockVisualizerElement.Top:
					base.Template = TopTemplate;
					break;
				case DockVisualizerElement.Bottom:
					base.Template = BottomTemplate;
					break;
				default:
					base.Template = null;
					break;
				}
			}
		}
	}

		public override void UpdateState(DockingHintAdornerBase adorner)
