		public override void UpdateHotTrack(DockHintButton hotButton)
		{
			UpdateHotTrack(LeftButton, hotButton);
			UpdateHotTrack(RightButton, hotButton);
			UpdateHotTrack(TopButton, hotButton);
			UpdateHotTrack(BottomButton, hotButton);
			UpdateHotTrack(FillButton, hotButton);
			UpdateHotTrack(TabLeftButton, hotButton);
			UpdateHotTrack(TabRightButton, hotButton);
			UpdateHotTrack(TabTopButton, hotButton);
			UpdateHotTrack(TabBottomButton, hotButton);
		}

		public void UpdateAvailableState(DockHintsConfiguration configuration)
		{
			if (FillButton != null)
			{
				FillButton.IsAvailable = configuration.GetIsEnabled(DockHint.Center);
			}
			if (LeftButton != null)
			{
				LeftButton.IsAvailable = configuration.GetIsEnabled(DockHint.CenterLeft);
			}
			if (RightButton != null)
			{
				RightButton.IsAvailable = configuration.GetIsEnabled(DockHint.CenterRight);
			}
			if (TopButton != null)
			{
				TopButton.IsAvailable = configuration.GetIsEnabled(DockHint.CenterTop);
			}
			if (BottomButton != null)
			{
				BottomButton.IsAvailable = configuration.GetIsEnabled(DockHint.CenterBottom);
			}
			if (TabLeftButton != null)
			{
				TabLeftButton.IsAvailable = configuration.GetIsEnabled(DockHint.TabLeft);
			}
			if (TabRightButton != null)
			{
				TabRightButton.IsAvailable = configuration.GetIsEnabled(DockHint.TabRight);
			}
			if (TabTopButton != null)
			{
				TabTopButton.IsAvailable = configuration.GetIsEnabled(DockHint.TabTop);
			}
			if (TabBottomButton != null)
			{
				TabBottomButton.IsAvailable = configuration.GetIsEnabled(DockHint.TabBottom);
			}
		}

		public override void UpdateAvailableState(DockingHintAdornerBase adorner)
		{
			DockHintsConfiguration dockHintsConfiguration = adorner.DockHintsConfiguration;
			UpdateAvailableState(dockHintsConfiguration);
		}

		public void UpdateEnabledState(DockHintsConfiguration configuration)
		{
			DockHintsVisibility = VisibilityHelper.Convert(configuration.DisplayMode != DockGuidDisplayMode.TabOnly && configuration.DisplayMode != DockGuidDisplayMode.FillOnly);
			TabHintsVisibility = VisibilityHelper.Convert(configuration.DisplayMode != DockGuidDisplayMode.DockOnly);
			if (FillButton != null)
			{
				FillButton.IsEnabled = configuration.GetIsVisible(DockHint.Center);
			}
			if (LeftButton != null)
			{
				LeftButton.IsEnabled = configuration.GetIsVisible(DockHint.CenterLeft);
			}
			if (RightButton != null)
			{
				RightButton.IsEnabled = configuration.GetIsVisible(DockHint.CenterRight);
			}
			if (TopButton != null)
			{
				TopButton.IsEnabled = configuration.GetIsVisible(DockHint.CenterTop);
			}
			if (BottomButton != null)
			{
				BottomButton.IsEnabled = configuration.GetIsVisible(DockHint.CenterBottom);
			}
			if (TabLeftButton != null)
			{
				TabLeftButton.IsEnabled = configuration.GetIsVisible(DockHint.TabLeft);
			}
			if (TabRightButton != null)
			{
				TabRightButton.IsEnabled = configuration.GetIsVisible(DockHint.TabRight);
			}
			if (TabTopButton != null)
			{
				TabTopButton.IsEnabled = configuration.GetIsVisible(DockHint.TabTop);
			}
			if (TabBottomButton != null)
			{
				TabBottomButton.IsEnabled = configuration.GetIsVisible(DockHint.TabBottom);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateOpactity(DockHintsConfiguration configuration)
		{
			bool flag = configuration.DisplayMode == DockGuidDisplayMode.DockAndFill || configuration.DisplayMode == DockGuidDisplayMode.FillOnly;
			if (TabLeftButton != null)
			{
				TabLeftButton.Opacity = ((!flag) ? 1 : 0);
			}
			if (TabRightButton != null)
			{
				TabRightButton.Opacity = ((!flag) ? 1 : 0);
			}
			if (TabTopButton != null)
			{
				TabTopButton.Opacity = ((!flag) ? 1 : 0);
			}
			if (TabBottomButton != null)
			{
				TabBottomButton.Opacity = ((!flag) ? 1 : 0);
			}
		}

		public override void UpdateEnabledState(DockingHintAdornerBase adorner)
		{
			DockHintsConfiguration dockHintsConfiguration = adorner.DockHintsConfiguration;
			UpdateEnabledState(dockHintsConfiguration);
		}

		protected override bool CalcVisibleState(DockingHintAdornerBase adorner)
		{
			DockHintsConfiguration dockHintsConfiguration = adorner.DockHintsConfiguration;
			if (dockHintsConfiguration.GetGuideIsVisible(base.Type))
			{
				return dockHintsConfiguration.ShowSelfDockHint;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override Rect CalcBounds(DockingHintAdornerBase adorner)
		{
			return adorner.TargetRect;
		}

		protected virtual void OnTabHintsVisibilityChanged(Visibility oldValue, Visibility newValue)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnDockHintsVisibilityChanged(Visibility oldValue, Visibility newValue)
		{
		}
	}

	public class SelectionHint : DockHintElement
	{
		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey ShowLeftMarkerPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowLeftMarkerProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey ShowRightMarkerPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowRightMarkerProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey ShowTopMarkerPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowTopMarkerProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey ShowBottomMarkerPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ShowBottomMarkerProperty;

		private BaseLayoutItem itemCore;

		public bool ShowLeftMarker
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(ShowLeftMarkerProperty);
			}
			internal set
			{
				SetValue(ShowLeftMarkerPropertyKey, value);
			}
		}

		public bool ShowRightMarker
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(ShowRightMarkerProperty);
			}
			internal set
			{
				SetValue(ShowRightMarkerPropertyKey, value);
			}
		}

		public bool ShowTopMarker
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(ShowTopMarkerProperty);
			}
			internal set
			{
				SetValue(ShowTopMarkerPropertyKey, value);
			}
		}

		public bool ShowBottomMarker
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(ShowBottomMarkerProperty);
			}
			internal set
			{
				SetValue(ShowBottomMarkerPropertyKey, value);
			}
		}

		public BaseLayoutItem Item
		{
			get
			{
				return itemCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Item != value)
				{
					itemCore = value;
					OnItemChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		protected UIElement ItemElement { get; set; }

		static SelectionHint()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<SelectionHint> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<SelectionHint>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<SelectionHint>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("ShowLeftMarker", ref ShowLeftMarkerPropertyKey, ref ShowLeftMarkerProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("ShowRightMarker", ref ShowRightMarkerPropertyKey, ref ShowRightMarkerProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("ShowTopMarker", ref ShowTopMarkerPropertyKey, ref ShowTopMarkerProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("ShowBottomMarker", ref ShowBottomMarkerPropertyKey, ref ShowBottomMarkerProperty, defValue: false);
		}

		public SelectionHint()
			: base(DockVisualizerElement.Selection)
		{
			base.IsTabStop = false;
			base.IsHitTestVisible = false;
		}

		public void EnqueueFocus()
		{
			Action action = delegate
			{
				Focus();
			};
			if (base.IsVisible)
			{
				action();
			}
			else
			{
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(action, DispatcherPriority.Render);
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateMarkers(bool isVerticalOrientation, bool isFirst, bool isLast)
		{
			if (isVerticalOrientation)
			{
				ShowTopMarker = !isFirst;
				ShowBottomMarker = !isLast;
				ShowLeftMarker = false;
				ShowRightMarker = false;
			}
			else
			{
				ShowLeftMarker = !isFirst;
				ShowRightMarker = !isLast;
				ShowTopMarker = false;
				ShowBottomMarker = false;
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateMarkers()
		{
			if (Item != null)
			{
				LayoutGroup parent = Item.Parent;
				if (parent != null)
				{
					int num = parent.Items.IndexOf(Item);
					bool isFirst = num == 0;
					bool isLast = num == parent.Items.Count - 1;
					UpdateMarkers(parent.Orientation == Orientation.Vertical, isFirst, isLast);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnItemElementMouseEnter(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateMarkers();
		}

		internal void OnItemElementMouseLeave(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			ShowLeftMarker = false;
			ShowRightMarker = false;
			ShowTopMarker = false;
			ShowBottomMarker = false;
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemChanged()
		{
			if (Item != null && Item.Manager != null)
			{
				IUIElement uIElement = Item.GetUIElement<BaseLayoutItem>();
				ItemElement = (UIElement)(uIElement ?? Item.GetUIElement<IUIElement>());
			}
			else
			{
				ItemElement = null;
			}
			UpdateMarkers();
		}

		protected internal Rect GetItemBounds()
		{
			if (Item != null && Item.Manager != null && ItemElement != null)
			{
				ILayoutElement viewElement = Item.Manager.GetViewElement((IUIElement)ItemElement);
				if (viewElement != null)
				{
					ForceUpdateElementBounds(viewElement);
					return ElementHelper.GetRect(viewElement);
				}
			}
			return Rect.Empty;
		}

		private void ForceUpdateElementBounds(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			element.Invalidate();
			element.EnsureBounds();
		}

		protected override bool CalcVisibleState(DockingHintAdornerBase adorner)
		{
			if (adorner.ShowSelectionHints && Item != null)
			{
				return Item.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override Rect CalcBounds(DockingHintAdornerBase adorner)
		{
			Rect itemBounds = GetItemBounds();
			if (!itemBounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				RectHelper.Inflate(ref itemBounds, 1.0, 1.0);
			}
			return itemBounds;
		}
	}
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_Text", Type = typeof(TextBox))]
	public class RenameHint : DockHintElement
	{
		private IDockLayoutElement LayoutElement;

		private BaseLayoutItem itemCore;

		private string OldCaption;

		private readonly Locker renamingLocker = new Locker();

		protected TextBox PartText { get; private set; }

		private DockLayoutManager Manager
		{
			get
			{
				if (Item == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Item.Manager;
			}
		}

		public bool IsRenamingStarted => Locker.op_Implicit(renamingLocker);

		internal BaseLayoutItem Item
		{
			get
			{
				return itemCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Item != value)
				{
					itemCore = value;
					OnItemChanged();
					OldCaption = ((itemCore != null) ? (itemCore.Caption as string) : null);
				}
			}
		}

		internal Size TextMinSize { get; private set; }

		static RenameHint()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<RenameHint> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<RenameHint>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<RenameHint>();
		}

		public RenameHint()
			: base(DockVisualizerElement.RenameHint)
		{
		}//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown


		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			UnsubscribeEvents();
			PartText = GetTemplateChild("PART_Text") as TextBox;
			SubscribeEvents();
		}

		private void SubscribeEvents()
		{
			if (PartText != null)
			{
				PartText.IsVisibleChanged += PartText_IsVisibleChanged;
				PartText.Loaded += PartText_Loaded;
			}
		}

		private void UnsubscribeEvents()
		{
			if (PartText != null)
			{
				PartText.IsVisibleChanged -= PartText_IsVisibleChanged;
				PartText.Loaded -= PartText_Loaded;
			}
		}

		private void PartText_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Item != null)
			{
				PartText.Text = Item.Caption as string;
			}
			PartText.Focus();
			PartText.SelectAll();
		}

		private void PartText_IsVisibleChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if ((bool)e.NewValue)
			{
				PartText.Focus();
				PartText.SelectAll();
			}
		}

		private void MeasureText()
		{
			string text = ((Item != null) ? (Item.Caption as string) : null);
			PartText.Text = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text)) ? text : "TestText");
			PartText.Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
			TextMinSize = PartText.DesiredSize;
		}

		internal void StartRenaming(IDockLayoutElement element)
		{
			if (Locker.op_Implicit(renamingLocker))
			{
				CancelRenaming();
			}
			renamingLocker.Lock();
			LayoutElement = element;
			Item = element.Item;
			if (Manager != null)
			{
				Manager.CoerceValue(DockLayoutManager.IsRenamingProperty);
			}
		}

		internal void EndRenaming()
		{
			if (Locker.op_Implicit(renamingLocker))
			{
				renamingLocker.Unlock();
				Item.Caption = PartText.Text;
				if (Manager != null)
				{
					Manager.RaiseEvent(new LayoutItemEndRenamingEventArgs(Item, OldCaption));
					Manager.CoerceValue(DockLayoutManager.IsRenamingProperty);
				}
				Item = null;
			}
		}

		internal void CancelRenaming()
		{
			if (Locker.op_Implicit(renamingLocker))
			{
				renamingLocker.Unlock();
				if (Manager != null)
				{
					Manager.RaiseEvent(new LayoutItemEndRenamingEventArgs(Item, OldCaption, canceled: true));
					Manager.CoerceValue(DockLayoutManager.IsRenamingProperty);
				}
				Item = null;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemChanged()
		{
			if (Item != null && Item.Manager != null && PartText != null)
			{
				MeasureText();
				PartText.Text = Item.Caption as string;
			}
		}

		protected internal Rect GetItemBounds()
		{
			UIElement uIElement = ((LayoutElement != null) ? LayoutElement.Element : Item);
			if (Item != null && Item.Manager != null && uIElement != null)
			{
				IDockLayoutElement layoutElement = LayoutElement;
				if (LayoutElement == null)
				{
					return Rect.Empty;
				}
				TemplatedCaptionControl templatedCaptionControl = (TemplatedCaptionControl)LayoutHelper.FindElement((FrameworkElement)uIElement, (Predicate<FrameworkElement>)((FrameworkElement e) => e is TemplatedCaptionControl));
				UIElement uIElement2 = ((templatedCaptionControl == null) ? uIElement : templatedCaptionControl.GetActualCaptionPart());
				Size size = uIElement2.RenderSize;
				if (size.Width <= 0.0 || size.Height <= 0.0 || templatedCaptionControl == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(Item.Caption as string))
				{
					size = TextMinSize;
				}
				Point point = PartText.TranslatePoint(CoordinateHelper.ZeroPoint, this);
				Point location = uIElement2.TranslatePoint(CoordinateHelper.ZeroPoint, layoutElement.View);
				return new Rect(location, size);
			}
			return Rect.Empty;
		}

		protected override bool CalcVisibleState(DockingHintAdornerBase adorner)
		{
			if (Item != null)
			{
				return Item.AllowRename;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override Rect CalcBounds(DockingHintAdornerBase adorner)
		{
			return GetItemBounds();
		}
	}

	public class FixedItemElement : DockLayoutElement
	{
		public FixedItemElement(UIElement uiElement, UIElement view)
			: base(LayoutItemType.FixedItem, uiElement, view)
		{
		}

		public override bool AcceptDropTarget(DockLayoutElementDragInfo dragInfo)
		{
			if (dragInfo.Target == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			LayoutItemType itemType = dragInfo.Target.ItemType;
			if (!LayoutItemsHelper.IsLayoutItem(dragInfo.Target))
			{
				return itemType == LayoutItemType.Group;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override BaseDropInfo CalcDropInfo(BaseLayoutItem item, Point point)
		{
			return DropTypeHelper.CalcSideDropInfo(ElementHelper.GetRect(this), point, 0.25);
		}

		protected override LayoutElementHitInfo CreateHitInfo(Point pt)
		{
			return new FixedItemElementHitInfo(pt, this, LayoutControllerHelper.GetLayoutController(base.Element));
		}

		public override ILayoutElementBehavior GetBehavior()
		{
			return new FixedItemElementBehavior(this);
		}
	}

	public class TreeItemElement : DockLayoutElement
	{
		public TreeItemElement(UIElement uiElement, UIElement view)
			: base(LayoutItemType.TreeItem, uiElement, view)
		{
		}

		protected override BaseLayoutItem GetItem(UIElement uiElement)
		{
			return ((TreeItem)uiElement).LayoutItem;
		}

		public override ILayoutElementBehavior GetBehavior()
		{
			return new TreeItemElementBehavior(this);
		}

		protected override LayoutElementHitInfo CreateHitInfo(Point pt)
		{
			return new TreeItemElementHitInfo(pt, this, LayoutControllerHelper.GetLayoutController(base.Element));
		}

		public override bool AcceptDropTarget(DockLayoutElementDragInfo dragInfo)
		{
			if (dragInfo.Target == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (dragInfo.Item is LayoutGroup && LayoutItemsHelper.IsParent(dragInfo.Target, dragInfo.Item))
			{
				return false;
			}
			LayoutItemType itemType = dragInfo.Target.ItemType;
			if (!LayoutItemsHelper.IsLayoutItem(dragInfo.Target))
			{
				return itemType == LayoutItemType.Group;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool AcceptDragSource(DockLayoutElementDragInfo dragInfo)
		{
			if (dragInfo.Item == dragInfo.Target)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return base.AcceptDragSource(dragInfo);
		}

		public override BaseDropInfo CalcDropInfo(BaseLayoutItem item, Point point)
		{
			switch (base.Item.ItemType)
			{
			case LayoutItemType.ControlItem:
			case LayoutItemType.FixedItem:
			case LayoutItemType.LayoutSplitter:
			case LayoutItemType.EmptySpaceItem:
			case LayoutItemType.Separator:
			case LayoutItemType.Label:
				return DropTypeHelper.CalcCenterDropInfo(ElementHelper.GetRect(this), point, 0.0);
			case LayoutItemType.Group:
				return DropTypeHelper.CalcCenterDropInfo(ElementHelper.GetRect(this), point, 0.4);
			default:
				return base.CalcDropInfo(item, point);
			}
		}
	}

	public class CustomizationViewElementFactory : LayoutElementFactory
	{
		protected override void InitializeFactory()
		{
			base.Initializers[typeof(CustomizationControl)] = (UIElement element, UIElement view) => new CustomizationControlElement(element, view);
			base.Initializers[typeof(HiddenItem)] = (UIElement element, UIElement view) => new HiddenItemElement(element, view);
			base.Initializers[typeof(TreeItem)] = (UIElement element, UIElement view) => new TreeItemElement(element, view);
			base.Initializers[typeof(HiddenItemsPanel)] = (UIElement element, UIElement view) => new HiddenItemsListElement(element, view);
		}
	}
	public class CustomizationView : LayoutView
	{
		public CustomizationView(IUIElement viewUIElement)
			: base(viewUIElement)
		{
		}

		protected override ILayoutElementFactory ResolveDefaultFactory()
		{
			return new CustomizationViewElementFactory();
		}

		protected override void RegisterListeners()
		{
			RegisterUIServiceListener(new LayoutViewSelectionListener());
			RegisterUIServiceListener(new CustomizationViewUIInteractionListener());
			RegisterUIServiceListener(new CustomizationViewClientDraggingListener());
		}
	}
	public class CustomizationViewUIInteractionListener : UIInteractionServiceListener
	{
		public CustomizationView View => base.ServiceProvider as CustomizationView;

		public override void OnActivate()
		{
			View.Container.CustomizationController.CloseMenu();
		}

		public override bool OnActiveItemChanging(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)element).Item;
			if (item != null && item.AllowActivate)
			{
				return !item.IsHidden;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool OnActiveItemChanged(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)element).Item;
			View.Container.Activate(item);
			LayoutGroup root = item.GetRoot();
			if (root != null)
			{
				View.Container.CustomizationController.CustomizationRoot = root;
			}
			return item?.IsActive ?? false;
		}

		public override bool OnMenuAction(LayoutElementHitInfo clickInfo)
		{
			View.Container.RenameHelper.CancelRenamingAndResetClickedState();
			IDockLayoutElement dockLayoutElement = clickInfo.Element as IDockLayoutElement;
			if (dockLayoutElement is HiddenItemElement)
			{
				if (dockLayoutElement.Item is FixedItem)
				{
					return false;
				}
				View.Container.CustomizationController.MenuSource = dockLayoutElement.Element;
				View.Container.CustomizationController.ShowHiddenItemMenu(dockLayoutElement.Item);
				return true;
			}
			if (dockLayoutElement is TreeItemElement)
			{
				return MenuHelper.ShowMenu(View.Container, dockLayoutElement.Item, dockLayoutElement.Element);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool OnClickPreviewAction(LayoutElementHitInfo clickInfo)
		{
			View.Container.RenameHelper.CancelRenamingAndResetClickedState();
			return base.OnClickPreviewAction(clickInfo);
		}
	}
	public class CustomizationViewClientDraggingListener : LayoutViewClientDraggingListener
	{
		public override void OnDragging(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			DockLayoutElementDragInfo dockLayoutElementDragInfo = new DockLayoutElementDragInfo(base.View, point, element);
			ILayoutElement element2 = (ILayoutElement)dockLayoutElementDragInfo.DropTarget;
			Point dragCursorPosition = base.View.ClientToScreen(point);
			if (!IsLayoutRoot(dockLayoutElementDragInfo.Target) && dockLayoutElementDragInfo.DropTarget is TreeItemElement && dockLayoutElementDragInfo.MoveType != MoveType.None)
			{
				Rect screenRect = ElementHelper.GetScreenRect(base.View, element2);
				dragCursorPosition = new CursorLocationHelper(160, 40).CorrectPosition(screenRect, dockLayoutElementDragInfo.MoveType);
				if (base.View.Container.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
				{
					dragCursorPosition.X += 160.0;
				}
			}
			base.View.Container.CustomizationController.SetDragCursorPosition(dragCursorPosition);
		}

		private bool IsLayoutRoot(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item is LayoutGroup)
			{
				return ((LayoutGroup)item).IsLayoutRoot;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool CanDrag(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)element).Item;
			if (item == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool CanDrop(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			DockLayoutElementDragInfo dockLayoutElementDragInfo = new DockLayoutElementDragInfo(base.View, point, element);
			if ((dockLayoutElementDragInfo.DropTarget is HiddenItemElement || dockLayoutElementDragInfo.DropTarget is HiddenItemsListElement) && dockLayoutElementDragInfo.Item.AllowHide)
			{
				LayoutItemType itemType = dockLayoutElementDragInfo.Item.ItemType;
				if (!LayoutItemsHelper.IsLayoutItem(dockLayoutElementDragInfo.Item))
				{
					return itemType == LayoutItemType.Group;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanDrop(point, element);
		}

		public override void OnDrop(Point point, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			ResetVisualization();
			DockLayoutElementDragInfo dockLayoutElementDragInfo = new DockLayoutElementDragInfo(base.View, point, element);
			if ((dockLayoutElementDragInfo.DropTarget is HiddenItemElement || dockLayoutElementDragInfo.DropTarget is HiddenItemsListElement) && dockLayoutElementDragInfo.Item.AllowHide)
			{
				base.View.Container.LayoutController.Hide(dockLayoutElementDragInfo.Item);
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnDrop(point, element);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class CursorLocationHelper
	{
		private int width;

		private int height;

		public CursorLocationHelper(int w, int h)
		{
			width = w;
			height = h;
		}

		public Point CorrectPosition(Rect targetRect, MoveType type)
		{
			double x = targetRect.X;
			double y = targetRect.Y;
			switch (type)
			{
			case MoveType.Left:
				x = targetRect.Left - (double)width;
				y = targetRect.Top - ((double)height - targetRect.Height) / 2.0;
				break;
			case MoveType.Right:
				x = targetRect.Right;
				y = targetRect.Top - ((double)height - targetRect.Height) / 2.0;
				break;
			case MoveType.Top:
				x = targetRect.Left - ((double)width - targetRect.Width) / 2.0;
				y = targetRect.Top - (double)height;
				break;
			case MoveType.Bottom:
				x = targetRect.Left - ((double)width - targetRect.Width) / 2.0;
				y = targetRect.Bottom;
				break;
			}
			return new Point(x, y);
		}
	}

	public class DockLayoutElementBehavior : ILayoutElementBehavior
	{
		public IDockLayoutElement Element { get; private set; }

		public virtual bool AllowDragging => Element.Item.AllowDrag;

		public virtual bool AllowResizing => Element.Item.AllowSizing;

		protected DockLayoutManager Manager => DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager(Element.View);

		public DockLayoutElementBehavior(IDockLayoutElement element)
		{
			AssertElement(element);
			Element = element;
		}

		protected virtual void AssertElement(IDockLayoutElement element)
		{
		}

		public virtual bool CanDrag(OperationType operation)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public virtual bool CanSelect()
		{
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class DockPaneElementBehavior : DockLayoutElementBehavior
	{
		public DockPaneElementBehavior(DockPaneElement element)
			: base(element)
		{
		}

		public override bool CanDrag(OperationType operation)
		{
			if (base.Manager == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			BaseLayoutItem item = base.Element.Item;
			switch (operation)
			{
			case OperationType.FloatingMoving:
				if (item.IsFloatingRootItem)
				{
					return base.Manager.ShowContentWhenDragging;
				}
				return false;
			case OperationType.Floating:
				if (item.AllowFloat && !item.IsFloatingRootItem)
				{
					return base.Manager.ShowContentWhenDragging;
				}
				return false;
			case OperationType.ClientDragging:
				if (item.AllowFloat)
				{
					return !base.Manager.ShowContentWhenDragging;
				}
				return item.AllowMove;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override bool CanSelect()
		{
			return base.Element.Item.AllowSelection;
		}
	}

	public class FloatDocumentElementBehavior : DockLayoutElementBehavior
	{
		public FloatDocumentElementBehavior(FloatDocumentElement element)
			: base(element)
		{
		}

		public override bool CanDrag(OperationType operation)
		{
			if (base.Manager == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (operation)
			{
			case OperationType.FloatingMoving:
				if (AllowDragging)
				{
					return base.Manager.ShowContentWhenDragging;
				}
				return false;
			case OperationType.FloatingResizing:
			{
				FloatGroup floatGroup = base.Element.Item.Parent as FloatGroup;
				if (AllowResizing)
				{
					if (floatGroup != null)
					{
						return !floatGroup.IsMaximized;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return false;
			}
			case OperationType.ClientDragging:
				if (AllowDragging)
				{
					return !base.Manager.ShowContentWhenDragging;
				}
				return false;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override bool CanSelect()
		{
			return base.Element.Item.AllowSelection;
		}
	}
	public class FloatPanePresenterElementBehavior : DockLayoutElementBehavior
	{
		public FloatPanePresenterElementBehavior(FloatPanePresenterElement element)
			: base(element)
		{
		}

		public override bool CanDrag(OperationType operation)
		{
			if (base.Manager == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (operation)
			{
			case OperationType.FloatingMoving:
				if (AllowDragging && !((FloatGroup)base.Element.Item).IsMinimized)
				{
					return base.Manager.ShowContentWhenDragging;
				}
				return false;
			case OperationType.FloatingResizing:
				if (AllowResizing)
				{
					return !((FloatGroup)base.Element.Item).IsMaximized;
				}
				return false;
			case OperationType.ClientDragging:
				if (AllowDragging && !((FloatGroup)base.Element.Item).IsMinimized)
				{
					return !base.Manager.ShowContentWhenDragging;
				}
				return false;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}
	}

				}
				return false;
			case OperationType.ClientDragging:
				if (item.AllowFloat)
				{
					return !base.Manager.ShowContentWhenDragging;
				}
				return item.AllowMove;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

	public class MDIDocumentElementBehavior : DockLayoutElementBehavior
	{
		protected DocumentPanel Document => base.Element.Item as DocumentPanel;

		public override bool AllowDragging
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.AllowDragging)
				{
					return AllowResizing;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public MDIDocumentElementBehavior(MDIDocumentElement element)
			: base(element)
		{
		}

		public override bool CanDrag(OperationType operation)
		{
			if (Document == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (operation)
			{
			case OperationType.Reordering:
				return true;
			case OperationType.Resizing:
				if (!Document.IsMaximized && !Document.IsMinimized)
				{
					return AllowResizing;
				}
				return false;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}
	}

	public class SplitterElement : DockLayoutElement
	{
		public override bool AllowActivate => false;

		public override bool AllowSelect => false;

		public SplitterElement(UIElement uiElement, UIElement view)
			: base(LayoutItemType.Splitter, uiElement, view)
		{
		}

		protected override BaseLayoutItem GetItem(UIElement uiElement)
		{
			return ((Splitter)uiElement).LayoutGroup;
		}

		protected override LayoutElementHitInfo CreateHitInfo(Point pt)
		{

	public class GroupPaneElement : DockLayoutContainer
	{
		private class GroupPaneElementDropInfo : BaseDropInfo
		{
			private bool isHorzontal;

			private bool isVertical;

			private DropType type;

			public override DropType Type => type;

			public override bool Horizontal => isHorzontal;

			public override bool Vertical => isVertical;

			public override Rect DropRect => Rect.Empty;

			public GroupPaneElementDropInfo(GroupPaneElement group, Point pt)
				: base(group.Bounds, pt)
			{
				type = DropType.None;
				Rect bounds = GetBounds(group.Items[0]);
				for (int i = 1; i < group.Items.Count; i++)
				{
					bounds.Union(GetBounds(group.Items[i]));
				}
				LayoutGroup layoutGroup = (LayoutGroup)group.Item;
				if (layoutGroup.GroupBorderStyle == GroupBorderStyle.NoBorder && !layoutGroup.IsLayoutRoot)
				{
					RectHelper.Inflate(ref bounds, (double)MovingHelper.NoBorderMarginHorizontal, (double)MovingHelper.NoBorderMarginVertical);
				}
				if (pt.X > bounds.Right)
				{
					type = DropType.Right;
					isHorzontal = true;
				}
				else if (pt.X < bounds.Left)
				{
					type = DropType.Left;
					isHorzontal = true;
				}
				else if (pt.Y > bounds.Bottom)
				{
					type = DropType.Bottom;
					isVertical = true;
				}
				else if (pt.Y < bounds.Top)
				{
					type = DropType.Top;
					isVertical = true;
				}
			}

			private static Rect GetBounds(ILayoutElement e)
			{
				return new Rect(e.Location, e.Size);
			}
		}

		public GroupPaneElement(UIElement uiElement, UIElement view)
			: base(LayoutItemType.Group, uiElement, view)
		{
		}

		public override ILayoutElementBehavior GetBehavior()
		{
			return new GroupPaneElementBehavior(this);
		}

		protected override void CheckAndSetHitTests(LayoutElementHitInfo hitInfo, HitTestType hitType)
		{
			hitInfo.CheckAndSetHitTest(HitTestType.ExpandButton, hitType, LayoutElementHitTest.ControlBox);
			base.CheckAndSetHitTests(hitInfo, hitType);
		}

		public override bool AcceptDockSource(DockLayoutElementDragInfo dragInfo, DockHintHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			if (base.AcceptDockSource(dragInfo, hitInfo))
			{
				return ((LayoutGroup)base.Item).AcceptDock;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool AcceptFill(DockLayoutElementDragInfo dragInfo)
		{
			LayoutItemType itemType = dragInfo.Item.ItemType;
			if (base.Item.IsControlItemsHost)
			{
				if (itemType != LayoutItemType.Panel && itemType != LayoutItemType.Document && itemType != LayoutItemType.TabPanelGroup)
				{
					return itemType != LayoutItemType.FloatGroup;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool AcceptDropTarget(DockLayoutElementDragInfo dragInfo)
		{
			if (dragInfo.Target == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			LayoutItemType itemType = dragInfo.Target.ItemType;
			if (!LayoutItemsHelper.IsLayoutItem(dragInfo.Target))
			{
				return itemType == LayoutItemType.Group;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override BaseDropInfo CalcDropInfo(BaseLayoutItem item, Point point)
		{
			if (item.ItemType == LayoutItemType.Panel || (!item.IsControlItemsHost && !LayoutItemsHelper.IsLayoutItem(item)))
			{
				return base.CalcDropInfo(item, point);
			}
			if (base.Items.Count == 0 || !((LayoutGroup)base.Item).HasVisibleItems || !((LayoutGroup)base.Item).HasNotCollapsedItems)
			{
				return DropTypeHelper.CalcCenterDropInfo(base.Bounds, point, 0.6);
			}
			return new GroupPaneElementDropInfo(this, point);
		}

		protected override LayoutElementHitInfo CreateHitInfo(Point pt)
		{
			return new GroupPaneElementHitInfo(pt, this);
		}
	}

			hitInfo.CheckAndSetHitTest(HitTestType.ScrollNextButton, hitType, LayoutElementHitTest.ControlBox);

			return new TabbedPaneElementHitInfo(pt, this);

				{
					autoHidePane = base.Element as AutoHidePane;
				}
				return autoHidePane;
			}
		}

		public Dock DockType
		{
			get
			{
				if (AutoHidePane == null)
				{
					return Dock.Left;
				}
				return AutoHidePane.DockType;
			}
		}

		public override bool HitTestingEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (AutoHidePane != null)
				{
					return AutoHidePane.AutoHideTray.IsExpanded;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

			: base(LayoutItemType.AutoHideContainer, uiElement, view)

		{
			return view;
		}

		public override ILayoutElementBehavior GetBehavior()
		{
			return new AutoHidePaneElementBehavior(this);
		}

		protected override bool CheckVisualHitTestCore(Point pt)
		{
			return HitTestHelper.CheckVisualHitTest(this, pt, IsVisualChild);
		}

		private bool IsVisualChild(DependencyObject root, DependencyObject child)
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = child;
			while (dependencyObject != null)
			{
				if (dependencyObject == root)
				{
					return true;
				}
				dependencyObject = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject);
				if (dependencyObject is AutoHideWindowHost.AutoHideWindowRoot)
				{
					dependencyObject = ((AutoHideWindowHost.AutoHideWindowRoot)dependencyObject).Pane;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		protected AutoHideTrayHeadersGroup AutoHideTrayHeadersGroup

			get

					autoHideTrayHeadersGroup = LayoutItemsHelper.GetVisualChild<AutoHideTrayHeadersGroup>(base.Element);
				}
				return autoHideTrayHeadersGroup;
			}
		}

		protected AutoHideTrayHeadersPanel HeadersPanel
		{
			get
			{
				if (headersPanelCore == null)
				{
					headersPanelCore = AutoHideTrayHeadersGroup.PartHeadersPanel;
				}
				return headersPanelCore;
			}
		}

		public override bool IsTabContainer => isTabContainerCore;

		public override bool IsHorizontalHeaders => HeadersPanel.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal;

		public override bool HasHeadersPanel
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsTabContainer)
				{
					return HeadersPanel != null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override Dock TabHeaderLocation => GetDock();

		public AutoHideTrayHeadersGroupElement(UIElement uiElement, UIElement view)
			: base(LayoutItemType.AutoHideGroup, uiElement, view)
		{
			isTabContainerCore = AutoHideTrayHeadersGroup != null && AutoHideTrayHeadersGroup.PartHeadersPanel != null;
		}

		protected override UIElement CheckView(UIElement view)
		{
			return view;
		}

		protected override LayoutElementHitInfo CreateHitInfo(Point pt)
		{
			return new AutoHideTrayHeadersGroupElementHitInfo(pt, this);
		}

		public override Rect GetHeadersPanelBounds()
		{
			bool isHorizontalHeaders = IsHorizontalHeaders;
			Dock dock = GetDock();
			bool flag = dock == Dock.Right || dock == Dock.Bottom;
			Size size = RectHelper.Size(base.Bounds);
			double width = (IsHorizontalHeaders ? size.Width : (size.Width - (double)thickness));
			double height = (IsHorizontalHeaders ? (size.Height - (double)thickness) : size.Height);
			return new Rect(isHorizontalHeaders ? base.Bounds.Left : (flag ? (base.Bounds.Left + (double)thickness) : base.Bounds.Left), (!isHorizontalHeaders) ? base.Bounds.Top : (flag ? (base.Bounds.Top + (double)thickness) : base.Bounds.Top), width, height);
		}

		public override Rect GetSelectedPageBounds()
		{
			bool isHorizontalHeaders = IsHorizontalHeaders;
			Dock dock = GetDock();
			bool flag = dock == Dock.Right || dock == Dock.Bottom;
			Size renderSize = base.View.RenderSize;
			double num = (isHorizontalHeaders ? renderSize.Width : ((double)thickness));
			double num2 = (isHorizontalHeaders ? ((double)thickness) : renderSize.Height);
			return new Rect(isHorizontalHeaders ? 0.0 : (flag ? 0.0 : (renderSize.Width - num)), (!isHorizontalHeaders) ? 0.0 : (flag ? 0.0 : (renderSize.Height - num2)), num, num2);
		}

		private Dock GetDock()
		{
			Dock dockType = AutoHideTrayHeadersGroup.Tray.DockType;
			return dockType switch
			{
				Dock.Left => Dock.Right, 
				Dock.Top => Dock.Bottom, 
				Dock.Right => Dock.Left, 
				Dock.Bottom => Dock.Top, 
				_ => dockType, 
			};
		}
	}

	public class FloatPanePresenterElement : DockLayoutContainer
	{
		private IDockLayoutElement nestedElementCore;

		public FloatPanePresenterElement(UIElement uiElement, UIElement view)
			: base(LayoutItemType.FloatGroup, uiElement, view)
		{
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (base.IsDragging)
			{
				nestedElementCore = GetNestedElementCore();
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		public override IDockLayoutElement CheckDragElement()
		{
			if (((FloatGroup)base.Item).HasSingleItem)
			{
				return GetNestedElement();
			}
			return this;
		}

		protected override void OnResetIsDragging()
		{
			if (base.IsDisposing)
			{
				nestedElementCore = null;
			}
			base.OnResetIsDragging();
		}

		protected override void EnsureBoundsCore()
		{
			base.Location = CoordinateHelper.ZeroPoint;
			base.Size = ((BaseFloatingContainer)(FloatPanePresenter)(object)base.Element).FloatSize;
		}

		protected override void CheckAndSetHitTests(LayoutElementHitInfo hitInfo, HitTestType hitType)
		{
			base.CheckAndSetHitTests(hitInfo, hitType);
			hitInfo.CheckAndSetHitTest(HitTestType.MaximizeButton, hitType, LayoutElementHitTest.ControlBox);
			hitInfo.CheckAndSetHitTest(HitTestType.MinimizeButton, hitType, LayoutElementHitTest.ControlBox);
			hitInfo.CheckAndSetHitTest(HitTestType.RestoreButton, hitType, LayoutElementHitTest.ControlBox);
		}

		private UIElement GetFloatElement()
		{
			return ((FloatPanePresenter)(object)base.Element).Element;
		}

		protected override void ResetStateCore()
		{
			UIElement floatElement = GetFloatElement();
			if (floatElement != null)
			{
				floatElement.ClearValue(ControlBox.PressedButtonProperty);
				floatElement.ClearValue(ControlBox.HotButtonProperty);
			}
		}

		protected override object InitPressedState()
		{
			return ControlBox.GetPressedButton(GetFloatElement());
		}

		protected override object InitHotState()
		{
			return ControlBox.GetHotButton(GetFloatElement());
		}

		protected override HitTestResult GetHitResult(LayoutElementHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			return HitTestHelper.GetHitResult(GetFloatElement(), DockLayoutElementHelper.GetElementPoint(hitInfo));
		}

		public override ILayoutElementBehavior GetBehavior()
		{
			return new FloatPanePresenterElementBehavior(this);
		}

		public override bool AcceptDockSource(DockLayoutElementDragInfo dragInfo, DockHintHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			return GetNestedElement()?.AcceptDockSource(dragInfo, hitInfo) ?? false;
		}

		public override bool AcceptDockTarget(DockLayoutElementDragInfo dragInfo, DockHintHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			IDockLayoutElement nestedElement = GetNestedElement();
			if (nestedElement != null)
			{
				return nestedElement.AcceptDockTarget(dragInfo, hitInfo);
			}
			if (!LayoutItemsHelper.IsDockItem(dragInfo.Target))
			{
				return LayoutItemsHelper.IsEmptyLayoutGroup(dragInfo.Target);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool AcceptFill(DockLayoutElementDragInfo dragInfo)
		{
			return GetNestedElement()?.AcceptFill(dragInfo) ?? false;
		}

		public override bool AcceptDropTarget(DockLayoutElementDragInfo dragInfo)
		{
			return GetNestedElement()?.AcceptDropTarget(dragInfo) ?? false;
		}

		public override bool AcceptDragSource(DockLayoutElementDragInfo dragInfo)
		{
			return GetNestedElement()?.AcceptDragSource(dragInfo) ?? false;
		}

		protected IDockLayoutElement GetNestedElement()
		{
			if (base.IsDisposing)
			{
				return nestedElementCore;
			}
			return GetNestedElementCore();
		}

		private IDockLayoutElement GetNestedElementCore()
		{
			if (base.Nodes.Length != 1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (IDockLayoutElement)base.Nodes[0];
		}
	}

		}

	public class LayoutElementFactory : UILayoutElementFactory
	{
		protected delegate ILayoutElement CreateInstance(UIElement uiElement, UIElement view);

		private IDictionary<Type, CreateInstance> initializers;

		private IDictionary<Type, CreateInstance> customInitializers;

		protected IDictionary<Type, CreateInstance> Initializers => initializers;

		protected IDictionary<Type, CreateInstance> CustomInitializers => customInitializers;

		public LayoutElementFactory()
		{
			initializers = new Dictionary<Type, CreateInstance>();
			customInitializers = new Dictionary<Type, CreateInstance>();
			InitializeFactory();
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeFactory()
		{
			Initializers[typeof(LayoutPanel)] = (UIElement element, UIElement view) => new DockPaneElement(element, view);
			Initializers[typeof(DocumentPanel)] = (UIElement element, UIElement view) => new DocumentElement(element, view);
			Initializers[typeof(LayoutGroup)] = (UIElement element, UIElement view) => new GroupPaneElement(element, view);
			Initializers[typeof(TabbedGroup)] = (UIElement element, UIElement view) => new TabbedPaneElement(element, view);
			Initializers[typeof(TabbedPaneItem)] = (UIElement element, UIElement view) => new TabbedPaneItemElement(element, view);
			Initializers[typeof(DocumentGroup)] = (UIElement element, UIElement view) => new DocumentPaneElement(element, view);
			Initializers[typeof(DocumentPaneItem)] = (UIElement element, UIElement view) => new DocumentPaneItemElement(element, view);
			Initializers[typeof(Splitter)] = (UIElement element, UIElement view) => new SplitterElement(element, view);
			Initializers[typeof(TabbedLayoutGroupItem)] = (UIElement element, UIElement view) => new TabbedLayoutGroupHeaderElement(element, view);
			Initializers[typeof(LayoutControlItem)] = (UIElement element, UIElement view) => new ControlItemElement(element, view);
			Initializers[typeof(LayoutSplitter)] = (UIElement element, UIElement view) => new LayoutSplitterElement(element, view);
			Initializers[typeof(EmptySpaceItem)] = (UIElement element, UIElement view) => new FixedItemElement(element, view);
			Initializers[typeof(LabelItem)] = (UIElement element, UIElement view) => new FixedItemElement(element, view);
			Initializers[typeof(SeparatorItem)] = (UIElement element, UIElement view) => new FixedItemElement(element, view);
			CustomInitializers[typeof(LayoutGroup)] = (UIElement element, UIElement view) => new TabbedLayoutGroupElement(element, view);
			CustomInitializers[typeof(DocumentPanel)] = (UIElement element, UIElement view) => new MDIDocumentElement(element, view);
		}

		protected sealed override IEnumerator<IUIElement> GetUIEnumerator(IUIElement rootKey)
		{
			return new IUIElementEnumerator(rootKey);
		}

		protected sealed override ILayoutElement CreateElement(IUIElement uiKey)
		{
			UIElement uiElement = uiKey as UIElement;
			UIElement view = uiKey.GetRootUIScope() as UIElement;
			return Resolve(uiElement, view);
		}

		private Type GetInitializerType(IDictionary<Type, CreateInstance> initializers, Type elementType)
		{
			Type type = elementType;
			while (type != null && !initializers.ContainsKey(type))
			{
				type = type.BaseType;
			}
			return type;
		}

		protected virtual bool TryGetCustomInitializer(UIElement uiElement, out CreateInstance createInstance)
		{
			Type type = uiElement.GetType();
			return CustomInitializers.TryGetValue(GetInitializerType(customInitializers, type), out createInstance);
		}

		private ILayoutElement Resolve(UIElement uiElement, UIElement view)
		{
			CreateInstance createInstance = null;
			Type type = uiElement.GetType();
			if (CanUseCustomInitializer(uiElement) && TryGetCustomInitializer(uiElement, out createInstance))
			{
				return createInstance(uiElement, view);
			}
			if (initializers.TryGetValue(GetInitializerType(initializers, type), out createInstance))
			{
				return createInstance(uiElement, view);
			}
			throw new AssertionException($"Could not resolve element for {type}.");
		}

		protected virtual bool CanUseCustomInitializer(UIElement uiElement)
		{
			if (uiElement is LayoutGroup layoutGroup)
			{
				if (layoutGroup.ItemType == LayoutItemType.Group)
				{
					return layoutGroup.IsTabHost;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (uiElement is DocumentPanel documentPanel)
			{
				return documentPanel.IsMDIChild;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class FloatLayoutElementFactory : LayoutElementFactory
	{
		protected override void InitializeFactory()
		{
			base.InitializeFactory();
			base.Initializers[typeof(FloatingAdornerPresenter)] = (UIElement element, UIElement view) => new FloatPanePresenterElement(element, view);
			base.Initializers[typeof(FloatingWindowPresenter)] = (UIElement element, UIElement view) => new FloatPanePresenterElement(element, view);
			base.Initializers[typeof(FloatGroup)] = (UIElement element, UIElement view) => new EmptyLayoutContainer();
		}

		protected override bool CanUseCustomInitializer(UIElement uiElement)
		{
			if (!(uiElement is DocumentPanel { IsFloatingRootItem: not false }))
			{
				return base.CanUseCustomInitializer(uiElement);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool TryGetCustomInitializer(UIElement uiElement, out CreateInstance createInstance)
		{
			if (uiElement is DocumentPanel { IsFloatingRootItem: not false })
			{
				createInstance = (UIElement element, UIElement view) => new FloatDocumentElement(element, view);
			}
			else
			{
				base.TryGetCustomInitializer(uiElement, out createInstance);
			}
			return createInstance != null;
		}
	}

	public class DockLayoutManagerViewAdapter : ViewAdapter
	{
		public class BehindViewHitTest
		{
			private List<object> views = new List<object>();

			public IEnumerable<object> Views => views;

			private HitTestResultBehavior HitTestResult(HitTestResult result)
			{
				return HitTestResultBehavior.Continue;
			}

			private HitTestFilterBehavior HitTestFilter(DependencyObject potentialHitTestTarget)
			{
				BaseLayoutItem layoutItem = DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(potentialHitTestTarget);
				if (layoutItem != null && !(layoutItem is FloatGroup))
				{
					IView view = layoutItem.Manager.GetView(layoutItem.GetRoot());
					if (view != null && !views.Contains(view))
					{
						views.Add(view);
					}
				}
				return HitTestFilterBehavior.Continue;
			}

			public void HitTest(FrameworkElement reference, Point hitPoint)
			{
				VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(reference, HitTestFilter, HitTestResult, new PointHitTestParameters(hitPoint));
			}
		}

		private DockLayoutManager Container => base.NotificationSource as DockLayoutManager;

		public DockLayoutManagerViewAdapter(DockLayoutManager container)
		{
			base.NotificationSource = container;
		}

		protected override IView GetBehindViewOverride(IView source, Point screenPoint)
		{
			//IL_018d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0194: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			bool flag = base.DragService.OperationType == OperationType.ClientDragging;
			LayoutView layoutView = null;
			LayoutView layoutView2 = source as LayoutView;
			bool flag2 = IsHitInDragElement(source, screenPoint);
			if (Container.Linked.Count > 0 && layoutView2 != null)
			{
				FloatingPaneWindow singleElement = (layoutView2 as FloatingView).With((FloatingView x) => x.RootElement as FloatingWindowPresenter).Return((FloatingWindowPresenter x) => x.Window, () => (FloatingPaneWindow)null);
				Point point = layoutView2.ScreenToClient(screenPoint);
				Point point2 = layoutView2.RootUIElement.PointToScreen(point);
				IEnumerable<Window> enumerable = NativeHelper.SortWindowsTopToBottom(Container.GetAllAffectedWindows());
				if (!flag || flag2)
				{
					enumerable = enumerable.Except((IEnumerable<Window>)singleElement.Yield());
				}
				Window window = enumerable.FirstOrDefault((Window x) => x.IsVisible && !(x is AdornerWindow) && new Rect(x.RenderSize).Contains(x.PointFromScreen(point2)) && !x.GetType().FullName.Contains("WpfVisualTreeService.Adorners.AdornerLayerWindow") && !x.GetType().FullName.Contains("WpfVisualTreeService.Adorners.AdornerWindow") && !(x is DragCursorWindow));
				if (window != null)
				{
					IEnumerable<IView> enumerable2 = FindViews(window, point2);
					if (!flag || flag2)
					{
						enumerable2 = enumerable2.Except(layoutView2.Yield());
					}
					foreach (IView item in enumerable2)
					{
						if (!(item is LayoutView { Container: var container } layoutView3) || (Container != container && (!Container.Linked.Contains(container) || Container.GetRealFloatingMode() != container.GetRealFloatingMode())) || !container.IsVisible)
						{
							continue;
						}
						if (layoutView != null)
						{
							if (layoutView3.RootUIElement.IsDescendantOf(layoutView.RootUIElement))
							{
								layoutView = layoutView3;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							layoutView = layoutView3;
						}
					}
					if (layoutView != null)
					{
						DockLayoutManager container2 = layoutView.Container;
						IDockLayoutElement dockLayoutElement = base.DragService.DragItem as IDockLayoutElement;
						UIElement sourceElement = ((flag && dockLayoutElement != null && dockLayoutElement.Element != null) ? dockLayoutElement.Element : layoutView2.RootUIElement);
						List<DependencyObject> logicalParents = GetLogicalParents(container2);
						if (logicalParents.OfType<Visual>().Any((Visual x) => x.IsDescendantOf(sourceElement)))
						{
							return null;
						}
						if (container2 != Container)
						{
							container2.LinkedDragService = Container.ViewAdapter.DragService;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			IView view = layoutView;
			IView behindView = view ?? base.GetBehindViewOverride(source, screenPoint);
			return CheckBehindView(source, behindView, screenPoint, flag2);
		}

		protected virtual IEnumerable<IView> FindViews(Window targetWindow, Point screenPoint)
		{
			BehindViewHitTest behindViewHitTest = new BehindViewHitTest();
			behindViewHitTest.HitTest(targetWindow, targetWindow.PointFromScreen(screenPoint));
			return behindViewHitTest.Views.OfType<IView>();
		}

		private IView CheckBehindView(IView sourceView, IView behindView, Point screenPoint, bool skipBehindView)
		{
			if (base.DragService.OperationType == OperationType.ClientDragging && (behindView == null || base.Views.Contains(behindView)))
			{
				IView view = sourceView.Adapter.GetView(screenPoint);
				if (!skipBehindView)
				{
					return view;
				}
				return base.GetBehindViewOverride(view, screenPoint);
			}
			return behindView;
		}

		private bool IsHitInDragElement(IView view, Point screenPoint)
		{
			IView view2 = view.Adapter.GetView(screenPoint);
			IView dragSource = view.Adapter.DragService.DragSource;
			if (view2 == dragSource)
			{
				Point pt = dragSource.ScreenToClient(screenPoint);
				ILayoutElement element = view2.Adapter.CalcHitInfo(view2, pt).Element;
				IDockLayoutElement dockLayoutElement = (IDockLayoutElement)view.Adapter.DragService.DragItem;
				IDockLayoutElement dockLayoutElement2 = (IDockLayoutElement)ElementHelper.GetRoot(element);
				IDockLayoutElement dockLayoutElement3 = (IDockLayoutElement)ElementHelper.GetRoot(dockLayoutElement);
				if ((element == dockLayoutElement || dockLayoutElement2 == dockLayoutElement3) && dockLayoutElement.CheckDragElement() == dockLayoutElement2.CheckDragElement())
				{
					return true;
				}
				return dockLayoutElement == dockLayoutElement2;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override Point GetBehindViewPointOverride(IView source, IView behindView, Point screenPoint)
		{
			if (behindView.Adapter != this)
			{
				Point point = ((LayoutView)source).ScreenToClient(screenPoint);
				Point point2 = ((LayoutView)source).RootUIElement.PointToScreen(point);
				foreach (DockLayoutManager item in Container.Linked)
				{
					if (item != null && item.ViewAdapter == behindView.Adapter)
					{
						return ((LayoutView)behindView).RootUIElement.PointFromScreen(point2);
					}
				}
			}
			return base.GetBehindViewPointOverride(source, behindView, screenPoint);
		}

		private List<DependencyObject> GetLogicalParents(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			List<DependencyObject> list = new List<DependencyObject>();
			while (obj != null)
			{
				list.Add(obj);
				obj = LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(obj);
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	public class DockHintHitInfo
	{
		protected DockHintElement Element { get; private set; }

		protected internal DockHintButton HitButton { get; private set; }

		public DockingHintAdornerBase Adorner { get; private set; }

		public DockVisualizerElement Type { get; private set; }

		public DockType DockType { get; private set; }

		public Dock Dock { get; private set; }

		public bool InHint
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(Element is SideDockHintElement))
				{
					return Element is CenterDockHintElement;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public bool InButton => HitButton != null;

		public bool IsHideButton { get; private set; }

		public bool IsCenter { get; private set; }

		public bool IsTabButton { get; private set; }

		public DockHintHitInfo(DockingHintAdornerBase adorner, HitTestResult hitResult)
		{
			Adorner = adorner;
			Type = DockVisualizerElement.None;
			if (hitResult == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Element = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<DockHintElement>(hitResult.VisualHit);
			if (Element == null || Element.Visibility != Visibility.Visible)
			{
				return;
			}
			Type = Element.Type;
			IsCenter = Type == DockVisualizerElement.Center;
			DockType = CalcDockType(hitResult.VisualHit);
			Dock = DockType.ToDock();
			HitButton = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<DockHintButton>(hitResult.VisualHit);
			if (InButton)
			{
				IsHideButton = HitButton.Name == "PART_Hide" && HitButton.IsEnabled;
				IsTabButton = HitButton.Name.Contains("PART_Tab") && HitButton.IsEnabled;
				if (!HitButton.IsAvailable)
				{
					DockType = DockType.None;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				DockType = DockType.None;
			}
		}

		private DockType CalcDockType(DependencyObject dObj)
		{
			DockType result = DockType.None;
			while (dObj != null)
			{
				DockType dockType = DockHintElement.GetDockType(dObj);
				if (dockType != DockType.None)
				{
					return dockType;
				}
				if (dObj is DockHintElement)
				{
					break;
				}
				dObj = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dObj);
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public class DragAdorner : PlacementAdorner
	{
		public class DragAdornerSurface : AdornerSurface
		{
			public DragAdornerSurface(PlacementAdorner adorner)
				: base(adorner)
			{
			}

			public DragAdornerSurface(PlacementAdorner adorner, bool enableValidation)
				: base(adorner, enableValidation)
			{
			}

			protected override void BringToFrontCore(UIElement placementElement)
			{
				int num = 0;
				IOrderedEnumerable<UIElement> orderedEnumerable = ((AdornerSurface)this).PlacementInfos.Keys.OrderBy((UIElement x) => Panel.GetZIndex(x));
				foreach (UIElement item in orderedEnumerable)
				{
					if (item != placementElement)
					{
						Panel.SetZIndex(item, num++);
					}
				}
				Panel.SetZIndex(placementElement, num++);
			}

			protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<UIElement, PlacementItemInfo> placementInfo in ((AdornerSurface)this).PlacementInfos)
				{
					if (placementInfo.Key is ISupportAutoSize { IsAutoSize: not false } supportAutoSize)
					{
						Rect bounds = placementInfo.Value.Bounds;
						Size size = supportAutoSize.FitToContent(bounds.Size);
						((AdornerSurface)this).SetBounds(placementInfo.Key, new Rect(bounds.Location, size));
					}
				}
				return ((FrameworkElement)this).MeasureOverride(availableSize);
			}
		}

		public DragAdorner(DockLayoutManager container)
			: base((UIElement)container)
		{
		}

		protected override BaseAdornerSurface CreateAdornerSurface()
		{
			return (BaseAdornerSurface)(object)new DragAdornerSurface((PlacementAdorner)(object)this, enableValidation: false);
		}

		protected override void OnActivated()
		{
			((BaseSurfacedAdorner)this).OnActivated();
			WindowHelper.BindFlowDirectionIfNeeded((FrameworkElement)(object)this, ((Adorner)this).AdornedElement);
		}

		protected override void SetBoundsInContainerCore(UIElement placementElement, Rect bounds)
		{
			if (placementElement is ISupportAutoSize { IsAutoSize: not false } supportAutoSize)
			{
				Size size = supportAutoSize.FitToContent(bounds.Size);
				((PlacementAdorner)this).PlacementSurface.SetBounds(placementElement, new Rect(bounds.Location, size));
			}
			else
			{
				((PlacementAdorner)this).SetBoundsInContainerCore(placementElement, bounds);
			}
		}
	}
	public class SelectionController : IDisposable
	{
		private IList<SelectionHint> selectionHints;

		private bool isDisposing;

		protected DockLayoutManager Container { get; private set; }

		protected DockingHintAdornerBase Adorner { get; private set; }

		protected internal IList<SelectionHint> Hints => selectionHints;

		public SelectionController(DockingHintAdornerBase adorner)
		{
			selectionHints = new List<SelectionHint>();
			Adorner = adorner;
			Container = DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager(((Adorner)(object)Adorner).AdornedElement);
			Container.LayoutItemSizeChanged += OnItemSizeChanged;
			Container.LayoutItemSelectionChanged += OnItemSelectionChanged;
		}

		private void OnItemSelectionChanged(object sender, LayoutItemSelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Container.IsCustomization)
			{
				UpdateHints();
				((BaseSurfacedAdorner)Adorner).Update();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemSizeChanged(object sender, LayoutItemSizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Container.IsCustomization)
			{
				UpdateHints();
				((BaseSurfacedAdorner)Adorner).Update();
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (!isDisposing)
			{
				isDisposing = true;
				Container.LayoutItemSelectionChanged -= OnItemSelectionChanged;
				Container.LayoutItemSizeChanged -= OnItemSizeChanged;
				Container = null;
				Ref.Clear(ref selectionHints);
			}
		}

		public virtual void UpdateHints()
		{
			if (EnsureSelectionHints())
			{
				Selection selection = Container.LayoutController.Selection;
				for (int i = 0; i < Hints.Count; i++)
				{
					BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = ((i < selection.Count) ? selection[i] : null);
					Hints[i].Item = (Adorner.ContainsSelection(baseLayoutItem) ? baseLayoutItem : null);
				}
			}
		}

		public void Focus(BaseLayoutItem layoutItem)
		{
			Hints.FirstOrDefault((SelectionHint x) => x.Item == layoutItem).Do(delegate(SelectionHint x)
			{
				x.EnqueueFocus();
			});
		}

		protected virtual bool EnsureSelectionHints()
		{
			if (!Container.LayoutController.IsCustomization)
			{
				return false;
			}
			while (Hints.Count < Container.LayoutController.Selection.Count)
			{
				Hints.Add(CreateSelectionHint());
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual SelectionHint CreateSelectionHint()
		{
			return (SelectionHint)Adorner.CreateDockHintElement(DockVisualizerElement.Selection, default(Size), Alignment.Fill);
		}
	}
	public class RenameController : IDisposable
	{
		private RenameHint renameHint;

		private bool isDisposing;

		public bool IsRenamingStarted
		{
			get
			{
				if (RenameHint != null)
				{
					return RenameHint.IsRenamingStarted;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected DockLayoutManager Container { get; private set; }

		protected DockingHintAdornerBase Adorner { get; private set; }

		protected internal RenameHint RenameHint => renameHint;

		public RenameController(DockingHintAdornerBase adorner)
		{
			Adorner = adorner;
			Container = DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager(((Adorner)(object)Adorner).AdornedElement);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (!isDisposing)
			{
				isDisposing = true;
				Container = null;
			}
		}

		internal void StartRenaming(IDockLayoutElement layoutElement)
		{
			if (!Adorner.ContainsSelection(layoutElement.Item))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (EnsureRenameHint())
			{
				if (renameHint.IsRenamingStarted)
				{
					CancelRenaming();
				}
				renameHint.StartRenaming(layoutElement);
			}
			((BaseSurfacedAdorner)Adorner).Update();
		}

		internal void CancelRenaming()
		{
			if (EnsureRenameHint() && renameHint.IsRenamingStarted)
			{
				renameHint.CancelRenaming();
			}
			((BaseSurfacedAdorner)Adorner).Update();
		}

		internal void EndRenaming()
		{
			if (EnsureRenameHint() && renameHint.IsRenamingStarted)
			{
				renameHint.EndRenaming();
			}
			((BaseSurfacedAdorner)Adorner).Update();
		}

		protected bool EnsureRenameHint()
		{
			if (renameHint == null)
			{
				renameHint = CreateRenameHint();
			}
			return renameHint != null;
		}

		protected RenameHint CreateRenameHint()
		{
			return (RenameHint)Adorner.CreateDockHintElement(DockVisualizerElement.RenameHint, default(Size), Alignment.Fill);
		}
	}

		}

	public class DockingHintAdorner : DockingHintAdornerBase
	{
		public DockingHintAdorner(UIElement container)
			: base(container)
		{
		}
	}
	public abstract class DockingHintAdornerBase : BaseSurfacedAdorner
	{
		protected class AdornerSurface : BaseAdornerSurface
		{
			private Dictionary<DockHintElement, ElementInfo> elementsCore;

			protected DockingHintAdornerBase Adorner => base.BaseAdorner as DockingHintAdornerBase;

			public Dictionary<DockHintElement, ElementInfo> ElementInfos => elementsCore;

			public AdornerSurface(DockingHintAdornerBase adorner)
				: base((BaseSurfacedAdorner)(object)adorner)
			{
				elementsCore = new Dictionary<DockHintElement, ElementInfo>();
			}

			public void AddElement(DockHintElement element, Size size, Alignment alignment, DockVisualizerElement type)
			{
				if (!ElementInfos.ContainsKey(element))
				{
					((Panel)this).Children.Add(element);
					((FrameworkElement)this).RemoveLogicalChild((object)element);
					Adorner.Manager.DockHintsContainer.Add(element);
					element.Measure(size);
					ElementInfos.Add(element, new ElementInfo(element.DesiredSize, alignment, type));
					if (type != DockVisualizerElement.Selection && type != DockVisualizerElement.DockZone)
					{
						Panel.SetZIndex(element, 10);
					}
				}
			}

			public void RemoveElement(DockHintElement element)
			{
				if (ElementInfos.ContainsKey(element))
				{
					((Panel)this).Children.Remove(element);
					ElementInfos.Remove(element);
					Adorner.Manager.DockHintsContainer.Remove(element);
				}
			}

			public void Clear()
			{
				DockHintElement[] array = new DockHintElement[ElementInfos.Count];
				ElementInfos.Keys.CopyTo(array, 0);
				Array.ForEach(array, RemoveElement);
			}

			public void ClearHotTrack()
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<DockHintElement, ElementInfo> elementInfo in ElementInfos)
				{
					elementInfo.Key.UpdateHotTrack(null);
				}
			}

			public void UpdateHotTrack(DockHintHitInfo hitInfo)
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<DockHintElement, ElementInfo> elementInfo in ElementInfos)
				{
					elementInfo.Key.UpdateHotTrack(hitInfo.HitButton);
				}
			}

			public void UpdateState()
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<DockHintElement, ElementInfo> elementInfo in ElementInfos)
				{
					elementInfo.Key.UpdateState(Adorner);
				}
			}

			public void UpdateEnabledState()
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<DockHintElement, ElementInfo> elementInfo in ElementInfos)
				{
					elementInfo.Key.UpdateEnabledState(Adorner);
				}
			}

			public void UpdateIsAvailable()
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<DockHintElement, ElementInfo> elementInfo in ElementInfos)
				{
					elementInfo.Key.UpdateAvailableState(Adorner);
				}
			}

			protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size finalSize)
			{
				Adorner.SurfaceRect = new Rect(CoordinateHelper.ZeroPoint, finalSize);
				foreach (KeyValuePair<DockHintElement, ElementInfo> elementInfo in ElementInfos)
				{
					elementInfo.Key.Arrange(Adorner, elementInfo.Value);
				}
				return finalSize;
			}
		}

		public class ElementInfo
		{
			public Size Size { get; private set; }

			public Alignment Alignment { get; private set; }

			public DockVisualizerElement Type { get; private set; }

			public ElementInfo(Size size, Alignment alignment, DockVisualizerElement type)
			{
				Size = size;
				Alignment = alignment;
				Type = type;
			}

			public Rect CalcPlacement(Rect container, double Indent)
			{
				switch (Alignment)
				{
				case Alignment.Fill:
					if (container.IsEmpty)
					{
						return container;
					}
					container = new Rect(container.X + Indent, container.Y + Indent, container.Width, container.Height);
					return PlacementHelper.Arrange(Size, container, Alignment);
				case Alignment.TopCenter:
					return PlacementHelper.Arrange(Size, container, Alignment, new Point(0.0, Indent));
				case Alignment.MiddleLeft:
					return PlacementHelper.Arrange(Size, container, Alignment, new Point(Indent, 0.0));
				case Alignment.MiddleRight:
					return PlacementHelper.Arrange(Size, container, Alignment, new Point(0.0 - Indent, 0.0));
				case Alignment.BottomCenter:
					return PlacementHelper.Arrange(Size, container, Alignment, new Point(0.0, 0.0 - Indent));
				default:
					return PlacementHelper.Arrange(Size, container, Alignment, new Point(Indent, Indent));
				}
			}
		}

		private SelectionController selectionControllerCore;

		private RenameController renameControllerCore;

		private HitTestHelper.HitCache hitCache;

		internal DockHintsConfiguration DockHintsConfiguration;

		public bool IsDisposing => ((BaseSurfacedAdorner)this).IsDisposing;

		protected DockLayoutManager Manager { get; private set; }

		protected internal SelectionController SelectionController => selectionControllerCore;

		protected internal RenameController RenameController => renameControllerCore;

		internal HostType HostType { get; set; }

		private bool ShouldCreateSideElements => HostType == HostType.Layout;

		protected AdornerSurface VisualizerSurface => ((BaseSurfacedAdorner)this).Surface as AdornerSurface;

		internal double Indent => VisualizerAdornerHelper.GetAdornerWindowIndent((UIElement)(object)this);

		public bool ShowSelectionHints { get; set; }

		public Rect TargetRect { get; set; }

		public Rect HintRect { get; set; }

		public Rect SurfaceRect { get; set; }

		public DockingHintAdornerBase(UIElement container)
			: base(container)
		{
			selectionControllerCore = CreateSelectionController();
			renameControllerCore = CreateRenameController();
			DockHintsConfiguration = new DockHintsConfiguration();
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			VisualizerSurface.Clear();
			((BaseSurfacedAdorner)this).Deactivate();
			Ref.Dispose(ref hitCache);
			Ref.Dispose(ref selectionControllerCore);
			Ref.Dispose(ref renameControllerCore);
			((BaseSurfacedAdorner)this).OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnActivated()
		{
			Manager = DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager(((Adorner)this).AdornedElement);
			CreateVisualizerElements();
			((UIElement)this).InvalidateArrange();
		}

		protected virtual SelectionController CreateSelectionController()
		{
			return new SelectionController(this);
		}

		protected virtual RenameController CreateRenameController()
		{
			return new RenameController(this);
		}

		protected virtual void CreateVisualizerElements()
		{
			Size size = new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity);
			CreateDockHintElement(DockVisualizerElement.DockZone, default(Size), Alignment.Fill);
			if (ShouldCreateSideElements)
			{
				CreateDockHintElement(DockVisualizerElement.Left, size, Alignment.MiddleLeft);
				CreateDockHintElement(DockVisualizerElement.Right, size, Alignment.MiddleRight);
				CreateDockHintElement(DockVisualizerElement.Top, size, Alignment.TopCenter);
				CreateDockHintElement(DockVisualizerElement.Bottom, size, Alignment.BottomCenter);
			}
			CreateDockHintElement(DockVisualizerElement.Center, size, Alignment.MiddleCenter);
		}

		public DockHintElement CreateDockHintElement(DockVisualizerElement type, Size size, Alignment alignment)
		{
			DockHintElement dockHintElement = CreateDockHintElement(type);
			if (dockHintElement != null)
			{
				VisualizerSurface.AddElement(dockHintElement, size, alignment, type);
			}
			return dockHintElement;
		}

		protected virtual DockHintElement CreateDockHintElement(DockVisualizerElement type)
		{
			return DockHintElementFactory.Make(type);
		}

		protected override BaseAdornerSurface CreateAdornerSurface()
		{
			return (BaseAdornerSurface)(object)new AdornerSurface(this);
		}

		public DockHintHitInfo HitTest(Point point)
		{
			double indent = Indent;
			return new DockHintHitInfo(this, HitTestHelper.HitTest(hitPoint: new Point(point.X + indent, point.Y + indent), element: (UIElement)(object)((BaseSurfacedAdorner)this).Surface, cache: ref hitCache));
		}

		public void ResetDocking()
		{
			DockHintsConfiguration.Invalidate();
			TargetRect = Rect.Empty;
			HintRect = Rect.Empty;
		}

		public void ClearHotTrack()
		{
			VisualizerSurface.ClearHotTrack();
		}

		public void UpdateHotTrack(DockHintHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			VisualizerSurface.UpdateHotTrack(hitInfo);
		}

		public void UpdateState()
		{
			VisualizerSurface.UpdateState();
		}

		public void UpdateEnabledState()
		{
			VisualizerSurface.UpdateEnabledState();
		}

		public void UpdateIsAvailable()
		{
			VisualizerSurface.UpdateIsAvailable();
		}

		public void UpdateSelection()
		{
			SelectionController.UpdateHints();
		}

		public bool ContainsSelection(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			LayoutGroup root = item.GetRoot();
			if (((Adorner)this).AdornedElement is AdornerWindowContent)
			{
				return ((AdornerWindowContent)((Adorner)this).AdornedElement).View == Manager.GetView(root);
			}
			IUIElement element = ((Adorner)this).AdornedElement as IUIElement;
			if (((Adorner)this).AdornedElement is FloatPanePresenter.FloatingContentPresenter)
			{
				element = ((ManagedContentPresenter)(FloatPanePresenter.FloatingContentPresenter)(object)((Adorner)this).AdornedElement).Container as IUIElement;
			}
			if (root != null)
			{
				return Manager.GetView(root) == Manager.GetView(element);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void SetDockHintsConfiguration(DockLayoutElementDragInfo dragInfo)
		{
			DockHintsConfiguration.Invalidate();
			DockHintsConfiguration.SetConfiguration(Manager, dragInfo);
		}
	}
