	public class TabHeadersAdorner : PlacementAdorner
	{
		private class TabHeadersAdornerSurface : AdornerSurface
		{
			public TabHeadersAdornerSurface(PlacementAdorner adorner)
				: base(adorner, false)
			{
			}

			public void RemoveFromLogicalTree(UIElement element)
			{
				((FrameworkElement)this).RemoveLogicalChild((object)element);
			}
		}

		public TabHint Tab { get; private set; }

		public TabHeaderHint Header { get; private set; }

		public DockLayoutManager Manager { get; private set; }

		private TabHeadersAdornerSurface TabHeadersSurface => ((PlacementAdorner)this).PlacementSurface as TabHeadersAdornerSurface;

		public bool IsTabHeaderHintEnabled { get; private set; }

		private double Indent => VisualizerAdornerHelper.GetAdornerWindowIndent((UIElement)(object)this);

		public TabHeadersAdorner(UIElement container)
			: base(container)
		{
			((UIElement)this).IsHitTestVisible = false;
		}

		protected override void OnActivated()
		{
			((BaseSurfacedAdorner)this).OnActivated();
			Tab = new TabHint();
			Header = new TabHeaderHint();
			Manager = DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager(((Adorner)this).AdornedElement);
			RegisterEx(Tab);
			RegisterEx(Header);
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			((BaseSurfacedAdorner)this).Deactivate();
			((BaseSurfacedAdorner)this).OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnDeactivated()
		{
			((PlacementAdorner)this).Unregister((UIElement)Tab);
			((PlacementAdorner)this).Unregister((UIElement)Header);
			((BaseSurfacedAdorner)this).OnDeactivated();
		}

		public void RegisterEx(UIElement element)
		{
			((PlacementAdorner)this).Register(element);
			TabHeadersSurface.RemoveFromLogicalTree(element);
			Manager.DockHintsContainer.Add(element);
		}

		protected override BaseAdornerSurface CreateAdornerSurface()
		{
			return (BaseAdornerSurface)(object)new TabHeadersAdornerSurface((PlacementAdorner)(object)this)
			{
				Opacity = 0.75
			};
		}

		public void ResetElements()
		{
			if (!((BaseSurfacedAdorner)this).IsDisposing)
			{
				((PlacementAdorner)this).SetVisible((UIElement)Tab, false);
				((PlacementAdorner)this).SetVisible((UIElement)Header, false);
				IsTabHeaderHintEnabled = false;
			}
		}

		public void ShowElements(Dock headerLocation, Rect tab, Rect header)
		{
			Tab.TabHeaderLocation = headerLocation;
			Header.TabHeaderLocation = headerLocation;
			((PlacementAdorner)this).SetVisible((UIElement)Tab, !tab.IsEmpty);
			((PlacementAdorner)this).SetVisible((UIElement)Header, !header.IsEmpty);
			double indent = Indent;
			if (!tab.IsEmpty)
			{
				tab.X += indent;
				tab.Y += indent;
				((PlacementAdorner)this).SetBoundsInContainer((UIElement)Tab, tab);
			}
			if (!header.IsEmpty)
			{
				header.X += indent;
				header.Y += indent;
				((PlacementAdorner)this).SetBoundsInContainer((UIElement)Header, header);
			}
			IsTabHeaderHintEnabled = !header.IsEmpty;
		}
	}
	public class ShadowResizeAdorner : PlacementAdorner
	{
		private class ShadowResizeAdornerSurface : AdornerSurface
		{
			public ShadowResizeAdornerSurface(PlacementAdorner adorner)
				: base(adorner)
			{
			}

			public ShadowResizeAdornerSurface(PlacementAdorner adorner, bool enableValidation)
				: base(adorner, enableValidation)
			{
			}

			public void RemoveLogicalChild(object child)
			{
				((FrameworkElement)this).RemoveLogicalChild(child);
			}
		}

		private UIElement savedControl;

		private UIElement ResizeBackground;

		private double Indent => VisualizerAdornerHelper.GetAdornerWindowIndent((UIElement)(object)this);

		public ShadowResizeAdorner(UIElement container)
			: base(container)
		{
			((UIElement)this).IsHitTestVisible = false;
		}

		protected override void OnActivated()
		{
			((BaseSurfacedAdorner)this).OnActivated();
			ResizeBackground = new ShadowResizeBackground();
			RegisterElement(ResizeBackground);
		}

		protected override void OnDeactivated()
		{
			UnregisterElement(ResizeBackground);
			if (savedControl != null)
			{
				UnregisterElement(savedControl);
			}
			((BaseSurfacedAdorner)this).OnDeactivated();
		}

		protected override BaseAdornerSurface CreateAdornerSurface()
		{
			return (BaseAdornerSurface)(object)new ShadowResizeAdornerSurface((PlacementAdorner)(object)this, enableValidation: false);
		}

		private void ResetElements()
		{
			((PlacementAdorner)this).SetVisible(ResizeBackground, false);
			if (savedControl != null)
			{
				((PlacementAdorner)this).SetVisible(savedControl, false);
				UnregisterElement(savedControl);
				savedControl = null;
			}
		}

		internal void EndResizing()
		{
			ResetElements();
		}

		internal void StartResizing(UIElement control, Rect bounds)
		{
			savedControl = control;
			RegisterElement(control);
			((PlacementAdorner)this).SetVisible(control, !bounds.IsEmpty);
			UpdateBounds(control, bounds);
		}

		internal void ShowBackground(Rect bounds)
		{
			((PlacementAdorner)this).SetVisible(ResizeBackground, !bounds.IsEmpty);
			UpdateBounds(ResizeBackground, bounds);
		}

		internal void Resize(Rect bounds)
		{
			UpdateBounds(savedControl, bounds);
		}

		private void RegisterElement(UIElement element)
		{
			((PlacementAdorner)this).Register(element);
			(((BaseSurfacedAdorner)this).Surface as ShadowResizeAdornerSurface).Do(delegate(ShadowResizeAdornerSurface x)
			{
				x.RemoveLogicalChild(element);
			});
			DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager(((Adorner)this).AdornedElement).DockHintsContainer.Add(element);
		}

		private void UpdateBounds(UIElement control, Rect bounds)
		{
			if (!bounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				double indent = Indent;
				bounds.X += indent;
				bounds.Y += indent;
				((PlacementAdorner)this).SetBoundsInContainer(control, bounds);
			}
		}

		private void UnregisterElement(UIElement element)
		{
			((PlacementAdorner)this).Unregister(element);
			DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager(((Adorner)this).AdornedElement).DockHintsContainer.Remove(element);
		}
	}
	public class AdornerWindowContent : Decorator
	{
		public IView View { get; private set; }

		internal AdornerWindowContent(IView view)
		{
			View = view;
		}
	}
	public class AdornerWindow : Window, IDisposable
	{
		private bool isOpenCore;

		private bool isDisposingCore;

		private MatrixTransform transform;

		private bool IsPerMonitorDpiAware;

		private Window eventTarget;

		private List<Window> subscriptions;

		public IView View { get; private set; }

		public bool IsDisposing => isDisposingCore;

		public DockLayoutManager Manager { get; private set; }

		public UIElement RootElement { get; private set; }

		public IAdornerWindowClient Client { get; internal set; }

		public bool IsOpen
		{
			get
			{
				return isOpenCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (IsOpen != value)
				{
					isOpenCore = value;
					OnIsOpenChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public DockLayoutManager Container => DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager(this);

		public AdornerWindow(IAdornerWindowClient client, UIElement container)
		{
			IsPerMonitorDpiAware = DpiHelper.IsPerMonitorDpiAware;
			Manager = DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager(container);
			Manager.SizeChanged += OnManagerSizeChanged;
			WindowHelper.BindFlowDirection(this, Manager);
			Client = client;
			base.ShowActivated = false;
			base.AllowsTransparency = true;
			base.ShowInTaskbar = false;
			base.Background = Brushes.Transparent;
			base.Topmost = true;
			base.WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.Manual;
			base.WindowStyle = WindowStyle.None;
			base.ResizeMode = ResizeMode.NoResize;
			View = GetView(Manager, Client);
			RootElement = new AdornerWindowContent(View);
			CheckTransform();
			base.Content = RootElement;
			SubscribeEvents();
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
		}

		private void ModifyWindowStyle()
		{
			IntPtr handle = new WindowInteropHelper(this).Handle;
			int windowLongSafe = NativeHelper.GetWindowLongSafe(handle, -20);
			windowLongSafe |= 0x80;
			NativeHelper.SetWindowLongSafe(handle, -20, windowLongSafe);
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			ModifyWindowStyle();
		}

		private void OnManagerSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CheckTransform();
		}

		private void CheckTransform()
		{
			Window window = WindowServiceHelper.GetWindow(Manager);
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = window;
			if (frameworkElement == null || !Manager.IsDescendantOf(frameworkElement))
			{
				frameworkElement = LayoutHelper.GetTopLevelVisual((DependencyObject)Manager);
			}
			if (frameworkElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			transform = Manager.TransformToVisual(frameworkElement) as MatrixTransform;
			if (transform != null && !transform.Matrix.IsIdentity)
			{
				Matrix matrix = transform.Matrix;
				transform = new MatrixTransform(Math.Abs(matrix.M11), matrix.M12, matrix.M21, Math.Abs(matrix.M22), 0.0, 0.0);
				if (transform != ((AdornerWindowContent)RootElement).LayoutTransform)
				{
					((AdornerWindowContent)RootElement).LayoutTransform = transform;
				}
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeEvents()
		{
			base.PreviewKeyDown += AdornerWindow_PreviewKey;
			base.PreviewKeyUp += AdornerWindow_PreviewKey;
			base.PreviewMouseDown += AdornerWindow_PreviewMouseDown;
			base.MouseUp += AdornerWindow_MouseUp;
		}

		private void UnSubscribeEvents()
		{
			base.PreviewKeyDown -= AdornerWindow_PreviewKey;
			base.PreviewKeyUp -= AdornerWindow_PreviewKey;
			base.PreviewMouseDown -= AdornerWindow_PreviewMouseDown;
			base.MouseUp -= AdornerWindow_MouseUp;
		}

		private void AdornerWindow_MouseUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!Container.Win32DragService.IsInEvent)
			{
				View.OnMouseUp(EventArgsHelper.Convert(RootElement, e));
			}
		}

		private void AdornerWindow_PreviewMouseDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			View.OnMouseDown(EventArgsHelper.Convert(RootElement, e));
		}

		private void AdornerWindow_PreviewKey(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Manager != null)
			{
				Manager.RaiseEvent(e);
				Manager.ProcessKey(e);
			}
		}

		private static IView GetView(DockLayoutManager manager, IAdornerWindowClient client)
		{
			IView view = client as IView;
			if (view == null && client is FloatingPaneWindow floatingPaneWindow)
			{
				view = manager.GetView(((WindowContentHolder)floatingPaneWindow).Container as IUIElement);
			}
			return view;
		}

		void IDisposable.Dispose()
		{
			if (!isDisposingCore)
			{
				isDisposingCore = true;
				isOpenCore = false;
				UnSubscribeEvents();
				UnSubscribeOwnerWindowEvents(GetEventTarget());
				Close();
				Manager.SizeChanged -= OnManagerSizeChanged;
				Manager = null;
				RootElement = null;
				Client = null;
			}
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		protected void OnIsOpenChanged()
		{
			if (IsOpen)
			{
				UpdateFloatingBounds(IsPerMonitorDpiAware);
				base.Topmost = true;
				Show();
				UpdateFloatingBounds();
				SubscribeOwnerWindowEvents(GetEventTarget());
			}
			else
			{
				UnSubscribeOwnerWindowEvents(GetEventTarget());
				base.Topmost = false;
				Hide();
			}
		}

		private Window GetEventTarget()
		{
			if (eventTarget == null)
			{
				eventTarget = (Window)(object)(Client as FloatingPaneWindow);
				if (eventTarget == null)
				{
					eventTarget = base.Owner;
				}
			}
			return eventTarget;
		}

		public void UpdateFloatingBounds(bool pending = false)
		{
			TrySetOwner();
			Rect bounds = Client.Bounds;
			if (transform != null && !transform.Matrix.IsIdentity)
			{
				Point point = transform.Transform(new Point(bounds.Width, bounds.Height));
				bounds.Width = point.X;
				bounds.Height = point.Y;
			}
			if (pending)
			{
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					SetPosition(bounds);
				}, DispatcherPriority.Background);
			}
			else
			{
				SetPosition(bounds);
			}
		}

		private void SetPosition(Rect bounds)
		{
			double num = 1.0;
			if (IsPerMonitorDpiAware)
			{
				Visual container = (Client as Visual) ?? ((Client as LayoutView).RootElement as Visual);
				num = DpiHelper.GetDpiFactor(container, this);
			}
			base.Left = bounds.Left * num;
			base.Top = bounds.Top * num;
			base.Width = bounds.Width * num;
			base.Height = bounds.Height * num;
		}

		private void TrySetOwner()
		{
			if (base.Owner == null && Container != null)
			{
				Window window = WindowServiceHelper.GetWindow(Container);
				if (window != null && window.IsVisible)
				{
					SubscribeOwnerWindowEvents(GetEventTarget());
				}
			}
		}

		private bool EnsureUnSubscribed(Window ownerWindow)
		{
			if (subscriptions == null)
			{
				subscriptions = new List<Window>();
			}
			return !subscriptions.Contains(ownerWindow);
		}

		private void SubscribeOwnerWindowEvents(Window ownerWindow)
		{
			if (ownerWindow != null && EnsureUnSubscribed(ownerWindow))
			{
				subscriptions.Add(ownerWindow);
				ownerWindow.SizeChanged += Owner_SizeChanged;
				ownerWindow.LocationChanged += Owner_LocationChanged;
			}
		}

		private void UnSubscribeOwnerWindowEvents(Window ownerWindow)
		{
			if (ownerWindow != null)
			{
				if (subscriptions != null)
				{
					subscriptions.Remove(ownerWindow);
				}
				ownerWindow.SizeChanged -= Owner_SizeChanged;
				ownerWindow.LocationChanged -= Owner_LocationChanged;
			}
		}

		private void Owner_LocationChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!Container.IsTransparencyDisabled)
			{
				UpdateFloatingBounds();
			}
		}

		private void Owner_SizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!Container.IsTransparencyDisabled)
			{
				UpdateFloatingBounds();
			}
		}
	}
	internal class AdornerWindowHelper : IDisposable
	{
		private bool isDisposing;

		private AdornerWindow adornerWindowCore;

		public DockLayoutManager Container { get; private set; }

		public LayoutView View { get; private set; }

		public AdornerWindow AdornerWindow => adornerWindowCore;

		public AdornerWindowHelper(LayoutView view, DockLayoutManager container)
		{
			View = view;
			Container = container;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (!isDisposing)
			{
				isDisposing = true;
				Ref.Dispose(ref adornerWindowCore);
				View = null;
				Container = null;
			}
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			Ref.Dispose(ref adornerWindowCore);
		}

		public void ShowAdornerWindow(bool forceUpdateAdornerBounds = false)
		{
			if (EnsureAdornerWindow(onShow: true))
			{
				if (!AdornerWindow.IsOpen)
				{
					AdornerWindow.IsOpen = true;
				}
				else if (forceUpdateAdornerBounds)
				{
					AdornerWindow.UpdateFloatingBounds();
				}
			}
		}

		public void HideAdornerWindow()
		{
			if (AdornerWindow != null)
			{
				AdornerWindow.IsOpen = false;
			}
		}

		private bool EnsureAdornerWindow(bool onShow = false)
		{
			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0046: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0049: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			bool flag = Container.IsTransparencyDisabled && View is FloatingView && onShow;
			if (adornerWindowCore == null || adornerWindowCore.IsDisposing || flag)
			{
				FloatingMode realFloatingMode = Container.GetRealFloatingMode();
				if ((int)realFloatingMode == 1)
				{
					adornerWindowCore = View.GetAdornerWindow();
					DockLayoutManager.SetDockLayoutManager(AdornerWindow, Container);
				}
			}
			return adornerWindowCore != null;
		}

		private UIElement TryGetAdornerWindowRoot()
		{
			if (AdornerWindow == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return AdornerWindow.RootElement;
		}
	}
	internal class Win32AdornerWindowProvider : IDisposable
	{
		private DispatcherTimer _HideTimer;

		private AdornerWindow adornerWindowCore;

		private bool isDisposing;

		private bool fCancelHiding;

		private DispatcherTimer HideTimer
		{
			get
			{
				if (_HideTimer == null)
				{
					_HideTimer = InvokeHelper.GetBackgroundTimer(180.0);
				}
				return _HideTimer;
			}
		}

		public Win32AdornerWindowProvider()
		{
			HideTimer.Tick += OnHideTimerTick;
		}

		private void OnHideTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			HideTimer.Stop();
			if (!fCancelHiding)
			{
				HideAdornerWindow();
			}
		}

		public void EnqueueHideAdornerWindow()
		{
			fCancelHiding = false;
			HideTimer.Start();
		}

		public void CancelHideAdornerWindow()
		{
			fCancelHiding = true;
			HideTimer.Stop();
		}

		public void HideAdornerWindow()
		{
			if (adornerWindowCore != null)
			{
				adornerWindowCore.IsOpen = false;
			}
		}

		public AdornerWindow GetWindow(IAdornerWindowClient client, DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			if (adornerWindowCore == null || adornerWindowCore.IsDisposing)
			{
				adornerWindowCore = new AdornerWindow(client, manager);
			}
			else
			{
				adornerWindowCore.Client = client;
			}
			return adornerWindowCore;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (!isDisposing)
			{
				isDisposing = true;
				HideTimer.Stop();
				HideTimer.Tick -= OnHideTimerTick;
				Ref.Dispose(ref adornerWindowCore);
			}
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}
	}
	[ContentProperty("Content")]
	public class AutoHideWindowHost : HwndHost
	{
		public class AutoHideWindowRoot : Decorator
		{
			public AutoHidePane Pane { get; set; }

			public AutoHideWindowHost Host { get; set; }

			public HitTestResult Hit(PointHitTestParameters hitTestParameters)
			{
				return HitTestHelper.GetHitResult(this, hitTestParameters.HitPoint);
			}
		}

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ContentProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty BackgroundProperty;

		private bool isContentRendered;

		private readonly Locker windowPosLocker = new Locker();

		private HwndSource hwndHost;

		private AutoHideWindowRoot _windowRoot;

		private AutoHideWindowRoot WindowRoot
		{
			get
			{
				if (_windowRoot == null)
				{
					_windowRoot = new AutoHideWindowRoot
					{
						Host = this
					};
					KeyboardNavigation.SetTabNavigation(_windowRoot, KeyboardNavigationMode.Cycle);
					AddLogicalChild(_windowRoot);
				}
				return _windowRoot;
			}
		}

		public object Content
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(ContentProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ContentProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public Brush Background
		{
			get
			{
				return (Brush)GetValue(BackgroundProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(BackgroundProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static AutoHideWindowHost()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<AutoHideWindowHost> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<AutoHideWindowHost>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<object>("Content", ref ContentProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((AutoHideWindowHost)d).OnContentChanged(e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<Brush>("Background", ref BackgroundProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((AutoHideWindowHost)d).OnBackgroundChanged((Brush)e.OldValue, (Brush)e.NewValue);
			});
		}

		public AutoHideWindowHost()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			AutoHidePane autoHidePane = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<AutoHidePane>((DependencyObject)this);
			if (autoHidePane != null)
			{
				WindowRoot.Pane = autoHidePane;
				bool flag = AutoHideTray.GetOrientation(autoHidePane) == Orientation.Vertical;
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, flag ? FrameworkElement.WidthProperty : FrameworkElement.HeightProperty, autoHidePane, "PanelSize");
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				ClearValue(ContentProperty);
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		protected virtual void OnContentChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue is UIElement)
			{
				WindowRoot.Child = null;
			}
			if (newValue is UIElement)
			{
				WindowRoot.Child = (UIElement)newValue;
				DockLayoutManager.SetDockLayoutManager(WindowRoot, DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager(this));
			}
		}

		protected override HandleRef BuildWindowCore(HandleRef hwndParent)
		{
			hwndHost = new HwndSource(new HwndSourceParameters
			{
				ParentWindow = hwndParent.Handle,
				WindowStyle = 1174405120,
				Width = 1,
				Height = 1
			});
			hwndHost.RootVisual = WindowRoot;
			hwndHost.ContentRendered += OnContentRendered;
			if (hwndHost.CompositionTarget != null && Background is SolidColorBrush)
			{
				hwndHost.CompositionTarget.BackgroundColor = ((SolidColorBrush)Background).Color;
			}
			return new HandleRef(this, hwndHost.Handle);
		}

		private void OnContentRendered(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			isContentRendered = true;
		}

		protected virtual void OnBackgroundChanged(Brush oldValue, Brush newValue)
		{
			if (hwndHost != null && hwndHost.CompositionTarget != null && Background is SolidColorBrush)
			{
				hwndHost.CompositionTarget.BackgroundColor = ((SolidColorBrush)Background).Color;
			}
		}

		protected override void DestroyWindowCore(HandleRef hwnd)
		{
			if (hwndHost != null)
			{
				hwndHost.Dispose();
				hwndHost = null;
			}
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size constraint)
		{
			WindowRoot.Measure(constraint);
			return WindowRoot.DesiredSize;
		}

		protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size finalSize)
		{
			WindowRoot.Arrange(new Rect(finalSize));
			return finalSize;
		}

		protected override IntPtr WndProc(IntPtr hwnd, int msg, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, ref bool handled)
		{
			if (msg == 70)
			{
				if (isContentRendered && !windowPosLocker.IsLocked)
				{
					windowPosLocker.Lock();
					try
					{
						NativeHelper.SetWindowPosSafe(hwndHost.Handle, IntPtr.Zero, 0, 0, 0, 0, 3);
					}
					finally
					{
						windowPosLocker.Unlock();
					}
				}
				return IntPtr.Zero;
			}
			return base.WndProc(hwnd, msg, wParam, lParam, ref handled);
		}

		protected override bool HasFocusWithinCore()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override HitTestResult HitTestCore(PointHitTestParameters hitTestParameters)
		{
			return WindowRoot.Hit(hitTestParameters);
		}
	}
	public class FloatingPaneWindow : WindowContentHolder, IDisposable, IAdornerWindowClient, IFloatingPane, IDraggableWindow
	{
		protected struct WindowMinMax
		{
			internal double minWidth;

			internal double maxWidth;

			internal double minHeight;

			internal double maxHeight;

			internal WindowMinMax(double minSize, double maxSize)
			{
				minWidth = minSize;
				maxWidth = maxSize;
				minHeight = minSize;
				maxHeight = maxSize;
			}
		}

		private class ShowInTaskBarConverter : IMultiValueConverter
		{
			public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				return (bool)values[0] && (bool)values[1];
			}

			public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

		private sealed class WindowMessageHandler
		{
			private readonly List<KeyValuePair<WM, MessageHandler>> _messageTable;

			private readonly FloatingPaneWindow owner;

			private WindowState _previousWindowState;

			private Win32DragService Win32DragService => owner.Win32DragService;

			private FloatGroup FloatGroup => owner.FloatGroup;

			private DockLayoutManager Manager => owner.Manager;

			public WindowMessageHandler(FloatingPaneWindow owner)
			{
				GuardHelper.ArgumentNotNull(owner, "owner");
				this.owner = owner;
				_messageTable = new List<KeyValuePair<WM, MessageHandler>>
				{
					new KeyValuePair<WM, MessageHandler>(WM.WM_CAPTURECHANGED, OnWmCaptureChanged),
					new KeyValuePair<WM, MessageHandler>(WM.WM_LBUTTONUP, OnWmLButtonUp),
					new KeyValuePair<WM, MessageHandler>(WM.WM_EXITSIZEMOVE, OnWmExitSizeMove),
					new KeyValuePair<WM, MessageHandler>(WM.WM_SIZE, OnWmSize),
					new KeyValuePair<WM, MessageHandler>(WM.WM_SIZING, OnWmSizing),
					new KeyValuePair<WM, MessageHandler>(WM.WM_MOVING, OnWmMoving),
					new KeyValuePair<WM, MessageHandler>(WM.WM_GETMINMAXINFO, OnWmGetMinMaxInfo),
					new KeyValuePair<WM, MessageHandler>(WM.WM_SHOWWINDOW, OnWmShowWindow),
					new KeyValuePair<WM, MessageHandler>(WM.WM_SETFOCUS, OnWmSetFocus),
					new KeyValuePair<WM, MessageHandler>(WM.WM_NCHITTEST, OnWmNcHitTest),
					new KeyValuePair<WM, MessageHandler>(WM.WM_WINDOWPOSCHANGING, OnWmWindowPosChanging),
					new KeyValuePair<WM, MessageHandler>(WM.WM_SYSCOMMAND, OnWmSysCommand),
					new KeyValuePair<WM, MessageHandler>(WM.WM_INITMENUPOPUP, OnWmInitMenuPopup)
				};
			}

			[SecuritySafeCritical]
			private IntPtr OnWmCaptureChanged(WM umsg, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, out bool handled)
			{
				if (Win32DragService.IsInEvent && Keyboard.IsKeyDown(Key.Escape) && Manager.GetView(FloatGroup) is FloatingView floatingView)
				{
					floatingView.OnKeyDown(Key.Escape);
				}
				handled = false;
				return IntPtr.Zero;
			}

			[SecuritySafeCritical]
			private IntPtr OnWmExitSizeMove(WM umsg, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, out bool handled)
			{
				FinishDragging();
				((UIElement)(object)owner).InvalidateVisual();
				handled = false;
				return IntPtr.Zero;
			}

			[SecuritySafeCritical]
			private IntPtr OnWmGetMinMaxInfo(WM umsg, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, out bool handled)
			{
				handled = false;
				if (!owner.LockHelper.IsLocked(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.NativeBounds) && !Win32DragService.IsResizing)
				{
					NativeHelper.WmGetMinMaxInfo(((WindowContentHolder)owner).interopHelperCore.Handle, lParam, owner.OverlapTaskbar);
					handled = true;
				}
				return IntPtr.Zero;
			}

			[SecuritySafeCritical]
			private IntPtr OnWmInitMenuPopup(WM umsg, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, out bool handled)
			{
				IntPtr systemMenuSafe = NativeHelper.GetSystemMenuSafe(((WindowContentHolder)owner).interopHelperCore.Handle, bRevert: false);
				if (systemMenuSafe != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					NativeHelper.EnableMenuItemSafe(systemMenuSafe, 61472u, 1u);
					bool isMaximized = FloatGroup.IsMaximized;
					uint num = ((isMaximized || !owner.CanMaximize) ? 1u : 0u);
					uint num2 = ((FloatGroup.FloatState == FloatState.Minimized || !owner.CanMinimize) ? 1u : 0u);
					uint num3 = ((FloatGroup.FloatState == FloatState.Normal) ? 1u : 0u);
					uint num4 = ((!owner.AllowNativeDragging || isMaximized) ? 1u : 0u);
					NativeHelper.EnableMenuItemSafe(systemMenuSafe, 61488u, 0 | num);
					NativeHelper.EnableMenuItemSafe(systemMenuSafe, 61472u, 0 | num2);
					NativeHelper.EnableMenuItemSafe(systemMenuSafe, 61728u, 0 | num3);
					NativeHelper.EnableMenuItemSafe(systemMenuSafe, 61456u, 0 | num4);
					NativeHelper.EnableMenuItemSafe(systemMenuSafe, 61440u, 0 | num4);
				}
				handled = false;
				return IntPtr.Zero;
			}

			[SecuritySafeCritical]
			private IntPtr OnWmLButtonUp(WM umsg, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, out bool handled)
			{
				if (Win32DragService.IsInEvent)
				{
					FinishDragging();
					handled = true;
				}
				else
				{
					handled = false;
				}
				return IntPtr.Zero;
			}

			[SecuritySafeCritical]
			private IntPtr OnWmMoving(WM umsg, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, out bool handled)
			{
				DoMoving();
				handled = false;
				return IntPtr.Zero;
			}

			[SecuritySafeCritical]
			private IntPtr OnWmNcHitTest(WM umsg, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, out bool handled)
			{
				if (((Window)(object)owner).WindowState == WindowState.Minimized)
				{
					handled = true;
					return new IntPtr(1);
				}
				handled = false;
				return IntPtr.Zero;
			}

			[SecuritySafeCritical]
			private IntPtr OnWmSetFocus(WM umsg, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, out bool handled)
			{
				handled = owner.LockHelper.IsLocked(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.Focus);
				return IntPtr.Zero;
			}

			[SecuritySafeCritical]
			private IntPtr OnWmShowWindow(WM umsg, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, out bool handled)
			{
				handled = WmShowWindow(wParam, lParam);
				return IntPtr.Zero;
			}

			[SecuritySafeCritical]
			private IntPtr OnWmSize(WM umsg, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, out bool handled)
			{
				WmSizeChanged(wParam);
				handled = false;
				return IntPtr.Zero;
			}

			[SecuritySafeCritical]
			private IntPtr OnWmSizing(WM umsg, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, out bool handled)
			{
				owner.DisableSizeToContent();
				if (Win32DragService.IsResizing)
				{
					DoSizing();
					handled = true;
				}
				else
				{
					handled = false;
				}
				return IntPtr.Zero;
			}

			[SecuritySafeCritical]
			private IntPtr OnWmSysCommand(WM umsg, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, out bool handled)
			{
				handled = false;
				switch (GetInt(wParam) & 0xFFF0)
				{
				case 61536:
					if (!CheckClosedKeyGesture())
					{
						Manager.DockController.Close(FloatGroup);
						handled = true;
					}
					break;
				case 61728:
					if (((Window)(object)owner).WindowState != WindowState.Normal)
					{
						owner.LockHelper.LockOnce(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.Restore);
					}
					if (FloatGroup.IsMaximized)
					{
						owner.RestoreFloatGroup();
						handled = true;
					}
					break;
				case 61488:
					if (!FloatGroup.IsMaximized)
					{
						owner.MaximizeFloatGroup();
						handled = true;
					}
					break;
				case 61472:
					if (FloatGroup.FloatState != FloatState.Minimized)
					{
						owner.MinimizeFloatGroup();
						handled = true;
					}
					break;
				}
				return IntPtr.Zero;
			}

			[SecuritySafeCritical]
			private IntPtr OnWmWindowPosChanging(WM umsg, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, out bool handled)
			{
				if (Win32DragService.IsDragging)
				{
					WINDOWPOS structure = (WINDOWPOS)Marshal.PtrToStructure(lParam, typeof(WINDOWPOS));
					if (((IDraggableWindow)owner).SuspendDragging || Manager.RaiseDockItemDraggingEvent(FloatGroup, new Point(structure.x, structure.y)))
					{
						structure.x = (int)((Window)(object)owner).Left;
						structure.y = (int)((Window)(object)owner).Top;
						Marshal.StructureToPtr(structure, lParam, fDeleteOld: true);
					}
				}
				handled = false;
				return IntPtr.Zero;
			}

			private bool WmShowWindow(IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam)
			{
				int num = NativeMethods.IntPtrToInt32(lParam);
				if (num != 1 && num == 3)
				{
					((Window)(object)owner).ShowActivated = ((Window)(object)owner).WindowState == WindowState.Maximized;
					owner.LockHelper.LockOnce(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.ParentOpening);
				}
				return false;
			}

			private bool WmSizeChanged(IntPtr wParam)
			{
				switch ((int)wParam)
				{
				case 0:
					if (_previousWindowState != WindowState.Normal)
					{
						CorrectRestoreBounds();
						_previousWindowState = WindowState.Normal;
					}
					break;
				case 1:
					_previousWindowState = WindowState.Minimized;
					break;
				case 2:
					_previousWindowState = WindowState.Maximized;
					break;
				}
				return false;
			}

			private void CorrectRestoreBounds()
			{
				Rect lastRestoreBounds = owner.lastRestoreBounds;
				if (owner.LockHelper.IsLocked(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.RestoreBounds) || lastRestoreBounds == Rect.Empty)
				{
					return;
				}
				using (owner.LockHelper.Lock(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.RestoreBounds))
				{
					((Window)(object)owner).Left = lastRestoreBounds.Left;
					((Window)(object)owner).Top = lastRestoreBounds.Top;
					((FrameworkElement)(object)owner).Width = lastRestoreBounds.Width;
					((FrameworkElement)(object)owner).Height = lastRestoreBounds.Height;
					owner.lastRestoreBounds = Rect.Empty;
				}
			}

			private void DoMoving()
			{
				Win32DragService.DoDragging();
			}

			private void DoSizing()
			{
				if (Win32DragService.IsResizing)
				{
					Win32DragService.DoSizing();
					owner.EnsureRelativeSize();
				}
			}

			private void FinishDragging()
			{
				if (Win32DragService.IsResizing)
				{
					owner.EnsureRelativeSize();
				}
				Win32DragService.FinishDragging();
			}

			public bool TryHandleMessage(int message, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, ref bool handled, ref IntPtr result)
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<WM, MessageHandler> item in _messageTable)
				{
					if (item.Key == (WM)message)
					{
						result = item.Value((WM)message, wParam, lParam, out handled);
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}

			public void SetPreviousWindowState(WindowState newValue)
			{
				_previousWindowState = newValue;
			}
		}

		private bool AllowNativeDragging
		{
			get
			{
				if (Manager.EnableNativeDragging)
				{
					return ((Window)this).WindowState != WindowState.Minimized;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool AllowNativeSizing
		{
			get
			{
				if (AllowNativeDragging)
				{
					return Manager.RedrawContentWhenResizing;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

					OnBindingsOwnerChanged(oldValue, value);

			}
		}

		static FloatingPaneWindow()
		{
			CanMaximizeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CanMaximize", typeof(bool), typeof(FloatingPaneWindow), new PropertyMetadata(true, OnCanMaximizeChanged));
			CanMinimizeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CanMinimize", typeof(bool), typeof(FloatingPaneWindow), new PropertyMetadata(true, OnCanMinimizeChanged));
			FloatingMaxSizeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("FloatingMaxSize", typeof(Size), typeof(FloatingPaneWindow), new PropertyMetadata(default(Size), OnFloatingMaxSizeChanged));
			FloatingMinSizeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("FloatingMinSize", typeof(Size), typeof(FloatingPaneWindow), new PropertyMetadata(default(Size), OnFloatingMinSizeChanged));
			AllowAeroSnapProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AllowAeroSnap", typeof(bool), typeof(FloatingPaneWindow), new PropertyMetadata(false, OnAllowAeroSnapChanged));
			FloatStateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("FloatState", typeof(FloatState), typeof(FloatingPaneWindow), new PropertyMetadata(FloatState.Normal, OnFloatStateChanged));
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<FloatingPaneWindow>.New().Register<bool>("InheritOwnerCommandBindings", ref InheritOwnerCommandBindingsProperty, true, (Action<FloatingPaneWindow>)delegate(FloatingPaneWindow d)
			{
				d.OnInheritOwnerCommandBindingsChanged();
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null).Register<bool>("InheritOwnerInputBindings", ref InheritOwnerInputBindingsProperty, true, (Action<FloatingPaneWindow>)delegate(FloatingPaneWindow d)
			{
				d.OnInheritOwnerInputBindingsChanged();
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("OverlapTaskbar", ref OverlapTaskbarProperty, false, (Action<FloatingPaneWindow, bool, bool>)delegate(FloatingPaneWindow d, bool oldValue, bool newValue)
				{
					d.OverlapTaskbarChanged(newValue);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.OverrideMetadata<WindowState>(Window.WindowStateProperty, WindowState.Normal, (Action<FloatingPaneWindow, WindowState, WindowState>)delegate(FloatingPaneWindow x, WindowState oldValue, WindowState newValue)
				{
					x.OnWindowStateChanged(oldValue, newValue);
				}, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None);
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<FloatingPaneWindow>();
		}

		private static bool CheckClosedKeyGesture()
		{
			if (Keyboard.IsKeyDown(Key.F4))
			{
				return Keyboard2.IsAltPressed;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static int GetInt(IntPtr ptr)
		{
			if (IntPtr.Size != 8)
			{
				return ptr.ToInt32();
			}
			return (int)ptr.ToInt64();
		}

		private static void OnAllowAeroSnapChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is FloatingPaneWindow floatingPaneWindow)
			{
				floatingPaneWindow.OnAllowAeroSnapChanged((bool)e.OldValue, (bool)e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		private static void OnCanMaximizeChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateSystemCommands((FloatingPaneWindow)(object)d);
		}

		private static void OnCanMinimizeChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateSystemCommands((FloatingPaneWindow)(object)d);
		}

		private static void OnFloatingMaxSizeChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is FloatingPaneWindow floatingPaneWindow)
			{
				floatingPaneWindow.OnFloatingMaxSizeChanged((Size)e.OldValue, (Size)e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		private static void OnFloatingMinSizeChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is FloatingPaneWindow floatingPaneWindow)
			{
				floatingPaneWindow.OnFloatingMinSizeChanged((Size)e.OldValue, (Size)e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		private static void OnFloatStateChanged(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (o is FloatingPaneWindow floatingPaneWindow)
			{
				floatingPaneWindow.OnFloatStateChanged((FloatState)e.OldValue, (FloatState)e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		private static void UpdateSystemCommands(FloatingPaneWindow window)
		{
			IntPtr handle = new WindowInteropHelper((Window)(object)window).Handle;
			if (!(handle == IntPtr.Zero))
			{
				int windowLongSafe = NativeHelper.GetWindowLongSafe(handle, -16);
				windowLongSafe = ((!window.CanMaximize) ? (windowLongSafe & -65537) : (windowLongSafe | 0x10000));
				windowLongSafe = ((!window.CanMinimize) ? (windowLongSafe & -131073) : (windowLongSafe | 0x20000));
				NativeHelper.SetWindowLongSafe(handle, -16, windowLongSafe);
			}
		}

		public FloatingPaneWindow(BaseFloatingContainer container)
			: base(container)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			FloatGroup = DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem((DependencyObject)(object)container) as FloatGroup;
			DependencyObjectExtensions.SetValueIfNotDefault((DependencyObject)(object)this, FrameworkElement.StyleProperty, (object)FloatGroup.WindowStyle);
			hiddenInitialization = true;
			((Window)this).WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.Manual;
			Manager = DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager((DependencyObject)(object)container);
			Manager.SizeChanged += OnManagerSizeChanged;
			WMHandler = new WindowMessageHandler(this);
			WindowHelper.BindFlowDirection((FrameworkElement)(object)this, Manager);
			((Window)this).AllowsTransparency = !Manager.IsTransparencyDisabled;
			((FrameworkElement)this).Loaded += OnLoaded;
			((Window)this).Activated += OnActivated;
			((Window)this).LocationChanged += OnLocationChanged;
			((FrameworkElement)this).SizeChanged += OnSizeChanged;
			((UIElement)this).PreviewGotKeyboardFocus += OnPreviewGotKeyboardFocus;
			FloatGroup.LayoutChanged += OnFloatGroupLayoutChanged;
			FloatGroup.Forward((FrameworkElement)(object)this, Window.SizeToContentProperty, "SizeToContent", BindingMode.TwoWay);
			FloatGroup.Forward((FrameworkElement)(object)this, UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, "IsEnabled");
			if (FloatGroup.ScreenLocationBeforeClose.HasValue)
			{
				Point point = ((FloatState == FloatState.Maximized) ? ScreenHelper.GetScreenRect(FloatGroup.ScreenLocationBeforeClose.Value).Location : FloatGroup.ScreenLocationBeforeClose.Value);
				((Window)this).Left = point.X;
				((Window)this).Top = point.Y;
			}
			if (CompatibilitySettings.MakeGetWindowReturnActualFloatPanelWindow)
			{
				WindowServiceHelper.SetIWindowService(FloatGroup, this);
				Window window = Window.GetWindow(Manager);
				if (window != null)
				{
					Window value = WindowServiceHelper.GetRootWindow(window) ?? window;
					WindowServiceHelper.SetRootWindow((DependencyObject)(object)this, value);
				}
			}
		}

		public void UpdateBoundsNative(Rect bounds)
		{
			if (EnqueueUpdateBounds(bounds))
			{
				return;
			}
			lastFloatingBounds = bounds;
			if (Manager.IsThemeChangedLocked || Manager.SerializationController.IsDeserializing || (FloatGroup.FloatState == FloatState.Minimized && !((Window)this).ShowInTaskbar) || LockHelper.IsLocked(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.WindowState) || (!LockHelper.IsLocked(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.Maximize) && Win32DragService.IsInEvent) || LockHelper.IsLocked(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.FloatingBounds))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (IsAutoSize)
			{
				Size size = SizeToContentHelper.FitSizeToContent(FloatGroup.SizeToContent, new Size(((UIElement)this).RenderSize.Width, ((UIElement)this).RenderSize.Height), bounds.Size);
				bounds.Size = size;
			}
			using (LockHelper.Lock(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.NativeBounds))
			{
				if (PresentationSource.FromVisual((Visual)(object)this) is HwndSource { CompositionTarget: not null } hwndSource)
				{
					bounds.Transform(hwndSource.CompositionTarget.TransformToDevice);
					NativeHelper.SetWindowPosSafe(hwndSource.Handle, IntPtr.Zero, (int)bounds.X, (int)bounds.Y, (int)bounds.Width, (int)bounds.Height, 84);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void DisableSizeToContent()
		{
			if (IsAutoSize)
			{
				((Window)this).SizeToContent = SizeToContent.Manual;
			}
		}

		internal bool Maximize()
		{
			if (CanMaximize)
			{
				DisableSizeToContent();
				((Window)this).WindowState = WindowState.Maximized;
			}
			return CanMaximize;
		}

		internal bool Minimize()
		{
			if (CanMinimize)
			{
				((Window)this).WindowState = WindowState.Minimized;
			}
			return CanMinimize;
		}

		internal bool Restore()
		{
			((Window)this).WindowState = WindowState.Normal;
			return true;
		}

		internal Rect RestoreBoundsToFloatBounds()
		{
			if (!IsRestoreBoundsValid() || ((Window)this).RestoreBounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			if (((Window)this).WindowState == WindowState.Normal && !((UIElement)this).IsVisible)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			Rect restoreBounds = ((Window)this).RestoreBounds;
			if (Manager.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
			{
				restoreBounds.X += restoreBounds.Width;
			}
			Rect rect = restoreBounds;
			PresentationSource presentationSource = PresentationSource.FromDependencyObject((DependencyObject)(object)this);
			if (presentationSource != null)
			{
				rect.Transform(presentationSource.CompositionTarget.TransformToDevice);
			}
			rect = TransformToRelativeBounds(rect);
			return new Rect(TransformWindowBoundsToFloatBounds(rect).Location, restoreBounds.Size);
		}

		internal Size TranslateWindowSizeToFloatSize()
		{
			Rect windowRect = WindowRect;
			PresentationSource presentationSource = PresentationSource.FromDependencyObject((DependencyObject)(object)this);
			if (presentationSource != null)
			{
				windowRect.Transform(presentationSource.CompositionTarget.TransformFromDevice);
			}
			return TransformWindowBoundsToFloatBounds(windowRect).Size;
		}

		internal void UpdateFloatGroupBounds()
		{
			fBoundsChangeRequested = true;
		}

		internal void UpdateOwnerWindow()
		{
			Window ownerWindow = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<Window>((DependencyObject)Manager);
			if (OwnerWindow != null)
			{
				((WindowContentHolder)this).UnSubscribe(OwnerWindow);
			}
			OwnerWindow = ownerWindow;
			if (Manager.OwnsFloatWindows)
			{
				((Window)this).Owner = OwnerWindow;
			}
			if (OwnerWindow != null)
			{
				((WindowContentHolder)this).Subscribe(OwnerWindow);
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateRenderOptions()
		{
			((DispatcherObject)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				VisualEffectsInheritanceHelper.SetTextAndRenderOptions((DependencyObject)(object)this, (DependencyObject)Manager);
			}, DispatcherPriority.Background);
		}

		protected override void EnsureRelativeLocationCore(Point floatLocation)
		{
			if (!(floatLocation == PointHelper.Empty))
			{
				FloatGroup.EnsureFloatLocation(floatLocation);
			}
		}

		protected override Point GetRelativeLocation(FrameworkElement owner)
		{
			PresentationSource presentationSource = PresentationSource.FromDependencyObject(owner);
			PresentationSource presentationSource2 = PresentationSource.FromDependencyObject((DependencyObject)(object)this);
			if (presentationSource != null && presentationSource.CompositionTarget != null)
			{
				Point point = ((((Window)this).WindowState == WindowState.Maximized && presentationSource2 != null) ? ((Visual)this).PointToScreen(default(Point)) : new Point(((Window)this).Left, ((Window)this).Top));
				Point point2 = presentationSource.CompositionTarget.TransformToDevice.Transform(point);
				if (double.IsNaN(point2.X) || double.IsNaN(point2.Y))
				{
					return PointHelper.Empty;
				}
				Point result = owner.PointFromScreen(point2);
				if (((FrameworkElement)this).FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
				{
					result.X -= ((FrameworkElement)this).ActualWidth;
				}
				return result;
			}
			return ((WindowContentHolder)this).GetRelativeLocation(owner);
		}

		protected virtual void OnAllowAeroSnapChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			UpdateResizingMode();
			UpdateMinMax();
		}

		protected override void OnClosed(EventArgs e)
		{
			((WindowContentHolder)this).OnClosed(e);
			if (isDragging)
			{
				Win32DragService.ReleaseCapture();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnClosing(CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			((Window)this).OnClosing(e);
			if (!e.Cancel && CheckClosedKeyGesture() && !isDisposingCore)
			{
				if (OwnerWindow != null)
				{
					((DispatcherObject)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(OwnerWindow.Close));
				}
				e.Cancel = true;
			}
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new FloatingPaneWindowAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected void OnDisposing()
		{
			BindingOperations.ClearAllBindings((DependencyObject)(object)this);
			ensureRelativeSizeOperation?.Abort();
			changeFloatStateOperation?.Abort();
			tryCorrectBoundsAsyncOperation?.Abort();
			tryCheckRelativeLocationAsyncOperation?.Abort();
			sizeChangedLockHelper.Reset();
			UnsubscribeDragWidget();
			if (OwnerWindow != null)
			{
				((WindowContentHolder)this).UnSubscribe(OwnerWindow);
				OwnerWindow = null;
			}
			LockHelper.GetLocker(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.ThemeChanging).Reset();
			LockHelper.GetLocker(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.CheckFloatBounds).Reset();
			((Window)this).Close();
			((UIElement)this).LayoutUpdated -= OnFloatGroupLayoutChangedLayoutUpdated;
			Manager.SizeChanged -= OnManagerSizeChanged;
			FloatGroup.LayoutChanged -= OnFloatGroupLayoutChanged;
			FloatGroup.ScreenLocationBeforeClose = new Point(((Window)this).Left, ((Window)this).Top);
			FloatGroup.ClearValue(WindowServiceHelper.IWindowServiceProperty);
		}

		protected virtual void OnFloatingMaxSizeChanged(Size oldValue, Size newValue)
		{
			UpdateMinMax();
		}

		protected virtual void OnFloatingMinSizeChanged(Size oldValue, Size newValue)
		{
			UpdateMinMax();
		}

		protected virtual void OnFloatStateChanged(FloatState oldValue, FloatState newValue)
		{
			if (changeFloatStateOperation != null)
			{
				changeFloatStateOperation.Abort();
			}
			Action<FloatState> method = ChangeFloatStateCore;
			if (newValue == FloatState.Maximized && !ScreenHelper.IsAttachedToPresentationSource((FrameworkElement)(object)this))
			{
				changeFloatStateOperation = ((DispatcherObject)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(method, newValue);
			}
			else
			{
				ChangeFloatStateCore(newValue);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnLocationChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (fBoundsChangeRequested || (!FloatGroup.IsMaximized && !Win32DragService.IsInEvent && !LockHelper.IsLocked(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.FloatingBounds) && !LockHelper.IsLocked(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.NativeBounds)))
			{
				EnsureRelativeLocation();
			}
		}

			OnPreviewKey(this, e);
		}

			OnPreviewKey(this, e);
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewMouseMove(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)

			if (AllowNativeSizing)
			{
				TryStartSizing();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnRenderSizeChanged(SizeChangedInfo sizeInfo)

			UpdateHeaderSize(sizeInfo.NewSize);

		}

		protected override void SetBounds(Rect bounds)
		{
			if (FloatGroup.ScreenLocationBeforeClose.HasValue && FloatState != FloatState.Maximized)
			{
				Point value = FloatGroup.ScreenLocationBeforeClose.Value;
				bounds = new Rect(new Point(value.X, value.Y), bounds.Size);
			}
			FloatGroup.ScreenLocationBeforeClose = null;
			bounds = TransformFloatBoundsToWindowBounds(bounds);
			if (DpiHelper.IsPerMonitorDpiAware)
			{
				double dpiFactor = DpiHelper.GetDpiFactor((Visual)(object)((WindowContentHolder)this).Container, (Visual)(object)this);
				bounds.X *= dpiFactor;
				bounds.Y *= dpiFactor;
			}
			if (ScreenHelper.IsAttachedToPresentationSource((FrameworkElement)(object)this))
			{
				UpdateBoundsNative(bounds);
			}
			else
			{
				((WindowContentHolder)this).SetBounds(bounds);
			}
		}

		protected override void Subscribe(Window ownerWindow)
		{
			if (ownerWindow != null)
			{
				((WindowContentHolder)this).Subscribe(ownerWindow);
				BindingsOwner = ownerWindow;
			}
		}

		protected override void TryCheckRelativeLocationAsync(object sender)
		{
			FloatGroup.ScreenLocationBeforeClose = null;
			if (((Window)this).Owner is DXWindow || ((Window)this).Owner is FloatingPaneWindow || ((Window)this).Owner is ThemedWindow)
			{
				tryCheckRelativeLocationAsyncOperation.Do(delegate(DispatcherOperation x)
				{
					x.Abort();
				});
				tryCheckRelativeLocationAsyncOperation = ((DispatcherObject)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					if (OwnerWindow != null)
					{
						((WindowContentHolder)this).CheckRelativeLocation();
						TryCheckRelativeLocationAsyncLocker.Unlock();
					}
				}, DispatcherPriority.Render);
			}
			else
			{
				((WindowContentHolder)this).TryCheckRelativeLocationAsync(sender);
			}
		}

		protected override void TryCorrectBoundsAsync(FrameworkElement owner, Rect bounds)
		{
			if (!ScreenHelper.IsAttachedToPresentationSource((FrameworkElement)(object)this))
			{
				SetWindowSize(bounds.Size);
				if (Manager.IsMeasureValid)
				{
					((WindowContentHolder)this).TryCorrectBoundsAsync(owner, bounds);
					return;
				}
			}
			if (TryCheckRelativeLocationAsyncLocker.IsLocked && ((Window)this).Owner is FloatingPaneWindow)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (OwnerWindow != null && (OwnerWindow is DXWindow || ((Window)this).Owner is FloatingPaneWindow || !Manager.IsMeasureValid))
			{
				correctBoundsRequested = true;
				if (fFirstRun)
				{
					fFirstRun = !OwnerWindow.IsArrangeValid || !Manager.IsMeasureValid;
					savedOwner = owner;
					savedBounds = bounds;
					if (!OwnerWindow.IsArrangeValid || !Manager.IsMeasureValid)
					{
						tryCorrectBoundsAsyncOperation.Do(delegate(DispatcherOperation x)
						{
							x.Abort();
						});
						tryCorrectBoundsAsyncOperation = ((DispatcherObject)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
						{
							if (correctBoundsRequested)
							{
								CorrectBoundsAction(savedOwner, savedBounds);
							}
						}, DispatcherPriority.Normal);
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			correctBoundsRequested = false;
			((WindowContentHolder)this).TryCorrectBoundsAsync(owner, bounds);
		}

		protected override void TrySetOwnerCore(Window containerWindow)
		{
			if (Manager.OwnsFloatWindows)
			{
				((WindowContentHolder)this).TrySetOwnerCore(containerWindow);
			}
			if (OwnerWindow == null)
			{
				OwnerWindow = containerWindow;
			}
		}

		protected override void UnSubscribe(Window ownerWindow)
		{
			if (ownerWindow == null)
			{
				ownerWindow = OwnerWindow;
			}
			((WindowContentHolder)this).UnSubscribe(ownerWindow);
			BindingsOwner = null;
		}

		private void ChangeFloatStateCore(FloatState state)
		{
			EnsureWindowState(state);
			changeFloatStateOperation = null;
		}

		private void ChangeWindowState(FloatState state)
		{
			changeWindowStateLocker.Unlock();
			if (!Locker.op_Implicit(changeWindowStateLocker))
			{
				ChangeWindowStateCore(state);
			}
		}

		private void ChangeWindowStateCore(FloatState state)
		{
			if (isDisposingCore)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (state == FloatState.Maximized && ((Window)this).WindowState != WindowState.Maximized)
			{
				lastRestoreBounds = ((changeFloatStateOperation == null) ? GetRestoreBounds() : Rect.Empty);
				((Window)this).WindowState = WindowState.Maximized;
			}
			if (state == FloatState.Normal && ((Window)this).WindowState != WindowState.Normal)
			{
				lastRestoreBounds = lastFloatingBounds;
				LockHelper.LockOnce(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.Restore);
				((Window)this).WindowState = WindowState.Normal;
			}
			if (state == FloatState.Minimized && ((Window)this).WindowState != WindowState.Minimized)
			{
				if (!Manager.SerializationController.IsDeserializing)
				{
					lastRestoreBounds = GetRestoreBounds();
				}
				((Window)this).WindowState = WindowState.Minimized;
			}
		}

		private void CheckTransform()
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = OwnerWindow;
			if (frameworkElement == null || !Manager.IsDescendantOf(frameworkElement))
			{
				frameworkElement = LayoutHelper.GetTopLevelVisual((DependencyObject)Manager);
			}
			if (frameworkElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			transform = Manager.TransformToVisual(frameworkElement) as MatrixTransform;
			if (transform == null || transform.Matrix.IsIdentity)
			{
				return;
			}
			Matrix matrix = transform.Matrix;
			transform = new MatrixTransform(Math.Abs(matrix.M11), matrix.M12, matrix.M21, Math.Abs(matrix.M22), 0.0, 0.0);
			if (transform != ((FrameworkElement)((ContentControl)this).Content).LayoutTransform)
			{
				((FrameworkElement)((ContentControl)this).Content).LayoutTransform = transform;
				if (!transform.Matrix.IsIdentity)
				{
					transformLocker.LockOnce();
				}
			}
		}

		private void CorrectBoundsAction(FrameworkElement owner, Rect bounds)
		{
			if (lockCorrectBounds > 0 || !correctBoundsRequested)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				lockCorrectBounds++;
				correctBoundsRequested = false;
				((WindowContentHolder)this).CorrectBoundsCore(owner, bounds);
			}
			finally
			{
				lockCorrectBounds--;
			}
		}

		private MultiBinding CreateShowInTaskBarBinding()
		{
			MultiBinding multiBinding = new MultiBinding
			{
				Converter = new ShowInTaskBarConverter()
			};
			multiBinding.Bindings.Add(new Binding(DockLayoutManager.ShowFloatWindowsInTaskbarProperty.Name)
			{
				Source = Manager
			});
			multiBinding.Bindings.Add(new Binding(FloatGroup.IsActuallyVisibleProperty.Name)
			{
				Source = FloatGroup
			});
			return multiBinding;
		}

		private bool EnqueueUpdateBounds(Rect bounds)
		{
			LockHelper.LockHelperDelegate action = delegate
			{
				UpdateBoundsNative(bounds);
			};
			LockHelper themeChangingLocker = LockHelper.GetLocker(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.ThemeChanging);
			if ((bool)themeChangingLocker)
			{
				themeChangingLocker.Reset();
			}
			if (Manager.IsThemeChangedLocked)
			{
				themeChangingLocker.Lock();
				themeChangingLocker.DoWhenUnlocked(action);
				((DispatcherObject)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					themeChangingLocker.Unlock();
				}, DispatcherPriority.Normal);
				return true;
			}
			LockHelper locker = LockHelper.GetLocker(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.CheckFloatBounds);
			if ((bool)locker)
			{
				locker.Reset();
			}
			if ((bool)locker)
			{
				locker.DoWhenUnlocked(action);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void EnsureRelativeSize()
		{
			if (FloatState == FloatState.Minimized || ((Window)this).WindowState == WindowState.Maximized)
			{
				return;
			}
			Size floatSize = TranslateWindowSizeToFloatSize();
			using (LockHelper.Lock(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.FloatingBounds))
			{
				FloatGroup.FloatSize = floatSize;
			}
		}

		private void EnsureRelativeSizeWithTransform()
		{
			transformLocker.Unlock();
			EnsureRelativeSize();
		}

		private void EnsureWindowState(FloatState state)
		{
			changeWindowStateLocker.Lock();
			ChangeWindowState(state);
		}

		private void EnsureRelativeLocation()
		{
			Rect rect = TransformToRelativeBounds(WindowRect);
			using (LockHelper.Lock(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.FloatingBounds))
			{
				FloatGroup.FloatLocation = rect.Location;
			}
		}

		private Rect GetRestoreBounds()
		{
			if (!IsRestoreBoundsValid())
			{
				return new Rect(0.0, 0.0, _restoreBounds.Width, _restoreBounds.Height);
			}
			return ((Window)this).RestoreBounds;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private Rect GetWindowRect()
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			RECT val = default(RECT);
			if (base.interopHelperCore != null)
			{
				NativeMethods.GetWindowRect(new HandleRef(this, base.interopHelperCore.Handle), ref val);
			}
			Rect result = new Rect(val.left, val.top, val.right - val.left, val.bottom - val.top);
			if (((FrameworkElement)this).FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
			{
				result.X += ((RECT)(ref val)).Width;
			}
			return result;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private bool IsRestoreBoundsValid()
		{
			IntPtr handle = new WindowInteropHelper((Window)(object)this).Handle;
			if (handle == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				return true;
			}
			WINDOWPLACEMENT windowPlacement = NativeHelper.GetWindowPlacement(handle);
			if (windowPlacement.rcNormalPosition.left <= windowPlacement.rcNormalPosition.right)
			{
				return windowPlacement.rcNormalPosition.top <= windowPlacement.rcNormalPosition.bottom;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void InvokeUpdateOwnerBindings()
		{
			updateOwnerBindingsOperation?.Abort();
			updateOwnerBindingsOperation = ((DispatcherObject)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				UpdateOwnerBindings();
			});
		}

		}
