		protected override void OnInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			((FrameworkElement)this).OnInitialized(e);
			((FrameworkElement)this).SetBinding(AllowAeroSnapProperty, (BindingBase)new Binding("AllowAeroSnap")
			{
				Source = Manager
			});
			((FrameworkElement)this).SetBinding(FloatingMaxSizeProperty, (BindingBase)new Binding("ActualMaxSize")
			{
				Source = FloatGroup
			});
			((FrameworkElement)this).SetBinding(FloatingMinSizeProperty, (BindingBase)new Binding("ActualMinSize")
			{
				Source = FloatGroup
			});
			((FrameworkElement)this).SetBinding(CanMaximizeProperty, (BindingBase)new Binding("CanMaximize")
			{
				Source = FloatGroup
			});
			((FrameworkElement)this).SetBinding(CanMinimizeProperty, (BindingBase)new Binding("CanMinimize")
			{
				Source = FloatGroup
			});
			((FrameworkElement)this).SetBinding(FloatStateProperty, (BindingBase)new Binding("FloatState")
			{
				Source = FloatGroup
			});
			((FrameworkElement)this).SetBinding(Window.TitleProperty, (BindingBase)new Binding
			{
				Source = FloatGroup,
				Path = new PropertyPath(FloatGroup.ActualWindowTaskbarTitleProperty)
			});
			((FrameworkElement)this).SetBinding(Window.IconProperty, (BindingBase)new Binding
			{
				Source = FloatGroup,
				Path = new PropertyPath(FloatGroup.ActualWindowTaskbarIconProperty)
			});
			if (((ContentControl)this).Content != null && firstCheck)
			{
				CheckTransform();
				((FrameworkElement)this).SetBinding(Window.ShowInTaskbarProperty, (BindingBase)CreateShowInTaskBarBinding());
				firstCheck = false;
			}
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			FloatGroup.RaiseWindowLoaded();
			((DispatcherObject)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				UnsubscribeDragWidget();
				SubscribeDragWidget();
			});
		}

		private void OnManagerSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sizeChangedLockHelper.IsLocked)
			{
				sizeChangedLockHelper.Reset();
			}
			if (Manager.IsThemeChangedLocked)
			{
				sizeChangedLockHelper.Lock();
				sizeChangedLockHelper.DoWhenUnlocked(delegate
				{
					((WindowContentHolder)this).TryCheckRelativeLocationAsync(sender);
				});
				((DispatcherObject)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					sizeChangedLockHelper.Unlock();
				}, DispatcherPriority.Render);
				return;
			}
			if (((Window)this).Owner is DXWindow || ((Window)this).Owner is FloatingPaneWindow)
			{
				TryCheckRelativeLocationAsyncLocker.LockOnce();
			}
			((WindowContentHolder)this).TryCheckRelativeLocationAsync(sender);
			CheckTransform();
			if (Locker.op_Implicit(transformLocker))
			{
				if (Locker.op_Implicit(TryCheckRelativeLocationAsyncLocker))
				{
					TryCheckRelativeLocationAsyncLocker.Unlocked += OnTryCheckRelativeLocationAsyncLockerUnlocked;
				}
				else
				{
					EnsureRelativeSizeWithTransform();
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnPreviewGotKeyboardFocus(object sender, KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OriginalSource != sender)
			{
				return;
			}
			IInputElement focusedElement = FocusManager.GetFocusedElement(FloatGroup);
			if (focusedElement == null || focusedElement == sender || !focusedElement.Focusable)
			{
				return;
			}
			IInputElement focusedElement2 = Keyboard.FocusedElement;
			if (focusedElement is Visual visual && !visual.IsDescendantOf((DependencyObject)(object)this))
			{
				FocusManager.SetFocusedElement(FloatGroup, null);
				return;
			}
			focusedElement.Focus();
			if (Keyboard.FocusedElement == focusedElement || Keyboard.FocusedElement != focusedElement2)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private void OnPreviewKey(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			Manager.RaiseEvent(e);
		}

		private void OnSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!Manager.IsThemeChangedLocked && (Win32DragService.IsResizing || (!correctBoundsRequested && !LockHelper.IsLocked(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.NativeBounds) && !LockHelper.IsLocked(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.FloatingBounds)) || IsAutoSize))
			{
				if (IsAutoSize)
				{
					ensureRelativeSizeOperation = ((DispatcherObject)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(EnsureRelativeSize));
				}
				else
				{
					EnsureRelativeSize();
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnTryCheckRelativeLocationAsyncLockerUnlocked(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			TryCheckRelativeLocationAsyncLocker.Unlocked -= OnTryCheckRelativeLocationAsyncLockerUnlocked;
			EnsureRelativeSizeWithTransform();
		}

		private void OnWindowStateChanged(WindowState oldValue, WindowState newValue)
		{
			if (isDisposingCore)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (newValue != WindowState.Normal && IsRestoreBoundsValid())
			{
				_restoreBounds = ((Window)this).RestoreBounds;
			}
			LockHelper.Unlock(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.Restore);
			WMHandler.SetPreviousWindowState(newValue);
			if (newValue == WindowState.Maximized)
			{
				if (FloatGroup.FloatState != FloatState.Maximized)
				{
					try
					{
						if (Win32DragService.IsDragging)
						{
							LockHelper.Lock(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.Maximize);
						}
						MaximizeFloatGroup();
						Rect restoreBounds = ((Window)this).RestoreBounds;
						if (Manager.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
						{
							restoreBounds.X += ((Window)this).RestoreBounds.Width;
						}
						restoreBounds = TransformToRelativeBounds(restoreBounds);
						if (DocumentPanel.GetRestoreBounds(FloatGroup) == default(Rect))
						{
							DocumentPanel.SetRestoreBounds(FloatGroup, restoreBounds);
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						LockHelper.Unlock(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.Maximize);
					}
				}
				else if (!Win32DragService.IsDragging)
				{
					Rect restoreBounds = TransformFromRelativeBounds(DocumentPanel.GetRestoreBounds(FloatGroup));
					if (restoreBounds.Width == 0.0 || restoreBounds.Height == 0.0)
					{
						return;
					}
					((Window)this).Left = restoreBounds.Left;
					if (Manager.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
					{
						((Window)this).Left -= restoreBounds.Width;
					}
					((Window)this).Top = restoreBounds.Top;
					((FrameworkElement)this).Width = restoreBounds.Width;
					((FrameworkElement)this).Height = restoreBounds.Height;
				}
			}
			if (newValue == WindowState.Minimized)
			{
				if (FloatGroup.FloatState != FloatState.Minimized)
				{
					MinimizeFloatGroup();
					Rect restoreBounds = ((Window)this).RestoreBounds;
					if (Manager.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
					{
						restoreBounds.X += ((Window)this).RestoreBounds.Width;
					}
					restoreBounds = TransformToRelativeBounds(restoreBounds);
					DocumentPanel.SetRestoreBounds(FloatGroup, restoreBounds);
				}
				else if (!Win32DragService.IsDragging)
				{
					Rect restoreBounds = TransformFromRelativeBounds(DocumentPanel.GetRestoreBounds(FloatGroup));
					if (restoreBounds.Width == 0.0 || restoreBounds.Height == 0.0)
					{
						return;
					}
					((Window)this).Left = restoreBounds.Left;
					if (Manager.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
					{
						((Window)this).Left -= restoreBounds.Width;
					}
					((Window)this).Top = restoreBounds.Top;
					((FrameworkElement)this).Width = restoreBounds.Width;
					((FrameworkElement)this).Height = restoreBounds.Height;
				}
			}
			if (newValue == WindowState.Normal && FloatGroup.FloatState != FloatState.Normal && !Win32DragService.IsInEvent)
			{
				RestoreFloatGroup();
			}
			if (!LockHelper.IsLocked(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.ParentOpening))
			{
				return;
			}
			((DispatcherObject)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				if (LockHelper.IsLocked(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.ParentOpening))
				{
					LockHelper.Unlock(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.ParentOpening);
					if (oldValue == WindowState.Maximized)
					{
						((Window)this).WindowState = WindowState.Maximized;
					}
				}
			});
		}

		private void OverlapTaskbarChanged(bool newValue)
		{
			((Window)this).WindowStyle = ((!OverlapTaskbar) ? WindowStyle.SingleBorderWindow : WindowStyle.None);
		}

		private void RestoreFloatGroup()
		{
			Manager.MDIController.Restore(FloatGroup.IsMaximizable ? FloatGroup : FloatGroup[0]);
		}

		private void SetWindowSize(Size newSize)
		{
			((FrameworkElement)this).Width = newSize.Width;
			((FrameworkElement)this).Height = newSize.Height;
		}

		private void SubscribeDragWidget()
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = LayoutHelper.FindElement((FrameworkElement)(object)this, (Predicate<FrameworkElement>)((FrameworkElement x) => x is FloatingDragWidget && x.IsVisible));
			if (frameworkElement == null)
			{
				frameworkElement = LayoutHelper.FindElement((FrameworkElement)(object)this, (Predicate<FrameworkElement>)((FrameworkElement x) => DockPane.GetHitTestType(x) == HitTestType.Header));
			}
			if (frameworkElement != null)
			{
				frameworkElement.PreviewMouseDown += OnDragWidgetPreviewMouseDown;
				dragWidgetRef = new WeakReference(frameworkElement);
			}
		}

		private Rect TransformFloatBoundsToWindowBounds(Rect bounds)
		{
			if (transform != null && !transform.Matrix.IsIdentity)
			{
				Point point = transform.Transform(new Point(bounds.Width, bounds.Height));
				bounds.Width = point.X;
				bounds.Height = point.Y;
			}
			return bounds;
		}

		private Rect TransformFromRelativeBounds(Rect rect)
		{
			FrameworkElement owner = ((WindowContentHolder)this).Container.Owner;
			if (owner != null && ScreenHelper.IsAttachedToPresentationSource(owner))
			{
				Point location = owner.PointToScreen(rect.Location);
				rect.Location = location;
			}
			return rect;
		}

		private Rect TransformToRelativeBounds(Rect rect)
		{
			FrameworkElement owner = ((WindowContentHolder)this).Container.Owner;
			if (owner != null && ScreenHelper.IsAttachedToPresentationSource(owner))
			{
				Point location = owner.PointFromScreen(rect.Location);
				rect.Location = location;
			}
			return rect;
		}

		private Rect TransformWindowBoundsToFloatBounds(Rect bounds)
		{
			if (transform != null && !transform.Matrix.IsIdentity)
			{
				GeneralTransform inverse = transform.Inverse;
				Point point = inverse.Transform(new Point(bounds.Width, bounds.Height));
				bounds.Width = point.X;
				bounds.Height = point.Y;
			}
			return bounds;
		}

		private bool TryStartDragging(bool isFloating = false)
		{
			return Win32DragService.TryStartDragging(this, isFloating);
		}

		private void TryStartSizing()
		{
			if (Win32DragService.TryStartSizing(this))
			{
				EnsureRelativeSize();
			}
		}

		private void UnsubscribeDragWidget()
		{
			if (dragWidgetRef != null && dragWidgetRef.Target is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
			{
				frameworkElement.PreviewMouseDown -= OnDragWidgetPreviewMouseDown;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateHeaderSize(Size size)
		{
			if (((Window)this).WindowState == WindowState.Minimized)
			{
				MinimizedFloatGroupsItem minimizedFloatGroupsItem = LayoutTreeHelper.GetVisualChildren((DependencyObject)(object)this).OfType<MinimizedFloatGroupsItem>().FirstOrDefault();
				if (minimizedFloatGroupsItem != null)
				{
					minimizedFloatGroupsItem.Width = size.Width;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateMinMax()
		{
			((DependencyObject)this).ClearValue(FrameworkElement.MinHeightProperty);
			((DependencyObject)this).ClearValue(FrameworkElement.MinWidthProperty);
			((DependencyObject)this).ClearValue(FrameworkElement.MaxHeightProperty);
			((DependencyObject)this).ClearValue(FrameworkElement.MaxWidthProperty);
			Size resizingMinSize = LayoutItemsHelper.GetResizingMinSize(FloatGroup);
			Size resizingMaxSize = LayoutItemsHelper.GetResizingMaxSize(FloatGroup);
			if (!double.IsNaN(resizingMinSize.Height))
			{
				((FrameworkElement)this).MinHeight = resizingMinSize.Height;
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(resizingMinSize.Width))
			{
				((FrameworkElement)this).MinWidth = resizingMinSize.Width;
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(resizingMaxSize.Height))
			{
				((FrameworkElement)this).MaxHeight = resizingMaxSize.Height;
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(resizingMaxSize.Width))
			{
				((FrameworkElement)this).MaxWidth = resizingMaxSize.Width;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateOwnerBindings()
		{
			UpdateOwnerInputBindings();
			UpdateOwnerCommandBindings();
		}

		private void UpdateOwnerCommandBindings()
		{
			if (BindingsOwner != null && InheritOwnerCommandBindings)
			{
				((UIElement)this).CommandBindings.AddRange(BindingsOwner.CommandBindings);
			}
			else
			{
				((UIElement)this).CommandBindings.Clear();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateOwnerInputBindings()
		{
			if (BindingsOwner != null && InheritOwnerInputBindings)
			{
				((UIElement)this).InputBindings.AddRange(BindingsOwner.InputBindings);
			}
			else
			{
				((UIElement)this).InputBindings.Clear();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateResizingMode()
		{
			((Window)this).ResizeMode = ((AllowAeroSnap && AllowNativeDragging) ? ResizeMode.CanResize : ResizeMode.NoResize);
		}

		protected override IntPtr HwndSourceHookHandler(IntPtr hwnd, int msg, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, ref bool handled)
		{
			if (base.interopHelperCore != null && base.interopHelperCore.Handle == hwnd)
			{
				IntPtr result = IntPtr.Zero;
				if (WMHandler.TryHandleMessage(msg, wParam, lParam, ref handled, ref result))
				{
					return result;
				}
			}
			return ((WindowContentHolder)this).HwndSourceHookHandler(hwnd, msg, wParam, lParam, ref handled);
		}

		void IDisposable.Dispose()
		{
			if (!isDisposingCore)
			{
				isDisposingCore = true;
				OnDisposing();
			}
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		private Size MeasureOverriderCore(Size constraint)
		{
			if (((Visual)(object)this).VisualChildrenCount > 0 && ((Visual)(object)this).GetVisualChild(0) is UIElement uIElement)
			{
				Size size = new Size(0.0, 0.0);
				Size availableSize = new Size
				{
					Width = (double.IsPositiveInfinity(constraint.Width) ? double.PositiveInfinity : Math.Max(0.0, constraint.Width - size.Width)),
					Height = (double.IsPositiveInfinity(constraint.Height) ? double.PositiveInfinity : Math.Max(0.0, constraint.Height - size.Height))
				};
				uIElement.Measure(availableSize);
				Size desiredSize = uIElement.DesiredSize;
				Point source = new Point(desiredSize.Width + size.Width, desiredSize.Height + size.Height);
				Point point = RoundPointToScreenPixels(source);
				return new Size(point.X, point.Y);
			}
			return new Size(0.0, 0.0);
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
		{
			WindowMinMax windowMinMax = GetWindowMinMax();
			Point point = ScreenToLogicalPixels(new Point(windowMinMax.minWidth, windowMinMax.minHeight));
			Point point2 = ScreenToLogicalPixels(new Point(windowMinMax.maxWidth, windowMinMax.maxHeight));
			Size constraint = new Size
			{
				Width = Math.Max(point.X, Math.Min(availableSize.Width, point2.X)),
				Height = Math.Max(point.Y, Math.Min(availableSize.Height, point2.Y))
			};
			Size size = MeasureOverriderCore(constraint);
			return new Size(Math.Max(size.Width, windowMinMax.minWidth), Math.Max(size.Height, windowMinMax.minHeight));
		}

		protected WindowMinMax GetWindowMinMax()
		{
			WindowMinMax result = default(WindowMinMax);
			Point point = new Point((double)GetField("_trackMaxWidthDeviceUnits"), (double)GetField("_trackMaxHeightDeviceUnits"));
			Point point2 = new Point((double)GetField("_trackMinWidthDeviceUnits"), (double)GetField("_trackMinHeightDeviceUnits"));
			result.minWidth = Math.Max(((FrameworkElement)this).MinWidth, point2.X);
			if (((FrameworkElement)this).MinWidth > ((FrameworkElement)this).MaxWidth)
			{
				result.maxWidth = Math.Min(((FrameworkElement)this).MinWidth, point.X);
			}
			else if (!double.IsPositiveInfinity(((FrameworkElement)this).MaxWidth))
			{
				result.maxWidth = Math.Min(((FrameworkElement)this).MaxWidth, point.X);
			}
			else
			{
				result.maxWidth = point.X;
			}
			result.minHeight = Math.Max(((FrameworkElement)this).MinHeight, point2.Y);
			if (((FrameworkElement)this).MinHeight > ((FrameworkElement)this).MaxHeight)
			{
				result.maxHeight = Math.Min(((FrameworkElement)this).MinHeight, point.Y);
				return result;
			}
			if (!double.IsPositiveInfinity(((FrameworkElement)this).MaxHeight))
			{
				result.maxHeight = Math.Min(((FrameworkElement)this).MaxHeight, point.Y);
				return result;
			}
			result.maxHeight = point.Y;
			Point source = new Point(result.minWidth, result.minHeight);
			Point source2 = new Point(result.maxWidth, result.maxHeight);
			source = RoundPointToScreenPixels(source);
			source2 = RoundPointToScreenPixels(source2);
			result.maxHeight = source2.Y;
			result.maxWidth = source2.X;
			result.minHeight = source.Y;
			result.minWidth = source.X;
			return result;
		}

		protected Point ScreenToLogicalPixels(Point point)
		{
			return GetHwndTarget()?.TransformFromDevice.Transform(point) ?? point;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		protected HwndTarget GetHwndTarget()
		{
			PresentationSource presentationSource = PresentationSource.FromVisual((Visual)(object)this);
			if (presentationSource != null)
			{
				return presentationSource.CompositionTarget as HwndTarget;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private double Round(double source)
		{
			return Math.Round(source + 0.5);
		}

		private Point RoundPoint(Point source)
		{
			return new Point(Round(source.X), Round(source.Y));
		}

		private Point RoundPointToScreenPixels(Point source)
		{
			Point source2 = LogicalPixelsToScreen(source);
			source2 = RoundPoint(source2);
			return ScreenToLogicalPixels(source2);
		}

		protected Point LogicalPixelsToScreen(Point point)
		{
			return GetHwndTarget()?.TransformToDevice.Transform(point) ?? point;
		}

		protected object GetField(string fieldName)
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(Window);
			return GetField(fieldName, typeFromHandle);
		}

		protected object GetField(string fieldName, Type type)
		{
			FieldInfo field = type.GetField(fieldName, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
			if (!(field != null))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return field.GetValue(this);
		}
	}
	internal class FloatingWindowLock
	{
		public enum LockerKey
		{
			WindowState,
			FloatingBounds,
			Maximize,
			Minimize,
			NativeBounds,
			RestoreBounds,
			ParentOpening,
			CheckFloatBounds,
			ThemeChanging,
			Focus,
			Restore,
			ResetMaximized
		}

		private Dictionary<LockerKey, LockHelper> lockers = new Dictionary<LockerKey, LockHelper>();

		public IDisposable Lock(LockerKey key)
		{
			return GetLocker(key).Lock();
		}

		public IDisposable LockOnce(LockerKey key)
		{
			return GetLocker(key).LockOnce();
		}

		public void Unlock(LockerKey key)
		{
			GetLocker(key).Unlock();
		}

		public bool IsLocked(LockerKey key)
		{
			return GetLocker(key);
		}

		public LockHelper GetLocker(LockerKey key)
		{
			if (!lockers.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
			{
				value = new LockHelper();
				lockers[key] = value;
			}
			return value;
		}
	}
	internal interface IDraggableWindow
	{
		FloatGroup FloatGroup { get; }

		bool IsDragging { get; set; }

		DockLayoutManager Manager { get; }

		bool SuspendDragging { get; set; }

		Window Window { get; }
	}
	internal class Win32DragService : DispatcherObject
	{
		private class DragOperation : IDisposable
		{
			public FloatGroup FloatGroup { get; private set; }

			public bool IsDisposing { get; private set; }

			public DockLayoutManager Manager { get; private set; }

			public IDraggableWindow Window { get; private set; }

			public DragOperation(IDraggableWindow window)
			{
				Window = window;
				FloatGroup = Window.FloatGroup;
				Manager = Window.Manager;
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				if (!IsDisposing)
				{
					IsDisposing = true;
					Manager = null;
					FloatGroup = null;
					Window = null;
				}
				GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
			}
		}

		private class OverrideCursor : IDisposable
		{
			public OverrideCursor(Cursor cursor)
			{
				if (Mouse.OverrideCursor != cursor)
				{
					Mouse.OverrideCursor = cursor;
				}
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(DisposeCore), DispatcherPriority.Input);
			}

			private void DisposeCore()
			{
				Mouse.OverrideCursor = null;
			}
		}

		private DragOperation dragOperation;

		private bool tryToSuspendDragging;

		private IDraggableWindow windowToDrag;

		public bool IsDragging { get; private set; }

		public bool IsInEvent
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsDragging)
				{
					return IsResizing;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public bool IsResizing { get; private set; }

		public SizingAction SizingAction { get; internal set; }

		private bool SuspendBehingDragging { get; set; }

		public void DoDragging()
		{
			if (IsDragging)
			{
				if (tryToSuspendDragging)
				{
					IDraggableWindow window = dragOperation.Window;
					bool suspendDragging = (SuspendBehingDragging = CanSuspendDragging(dragOperation.Window));
					window.SuspendDragging = suspendDragging;
					tryToSuspendDragging = false;
				}
				FloatingView floatingView = dragOperation.Window.Manager.GetView(dragOperation.Window.FloatGroup) as FloatingView;
				if (!SuspendBehingDragging && floatingView != null)
				{
					MouseButtons buttons = MouseButtons.Left;
					Point mousePositionSafe = NativeHelper.GetMousePositionSafe();
					mousePositionSafe = floatingView.RootUIElement.PointFromScreen(mousePositionSafe);
					DevExpress.Xpf.Layout.Core.Platform.MouseEventArgs ea = new DevExpress.Xpf.Layout.Core.Platform.MouseEventArgs(mousePositionSafe, buttons);
					floatingView.OnMouseMove(ea);
				}
			}
		}

		public void DoSizing()
		{
			if (IsResizing && dragOperation.Window.Manager.GetView(dragOperation.Window.FloatGroup) is FloatingView floatingView)
			{
				MouseButtons buttons = MouseButtons.Left;
				Point mousePositionSafe = NativeHelper.GetMousePositionSafe();
				mousePositionSafe = floatingView.RootUIElement.PointFromScreen(mousePositionSafe);
				DevExpress.Xpf.Layout.Core.Platform.MouseEventArgs ea = new DevExpress.Xpf.Layout.Core.Platform.MouseEventArgs(mousePositionSafe, buttons);
				floatingView.OnMouseMove(ea);
			}
		}

		public void FinishDragging()
		{
			if (IsDragging || IsResizing)
			{
				if (Mouse.LeftButton != MouseButtonState.Released)
				{
					base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(FinishDragging), DispatcherPriority.Input);
				}
				else
				{
					base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(FinishDraggingCore));
				}
			}
		}

		internal void CancelDragging()
		{
			windowToDrag = null;
		}

		internal void EnqueueDragging(IDraggableWindow window)
		{
			windowToDrag = window;
		}

		internal void ReleaseCapture()
		{
			if (!IsDragging && !IsResizing)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool isDragging = (IsResizing = false);
			IsDragging = isDragging;
			if (dragOperation != null)
			{
				dragOperation.Window.IsDragging = false;
				if (dragOperation.Window.Manager.GetView(dragOperation.Window.FloatGroup) is FloatingView floatingView)
				{
					floatingView.OnMouseCaptureLost();
					Ref.Dispose(ref dragOperation);
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool TryStartDragging(IDraggableWindow window, bool isFloating)
		{
			if (window == null || IsInEvent)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Mouse.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed)
			{
				if (!CanDrag(window))
				{
					return false;
				}
				dragOperation = new DragOperation(window);
				DockLayoutManager manager = window.Manager;
				if (!(manager.GetView(window.FloatGroup) is FloatingView floatingView))
				{
					return false;
				}
				floatingView.ReleaseCapture();
				bool isDragging = (IsDragging = true);
				window.IsDragging = isDragging;
				tryToSuspendDragging = true;
				if (isFloating)
				{
					Matrix transformFromDevice = PresentationSource.FromVisual(manager).CompositionTarget.TransformFromDevice;
					Point point = transformFromDevice.Transform(window.Window.PointToScreen(Mouse.GetPosition(window.Window)));
					Point dragOrigin = manager.ViewAdapter.DragService.DragOrigin;
					if (double.IsNaN(dragOrigin.X) || double.IsNaN(dragOrigin.Y))
					{
						window.Window.Left = point.X - 15.0;
						window.Window.Top = point.Y - 15.0;
					}
					else
					{
						Point point2 = transformFromDevice.Transform(manager.PointToScreen(dragOrigin));
						Point dragOffset = manager.GetDragOffset();
						double num = point.X - point2.X + dragOffset.X;
						double num2 = point.Y - point2.Y + dragOffset.Y;
						window.Window.Left += num;
						window.Window.Top += num2;
					}
				}
				manager.StartNativeDragging();
				using (new OverrideCursor(Cursors.Arrow))
				{
					IntPtr handle = new WindowInteropHelper(window.Window).Handle;
					Win32.SendMessage(handle, 274, 61458, IntPtr.Zero);
					Win32.SendMessage(handle, 514, 0, IntPtr.Zero);
				}
				manager.CompleteNativeDragging();
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool TryStartDragging(bool isFloating = true)
		{
			try
			{
				return windowToDrag != null && TryStartDragging(windowToDrag, isFloating);
			}
			finally
			{
				windowToDrag = null;
			}
		}

		internal bool TryStartSizing(IDraggableWindow floatingPaneWindow)
		{
			if (IsInEvent)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Mouse.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed && floatingPaneWindow.Manager.ViewAdapter.DragService.OperationType == OperationType.FloatingResizing)
			{
				if (!(floatingPaneWindow.Manager.GetView(floatingPaneWindow.FloatGroup) is FloatingView floatingView) || floatingView != floatingPaneWindow.Manager.ViewAdapter.DragService.DragSource)
				{
					return false;
				}
				dragOperation = new DragOperation(floatingPaneWindow);
				if (Mouse.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed)
				{
					IsResizing = true;
					floatingView.ReleaseCapture();
					using (new OverrideCursor(SizingAction.ToCursor()))
					{
						floatingPaneWindow.Window.DragSize(SizingAction);
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool CanDrag(IDraggableWindow window)
		{
			return window.Manager.ViewAdapter.DragService.DragItem != null;
		}

		private bool CanSuspendDragging(IDraggableWindow window)
		{
			if (window.Manager.GetViewElement(window.FloatGroup.GetUIElement<FloatPanePresenter>()) is IDockLayoutElement dockLayoutElement)
			{
				BaseLayoutItem item = dockLayoutElement.CheckDragElement().Item;
				return window.Manager.RaiseDockOperationStartingEvent(DockOperation.Move, item);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void FinishDraggingCore()
		{
			if ((IsDragging || IsResizing) && dragOperation != null && Mouse.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Released)
			{
				dragOperation.Window.IsDragging = false;
				bool isDragging = (IsResizing = false);
				IsDragging = isDragging;
				if (dragOperation.Window.Manager.GetView(dragOperation.Window.FloatGroup) is FloatingView floatingView)
				{
					MouseButtons buttons = MouseButtons.None;
					Point mousePositionSafe = NativeHelper.GetMousePositionSafe();
					mousePositionSafe = floatingView.RootUIElement.PointFromScreen(mousePositionSafe);
					DevExpress.Xpf.Layout.Core.Platform.MouseEventArgs ea = new DevExpress.Xpf.Layout.Core.Platform.MouseEventArgs(mousePositionSafe, buttons, MouseButtons.Left);
					floatingView.OnMouseUp(ea);
					Ref.Dispose(ref dragOperation);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class FloatingPaneAdornerElement : Decorator, IFloatingPane, ISupportAutoSize
	{
		public DockLayoutManager Manager { get; private set; }

		public FloatGroup FloatGroup { get; private set; }

		public SizeToContent SizeToContent => FloatGroup.Return((FloatGroup x) => x.SizeToContent, () => SizeToContent.Manual);

		DockLayoutManager IFloatingPane.Manager => Manager;

		FloatGroup IFloatingPane.FloatGroup => FloatGroup;

		bool ISupportAutoSize.IsAutoSize => SizeToContent != SizeToContent.Manual;

		private static Size GetConstraintSize(SizeToContent sizeToContent, Size bounds)
		{
			Size result = bounds;
			switch (sizeToContent)
			{
			case SizeToContent.Height:
				result.Height = double.PositiveInfinity;
				break;
			case SizeToContent.Width:
				result.Width = double.PositiveInfinity;
				break;
			case SizeToContent.WidthAndHeight:
				result = SizeHelper.Infinite;
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static Size GetAutoSize(SizeToContent sizeToContent, Size bounds, Size desiredSize)
		{
			Size result = bounds;
			switch (sizeToContent)
			{
			case SizeToContent.Height:
				result.Height = desiredSize.Height;
				break;
			case SizeToContent.Width:
				result.Width = desiredSize.Width;
				break;
			case SizeToContent.WidthAndHeight:
				result = desiredSize;
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public FloatingPaneAdornerElement(BaseFloatingContainer container)
		{
			FloatGroup = DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem((DependencyObject)(object)container) as FloatGroup;
			Manager = DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager((DependencyObject)(object)container);
			WindowHelper.BindFlowDirection(this, Manager);
			base.UseLayoutRounding = true;
			FloatGroup.Forward(this, UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, "IsEnabled");
		}

		public void EnsureFlowDirection()
		{
			WindowHelper.BindFlowDirectionIfNeeded(this, Manager);
		}

		private Size MeasureAutoSize(Size availableSize)
		{
			Size constraintSize = GetConstraintSize(SizeToContent, availableSize);
			Measure(constraintSize);
			Size desiredSize = MathHelper.MeasureMinSize(new Size[2] { base.DesiredSize, FloatGroup.ActualMinSize });
			Size autoSize = GetAutoSize(SizeToContent, availableSize, desiredSize);
			FloatGroup.UpdateAutoFloatingSize(autoSize);
			return autoSize;
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new FloatingPaneAdornerElementAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		Size ISupportAutoSize.FitToContent(Size availableSize)
		{
			return MeasureAutoSize(availableSize);
		}
	}
	public class HwndHostEventAccumulator : IHwndHostEventListener
	{
		[ThreadStatic]
		private static HwndHostEventAccumulator instance;

		private bool hasListeners;

		private WeakList<DockLayoutManager> listeners;

		private bool HasListeners
		{
			get
			{
				return hasListeners;
			}
			set
			{
				if (hasListeners != value)
				{
					hasListeners = value;
					OnHasListenersChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public static void Register(DockLayoutManager listener)
		{
			if (instance == null)
			{
				instance = new HwndHostEventAccumulator();
			}
			instance.RegisterCore(listener);
		}

		public static void Unregister(DockLayoutManager listener)
		{
			instance?.UnregisterCore(listener);
		}

		private void OnHasListenersChanged()
		{
			if (HasListeners)
			{
				HwndHostEventProvider.Register((IHwndHostEventListener)(object)this);
			}
			else
			{
				HwndHostEventProvider.Unregister((IHwndHostEventListener)(object)this);
			}
		}

		private void OnMouseDown(DependencyObject hwndHost, MouseButtonEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			if (listeners == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Point pos = NativeHelper.GetMousePositionSafe();
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = LayoutHelper.FindLayoutOrVisualParentObject(hwndHost, (Predicate<DependencyObject>)((DependencyObject x) => DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(x) != null && DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager(x) != null), true, (DependencyObject)null);
			if (dependencyObject != null)
			{
				DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager(dependencyObject);
				if (listeners.Contains(dockLayoutManager))
				{
					BaseLayoutItem layoutItem = DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(dependencyObject);
					if (dockLayoutManager.GetView(layoutItem.GetRoot()) is LayoutView layoutView)
					{
						DevExpress.Xpf.Layout.Core.Platform.MouseEventArgs ea = new DevExpress.Xpf.Layout.Core.Platform.MouseEventArgs(layoutView.RootUIElement.PointFromScreen(pos), EventArgsHelper.GetChangedButtons(eventArgs));
						layoutView.OnMouseEvent(MouseEventType.MouseDown, ea);
					}
				}
			}
			Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				((IEnumerable<DockLayoutManager>)listeners).ForEach(delegate(DockLayoutManager x)
				{
					x.ForceCollapseByMouseCheck(pos);
				});
			}, DispatcherPriority.Input);
		}

		void IHwndHostEventListener.OnMouseDown(DependencyObject hwndHost, MouseButtonEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			if (!(hwndHost is AutoHideWindowHost))
			{
				OnMouseDown(hwndHost, eventArgs);
			}
		}

		private void RegisterCore(DockLayoutManager listener)
		{
			if (listeners == null)
			{
				listeners = new WeakList<DockLayoutManager>();
			}
			listeners.Add(listener);
			HasListeners = ((IEnumerable<DockLayoutManager>)listeners).Any();
		}

		private void UnregisterCore(DockLayoutManager listener)
		{
			if (listeners == null)
			{
				listeners = new WeakList<DockLayoutManager>();
			}
			listeners.Remove(listener);
			HasListeners = ((IEnumerable<DockLayoutManager>)listeners).Any();
		}
	}
	internal static class VirtualDesktopHelper
	{
		private static readonly IVirtualDesktopManager manager;

		static VirtualDesktopHelper()
		{
			if (WindowsVersionProvider.IsWindows10 || WindowsVersionProvider.IsWindows11)
			{
				try
				{
					manager = (IVirtualDesktopManager)new ComVirtualDesktopManager();
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static bool IsWindowOnCurrentVirtualDesktop(Window window)
		{
			if (!DockLayoutManager.SupportVirtualDesktops || manager == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			IntPtr handle = ((HwndSource)PresentationSource.FromVisual(window)).Handle;
			if (manager.IsWindowOnCurrentVirtualDesktop(handle, out var OnCurrentDesktop) != 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return OnCurrentDesktop != 0;
		}
	}

	internal abstract class BaseResizingPreviewHelper : IResizingPreviewHelper
	{
		private LayoutView viewCore;

		protected Rect InitialBounds;

		private UIElement resizer;

		public LayoutView View => viewCore;

		public DockLayoutManager Owner => View.Container;

		protected virtual FloatingMode Mode => Owner.GetRealFloatingMode();

		protected ILayoutElement Element { get; private set; }

		protected Point StartPoint { get; private set; }

		public Size MinSize { get; set; }

		public Size MaxSize { get; set; }

		public BoundsHelper BoundsHelper { get; set; }

		protected UIElement Resizer
		{
			get
			{
				if (resizer == null)
				{
					resizer = GetUIElement();
				}
				return resizer;
			}
		}

		public BaseResizingPreviewHelper(LayoutView view)
		{
			viewCore = view;
		}

		private void ForceUpdateElementBounds(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			element.Invalidate();
			element.EnsureBounds();
		}

		protected internal Rect GetItemBounds(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				ForceUpdateElementBounds(element);
				return ElementHelper.GetRect(element);
			}
			return Rect.Empty;
		}

		public void InitResizing(Point start, ILayoutElement element)
		{
			Element = element;
			StartPoint = start;
			OnInitResizing();
		}

		public void Resize(Point change)
		{
			OnResizing(change);
		}

		public void EndResizing()
		{
			OnEndResizing();
		}

		protected abstract UIElement GetUIElement();

		protected virtual void OnInitResizing()
		{
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0059: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (BoundsHelper == null)
			{
				BoundsHelper = new BoundsHelper(View, Element, MinSize);
			}
			InitialBounds = (((int)Mode == 0) ? GetInitialAdornerBounds() : GetInitialWindowBounds());
			View.ResizingWindowHelper.ShowResizeWindow(Resizer, InitialBounds, Mode);
		}

		protected virtual void OnResizing(Point change)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Rect bounds = (((int)Mode == 0) ? GetAdornerBounds(change) : GetWindowBounds(change));
			View.ResizingWindowHelper.UpdateResizeWindow(bounds);
		}

		protected virtual void OnEndResizing()
		{
			View.ResizingWindowHelper.HideResizeWindow();
		}

		protected virtual Rect GetInitialAdornerBounds()
		{
			return Rect.Empty;
		}

		protected virtual Rect GetInitialWindowBounds()
		{
			return Rect.Empty;
		}

		protected virtual Rect GetAdornerBounds(Point change)
		{
			return Rect.Empty;
		}

		protected virtual Rect GetWindowBounds(Point change)
		{
			return Rect.Empty;
		}

		protected Rect CorrectBounds(Rect bounds1)
		{
			PresentationSource presentationSource = PresentationSource.FromDependencyObject(Owner);
			Point location = bounds1.Location;
			if (presentationSource != null)
			{
				location = Owner.PointToScreen(bounds1.Location);
				bounds1 = new Rect(presentationSource.CompositionTarget.TransformFromDevice.Transform(location), bounds1.Size);
			}
			else
			{
				bounds1 = new Rect(location, bounds1.Size);
			}
			return bounds1;
		}
	}

	internal class AutoHideResizingPreviewHelper : BaseResizingPreviewHelper
	{
		private Dock Dock => AutoHidePaneElement.DockType;

		private AutoHidePaneElement AutoHidePaneElement => base.Element as AutoHidePaneElement;

		protected override FloatingMode Mode
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (!base.Owner.EnableWin32Compatibility)
				{
					return base.Mode;
				}
				return (FloatingMode)1;
			}
		}

		public AutoHideResizingPreviewHelper(LayoutView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		protected override Rect GetInitialAdornerBounds()
		{
			return GetItemBounds(base.Element);
		}

		protected override Rect GetAdornerBounds(Point change)
		{
			change = new Point(change.X - base.StartPoint.X, change.Y - base.StartPoint.Y);
			Rect result = new Rect(RectHelper.TopLeft(InitialBounds), RectHelper.BottomRight(InitialBounds));
			if (!result.IsEmpty)
			{
				switch (Dock)
				{
				case Dock.Left:
					result.Width += change.X;
					break;
				case Dock.Right:
					RectHelper.SetLeft(ref result, result.Left + change.X);
					break;
				case Dock.Top:
					result.Height += change.Y;
					break;
				case Dock.Bottom:
					RectHelper.SetTop(ref result, result.Top + change.Y);
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override Rect GetWindowBounds(Point change)
		{
			Point screenPoint = base.View.ClientToScreen(change);
			return CorrectBounds(base.BoundsHelper.CalcBounds(screenPoint));
		}

		protected override Rect GetInitialWindowBounds()
		{
			Point screenPoint = base.View.ClientToScreen(base.StartPoint);
			return CorrectBounds(base.BoundsHelper.CalcBounds(screenPoint));
		}

		protected override UIElement GetUIElement()
		{
			return new AutoHideResizePointer
			{
				Dock = Dock
			};
		}
	}

	internal class ResizingOverlayWindow : Window, IDisposable
	{
		private DockLayoutManager manager;

		private MatrixTransform transform;

		private bool isDisposingCore;

		public ResizingOverlayWindow(UIElement container)
		{
			base.ResizeMode = ResizeMode.NoResize;
			base.WindowStyle = WindowStyle.None;
			base.ShowInTaskbar = false;
			base.AllowsTransparency = true;
			base.Background = null;
			base.ShowActivated = false;
			base.IsHitTestVisible = false;
			Window window = WindowServiceHelper.GetWindow(container);
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = window;
			manager = DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager(container);
			if (manager.OwnsFloatWindows)
			{
				base.Owner = window;
			}
			if (frameworkElement == null || !manager.IsDescendantOf(frameworkElement))
			{
				frameworkElement = LayoutHelper.GetTopLevelVisual((DependencyObject)manager);
			}
			if (frameworkElement != null)
			{
				transform = manager.TransformToVisual(frameworkElement) as MatrixTransform;
				if (transform != null && !transform.Matrix.IsIdentity)
				{
					Matrix matrix = transform.Matrix;
					transform = new MatrixTransform(Math.Abs(matrix.M11), matrix.M12, matrix.M21, Math.Abs(matrix.M22), 0.0, 0.0);
				}
			}
			ContentControlHelper.SetContentIsNotLogical((ContentControl)this, true);
		}

		public ResizingOverlayWindow()
		{
			base.ResizeMode = ResizeMode.NoResize;
			base.WindowStyle = WindowStyle.None;
			base.ShowInTaskbar = false;
			base.AllowsTransparency = true;
			base.Background = null;
			base.ShowActivated = false;
			base.IsHitTestVisible = false;
		}

		public void UpdateBounds(Rect bounds)
		{
			PresentationSource presentationSource = PresentationSource.FromVisual(this);
			if (presentationSource != null)
			{
				bounds.Transform(PresentationSource.FromVisual(this).CompositionTarget.TransformToDevice);
			}
			if (transform != null && !transform.Matrix.IsIdentity)
			{
				Point point = transform.Transform(new Point(bounds.Width, bounds.Height));
				bounds.Width = point.X;
				bounds.Height = point.Y;
			}
			if (PresentationSource.FromVisual(this) is HwndSource hwndSource)
			{
				NativeHelper.SetWindowPosSafe(hwndSource.Handle, IntPtr.Zero, (int)bounds.X, (int)bounds.Y, (int)bounds.Width, (int)bounds.Height, 84);
				return;
			}
			base.Left = bounds.X;
			base.Top = bounds.Y;
			base.Width = bounds.Width;
			base.Height = bounds.Height;
		}

		internal void ShowContentInBounds(UIElement element, Rect bounds)
		{
			base.Content = element;
			UpdateBounds(bounds);
			Show();
		}

		protected override void OnContentChanged(object oldContent, object newContent)
		{
			base.OnContentChanged(oldContent, newContent);
			(oldContent as UIElement).Do(delegate(UIElement x)
			{
				manager.DockHintsContainer.Remove(x);
			});
			(newContent as UIElement).Do(delegate(UIElement x)
			{
				manager.DockHintsContainer.Add(x);
			});
		}

		void IDisposable.Dispose()
		{
			if (!isDisposingCore)
			{
				isDisposingCore = true;
				base.Content = null;
				Close();
			}
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}
	}
	public class ResizingWindowHelper : IDisposable
	{
		private UIElement Container;

		private ResizingOverlayWindow windowCore;

		private bool isDisposing;

		private FloatingMode Mode;

		private ShadowResizeAdorner Adorner;

		private int windowShowCount;

		public LayoutView View { get; private set; }

		private ResizingOverlayWindow Window
		{
			get
			{
				if (windowCore == null)
				{
					windowCore = new ResizingOverlayWindow(Container);
				}
				return windowCore;
			}
		}

		private bool windowShown => windowShowCount > 0;

		public ResizingWindowHelper(LayoutView view)
		{
			View = view;
			Container = View.Container;
		}

		private void UpdateWindowBounds(Rect bounds)
		{
			Window.UpdateBounds(bounds);
		}

		private void ShowResizeOverlayWindow(UIElement content, Rect initialBounds, UIElement owner)
		{
			Window.ShowContentInBounds(content, initialBounds);
			windowShowCount++;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (!isDisposing)
			{
				isDisposing = true;
				Container = null;
				Ref.Dispose(ref windowCore);
			}
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		public void ShowResizeWindow(UIElement Resizer, Rect InitialBounds, FloatingMode mode)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Mode = mode;
			if ((int)Mode == 0)
			{
				if (View != null)
				{
					View.AdornerHelper.TryShowAdornerWindow(forceUpdateAdornerBounds: true);
					Adorner = View.AdornerHelper.GetShadowResizeAdorner();
					if (Adorner != null)
					{
						Adorner.StartResizing(Resizer, InitialBounds);
						((BaseSurfacedAdorner)Adorner).Update(true);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ShowResizeOverlayWindow(Resizer, InitialBounds, View.Container);
			}
		}

		public void HideResizeWindow()

		}

		public static Rect CheckScreenBounds(DockLayoutManager manager, Rect screenBounds)
		{
			if (manager == null)
			{
				return screenBounds;
			}
			Rect workingArea = GetWorkingArea(manager, screenBounds);
			Rect rect = screenBounds;
			if (manager.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
			{
				rect = new Rect(0.0 - rect.X - rect.Width, rect.Y, rect.Width, rect.Height);
			}
			if (!IsZero(workingArea))
			{
				bool flag = workingArea.IntersectsWith(rect);
				if (!flag || GetWorkingArea(manager, new Rect(screenBounds.Location, default(Size))).Top > rect.Top + 12.0)
				{
					if (!flag)
					{
						workingArea = GetWorkingArea(manager, new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0));
					}
					double x = Math.Min(Math.Max(workingArea.Left, rect.Left), Math.Max(workingArea.Left, workingArea.Right - screenBounds.Width));
					double y = Math.Min(Math.Max(screenBounds.Top, workingArea.Top), Math.Max(workingArea.Top, workingArea.Bottom - screenBounds.Height));
					screenBounds = new Rect(x, y, screenBounds.Width, screenBounds.Height);
					if (manager.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
					{
						screenBounds = new Rect(0.0 - screenBounds.X - rect.Width, screenBounds.Y, rect.Width, rect.Height);
					}
				}
			}
			return screenBounds;
		}

		private static bool IsZero(Rect r)
		{
			return r == new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
		}

		private static Rect GetWorkingArea(DockLayoutManager manager, Rect screenBounds, bool checkAeroMode)
		{

			if (!checkAeroMode || (int)manager.GetRealFloatingMode() != 0)

		}

		private static Rect GetAdornerWorkingArea(DockLayoutManager manager, bool checkAeroMode)
		{
			if (!checkAeroMode)
			{
				return GetAdornerWorkingArea(manager);
			}
			UIElement topContainerWithAdornerLayer = LayoutHelper.GetTopContainerWithAdornerLayer((UIElement)manager);
			if (topContainerWithAdornerLayer != null)
			{
				Point location = topContainerWithAdornerLayer.TranslatePoint(CoordinateHelper.ZeroPoint, manager);
				Rect rect = new Rect(location, topContainerWithAdornerLayer.RenderSize);
				Window window = WindowServiceHelper.GetWindow(manager);
				DXWindow val = (DXWindow)(object)((window is DXWindow) ? window : null);
				if (val != null && val.IsAeroMode)
				{
					Rect clientArea = val.ClientArea;
					location = topContainerWithAdornerLayer.TranslatePoint(clientArea.Location, manager);
					rect = new Rect(location, clientArea.Size);
				}
				if (topContainerWithAdornerLayer.TransformToVisual(manager) is MatrixTransform { Matrix: { IsIdentity: false }, Matrix: var matrix2 })
				{
					MatrixTransform matrixTransform2 = new MatrixTransform(Math.Abs(matrix2.M11), matrix2.M12, matrix2.M21, Math.Abs(matrix2.M22), 0.0, 0.0);
					if (!matrixTransform2.Matrix.IsIdentity)
					{
						rect = matrixTransform2.TransformBounds(rect);
						rect.Location = location;
					}
				}
				if (FrameworkElement.GetFlowDirection(topContainerWithAdornerLayer) != manager.FlowDirection)
				{
					rect.X -= rect.Width;
				}
				return rect;
			}
			return new Rect(CoordinateHelper.ZeroPoint, manager.RenderSize);
		}

		private static Rect GetWorkingArea(DockLayoutManager manager, Rect screenBounds)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)manager.GetRealFloatingMode() != 0)
			{
				return GetScreenWorkingArea(manager, screenBounds);
			}
			return GetAdornerWorkingArea(manager);
		}

		private static Rect GetAdornerWorkingArea(DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			UIElement topContainerWithAdornerLayer = LayoutHelper.GetTopContainerWithAdornerLayer((UIElement)manager);
			if (topContainerWithAdornerLayer != null)
			{
				Point location = topContainerWithAdornerLayer.TranslatePoint(CoordinateHelper.ZeroPoint, manager);
				if (FrameworkElement.GetFlowDirection(topContainerWithAdornerLayer) != manager.FlowDirection)
				{
					location.X -= topContainerWithAdornerLayer.RenderSize.Width;
				}
				return new Rect(location, topContainerWithAdornerLayer.RenderSize);
			}
			return new Rect(CoordinateHelper.ZeroPoint, manager.RenderSize);
		}

		private static Rect GetScreenWorkingArea(DockLayoutManager manager, Rect restoreBounds)
		{
			int num = ((manager.FlowDirection != FlowDirection.RightToLeft) ? 1 : (-1));
			Point point = manager.PointToScreen(CoordinateHelper.ZeroPoint);
			Rect rect = new Rect(GetDisplayMatrix(manager, inverse: true).Transform(restoreBounds.Location), restoreBounds.Size);
			if (manager.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
			{
				rect.X = 0.0 - rect.X - rect.Width;
			}
			rect = Rect.Offset(rect, point.X, point.Y);
			Rect workingArea = GetWorkingArea(rect);
			Point point2 = manager.PointFromScreen(workingArea.Location);
			point2 = new Point((double)num * point2.X, point2.Y);
			return new Rect(point2, (Size)GetDisplayMatrix(manager).Transform((Vector)workingArea.Size));
		}

		private static Matrix GetDisplayMatrix(UIElement element, bool inverse = false)
		{
			PresentationSource presentationSource = PresentationSource.FromVisual(element);
			if (presentationSource != null)
			{
				if (!inverse)
				{
					return presentationSource.CompositionTarget.TransformFromDevice;
				}
				return presentationSource.CompositionTarget.TransformToDevice;
			}
			return Matrix.Identity;
		}

		public static Rect GetAvailableAdornerRect(DockLayoutManager container, Rect bounds)
		{
			UIElement topContainerWithAdornerLayer = LayoutHelper.GetTopContainerWithAdornerLayer((UIElement)container);
			if (topContainerWithAdornerLayer == null)
			{
				return bounds;
			}
			Size renderSize = topContainerWithAdornerLayer.RenderSize;
			Point location = topContainerWithAdornerLayer.TranslatePoint(ZeroPoint, container);
			Rect rect = new Rect(location, renderSize);
			Window window = WindowServiceHelper.GetWindow(container);
			DXWindow val = (DXWindow)(object)((window is DXWindow) ? window : null);
			if (val != null && val.IsAeroMode)
			{
				Rect clientArea = val.ClientArea;
				location = topContainerWithAdornerLayer.TranslatePoint(clientArea.Location, container);
				renderSize = clientArea.Size;
				rect = new Rect(location, renderSize);
			}
			if (topContainerWithAdornerLayer.TransformToVisual(container) is MatrixTransform { Matrix: { IsIdentity: false }, Matrix: var matrix2 })
			{
				MatrixTransform matrixTransform2 = new MatrixTransform(Math.Abs(matrix2.M11), matrix2.M12, matrix2.M21, Math.Abs(matrix2.M22), 0.0, 0.0);
				if (!matrixTransform2.Matrix.IsIdentity)
				{
					rect = matrixTransform2.TransformBounds(rect);
					rect.Location = location;
				}
			}
			if (((FrameworkElement)topContainerWithAdornerLayer).FlowDirection != container.FlowDirection)
			{
				rect.X -= rect.Width;
			}
			return rect;
		}

	public static class VisualOrderHelper
	{
		public static int GetVisualOrder(this UIElement element, DockLayoutManager container)
		{
			int num = -1;
			using (IUIElementEnumerator iUIElementEnumerator = new IUIElementEnumerator(container))
			{
				while (iUIElementEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					num++;
					if (iUIElementEnumerator.Current == element)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (num != -1)
			{
				if (element is LayoutGroup)
				{
					num += 100000;
				}
				if (element is AutoHideTray)
				{
					num += 200000;
				}
				if (element is FloatPanePresenter)
				{
					FloatingPaneWindow floatingWindow = (element as FloatingWindowPresenter).With((FloatingWindowPresenter x) => x.Window);
					if (floatingWindow == null)
					{
						num += 300000;
					}
					else
					{
						IEnumerable<Window> enumerable2;
						if (Application.Current == null)
						{
							IEnumerable<Window> enumerable = (IEnumerable<Window>)(object)new FloatingPaneWindow[1] { floatingWindow };
							enumerable2 = enumerable;
						}
						else
						{
							enumerable2 = NativeHelper.SortWindowsTopToBottom(container.GetAffectedWindows());
						}
						IEnumerable<Window> source = enumerable2;
						Window mainWindow = WindowServiceHelper.GetWindow(container);
						Window window = source.FirstOrDefault((Window x) => x == mainWindow || (object)x == floatingWindow);
						if ((object)window == floatingWindow)
						{
							num += 300000;
						}
					}
				}
				if (element is CustomizationControl)
				{
					num += 400000;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public static void BringToFront(this FloatPanePresenter pane, DockLayoutManager container)
		{
			if (pane != null && container != null)
			{
				Panel floatingRoot = GetFloatingRoot(pane);
				if (floatingRoot != null)
				{
					UIElement floatingRootChild = GetFloatingRootChild(pane);
					UIElement[] children = GetChildren(floatingRoot);
					UpdateVisualOrder(floatingRootChild, children);
					((IUIElement)container).Children.MakeLast(pane);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void UpdateVisualOrder(UIElement topChild, UIElement[] children)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < children.Length; i++)
			{
				if (topChild != children[i])
				{
					Panel.SetZIndex(children[i], i);
				}
			}
			Panel.SetZIndex(topChild, children.Length + 1);
		}

		private static UIElement[] GetChildren(Panel floatingRoot)
		{
			UIElement[] array = new UIElement[floatingRoot.Children.Count];
			floatingRoot.Children.CopyTo(array, 0);
			return array;
		}

		private static Panel GetFloatingRoot(FloatPanePresenter element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UIElement uIElement = (UIElement)(object)element;
			while (uIElement != null && !(uIElement is GroupPanel))
			{
				uIElement = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(uIElement) as UIElement;
			}
			return uIElement as Panel;
		}

		private static UIElement GetFloatingRootChild(FloatPanePresenter element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UIElement uIElement = (UIElement)(object)element;
			UIElement result = null;
			while (uIElement != null && !(uIElement is GroupPanel))
			{
				result = uIElement;
				uIElement = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(uIElement) as UIElement;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public static class EventArgsHelper
	{
		[DebuggerStepThrough]
		public static DevExpress.Xpf.Layout.Core.Platform.MouseEventArgs Convert(UIElement element, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			MouseButtons mouseButtons = GetMouseButtons(e);
			MouseButtons changedButtons = GetChangedButtons(e);
			return new DevExpress.Xpf.Layout.Core.Platform.MouseEventArgs(e.GetPosition(element), mouseButtons, changedButtons)
			{
				OriginalEvent = e
			};
		}

		[DebuggerStepThrough]
		public static DevExpress.Xpf.Layout.Core.Platform.MouseEventArgs Convert(UIElement element, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			MouseButtons mouseButtons = GetMouseButtons(e);
			return new DevExpress.Xpf.Layout.Core.Platform.MouseEventArgs(e.GetPosition(element), mouseButtons)
			{
				OriginalEvent = e
			};
		}

		[DebuggerStepThrough]
		public static MouseButtons GetChangedButtons(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			MouseButtons mouseButtons = MouseButtons.None;
			if (e.ChangedButton == MouseButton.Left)
			{
				mouseButtons |= MouseButtons.Left;
			}
			if (e.ChangedButton == MouseButton.Middle)
			{
				mouseButtons |= MouseButtons.Middle;
			}
			if (e.ChangedButton == MouseButton.Right)
			{
				mouseButtons |= MouseButtons.Right;
			}
			return mouseButtons;
		}

		[DebuggerStepThrough]
		private static MouseButtons GetMouseButtons(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			MouseButtons mouseButtons = MouseButtons.None;
			if (e.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed)
			{
				mouseButtons |= MouseButtons.Left;
			}
			if (e.MiddleButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed)
			{
				mouseButtons |= MouseButtons.Middle;
			}
			if (e.RightButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed)
			{
				mouseButtons |= MouseButtons.Right;
			}
			if (e.XButton1 == MouseButtonState.Pressed)
			{
				mouseButtons |= MouseButtons.XButton1;
			}
			if (e.XButton2 == MouseButtonState.Pressed)
			{
				mouseButtons |= MouseButtons.XButton2;
			}
			return mouseButtons;
		}
	}
	public static class HitTestHelper
	{
		public sealed class HitCache : IDisposable
		{
			private class HitCacheHelper
			{
				private class HitCacheResult
				{
					public static HitCacheResult Empty;

					private WeakReference lastElement;

					private Point lastPoint;

					private WeakReference resultReference;

					public HitTestResult Result
					{
						get
						{
							if (resultReference == null)
							{
								return null;
							}
							return (HitTestResult)resultReference.Target;
						}
					}

					static HitCacheResult()
					{
						Empty = new HitCacheResult();
					}

					private HitCacheResult()
					{
					}

					public HitCacheResult(UIElement element, Point point, HitTestResult result)
					{
						lastElement = new WeakReference(element);
						lastPoint = point;
						resultReference = new WeakReference(result);
					}

					private bool CheckElement(UIElement element)
					{
						if (lastElement != null)
						{
							return lastElement.Target != element;
						}
						return true;
					}

					public bool Accept(Point point, UIElement element)
					{
						if (!(point != lastPoint))
						{
							return CheckElement(element);
						}
						return true;
					}
				}

				private class HitCacheResultQueue : ConcurrentQueue<HitCacheResult>
				{
					public HitCacheResult Dequeue()
					{
						TryDequeue(out var result);
						return result;
					}
				}

				private const int hitCacheSize = 3;

				private HitCacheResultQueue cacheInternal = new HitCacheResultQueue();

				public HitTestResult GetHitResult(UIElement element, Point point)
				{
					HitCacheResultQueue hitCacheResultQueue = cacheInternal;
					HitTestResult hitTestResult = hitCacheResultQueue.FirstOrDefault((HitCacheResult hit) => !hit.Accept(point, element) && hit.Result != null, HitCacheResult.Empty).Result;
					if (hitTestResult == null || !IsValid(hitTestResult))
					{
						hitTestResult = new TopMostDockLayoutManagerHitResult(element, point).GetHitTest();
						hitCacheResultQueue.Enqueue(new HitCacheResult(element, point, hitTestResult));
						if (hitCacheResultQueue.Count > 3)
						{
							hitCacheResultQueue.Dequeue();
						}
					}
					return hitTestResult;
				}

				public void Reset()
				{
					HitCacheResultQueue hitCacheResultQueue = new HitCacheResultQueue();
					cacheInternal = hitCacheResultQueue;
				}
			}

			private HitCacheHelper hitCacheHelper;

			public HitCache()
			{
				hitCacheHelper = new HitCacheHelper();
			}

			public HitTestResult GetHitResult(UIElement element, Point point)
			{
				if (element == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return hitCacheHelper.GetHitResult(element, point);
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				Reset();
				GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
			}

			private static bool IsValid(HitTestResult result)
			{
				if (result != null)
				{
					return LayoutHelper.GetParent(result.VisualHit, false) != null;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				hitCacheHelper.Reset();
			}
		}

		private class TopMostDockLayoutManagerHitResult
		{
			private HitTestResult _hitResult;

			public TopMostDockLayoutManagerHitResult(UIElement view, Point hitPoint)
			{
				VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(view, NoNestedDockLayoutManager, HitTestResult, new PointHitTestParameters(hitPoint));
			}

			public HitTestResult GetHitTest()
			{
				return _hitResult;
			}

			private HitTestResultBehavior HitTestResult(HitTestResult result)
			{
				_hitResult = result;
				return HitTestResultBehavior.Stop;
			}

			private HitTestFilterBehavior NoNestedDockLayoutManager(DependencyObject potentialHitTestTarget)
			{
				if (potentialHitTestTarget is UIElement && !isVisible((UIElement)potentialHitTestTarget))
				{
					return HitTestFilterBehavior.ContinueSkipSelfAndChildren;
				}
				if (potentialHitTestTarget is DockLayoutManager)
				{
					return HitTestFilterBehavior.ContinueSkipChildren;
				}
				return HitTestFilterBehavior.Continue;
			}

			private bool isVisible(UIElement element)
			{
				return element.IsVisible;
			}
		}

		private static HitCache HitTestCache = new HitCache();

		public static bool IsDraggable(DependencyObject element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			HitTestType hitTestType = DockPane.GetHitTestType(element);
			if (hitTestType != HitTestType.Label)
			{
				return hitTestType == HitTestType.Header;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool TryGetControlBox(DependencyObject element, out BaseControlBoxControl result)
		{
			result = null;
			using (IEnumerator<DependencyObject> enumerator = LayoutItemsHelper.GetEnumerator(element, null))
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					if (enumerator.Current is BaseControlBoxControl)
					{
						result = enumerator.Current as BaseControlBoxControl;
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool HitTestTypeEquals(object prevHitResult, object hitResult)
		{
			bool flag = object.Equals(prevHitResult, hitResult);
			if (!flag)
			{
				if (hitResult == null && object.Equals(HitTestType.Undefined, prevHitResult))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (prevHitResult == null && object.Equals(HitTestType.Undefined, hitResult))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return flag;
		}

		public static void ResetCache()
		{
			HitTestCache.Reset();
		}

		public static HitTestResult GetHitResult(UIElement element, Point hitPoint)
		{
			return HitTestCache.GetHitResult(element, hitPoint);
		}

		public static HitTestResult HitTest(UIElement element, Point hitPoint, ref HitCache cache)
		{
			if (cache == null)
			{
				cache = new HitCache();
			}
			return cache.GetHitResult(element, hitPoint);
		}

		public static HitTestType GetHitTestType(HitTestResult hitResult)
		{
			HitTestType hitTestType = DockPane.GetHitTestType(hitResult.VisualHit);
			if (hitTestType == HitTestType.Undefined)
			{
				hitTestType = CheckAdornerDecorator(hitResult);
				if (hitTestType == HitTestType.Undefined)
				{
					hitTestType = CheckNonLogicalTree(hitResult);
				}
			}
			return hitTestType;
		}

		public static bool CheckVisualHitTest(IDockLayoutElement element, Point pt, Func<DependencyObject, DependencyObject, bool> isVisualChildDelegate)
		{
			UIElement uIElement = element.View;
			UIElement uIElement2 = element.Element;
			if (element is FloatPanePresenterElement)
			{
				uIElement2 = uIElement;
			}
			if (uIElement is AutoHideTray autoHideTray && !(uIElement2 is AutoHideTray))
			{
				IUIElement element2 = uIElement2 as IUIElement;
				if (FindScope<AutoHidePane>(element2) != null)
				{
					AutoHidePane panel = autoHideTray.Panel;
					pt = autoHideTray.TranslatePoint(pt, panel);
					uIElement = panel;
				}
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = GetHitResult(uIElement, pt)?.VisualHit;
			if (dependencyObject != null)
			{
				return isVisualChildDelegate(uIElement2, dependencyObject);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool CheckVisualHitTest(IDockLayoutElement element, Point pt)
		{
			return CheckVisualHitTest(element, pt, IsVisualChild);
		}

		private static bool IsVisualChild(DependencyObject root, DependencyObject child)
		{
			for (DependencyObject dependencyObject = child; dependencyObject != null; dependencyObject = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject))
			{
				if (dependencyObject == root)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static IUIElement FindScope<T>(IUIElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (element is T)
			{
				return element;
			}
			for (IUIElement scope = element.Scope; scope != null; scope = scope.Scope)
			{
				if (scope is T)
				{
					return scope;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static HitTestType CheckAdornerDecorator(HitTestResult result)
		{
			AdornerDecorator adornerDecorator = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<AdornerDecorator>(result.VisualHit);
			if (adornerDecorator != null)
			{
				DependencyObject parent = LayoutHelper.GetParent((DependencyObject)adornerDecorator, false);
				if (parent != null)
				{
					return (HitTestType)parent.GetValue(DockPane.HitTestTypeProperty);
				}
			}
			return HitTestType.Undefined;
		}

		private static HitTestType CheckNonLogicalTree(HitTestResult hitElement)
		{
			HitTestType hitTestType = HitTestType.Undefined;
			for (DependencyObject dependencyObject = hitElement.VisualHit; dependencyObject != null; dependencyObject = LayoutHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject, false))
			{
				hitTestType = DockPane.GetHitTestType(dependencyObject);
				if (hitTestType != HitTestType.Undefined)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return hitTestType;
		}
	}

	{

			};

			return captionLocation.ToDock().ToThickness(arg);
		}

		{
			return captionLocation.ToDock().RotateThickness(arg);
		}
	}
	public static class AutoHideTypeExtension
	{
		public static Dock ToDock(this AutoHideType type)
		{
			return type switch
			{
				AutoHideType.Right => Dock.Right, 
				AutoHideType.Top => Dock.Top, 
				AutoHideType.Bottom => Dock.Bottom, 
				_ => Dock.Left, 
			};
		}

		public static AutoHideType ToAutoHideType(this Dock dock)
		{
			return dock switch
			{
				Dock.Left => AutoHideType.Left, 
				Dock.Right => AutoHideType.Right, 
				Dock.Top => AutoHideType.Top, 
				Dock.Bottom => AutoHideType.Bottom, 
				_ => AutoHideType.Default, 
			};
		}
	}

	public class DockLayoutElementHelper
	{
		public static Point GetElementPoint(LayoutElementHitInfo hi)
