	internal abstract class ViewEventSubscriber<T> : IDisposable
	{
		protected BaseView View { get; private set; }

		public T Root { get; set; }

		public T Source { get; private set; }

		protected ViewEventSubscriber(T source, BaseView view)
		{
			Source = source;
			Root = source;
			View = view;
			if (Source != null)
			{
				Subscribe(Source);
			}
		}

		protected abstract void Subscribe(T element);

		protected abstract void UnSubscribe(T element);

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (Source != null)
			{
				UnSubscribe(Source);
				Source = default(T);
			}
			View = null;
			Root = default(T);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}
	}
	internal class ViewEventSubscriberHelper
	{
		public static bool IsInPopup(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsInPopupCore(DependencyObject dObj)
		{
			return DockLayoutManagerHelper.IsPopupRoot(LayoutHelper.FindRoot(dObj, false));
		}

		private static bool IsChildElement(DependencyObject container, DependencyObject dObj)
		{
			if (!LayoutHelper.IsChildElement(container, dObj))
			{
				return container == dObj;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool CanHandlePreviewEvent(DependencyObject container, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OriginalSource is DependencyObject dObj)
			{
				if (IsInPopupCore(dObj))
				{
					return IsChildElement(container, dObj);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class MouseEventSubscriber : ViewEventSubscriber<UIElement>
	{
		public MouseEventSubscriber(UIElement source, BaseView view)
			: base(source, view)
		{
		}

		protected override void Subscribe(UIElement element)
		{
			element.PreviewMouseDown += RootUIElementPreviewMouseDown;
			element.MouseMove += RootUIElementMouseMove;
			element.MouseUp += RootUIElementMouseUp;
			element.MouseDown += RootUIElementMouseDown;
			element.MouseLeave += RootUIElementMouseLeave;
			element.LostMouseCapture += RootUIElementLostMouseCapture;
		}

		protected override void UnSubscribe(UIElement element)
		{
			element.PreviewMouseDown -= RootUIElementPreviewMouseDown;
			element.MouseMove -= RootUIElementMouseMove;
			element.MouseUp -= RootUIElementMouseUp;
			element.MouseLeave -= RootUIElementMouseLeave;
			element.MouseDown -= RootUIElementMouseDown;
			element.LostMouseCapture -= RootUIElementLostMouseCapture;
		}

		private void RootUIElementMouseUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(base.View as ICustomDragProcessor).Return((ICustomDragProcessor x) => x.IsInEvent, () => false))
			{
				DevExpress.Xpf.Layout.Core.Platform.MouseEventArgs e2 = EventArgsHelper.Convert(base.Root, e);
				base.View.OnMouseEvent(MouseEventType.MouseUp, e2);
				e.Handled = e2.Handled;
			}
		}

		private void RootUIElementMouseMove(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			ICustomDragProcessor input = base.View as ICustomDragProcessor;
			if (base.View.IsDisposing || input.Return((ICustomDragProcessor x) => x.IsInEvent, () => false))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (CanSkipMoveEvent(e))
			{
				input.Do(delegate(ICustomDragProcessor x)
				{
					x.CancelDragging();
				});
				return;
			}
			base.View.OnMouseEvent(MouseEventType.MouseMove, EventArgsHelper.Convert(base.Root, e));
			input.Do(delegate(ICustomDragProcessor x)
			{
				x.StartDragging();
			});
		}

		private void RootUIElementPreviewMouseDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(base.View as ICustomDragProcessor).Return((ICustomDragProcessor x) => x.IsInEvent, () => false) && ViewEventSubscriberHelper.CanHandlePreviewEvent(sender as DependencyObject, e))
			{
				HitTestHelper.ResetCache();
				base.View.OnMouseEvent(MouseEventType.MouseDown, EventArgsHelper.Convert(base.Root, e));
			}
		}

		private void RootUIElementMouseDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			e.Handled = base.View != null && base.View.CanHandleMouseDown();
		}

		private void RootUIElementMouseLeave(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.View.OnMouseEvent(MouseEventType.MouseLeave);
		}

		private void RootUIElementLostMouseCapture(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.View.OnMouseEvent(MouseEventType.MouseCaptureLost);
		}

		private bool CanSkipMoveEvent(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.View.Adapter.DragService.DragItem != null)
			{
				if (base.View.Adapter.DragService.DragSource != null)
				{
					return e.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Released;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void OnDesignTimeEvent(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(e is System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (e is MouseButtonEventArgs)
			{
				if (e.RoutedEvent == UIElement.PreviewMouseDownEvent)
				{
					RootUIElementPreviewMouseDown(sender, (MouseButtonEventArgs)e);
				}
				if (e.RoutedEvent == UIElement.MouseUpEvent)
				{
					RootUIElementMouseUp(sender, (MouseButtonEventArgs)e);
				}
			}
			else if (e.RoutedEvent == UIElement.MouseMoveEvent)
			{
				RootUIElementMouseMove(sender, (System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs)e);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class KeyboardEventSubscriber : ViewEventSubscriber<IInputElement>
	{
		public KeyboardEventSubscriber(IInputElement rootUIElement, BaseView view)
			: base(rootUIElement, view)
		{
		}

		protected override void Subscribe(IInputElement element)
		{
			element.PreviewKeyDown += RootUIElementKeyDown;
			element.PreviewKeyUp += RootUIElementKeyDown;
		}

		protected override void UnSubscribe(IInputElement element)
		{
			element.PreviewKeyDown -= RootUIElementKeyDown;
			element.PreviewKeyUp -= RootUIElementKeyDown;
		}

		private void RootUIElementKeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.View != null)
			{
				bool flag = base.View.Adapter.DragService.OperationType == OperationType.Regular;
				if (e.IsDown)
				{
					base.View.OnKeyDown(e.Key);
				}
				if (e.IsUp)
				{
					base.View.OnKeyUp(e.Key);
				}
				if (!flag && e.Key == Key.Tab)
				{
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class LayoutView : BaseView, IAdornerWindowClient, ICustomDragProcessor
	{
		private readonly Locker mouseCaptureLocker = new Locker();

		private MouseEventSubscriber mouseEventSubscriber;

		private ResizingWindowHelper resizingWindowHelper;

		private IDictionary<object, IDisposable> subscriptions;

		private VisualizerAdornerHelper visualizerAdornerHelper;

		public VisualizerAdornerHelper AdornerHelper => visualizerAdornerHelper;

		public DockLayoutManager Container { get; private set; }

		public override bool IsActiveAndCanProcessEvent
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.IsActiveAndCanProcessEvent)
				{
					return base.ZOrder != -1;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool IsAdornerHelperInitialized => visualizerAdornerHelper != null;

		public ResizingWindowHelper ResizingWindowHelper => resizingWindowHelper;

		public IUIElement RootElement { get; private set; }

		public LayoutGroup RootGroup { get; private set; }

		public override object RootKey => RootElement;

		public UIElement RootUIElement { get; private set; }

		public override HostType Type => HostType.Layout;

		protected virtual bool CanCaptureMouse => true;

		protected IInputElement KeyboardFocusHolder { get; private set; }

		Rect IAdornerWindowClient.Bounds => CalcBounds();

		internal object LastProcessedEvent { get; set; }

		bool ICustomDragProcessor.IsInEvent => Container.Return((DockLayoutManager x) => x.Win32DragService.IsInEvent, () => false);

		public LayoutView(IUIElement viewUIElement)
			: base(null, null)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			RootElement = viewUIElement;
			Initialize(viewUIElement);
			RegisterListeners();
		}

		public override Point ClientToScreen(Point clientPoint)
		{
			return CoordinateHelper.PointToScreen(Container, RootUIElement, clientPoint);
		}

		public override Point ScreenToClient(Point screenPoint)
		{
			return CoordinateHelper.PointFromScreen(Container, RootUIElement, screenPoint);
		}

		internal void OnDesignTimeEvent(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!base.IsDisposing)
			{
				mouseEventSubscriber.OnDesignTimeEvent(sender, e);
			}
		}

		internal void RootUIElementKeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.IsDown)
			{
				OnKeyDown(e.Key);
			}
			if (e.IsUp)
			{
				OnKeyUp(e.Key);
			}
			if (base.Adapter.DragService.OperationType != OperationType.Regular && e.Key == Key.Tab)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual DockingHintAdorner CreateDockingHintAdorner(UIElement adornedElement)
		{
			return new DockingHintAdorner(adornedElement)
			{
				HostType = Type
			};
		}

		protected internal virtual SelectionAdorner CreateSelectionAdorner(UIElement adornedElement)
		{
			return new SelectionAdorner(adornedElement)
			{
				HostType = Type
			};
		}

		protected internal virtual ShadowResizeAdorner CreateShadowResizeAdorner(UIElement adornedElement)
		{
			return new ShadowResizeAdorner(adornedElement);
		}

		protected internal virtual TabHeadersAdorner CreateTabHeadersAdorner(UIElement adornedElement)
		{
			return new TabHeadersAdorner(adornedElement);
		}

		protected internal virtual AdornerWindow GetAdornerWindow()
		{
			return new AdornerWindow(this, Container);
		}

		protected internal virtual void Initialize(IUIElement viewUIElement)
		{
			RootUIElement = CheckRootUIElement(viewUIElement);
			if (RootUIElement != null)
			{
				Container = DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager(RootUIElement);
				RootGroup = DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(RootUIElement) as LayoutGroup;
				if (visualizerAdornerHelper != null)
				{
					visualizerAdornerHelper.Dispose();
				}
				visualizerAdornerHelper = new VisualizerAdornerHelper(this);
				InvalidateZOrder();
			}
			resizingWindowHelper = new ResizingWindowHelper(this);
			SubscribeMouseEvents(RootUIElement);
		}

		protected override int CalcZOrder()
		{
			return ((UIElement)RootElement).GetVisualOrder(Container);
		}

		protected override bool CanHandleMouseCaptureLost()
		{
			return !Locker.op_Implicit(mouseCaptureLocker);
		}

		protected override bool CanSuspendBehindDragging(ILayoutElement dragItem)
		{
			return RaiseStartDocking(dragItem);
		}

		protected override bool CanSuspendClientDragging(ILayoutElement dragItem)
		{
			if (LayoutItemsHelper.IsLayoutItem(((IDockLayoutElement)dragItem).Item))
			{
				return false;
			}
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)dragItem).CheckDragElement().Item;
			if (!item.AllowFloat || !item.IsItemWithRestrictedFloating() || !Container.RaiseDockOperationStartingEvent(DockOperation.Move, item))
			{
				return RaiseStartDocking(dragItem);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool CanSuspendDocking(ILayoutElement dragItem)
		{
			return RaiseStartDocking(dragItem);
		}

		protected override bool CanSuspendFloating(ILayoutElement dragItem)
		{
			return RaiseStartDocking(dragItem);
		}

		protected override bool CanSuspendReordering(ILayoutElement dragItem)
		{
			if (dragItem is MDIDocumentElement)
			{
				BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)dragItem).CheckDragElement().Item;
				return Container.RaiseDockOperationStartingEvent(DockOperation.Move, item);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool CanSuspendResizing(ILayoutElement dragItem)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)dragItem).CheckDragElement().Item;
			return Container.RaiseDockOperationStartingEvent(DockOperation.Resize, item);
		}

		protected override bool CanUseCustomServiceListener(object key)
		{
			if (base.Adapter.DragService.DragItem is MDIDocumentElement)
			{
				if (!object.Equals(key, OperationType.Reordering))
				{
					return object.Equals(key, OperationType.Resizing);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool CheckReordering(Point point)
		{
			DockHintHitInfo hitInfo = AdornerHelper.GetHitInfo(point);
			if (hitInfo != null)
			{
				return !hitInfo.InHint;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual UIElement CheckRootUIElement(IUIElement viewUIElement)
		{
			return viewUIElement as UIElement;
		}

		protected override ServiceListener GetCustomUIServiceListener<ServiceListener>(object key)
		{
			if (object.Equals(key, OperationType.Reordering))
			{
				return new LayoutViewMDIReorderingListener() as ServiceListener;
			}
			if (object.Equals(key, OperationType.Resizing))
			{
				return new LayoutViewMDIResizingListener() as ServiceListener;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override ILayoutElement GetDragItemCore(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			return ((IDockLayoutElement)element).GetDragItem();
		}

		protected override ILayoutElementBehavior GetElementBehaviorCore(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			if (!(element is IDockLayoutElement))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ((IDockLayoutElement)element).GetBehavior();
		}

		protected override bool IsOnCurrentVirtualDesktopCore()
		{
			UIElement rootUIElement = RootUIElement;
			if (!(((rootUIElement != null) ? UIElementExtensions.GetRootVisual(rootUIElement) : null) is Window window))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return VirtualDesktopHelper.IsWindowOnCurrentVirtualDesktop(window);
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			UnSubscribeMouseEvents(RootUIElement);
			ReleaseCaptureCore();
			Ref.Dispose(ref visualizerAdornerHelper);
			Ref.Dispose(ref resizingWindowHelper);
			Container = null;
			RootUIElement = null;
			RootElement = null;
			RootGroup = null;
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected virtual void RegisterListeners()
		{
			RegisterUIServiceListener(new LayoutViewRegularDragListener());
			RegisterUIServiceListener(new LayoutViewFloatingDragListener());
			RegisterUIServiceListener(new LayoutViewReorderingListener());
			RegisterUIServiceListener(new LayoutViewClientDraggingListener());
			RegisterUIServiceListener(new LayoutViewNonClientDraggingListener());
			RegisterUIServiceListener(new LayoutViewUIInteractionListener());
			RegisterUIServiceListener(new LayoutViewSelectionListener());
			RegisterUIServiceListener(new LayoutViewActionListener());
			RegisterUIServiceListener(new LayoutViewContextActionServiceListener());
		}

		protected override void ReleaseCaptureCore()
		{
			Locker val = mouseCaptureLocker.Lock();
			try
			{
				UnsubscribeKeyboardEvent();
				if (RootUIElement != null)
				{
					RootUIElement.ReleaseMouseCapture();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		protected override ILayoutElementBehavior ResolveDefaultBehavior()
		{
			return new EmptyBehavior();
		}

		protected override ILayoutElementFactory ResolveDefaultFactory()
		{
			return new LayoutElementFactory();
		}

		protected override void SetCaptureCore()
		{
			if (CanCaptureMouse)
			{
				RootUIElement.CaptureMouse();
			}
			SubscribeKeyboardEvent();
		}

		protected void SubscribeKeyboardEvent()
		{
			if (KeyboardFocusHolder != KeyHelper.FocusedElement)
			{
				if (KeyboardFocusHolder != null)
				{
					UnSubscribeCore(KeyboardFocusHolder);
				}
				KeyboardFocusHolder = KeyHelper.FocusedElement;
				if (KeyboardFocusHolder != null)
				{
					SubscribeCore(KeyboardFocusHolder, new KeyboardEventSubscriber(KeyboardFocusHolder, this));
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SubscribeMouseEvents(UIElement element)
		{
			mouseEventSubscriber = new MouseEventSubscriber(element, this)
			{
				Root = RootUIElement
			};
			SubscribeCore(element, mouseEventSubscriber);
		}

		protected void UnsubscribeKeyboardEvent()
		{
			if (KeyboardFocusHolder != null)
			{
				UnSubscribeCore(KeyboardFocusHolder);
				KeyboardFocusHolder = null;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UnSubscribeMouseEvents(UIElement element)
		{
			UnSubscribeCore(element);
		}

		private Rect CalcBounds()
		{
			Point screenLocation = WindowHelper.GetScreenLocation(RootUIElement);
			Size renderSize = RootUIElement.RenderSize;
			if (Container.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
			{
				screenLocation.X -= renderSize.Width;
			}
			return new Rect(screenLocation, renderSize);
		}

		private bool RaiseStartDocking(ILayoutElement dragItem)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)dragItem).Item;
			return Container.RaiseItemCancelEvent(item, DockLayoutManager.DockItemStartDockingEvent);
		}

		private void SubscribeCore(object element, IDisposable subscriber)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				if (subscriptions == null)
				{
					subscriptions = new Dictionary<object, IDisposable>();
				}
				if (subscriptions.TryGetValue(element, out var value))
				{
					Ref.Dispose(ref value);
					subscriptions[element] = subscriber;
				}
				else
				{
					subscriptions.Add(element, subscriber);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UnSubscribeCore(object element)
		{
			if (element != null && subscriptions != null && subscriptions.TryGetValue(element, out var value))
			{
				Ref.Dispose(ref value);
				subscriptions.Remove(element);
			}
		}

		protected override void BeginProcessEvent(object ea)
		{
			base.BeginProcessEvent(ea);
			LastProcessedEvent = ea;
		}

		protected override void EndProcessEvent(object ea)
		{
			LastProcessedEvent = null;
			base.EndProcessEvent(ea);
		}

		void ICustomDragProcessor.CancelDragging()
		{
			Container.Do(delegate(DockLayoutManager x)
			{
				x.Win32DragService.CancelDragging();
			});
		}

		void ICustomDragProcessor.StartDragging()
		{
			if (!base.Adapter.IsInEvent)
			{
				Container.Do(delegate(DockLayoutManager x)
				{
					x.Win32DragService.TryStartDragging();
				});
			}
		}
	}
	public class FloatingView : LayoutView
	{
		private readonly Locker floatingLocker = new Locker();

		public FloatGroup FloatGroup => base.RootGroup as FloatGroup;

		public override HostType Type => HostType.Floating;

		internal bool IsFloating => Locker.op_Implicit(floatingLocker);

		protected override bool CanCaptureMouse
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsFloating)
				{
					return !base.Container.EnableNativeDragging;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public FloatingView(IUIElement viewUIElement)
			: base(viewUIElement)
		{
		}//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown


		public override Point ScreenToClient(Point screenPoint)
		{
			if (base.IsDisposing)
			{
				return default(Point);
			}
			return base.ScreenToClient(screenPoint);
		}

		internal void BeginFloating()
		{
			floatingLocker.Lock();
		}

		internal void EndFloating()
		{
			floatingLocker.Unlock();
		}

		protected internal void EnterReordering()
		{
			base.RootUIElement.Opacity = 0.9;
		}

		protected internal override AdornerWindow GetAdornerWindow()
		{
			if (!(RootKey is FloatingWindowPresenter floatingWindowPresenter))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return floatingWindowPresenter.EnsureAdornerWindow();
		}

		protected internal void LeaveReordering()
		{
			base.RootUIElement?.ClearValue(UIElement.OpacityProperty);
		}

		protected internal void SetFloatingBounds(Rect screenRect)
		{
			FloatGroup.FloatLocation = RectHelper.Location(screenRect);
			FloatGroup.FitSizeToContent(RectHelper.Size(screenRect));
			base.RootUIElement.UpdateLayout();
		}

		protected internal void SetFloatLocation(Point screenLocation)
		{
			if (!base.Container.RaiseDockItemDraggingEvent(FloatGroup, screenLocation))
			{
				FloatGroup.FloatLocation = screenLocation;
			}
		}

		protected override bool CanSuspendFloatingMoving(ILayoutElement dragItem)
		{
			if (base.Container.EnableNativeDragging)
			{
				return false;
			}
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)dragItem).CheckDragElement().Item;
			return base.Container.RaiseDockOperationStartingEvent(DockOperation.Move, item);
		}

		protected override bool CanUseCustomServiceListener(object key)
		{
			bool flag = object.Equals(key, typeof(IUIInteractionServiceListener)) || object.Equals(key, OperationType.FloatingMoving);
			if (!base.CanUseCustomServiceListener(key))
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					return base.Container.Return((DockLayoutManager x) => x.EnableNativeDragging, () => false);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override UIElement CheckRootUIElement(IUIElement viewUIElement)
		{
			return ((FloatPanePresenter)viewUIElement).Element;
		}

		protected override ServiceListener GetCustomUIServiceListener<ServiceListener>(object key)
		{
			if (object.Equals(key, typeof(IUIInteractionServiceListener)))
			{
				return new FloatingViewNativeInteractionListener() as ServiceListener;
			}
			if (object.Equals(key, OperationType.FloatingMoving))
			{
				return new FloatingViewNativeFloatingMovingListener() as ServiceListener;
			}
			return base.GetCustomUIServiceListener<ServiceListener>(key);
		}

		protected override void RegisterListeners()
		{
			base.RegisterListeners();
			RegisterUIServiceListener(new FloatingViewFloatingMovingListener());
			RegisterUIServiceListener(new FloatingViewFloatingResizingListener());
			RegisterUIServiceListener(new FloatingViewUIInteractionListener());
		}

		protected override void ReleaseCaptureCore()
		{
			base.ReleaseCaptureCore();
			base.ResizingWindowHelper?.Reset();
		}

		protected override ILayoutElementFactory ResolveDefaultFactory()
		{
			return new FloatLayoutElementFactory();
		}
	}

	public class VisualizerAdornerHelper : IDisposable
	{
		private bool isDisposing;

		private bool fUseAdornerWindow;

		private AdornerWindowHelper helper;

		private SelectionAdorner selectionAdornerCore;

		private DockingHintAdorner dockingHintAdornerCore;

		private TabHeadersAdorner tabHeadersAdornerCore;

		private ShadowResizeAdorner shadowResizeAdornerCore;

		private DispatcherTimer HideTimer;

		private bool fCancelHiding;

		private List<Action> delayedActions;

		private int lockHidingCounter;

		public LayoutView View { get; private set; }

		public DockLayoutManager Container { get; private set; }

		public SelectionAdorner SelectionAdorner => selectionAdornerCore;

		public TabHeadersAdorner TabHeadersAdorner => tabHeadersAdornerCore;

		internal bool IsTabHeadersHintEnabled => TabHeadersAdorner?.IsTabHeaderHintEnabled ?? false;

		public VisualizerAdornerHelper(LayoutView view)
		{
			View = view;
			Container = view.Container;
			Container.Unloaded += OnContainerUnloaded;
			fUseAdornerWindow = !WindowHelper.IsXBAP;
			TryCreateAdornerWindowHelper(view);
			InitTimer();
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (!isDisposing)
			{
				isDisposing = true;
				DestroyTimer();
				CleanAdorners();
				Ref.Dispose(ref helper);
				Container.Unloaded -= OnContainerUnloaded;
				Container = null;
				View = null;
			}
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		private void OnContainerUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			CleanAdorners();
		}

		internal void CleanAdorners()
		{
			Ref.Dispose<ShadowResizeAdorner>(ref shadowResizeAdornerCore);
			Ref.Dispose<TabHeadersAdorner>(ref tabHeadersAdornerCore);
			Ref.Dispose<DockingHintAdorner>(ref dockingHintAdornerCore);
			Ref.Dispose<SelectionAdorner>(ref selectionAdornerCore);
		}

		private void InitTimer()
		{
			delayedActions = new List<Action>();
			HideTimer = InvokeHelper.GetBackgroundTimer(180.0);
			HideTimer.Tick += HideTimer_Tick;
		}

		private void DestroyTimer()
		{
			HideTimer.Tick -= HideTimer_Tick;
			delayedActions.Clear();
		}

		protected void TryCreateAdornerWindowHelper(LayoutView view)
		{
			if (fUseAdornerWindow)
			{
				helper = CreateAdornerWindowHelper(view);
			}
		}

		private UIElement TryGetAdornerWindowRoot()
		{
			if (helper.AdornerWindow == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return helper.AdornerWindow.RootElement;
		}

		private AdornerWindowHelper CreateAdornerWindowHelper(LayoutView view)
		{
			return new AdornerWindowHelper(view, Container);
		}

		protected UIElement GetAdornedElement()
		{
			UIElement uIElement = null;
			if (fUseAdornerWindow)
			{
				uIElement = TryGetAdornerWindowRoot();
			}
			return uIElement ?? View.RootUIElement;
		}

		public RenameController GetRenameController()
		{
			if (selectionAdornerCore == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return selectionAdornerCore.RenameController;
		}

		public SelectionAdorner GetSelectionAdorner()
		{
			if (selectionAdornerCore == null || selectionAdornerCore.IsDisposing)
			{
				UIElement rootUIElement = View.RootUIElement;
				selectionAdornerCore = FindAdorner<SelectionAdorner>(rootUIElement);
				if (selectionAdornerCore == null)
				{
					selectionAdornerCore = View.CreateSelectionAdorner(rootUIElement);
					EnsureAdornerActivated((BaseSurfacedAdorner)(object)selectionAdornerCore);
				}
			}
			return selectionAdornerCore;
		}

		public DockingHintAdorner GetDockingHintAdorner()
		{
			if (dockingHintAdornerCore == null || dockingHintAdornerCore.IsDisposing)
			{
				UIElement adornedElement = GetAdornedElement();
				dockingHintAdornerCore = FindAdorner<DockingHintAdorner>(adornedElement);
				if (dockingHintAdornerCore == null)
				{
					dockingHintAdornerCore = View.CreateDockingHintAdorner(adornedElement);
					EnsureAdornerActivated((BaseSurfacedAdorner)(object)Container.DragAdorner);
					EnsureAdornerActivated((BaseSurfacedAdorner)(object)dockingHintAdornerCore);
				}
			}
			return dockingHintAdornerCore;
		}

		public TabHeadersAdorner GetTabHeadersAdorner()
		{
			if (tabHeadersAdornerCore == null)
			{
				UIElement adornedElement = GetAdornedElement();
				tabHeadersAdornerCore = VisualizerAdornerHelper.FindAdorner<TabHeadersAdorner>(adornedElement);
				if (tabHeadersAdornerCore == null)
				{
					tabHeadersAdornerCore = View.CreateTabHeadersAdorner(adornedElement);
					EnsureAdornerActivated((BaseSurfacedAdorner)(object)Container.DragAdorner);
					EnsureAdornerActivated((BaseSurfacedAdorner)(object)tabHeadersAdornerCore);
				}
			}
			return tabHeadersAdornerCore;
		}

		public ShadowResizeAdorner GetShadowResizeAdorner()
		{
			if (shadowResizeAdornerCore == null)
			{
				UIElement adornedElement = GetAdornedElement();
				shadowResizeAdornerCore = VisualizerAdornerHelper.FindAdorner<ShadowResizeAdorner>(adornedElement);
				if (shadowResizeAdornerCore == null)
				{
					shadowResizeAdornerCore = View.CreateShadowResizeAdorner(adornedElement);
					EnsureAdornerActivated((BaseSurfacedAdorner)(object)Container.DragAdorner);
					EnsureAdornerActivated((BaseSurfacedAdorner)(object)shadowResizeAdornerCore);
				}
			}
			return shadowResizeAdornerCore;
		}

		public void TryShowAdornerWindow(bool forceUpdateAdornerBounds = false)
		{
			fCancelHiding = true;
			if (fUseAdornerWindow)
			{
				if (Container.IsTransparencyDisabled && View is FloatingView)
				{
					Container.Win32AdornerWindowProvider.CancelHideAdornerWindow();
				}
				helper.ShowAdornerWindow(forceUpdateAdornerBounds);
			}
		}

		public void TryHideAdornerWindow()
		{
			HideTimer.Stop();
			DoHidingActions();
			if (fUseAdornerWindow)
			{
				helper.HideAdornerWindow();
			}
		}

		public void BeginHideAdornerWindowAndResetDockingHints()
		{
			fCancelHiding = false;
			delayedActions.Add(ResetDockingHints);
			if (Container.IsTransparencyDisabled && View is FloatingView)
			{
				DoHidingActions();
				if (fUseAdornerWindow)
				{
					Container.Win32AdornerWindowProvider.EnqueueHideAdornerWindow();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				HideTimer.Start();
			}
		}

		public void BeginHideAdornerWindowAndResetTabHeadersHints()
		{
			fCancelHiding = false;
			delayedActions.Add(ResetTabHeadersHints);
			HideTimer.Start();
		}

		public void BeginHideAdornerWindow()
		{
			fCancelHiding = false;
			HideTimer.Start();
		}

		private void HideTimer_Tick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			HideTimer.Stop();
			DoHidingActions();
			if (fUseAdornerWindow && !fCancelHiding)
			{
				helper.HideAdornerWindow();
			}
		}

		public void ResetDragVisualization()
		{
			Container.CustomizationController.HideDragCursor();
			Container.CustomizationController.UpdateDragInfo(null);
		}

		private void DoHidingActions()
		{
			if (lockHidingCounter <= 0)
			{
				lockHidingCounter++;
				Action[] array = delayedActions.ToArray();
				delayedActions.Clear();
				Action[] array2 = array;
				for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
				{
					array2[i]?.Invoke();
				}
				lockHidingCounter--;
			}
		}

		public void ShowSelection()
		{
			if (Container.IsCustomization && !Container.IsInDesignTime)
			{
				DockingHintAdornerBase selectionAdorner = GetSelectionAdorner();
				if (selectionAdorner != null)
				{
					selectionAdorner.ShowSelectionHints = true;
					selectionAdorner.UpdateSelection();
					((BaseSurfacedAdorner)selectionAdorner).Update(true);
				}
			}
		}

		public void HideSelection()
		{
			if (dockingHintAdornerCore != null)
			{
				DockingHintAdornerBase selectionAdorner = GetSelectionAdorner();
				if (selectionAdorner != null)
				{
					selectionAdorner.ShowSelectionHints = false;
					selectionAdorner.UpdateSelection();
					((BaseSurfacedAdorner)selectionAdorner).Update(((BaseSurfacedAdorner)selectionAdorner).Visible);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InvalidateSelectionAdorner()
		{
			if (selectionAdornerCore != null)
			{
				DockingHintAdornerBase dockingHintAdornerBase = selectionAdornerCore;
				InvokeHelper.BeginInvoke((DependencyObject)(object)dockingHintAdornerBase, new Action(((BaseSurfacedAdorner)dockingHintAdornerBase).Update), DispatcherPriority.Render);
			}
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			if (LayoutHelper.GetTopContainerWithAdornerLayer((UIElement)Container) != null)
			{
				ResetDockingHints();
				ResetTabHeadersHints();
			}
			if (Container.IsDesktopFloatingMode)
			{
				Ref.Dispose<ShadowResizeAdorner>(ref shadowResizeAdornerCore);
			}
			Ref.Dispose<DockingHintAdorner>(ref dockingHintAdornerCore);
			Ref.Dispose<TabHeadersAdorner>(ref tabHeadersAdornerCore);
			Ref.Dispose<SelectionAdorner>(ref selectionAdornerCore);
			if (fUseAdornerWindow)
			{
				helper.Reset();
			}
		}

		public void ResetDockingHints()
		{
			if (dockingHintAdornerCore != null)
			{
				DockingHintAdornerBase dockingHintAdorner = GetDockingHintAdorner();
				if (dockingHintAdorner != null)
				{
					dockingHintAdorner.ResetDocking();
					((BaseSurfacedAdorner)dockingHintAdorner).Update(((BaseSurfacedAdorner)dockingHintAdorner).Visible);
				}
			}
		}

		public void ResetTabHeadersHints()
		{
			if (tabHeadersAdornerCore != null)
			{
				TabHeadersAdorner tabHeadersAdorner = GetTabHeadersAdorner();
				if (tabHeadersAdorner != null)
				{
					tabHeadersAdorner.ResetElements();
					((BaseSurfacedAdorner)tabHeadersAdorner).Update(false);
				}
			}
		}

		public DockHintHitInfo GetHitInfo(Point point)
		{
			if (dockingHintAdornerCore == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetDockingHintAdorner()?.HitTest(point);
		}

		public void UpdateTabHeadersHint(DockLayoutElementDragInfo dragInfo, bool forceUpdateAdornerBounds = false)
		{
			delayedActions.Remove(ResetTabHeadersHints);
			TryShowAdornerWindow(forceUpdateAdornerBounds);
			TabHeadersAdorner tabHeadersAdorner = GetTabHeadersAdorner();
			if (tabHeadersAdorner != null && dragInfo.Item != null && dragInfo.DropTarget is IDockLayoutContainer { IsTabContainer: not false } dockLayoutContainer)
			{
				TabHeaderInsertHelper tabHeaderInsertHelper = new TabHeaderInsertHelper(dockLayoutContainer, dragInfo.Point, dockLayoutContainer.Item != dragInfo.Item.Parent);
				if (CanShowTabHeaderHint(dragInfo, tabHeaderInsertHelper.TabIndex, tabHeaderInsertHelper.Tab, tabHeaderInsertHelper.Header))
				{
					tabHeadersAdorner.ShowElements(dockLayoutContainer.TabHeaderLocation, tabHeaderInsertHelper.Tab, tabHeaderInsertHelper.Header);
				}
				else
				{
					tabHeadersAdorner.ResetElements();
				}
				((BaseSurfacedAdorner)tabHeadersAdorner).Update(true);
			}
		}

		private bool CanShowTabHeaderHint(DockLayoutElementDragInfo dragInfo, int insertIndex, Rect tab, Rect header)
		{
			if (dragInfo.DropTarget is IDockLayoutContainer dockLayoutContainer)
			{
				return Container.RaiseShowingTabHintsEvent(dragInfo.Item, dockLayoutContainer.Item, insertIndex, tab, header);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void UpdateDockingHints(DockLayoutElementDragInfo dragInfo, bool forceUpdateAdornerBounds = false)
		{
			delayedActions.Remove(ResetDockingHints);
			TryShowAdornerWindow(forceUpdateAdornerBounds);
			DockingHintAdornerBase dockingHintAdorner = GetDockingHintAdorner();
			if (dockingHintAdorner != null && dragInfo.Item != null)
			{
				DockHintHitInfo dockHintHitInfo = dockingHintAdorner.HitTest(dragInfo.Point);
				dockingHintAdorner.TargetRect = dragInfo.TargetRect;
				dockingHintAdorner.SetDockHintsConfiguration(dragInfo);
				if (dragInfo.Target != null)
				{
					Container.RaiseShowingDockHintsEvent(dragInfo.Item, dragInfo.Target, dockingHintAdorner.DockHintsConfiguration);
				}
				dockingHintAdorner.UpdateHotTrack(dockHintHitInfo);
				dockingHintAdorner.UpdateState();
				if (canDock(dragInfo, dockHintHitInfo))
				{
					dockingHintAdorner.HintRect = HintRectCalculator.Calc(dragInfo, dockHintHitInfo);
				}
				else
				{
					dockingHintAdorner.HintRect = Rect.Empty;
					dockingHintAdorner.ClearHotTrack();
				}
				((BaseSurfacedAdorner)dockingHintAdorner).Update(true);
			}
		}

		private bool canDock(DockLayoutElementDragInfo dragInfo, DockHintHitInfo adornerHitInfo)
		{
			if (dragInfo.AcceptDocking(adornerHitInfo))
			{
				return !Container.RaiseItemDockingEvent(DockLayoutManager.DockItemDockingEvent, dragInfo.Item, dragInfo.Point, adornerHitInfo.IsCenter ? dragInfo.Target : dragInfo.Target.GetRoot(), adornerHitInfo.DockType, adornerHitInfo.IsHideButton);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static T FindAdorner<T>(UIElement container) where T : BaseSurfacedAdorner
		{
			AdornerLayer adornerLayer = AdornerHelper.FindAdornerLayer(container);
			if (adornerLayer == null)
			{
				return default(T);
			}
			Adorner[] adorners = adornerLayer.GetAdorners(container);
			if (adorners == null)
			{
				return default(T);
			}
			Adorner adorner = Array.Find(adorners, (Adorner a) => a is T);
			return (T)(object)((adorner is T) ? adorner : null);
		}

		public static void EnsureAdornerActivated(BaseSurfacedAdorner adorner)
		{
			if (adorner != null)
			{
				DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<DockLayoutManager>((DependencyObject)((Adorner)(object)adorner).AdornedElement);
				if ((dockLayoutManager == null || !dockLayoutManager.IsInDesignTime || AdornerLayer.GetAdornerLayer(dockLayoutManager) != null) && !adorner.IsActivated)
				{
					adorner.Activate();
				}
			}
		}

		public static double GetAdornerWindowIndent(UIElement element)
		{
			return 0.0;
		}
	}
	internal static class TestParams
	{
		public static DevExpress.Xpf.Layout.Core.SelectionMode? SelectionMode;
	}
	public class LayoutViewSelectionListener : SelectionListener
	{
		public LayoutView View => base.ServiceProvider as LayoutView;

		public override DevExpress.Xpf.Layout.Core.SelectionMode CheckMode(ILayoutElement item)
		{
			return TestParams.SelectionMode ?? SelectionModeHelper.GetActualSelectionMode();
		}

		public override bool OnSelectionChanging(ILayoutElement element, bool selected)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)element).Item;
			return !View.Container.RaiseItemSelectionChangingEvent(item, selected);
		}

		public override void OnSelectionChanged(ILayoutElement element, bool selected)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)element).Item;
			item.SetSelected(View.Container, selected);
		}

			DockingHintAdornerBase selectionAdorner = View.AdornerHelper.SelectionAdorner;
			if (selectionAdorner != null)

				BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)layoutElement).Item;
				selectionAdorner.SelectionController.Focus(item);
			}
		}
	}
	public class LayoutViewUIInteractionListener : UIInteractionServiceListener
	{
		public LayoutView View => base.ServiceProvider as LayoutView;

		public override void OnActivate()
		{
			View.With((LayoutView x) => x.Container).With((DockLayoutManager x) => x.CustomizationController).Do(delegate(ICustomizationController x)
			{
				x.CloseMenu();
			});
		}

		public override bool OnActiveItemChanging(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			IDockLayoutElement dockLayoutElement = (IDockLayoutElement)element;
			View.Container.RenameHelper.CancelRenamingAndResetClickedState();
			System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e = (View.LastProcessedEvent as DevExpress.Xpf.Layout.Core.Platform.MouseEventArgs).With((DevExpress.Xpf.Layout.Core.Platform.MouseEventArgs x) => x.OriginalEvent as System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs);
			if (element.IsTabHeader && e != null && e.MiddleButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed && !DockLayoutManagerParameters.ActivateItemOnTabHeaderMiddleClick)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (dockLayoutElement.AllowActivate)
			{
				return dockLayoutElement.IsEnabled;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool OnActiveItemChanged(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)element).Item;
			View.Container.Activate(item);
			LayoutGroup root = item.GetRoot();
			if (root != null)
			{
				View.Container.CustomizationController.CustomizationRoot = root;
			}
			return item?.IsActive ?? false;
		}

		public override bool OnClickPreviewAction(LayoutElementHitInfo clickInfo)
		{
			if (!clickInfo.InHeader || KeyHelper.IsCtrlPressed || KeyHelper.IsShiftPressed)
			{
				return View.Container.RenameHelper.CancelRenamingAndResetClickedState();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool OnClickAction(LayoutElementHitInfo clickInfo)
		{
			if (clickInfo is DockLayoutElementHitInfo dockLayoutElementHitInfo)
			{
				IDockLayoutElement item = dockLayoutElementHitInfo.Element as IDockLayoutElement;
				if (dockLayoutElementHitInfo.InHeader)
				{
					return RenameItemCore(item);
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool OnMouseDown(LayoutElementHitInfo clickInfo)
		{
			IDockLayoutElement dockLayoutElement = (IDockLayoutElement)clickInfo.Element;
			BaseLayoutItem item = dockLayoutElement.Item;
			if (item == null || !item.IsActive)
			{
				return false;
			}
			View.Container.FocusItem(item);
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual bool CanScrollNextCore(BaseLayoutItem scrollTarget)
		{
			if (scrollTarget is LayoutGroup layoutGroup)
			{
				return layoutGroup.TabHeaderCanScrollNext;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool CanScrollPrevCore(BaseLayoutItem scrollTarget)
		{
			if (scrollTarget is LayoutGroup layoutGroup)
			{
				return layoutGroup.TabHeaderCanScrollPrev;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool ScrollPrevCore(BaseLayoutItem scrollTarget)
		{
			if (scrollTarget is LayoutGroup layoutGroup)
			{
				return layoutGroup.ScrollPrev();
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool ScrollNextCore(BaseLayoutItem scrollTarget)
		{
			if (scrollTarget is LayoutGroup layoutGroup)
			{
				return layoutGroup.ScrollNext();
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool RenameItemCore(IDockLayoutElement item)
		{
			if (!View.Container.RenameHelper.CancelRenaming())
			{
				return View.Container.RenameHelper.RenameByClick(item);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool HideCore(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			LayoutPanel layoutPanel = item as LayoutPanel;
			if (layoutPanel != null)
			{
				layoutPanel.AutoHideExpandState = AutoHideExpandState.Hidden;
			}
			return layoutPanel != null;
		}

		protected virtual bool ExpandItemCore(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			LayoutGroup layoutGroup = item as LayoutGroup;
			LayoutPanel layoutPanel = item as LayoutPanel;
			if (layoutGroup != null)
			{
				layoutGroup.Expanded = !layoutGroup.Expanded;
				View.AdornerHelper.InvalidateSelectionAdorner();
			}
			if (layoutPanel != null)
			{
				bool flag = layoutPanel.AutoHideExpandState == AutoHideExpandState.Expanded;
				layoutPanel.AutoHideExpandState = (flag ? AutoHideExpandState.Visible : AutoHideExpandState.Expanded);
			}
			if (layoutGroup == null)
			{
				return layoutPanel != null;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual bool MaximizeItemCore(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			return View.Container.MDIController.Maximize(GetDocument(item) ?? item);
		}

		protected virtual bool MinimizeItemCore(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			return View.Container.MDIController.Minimize(item);
		}

		protected virtual bool RestoreItemCore(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			return View.Container.MDIController.Restore(GetDocument(item) ?? item);
		}

		protected static DocumentPanel GetDocument(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			DocumentPanel result = item as DocumentPanel;
			if (item is DocumentGroup)
			{
				result = ((DocumentGroup)item).SelectedItem as DocumentPanel;
			}
			if (item is FloatGroup)
			{
				result = ((FloatGroup)item)[0] as DocumentPanel;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual bool CloseItemCore(BaseLayoutItem itemToClose)
		{
			if (itemToClose is TabbedGroup tabbedGroup && (tabbedGroup.ItemType != LayoutItemType.TabPanelGroup || !tabbedGroup.IsFloatingRootItem))
			{
				itemToClose = tabbedGroup.SelectedItem;
			}
			if (itemToClose == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (itemToClose.Parent is TabbedGroup { Parent: FloatGroup { FloatState: FloatState.Minimized } parent })
			{
				itemToClose = parent;
			}
			return View.Container.DockController.CloseEx(itemToClose);
		}

		protected virtual bool PinItemCore(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (PinDocument(item))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!item.IsAutoHidden)
			{
				return PinItem(item);
			}
			return UnPinItem(item);
		}

		protected bool PinDocument(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			return View.Container.DockController.ToggleItemPinStatus(item);
		}

		protected bool UnPinItem(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (!item.AllowDock)
			{
				return View.Container.DockController.Float(item) != null;
			}
			if (item.IsAutoHidden)
			{
				item = item.Parent;
			}
			return View.Container.DockController.Dock(item);
		}

		protected bool PinItem(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item.Parent is TabbedGroup)
			{
				item = item.Parent;
			}
			if (item.IsFloating && View.Container.RaiseItemDockingEvent(DockLayoutManager.DockItemStartDockingEvent, item, CoordinateHelper.ZeroPoint, null, DockType.None, isHiding: true))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return View.Container.DockController.Hide(item);
		}

		protected override bool IsFloatingElement(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)element).Item;
			if (!(item is FloatGroup))
			{
				return item.IsFloatingRootItem;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool IsMDIDocument(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			return element is MDIDocumentElement;
		}

		protected override bool IsControlItemElement(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			return element is ControlItemElement;
		}

		protected override bool DoControlItemDoubleClick(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			if (((IDockLayoutElement)element).Item is LayoutControlItem item)
			{
				return SelectAllInControl(item);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool SelectAllInControl(LayoutControlItem item)
		{
			RoutedCommand selectAll = ApplicationCommands.SelectAll;
			if (selectAll.CanExecute(null, item.Control))
			{
				selectAll.Execute(null, item.Control);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool MaximizeElementOnDoubleClick(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)element).Item;
			return View.Container.MDIController.Maximize(GetDocument(item) ?? item);
		}

		protected override bool RestoreElementOnDoubleClick(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)element).Item;
			return View.Container.MDIController.Restore(GetDocument(item) ?? item);
		}

		protected override bool IsMaximized(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)element).Item;
			if (item is FloatGroup)
			{
				return ((FloatGroup)item).IsMaximized;
			}
			if ((GetDocument(((IDockLayoutElement)element).Item) ?? item) is LayoutPanel layoutPanel)
			{
				return layoutPanel.IsMaximized;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override IFloatingHelper CreateFloatingHelper()
		{
			return new FloatingHelper(View);
		}

		protected override bool CanFloatElementOnDoubleClick(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)element).Item;
			return item.FloatOnDoubleClick;
		}

		public override bool OnMenuAction(LayoutElementHitInfo clickInfo)
		{
			View.Container.RenameHelper.CancelRenamingAndResetClickedState();
			if (!(clickInfo.Element is IDockLayoutElement))
			{
				return false;
			}
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)clickInfo.Element).Item;
			return ShowMenuCore(item);
		}

		public override bool OnMiddleButtonClickAction(LayoutElementHitInfo clickInfo)
		{
			if (clickInfo.Element == null || !(clickInfo.Element is IDockLayoutElement) || !clickInfo.InHeader)
			{
				return false;
			}
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)clickInfo.Element).Item;
			return OnMiddleButtonClickActionCore(item);
		}

		protected virtual bool OnMiddleButtonClickActionCore(BaseLayoutItem clickTarget)
		{
			if (clickTarget != null && clickTarget.IsTabPage && LayoutItemsHelper.IsDockItem(clickTarget))
			{
				return CloseItemCore(clickTarget);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool ShowMenuCore(BaseLayoutItem menuTarget)
		{
			return ShowMenuCore(menuTarget, forceShow: false);
		}

		protected bool ShowMenuCore(BaseLayoutItem menuTarget, bool forceShow)
		{
			return MenuHelper.ShowMenu(View.Container, menuTarget, null, forceShow);
		}

		protected virtual void ShowItemsSelectorMenu(UIElement source, BaseLayoutItem[] items)
		{
			View.Container.CustomizationController.ShowItemSelectorMenu(source, items);
		}
	}
	public class FloatingViewUIInteractionListener : LayoutViewUIInteractionListener
	{
		public override void OnActivate()
		{
			base.OnActivate();
			if (base.View.RootKey is FloatPanePresenter floatPanePresenter)
			{
				floatPanePresenter.Activate(base.View.Container);
			}
		}

		protected override bool DockElementOnDoubleClick(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)element).Item;
			DockSituation lastDockSituation = item.GetLastDockSituation();
			if (lastDockSituation == null || !(lastDockSituation.DockTarget is AutoHideGroup))
			{
				return base.View.Container.DockController.Dock(item);
			}
			return base.View.Container.DockController.Hide(item, lastDockSituation.DockTarget as AutoHideGroup);
		}

		protected override bool CanMaximizeOrRestore(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)element).Item;
			return item.IsMaximizable;
		}
	}
	public class FloatingViewNativeInteractionListener : FloatingViewUIInteractionListener
	{
		public new FloatingView View => base.ServiceProvider as FloatingView;

		protected override bool MaximizeItemCore(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			return MaximizeView();
		}

		protected override bool MinimizeItemCore(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			return MinimizeView();
		}

		protected override bool MaximizeElementOnDoubleClick(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			return MaximizeView();
		}

		private bool MaximizeView()
		{
			FloatGroup floatGroup = View.FloatGroup;
			FloatingWindowPresenter element = floatGroup.UIElements.GetElement<FloatingWindowPresenter>();
			return element.With((FloatingWindowPresenter x) => x.Window).Return((FloatingPaneWindow x) => x.Maximize(), null);
		}

		private bool MinimizeView()
		{
			FloatGroup floatGroup = View.FloatGroup;
			FloatingWindowPresenter element = floatGroup.UIElements.GetElement<FloatingWindowPresenter>();
			return element.With((FloatingWindowPresenter x) => x.Window).Return((FloatingPaneWindow x) => x.Minimize(), null);
		}

		protected override bool RestoreElementOnDoubleClick(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			return RestoreView();
		}

		protected override bool RestoreItemCore(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			return RestoreView();
		}

		private bool RestoreView()
		{
			FloatGroup floatGroup = View.FloatGroup;
			FloatingWindowPresenter element = floatGroup.UIElements.GetElement<FloatingWindowPresenter>();
			return element.With((FloatingWindowPresenter x) => x.Window).Return((FloatingPaneWindow x) => x.Restore(), null);
		}
	}
	public class AutoHideViewUIInteractionListener : LayoutViewUIInteractionListener
	{
		public override bool OnActiveItemChanging(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			if (!GetIsRightButtonPressed() && TryCollapseAutoHideTray(element))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return base.OnActiveItemChanging(element);
		}

		public override bool OnMenuAction(LayoutElementHitInfo clickInfo)
		{
			if (clickInfo.Element is AutoHideTrayElement { Tray: { } tray })
			{
				ShowItemsSelectorMenu(tray, tray.GetItems());
				return true;
			}
			if (clickInfo.Element is AutoHidePaneHeaderItemElement autoHidePaneHeaderItemElement)
			{
				MenuHelper.ShowMenu(base.View.Container, autoHidePaneHeaderItemElement.Item, autoHidePaneHeaderItemElement.Element);
				return true;
			}
			return base.OnMenuAction(clickInfo);
		}

		protected override IFloatingHelper CreateFloatingHelper()
		{
			return new AutoHideFloatingHelper(base.View);
		}

		private bool CollapseAutoHideTray(AutoHideTray tray, BaseLayoutItem itemToCollapse = null)
		{
			bool flag = tray?.IsExpanded ?? false;
			if (flag)
			{
				tray.DoCollapse(itemToCollapse);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private bool GetIsRightButtonPressed()
		{
			return Mouse.RightButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed;
		}

		private bool TryCollapseAutoHideTray(ILayoutElement element)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem item = ((IDockLayoutElement)element).Item;
			AutoHideTrayElement autoHideTrayElement = element as AutoHideTrayElement;
			if (item == null && autoHideTrayElement != null)
			{
				CollapseAutoHideTray(autoHideTrayElement.Tray);
			}
			else if (base.View.Container.CanAutoHideOnMouseDown && element is AutoHidePaneHeaderItemElement { Tray: not null } autoHidePaneHeaderItemElement && item == autoHidePaneHeaderItemElement.Tray.HotItem && CollapseAutoHideTray(autoHidePaneHeaderItemElement.Tray, item))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class MenuHelper
	{
		private readonly DockLayoutManager _manager;

		private MenuHelper(DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			_manager = manager;
		}

		public static bool ShowMenu(DockLayoutManager manager, BaseLayoutItem item, UIElement placementTarget = null, bool forceShow = false)
		{
			if (manager == null || manager.IsInDesignTime || item == null || (!item.AllowContextMenu && !forceShow))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return new MenuHelper(manager).ShowMenu(item, placementTarget);
		}

		public bool ShowMenu(BaseLayoutItem item, UIElement placementTarget)
		{
			try
			{
				_manager.CustomizationController.MenuSource = placementTarget;
				if (item is LayoutControlItem || item is FixedItem)
				{
					ShowLayoutControlItemContextMenu(item);
					return true;
				}
				if (item is LayoutGroup layoutGroup)
				{
					ShowItemsSelectorMenu(layoutGroup.GetUIElement<IUIElement>() as UIElement, layoutGroup.GetItems());
				}
				else
				{
					ShowItemContextMenu(item);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				_manager.CustomizationController.MenuSource = null;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void ShowItemsSelectorMenu(UIElement source, BaseLayoutItem[] items)
		{
			_manager.CustomizationController.ShowItemSelectorMenu(source, items);
		}

		private void ShowItemContextMenu(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			_manager.CustomizationController.ShowContextMenu(item);
		}

		private void ShowLayoutControlItemContextMenu(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			_manager.CustomizationController.ShowControlItemContextMenu(item);
		}
	}

	internal struct Dpi : IEquatable<Dpi>
	{
		public static readonly Dpi Default = new Dpi(96, 96);

		public int X { get; private set; }

		public int Y { get; private set; }

		public double ScaleX { get; private set; }

		public double ScaleY { get; private set; }

		public Dpi(int x, int y)
		{
			this = default(Dpi);
			X = x;
			Y = y;
			ScaleX = (float)X / 96f;
			ScaleY = (float)Y / 96f;
		}

		public bool Equals(Dpi other)
		{
			return this == other;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object other)
		{
			if (other is Dpi)
			{
				return this == (Dpi)other;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.Calculate(X, Y);
		}

		public static bool operator ==(Dpi dpi1, Dpi dpi2)
		{
			if (dpi1.X == dpi2.X)
			{
				return dpi1.Y == dpi2.Y;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(Dpi dpi1, Dpi dpi2)
		{
			return !(dpi1 == dpi2);
		}
	}
	internal static class DpiHelper
	{
		private static Matrix _transformToDevice;

		private static bool isPerMonitorDpiAware;

		private static readonly Dpi SystemDpi;

		public static bool IsPerMonitorDpiAware => isPerMonitorDpiAware;

		private static bool IsProcessPerMonitorDpiAware => GetDpiAwareness() == NativeHelper.PROCESS_DPI_AWARENESS.Process_Per_Monitor_DPI_Aware;

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		static DpiHelper()
		{
			SystemDpi = GetSystemDpi();
			IntPtr dC = NativeMethods.GetDC(IntPtr.Zero);
			int deviceCaps = NativeMethods.GetDeviceCaps(dC, 88);
			int deviceCaps2 = NativeMethods.GetDeviceCaps(dC, 90);
			_transformToDevice = Matrix.Identity;
			_transformToDevice.Scale((double)deviceCaps / 96.0, (double)deviceCaps2 / 96.0);
			isPerMonitorDpiAware = IsProcessPerMonitorDpiAware && EnvironmentHelper.IsRedstoneOneOrNewer && IsScalingSupported();
		}

		public static double GetDpiFactor(Visual container, Visual window)
		{
			Dpi dpiFromVisual = GetDpiFromVisual(container);
			Dpi dpiFromVisual2 = GetDpiFromVisual(window);
			return (double)dpiFromVisual.X / (double)dpiFromVisual2.X;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static Dpi GetDpiFromVisual(Visual sourceVisual)
		{
			if (sourceVisual == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("sourceVisual");
			}
			if (!EnvironmentHelper.IsEightOneOrNewer)
			{
				return SystemDpi;
			}
			if (!(PresentationSource.FromVisual(sourceVisual) is HwndSource hwndSource))
			{
				return SystemDpi;
			}
			IntPtr handleMonitor = NativeHelper.MonitorFromWindow(hwndSource.Handle, 2);
			return GetDpi(handleMonitor);
		}

		public static Point LogicalPixelsToDevice(Point logicalPoint)
		{
			return _transformToDevice.Transform(logicalPoint);
		}

		private static bool? GetDoNotScaleForDpiChanges()
		{
			Assembly entryAssembly = Assembly.GetEntryAssembly();
			if (entryAssembly == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UriBuilder uriBuilder = new UriBuilder(entryAssembly.CodeBase);
			string exePath = Uri.UnescapeDataString(uriBuilder.Path);
			try
			{
				Configuration config = ConfigurationManager.OpenExeConfiguration(exePath);
				return GetDoNotScaleForDpiChanges(config);
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		private static bool? GetDoNotScaleForDpiChanges(Configuration config)
		{
			ConfigurationSection section = config.GetSection("runtime");
			if (section == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SectionInformation sectionInformation = section.SectionInformation;
			if (sectionInformation == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string rawXml = sectionInformation.GetRawXml();
			if (rawXml == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			XDocument xDocument = SafeXml.CreateXDocument(rawXml, (Action<XmlReaderSettings>)null);
			if (xDocument == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IEnumerable<XElement> enumerable = xDocument.Descendants();
			if (enumerable == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			XElement xElement = enumerable.SingleOrDefault((XElement x) => x.Name.LocalName.Equals("AppContextSwitchOverrides", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
			if (xElement == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IEnumerable<XAttribute> enumerable2 = xElement.Attributes();
			if (enumerable2 == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			XAttribute xAttribute = enumerable2.SingleOrDefault((XAttribute x) => x.Name.LocalName.Equals("value", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
			string[] array = (from x in xAttribute.Value.Split('=')
				select x.Trim()).ToArray();
			if (array.Length != 2)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!array[0].Equals("Switch.System.Windows.DoNotScaleForDpiChanges", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!bool.TryParse(array[1], out var result))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return result;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static Dpi GetDpi(IntPtr handleMonitor)
		{
			if (handleMonitor == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				return SystemDpi;
			}
			int dpiX = 1;
			int dpiY = 1;
			if (NativeHelper.GetDpiForMonitor(handleMonitor, NativeHelper.MONITOR_DPI_TYPE.MDT_Effective_DPI, ref dpiX, ref dpiY) != 0)
			{
				return SystemDpi;
			}
			return new Dpi(dpiX, dpiY);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static NativeHelper.PROCESS_DPI_AWARENESS? GetDpiAwareness()
		{
			if (!EnvironmentHelper.IsEightOneOrNewer)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (NativeHelper.GetProcessDpiAwareness(IntPtr.Zero, out var value) != 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return value;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static Dpi GetSystemDpi()
		{
			IntPtr intPtr = IntPtr.Zero;
			try
			{
				intPtr = NativeMethods.GetDC(IntPtr.Zero);
				if (intPtr == IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					return Dpi.Default;
				}
				return new Dpi(NativeMethods.GetDeviceCaps(intPtr, 88), NativeMethods.GetDeviceCaps(intPtr, 90));
			}
			finally
			{
				if (intPtr != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					NativeMethods.ReleaseDC(IntPtr.Zero, intPtr);
				}
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static Dpi GetSystemDpi(Visual sourceVisual)
		{
			if (sourceVisual == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("sourceVisual");
			}
			PresentationSource presentationSource = PresentationSource.FromVisual(sourceVisual);
			if (presentationSource == null || presentationSource.CompositionTarget == null)
			{
				return Dpi.Default;
			}
			return new Dpi((int)((double)Dpi.Default.X * presentationSource.CompositionTarget.TransformToDevice.M11), (int)((double)Dpi.Default.Y * presentationSource.CompositionTarget.TransformToDevice.M22));
		}

		private static bool IsScalingSupported()
		{
			bool? doNotScaleForDpiChanges = GetDoNotScaleForDpiChanges();
			if (doNotScaleForDpiChanges.HasValue)
			{
				return !doNotScaleForDpiChanges.Value;
			}
			Version frameworkVersion = TargetFramework.GetFrameworkVersion();
			if (frameworkVersion == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return new Version(4, 6, 2) <= frameworkVersion;
		}
	}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static IEnumerable<Window> SortWindowsTopToBottom(IEnumerable<Window> unsorted)
		{
			Dictionary<IntPtr, Window> byHandle = unsorted.Where((Window x) => PresentationSource.FromVisual(x) != null).ToDictionary((Window win) => ((HwndSource)PresentationSource.FromVisual(win)).Handle);
			IntPtr hWnd = GetTopWindowSafe(IntPtr.Zero);
			while (hWnd != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				if (byHandle.ContainsKey(hWnd))
				{
					yield return byHandle[hWnd];
				}
				hWnd = GetNextWindowSafe(hWnd, 2u);
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static IntPtr GetTopWindowSafe(IntPtr hWnd)
		{
			return GetTopWindow(hWnd);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static IntPtr GetNextWindowSafe(IntPtr hWnd, uint wCmd)
		{
			return GetWindow(hWnd, wCmd);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		internal static void WmGetMinMaxInfo(IntPtr hwnd, IntPtr lParam, bool overlapTaskbar)
		{
			//IL_003f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0044: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0055: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0075: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0095: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0091: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0097: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0100: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			MINMAXINFO structure = (MINMAXINFO)Marshal.PtrToStructure(lParam, typeof(MINMAXINFO));
			int flags = 2;
			IntPtr intPtr = MonitorFromWindow(hwnd, flags);
			if (intPtr != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				MONITORINFO mONITORINFO = new MONITORINFO();
				GetMonitorInfo(intPtr, mONITORINFO);
				RECT rcWork = mONITORINFO.rcWork;
				RECT rcMonitor = mONITORINFO.rcMonitor;
				structure.ptMaxPosition.x = Math.Abs(rcWork.left - rcMonitor.left);
				structure.ptMaxPosition.y = Math.Abs(rcWork.top - rcMonitor.top);
				RECT val = (overlapTaskbar ? rcMonitor : rcWork);
				structure.ptMaxSize.x = Math.Abs(val.right - val.left);
				structure.ptMaxSize.y = Math.Abs(val.bottom - val.top);
				if (IsZoomed(hwnd))
				{
					structure.ptMaxTrackSize.x = structure.ptMaxSize.x;
					structure.ptMaxTrackSize.y = structure.ptMaxSize.y;
				}
			}
			Marshal.StructureToPtr(structure, lParam, fDeleteOld: true);
		}

	{

		AutoHidden,
		Floating,
		Unset
