	public class PlaceHolder : ISerializableItem, ISupportInitialize
	{
		private string parentName;

		private string ownerName;

		private int index;

		private int _hash;

		public LayoutGroup Parent { get; private set; }

		public BaseLayoutItem Owner { get; internal set; }

		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public PlaceHolderState DockState { get; set; }

		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string ParentName
		{
			get
			{
				if (Parent == null)
				{
					return parentName;
				}
				return Parent.Name;
			}
			set
			{
				parentName = value;
			}
		}

		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string OwnerName
		{
			get
			{
				if (Owner == null)
				{
					return ownerName;
				}
				return Owner.Name;
			}
			set
			{
				ownerName = value;
			}
		}

		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public int Index
		{
			get
			{
				if (Parent == null)
				{
					return GetRestoredIndex();
				}
				return Parent.PlaceHolderHelper.IndexOf(this);
			}
			set
			{
				index = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsFloating => DockState == PlaceHolderState.Floating;

		public bool IsAutoHidden => DockState == PlaceHolderState.AutoHidden;

		public bool IsDocked => DockState == PlaceHolderState.Docked;

		string ISerializableItem.Name { get; set; }

		string ISerializableItem.TypeName => typeof(PlaceHolder).Name;

		string ISerializableItem.ParentName { get; set; }

		string ISerializableItem.ParentCollectionName { get; set; }

		private int GetRestoredIndex()
		{
			return index;
		}

		internal PlaceHolder()
		{
		}

		public PlaceHolder(BaseLayoutItem owner, LayoutGroup parent)
		{
			Owner = owner;
			DockState = (owner.IsFloating ? PlaceHolderState.Floating : (owner.IsAutoHidden ? PlaceHolderState.AutoHidden : PlaceHolderState.Docked));
			UpdateParent(parent);
		}

		public int GetDockIndex()
		{
			int num = -1;
			if (Parent != null)
			{
				num = Parent.PlaceHolderHelper.IndexOf(this);
			}
			if (num != -1)
			{
				return num;
			}
			return GetRestoredIndex();
		}

		private void InvalidateHash()
		{
			_hash = HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<PlaceHolderState, LayoutGroup, BaseLayoutItem>(DockState, Parent, Owner);
		}

		internal void UpdateParent(LayoutGroup newParent)
		{
			if (newParent == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("newParent");
			}
			Parent = newParent;
			InvalidateHash();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			PlaceHolder placeHolder = obj as PlaceHolder;
			if (placeHolder != null && Parent == placeHolder.Parent && Owner == placeHolder.Owner)
			{
				return DockState == placeHolder.DockState;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _hash;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(PlaceHolder left, PlaceHolder right)
		{
			return object.Equals(left, right);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(PlaceHolder left, PlaceHolder right)
		{
			return !object.Equals(left, right);
		}

		public void BeginInit()
		{
		}

		public void EndInit()
		{
			InvalidateHash();
		}
	}
	internal class PlaceHolderHelper
	{
		private readonly ObservableCollection<object> itemsInternal = new ObservableCollection<object>();

		public LayoutGroup Owner { get; private set; }

		public int Count => itemsInternal.Count;

		public bool HasPlaceHolders => itemsInternal.FirstOrDefault((object fe) => fe is PlaceHolder) != null;

		internal object this[int index] => itemsInternal[index];

		public static PlaceHolder GetPlaceHolderForDockOperation(BaseLayoutItem item, bool isRestore)
		{
			PlaceHolder placeHolder = PlaceHolderToDock(item, isRestore);
			if (isRestore)
			{
				return placeHolder;
			}
			if (!(placeHolder != null) || !CanRestoreLayoutHierarchy(item, placeHolder.DockState))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return placeHolder;
		}

		private static PlaceHolder PlaceHolderToDock(BaseLayoutItem item, bool isRestore)
		{
			PlaceHolder placeHolder = null;
			if (isRestore)
			{
				placeHolder = item.DockInfo.LastOrDefault((PlaceHolder d) => !d.IsDocked);
			}
			if (placeHolder == null)
			{
				placeHolder = item.DockInfo.Find((PlaceHolder d) => d.IsDocked);
			}
			return placeHolder;
		}

		public static PlaceHolder GetPlaceHolder(BaseLayoutItem itemToDock, PlaceHolderState state = PlaceHolderState.Docked)
		{
			return itemToDock.DockInfo.Find((PlaceHolder di) => di.DockState == state);
		}

		public static int GetPlaceHolderCount(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			return item.DockInfo.Count;
		}

		public static bool HasItems(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			return item.DockInfo.Count > 0;
		}

		public static LayoutGroup[] GetAffectedGroups(BaseLayoutItem panel)
		{
			List<LayoutGroup> groups = new List<LayoutGroup>();
			panel.DockInfo.ForeEach(delegate(PlaceHolder ph)
			{
				groups.Add(ph.Parent);
			});
			return groups.ToArray();
		}

		public static LayoutGroup GetAffectedGroup(BaseLayoutItem panel, PlaceHolderState state = PlaceHolderState.Docked)
		{
			PlaceHolder placeHolder = panel.DockInfo.Find((PlaceHolder di) => di.DockState == state);
			if (!(placeHolder != null))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return placeHolder.Parent;
		}

		public static void ClearPlaceHolder(BaseLayoutItem itemToDock, BaseLayoutItem dockingRoot)
		{
			itemToDock.DockInfo.ToList().ForEach(delegate(PlaceHolder placeHolder)
			{
				LayoutGroup parent = placeHolder.Parent;
				if (parent != null && GetPlaceHolderRoot(placeHolder).Parent != dockingRoot)
				{
					parent.PlaceHolderHelper.Remove(placeHolder);
					itemToDock.DockInfo.Remove(placeHolder);
				}
				else
				{
					itemToDock.DockInfo.Remove(placeHolder);
				}
			});
		}

		public static void ClearPlaceHolder(BaseLayoutItem item, PlaceHolder placeHolder)
		{
			if (!(placeHolder == null))
			{
				LayoutGroup parent = placeHolder.Parent;
				item.DockInfo.Remove(placeHolder);
				parent?.PlaceHolderHelper.Remove(placeHolder);
			}
		}

		public static void ClearPlaceHolder(BaseLayoutItem item, PlaceHolderState state)
		{
			PlaceHolder placeHolder = GetPlaceHolder(item, state);
			ClearPlaceHolder(item, placeHolder);
		}

		public static void ClearPlaceHolder(BaseLayoutItem itemToDock)
		{
			itemToDock.DockInfo.ForeEach(delegate(PlaceHolder placeHolder)
			{
				placeHolder.Parent?.PlaceHolderHelper.Remove(placeHolder);
			});
			itemToDock.DockInfo.Clear();
		}

		internal static int GetDockIndex(BaseLayoutItem itemToDock, PlaceHolder ph)
		{
			return GetDockIndex(ph);
		}

		internal static IEnumerable<LayoutGroup> RestoreLayoutHierarchy(DockLayoutManager container, PlaceHolder ph, out LayoutGroup targetGroup)
		{
			targetGroup = null;
			List<LayoutGroup> list = new List<LayoutGroup>();
			if (ph == null || ph.Parent == null)
			{
				return list;
			}
			LayoutGroup layoutGroup = (targetGroup = ph.Parent);
			if (layoutGroup.IsInTree())
			{
				return list;
			}
			LayoutGroup root = layoutGroup.GetRoot();
			if (root.IsInTree())
			{
				list.Add(targetGroup);
			}
			else
			{
				RestoreLayoutHierarchyCore(container, layoutGroup, list);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static void RestoreLayoutHierarchyCore(DockLayoutManager container, LayoutGroup group, List<LayoutGroup> affectedGroups)
		{
			PlaceHolder placeHolder = group.DockInfo.LastOrDefault();
			if (placeHolder != null && placeHolder.DockState != PlaceHolderState.Unset)
			{
				LayoutGroup parent = placeHolder.Parent;
				RestoreLayoutHierarchyCore(container, parent, affectedGroups);
				int dockIndex = GetDockIndex(placeHolder);
				DockControllerHelper.InsertItemInGroup(parent, group, dockIndex);
				ClearPlaceHolder(group);
			}
			group.IsUngroupped = false;
			container.DecomposedItems.Remove(group);
			affectedGroups.Add(group);
		}

		internal static bool CanRestoreLayoutHierarchy(BaseLayoutItem item, PlaceHolderState desiredState = PlaceHolderState.Docked)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			PlaceHolder placeHolder = item.DockInfo.Find((PlaceHolder di) => di.DockState == desiredState);
			if (placeHolder == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			LayoutGroup parent = placeHolder.Parent;
			if (parent != null)
			{
				return CanRestoreLayoutHierarchyCore(parent, desiredState);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool CanRestoreLayoutHierarchyCore(LayoutGroup group, PlaceHolderState desiredState)
		{
			if (group == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			PlaceHolder placeHolder = group.DockInfo.FirstOrDefault((PlaceHolder x) => x.DockState == desiredState);
			if (placeHolder == null)
			{
				LayoutGroup root = group.GetRoot();
				if (root != null)
				{
					if (!(root is AutoHideGroup) && !(root is FloatGroup))
					{
						return root.IsRootGroup;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return CanRestoreLayoutHierarchyCore(placeHolder.Parent, desiredState);
		}

		internal static LayoutGroup GetPlaceHolderRoot(BaseLayoutItem item, PlaceHolderState desiredState)
		{
			HashSet<LayoutGroup> parents = new HashSet<LayoutGroup>();
			return GetPlaceHolderRoot(item, desiredState, parents);
		}

		internal static LayoutGroup GetPlaceHolderRoot(BaseLayoutItem item, PlaceHolderState desiredState, HashSet<LayoutGroup> parents)
		{
			IEnumerable<PlaceHolder> enumerable = from x in item.DockInfo.AsEnumerable()
				where x.DockState == desiredState
				select x;
			foreach (PlaceHolder item2 in enumerable)
			{
				if (item2.Parent != null && parents.Add(item2.Parent))
				{
					LayoutGroup placeHolderRoot = GetPlaceHolderRoot(item2.Parent, desiredState, parents);
					return placeHolderRoot ?? item2.Parent;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static IEnumerable<LayoutGroup> GetLayoutHierarchy(PlaceHolder placeHolder)
		{
			HashSet<PlaceHolder> hashSet = new HashSet<PlaceHolder>();
			List<LayoutGroup> list = new List<LayoutGroup>();
			PlaceHolder placeHolder2 = placeHolder;
			while (placeHolder2 != null && placeHolder2.Parent != null && !placeHolder2.Parent.IsInTree())
			{
				list.Add(placeHolder2.Parent);
				PlaceHolder placeHolder3 = placeHolder2.Parent.DockInfo.LastOrDefault();
				if (!hashSet.Add(placeHolder3) || !(placeHolder3 != null))
				{
					break;
				}
				placeHolder2 = placeHolder3;
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal static PlaceHolder GetPlaceHolderRoot(PlaceHolder placeHolder)
		{
			HashSet<PlaceHolder> hashSet = new HashSet<PlaceHolder>();
			PlaceHolder placeHolder2 = placeHolder;
			while (placeHolder2 != null && placeHolder2.Parent != null && !placeHolder2.Parent.IsInTree())
			{
				PlaceHolder placeHolder3 = placeHolder2.Parent.DockInfo.LastOrDefault();
				if (!hashSet.Add(placeHolder3) || !(placeHolder3 != null))
				{
					break;
				}
				placeHolder2 = placeHolder3;
			}
			return placeHolder2;
		}

		public static int GetDockIndex(PlaceHolder placeHolder)
		{
			LayoutGroup parent = placeHolder.Parent;
			PlaceHolderHelper placeHolderHelper = parent.PlaceHolderHelper;
			int result = 0;
			int num = placeHolderHelper.IndexOf(placeHolder);
			if (num == -1)
			{
				num = placeHolder.GetDockIndex();
			}
			BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = null;
			for (int i = num; i < placeHolderHelper.Count; i++)
			{
				if (placeHolderHelper[i] is BaseLayoutItem)
				{
					baseLayoutItem = (BaseLayoutItem)placeHolderHelper[i];
					result = parent.Items.IndexOf(baseLayoutItem);
					break;
				}
			}
			if (baseLayoutItem == null)
			{
				for (int num2 = num - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					if (placeHolderHelper[num2] is BaseLayoutItem)
					{
						baseLayoutItem = (BaseLayoutItem)placeHolderHelper[num2];
						result = parent.Items.IndexOf(baseLayoutItem) + 1;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal static void AddPlaceHolderForItem(LayoutGroup parent, BaseLayoutItem item, PlaceHolder ph, int index)
		{
			if (!item.DockInfo.Contains(ph))
			{
				item.DockInfo.Add(ph);
			}
			parent?.PlaceHolderHelper.Insert(index, ph);
		}

		internal static void AddFakePlaceHolderForItem(LayoutGroup parent, BaseLayoutItem item, PlaceHolderState dockState = PlaceHolderState.Unset)
		{
			AddFakePlaceHolderForItem(parent, item, 0, dockState);
		}

		internal static void AddFakePlaceHolderForItem(LayoutGroup parent, BaseLayoutItem item, int index, PlaceHolderState dockState = PlaceHolderState.Unset)
		{
			PlaceHolder placeHolder = new PlaceHolder(item, parent)
			{
				DockState = dockState
			};
			if (!item.DockInfo.Contains(placeHolder))
			{
				item.DockInfo.Add(placeHolder);
			}
			parent?.PlaceHolderHelper.Insert(index, placeHolder);
		}

		internal static void ReplacePlaceHolderOwner(LayoutGroup parent, PlaceHolder oldPlaceHolder, BaseLayoutItem newItem)
		{
			oldPlaceHolder.Owner = newItem;
			oldPlaceHolder.Owner.DockInfo.Remove(oldPlaceHolder);
			newItem.DockInfo.Add(oldPlaceHolder);
		}

		internal static void StorePositionAndRemove(LayoutGroup parent, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			PlaceHolder item2 = new PlaceHolder(item, parent)
			{
				DockState = PlaceHolderState.Unset
			};
			parent.PlaceHolderHelper.Insert(parent.PlaceHolderHelper.IndexOf(item), item2);
			parent.Remove(item);
		}

		internal static void InsertItemToPosition(LayoutGroup parent, BaseLayoutItem oldItem, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			PlaceHolder placeHolderForItem = parent.PlaceHolderHelper.GetPlaceHolderForItem(oldItem);
			if (!(placeHolderForItem == null))
			{
				placeHolderForItem.Owner = item;
				int dockIndex = GetDockIndex(placeHolderForItem);
				parent.Insert(dockIndex, item);
				parent.PlaceHolderHelper.Remove(placeHolderForItem);
			}
		}

		public PlaceHolderHelper(LayoutGroup owner)
		{
			Owner = owner;
		}

		public void Remove(object item)
		{
			itemsInternal.Remove(item);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, object item)
		{
			if (!itemsInternal.Contains(item))
			{
				if (index < 0 || index >= Count)
				{
					index = Count;
				}
				itemsInternal.Insert(index, item);
			}
		}

		public void Add(object item)
		{
			if (!itemsInternal.Contains(item))
			{
				itemsInternal.Add(item);
			}
		}

		public int IndexOf(object item)
		{
			return itemsInternal.IndexOf(item);
		}

		public bool Contains(object item)
		{
			return itemsInternal.Contains(item);
		}

		public IEnumerable<PlaceHolder> GetPlaceHolders()
		{
			return itemsInternal.Where((object x) => x is PlaceHolder).Cast<PlaceHolder>();
		}

		public void AddPlaceHolderForItem(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (!(GetPlaceHolderForItem(item) != null))
			{
				LayoutGroup parent = item.Parent;
				PlaceHolder placeHolder = new PlaceHolder(item, parent);
				if (!item.DockInfo.Contains(placeHolder))
				{
					item.DockInfo.Add(placeHolder);
				}
				Insert(IndexOf(item), placeHolder);
			}
		}

		public void InsertItem(int index, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			LayoutGroup owner = Owner;
			PlaceHolder placeHolderForItem = GetPlaceHolderForItem(item);
			if (placeHolderForItem == null || placeHolderForItem.Parent != owner)
			{
				if (index < owner.Items.Count - 1)
				{
					BaseLayoutItem item2 = owner.Items[index + 1];
					index = owner.PlaceHolderHelper.IndexOf(item2);
					owner.PlaceHolderHelper.Insert(index, item);
				}
				else
				{
					owner.PlaceHolderHelper.Add(item);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				index = owner.PlaceHolderHelper.IndexOf(placeHolderForItem);
				owner.PlaceHolderHelper.Insert(index, item);
				owner.PlaceHolderHelper.Remove(placeHolderForItem);
			}
		}

		public void MoveItem(int index, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			Remove(item);
			InsertItem(index, item);
		}

		private PlaceHolder GetPlaceHolderForItem(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			return (PlaceHolder)itemsInternal.FirstOrDefault((object obj) => obj is PlaceHolder && ((PlaceHolder)obj).Owner == item);
		}

		internal void MoveItemsTo(LayoutGroup group)
		{
			List<PlaceHolder> list = GetPlaceHolders().ToList();
			foreach (PlaceHolder item in list)
			{
				Remove(item);
				item.UpdateParent(group);
				group.PlaceHolderHelper.Insert(item.Index, item);
			}
		}

		internal static void DecomposeTo(BaseLayoutItem itemToDecompose, LayoutGroup newGroup)
		{
			DecomposeTo(itemToDecompose, newGroup, out var _);
		}

		internal static void DecomposeTo(BaseLayoutItem itemToDecompose, LayoutGroup newGroup, out IEnumerable<LayoutGroup> decomposedGroups)
		{
			List<LayoutGroup> list = new List<LayoutGroup>();
			DecomposeToCore(itemToDecompose, newGroup, list);
			decomposedGroups = list;
		}

		private static void DecomposeToCore(BaseLayoutItem itemToDecompose, LayoutGroup newGroup, List<LayoutGroup> decomposedGroups)
		{
			if (itemToDecompose is LayoutGroup layoutGroup)
			{
				decomposedGroups.Add(layoutGroup);
				ObservableCollection<object> source = layoutGroup.PlaceHolderHelper.itemsInternal;
				object[] array = source.ToArray();
				foreach (object obj in array)
				{
					PlaceHolder placeHolder = obj as PlaceHolder;
					if (placeHolder != null)
					{
						if (placeHolder.Owner is LayoutGroup)
						{
							DecomposeToCore((LayoutGroup)placeHolder.Owner, newGroup, decomposedGroups);
							continue;
						}
						placeHolder.Parent.PlaceHolderHelper.Remove(placeHolder);
						placeHolder.UpdateParent(newGroup);
					}
					if (obj is LayoutGroup itemToDecompose2)
					{
						DecomposeToCore(itemToDecompose2, newGroup, decomposedGroups);
						continue;
					}
					if (obj is BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem)
					{
						baseLayoutItem.Parent.Remove((BaseLayoutItem)obj);
						newGroup.Add((BaseLayoutItem)obj);
					}
					newGroup.PlaceHolderHelper.Add(obj);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				newGroup.Add(itemToDecompose);
				newGroup.PlaceHolderHelper.Add(itemToDecompose);
			}
		}
	}
}

		private class ContextMenuManager : IDisposable
		{
			private delegate PopupMenu CreateInstance();

			private readonly Dictionary<Type, PopupMenu> menuCache = new Dictionary<Type, PopupMenu>();

			private readonly Dictionary<Type, CreateInstance> initializers = new Dictionary<Type, CreateInstance>();

			private CustomizationController Controller;

			private readonly List<BaseLayoutElementMenu> menus = new List<BaseLayoutElementMenu>();

			private readonly Locker initializeLocker = new Locker();

			private bool isDisposing;

			public ItemsSelectorMenu ItemsSelectorMenu => GetMenuByType<ItemsSelectorMenu>();

			public ItemContextMenu ItemsContextMenu => GetMenuByType<ItemContextMenu>();

			public LayoutControlItemContextMenu LayoutControlItemMenu => GetMenuByType<LayoutControlItemContextMenu>();

			public LayoutControlItemCustomizationMenu LayoutControlItemCustomizationMenu => GetMenuByType<LayoutControlItemCustomizationMenu>();

			public HiddenItemContextMenu HiddenItemMenu => GetMenuByType<HiddenItemContextMenu>();

			public ContextMenuManager(CustomizationController controller)
			{
				//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_002c: Expected O, but got Unknown
				Controller = controller;
				InitializeFactory();
			}

			public void Initialize()
			{
				if (Locker.op_Implicit(initializeLocker))
				{
					return;
				}
				initializeLocker.LockOnce();
				foreach (KeyValuePair<Type, CreateInstance> initializer in initializers)
				{
					if (!menuCache.TryGetValue(initializer.Key, out var value))
					{
						value = initializer.Value();
						menuCache[initializer.Key] = value;
					}
				}
			}

			private void InitializeFactory()
			{
				initializers[typeof(ItemsSelectorMenu)] = () => (PopupMenu)(object)Controller.CreateItemsSelectorMenu().Do(delegate(ItemsSelectorMenu x)
				{
					menus.Add(x);
				});
				initializers[typeof(ItemContextMenu)] = () => (PopupMenu)(object)Controller.CreateItemContextMenu().Do(delegate(ItemContextMenu x)
				{
					menus.Add(x);
				});
				initializers[typeof(LayoutControlItemContextMenu)] = () => (PopupMenu)(object)Controller.CreateLayoutControlItemContextMenu().Do(delegate(LayoutControlItemContextMenu x)
				{
					menus.Add(x);
				});
				initializers[typeof(LayoutControlItemCustomizationMenu)] = () => (PopupMenu)(object)Controller.CreateLayoutControlItemCustomizationMenu().Do(delegate(LayoutControlItemCustomizationMenu x)
				{
					menus.Add(x);
				});
				initializers[typeof(HiddenItemContextMenu)] = () => (PopupMenu)(object)Controller.CreateHiddenItemMenu().Do(delegate(HiddenItemContextMenu x)
				{
					menus.Add(x);
				});
			}

			private TMenu GetMenuByType<TMenu>() where TMenu : PopupMenu
			{
				if (!menuCache.TryGetValue(typeof(TMenu), out var value) && initializers.TryGetValue(typeof(TMenu), out var value2))
				{
					value = value2();
					menuCache[typeof(TMenu)] = value;
				}
				TMenu val = (TMenu)(object)((value is TMenu) ? value : null);
				if (val == null)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException("type");
				}
				return val;
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				foreach (BaseLayoutElementMenu menu in menus)
				{
					menu.Close();
					((CustomizablePopupMenuBase)menu).ClearItems();
				}
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				if (!isDisposing)
				{
					isDisposing = true;
					Controller = null;
				}
				GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
			}
		}

						DockLayoutManager.AddLogicalChild(Container, (DependencyObject)(object)barManagerCore);

		static CustomizationController()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<CustomizationController> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<CustomizationController>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("IsCustomization", ref IsCustomizationProperty, defValue: false, OnIsCustomizationChanged, CoerceIsCustomization);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<ObservableCollection<BaseLayoutItem>>("CustomizationItems", ref CustomizationItemsProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<LayoutGroup>("CustomizationRoot", ref CustomizationRootProperty, null, OnCustomizationRootChanged, CoerceCustomizationRoot);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DragInfo>("DragInfo", ref DragInfoProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterDirectEvent<DragInfoChangedEventHandler>("DragInfoChanged", ref DragInfoChangedEvent);
		}

		private static void OnIsCustomizationChanged(DependencyObject obj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			DockLayoutManager container = ((CustomizationController)obj).Container;
			container.CoerceValue(DockLayoutManager.IsCustomizationProperty);
			container.RaiseEvent(new IsCustomizationChangedEventArgs((bool)e.NewValue)
			{
				Source = container
			});
		}

		private static object CoerceIsCustomization(DependencyObject dObj, object value)
		{
			if (!((CustomizationController)dObj).Container.IsInDesignTime)
			{
				return value;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static void OnCustomizationRootChanged(DependencyObject obj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((CustomizationController)obj).OnCustomizationRootChanged((LayoutGroup)e.NewValue);
		}

		private static object CoerceCustomizationRoot(DependencyObject obj, object baseValue)
		{
			return ((CustomizationController)obj).CoerceCustomizationRoot((LayoutGroup)baseValue);
		}

		public CustomizationController(DockLayoutManager container)
		{
			Container = container;
			Container.Unloaded += OnContainerUnloaded;
			Container.ClosedPanels.CollectionChanged += OnClosedPanelsCollectionChanged;
			CustomizationItems = new ObservableCollection<BaseLayoutItem>();
			contextMenuManager = new ContextMenuManager(this);
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(InitializeContextMenuManager));
		}

		private void InitializeContextMenuManager()
		{
			if (!isDisposing)
			{
				contextMenuManager.Initialize();
			}
		}

		private void OnContainerUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			contextMenuManager.Reset();
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeMenuController(BarManagerMenuController controller)
		{
			((FrameworkElement)(object)controller).DataContext = null;
			DockLayoutManager.AddLogicalChild(Container, (DependencyObject)(object)controller);
		}

		protected virtual BarManagerMenuController CreateMenuController()
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return new BarManagerMenuController();
		}

		void IDisposable.Dispose()
		{
			if (!isDisposing)
			{
				isDisposing = true;
				OnDisposing();
			}
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		protected virtual void OnDisposing()
		{
			Container.Unloaded -= OnContainerUnloaded;
			Container.ClosedPanels.CollectionChanged -= OnClosedPanelsCollectionChanged;
			barManagerCore = null;
			itemContextMenuController = null;
			itemsSelectorMenuController = null;
			layoutControlItemContextMenuController = null;
			layoutControlItemCustomizationMenuController = null;
			ClosedItemsBar = null;
			DisposeCustomizationForm();
			FloatingContainer dragCursorContainer = DragCursorContainer;
			if (dragCursorContainer != null)
			{
				dragCursorContainer.Close();
			}
			contextMenuManager.Dispose();
			Container = null;
		}

		private void DisposeCustomizationForm()
		{
			if (CustomizationForm != null)
			{
				((Window)(object)CustomizationForm).Closed -= CustomizationFormClosed;
				((ContentControl)(object)CustomizationForm).Content = null;
				((Window)(object)CustomizationForm).Close();
				CustomizationForm = null;
			}
			if (CustomizationControl != null)
			{
				DockLayoutManager.SetDockLayoutManager(CustomizationControl, null);
				CustomizationControl.Dispose();
				CustomizationControl = null;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnCustomizationRootChanged(LayoutGroup root)
		{
			this.ClearSelection();
			CustomizationItems.Clear();
			CustomizationItems.Add(root);
		}

		protected virtual object CoerceCustomizationRoot(LayoutGroup baseValue)

		protected virtual void OnClosedPanelsCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (EnsureClosedItemsBar())
			{
				switch (e.Action)
				{
				case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
					ClosedItemsBar.AddItems(e.NewItems);
					break;
				case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
					ClosedItemsBar.RemoveItems(e.OldItems);
					break;
				case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
					ClosedItemsBar.ResetItems(Container.ClosedPanels);
					break;
				}
				UpdateClosedItemsBarVisibility();
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateClosedItemsBarVisibility()
		{
			if (IsHideClosedItems)
			{
				HideClosedItemsBar();
			}
			else if (IsAutoShowClosedItems)
			{
				if (Container.ClosedPanels.Count == 0)
				{
					HideClosedItemsBar();
				}
				else
				{
					ShowClosedItemsBar();
				}
			}
		}

		public void UpdateClosedItemsBar()
		{
			if (EnsureClosedItemsBar())
			{
				ClosedItemsBar.UpdateItems(Container.ClosedPanels);
				UpdateClosedItemsBarVisibility();
			}
		}

		public void ShowItemSelectorMenu(UIElement source, BaseLayoutItem[] items)
		{
			CloseMenu();
			ItemsSelectorMenuController.Menu = (PopupMenu)(object)ItemsSelectorMenu;
			ItemsSelectorMenu.Show(source, items);
		}

		public void ShowContextMenu(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			CloseMenu();
			ItemContextMenuController.Menu = (PopupMenu)(object)ItemContextMenu;
			UIElement placementTarget = MenuSource ?? (item.GetUIElement<IUIElement>() as UIElement);
			ItemContextMenu.Show(item, placementTarget);
			MenuSource = null;
		}

		public void ShowControlItemContextMenu(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			CloseMenu();
			if (IsCustomization)
			{
				ShowControlItemCustomizationMenu(item);
			}
			else
			{
				ShowControlItemNormalMenu(item);
			}
		}

		private void ShowControlItemNormalMenu(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			LayoutControlItemContextMenuController.Menu = (PopupMenu)(object)LayoutControlItemContextMenu;
			LayoutControlItemContextMenu.Show(item);
		}

		private void ShowControlItemCustomizationMenu(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			LayoutControlItemCustomizationMenuController.Menu = (PopupMenu)(object)LayoutControlItemCustomizationMenu;
			UIElement source = MenuSource ?? (item.GetUIElement<IUIElement>() as UIElement);
			LayoutControlItemCustomizationMenu.Show(source, Selection.ToArray());
			MenuSource = null;
		}

		public void ShowHiddenItemMenu(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			CloseMenu();
			HiddenItemsMenuController.Menu = (PopupMenu)(object)HiddenItemContextMenu;
			UIElement placementTarget = MenuSource ?? (item.GetUIElement<IUIElement>() as UIElement);
			HiddenItemContextMenu.Show(item, placementTarget);
			MenuSource = null;
		}

		public void CloseMenu()
		{
			contextMenuManager.Reset();
			menuItemCounter = 0;
		}

		protected bool EnsureClosedItemsBar()
		{
			if (Container.ClosedItemsPanel == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ClosedItemsBar == null)
			{
				ClosedItemsBar = CreateClosedItemsBar();
			}
			else if (ClosedItemsBar.Panel == null)
			{
				ClosedItemsBar.UpdatePanel(Container.ClosedItemsPanel);
			}
			return ClosedItemsBar != null;
		}

		public void HideClosedItemsBar()
		{
			if (IsClosedPanelsVisible)
			{
				Container.LockClosedPanelsVisibility();
				try
				{
					((BarItemLinkHolderBase)ClosedItemsBar).Visible = false;
				}
				finally
				{
					Container.UnlockClosedPanelsVisibility();
				}
				closedItemCounter = ((Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)((BarItemLinkHolderBase)ClosedItemsBar).ItemLinks).Count;
			}
		}

		public void ShowClosedItemsBar()
		{
			if (IsClosedPanelsVisible || !CanShowClosedItems || !EnsureClosedItemsBar())
			{
				return;
			}
			Container.LockClosedPanelsVisibility();
			try
			{
				((BarItemLinkHolderBase)ClosedItemsBar).Visible = true;
			}
			finally
			{
				Container.UnlockClosedPanelsVisibility();
			}
		}

		public void ShowCustomizationForm()
		{
			if (IsCustomization && !IsCustomizationFormVisible && EnsureCustomizationForm())
			{
				EnsureDockLayoutManager();
				((UIElement)(object)CustomizationForm).Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				Container.RaiseEvent(new CustomizationFormVisibleChangedEventArgs(newValue: true)
				{
					Source = Container
				});
				((UIElement)(object)CustomizationForm).Focus();
			}
		}

		private void EnsureDockLayoutManager()
		{
			if (CustomizationControl != null && Container != null)
			{
				DockLayoutManager.SetDockLayoutManager(CustomizationControl, Container);
			}
		}

		private void CustomizationFormClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Container.RaiseEvent(new CustomizationFormVisibleChangedEventArgs(newValue: false)
			{
				Source = Container
			});
			if (lockHideCustomization <= 0)
			{
				EndCustomization();
			}
		}

		public void HideCustomizationForm()
		{
			if (CustomizationForm != null)
			{
				lockHideCustomization++;
				((UIElement)(object)CustomizationForm).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				Container.RaiseEvent(new CustomizationFormVisibleChangedEventArgs(newValue: false)
				{
					Source = Container
				});
				DockLayoutManager.SetDockLayoutManager(CustomizationControl, null);
				lockHideCustomization--;
			}
		}

		public void BeginCustomization()
		{
			if (Container.AllowCustomization)
			{
				IsCustomization = true;
				CustomizationRoot = Container.LayoutRoot;
				ShowCustomizationForm();
			}
		}

		public void EndCustomization()
		{
			this.ClearSelection();
			HideCustomizationForm();
			DisposeCustomizationForm();
			IsCustomization = false;
		}

		public void ShowDocumentSelectorForm()
		{
			if (Container.AllowDocumentSelector && EnsureDocumentSelectorContainer())
			{
				DocumentSelectorControl.InitializeItems(Container);
				if (DocumentSelectorControl.HasItemsToShow)
				{
					DocumentSelectorControl.SetSelectedItem();
					DocumentSelectorControl.PanelsCaption = DockingLocalizer.GetString(DockingStringId.DocumentSelectorPanels);
					DocumentSelectorControl.DocumentsCaption = DockingLocalizer.GetString(DockingStringId.DocumentSelectorDocuments);
					Size size = DocumentSelectorContainerFactory.GetSize(Container, new Size(400.0, 220.0));
					((ContentControl)(object)DocumentSelectorContainer).ContentTemplate = DocumentSelectorContainerFactory.GetTemplate(Container);
					((FrameworkElement)(object)DocumentSelectorContainer).Height = size.Height;
					((FrameworkElement)(object)DocumentSelectorContainer).Width = size.Width;
					Point location = DocumentSelectorContainerFactory.GetLocation(Container, size);
					((Window)(object)DocumentSelectorContainer).Top = location.Y;
					((Window)(object)DocumentSelectorContainer).Left = location.X;
					((UIElement)(object)DocumentSelectorContainer).Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				}
			}
		}

		public void HideDocumentSelectorForm()
		{
			if (DocumentSelectorContainer != null)
			{
				((Window)(object)DocumentSelectorContainer).Close();
				DocumentSelectorContainer = null;
			}
		}

		protected bool EnsureDocumentSelectorContainer()
		{
			if (DocumentSelectorContainer == null && EnsureDocumentSelectorControl())
			{
				DocumentSelectorContainer = CreateDocumentSelectorContainer();
			}
			return DocumentSelectorContainer != null;
		}

		protected bool EnsureDocumentSelectorControl()
		{
			if (DocumentSelectorControl == null)
			{
				DocumentSelectorControl = CreateDocumentSelectorControl();
				WindowHelper.BindFlowDirection(DocumentSelectorControl, Container);
			}
			return DocumentSelectorControl != null;
		}

		protected virtual DocumentSelector CreateDocumentSelectorControl()
		{
			return new DocumentSelector();
		}

		protected virtual ThemedWindow CreateDocumentSelectorContainer()
		{
			return DocumentSelectorContainerFactory.CreateDocumentSelectorContainer(Container, DocumentSelectorControl);
		}

		protected bool EnsureDragCursorContainer(Size size = default(Size))
		{
			if (DragCursorContainer == null)
			{
				if (EnsureDragCursorControl())
				{
					DragCursorContainer = CreateDragCursorContainer(size);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				((BaseFloatingContainer)DragCursorContainer).FloatSize = ((size == default(Size)) ? new Size(150.0, 150.0) : size);
				((BaseFloatingContainer)DragCursorContainer).Content = DragCursorControl;
			}
			if (Container.OwnsFloatWindows)
			{
				FloatingContainer dragCursorContainer = DragCursorContainer;
				((FloatingWindowContainer)(object)((dragCursorContainer is FloatingWindowContainer) ? dragCursorContainer : null)).With((FloatingWindowContainer x) => x.Window).Do(delegate(WindowContentHolder x)
				{
					((Window)(object)x).Owner = WindowServiceHelper.GetWindow(Container);
				});
			}
			return DragCursorContainer != null;
		}

		protected bool EnsureDragCursorControl()
		{
			if (DragCursorControl == null)
			{
				DragCursorControl = CreateDragCursorControl();
			}
			return DragCursorControl != null;
		}

		protected virtual FloatingContainer CreateDragCursorContainer(Size size = default(Size))
		{
			return DragCursorFactory.CreateDragCursorContainer(Container, DragCursorControl, size);
		}

		protected virtual DragCursorControl CreateDragCursorControl()
		{
			return new DragCursorControl();
		}

		private Point GetDragCursorPos(Point screenPoint, BaseLayoutItem dragItem)
		{
			if (dragItem != null && dragItem.IsItemWithRestrictedFloating() && dragItem.AllowFloat)
			{
				Rect dragCursorBounds = dragItem.DragCursorBounds;
				screenPoint -= new Vector(dragCursorBounds.Location.X, dragCursorBounds.Location.Y);
				if (!Container.IsDesktopFloatingMode)
				{
					screenPoint = DockLayoutManagerExtension.CorrectBoundsInAdorner(bounds: new Rect(screenPoint, dragCursorBounds.Size), container: Container).Location;
				}
				if (Container.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
				{
					screenPoint.X += dragCursorBounds.Size.Width;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Thickness floatingBorderMargin = dragItem.GetFloatingBorderMargin();
				screenPoint -= new Vector(floatingBorderMargin.Left, floatingBorderMargin.Top);
			}
			return screenPoint;
		}

		public void ShowDragCursor(Point point, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (!IsDragCursorVisible)
			{
				Size size = default(Size);
				if (item.IsItemWithRestrictedFloating() && item.AllowFloat)
				{
					size = item.DragCursorBounds.Size;
				}
				if (EnsureDragCursorContainer(size))
				{
					DragCursorControl.DragItem = item;
					((BaseFloatingContainer)DragCursorContainer).FloatLocation = GetDragCursorPos(point, item);
					Container.AddToLogicalTree(DragCursorContainer, DragCursorControl);
					((BaseFloatingContainer)DragCursorContainer).IsOpen = true;
				}
			}
		}

		public void HideDragCursor()
		{
			if (IsDragCursorVisible)
			{
				((BaseFloatingContainer)DragCursorContainer).IsOpen = false;
				Container.RemoveFromLogicalTree(DragCursorContainer, DragCursorControl);
				((BaseFloatingContainer)DragCursorContainer).Content = null;
				DragCursorControl.DragItem = null;
			}
		}

		public void SetDragCursorPosition(Point point)
		{
			if (IsDragCursorVisible)
			{
				((BaseFloatingContainer)DragCursorContainer).FloatLocation = GetDragCursorPos(point, DragCursorControl.DragItem);
			}
		}

		public FrameworkElement[] GetChildren()
		{
			List<FrameworkElement> list = new List<FrameworkElement>();
			if (barManagerCore != null && isOwnBarManager)
			{
				list.Add((FrameworkElement)(object)barManagerCore);
			}
			if (!IsCustomization)
			{
				return list.ToArray();
			}
			if (IsCustomizationFormVisible)
			{
				if (CustomizationForm != null)
				{
					list.Add((FrameworkElement)(object)CustomizationForm);
				}
				if (CustomizationControl != null)
				{
					list.Add(CustomizationControl);
					FrameworkElement[] children = CustomizationControl.GetChildren();
					for (int i = 0; i < children.Length; i++)
					{
						if (children[i] != null)
						{
							list.Add(children[i]);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (IsDragCursorVisible)
			{
				if (DragCursorContainer != null)
				{
					list.Add((FrameworkElement)(object)DragCursorContainer);
				}
				if (DragCursorControl != null)
				{
					list.Add(DragCursorControl);
					FrameworkElement[] children2 = DragCursorControl.GetChildren();
					for (int j = 0; j < children2.Length; j++)
					{
						if (children2[j] != null)
						{
							list.Add(children2[j]);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (IsDocumentSelectorContainerVisible)
			{
				if (DocumentSelectorContainer != null)
				{
					list.Add((FrameworkElement)(object)DocumentSelectorContainer);
				}
				if (DocumentSelectorControl != null)
				{
					list.Add(DocumentSelectorControl);
					FrameworkElement[] children3 = DocumentSelectorControl.GetChildren();
					for (int k = 0; k < children3.Length; k++)
					{
						if (children3[k] != null)
						{
							list.Add(children3[k]);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		protected bool EnsureCustomizationForm()
		{
			if (CustomizationForm == null && EnsureCustomizationControl())
			{
				CustomizationForm = CreateCustomizationForm();
				((Window)(object)CustomizationForm).Closed += CustomizationFormClosed;
			}
			return CustomizationForm != null;
		}

		protected bool EnsureCustomizationControl()
		{
			if (CustomizationControl == null)
			{
				CustomizationControl = CreateCustomizationControl();
			}
			return CustomizationControl != null;
		}

		protected virtual CustomizationControl CreateCustomizationControl()
		{
			return new CustomizationControl();
		}

		protected virtual ThemedWindow CreateCustomizationForm()
		{
			return CustomizationFormFactory.CreateCustomizationForm(Container, CustomizationControl);
		}

		public static string GetUniqueMenuItemName()
		{
			return $"MenuItem{++menuItemCounter}";
		}

		public static string GetUniqueClosedItemName()
		{
			return $"ClosedItem{++closedItemCounter}";
		}

		public T CreateCommand<T>() where T : CustomizationControllerCommand, new()
		{
			return new T
			{
				Controller = this
			};
		}

		public void DesignTimeRaiseEvent(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!isDisposing)
			{
				IUIElement rootUIScope = LayoutItemsHelper.GetIUIParent(sender as DependencyObject).GetRootUIScope();
				if (rootUIScope != null && Container.GetView(rootUIScope) is LayoutView layoutView)
				{
					layoutView.OnDesignTimeEvent(sender, e);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public static class CustomizationControllerHelper
	{
		private static ICustomizationController GetCustomizationController(DockLayoutManager container)
		{
			return container?.CustomizationController;
		}

		public static CustomizationControllerCommand CreateCommand(DockLayoutManager container)
		{
			ICustomizationController customizationController = GetCustomizationController(container);
			if (!customizationController.IsClosedPanelsVisible)
			{
				return CreateCommand<ShowClosedItemsCommand>(container);
			}
			return CreateCommand<HideClosedItemsCommand>(container);
		}

		public static T CreateCommand<T>(DockLayoutManager container) where T : CustomizationControllerCommand, new()
		{
			ICustomizationController customizationController = GetCustomizationController(container);
			if (customizationController == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return customizationController.CreateCommand<T>();
		}

		public static void AssignCommand(BarItem item, ICommand command, UIElement commandTarget)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				item.Command = command;
				item.CommandTarget = commandTarget;
			}
		}
	}
	internal static class CustomizationControllerExtensions
	{
		public static void ClearSelection(this ICustomizationController controller)
		{
			if (controller != null)
			{
				LayoutGroup customizationRoot = controller.CustomizationRoot;
				DockLayoutManager container = controller.Container;
				if (customizationRoot != null && container != null)
				{
					IView view = container.GetView(customizationRoot);
					container.ViewAdapter.SelectionService.ClearSelection(view);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class DragInfo
	{
		private readonly int _hash;

		public BaseLayoutItem Item { get; private set; }

		public BaseLayoutItem Target { get; private set; }

		public DropType Type { get; private set; }

		public DragInfo(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem target, DropType type)
		{
			Item = item;
			Target = target;
			Type = type;
			_hash = HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<DropType, BaseLayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem>(type, item, target);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			DragInfo dragInfo = obj as DragInfo;
			if (dragInfo != null && EqualityComparer<BaseLayoutItem>.Default.Equals(Item, dragInfo.Item) && EqualityComparer<BaseLayoutItem>.Default.Equals(Target, dragInfo.Target))
			{
				return Type == dragInfo.Type;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _hash;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(DragInfo left, DragInfo right)
		{
			return object.Equals(left, right);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(DragInfo left, DragInfo right)
		{
			return !object.Equals(left, right);
		}
	}
	public delegate void DragInfoChangedEventHandler(object sender, DragInfoChangedEventArgs e);
	public class DragInfoChangedEventArgs : RoutedEventArgs
	{
		public DragInfo Info { get; private set; }

		public DragInfoChangedEventArgs(DragInfo info)
		{
			Info = info;
			base.RoutedEvent = CustomizationController.DragInfoChangedEvent;
		}

		protected override void InvokeEventHandler(Delegate genericHandler, object genericTarget)
		{
			((DragInfoChangedEventHandler)genericHandler)(genericTarget, this);
		}
	}
	public abstract class CustomizationControllerCommand : ICommand
	{
		private class CustomizationControllerCommandLink : RoutedCommand
		{
			public CustomizationControllerCommand Command { get; private set; }

			public CustomizationControllerCommandLink(string name, CustomizationControllerCommand command)
				: base(name, typeof(CustomizationControllerCommand))
			{
				Command = command;
			}
		}

		protected internal ICustomizationController Controller { get; set; }

		public static RoutedCommand ShowClosedItems { get; private set; }

		public static RoutedCommand HideClosedItems { get; private set; }

		private event EventHandler CanExecuteChangedCore;

		event EventHandler ICommand.CanExecuteChanged
		{
			add
			{
				CanExecuteChangedCore += value;
			}
			remove
			{
				CanExecuteChangedCore -= value;
			}
		}

		internal CustomizationControllerCommand()
		{
		}

		protected abstract void ExecuteCore(ICustomizationController controller);

		protected abstract bool CanExecuteCore(ICustomizationController controller);

		protected void RaiseCanExecuteChanged()
		{
			if (this.CanExecuteChangedCore != null)
			{
				this.CanExecuteChangedCore(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		bool ICommand.CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (Controller != null)
			{
				return CanExecuteCore(Controller);
			}
			return false;
		}

		void ICommand.Execute(object parameter)
		{
			if (Controller != null)
			{
				ExecuteCore(Controller);
			}
		}

		static CustomizationControllerCommand()
		{
			ShowClosedItems = new CustomizationControllerCommandLink("ShowClosedItems", new ShowClosedItemsCommand());
			HideClosedItems = new CustomizationControllerCommandLink("HideClosedItems", new HideClosedItemsCommand());
		}

		internal static void CanExecute(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			ICustomizationController customizationController = GetCustomizationController(DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager(sender as DependencyObject));
			CustomizationControllerCommand command = ((CustomizationControllerCommandLink)e.Command).Command;
			e.CanExecute = customizationController != null && command.CanExecuteCore(customizationController);
		}

		internal static void Executed(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			ICustomizationController customizationController = GetCustomizationController(DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager(sender as DependencyObject));
			if (customizationController != null && e.Parameter != null)
			{
				CustomizationControllerCommand command = ((CustomizationControllerCommandLink)e.Command).Command;
				command.ExecuteCore(customizationController);
			}
		}

		private static ICustomizationController GetCustomizationController(DockLayoutManager container)
		{
			return container?.CustomizationController;
		}
	}
	public class ShowClosedItemsCommand : CustomizationControllerCommand
	{
		protected override bool CanExecuteCore(ICustomizationController controller)
		{
			if (controller.ClosedPanelsBarVisibility != ClosedPanelsBarVisibility.Never && controller.Container.ClosedPanels.Count > 0)
			{
				return !controller.IsClosedPanelsVisible;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void ExecuteCore(ICustomizationController controller)
		{
			controller.ShowClosedItemsBar();
			if (controller.Container.ClosedPanelsBarVisibility == ClosedPanelsBarVisibility.Auto)
			{
				controller.Container.ClosedPanelsBarVisibility = ClosedPanelsBarVisibility.Manual;
			}
		}
	}
	public class HideClosedItemsCommand : CustomizationControllerCommand
	{
		protected override bool CanExecuteCore(ICustomizationController controller)
		{
			return controller.IsClosedPanelsVisible;
		}

		protected override void ExecuteCore(ICustomizationController controller)
		{
			controller.HideClosedItemsBar();
			if (controller.Container.ClosedPanelsBarVisibility == ClosedPanelsBarVisibility.Auto)
			{
				controller.Container.ClosedPanelsBarVisibility = ClosedPanelsBarVisibility.Manual;
			}
		}
	}
	public class ShowCustomizationFormCommand : CustomizationControllerCommand
	{
		protected override bool CanExecuteCore(ICustomizationController controller)
		{
			if (!controller.IsCustomizationFormVisible)
			{
				return controller.IsCustomization;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void ExecuteCore(ICustomizationController controller)
		{
			controller.ShowCustomizationForm();
		}
	}
	public class HideCustomizationFormCommand : CustomizationControllerCommand
	{
		protected override bool CanExecuteCore(ICustomizationController controller)
		{
			if (controller.IsCustomizationFormVisible)
			{
				return controller.IsCustomization;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void ExecuteCore(ICustomizationController controller)
		{
			controller.HideCustomizationForm();
		}
	}
	public class EndCustomizationCommand : CustomizationControllerCommand
	{
		protected override bool CanExecuteCore(ICustomizationController controller)
		{
			return controller.IsCustomization;
		}

		protected override void ExecuteCore(ICustomizationController controller)
		{
			controller.EndCustomization();
		}
	}
	public class BeginCustomizationCommand : CustomizationControllerCommand
	{
		protected override bool CanExecuteCore(ICustomizationController controller)
		{
			return !controller.IsCustomization;
		}

		protected override void ExecuteCore(ICustomizationController controller)
		{
			controller.BeginCustomization();
		}
	}
	public class CustomizationFormFactory
	{
		private static Size DesiredSize = new Size(350.0, 400.0);

		public static ThemedWindow CreateCustomizationForm(DockLayoutManager manager, object content)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ThemedWindow val = new ThemedWindow();
			((Window)(object)val).Owner = Window.GetWindow(manager);
			((FrameworkElement)(object)val).MinWidth = 300.0;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)val).MinHeight = 300.0;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)val).Width = DesiredSize.Width;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)val).Height = DesiredSize.Height;
			val.ControlBoxButtonSet = (ControlBoxButtons)1;
			Point point = CalcFormLocation(manager, val);
			((Window)(object)val).Top = point.Y;
			((Window)(object)val).Left = point.X;
			val.Icon = ImageHelper.GetImage("Customization");
			((Window)(object)val).Title = DockingLocalizer.GetString(DockingStringId.TitleCustomizationForm);
			((ContentControl)(object)val).Content = content;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)val).FlowDirection = manager.FlowDirection;
			((DependencyObject)content).SetValue(DockLayoutManager.DockLayoutManagerProperty, manager);
			manager.RegisterView((CustomizationControl)content);
			return val;
		}

		private static Point CalcFormLocation(DockLayoutManager owner, ThemedWindow container)
		{
			Point point = new Point(owner.ActualWidth - ((FrameworkElement)(object)container).Width, 0.0);
			if (owner.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
			{
				point.X += ((FrameworkElement)(object)container).Width;
			}
			if (!DockLayoutManagerHelper.IsPopupRoot(LayoutHelper.FindRoot((DependencyObject)owner, false)))
			{
				Window window = Window.GetWindow(owner);
				if (window != null)
				{
					Point point2 = window.TransformToDescendant(owner).Transform(point);
					if (point2.Y > 0.0)
					{
						point.Y = point2.Y;
					}
				}
				point = ScreenHelper.GetScreenLocation(point, (FrameworkElement)owner, false);
				return ScreenHelper.UpdateContainerLocation(new Rect(point, new Size(((FrameworkElement)(object)container).Width, ((FrameworkElement)(object)container).Height)));
			}
			return point;
		}
	}

		public static object GetContent(MenuItems type)
		{
			if (!ContentCache.TryGetValue(type, out var value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return value;
		}

		public static ImageSource GetGlyph(MenuItems type)
		{
			if (!GlyphCache.TryGetValue(type, out var value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return value;
		}

		public static string GetUniqueName(MenuItems type)
		{
			if (!MenuItemsUniqueNames.TryGetValue(type, out var value))
			{
				return CustomizationController.GetUniqueMenuItemName();
			}
			return value;
		}

		public static MenuItems? GetMenuItemByUniqueName(string name)
		{
			foreach (MenuItems key in MenuItemsUniqueNames.Keys)
			{
				if (MenuItemsUniqueNames[key] == name)
				{
					return key;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	public delegate void HotItemChangedEventHandler(object sender, HotItemChangedEventArgs e);

	{
		public BaseLayoutItem Hot { get; private set; }

		{
			Hot = hot;
			PrevHot = prevHot;
		}

		protected override void InvokeEventHandler(Delegate genericHandler, object genericTarget)
		{
			((HotItemChangedEventHandler)genericHandler)(genericTarget, this);
		}
	}

	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_PaneContent", Type = typeof(FrameworkElement))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_Sizer", Type = typeof(ElementSizer))]
	public class AutoHidePane : psvContentControl, IUIElement
	{
		private enum PanelSizeAction
		{
			Expand,
			Maximize,
			Resize
		}

		private class AnimationContext

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PanelSizeProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty AutoHideTrayProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey IsCollapsedPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsCollapsedProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey IsSizerVisiblePropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsSizerVisibleProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DisplayModeProperty;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty AutoHideSizeProperty;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty SizeToContentProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ViewStyleProperty;

		private readonly Locker containerSizeLocker = new Locker();

		private readonly WeakList<EventHandler> layoutItemChangedHandlers = new WeakList<EventHandler>();

		private AnimationContext _Context;

		private AutoHideGroup animatedGroup;

		private Size arrangeSize;

		private Size borderSize;

		private bool firstMeasure = true;

		private int isClosing;

		private int isSizing;

		private UIChildren uiChildren = new UIChildren();

		public DockingViewStyle ViewStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return (DockingViewStyle)GetValue(ViewStyleProperty);

		public AutoHideTray AutoHideTray

		public bool CanCollapse => CanCollapseCore();

		public bool CanHideCurrentItem => CanHideCurrentItemCore();

		public AutoHideMode DisplayMode

				return (double)GetValue(PanelSizeProperty);
