		public AutoHidePanePresenter PartAutoHidePresenter { get; private set; }

		public Border PartPaneBorder { get; private set; }

		public FrameworkElement PartPaneContent { get; private set; }

		public FrameworkElement PartPaneContentPresenter { get; private set; }

		internal ElementSizer PartSizer { get; private set; }

		protected internal double Size { get; private set; }

		protected Orientation Orientation => AutoHideTray.GetOrientation(this);

		private DoubleAnimation CollapseAnimation { get; set; }

		private AnimationContext Context => _Context ?? (_Context = new AnimationContext());

		private DoubleAnimation ExpandAnimation { get; set; }

		private bool IsHorz => Orientation == Orientation.Vertical;

		private bool IsSizing => isSizing > 0;

		private LayoutPanel LayoutPanel => base.LayoutItem as LayoutPanel;

		private SizeToContent SizeToContent
		{
			get
			{
				return (SizeToContent)GetValue(SizeToContentProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(SizeToContentProperty, value);
			}
		}

		IUIElement IUIElement.Scope => AutoHideTray;

		UIChildren IUIElement.Children => uiChildren ?? (uiChildren = new UIChildren());

		internal event EventHandler LayoutItemChanged
		{
			add
			{
				layoutItemChangedHandlers.Add(value);
			}
			remove
			{
				layoutItemChangedHandlers.Remove(value);
			}
		}

		static AutoHidePane()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<AutoHidePane> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<AutoHidePane>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<AutoHidePane>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("PanelSize", ref PanelSizeProperty, 0.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure, null, (DependencyObject dObj, object value) => ((AutoHidePane)dObj).CoercePanelSize((double)value));
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("DockType", ref DockTypePropertyKey, ref DockTypeProperty, Dock.Left);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<AutoHideTray>("AutoHideTray", ref AutoHideTrayProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((AutoHidePane)dObj).OnAutoHideTrayChanged(e.OldValue as AutoHideTray, e.NewValue as AutoHideTray);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("IsCollapsed", ref IsCollapsedPropertyKey, ref IsCollapsedProperty, defValue: true, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((AutoHidePane)dObj).OnIsCollapsedChanged((bool)e.OldValue, (bool)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("IsSizerVisible", ref IsSizerVisiblePropertyKey, ref IsSizerVisibleProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("DisplayMode", ref DisplayModeProperty, AutoHideMode.Default, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((AutoHidePane)dObj).OnDisplayModeChanged((AutoHideMode)e.OldValue, (AutoHideMode)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("AutoHideSize", ref AutoHideSizeProperty, default(Size), delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((AutoHidePane)d).OnAutoHideSizeChanged((Size)e.OldValue, (Size)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("SizeToContent", ref SizeToContentProperty, SizeToContent.Manual, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((AutoHidePane)d).OnSizeToContentChanged((SizeToContent)e.OldValue, (SizeToContent)e.NewValue);
			});
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<AutoHidePane>.New().Register<DockingViewStyle>("ViewStyle", ref ViewStyleProperty, DockingViewStyle.Default, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		public AutoHidePane()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ContentControlHelper.SetContentIsNotLogical((ContentControl)this, true);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			PartAutoHidePresenter = GetTemplateChild("PART_Presenter") as AutoHidePanePresenter;
			PartPaneContent = GetTemplateChild("PART_PaneContent") as FrameworkElement;
			PartPaneBorder = GetTemplateChild("PART_PaneBorder") as Border;
			PartSizer = GetTemplateChild("PART_Sizer") as ElementSizer;
			if (PartPaneBorder != null)
			{
				UpdatePaneBorder();
			}
			if (base.Container != null)
			{
				base.Container.SizeChanged += OnContainerSizeChanged;
				base.Container.AutoHideLayer.Do(delegate(FrameworkElement x)
				{
					x.SizeChanged += OnContainerSizeChanged;
				});
			}
			base.LayoutUpdated += OnLayoutUpdated;
		}

		protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size arrangeBounds)
		{
			arrangeSize = base.ArrangeOverride(arrangeBounds);
			return arrangeSize;
		}

		protected virtual bool CanCollapseCore()
		{
			BaseLayoutItem layoutItem = DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(this);
			if (layoutItem == null || !layoutItem.IsActive)
			{
				if (!KeyboardFocusHelper.IsKeyboardFocused(this))
				{
					return !KeyboardFocusHelper.IsKeyboardFocusWithin(this);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool CanHideCurrentItemCore()
		{
			if (KeyboardFocusHelper.IsKeyboardFocusWithin(this))
			{
				DependencyObject focusedElement = KeyboardFocusHelper.FocusedElement;
				if (focusedElement != null)
				{
					DependencyObject dependencyObject = LayoutHelper.FindRoot(focusedElement, false);
					if (dependencyObject != null && !DockLayoutManagerHelper.IsPopupRoot(dependencyObject))
					{
						return !DragManager.GetIsDragging(dependencyObject);
					}
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual object CoercePanelSize(double size)
		{
			if (isClosing > 0)
			{
				size = 0.0;
			}
			if (IsSizing)
			{
				size = Size;
			}
			return size;
		}

		private void EnsureBorderSize()
		{
			if (PartPaneContentPresenter == null)
			{
				EnsurePaneContentPresenter();
			}
			if (PartPaneContentPresenter != null && PartPaneContent != null)
			{
				if (base.LayoutItem == null)
				{
					borderSize = PartPaneContent.DesiredSize;
				}
				else
				{
					borderSize = new Size(PartPaneContent.DesiredSize.Width - PartPaneContentPresenter.DesiredSize.Width, PartPaneContent.DesiredSize.Width - PartPaneContentPresenter.DesiredSize.Width);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size constraint)
		{
			Size constraint2 = constraint;
			bool flag = Orientation == Orientation.Vertical;
			bool sizeToContent = GetSizeToContent(flag);
			if (sizeToContent)
			{
				PanelSize = double.NaN;
				constraint2 = (flag ? new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, constraint2.Height) : new Size(constraint2.Width, double.PositiveInfinity));
			}
			if (firstMeasure && base.LayoutItem == null)
			{
				IsSizerVisible = true;
			}
			Size size = base.MeasureOverride(constraint2);
			if (sizeToContent && flag && LayoutPanel != null && !DockLayoutManagerParameters.AutoHidePanelsAutoSizeDependsOnCaption)
			{
				DockPaneContentPresenter dockPaneContentPresenter = LayoutTreeHelper.GetVisualChildren((DependencyObject)LayoutPanel).OfType<DockPaneContentPresenter>().FirstOrDefault();
				DockPaneHeaderPresenter dockPaneHeaderPresenter = LayoutTreeHelper.GetVisualChildren((DependencyObject)LayoutPanel).OfType<DockPaneHeaderPresenter>().FirstOrDefault();
				if (dockPaneContentPresenter != null && dockPaneHeaderPresenter != null)
				{
					double num = Math.Max(0.0, dockPaneHeaderPresenter.DesiredSize.Width - dockPaneContentPresenter.DesiredSize.Width);
					if (num > 0.0)
					{
						size = base.MeasureOverride(new Size(size.Width - num, constraint2.Height));
					}
				}
			}
			if (firstMeasure)
			{
				if (base.LayoutItem == null)
				{
					base.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				EnsureBorderSize();
				UpdateIsSizerVisible();
				firstMeasure = false;
			}
			return new Size(Math.Min(size.Width, constraint.Width), Math.Min(size.Height, constraint.Height));
		}

		protected virtual void OnAutoHideTrayChanged(AutoHideTray oldTray, AutoHideTray newTray)
		{
			UnSubscribe(oldTray);
			Subscribe(newTray);
		}

		protected virtual void OnCollapsed(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			AutoHideGroup autoHideGroup = GetAutoHideGroup();
			if (autoHideGroup != null)
			{
				animatedGroup = autoHideGroup;
				double panelSize = PanelSize;
				CompletePreviousAnimation(isCollapsed: true);
				autoHideGroup.IsAnimated = true;
				bool isHorz = Orientation == Orientation.Vertical;
				double actualSize = GetActualSize(isHorz);
				double value = ((!double.IsNaN(panelSize)) ? Math.Min(panelSize, actualSize) : actualSize);
				if (autoHideGroup.AutoHideSpeed > 0)
				{
					CollapseAnimation = new DoubleAnimation
					{
						From = value,
						To = 0.0,
						Duration = new Duration(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(autoHideGroup.AutoHideSpeed))
					};
					CollapseAnimation.Completed += OnCollapseAnimationCompleted;
					AutoHideTray.IsAnimated = true;
					BeginAnimation(PanelSizeProperty, CollapseAnimation);
				}
				else
				{
					OnCollapseCompleted();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return (AutomationPeer)(object)new AutoHidePaneAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			CancelAnimation();
			UnSubscribe(AutoHideTray);
			if (PartPaneContentPresenter != null)
			{
				PartPaneContentPresenter.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty);
				PartPaneContentPresenter.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.HeightProperty);
			}
			if (PartAutoHidePresenter != null)
			{
				PartAutoHidePresenter.Dispose();
				PartAutoHidePresenter = null;
			}
			if (base.Container != null)
			{
				base.Container.SizeChanged -= OnContainerSizeChanged;
				base.Container.AutoHideLayer.Do(delegate(FrameworkElement x)
				{
					x.SizeChanged -= OnContainerSizeChanged;
				});
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected virtual void OnExpanded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			AutoHideGroup autoHideGroup = GetAutoHideGroup();
			if (autoHideGroup != null)
			{
				ExpandWithAnimation(autoHideGroup, PanelSizeAction.Expand);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnHotItemChanged(object sender, HotItemChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			SetValue(DockLayoutManager.LayoutItemProperty, e.Hot);
			if (e.Hot != null)
			{
				e.Hot.SelectTemplateIfNeeded();
			}
			SetValue(ContentControl.ContentProperty, e.Hot);
			if (ExpandAnimation != null)
			{
				RecalculatePanelSize();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnLayoutItemChanged(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem oldItem)
		{
			base.OnLayoutItemChanged(item, oldItem);
			if (oldItem != null)
			{
				oldItem.ClearTemplate();
				ClearValue(AutoHideSizeProperty);
				ClearValue(SizeToContentProperty);
			}
			if (item != null)
			{
				BindBorderCursor();
				item.SelectTemplateIfNeeded();
				DockLayoutManager.SetUIScope(item, this);
				SetBinding(AutoHideSizeProperty, new Binding
				{
					Path = new PropertyPath(AutoHideGroup.AutoHideSizeProperty),
					Source = item
				});
				SetBinding(SizeToContentProperty, new Binding
				{
					Path = new PropertyPath(AutoHideGroup.SizeToContentProperty),
					Source = item
				});
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, ViewStyleProperty, base.LayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem.DockingViewStyleProperty);
			}
			else
			{
				ClosePaneCore(oldItem);
				IsCollapsed = true;
				base.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				ClearValue(ViewStyleProperty);
			}
			foreach (EventHandler layoutItemChangedHandler in layoutItemChangedHandlers)
			{
				layoutItemChangedHandler(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnPanelClosed(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			isClosing++;
			CoerceValue(PanelSizeProperty);
			ClearValue(ContentControl.ContentProperty);
			CancelAnimation();
			Size = 0.0;
			ClosePaneCore();
			isClosing--;
		}

		protected virtual void OnPanelResizing(object sender, PanelResizingEventArgs e)
		{
			AutoHideGroup autoHideGroup = GetAutoHideGroup();
			if (base.LayoutItem != null && autoHideGroup != null && PartPaneContentPresenter != null)
			{
				isSizing++;
				base.LayoutItem.ResizeLockHelper.Lock();
				bool isHorz = IsHorz;
				double num = (isHorz ? base.ActualWidth : base.ActualHeight) - e.Size;
				double desiredSize = (isHorz ? PartPaneContentPresenter.ActualWidth : PartPaneContentPresenter.ActualHeight) - num;
				Size = CalcPanelSize(PanelSizeAction.Resize, autoHideGroup, base.LayoutItem, desiredSize);
				Size autoHideSize = AutoHideGroup.GetAutoHideSize(base.LayoutItem);
				AutoHideGroup.SetAutoHideSize(base.LayoutItem, isHorz ? new Size(Size, autoHideSize.Height) : new Size(autoHideSize.Width, Size));
				AutoHideGroup.SetSizeToContent(base.LayoutItem, SizeToContent.Manual);
				(base.LayoutItem as LayoutPanel).If((LayoutPanel x) => x.AutoHideExpandState == AutoHideExpandState.Expanded).Do(delegate(LayoutPanel x)
				{
					x.SetCurrentValue(LayoutPanel.AutoHideExpandStateProperty, AutoHideExpandState.Visible);
				});
				CoerceValue(PanelSizeProperty);
				isSizing--;
			}
		}

		private void ApplyPanelSize(double size = double.NaN)
		{
			double num = (double.IsNaN(size) ? Size : size);
			double panelSize = (Size = num);
			PanelSize = panelSize;
			BeginAnimation(PanelSizeProperty, null);
			if (GetSizeToContent(IsHorz))
			{
				PanelSize = double.NaN;
			}
			AutoHideTray.IsAnimated = false;
			AutoHideGroup autoHideGroup = GetAutoHideGroup();
			if (autoHideGroup != null)
			{
				autoHideGroup.SelectedTabIndex = autoHideGroup.Items.IndexOf(base.LayoutItem);
				autoHideGroup.IsAnimated = false;
				autoHideGroup.IsExpanded = true;
			}
			animatedGroup = null;
		}

		private void BindBorderCursor()
		{
			Cursor cursor = DockType.ToCursor();
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(PartPaneBorder, FrameworkElement.CursorProperty, base.LayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem.AllowSizingProperty, new ConditionalCursorConverter
			{
				Cursor = cursor
			});
		}

		private void BindPanelSizeToContentSize()
		{
			bool flag = AutoHideTray.GetOrientation(this) == Orientation.Vertical;
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(PartPaneContentPresenter, flag ? FrameworkElement.WidthProperty : FrameworkElement.HeightProperty, this, "PanelSize");
		}

		private double CalcPanelSize(PanelSizeAction action, AutoHideGroup aGroup, BaseLayoutItem layoutItem, double desiredSize = double.NaN)
		{
			bool isHorz = IsHorz;
			if (LayoutPanel.Return((LayoutPanel x) => x.AutoHideExpandState == AutoHideExpandState.Expanded, () => false))
			{
				action = PanelSizeAction.Maximize;
			}
			double availableAutoHideSize = GetAvailableAutoHideSize(isHorz);
			bool flag = !double.IsNaN(availableAutoHideSize);
			double num = 0.0;
			switch (action)
			{
			case PanelSizeAction.Expand:
			{
				Size actualAutoHideSize = aGroup.GetActualAutoHideSize(layoutItem);
				num = MathHelper.MeasureDimension(isHorz ? aGroup.ActualMinSize.Width : aGroup.ActualMinSize.Height, isHorz ? aGroup.ActualMaxSize.Width : aGroup.ActualMaxSize.Height, isHorz ? actualAutoHideSize.Width : actualAutoHideSize.Height);
				if (flag)
				{
					num = Math.Min(num, availableAutoHideSize);
				}
				break;
			}
			case PanelSizeAction.Maximize:
				if (flag)
				{
					num = availableAutoHideSize;
				}
				num = MathHelper.MeasureDimension(isHorz ? aGroup.ActualMinSize.Width : aGroup.ActualMinSize.Height, isHorz ? aGroup.ActualMaxSize.Width : aGroup.ActualMaxSize.Height, num);
				break;
			case PanelSizeAction.Resize:
			{
				double num2 = (isHorz ? (GetActualSize(isHorz) - layoutItem.ActualWidth) : (GetActualSize(isHorz) - layoutItem.ActualHeight));
				num = MathHelper.MeasureDimension(isHorz ? (layoutItem.ActualMinSize.Width + num2) : (layoutItem.ActualMinSize.Height + num2), isHorz ? layoutItem.ActualMaxSize.Width : layoutItem.ActualMaxSize.Height, desiredSize);
				num = MathHelper.MeasureDimension(isHorz ? aGroup.ActualMinSize.Width : aGroup.ActualMinSize.Height, isHorz ? aGroup.ActualMaxSize.Width : aGroup.ActualMaxSize.Height, num);
				if (flag)
				{
					num = Math.Min(num, availableAutoHideSize);
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private void CancelAnimation()
		{
			BeginAnimation(PanelSizeProperty, null);
			if (ExpandAnimation != null || CollapseAnimation != null)
			{
				if (ExpandAnimation != null)
				{
					ExpandAnimation.Completed -= OnExpandAnimationCompleted;
					ExpandAnimation = null;
				}
				if (CollapseAnimation != null)
				{
					CollapseAnimation.Completed -= OnCollapseAnimationCompleted;
					CollapseAnimation = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ClosePaneCore(BaseLayoutItem item = null)
		{
			AutoHideGroup autoHideGroup = GetAutoHideGroup() ?? item.Return((BaseLayoutItem x) => x.Parent as AutoHideGroup, () => (AutoHideGroup)null);
			if (autoHideGroup != null)
			{
				autoHideGroup.IsAnimated = false;
				autoHideGroup.IsExpanded = false;
				if (!AutoHideTray.IsExpandingLocked)
				{
					autoHideGroup.ClearValue(LayoutGroup.SelectedTabIndexProperty);
				}
			}
		}

		private void CompletePreviousAnimation(bool isCollapsed)
		{
			bool flag = CollapseAnimation != null;
			bool flag2 = ExpandAnimation != null;
			CancelAnimation();
			AutoHideGroup autoHideGroup = animatedGroup;
			if (autoHideGroup == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				autoHideGroup.SelectedTabIndex = autoHideGroup.Items.IndexOf(base.LayoutItem);
				autoHideGroup.IsAnimated = false;
				autoHideGroup.IsExpanded = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				autoHideGroup.IsAnimated = false;
				autoHideGroup.IsExpanded = false;
				if (isCollapsed)
				{
					autoHideGroup.ClearValue(LayoutGroup.SelectedTabIndexProperty);
				}
			}
		}

		private void EnsurePaneContentPresenter()
		{
			PartPaneContentPresenter = LayoutItemsHelper.GetTemplateChild<ContentPresenter>(PartPaneContent ?? this);
			if (PartPaneContentPresenter != null)
			{
				BindPanelSizeToContentSize();
			}
		}

		private void ExpandWithAnimation(double to, double from = 0.0)
		{
			AutoHideGroup autoHideGroup = GetAutoHideGroup();
			if (autoHideGroup != null)
			{
				autoHideGroup.IsAnimated = true;
				if (Context.IsAnimationEnabled && autoHideGroup.AutoHideSpeed > 0 && to != from)
				{
					ExpandAnimation = new DoubleAnimation
					{
						From = from,
						To = to,
						Duration = new Duration(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(autoHideGroup.AutoHideSpeed))
					};
					ExpandAnimation.Completed += OnExpandAnimationCompleted;
					AutoHideTray.IsAnimated = true;
					BeginAnimation(PanelSizeProperty, ExpandAnimation);
				}
				else
				{
					ApplyPanelSize(to);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ExpandWithAnimation(AutoHideGroup aGroup, PanelSizeAction action, bool isAnimationAllowed = true)
		{
			base.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			Context.IsAnimationEnabled = isAnimationAllowed;
			bool isHorz = IsHorz;
			if (ExpandAnimation != null || CollapseAnimation != null)
			{
				Size = GetActualSize(isHorz);
			}
			CompletePreviousAnimation(isCollapsed: false);
			animatedGroup = aGroup;
			if (GetSizeToContent(isHorz))
			{
				InvalidateMeasure();
				base.LayoutUpdated += OnLayoutUpdatedOnAutoSize;
			}
			else
			{
				double size = Size;
				Size = CalcPanelSize(action, aGroup, base.LayoutItem);
				ExpandWithAnimation(Size, size);
			}
			LayoutPanel.With((LayoutPanel x) => x.ExpandAnimationLocker).Do(delegate(Locker x)
			{
				x.Lock();
			});
			LayoutPanel.If((LayoutPanel x) => x.AutoHideExpandState == AutoHideExpandState.Hidden).Do(delegate(LayoutPanel x)
			{
				x.SetCurrentValue(LayoutPanel.AutoHideExpandStateProperty, (action != PanelSizeAction.Maximize) ? AutoHideExpandState.Visible : AutoHideExpandState.Expanded);
			});
			LayoutPanel.With((LayoutPanel x) => x.ExpandAnimationLocker).Do(delegate(Locker x)
			{
				x.Unlock();
			});
			IsCollapsed = false;
		}

		private double GetActualSize(bool isHorz)
		{
			if (PartPaneContentPresenter == null)
			{
				if (!isHorz)
				{
					return base.ActualHeight;
				}
				return base.ActualWidth;
			}
			if (!isHorz)
			{
				return PartPaneContentPresenter.ActualHeight;
			}
			return PartPaneContentPresenter.ActualWidth;
		}

		private AutoHideGroup GetAutoHideGroup()
		{
			BaseLayoutItem layoutItem = DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(this);
			return layoutItem.With((BaseLayoutItem x) => x.Parent) as AutoHideGroup;
		}

		private double GetAvailableAutoHideSize(bool isHorz)
		{
			DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = base.Container ?? DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager(this);
			if (dockLayoutManager == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			double availableAutoHideSize = dockLayoutManager.GetAvailableAutoHideSize(isHorz);
			if (double.IsNaN(availableAutoHideSize))
			{
				return availableAutoHideSize;
			}
			double num = ((DisplayMode == AutoHideMode.Inline) ? PartSizer.Return((ElementSizer x) => x.Thickness, () => 0.0) : 0.0);
			double num2 = (isHorz ? borderSize.Width : borderSize.Height);
			return Math.Max(0.0, availableAutoHideSize - num - num2);
		}

		private bool GetSizeToContent(bool fhorz)
		{
			if (base.LayoutItem == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SizeToContent sizeToContent = AutoHideGroup.GetSizeToContent(base.LayoutItem);
			if (sizeToContent == SizeToContent.WidthAndHeight || (fhorz ? (sizeToContent == SizeToContent.Width) : (sizeToContent == SizeToContent.Height)))
			{
				return (base.LayoutItem as LayoutPanel).Return((LayoutPanel x) => x.AutoHideExpandState != AutoHideExpandState.Expanded, () => false);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void LockOnContainerSizeChanged()
		{
			containerSizeLocker.LockOnce();
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				if (ExpandAnimation == null)
				{
					containerSizeLocker.Unlock();
				}
				else
				{
					LockOnContainerSizeChanged();
				}
			}, DispatcherPriority.Input);
		}

		private void OnAutoHideSizeChanged(Size oldValue, Size newValue)
		{
			if (!(IsHorz ? (SizeToContent == SizeToContent.Width) : (SizeToContent == SizeToContent.Height)) && SizeToContent != SizeToContent.WidthAndHeight && !IsSizing)
			{
				RecalculatePanelSize();
			}
		}

		private void OnCollapseAnimationCompleted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			CollapseAnimation.Completed -= OnCollapseAnimationCompleted;
			CollapseAnimation = null;
			OnCollapseCompleted();
		}

		private void OnCollapseCompleted()
		{
			AutoHideTray.IsAnimated = false;
			ClosePaneCore();
			animatedGroup = null;
			IsCollapsed = true;
			Size = 0.0;
			base.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
		}

		private void OnContainerSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.Container == null || AutoHideTray == null || !DockLayoutManagerParameters.AutoHidePanelsFitToContainer || CollapseAnimation != null || IsSizing || Locker.op_Implicit(containerSizeLocker))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ExpandAnimation != null)
			{
				LockOnContainerSizeChanged();
				return;
			}
			double num = (IsHorz ? (e.NewSize.Width - e.PreviousSize.Width) : (e.NewSize.Height - e.PreviousSize.Height));
			if (num != 0.0)
			{
				base.Container.InvalidateView(base.Container.LayoutRoot);
				if (AutoHideTray.IsExpanded)
				{
					LockOnContainerSizeChanged();
				}
				RecalculatePanelSize();
			}
		}

		private void OnDisplayModeChanged(AutoHideMode oldValue, AutoHideMode newValue)
		{
			UpdateIsSizerVisible();
		}

		private void OnExpandAnimationCompleted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			double size = double.NaN;
			if (ExpandAnimation != null)
			{
				size = ExpandAnimation.To ?? double.NaN;
				ExpandAnimation.Completed -= OnExpandAnimationCompleted;
				ExpandAnimation = null;
			}
			ApplyPanelSize(size);
		}

		private void OnIsCollapsedChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			UpdateIsSizerVisible();
		}

		private void OnLayoutUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			base.LayoutUpdated -= OnLayoutUpdated;
			EnsurePaneContentPresenter();
		}

		private void OnLayoutUpdatedOnAutoSize(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			base.LayoutUpdated -= OnLayoutUpdatedOnAutoSize;
			if (double.IsNaN(Size))
			{
				Size = 0.0;
			}
			double num = ((DisplayMode == AutoHideMode.Inline) ? PartSizer.Return((ElementSizer x) => x.Thickness, () => 0.0) : 0.0);
			ExpandWithAnimation(IsHorz ? (arrangeSize.Width - borderSize.Width - num) : (arrangeSize.Height - borderSize.Height - num), Size);
		}

		private void OnPanelMaximized(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			AutoHideGroup autoHideGroup = GetAutoHideGroup();
			if (base.LayoutItem != null && autoHideGroup != null)
			{
				ExpandWithAnimation(autoHideGroup, PanelSizeAction.Maximize);
			}
		}

		private void OnPanelRestored(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			AutoHideGroup autoHideGroup = GetAutoHideGroup();
			if (base.LayoutItem != null && autoHideGroup != null && !IsSizing)
			{
				ExpandWithAnimation(autoHideGroup, PanelSizeAction.Expand);
			}
		}

		private void OnSizeToContentChanged(SizeToContent oldValue, SizeToContent newValue)
		{
			bool isHorz = IsHorz;
			bool flag = (isHorz ? (oldValue == SizeToContent.Width) : (oldValue == SizeToContent.Height)) || oldValue == SizeToContent.WidthAndHeight;
			bool flag2 = (isHorz ? (newValue == SizeToContent.Width) : (newValue == SizeToContent.Height)) || newValue == SizeToContent.WidthAndHeight;
			if (flag != flag2)
			{
				InvalidateMeasure();
				RecalculatePanelSize();
			}
		}

		private void RecalculatePanelSize()
		{
			AutoHideGroup autoHideGroup = GetAutoHideGroup();
			if (autoHideGroup != null && autoHideGroup.IsExpanded && AutoHideTray.IsExpanded)
			{
				ExpandWithAnimation(autoHideGroup, PanelSizeAction.Expand, isAnimationAllowed: false);
			}
		}

		private void Subscribe(AutoHideTray tray)
		{
			if (tray != null)
			{
				((IUIElement)tray).Children.Add(this);
				tray.Collapsed += OnCollapsed;
				tray.Expanded += OnExpanded;
				tray.PanelClosed += OnPanelClosed;
				tray.HotItemChanged += OnHotItemChanged;
				tray.PanelResizing += OnPanelResizing;
				tray.PanelMaximized += OnPanelMaximized;
				tray.PanelRestored += OnPanelRestored;
			}
		}

		private void UnSubscribe(AutoHideTray tray)
		{
			if (tray != null)
			{
				((IUIElement)tray).Children.Remove(this);
				tray.Collapsed -= OnCollapsed;
				tray.Expanded -= OnExpanded;
				tray.PanelClosed -= OnPanelClosed;
				tray.HotItemChanged -= OnHotItemChanged;
				tray.PanelResizing -= OnPanelResizing;
				tray.PanelMaximized -= OnPanelMaximized;
				tray.PanelRestored -= OnPanelRestored;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateIsSizerVisible()
		{
			IsSizerVisible = DisplayMode == AutoHideMode.Inline && !IsCollapsed && base.LayoutItem != null;
		}

		private void UpdatePaneBorder()
		{
			if (base.LayoutItem != null)
			{
				BindBorderCursor();
			}
			PartPaneBorder.HorizontalAlignment = DockExtensions.ToHorizontalAlignment(DockType, IsInverted: true);
			PartPaneBorder.VerticalAlignment = DockExtensions.ToVerticalAlignment(DockType, IsInverted: true);
		}
	}
	public class AutoHideTrayHeadersGroup : psvItemsControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty LayoutItemProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DockTypeProperty;

		private AutoHideTray trayCore;

		public Dock DockType
		{
			get
			{
				return (Dock)GetValue(DockTypeProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DockTypeProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public BaseLayoutItem LayoutItem
		{
			get
			{
				return (BaseLayoutItem)GetValue(LayoutItemProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LayoutItemProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public AutoHideTrayHeadersPanel PartHeadersPanel { get; private set; }

		public AutoHideTray Tray => trayCore ?? LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<AutoHideTray>((DependencyObject)this);

		static AutoHideTrayHeadersGroup()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<AutoHideTrayHeadersGroup> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<AutoHideTrayHeadersGroup>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<AutoHideTrayHeadersGroup>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<BaseLayoutItem>("LayoutItem", ref LayoutItemProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs ea)
			{
				((AutoHideTrayHeadersGroup)dObj).OnLayoutItemChanged((BaseLayoutItem)ea.OldValue, (BaseLayoutItem)ea.NewValue);
			});
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<AutoHideTrayHeadersGroup>.New().Register<Dock>("DockType", ref DockTypeProperty, Dock.Left, (Action<AutoHideTrayHeadersGroup, Dock, Dock>)delegate(AutoHideTrayHeadersGroup d, Dock oldValue, Dock newValue)
			{
				d.OnDockTypeChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		public AutoHideTrayHeadersGroup()
		{
		}

		public AutoHideTrayHeadersGroup(AutoHideTray tray)
			: this()
		{
			trayCore = tray;
		}

		protected internal virtual void EnsureLayoutItem(AutoHideGroup aGroup)
		{
			if (aGroup != null)
			{
				DockLayoutManager.SetLayoutItem(this, aGroup);
				base.ItemsSource = aGroup.Items;
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, DockTypeProperty, aGroup, "DockType");
			}
		}

		protected void AcceptHeaderItems(Action<AutoHidePaneHeaderItem, BaseLayoutItem> action)
		{
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem item in (IEnumerable)base.Items)
			{
				if (LayoutHelper.FindElement((FrameworkElement)this, (Predicate<FrameworkElement>)((FrameworkElement element) => IsHeaderForItem(element, item))) is AutoHidePaneHeaderItem arg)
				{
					action(arg, item);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ClearContainer(DependencyObject element)
		{
			if (element is AutoHidePaneHeaderItem autoHidePaneHeaderItem)
			{
				autoHidePaneHeaderItem.LayoutItem.ClearTemplate();
				autoHidePaneHeaderItem.ClearValue(AutoHideTray.OrientationProperty);
				autoHidePaneHeaderItem.Dispose();
			}
			base.ClearContainer(element);
		}

		protected override void EnsureItemsPanelCore(Panel itemsPanel)
		{
			base.EnsureItemsPanelCore(itemsPanel);
			PartHeadersPanel = itemsPanel as AutoHideTrayHeadersPanel;
		}

		protected override DependencyObject GetContainerForItemOverride()
		{
			return new AutoHidePaneHeaderItem(this);
		}

		protected override bool IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(object item)
		{
			return item is AutoHidePaneHeaderItem;
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			UnSubscribeTray();
			ClearValue(AutoHideTray.OrientationProperty);
			ClearValue(DockTypeProperty);
			ClearValue(LayoutItemProperty);
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected virtual void OnDockTypeChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			foreach (object item in (IEnumerable)base.Items)
			{
				if (base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(item) is AutoHidePaneHeaderItem autoHidePaneHeaderItem)
				{
					autoHidePaneHeaderItem.SetValue(AutoHideTray.OrientationProperty, DockType.ToOrthogonalOrientation());
					autoHidePaneHeaderItem.Location = DockType;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnLayoutItemChanged(BaseLayoutItem oldValue, BaseLayoutItem newValue)
		{
			EnsureLayoutItem(newValue as AutoHideGroup);
		}

		protected override void OnLoaded()
		{
			base.OnLoaded();
			SubscribeTray();
			if (trayCore != null)
			{
				AcceptHeaderItems(delegate(AutoHidePaneHeaderItem headerItem, BaseLayoutItem item)
				{
					headerItem.IsSelected = trayCore.HotItem == item;
				});
				AcceptHeaderItems(delegate(AutoHidePaneHeaderItem headerItem, BaseLayoutItem item)
				{
					headerItem.IsSelected = trayCore.HotItem == item;
				});
			}
		}

		protected override void OnUnloaded()
		{
			UnSubscribeTray();
			base.OnUnloaded();
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainer(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			if (element is AutoHidePaneHeaderItem autoHidePaneHeaderItem)
			{
				autoHidePaneHeaderItem.SetValue(AutoHideTray.OrientationProperty, DockType.ToOrthogonalOrientation());
				autoHidePaneHeaderItem.Location = DockType;
			}
			if (item is BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem)
			{
				baseLayoutItem.ParentLockHelper.Lock();
				if (Tray != null && Tray.HotItem == baseLayoutItem)
				{
					baseLayoutItem.SelectTemplateIfNeeded();
				}
				baseLayoutItem.ParentLockHelper.Unlock();
			}
		}

		protected void SubscribeTray()
		{
			trayCore = Tray;
			if (trayCore != null)
			{
				trayCore.HotItemChanged += OnTrayHotItemChanged;
				trayCore.Expanded += OnTrayExpanded;
				trayCore.Collapsed += OnTrayCollapsed;
				trayCore.PanelClosed += OnTrayPanelClosed;
			}
		}

		protected void UnSubscribeTray()
		{
			if (trayCore != null)
			{
				trayCore.HotItemChanged -= OnTrayHotItemChanged;
				trayCore.Expanded -= OnTrayExpanded;
				trayCore.Collapsed -= OnTrayCollapsed;
				trayCore.PanelClosed -= OnTrayPanelClosed;
				trayCore = null;
			}
		}

		private bool IsHeaderForItem(FrameworkElement element, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (element is AutoHidePaneHeaderItem autoHidePaneHeaderItem)
			{
				return autoHidePaneHeaderItem.LayoutItem == item;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void OnTrayCollapsed(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			AcceptHeaderItems(delegate(AutoHidePaneHeaderItem headerItem, BaseLayoutItem item)
			{
				headerItem.IsSelected = false;
			});
		}

		private void OnTrayExpanded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			AcceptHeaderItems(delegate(AutoHidePaneHeaderItem headerItem, BaseLayoutItem item)
			{
				headerItem.IsSelected = Tray.HotItem == item;
			});
		}

		private void OnTrayHotItemChanged(object sender, HotItemChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			AcceptHeaderItems(delegate(AutoHidePaneHeaderItem headerItem, BaseLayoutItem item)
			{
				headerItem.IsSelected = e.Hot == item;
			});
		}

		private void OnTrayPanelClosed(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			AcceptHeaderItems(delegate(AutoHidePaneHeaderItem headerItem, BaseLayoutItem item)
			{
				headerItem.IsSelected = false;
			});
		}
	}
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_ControlBox", Type = typeof(BaseControlBoxControl))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_CaptionControl", Type = typeof(CaptionControl))]
	public class AutoHidePaneHeaderItem : psvSelectorItem, IUIElement, ITabHeader
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty LocationProperty;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ItemIsVisibleProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ActualBorderThicknessProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey ActualBorderThicknessPropertyKey;

		public Thickness ActualBorderThickness => (Thickness)GetValue(ActualBorderThicknessProperty);

		public AutoHideTrayHeadersGroup HeadersGroup { get; private set; }

		public bool ItemIsVisible => (bool)GetValue(ItemIsVisibleProperty);

		public Dock Location
		{
			get
			{
				return (Dock)GetValue(LocationProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LocationProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public TemplatedCaptionControl PartCaptionControlPresenter { get; private set; }

		public BaseControlBoxControl PartControlBox { get; private set; }

		public TabHeaderPinLocation PinLocation => TabHeaderPinLocation.Default;

		public bool IsPinned => false;

		public Rect ArrangeRect { get; private set; }

		public CaptionControl PartCaptionControl
		{
			get
			{
				if (PartCaptionControlPresenter == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return PartCaptionControlPresenter.PartCaption;
			}
		}

		public int ScrollIndex { get; private set; }

		IUIElement IUIElement.Scope => DockLayoutManager.GetUIScope(this);

		UIChildren IUIElement.Children => null;

		static AutoHidePaneHeaderItem()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<AutoHidePaneHeaderItem> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<AutoHidePaneHeaderItem>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<AutoHidePaneHeaderItem>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("Location", ref LocationProperty, Dock.Left, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs ea)
			{
				((AutoHidePaneHeaderItem)dObj).OnLocationChanged((Dock)ea.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ItemIsVisible", ref ItemIsVisibleProperty, defValue: true, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs ea)
			{
				((AutoHidePaneHeaderItem)dObj).OnItemIsVisibleChanged((bool)ea.NewValue);
			});
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<AutoHidePaneHeaderItem>.New().OverrideMetadata<Thickness>(Control.BorderThicknessProperty, (Action<AutoHidePaneHeaderItem, Thickness, Thickness>)delegate(AutoHidePaneHeaderItem d, Thickness oldValue, Thickness newValue)
			{
				d.OnBorderThicknessChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			}).RegisterReadOnly<Thickness>("ActualBorderThickness", ref ActualBorderThicknessPropertyKey, ref ActualBorderThicknessProperty, default(Thickness), (Func<AutoHidePaneHeaderItem, Thickness, Thickness>)((AutoHidePaneHeaderItem d, Thickness value) => d.OnCoerceActualBorderThickness(value)), (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		public AutoHidePaneHeaderItem(AutoHideTrayHeadersGroup headersGroup)
		{
			HeadersGroup = headersGroup;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			PartControlBox = GetTemplateChild("PART_ControlBox") as BaseControlBoxControl;
			PartCaptionControlPresenter = GetTemplateChild("PART_CaptionControlPresenter") as TemplatedCaptionControl;
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected virtual void OnBorderThicknessChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			CoerceValue(ActualBorderThicknessProperty);
		}

		private void OnLayoutUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			base.LayoutUpdated -= OnLayoutUpdated;
			CoerceValue(ActualBorderThicknessProperty);
		}

		protected override void AfterArrange()
		{
			base.LayoutUpdated -= OnLayoutUpdated;
			base.LayoutUpdated += OnLayoutUpdated;
		}

		protected virtual Thickness OnCoerceActualBorderThickness(Thickness value)
		{
			GetItemAlignment<AutoHideTray>(Location.ToOrthogonalOrientation() == Orientation.Horizontal, out var isLeftAligned, out var isRightAligned);
			Thickness borderThickness = base.BorderThickness;
			if (base.ViewStyle == DockingViewStyle.Light)
			{
				if (isLeftAligned)
				{
					if (Location == Dock.Bottom || Location == Dock.Right)
					{
						borderThickness.Right = 0.0;
					}
					else
					{
						borderThickness.Left = 0.0;
					}
				}
				if (isRightAligned)
				{
					if (Location == Dock.Bottom || Location == Dock.Right)
					{
						borderThickness.Left = 0.0;
					}
					else
					{
						borderThickness.Right = 0.0;
					}
				}
				borderThickness.Bottom = 0.0;
			}
			return Location.RotateThickness(borderThickness);
		}

		protected override void OnIsSelectedChanged(bool selected)
		{
			base.OnIsSelectedChanged(selected);
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected void OnItemIsVisibleChanged(bool newValue)
		{
			Recalc();
		}

		protected virtual void OnLocationChanged(Dock location)
		{
			CoerceValue(ActualBorderThicknessProperty);
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected override void OnViewStyleChanged(DockingViewStyle oldValue, DockingViewStyle newValue)
		{
			CoerceValue(ActualBorderThicknessProperty);
		}

		protected override void Subscribe(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			base.Subscribe(item);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, ItemIsVisibleProperty, base.LayoutItem, "IsVisibleCore");
		}

		protected override void Unsubscribe(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			ClearValue(ItemIsVisibleProperty);
			base.Unsubscribe(item);
		}

		private string GetSvgPaletteState()
		{
			if (base.IsSelected)
			{
				if (!base.LayoutItem.IsActive)
				{
					return "Inactive";
				}
				return "Selected";
			}
			if (!base.IsMouseOver)
			{
				return "Normal";
			}
			return "Hover";
		}

		private void Recalc()
		{
			BaseHeadersPanel.Invalidate(this);
		}

		private void UpdateSvgPaletteState()
		{
			SvgImageHelper.SetState((DependencyObject)this, GetSvgPaletteState());
		}

		private void UpdateVisualState()
		{
			if (base.IsSelected)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Selected", useTransitions: false);
			}
			else if (base.IsMouseOver)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "MouseOver", useTransitions: false);
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Normal", useTransitions: false);
			}
			switch (Location)
			{
			case Dock.Top:
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Top", useTransitions: false);
				break;
			case Dock.Bottom:
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Bottom", useTransitions: false);
				break;
			case Dock.Right:
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Right", useTransitions: false);
				break;
			default:
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Left", useTransitions: false);
				break;
			}
			UpdateSvgPaletteState();
		}

		public void Apply(ITabHeaderInfo info)
		{
			EnsureItemCaptionElementsVisibility();
			base.Visibility = VisibilityHelper.Convert(ItemIsVisible && info.IsVisible);
			if (PartCaptionControl != null)
			{
				Measure(info.Rect.Size);
			}
			ArrangeRect = info.Rect;
		}

		public ITabHeaderInfo CreateInfo(Size size)
		{
			EnsureItemCaptionElementsVisibility();
			base.Visibility = VisibilityHelper.Convert(ItemIsVisible);
			Measure(size);
			return new BaseHeaderInfo(this, PartCaptionControl, PartControlBox, base.IsSelected);
		}

		private void EnsureItemCaptionElementsVisibility()
		{
			if (base.LayoutItem != null)
			{
				base.LayoutItem.CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsCaptionVisibleProperty);
				base.LayoutItem.CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsCaptionImageVisibleProperty);
			}
		}
	}
	public class AutoHideTrayHeadersPanel : BaseHeadersPanel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty BottomMarginProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LeftMarginProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RightMarginProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty TopMarginProperty;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty DockTypeProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ViewStyleProperty;

		public Thickness BottomMargin
		{
			get

			}
			set

				SetValue(BottomMarginProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public Dock DockType => (Dock)GetValue(DockTypeProperty);

		public AutoHideTrayHeadersGroup HeadersGroup { get; private set; }

		public Thickness LeftMargin
		{
			get
			{
				return (Thickness)GetValue(LeftMarginProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LeftMarginProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public Thickness RightMargin
		{
			get
			{
				return (Thickness)GetValue(RightMarginProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(RightMarginProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public Thickness TopMargin
		{
			get
			{
				return (Thickness)GetValue(TopMarginProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(TopMarginProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public DockingViewStyle ViewStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return (DockingViewStyle)GetValue(ViewStyleProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ViewStyleProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override bool StretchItems => true;

		static AutoHideTrayHeadersPanel()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<AutoHideTrayHeadersPanel> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<AutoHideTrayHeadersPanel>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("LeftMargin", ref LeftMarginProperty, new Thickness(0.0), delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((AutoHideTrayHeadersPanel)dObj).OnSideMarginChanged();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("TopMargin", ref TopMarginProperty, new Thickness(0.0), delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((AutoHideTrayHeadersPanel)dObj).OnSideMarginChanged();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("RightMargin", ref RightMarginProperty, new Thickness(0.0), delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((AutoHideTrayHeadersPanel)dObj).OnSideMarginChanged();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("BottomMargin", ref BottomMarginProperty, new Thickness(0.0), delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((AutoHideTrayHeadersPanel)dObj).OnSideMarginChanged();
			});
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<AutoHideTrayHeadersPanel>.New().Register<Dock>("DockType", ref DockTypeProperty, Dock.Left, (Action<AutoHideTrayHeadersPanel, Dock, Dock>)delegate(AutoHideTrayHeadersPanel d, Dock oldValue, Dock newValue)
			{
				d.OnDockTypeChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null).Register<DockingViewStyle>("ViewStyle", ref ViewStyleProperty, DockingViewStyle.Default, (Action<AutoHideTrayHeadersPanel, DockingViewStyle, DockingViewStyle>)delegate(AutoHideTrayHeadersPanel d, DockingViewStyle oldValue, DockingViewStyle newValue)
			{
				d.OnViewStyleChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		protected internal void UpdateActualMargin()
		{
			HeadersGroup = LayoutItemsHelper.GetTemplateParent<AutoHideTrayHeadersGroup>(this);
			if (HeadersGroup != null && HeadersGroup.Tray != null)
			{
				UpdateActualMargin(HeadersGroup.Tray);
			}
		}

		protected override Thickness GetClipMargin()
		{
			Thickness result = base.GetClipMargin();
			if (!base.IsHorizontal)
			{
				result = new Thickness(result.Top, result.Right, result.Bottom, result.Left);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override Geometry GetLayoutClip(Size layoutSlotSize)
		{
			if (!base.ClipToBounds)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return base.GetLayoutClip(layoutSlotSize);
		}

		protected virtual void OnDockTypeChanged(Dock oldValue, Dock newValue)
		{
			EnsureLayout();
		}

		protected override void OnLayoutItemChanged(BaseLayoutItem oldValue, BaseLayoutItem newValue)
		{
			base.OnLayoutItemChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			if (newValue is AutoHideGroup source)
			{
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, DockTypeProperty, source, AutoHideGroup.DockTypeProperty);
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, ViewStyleProperty, source, BaseLayoutItem.DockingViewStyleProperty);
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(DockTypeProperty);
				ClearValue(ViewStyleProperty);
			}
			EnsureLayout();
		}

		protected virtual void OnSideMarginChanged()
		{
			UpdateActualMargin();
		}

		protected virtual void OnViewStyleChanged(DockingViewStyle oldValue, DockingViewStyle newValue)
		{
			UpdateActualMargin();
		}

		protected void UpdateActualMargin(AutoHideTray tray)
		{
			if (ViewStyle == DockingViewStyle.Light)
			{
				ClearValue(FrameworkElement.MarginProperty);
				return;
			}
			if (AutoHideTray.GetIsLeft(tray))
			{
				base.Margin = LeftMargin;
			}
			if (AutoHideTray.GetIsTop(tray))
			{
				base.Margin = TopMargin;
			}
			if (AutoHideTray.GetIsRight(tray))
			{
				base.Margin = RightMargin;
			}
			if (AutoHideTray.GetIsBottom(tray))
			{
				base.Margin = BottomMargin;
			}
		}

		private void EnsureLayout()
		{
			base.Orientation = DockType.ToOrthogonalOrientation();
			UpdateActualMargin();
		}
	}
	public class AutoHidePanePresenter : psvContentControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty Win32CompatibleTemplateProperty;

		private static ControlTemplate _DefaultTemplate;

		private const string DefaultTemplateXaml = "<ControlTemplate TargetType='local:AutoHidePanePresenter' xmlns='http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation' xmlns:x='http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml' xmlns:local='clr-namespace:DevExpress.Xpf.Docking.VisualElements;assembly=DevExpress.Xpf.Docking.v23.2'><ContentPresenter Content='{TemplateBinding Content}' ContentTemplate='{TemplateBinding ContentTemplate}'/></ControlTemplate>";

		private AutoHideWindowHost autoHideWindowHost;

		private static ControlTemplate DefaultTemplate => _DefaultTemplate ?? (_DefaultTemplate = (ControlTemplate)XamlReader.Parse("<ControlTemplate TargetType='local:AutoHidePanePresenter' xmlns='http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation' xmlns:x='http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml' xmlns:local='clr-namespace:DevExpress.Xpf.Docking.VisualElements;assembly=DevExpress.Xpf.Docking.v23.2'><ContentPresenter Content='{TemplateBinding Content}' ContentTemplate='{TemplateBinding ContentTemplate}'/></ControlTemplate>"));

		private DockLayoutManager Manager => DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager(this);

		public ControlTemplate Win32CompatibleTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return (ControlTemplate)GetValue(Win32CompatibleTemplateProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(Win32CompatibleTemplateProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static AutoHidePanePresenter()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<AutoHidePanePresenter> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<AutoHidePanePresenter>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<AutoHidePanePresenter>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<ControlTemplate>("Win32CompatibleTemplate", ref Win32CompatibleTemplateProperty);
		}

		public AutoHidePanePresenter()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<AutoHidePanePresenter>(this);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			if (Manager != null)
			{
				Manager.EnableWin32CompatibilityChanged += Manager_EnableWin32CompatibilityChanged;
			}
			DisposeAutoHideWindowHost(autoHideWindowHost);
			autoHideWindowHost = LayoutItemsHelper.GetTemplateChild<AutoHideWindowHost>(this);
		}

		protected override void OnContentChanged(object content, object oldContent)
		{
			base.OnContentChanged(content, oldContent);
			base.Template = SelectTemplate();
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			DisposeAutoHideWindowHost(autoHideWindowHost);
			if (Manager != null)
			{
				Manager.EnableWin32CompatibilityChanged -= Manager_EnableWin32CompatibilityChanged;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnInitialized(e);
			base.Template = SelectTemplate();
		}

		protected override void OnLoaded()
		{
			base.OnLoaded();
			base.Template = SelectTemplate();
		}

		protected override void OnUnloaded()
		{
			base.Template = null;
			DisposeAutoHideWindowHost(autoHideWindowHost);
			base.OnUnloaded();
		}

		private void DisposeAutoHideWindowHost(IDisposable autoHideWindowHost)
		{
			if (autoHideWindowHost != null)
			{
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					autoHideWindowHost.Dispose();
				});
			}
		}

		private ControlTemplate SelectTemplate()
		{
			if (Manager == null || !Manager.EnableWin32Compatibility)
			{
				return DefaultTemplate;
			}
			return Win32CompatibleTemplate;
		}

		private void Manager_EnableWin32CompatibilityChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.Template = SelectTemplate();
		}
	}

			{
				return (Dock)GetValue(DockTypeProperty);
			}
			internal set
			{
				SetValue(DockTypePropertyKey, value);
			}
		}

		public AutoHidePane Panel { get; private set; }

		public bool IsAutoHideLocked => lockAutoHide > 0;

		internal bool IsExpandingLocked => Locker.op_Implicit(expandingLocker);

		static AutoHideTray()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<AutoHideTray> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<AutoHideTray>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<AutoHideTray>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttached("Orientation", ref OrientationProperty, Orientation.Vertical, OnOrientationChanged);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("DockType", ref DockTypePropertyKey, ref DockTypeProperty, Dock.Left, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((AutoHideTray)dObj).OnDockTypeChanged((Dock)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("IsExpanded", ref IsExpandedPropertyKey, ref IsExpandedProperty, defValue: false, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((AutoHideTray)dObj).OnIsExpandedChanged((bool)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly<BaseLayoutItem>("HotItem", ref HotItemPropertyKey, ref HotItemProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((AutoHideTray)dObj).OnHotItemChanged((BaseLayoutItem)e.NewValue, (BaseLayoutItem)e.OldValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("CheckInterval", ref CheckIntervalProperty, new TimeSpan(0L), delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((AutoHideTray)dObj).OnCheckIntervalChanged((TimeSpan)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterDirectEvent<RoutedEventHandler>("Expanded", ref Expanded);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterDirectEvent<RoutedEventHandler>("Collapsed", ref Collapsed);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterDirectEvent<RoutedEventHandler>("PanelClosed", ref PanelClosed);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterDirectEvent<HotItemChangedEventHandler>("HotItemChanged", ref HotItemChanged);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterDirectEvent<PanelResizingEventHandler>("PanelResizing", ref PanelResizing);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterDirectEvent<RoutedEventHandler>("PanelMaximized", ref PanelMaximized);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterDirectEvent<RoutedEventHandler>("PanelRestored", ref PanelRestored);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttachedReadonlyInherited("IsTop", ref IsTopPropertyKey, ref IsTopProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttachedReadonlyInherited("IsLeft", ref IsLeftPropertyKey, ref IsLeftProperty, defValue: true);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttachedReadonlyInherited("IsRight", ref IsRightPropertyKey, ref IsRightProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttachedReadonlyInherited("IsBottom", ref IsBottomPropertyKey, ref IsBottomProperty, defValue: false);
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<AutoHideTray>.New().AddOwner<DockLayoutManager>(ref DockLayoutManagerProperty, DockLayoutManager.DockLayoutManagerProperty, (DockLayoutManager)null, (Action<AutoHideTray, DockLayoutManager, DockLayoutManager>)delegate(AutoHideTray d, DockLayoutManager oldValue, DockLayoutManager newValue)
			{
				d.OnDockLayoutManagerChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			}).OverrideMetadata<Thickness>(Control.BorderThicknessProperty, (Action<AutoHideTray, Thickness, Thickness>)delegate(AutoHideTray d, Thickness oldValue, Thickness newValue)
			{
				d.OnBorderThicknessChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			})
				.Register<DockingViewStyle>("ViewStyle", ref ViewStyleProperty, DockingViewStyle.Default, (Action<AutoHideTray, DockingViewStyle, DockingViewStyle>)delegate(AutoHideTray d, DockingViewStyle oldValue, DockingViewStyle newValue)
				{
					d.ViewStyleChanged(oldValue, newValue);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.RegisterReadOnly<Thickness>("ActualBorderThickness", ref ActualBorderThicknessPropertyKey, ref ActualBorderThicknessProperty, default(Thickness), (Func<AutoHideTray, Thickness, Thickness>)((AutoHideTray d, Thickness value) => d.OnCoerceActualBorderThickness(value)), (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

			return (Orientation)obj.GetValue(OrientationProperty);
		}

		{
			obj.SetValue(OrientationProperty, value);
		}

			return (bool)obj.GetValue(IsLeftProperty);
		}

			return (bool)obj.GetValue(IsTopProperty);
