		internal static void ClearDock(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			obj.ClearValue(IsLeftPropertyKey);
			obj.ClearValue(IsRightPropertyKey);
			obj.ClearValue(IsTopPropertyKey);
			obj.ClearValue(IsBottomPropertyKey);
		}

		internal static void SetDock(DependencyObject obj, Dock value)
		{
			SetIsLeft(obj, value == Dock.Left);
			SetIsRight(obj, value == Dock.Right);
			SetIsTop(obj, value == Dock.Top);
			SetIsBottom(obj, value == Dock.Bottom);
		}

		private static void SetIsTop(DependencyObject obj, bool value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(IsTopPropertyKey, value);
		}

		private static void SetIsBottom(DependencyObject obj, bool value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(IsBottomPropertyKey, value);
		}

		private static void SetIsLeft(DependencyObject obj, bool value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(IsLeftPropertyKey, value);
		}

		private static void SetIsRight(DependencyObject obj, bool value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(IsRightPropertyKey, value);
		}

		private static void InvalidateView(AutoHideTray tray)
		{
			tray.Container.GetView(tray)?.Invalidate();
		}

		private static void OnOrientationChanged(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (dObj is UIElement uIElement)
			{
				uIElement.InvalidateMeasure();
				uIElement.InvalidateArrange();
			}
		}

		public AutoHideTray()
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DockPane.SetHitTestType(this, HitTestType.PageHeaders);
			CloseTimer = new DispatcherTimer(DispatcherPriority.Background);
			CloseTimer.Tick += OnCloseTimerTick;
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			CloseTimer.Stop();
			Ref.Dispose(ref hitCache);
			UnSubscribe();
			View = null;
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnLoaded()
		{
			Subscribe();
		}

		protected override void OnUnloaded()
		{
			CloseTimer.Stop();
			UnSubscribe();
		}

		protected override void OnHasItemsChanged(bool hasItems)
		{
			EnsureVisibility(hasItems);
		}

		protected virtual void OnDockTypeChanged(Dock value)
		{
			SetDock(this, value);
			CoerceValue(ActualBorderThicknessProperty);
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsExpandedChanged(bool value)
		{
			if (!base.IsDisposing)
			{
				InvalidateView(this);
				CheckCloseTimer();
				if (value)
				{
					RaiseExpanded();
				}
				else
				{
					RaiseCollapsed();
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnHotItemChanged(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem oldItem)
		{
			using (LockExpanding())
			{
				InvalidateView(this);
				bool isExpanded = IsExpanded;
				if (isExpanded)
				{
					IsExpanded = false;
				}
				RaiseHotItemChanged(item, oldItem);
				if (isExpanded)
				{
					IsExpanded = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnCheckIntervalChanged(TimeSpan timeSpan)
		{
			CloseTimer.Interval = timeSpan;
			CheckCloseTimer();
		}

		private AutoHideExpandMode GetRealAutoHideMode()
		{
			if (!base.Container.IsInDesignTime)
			{
				return base.Container.AutoHideExpandMode;
			}
			return AutoHideExpandMode.MouseDown;
		}

		private bool EnsureUnSubscribed(UIElement element)
		{
			if (subscriptions == null)
			{
				subscriptions = new List<UIElement>();
			}
			return !subscriptions.Contains(element);
		}

		private void SubscribeTrayMouseMove(UIElement element)
		{
			if (element != null && EnsureUnSubscribed(element))
			{
				Mouse.AddPreviewMouseMoveHandler(element, TrayMouseMove);
				subscriptions.Add(element);
			}
		}

		private void UnSubscribeTrayMouseMove(UIElement element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				if (subscriptions != null)
				{
					subscriptions.Remove(element);
				}
				Mouse.RemovePreviewMouseMoveHandler(element, TrayMouseMove);
			}
		}

		protected void Subscribe()
		{
			SubscribeTrayMouseMove(this);
			SubscribeTrayMouseMove(Panel);
			SubscribeTrayMouseMove(base.Container);
			Mouse.AddMouseEnterHandler(this, TrayMouseEnter);
		}

		protected void UnSubscribe()
		{
			UnSubscribeTrayMouseMove(this);
			UnSubscribeTrayMouseMove(Panel);
			UnSubscribeTrayMouseMove(base.Container);
			Mouse.RemoveMouseEnterHandler(this, TrayMouseEnter);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			EnsureVisibility(base.HasItems);
			if (Panel != null)
			{
				DockLayoutManager.Ensure(Panel);
			}
			if (base.Container != null)
			{
				View = base.Container.GetView(this) as AutoHideView;
				if (View != null)
				{
					View.Initialize(this);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void EnsureItemsPanelCore(Panel itemsPanel)
		{
			base.EnsureItemsPanelCore(itemsPanel);
			PartHeaderGroupsPanel = itemsPanel as StackPanel;
			if (PartHeaderGroupsPanel != null)
			{
				PartHeaderGroupsPanel.Orientation = GetOrientation(this);
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(object item)
		{
			if (!(item is BaseLayoutItem))
			{
				return item is AutoHideTrayHeadersGroup;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override DependencyObject GetContainerForItemOverride()
		{
			return new AutoHideTrayHeadersGroup();
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainer(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			if (element is AutoHideTrayHeadersGroup autoHideTrayHeadersGroup && DockLayoutManagerExtension.IsInContainer(this))
			{
				autoHideTrayHeadersGroup.SetValue(OrientationProperty, GetOrientation(this));
				autoHideTrayHeadersGroup.EnsureLayoutItem(item as AutoHideGroup);
			}
			LayoutItemData.ConvertToBaseLayoutItem(element)?.SelectTemplate();
		}

		protected override void ClearContainer(DependencyObject element)
		{
			if (element is AutoHideTrayHeadersGroup autoHideTrayHeadersGroup)
			{
				autoHideTrayHeadersGroup.Dispose();
			}
			BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = LayoutItemData.ConvertToBaseLayoutItem(element);
			if (baseLayoutItem != null)
			{
				baseLayoutItem.ClearTemplate();
				if (baseLayoutItem is AutoHideGroup autoHideGroup && autoHideGroup.Items.Contains(HotItem))
				{
					ClosePanelCore();
				}
			}
		}

		public BaseLayoutItem[] GetItems()
		{
			List<BaseLayoutItem> list = new List<BaseLayoutItem>();
			foreach (AutoHideGroup item in (IEnumerable)base.Items)
			{
				list.AddRange(item.GetItems());
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		protected virtual void RaiseExpanded()
		{
			if (lockPanelChanging <= 0)
			{
				lockPanelChanging++;
				RaisePanelEvent(Expanded);
				lockPanelChanging--;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void RaiseCollapsed()
		{
			if (lockPanelChanging <= 0)
			{
				lockPanelChanging++;
				RaisePanelEvent(Collapsed);
				lockPanelChanging--;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void RaiseHotItemChanged(BaseLayoutItem value, BaseLayoutItem prev)
		{
			if (lockPanelChanging <= 0)
			{
				lockPanelChanging++;
				RaiseEvent(new HotItemChangedEventArgs(value, prev)
				{
					RoutedEvent = HotItemChanged,
					Source = this
				});
				lockPanelChanging--;
			}
		}

		protected void RaisePanelEvent(RoutedEvent routedEvent)
		{
			RaiseEvent(new RoutedEventArgs
			{
				RoutedEvent = routedEvent,
				Source = this
			});
		}

		protected virtual void RaisePanelResizing(double size)
		{
			RaiseEvent(new PanelResizingEventArgs(size)
			{
				RoutedEvent = PanelResizing,
				Source = this
			});
		}

		protected internal virtual void EnsureAutoHidePanel(AutoHidePane trayPanel)
		{
			Panel = trayPanel;
			SetDock(Panel, DockType);
		}

		public void DoMaximize(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (!IsExpanded)
			{
				DoExpand(item);
			}
			else
			{
				Maximize(item);
			}
		}

		private void Maximize(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (base.HasItems)
			{
				LockAutoHide();
				HotItem = item;
				base.Container.CollapseOtherViews(item);
				RaisePanelEvent(PanelMaximized);
				UnlockAutoHide();
			}
		}

		private void Restore(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (base.HasItems)
			{
				LockAutoHide();
				base.Container.CollapseOtherViews(item);
				RaisePanelEvent(PanelRestored);
				UnlockAutoHide();
			}
		}

		public void DoRestore(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (IsExpanded && HotItem == item)
			{
				Restore(item);
			}
			else
			{
				DoExpand(item);
			}
		}

		public void DoExpand(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (base.HasItems && !Locker.op_Implicit(ExpandLocker))
			{
				ExpandLocker.Lock();
				LockAutoHide();
				HotItem = item;
				base.Container.CollapseOtherViews(item);
				if (!IsExpanded)
				{
					IsExpanded = true;
				}
				UnlockAutoHide();
				ExpandLocker.Unlock();
			}
		}

		public void DoResizePanel(double size)
		{
			if (base.HasItems)
			{
				LockAutoHide();
				RaisePanelResizing(size);
				UnlockAutoHide();
			}
		}

		public void DoCollapseIfPossible(bool force = false)
		{
			if (Panel != null && base.Container != null && ((Panel.CanHideCurrentItem && base.Container.AutoHideMode != AutoHideMode.Inline) || force))
			{
				DoCollapse();
			}
		}

		public void DoCollapse(BaseLayoutItem itemToCollapse = null)
		{
			if (base.HasItems)
			{
				LockAutoHide();
				if (IsExpanded)
				{
					IsExpanded = false;
					lastCollapsedItem = new WeakReference(itemToCollapse);
				}
				UnlockAutoHide();
			}
		}

		public void DoClosePanel()
		{
			if (base.HasItems)
			{
				ClosePanelCore();
			}
		}

		protected void ClosePanelCore()
		{
			lockPanelChanging++;
			IsExpanded = false;
			RaisePanelEvent(PanelClosed);
			HotItem = null;
			lockPanelChanging--;
		}

		public void LockAutoHide()
		{
			lockAutoHide++;
		}

		public void UnlockAutoHide()
		{
			lockAutoHide--;
		}

		protected void TrayMouseEnter(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (View != null)
			{
				if (View.LayoutRoot == null)
				{
					View.EnsureLayoutRoot();
				}
				else if (!View.LayoutRoot.IsReady)
				{
					View.LayoutRoot.Invalidate();
				}
			}
			lastCollapsedItem = null;
		}

		protected void TrayMouseMove(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = base.Container?.ViewAdapter?.IsInEvent ?? true;
			if (!(PopupMenuManager.TopPopup != null || ExpandOnMouseDown || IsAutoHideLocked || flag) && base.HasItems)
			{
				LockAutoHide();
				AutoHideByMouse(e);
				UnlockAutoHide();
			}
		}

		protected void AutoHideByMouse(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			HitTestResult hit = GetHit(this, e);
			HitTestResult hit2 = GetHit(Panel, e);
			if (TryCollapseByMouse(hit, hit2) || hit == null || hit2 != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DependencyObject visualHit = hit.VisualHit;
			if (visualHit != null)
			{
				BaseLayoutItem hitItem = GetHitItem(visualHit);
				if (hitItem != null && !(hitItem is AutoHideGroup) && hitItem.IsEnabled)
				{
					if (!IsExpanded)
					{
						if (lastCollapsedItem.Return((WeakReference x) => x.Target, () => (object)null) == hitItem)
						{
							return;
						}
						base.Container.ViewAdapter.ProcessAction(ViewAction.Hiding);
						DoExpand(hitItem);
					}
					else if (Panel.CanHideCurrentItem)
					{
						HotItem = hitItem;
					}
				}
			}
			lastCollapsedItem = null;
		}

		private static BaseLayoutItem GetHitItem(DependencyObject hitObj)
		{
			return DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(hitObj);
		}

		private void EnsureVisibility(bool hasItems)
		{
			base.Visibility = VisibilityHelper.Convert(hasItems);
			if (Panel != null)
			{
				Panel.IsCollapsed = true;
			}
		}

		private HitTestResult GetHit(UIElement element, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			return HitTestHelper.HitTest(element, e.GetPosition(element), ref hitCache);
		}

		private void OnCloseTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			CheckCollapseByMouse();
		}

		private bool TryCollapseByMouse(HitTestResult trayHit, HitTestResult panelHit)
		{
			bool flag = trayHit == null && panelHit == null && IsExpanded && Panel.CanCollapse && base.Container.AutoHideMode != AutoHideMode.Inline;
			if (flag)
			{
				DoCollapse();
				lastCollapsedItem = null;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private void CheckCloseTimer()
		{
			if (IsExpanded && CloseTimer.Interval.Ticks > 0)
			{
				CloseTimer.Start();
			}
			else
			{
				CloseTimer.Stop();
			}
		}

		private void OnBorderThicknessChanged(Thickness oldValue, Thickness newValue)
		{
			CoerceValue(ActualBorderThicknessProperty);
		}

		private void ViewStyleChanged(DockingViewStyle oldValue, DockingViewStyle newValue)
		{
			CoerceValue(ActualBorderThicknessProperty);
		}

		private void OnDockLayoutManagerChanged(DockLayoutManager oldValue, DockLayoutManager newValue)
		{
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, ViewStyleProperty, newValue, DockLayoutManager.ViewStyleProperty);
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(ViewStyleProperty);
			}
		}

		private Thickness OnCoerceActualBorderThickness(Thickness value)
		{
			if (ViewStyle != DockingViewStyle.Light)
			{
				return value;
			}
			return DockType.RotateThickness(base.BorderThickness);
		}

		internal void CheckCollapseByMouse(Point? pos = null)
		{
			if (FrameworkElementExtensions.IsInVisualTree((FrameworkElement)this) && FrameworkElementExtensions.IsInVisualTree((FrameworkElement)Panel))
			{
				Point point = pos ?? NativeHelper.GetMousePositionSafe();
				HitTestResult trayHit = HitTestHelper.HitTest(this, PointFromScreen(point), ref hitCache);
				HitTestResult panelHit = HitTestHelper.HitTest(Panel, Panel.PointFromScreen(point), ref hitCache);
				TryCollapseByMouse(trayHit, panelHit);
			}
		}

		internal IDisposable LockExpanding()
		{
			return (IDisposable)expandingLocker.Lock();
		}
	}
	public abstract class BasePanePresenter<TVisual, TLogical> : psvContentPresenter where TVisual : DependencyObject, IDisposable where TLogical : BaseLayoutItem
	{
		private static readonly DataTemplate Empty = new DataTemplate();

		public TVisual Owner { get; private set; }

		protected BasePanePresenter()
		{
			base.ContentTemplate = Empty;
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			TLogical val = ConvertToLogicalItem(base.Content);
			if (val != null && Owner is IUIElement)
			{
				val.UIElements.Remove((IUIElement)Owner);
			}
			base.OnDispose();
			Owner = null;
		}

		protected virtual TLogical ConvertToLogicalItem(object content)
		{
			return content as TLogical;
		}

		protected override void OnContentChanged(object content, object oldContent)
		{
			base.OnContentChanged(content, oldContent);
			TLogical item = ConvertToLogicalItem(content);
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				ChangeTemplate(item);
			}
		}

		protected internal void EnsureOwner(TVisual owner)
		{
			Owner = owner;
			ChangeTemplate(ConvertToLogicalItem(base.Content));
		}

		protected virtual void OnStylePropertyChanged()
		{
			ChangeTemplate(ConvertToLogicalItem(base.Content));
		}

		private void ChangeTemplate(TLogical item)
		{
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				base.ContentTemplate = SelectTemplate(item) ?? Empty;
			}
		}

		private DataTemplate SelectTemplate(TLogical item)
		{
			if (item == null || !CanSelectTemplate(item))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return SelectTemplateCore(item);
		}

		protected abstract bool CanSelectTemplate(TLogical item);

		protected abstract DataTemplate SelectTemplateCore(TLogical item);
	}
	public abstract class DockItemContentPresenter<TVisual, TLogical> : BasePanePresenter<TVisual, TLogical> where TVisual : DependencyObject, IDisposable where TLogical : BaseLayoutItem
	{
		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsControlItemsHostProperty;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsDataBoundProperty;

		static DockItemContentPresenter()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DockItemContentPresenter<TVisual, TLogical>> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DockItemContentPresenter<TVisual, TLogical>>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("IsControlItemsHost", ref IsControlItemsHostProperty, defValue: false, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs ea)
			{
				((DockItemContentPresenter<TVisual, TLogical>)dObj).OnIsControlItemsHostChanged((bool)ea.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("IsDataBound", ref IsDataBoundProperty, defValue: false, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs ea)
			{
				((DockItemContentPresenter<TVisual, TLogical>)dObj).OnIsDataBoundChanged((bool)ea.NewValue);
			});
		}

		protected override TLogical ConvertToLogicalItem(object content)
		{
			return (LayoutItemData.ConvertToBaseLayoutItem(content) as TLogical) ?? base.ConvertToLogicalItem(content);
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsControlItemsHostChanged(bool value)
		{
			EnsureOwner(base.Owner);
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsDataBoundChanged(bool value)
		{
			EnsureOwner(base.Owner);
		}
	}
	public class BaseSplitterItem : Thumb
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty DragIncrementProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty KeyboardIncrementProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty OrientationProperty;

		private ResizeData _resizeData;

		private LayoutResizingPreviewHelper resizePreviewHelper;

		private IResizeCalculator resizeCalculatorCore;

		protected bool IsActivated { get; private set; }

		protected bool IsHorizontal => Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal;

		public DockLayoutManager Manager { get; private set; }

		public LayoutGroup LayoutGroup { get; protected set; }

		private bool RedrawContent
		{
			get
			{
				if (Manager != null)
				{
					return Manager.RedrawContentWhenResizing;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private bool IsDragStarted => _resizeData != null;

		private LayoutResizingPreviewHelper ResizePreviewHelper
		{
			get
			{
				if (resizePreviewHelper == null)
				{
					resizePreviewHelper = new LayoutResizingPreviewHelper(Manager.GetView(LayoutGroup) as LayoutView, LayoutGroup);
				}
				return resizePreviewHelper;
			}
		}

		protected IResizeCalculator ResizeCalculator
		{
			[DebuggerStepThrough]
			get
			{
				if (resizeCalculatorCore == null)
				{
					resizeCalculatorCore = ResolveResizeCalculator();
				}
				return resizeCalculatorCore;
			}
		}

		public double DragIncrement
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(DragIncrementProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DragIncrementProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double KeyboardIncrement
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(KeyboardIncrementProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(KeyboardIncrementProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public Orientation Orientation
		{
			get
			{
				return (Orientation)GetValue(OrientationProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(OrientationProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static BaseSplitterItem()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<BaseSplitterItem> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<BaseSplitterItem>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("DragIncrement", ref DragIncrementProperty, 1.0);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("KeyboardIncrement", ref KeyboardIncrementProperty, 10.0);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("Orientation", ref OrientationProperty, Orientation.Horizontal, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((BaseSplitterItem)dObj).OnOrientationChanged((Orientation)e.NewValue);
			});
		}

		private static void OnDragStarted(object sender, DragStartedEventArgs e)
		{
			(sender as BaseSplitterItem).OnDragStarted(e);
		}

		private static void OnDragCompleted(object sender, DragCompletedEventArgs e)
		{
			(sender as BaseSplitterItem).OnDragCompleted(e);
		}

		private static void OnDragDelta(object sender, DragDeltaEventArgs e)
		{
			(sender as BaseSplitterItem).OnDragDelta(e);
		}

		protected static bool IsResizableItem(BaseLayoutItem item, bool isHorizontal)
		{
			if (LayoutItemsHelper.IsResizable(item, isHorizontal))
			{
				return item.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public BaseSplitterItem()
		{
			base.Focusable = false;
			base.IsTabStop = false;
		}

		public virtual void Activate()
		{
			if (!IsActivated)
			{
				IsActivated = true;
				SubscribeThumbEvents();
			}
		}

		public virtual void Deactivate()
		{
			UnsubscribeThumbEvents();
			IsActivated = false;
		}

		private void SubscribeThumbEvents()
		{
			base.DragStarted += OnDragStarted;
			base.DragDelta += OnDragDelta;
			base.DragCompleted += OnDragCompleted;
		}

		private void UnsubscribeThumbEvents()
		{
			base.DragStarted -= OnDragStarted;
			base.DragDelta -= OnDragDelta;
			base.DragCompleted -= OnDragCompleted;
		}

		private void CancelResize()
		{
			SetDefinitionLength(_resizeData.Definition1, _resizeData.OriginalDefinition1Length);
			SetDefinitionLength(_resizeData.Definition2, _resizeData.OriginalDefinition2Length);
			ResetResizing();
		}

		private void ResetResizing()
		{
			if (!RedrawContent)
			{
				ResizePreviewHelper.EndResizing();
				resizePreviewHelper = null;
			}
			_resizeData = null;
			ReleaseMouseCapture();
		}

		private double GetActualLength(DefinitionBase definition)
		{
			if (definition is ColumnDefinition columnDefinition)
			{
				return columnDefinition.ActualWidth;
			}
			return ((RowDefinition)definition).ActualHeight;
		}

		private void GetDeltaConstraints(out double minDelta, out double maxDelta)
		{
			double actualLength = GetActualLength(_resizeData.Definition1);
			double actualLength2 = GetActualLength(_resizeData.Definition2);
			double num = DefinitionsHelper.UserMinSizeValueCache(_resizeData.Definition1);
			double num2 = DefinitionsHelper.UserMaxSizeValueCache(_resizeData.Definition1);
			double num3 = DefinitionsHelper.UserMinSizeValueCache(_resizeData.Definition2);
			double num4 = DefinitionsHelper.UserMaxSizeValueCache(_resizeData.Definition2);
			if (_resizeData.SplitterIndex == _resizeData.Definition1Index)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, _resizeData.SplitterLength);
			}
			else if (_resizeData.SplitterIndex == _resizeData.Definition2Index)
			{
				num3 = Math.Max(num3, _resizeData.SplitterLength);
			}
			if (_resizeData.SplitBehavior == SplitBehavior.Split)
			{
				minDelta = 0.0 - Math.Min(actualLength - num, num4 - actualLength2);
				maxDelta = Math.Min(num2 - actualLength, actualLength2 - num3);
			}
			else if (_resizeData.SplitBehavior == SplitBehavior.Resize1)
			{
				minDelta = num - actualLength;
				maxDelta = num2 - actualLength;
			}
			else
			{
				minDelta = actualLength2 - num4;
				maxDelta = actualLength2 - num3;
			}
		}

		protected virtual GridResizeDirection GetEffectiveResizeDirection()
		{
			if (LayoutGroup != null)
			{
				if (LayoutGroup.Orientation != Orientation.Horizontal)
				{
					return GridResizeDirection.Rows;
				}
				return GridResizeDirection.Columns;
			}
			return GridResizeDirection.Rows;
		}

		private static DefinitionBase GetGridDefinition(Grid grid, int index, GridResizeDirection direction)
		{
			if (direction != GridResizeDirection.Columns)
			{
				return grid.RowDefinitions[index];
			}
			return grid.ColumnDefinitions[index];
		}

		protected virtual Grid GetParentGrid()
		{
			return (Grid)LayoutHelper.GetParent((DependencyObject)this, false);
		}

		private bool InitializeData()
		{
			Grid parentGrid = GetParentGrid();
			if (parentGrid != null)
			{
				_resizeData = new ResizeData();
				_resizeData.Grid = parentGrid;
				_resizeData.ResizeDirection = GetEffectiveResizeDirection();
				_resizeData.SplitterLength = Math.Min(base.ActualWidth, base.ActualHeight);
				if (!SetupDefinitionsToResize())
				{
					_resizeData = null;
				}
				else
				{
					ResizeCalculator.Init(_resizeData.SplitBehavior);
					ResizeCalculator.Orientation = Orientation;
					if (!RedrawContent)
					{
						ResizePreviewHelper.InitResizing(default(Point), Manager.GetViewElement(this as IUIElement));
					}
				}
			}
			return _resizeData != null;
		}

		private static bool IsStar(DefinitionBase definition)
		{
			return DefinitionsHelper.IsStar(definition);
		}

		internal bool KeyboardMoveSplitter(double horizontalChange, double verticalChange)
		{
			if (_resizeData != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			InitializeData();
			if (_resizeData == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			MoveSplitter(CorrectChange(IsHorizontal ? horizontalChange : verticalChange));
			ResetResizing();
			return true;
		}

		private void MoveSplitter(double change)
		{
			using (new NotificationBatch(Manager))
			{
				Tuple<BaseLayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem> itemsToResize = GetItemsToResize();
				if (itemsToResize != null && itemsToResize.Item1 != null && itemsToResize.Item2 != null)
				{
					ResizeCalculator.Resize(itemsToResize.Item1, itemsToResize.Item2, change);
					NotifySizingAction(Manager);
				}
			}
		}

		private void NotifySizingAction(DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			if (LayoutGroup != null && manager != null)
			{
				int current = GetCurrent(LayoutGroup.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal);
				BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = LayoutGroup.ItemsInternal[current - 1] as BaseLayoutItem;
				BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem2 = LayoutGroup.ItemsInternal[current + 1] as BaseLayoutItem;
				DependencyProperty property = ((LayoutGroup.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal) ? BaseLayoutItem.ItemWidthProperty : BaseLayoutItem.ItemHeightProperty);
				if (baseLayoutItem != null)
				{
					NotificationBatch.Action(manager, baseLayoutItem, property);
				}
				if (baseLayoutItem2 != null)
				{
					NotificationBatch.Action(manager, baseLayoutItem2, property);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual double GetMin(DefinitionBase definition)
		{
			bool flag = definition is ColumnDefinition;
			BaseLayoutItem item = GetItem(definition, flag);
			if (item is FixedItem)
			{
				return 5.0;
			}
			if (item is LayoutPanel)
			{
				return flag ? 12 : 18;
			}
			if (item is TabbedGroup)
			{
				return 24.0;
			}
			if (item is LayoutControlItem)
			{
				return flag ? 24 : 10;
			}
			return 12.0;
		}

		private double CorrectChange(double change)
		{
			if (base.FlowDirection != _resizeData.Grid.FlowDirection)
			{
				change = 0.0 - change;
			}
			GetDeltaConstraints(out var minDelta, out var maxDelta);
			return Math.Min(Math.Max(change, minDelta), maxDelta);
		}

		private double GetActualChange(double horizontalChange, double verticalChange)
		{
			double dragIncrement = DragIncrement;
			double num = (IsHorizontal ? horizontalChange : verticalChange);
			return Math.Round(num / dragIncrement) * dragIncrement;
		}

		private void OnDragCompleted(DragCompletedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_resizeData != null)
			{
				if (!RedrawContent)
				{
					Dpi dpiFromVisual = DpiHelper.GetDpiFromVisual(this);
					double change = CorrectChange(GetActualChange(e.HorizontalChange / dpiFromVisual.ScaleX, e.VerticalChange / dpiFromVisual.ScaleY));
					MoveSplitter(change);
				}
				Tuple<BaseLayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem> itemsToResize = GetItemsToResize();
				RaiseDockOperationCompletedEvent(itemsToResize.Item1, itemsToResize.Item2);
				ResetResizing();
			}
			Manager.Do(delegate(ISupportBatchUpdate x)
			{
				x.EndUpdate();
			});
		}

		private void RaiseDockOperationCompletedEvent(BaseLayoutItem item1, BaseLayoutItem item2)
		{
			if (Manager != null)
			{
				Manager.RaiseDockOperationCompletedEvent(DockOperation.Resize, item1);
				Manager.RaiseDockOperationCompletedEvent(DockOperation.Resize, item2);
			}
		}

		private void OnDragDelta(DragDeltaEventArgs e)
		{
			if (_resizeData != null)
			{
				double num = CorrectChange(GetActualChange(e.HorizontalChange, e.VerticalChange));
				if (RedrawContent)
				{
					MoveSplitter(num);
				}
				else
				{
					ResizePreviewHelper.Resize(IsHorizontal ? new Point(num, 0.0) : new Point(0.0, num));
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual IResizeCalculator ResolveResizeCalculator()
		{
			return new LayoutResizeCalculator
			{
				Orientation = Orientation
			};
		}

		private void OnDragStarted(DragStartedEventArgs e)
		{
			Manager.Do(delegate(ISupportBatchUpdate x)
			{
				x.BeginUpdate();
			});
			CaptureMouse();
			if (InitializeData())
			{
				Tuple<BaseLayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem> itemsToResize = GetItemsToResize();
				if (RaiseDockOpearationStarted(itemsToResize.Item1, itemsToResize.Item2))
				{
					ResetResizing();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool RaiseDockOpearationStarted(BaseLayoutItem item1, BaseLayoutItem item2)
		{
			if (Manager != null)
			{
				if (!Manager.RaiseDockOperationStartingEvent(DockOperation.Resize, item1))
				{
					return Manager.RaiseDockOperationStartingEvent(DockOperation.Resize, item2);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private Tuple<BaseLayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem> GetItemsToResize()
		{
			Tuple<BaseLayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem> result = new Tuple<BaseLayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem>(null, null);
			if (IsDragStarted)
			{
				DefinitionBase definition = _resizeData.Definition1;
				DefinitionBase definition2 = _resizeData.Definition2;
				BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = null;
				BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem2 = null;
				if (definition != null && definition2 != null)
				{
					bool isColumn = _resizeData.ResizeDirection == GridResizeDirection.Columns;
					baseLayoutItem = GetItem(definition, isColumn);
					baseLayoutItem2 = GetItem(definition2, isColumn);
					result = new Tuple<BaseLayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem>(baseLayoutItem, baseLayoutItem2);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			switch (e.Key)
			{
			case Key.Left:
				e.Handled = KeyboardMoveSplitter(0.0 - KeyboardIncrement, 0.0);
				break;
			case Key.Up:
				e.Handled = KeyboardMoveSplitter(0.0, 0.0 - KeyboardIncrement);
				break;
			case Key.Right:
				e.Handled = KeyboardMoveSplitter(KeyboardIncrement, 0.0);
				break;
			case Key.Down:
				e.Handled = KeyboardMoveSplitter(0.0, KeyboardIncrement);
				break;
			case Key.Escape:
				if (_resizeData != null)
				{
					CancelResize();
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			Manager = DockLayoutManager.Ensure(this);
			if (LayoutGroup != null)
			{
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, OrientationProperty, LayoutGroup, LayoutGroup.OrientationProperty);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateCursor()
		{
			if (LayoutGroup != null)
			{
				UpdateCursor(LayoutGroup.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetDefinitionLength(DefinitionBase definition, GridLength length)
		{
			if (!(length.Value < 0.0))
			{
				bool flag = definition is ColumnDefinition;
				GetItem(definition, flag)?.SetValue(flag ? BaseLayoutItem.ItemWidthProperty : BaseLayoutItem.ItemHeightProperty, length);
			}
		}

		private BaseLayoutItem GetItem(DefinitionBase definition, bool isColumn)
		{
			if (_resizeData == null || _resizeData.Grid == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (LayoutGroup != null)
			{
				int num = (isColumn ? _resizeData.Grid.ColumnDefinitions.IndexOf(definition as ColumnDefinition) : _resizeData.Grid.RowDefinitions.IndexOf(definition as RowDefinition));
				if (num != -1)
				{
					return LayoutGroup.ItemsInternal[num] as BaseLayoutItem;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual int GetNext(int current)
		{
			if (LayoutGroup == null)
			{
				return current;
			}
			int num = LayoutGroup.ItemsInternal.IndexOf(this);
			BaseLayoutItem item = LayoutGroup.ItemsInternal[num + 1] as BaseLayoutItem;
			int num2 = LayoutGroup.Items.IndexOf(item);
			for (int i = num2; i < LayoutGroup.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				item = LayoutGroup.Items[i];
				if (IsResizableItem(item, IsHorizontal))
				{
					return LayoutGroup.ItemsInternal.IndexOf(item);
				}
			}
			return current;
		}

		protected virtual int GetPrev(int current)
		{
			if (LayoutGroup != null)
			{
				int num = LayoutGroup.ItemsInternal.IndexOf(this);
				BaseLayoutItem item = LayoutGroup.ItemsInternal[num - 1] as BaseLayoutItem;
				int num2 = LayoutGroup.Items.IndexOf(item);
				for (int num3 = num2; num3 >= 0; num3--)
				{
					item = LayoutGroup.Items[num3];
					if (IsResizableItem(item, IsHorizontal))
					{
						return LayoutGroup.ItemsInternal.IndexOf(item);
					}
				}
			}
			return current;
		}

		protected virtual int GetCurrent(bool isColumns)
		{
			return (int)GetValue(isColumns ? Grid.ColumnProperty : Grid.RowProperty);
		}

		private bool SetupDefinitionsToResize()
		{
			bool flag = _resizeData.ResizeDirection == GridResizeDirection.Columns;
			int num = (int)GetValue(flag ? Grid.ColumnSpanProperty : Grid.RowSpanProperty);
			if (num == 1)
			{
				int current = GetCurrent(flag);
				int prev = GetPrev(current);
				int next = GetNext(current);
				int num2 = (flag ? _resizeData.Grid.ColumnDefinitions.Count : _resizeData.Grid.RowDefinitions.Count);
				if (prev >= 0 && prev != current && next < num2 && next != current)
				{
					_resizeData.SplitterIndex = current;
					_resizeData.Definition1Index = prev;
					_resizeData.Definition1 = GetGridDefinition(_resizeData.Grid, prev, _resizeData.ResizeDirection);
					_resizeData.OriginalDefinition1Length = DefinitionsHelper.UserSizeValueCache(_resizeData.Definition1);
					_resizeData.OriginalDefinition1ActualLength = GetActualLength(_resizeData.Definition1);
					_resizeData.Definition2Index = next;
					_resizeData.Definition2 = GetGridDefinition(_resizeData.Grid, next, _resizeData.ResizeDirection);
					_resizeData.OriginalDefinition2Length = DefinitionsHelper.UserSizeValueCache(_resizeData.Definition2);
					_resizeData.OriginalDefinition2ActualLength = GetActualLength(_resizeData.Definition2);
					bool flag2 = IsStar(_resizeData.Definition1);
					bool flag3 = IsStar(_resizeData.Definition2);
					if (flag2 && flag3)
					{
						_resizeData.SplitBehavior = SplitBehavior.Split;
					}
					else
					{
						_resizeData.SplitBehavior = (flag2 ? SplitBehavior.Resize2 : (flag3 ? SplitBehavior.Resize1 : SplitBehavior.PixelSplit));
					}
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual void OnOrientationChanged(Orientation orientation)
		{
			if (base.IsMouseOver)
			{
				UpdateCursor();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateCursor(bool horz)
		{
			if (CanResize())
			{
				base.Cursor = (horz ? Cursors.SizeWE : Cursors.SizeNS);
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(FrameworkElement.CursorProperty);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			UpdateCursor();
		}

		private bool CanResize()
		{
			bool flag = GetEffectiveResizeDirection() == GridResizeDirection.Columns;
			int num = (int)GetValue(flag ? Grid.ColumnSpanProperty : Grid.RowSpanProperty);
			Grid parentGrid = GetParentGrid();
			if (parentGrid != null && num == 1)
			{
				int current = GetCurrent(flag);
				int prev = GetPrev(current);
				int next = GetNext(current);
				int num2 = (flag ? parentGrid.ColumnDefinitions.Count : parentGrid.RowDefinitions.Count);
				if (prev >= 0 && prev != current && next < num2 && next != current)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		internal bool IsControlBoxVisible => (bool)GetValue(IsControlBoxVisibleProperty);

		protected virtual bool AllowCustomContent => true;

		protected Panel PartButtonsPanel { get; private set; }

		static BaseControlBoxControl()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<BaseControlBoxControl>();
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<BaseControlBoxControl>.New().Register<Style>("ButtonStyle", ref ButtonStyleProperty, (Style)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null).Register<double>("ButtonWidth", ref ButtonWidthProperty, double.NaN, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<double>("ButtonHeight", ref ButtonHeightProperty, double.NaN, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<DataTemplate>("CloseButtonTemplate", ref CloseButtonTemplateProperty, (DataTemplate)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("IsCloseButtonVisible", ref IsCloseButtonVisibleProperty, false, (Action<BaseControlBoxControl, bool, bool>)delegate(BaseControlBoxControl d, bool oldValue, bool newValue)
				{
					d.OnIsCloseButtonVisibleChanged(oldValue, newValue);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure)
				.Register<BaseLayoutItem>("LayoutItem", ref LayoutItemProperty, (BaseLayoutItem)null, (Action<BaseControlBoxControl, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(BaseControlBoxControl dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs ea)
				{
					dObj.OnLayoutItemChanged((BaseLayoutItem)ea.NewValue);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<object>("ControlBoxContent", ref ControlBoxContentProperty, (object)null, (Action<BaseControlBoxControl, object, object>)delegate(BaseControlBoxControl d, object oldValue, object newValue)
				{
					d.OnControlBoxContentChanged(oldValue, newValue);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<DataTemplate>("ControlBoxContentTemplate", ref ControlBoxContentTemplateProperty, (DataTemplate)null, (Action<BaseControlBoxControl, DataTemplate, DataTemplate>)delegate(BaseControlBoxControl d, DataTemplate oldValue, DataTemplate newValue)
				{
					d.OnControlBoxContentTemplateChanged(oldValue, newValue);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("IsControlBoxVisible", ref IsControlBoxVisibleProperty, false, (Action<BaseControlBoxControl, bool, bool>)delegate(BaseControlBoxControl d, bool oldValue, bool newValue)
				{
					d.OnIsControlBoxVisibleChanged(oldValue, newValue);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("IsActuallyVisible", ref IsActuallyVisibleProperty, true, (Action<BaseControlBoxControl, bool, bool>)delegate(BaseControlBoxControl d, bool oldValue, bool newValue)
				{
					d.OnIsActuallyVisibleChanged(oldValue, newValue);
				}, (Func<BaseControlBoxControl, bool, bool>)((BaseControlBoxControl d, bool value) => d.OnCoerceIsActuallyVisible(value)), (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.RegisterAttached<BaseControlBoxControl, BaseControlBoxControl>("GetControlBox", ref ControlBoxProperty, (BaseControlBoxControl)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits)
				.RegisterAttachedReadOnly<BaseControlBoxControl, ICommand>("GetContextCommand", ref ContextCommandPropertyKey, ref ContextCommandProperty, (ICommand)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits);
		}

		internal static BaseControlBoxControl GetControlBox(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (BaseControlBoxControl)obj.GetValue(ControlBoxProperty);
		}

		internal static void SetControlBox(DependencyObject obj, ControlBox value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(ControlBoxProperty, value);
		}

		private static ContextAction GetContextAction(object param)
		{
			try
			{
				return (ContextAction)TypeCastHelper.TryCast(param, typeof(ContextAction));
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return ContextAction.Undefined;
			}
		}

		public static void Invalidate(DependencyObject sender)
		{
			GetControlBox(sender).Do(delegate(BaseControlBoxControl x)
			{
				x.InvalidateMeasure();
			});
		}

		public BaseControlBoxControl()
		{
			base.Background = Brushes.Transparent;
			DockPane.SetHitTestType(this, HitTestType.ControlBox);
			SetValue(ControlBoxProperty, this);
			SetValue(ContextCommandPropertyKey, new DelegateCommand<object>(OnExecute, CanExecute, false));
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			EnsureTemplateChildren();
			if (PartCloseButton != null)
			{
				PartCloseButton.SetToolTip(GetToolTip(DockingStringId.ControlButtonClose));
			}
			EnsureControlBoxContent();
			CoerceIsActuallyVisible();
		}

		internal static object GetToolTip(DockingStringId dockingStringId)
		{
			string text = DockingLocalizer.GetString(dockingStringId);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return text;
			}
			return null;
		}

		[Obsolete]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected internal virtual void SetHotButton(HitTestType hitTest)
		{
		}

		[Obsolete]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected internal virtual void SetPressedButton(HitTestType hitTest)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void ClearControlBoxBindings()
		{
			if (PartCustomContent != null && AllowCustomContent)
			{
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(PartCustomContent, ContentPresenter.ContentProperty);
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(PartCustomContent, ContentPresenter.ContentTemplateProperty);
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(PartCustomContent, UIElement.VisibilityProperty);
			}
			if (PartCloseButton != null)
			{
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(PartCloseButton, UIElement.VisibilityProperty);
			}
			BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, IsCloseButtonVisibleProperty);
			BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, ControlBoxContentProperty);
			BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, ControlBoxContentTemplateProperty);
			BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, IsControlBoxVisibleProperty);
		}

		protected void CoerceIsActuallyVisible()
		{
			CoerceValue(IsActuallyVisibleProperty);
		}

		protected T EnsurePresenter<T>(T part, string name) where T : psvContentPresenter
		{
			if (part != null && !LayoutItemsHelper.IsTemplateChild(part, this))
			{
				part.Dispose();
			}
			return GetTemplateChild(name) as T;
		}

		protected virtual void EnsureTemplateChildren()
		{
			PartButtonsPanel = LayoutItemsHelper.GetChild<Panel>(this);
			PartCustomContent = GetTemplateChild("PART_CustomContent") as ContentPresenter;
			PartCloseButton = EnsurePresenter(PartCloseButton, "PART_CloseButton");
		}

		protected void InvalidateContextCommand()
		{
			(ContextCommand as DelegateCommand<object>)?.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
		}

		protected virtual bool OnCoerceIsActuallyVisible(bool value)
		{
			if (LayoutItem != null)
			{
				bool flag = IsControlBoxVisible && PartCustomContent != null && (ControlBoxContent != null || ControlBoxContentTemplate != null);
				if (!IsCloseButtonVisible && !flag)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual void OnControlBoxContentChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			CoerceIsActuallyVisible();
		}

		protected virtual void OnControlBoxContentTemplateChanged(DataTemplate oldValue, DataTemplate newValue)
		{
			CoerceIsActuallyVisible();
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			ClearControlBoxBindings();
			LayoutItem = null;
			if (PartButtonsPanel != null)
			{
				PartButtonsPanel = null;
			}
			if (PartCloseButton != null)
			{
				PartCloseButton.Dispose();
				PartCloseButton = null;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsActuallyVisibleChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsCloseButtonVisibleChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			CoerceIsActuallyVisible();
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsControlBoxVisibleChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			CoerceIsActuallyVisible();
		}

		protected virtual void OnLayoutItemChanged(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			EnsureControlBoxContent();
		}

		protected virtual void SetControlBoxBindings()
		{
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, IsCloseButtonVisibleProperty, LayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem.IsCloseButtonVisibleProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, ControlBoxContentProperty, LayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem.ControlBoxContentProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, ControlBoxContentTemplateProperty, LayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem.ControlBoxContentTemplateProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, IsControlBoxVisibleProperty, LayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem.IsControlBoxVisibleProperty);
			if (PartCustomContent != null && AllowCustomContent)
			{
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(PartCustomContent, ContentPresenter.ContentProperty, LayoutItem, "ControlBoxContent");
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(PartCustomContent, ContentPresenter.ContentTemplateProperty, LayoutItem, "ControlBoxContentTemplate");
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(PartCustomContent, UIElement.VisibilityProperty, LayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem.IsControlBoxVisibleProperty, new BooleanToVisibilityConverter());
			}
			if (PartCloseButton != null)
			{
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(PartCloseButton, UIElement.VisibilityProperty, LayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem.IsCloseButtonVisibleProperty, new BooleanToVisibilityConverter());
			}
		}

		private bool CanExecute(object param)
		{
			ContextAction contextAction = GetContextAction(param);
			return base.Container?.CanExecuteContextAction(contextAction, LayoutItem) ?? false;
		}

		private void EnsureControlBoxContent()
		{
			if (LayoutItem != null)
			{
				SetControlBoxBindings();
			}
			else
			{
				ClearControlBoxBindings();
			}
		}

		private void OnExecute(object param)
		{
			ContextAction contextAction = GetContextAction(param);
			base.Container?.ExecuteContextAction(contextAction, LayoutItem);
		}
	}
	public class ControlBox : FrameworkElement
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty HotButtonProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PressedButtonProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MDIButtonMinimizeTemplateProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MDIButtonRestoreTemplateProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MDIButtonCloseTemplateProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MDIButtonBorderStyleProperty;

		public Style MDIButtonBorderStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return (Style)GetValue(MDIButtonBorderStyleProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MDIButtonBorderStyleProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public DataTemplate MDIButtonCloseTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return (DataTemplate)GetValue(MDIButtonCloseTemplateProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MDIButtonCloseTemplateProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public DataTemplate MDIButtonMinimizeTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return (DataTemplate)GetValue(MDIButtonMinimizeTemplateProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MDIButtonMinimizeTemplateProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public DataTemplate MDIButtonRestoreTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return (DataTemplate)GetValue(MDIButtonRestoreTemplateProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MDIButtonRestoreTemplateProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static ControlBox()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<ControlBox> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<ControlBox>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttachedInherited("HotButton", ref HotButtonProperty, HitTestType.Undefined);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttachedInherited("PressedButton", ref PressedButtonProperty, HitTestType.Undefined);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplate>("MDIButtonMinimizeTemplate", ref MDIButtonMinimizeTemplateProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((ControlBox)dObj).OnMDIButtonMinimizeChanged((DataTemplate)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplate>("MDIButtonRestoreTemplate", ref MDIButtonRestoreTemplateProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((ControlBox)dObj).OnMDIButtonRestoreChanged((DataTemplate)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplate>("MDIButtonCloseTemplate", ref MDIButtonCloseTemplateProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((ControlBox)dObj).OnMDIButtonCloseChanged((DataTemplate)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<Style>("MDIButtonBorderStyle", ref MDIButtonBorderStyleProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((ControlBox)dObj).OnMDIButtonBorderStyleChanged((Style)e.NewValue);
			});
		}

		public static HitTestType GetHotButton(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (HitTestType)obj.GetValue(HotButtonProperty);
		}

		public static void SetHotButton(DependencyObject obj, HitTestType value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(HotButtonProperty, value);
		}

		public static HitTestType GetPressedButton(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (HitTestType)obj.GetValue(PressedButtonProperty);
		}

		public static void SetPressedButton(DependencyObject obj, HitTestType value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(PressedButtonProperty, value);
		}

		public ControlBox()
		{
			base.Loaded += ControlBox_Loaded;
		}

		protected virtual void OnMDIButtonBorderStyleChanged(Style value)
		{
			DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = DockLayoutManager.Ensure(this);
			if (dockLayoutManager != null && !dockLayoutManager.IsDisposing)
			{
				dockLayoutManager.MDIController.MDIMenuBar.UpdateMDIButtonBorderStyle(dockLayoutManager, value);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnMDIButtonCloseChanged(DataTemplate value)
		{
			PrepareMDIButton(GetBarItem(MDIMenuBar.ItemType.Close), value);
		}

		protected virtual void OnMDIButtonMinimizeChanged(DataTemplate value)
		{
			PrepareMDIButton(GetBarItem(MDIMenuBar.ItemType.Minimize), value);
		}

		protected virtual void OnMDIButtonRestoreChanged(DataTemplate value)
		{
			PrepareMDIButton(GetBarItem(MDIMenuBar.ItemType.Restore), value);
		}

		protected virtual void PrepareMDIButton(BarMDIButtonItem barItem, DataTemplate value)
		{
			if (barItem != null)
			{
				((BarItem)barItem).GlyphTemplate = value;
			}
		}

		private void ControlBox_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnMDIButtonCloseChanged(MDIButtonCloseTemplate);
			OnMDIButtonRestoreChanged(MDIButtonRestoreTemplate);
			OnMDIButtonMinimizeChanged(MDIButtonMinimizeTemplate);
			OnMDIButtonBorderStyleChanged(MDIButtonBorderStyle);
		}

		private BarMDIButtonItem GetBarItem(MDIMenuBar.ItemType type)
		{
			DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = DockLayoutManager.Ensure(this);
			if (dockLayoutManager == null || dockLayoutManager.IsDisposing)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return dockLayoutManager.MDIController.MDIMenuBar.GetBarItem(type);
		}
	}

	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_ExpandButton", Type = typeof(ControlBoxButtonPresenter))]
	public class GroupBoxControlBoxControl : BaseControlBoxControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ExpandButtonTemplateProperty;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty AllowExpandProperty;

		public DataTemplate ExpandButtonTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return (DataTemplate)GetValue(ExpandButtonTemplateProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ExpandButtonTemplateProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public ControlBoxButtonPresenter PartExpandButton { get; private set; }

		internal bool AllowExpand => (bool)GetValue(AllowExpandProperty);

		static GroupBoxControlBoxControl()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<GroupBoxControlBoxControl> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<GroupBoxControlBoxControl>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<GroupBoxControlBoxControl>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplate>("ExpandButtonTemplate", ref ExpandButtonTemplateProperty);
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<GroupBoxControlBoxControl>.New().OverrideMetadata<Thickness>(FrameworkElement.MarginProperty, (Action<GroupBoxControlBoxControl>)delegate
			{
			}, (Func<GroupBoxControlBoxControl, Thickness, Thickness>)((GroupBoxControlBoxControl d, Thickness value) => d.OnCoerceMargin(value))).Register<bool>("AllowExpand", ref AllowExpandProperty, false, (Action<GroupBoxControlBoxControl, bool, bool>)delegate(GroupBoxControlBoxControl d, bool oldValue, bool newValue)
			{
				d.OnAllowExpandChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		protected override void ClearControlBoxBindings()
		{
			if (PartExpandButton != null)
			{
				PartExpandButton.ClearValue(UIElement.VisibilityProperty);
			}
			ClearValue(AllowExpandProperty);
			base.ClearControlBoxBindings();
		}

		protected override void EnsureTemplateChildren()
		{
			base.EnsureTemplateChildren();
			PartExpandButton = EnsurePresenter(PartExpandButton, "PART_ExpandButton");
		}

		protected virtual void OnAllowExpandChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			CoerceIsActuallyVisible();
		}

		protected override bool OnCoerceIsActuallyVisible(bool value)
		{
			if (!base.OnCoerceIsActuallyVisible(value))
			{
				if (PartExpandButton != null)
				{
					return AllowExpand;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual Thickness OnCoerceMargin(Thickness value)
		{
			if (!base.IsActuallyVisible)
			{
				return default(Thickness);
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (PartExpandButton != null)
			{
				PartExpandButton.Dispose();
				PartExpandButton = null;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnIsActuallyVisibleChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			base.OnIsActuallyVisibleChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			CoerceValue(FrameworkElement.MarginProperty);
		}

		protected override void SetControlBoxBindings()
		{
			base.SetControlBoxBindings();
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, AllowExpandProperty, base.LayoutItem, LayoutGroup.AllowExpandProperty);
			if (PartExpandButton != null)
			{
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(PartExpandButton, UIElement.VisibilityProperty, base.LayoutItem, LayoutGroup.AllowExpandProperty, new BooleanToVisibilityConverter());
			}
		}
	}

			{
				d.OnDockItemStateChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.RegisterReadOnly<DockItemState>("ActualDockItemState", ref ActualDockItemStatePropertyKey, ref ActualDockItemStateProperty, DockItemState.Undefined, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		protected virtual void OnDockItemStateChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			UpdateActualDockItemState();
		}

		protected override void OnLayoutItemChanged(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			base.OnLayoutItemChanged(item);
			if (base.LayoutItem is LayoutPanel)
			{
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, DockItemStateProperty, base.LayoutItem, LayoutPanel.DockItemStateProperty);
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(DockItemStateProperty);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnUseOptimizedTemplateChanged()
		{
			UpdateActualDockItemState();
		}

		protected override void SetControlBoxBindings()
		{
			base.SetControlBoxBindings();
			PartPinButton.Do(delegate(ControlBoxButtonPresenter x)
			{
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(x, UIElement.VisibilityProperty, base.LayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem.IsPinButtonVisibleProperty, new BooleanToVisibilityConverter());
			});
			PartMaximizeButton.Do(delegate(ControlBoxButtonPresenter x)
			{
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(x, UIElement.VisibilityProperty, base.LayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem.IsMaximizeButtonVisibleProperty, new BooleanToVisibilityConverter());
			});
			PartMinimizeButton.Do(delegate(ControlBoxButtonPresenter x)
			{
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(x, UIElement.VisibilityProperty, base.LayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem.IsMinimizeButtonVisibleProperty, new BooleanToVisibilityConverter());
			});
			PartRestoreButton.Do(delegate(ControlBoxButtonPresenter x)
			{
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(x, UIElement.VisibilityProperty, base.LayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem.IsRestoreButtonVisibleProperty, new BooleanToVisibilityConverter());
			});
			if (base.LayoutItem is LayoutPanel)
			{
				PartHideButton.Do(delegate(ControlBoxButtonPresenter x)
				{
					BindingHelper.SetBinding(x, UIElement.VisibilityProperty, base.LayoutItem, LayoutPanel.IsHideButtonVisibleProperty, new BooleanToVisibilityConverter());
				});
				PartExpandButton.Do(delegate(ControlBoxButtonPresenter x)
				{
					BindingHelper.SetBinding(x, UIElement.VisibilityProperty, base.LayoutItem, LayoutPanel.IsExpandButtonVisibleProperty, new BooleanToVisibilityConverter());
				});
				PartCollapseButton.Do(delegate(ControlBoxButtonPresenter x)
				{
					BindingHelper.SetBinding(x, UIElement.VisibilityProperty, base.LayoutItem, LayoutPanel.IsCollapseButtonVisibleProperty, new BooleanToVisibilityConverter());
				});
			}
		}

		private void UpdateActualDockItemState()
		{
			if (base.LayoutItem is LayoutPanel layoutPanel && UseOptimizedTemplate)
			{
				ActualDockItemState = (layoutPanel.IsFloating ? DockItemState.Floating : layoutPanel.DockItemState);
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(ActualDockItemStatePropertyKey);
			}
		}
	}

				PartScrollNextButton.ClearValue(UIElement.VisibilityProperty);
				PartScrollNextButton.ClearValue(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty);
			}
			if (PartDropDownButton != null)

			PartDropDownButton = EnsurePresenter(PartDropDownButton, "PART_DropDownButton");
			PartRestoreButton = EnsurePresenter(PartRestoreButton, "PART_RestoreButton");
			PartStackPanel = GetTemplateChild("PART_StackPanel") as StackPanel;
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size constraint)
		{
			Size size = base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			if (size != _measureResult)
			{
				(base.Parent as UIElement).If((UIElement x) => x.GetArrangeInProgress()).Do(delegate(UIElement x)
				{
					x.InvalidateMeasure();
				});
				_measureResult = size;
			}
			return size;
		}

				PartRestoreButton.Dispose();
				PartRestoreButton = null;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void SetControlBoxBindings()
		{

			{
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(PartScrollPrevButton, UIElement.VisibilityProperty, base.LayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem.IsScrollPrevButtonVisibleProperty, new BooleanToVisibilityConverter());
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(PartScrollPrevButton, UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, base.LayoutItem, LayoutGroup.TabHeaderCanScrollPrevProperty);
			}
			if (PartScrollNextButton != null)
			{
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(PartScrollNextButton, UIElement.VisibilityProperty, base.LayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem.IsScrollNextButtonVisibleProperty, new BooleanToVisibilityConverter());
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(PartScrollNextButton, UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, base.LayoutItem, LayoutGroup.TabHeaderCanScrollNextProperty);
			}
			if (PartDropDownButton != null)
			{
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(PartDropDownButton, UIElement.VisibilityProperty, base.LayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem.IsDropDownButtonVisibleProperty, new BooleanToVisibilityConverter());
			}
			if (PartRestoreButton != null)
			{
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(PartRestoreButton, UIElement.VisibilityProperty, base.LayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem.IsRestoreButtonVisibleProperty, new BooleanToVisibilityConverter());
			}
			if (PartStackPanel != null)

			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, CanScrollNextProperty, base.LayoutItem, LayoutGroup.TabHeaderCanScrollNextProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, CanScrollPrevProperty, base.LayoutItem, LayoutGroup.TabHeaderCanScrollPrevProperty);
		}

	public abstract class BaseCustomizationItem : ContentControl, IUIElement
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty LayoutItemProperty;

		public BaseLayoutItem LayoutItem
		{
			get
			{
				return (BaseLayoutItem)GetValue(LayoutItemProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LayoutItemProperty, value);
			}
		}

		IUIElement IUIElement.Scope => DockLayoutManager.GetUIScope(this);

		UIChildren IUIElement.Children { get; } = new UIChildren();

		static BaseCustomizationItem()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<BaseCustomizationItem>.New().Register<BaseLayoutItem>("LayoutItem", ref LayoutItemProperty, (BaseLayoutItem)null, (Action<BaseCustomizationItem, BaseLayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem>)delegate(BaseCustomizationItem d, BaseLayoutItem oldValue, BaseLayoutItem newValue)
			{
				d.OnLayoutItemChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		protected virtual void OnLayoutItemChanged(BaseLayoutItem oldValue, BaseLayoutItem newValue)
		{
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				newValue.Forward(this, ContentControl.ContentProperty, BaseLayoutItem.ActualCustomizationCaptionProperty);
				newValue.Forward(this, ContentControl.ContentTemplateProperty, BaseLayoutItem.ActualCustomizationCaptionTemplateProperty);
				newValue.Forward(this, ContentControl.ContentTemplateSelectorProperty, BaseLayoutItem.ActualCustomizationCaptionTemplateSelectorProperty);
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(ContentControl.ContentProperty);
				ClearValue(ContentControl.ContentTemplateProperty);
				ClearValue(ContentControl.ContentTemplateSelectorProperty);
			}
		}
	}
	[DXToolboxBrowsable(false)]
	public class DockHintButton : psvControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsHotProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsAvailableProperty;

		public bool IsHot
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsHotProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsHotProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsAvailable
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsAvailableProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsAvailableProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static DockHintButton()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DockHintButton> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DockHintButton>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("IsHot", ref IsHotProperty, defValue: false, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs ea)
			{
				((DockHintButton)dObj).OnIsHotChanged((bool)ea.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("IsAvailable", ref IsAvailableProperty, defValue: true, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs ea)
			{
				((DockHintButton)dObj).OnIsAvailableChanged((bool)ea.NewValue);
			});
		}

		public DockHintButton()
		{
			base.IsEnabledChanged += DockHintButton_IsEnabledChanged;
		}

		private void DockHintButton_IsEnabledChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsHotChanged(bool hot)
		{
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsAvailableChanged(bool available)
		{
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		private void UpdateVisualState()
		{
			if (base.IsEnabled)
			{
				if (IsAvailable)
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Available", useTransitions: false);
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, IsHot ? "MouseOver" : "Normal", useTransitions: false);
				}
				else
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Normal", useTransitions: false);
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Unavailable", useTransitions: false);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Normal", useTransitions: false);
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Disabled", useTransitions: false);
			}
		}
	}
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_MDIPanel", Type = typeof(MDIPanel))]
	public class DocumentMDIContainer : psvItemsControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty LayoutItemProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey HasMaximizedDocumentsPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty HasMaximizedDocumentsProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey IsHeaderVisiblePropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsHeaderVisibleProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ThemeDependentBackgroundProperty;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty BackgroundInternalProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ActualBackgroundProperty;

		public BaseLayoutItem LayoutItem
		{
			get
			{

			}
		}

		public LayoutGroup LayoutGroup => LayoutItem as LayoutGroup;

		public bool HasMaximizedDocuments => (bool)GetValue(HasMaximizedDocumentsProperty);

		public bool IsHeaderVisible
		{
			get
			{

			}

			}

		public MDIPanel PartMDIPanel { get; private set; }

		public ItemsPresenter PartMDIPanelPresenter { get; private set; }

		public ScrollViewer PartScroller { get; private set; }

		static DocumentMDIContainer()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DocumentMDIContainer> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DocumentMDIContainer>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<DocumentMDIContainer>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<BaseLayoutItem>("LayoutItem", ref LayoutItemProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DocumentMDIContainer)dObj).OnLayoutItemChanged((BaseLayoutItem)e.OldValue, (BaseLayoutItem)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("HasMaximizedDocuments", ref HasMaximizedDocumentsPropertyKey, ref HasMaximizedDocumentsProperty, defValue: false, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DocumentMDIContainer)dObj).OnHasMaximizedDocumentsChanged((bool)e.NewValue);
			}, (DependencyObject dObj, object value) => ((DocumentMDIContainer)dObj).CoerceHasMaximizedDocumentsVisible((bool)value));
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("IsHeaderVisible", ref IsHeaderVisiblePropertyKey, ref IsHeaderVisibleProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<Brush>("ThemeDependentBackground", ref ThemeDependentBackgroundProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DocumentMDIContainer)dObj).OnBackgroundChanged((Brush)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<Brush>("BackgroundInternal", ref BackgroundInternalProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DocumentMDIContainer)dObj).OnBackgroundChanged((Brush)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<Brush>("ActualBackground", ref ActualBackgroundProperty, null, null, (DependencyObject dObj, object value) => ((DocumentMDIContainer)dObj).CoerceActualBackground((Brush)value));
		}

		public DocumentMDIContainer()
		{
			this.StartListen(BackgroundInternalProperty, "Background");
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (PartMDIPanel != null)
			{
				PartMDIPanel.RequestBringIntoView -= PartMDIPanel_RequestBringIntoView;
			}
			ClearValue(LayoutItemProperty);
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected virtual void OnLayoutItemChanged(BaseLayoutItem oldItem, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			OnLayoutGroupChanged(oldItem as LayoutGroup, item as LayoutGroup);
		}

		protected virtual void OnLayoutGroupChanged(LayoutGroup oldGroup, LayoutGroup group)
		{
			if (oldGroup != null)
			{
				oldGroup.SelectedItemChanged -= OnSelectedDocumentChanged;
			}
			if (group == null)
			{
				ClearValue(DockLayoutManager.LayoutItemProperty);
				ClearValue(ItemsControl.ItemsSourceProperty);
			}
			else
			{
				SetValue(DockLayoutManager.LayoutItemProperty, group);
				SetValue(ItemsControl.ItemsSourceProperty, group.Items);
				group.SelectedItemChanged += OnSelectedDocumentChanged;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectedDocumentChanged(object sender, SelectedItemChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnHasMaximizedDocumentsChanged(HasMaximizedDocuments);
		}

		protected virtual void OnBackgroundChanged(Brush newValue)
		{
			CoerceValue(ActualBackgroundProperty);
		}

		protected virtual object CoerceActualBackground(Brush value)
		{
			return base.Background ?? ThemeDependentBackground;
		}

		protected override bool IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(object item)
		{
			if (!(item is BaseLayoutItem))
			{
				return item is MDIDocument;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override DependencyObject GetContainerForItemOverride()
		{
			return new MDIDocument();
		}

		protected virtual void OnHasMaximizedDocumentsChanged(bool hasMaximizedDocuments)
		{
			DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = DockLayoutManager.Ensure(this);
			IsHeaderVisible = false;
			if (hasMaximizedDocuments)
			{
				InvokeHelper.BeginInvoke(this, (Action)delegate
				{
					MDIControllerHelper.MergeMDITitles(GetActiveDocument());
				});
				if (!MDIControllerHelper.MergeMDIMenuItems(this))
				{
					IsHeaderVisible = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				MDIControllerHelper.UnMergeMDITitles(this);
				MDIControllerHelper.UnMergeMDIMenuItems(this);
			}
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		private void UpdateVisualState()
		{
			if (IsHeaderVisible)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "HeaderVisible", useTransitions: false);
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "HeaderHidden", useTransitions: false);
			}
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, HasMaximizedDocuments ? "Maximized" : "EmptyMaximizedState", useTransitions: false);
		}

		protected virtual bool CoerceHasMaximizedDocumentsVisible(bool baseValue)
		{
			foreach (DependencyObject item in (IEnumerable)base.Items)
			{
				if (MDIStateHelper.GetMDIState(item) == MDIState.Maximized)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainer(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			base.PrepareContainer(element, item);
			if (item is BaseLayoutItem)
			{
				((BaseLayoutItem)item).SelectTemplate();
			}
		}

		protected override void ClearContainer(DependencyObject element)
		{
			if (element is BaseLayoutItem)
			{
				((BaseLayoutItem)element).ClearTemplate();
			}
			CoerceValue(HasMaximizedDocumentsProperty);
			base.ClearContainer(element);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			PartScroller = LayoutItemsHelper.GetTemplateChild<ScrollViewer>(this);
			if (PartScroller != null)
			{
				PartScroller.Focusable = false;
				PartScroller.CanContentScroll = true;
				PartScroller.SetBinding(ScrollBarExtensions.AllowMouseScrollingProperty, new Binding
				{
					Source = LayoutItem,
					Path = new PropertyPath(ScrollBarExtensions.AllowMouseScrollingProperty)
				});
			}
			PartMDIPanelPresenter = GetTemplateChild("PART_MDIPanelPresenter") as ItemsPresenter;
			if (PartMDIPanelPresenter != null)
			{
				PartMDIPanelPresenter.Loaded += PartMDIPanelPresenter_Loaded;
			}
			CoerceValue(HasMaximizedDocumentsProperty);
		}

		private void PartMDIPanelPresenter_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			PartMDIPanelPresenter.Loaded -= PartMDIPanelPresenter_Loaded;
			PartMDIPanel = LayoutItemsHelper.GetTemplateChild<MDIPanel>(PartMDIPanelPresenter);
			if (PartMDIPanel != null)
			{
				PartMDIPanel.RequestBringIntoView += PartMDIPanel_RequestBringIntoView;
				if (HasMaximizedDocuments)
				{
					MDIControllerHelper.MergeMDITitles(GetActiveDocument());
				}
			}
		}

		private void PartMDIPanel_RequestBringIntoView(object sender, RequestBringIntoViewEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(e.OriginalSource is DocumentPanel))
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnActualSizeChanged(Size value)
		{
			base.OnActualSizeChanged(value);
			if (!base.IsDisposing)
			{
				if (PartMDIPanel != null)
				{
					PartMDIPanel.InvalidateMeasure();
				}
				if (DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(this) is DocumentGroup documentGroup)
				{
					documentGroup.MDIAreaSize = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public UIElement GetActiveDocument()
		{
			if (PartMDIPanel == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return PartMDIPanel.GetActiveDocument();
		}
	}
	public class MDIPanel : ScrollablePanel
	{
		static MDIPanel()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<MDIPanel> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<MDIPanel>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideMetadataNotDataBindable(Panel.IsItemsHostProperty, defValue: true);
		}

		public MDIDocument GetActiveDocument()
		{
			foreach (UIElement internalChild in base.InternalChildren)
			{
				if (internalChild != null)
				{
					BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = (internalChild as BaseLayoutItem) ?? DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(internalChild);
					if (baseLayoutItem != null && baseLayoutItem.Parent != null && baseLayoutItem.Parent.SelectedItem == baseLayoutItem)
					{
						return (internalChild as MDIDocument) ?? LayoutItemsHelper.GetVisualChild<MDIDocument>(baseLayoutItem);
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size avalaibleSize)
		{
			Rect rect = default(Rect);
			Size constraint = CheckConstraints(avalaibleSize);
			foreach (UIElement internalChild in base.InternalChildren)
			{
				if (internalChild != null)
				{
					Size availableSize = CheckMDISize(MDIStateHelper.GetMDIState(internalChild), DocumentPanel.GetMDISize(internalChild), constraint);
					internalChild.Measure(availableSize);
					Rect elementRect = GetElementRect(constraint, internalChild);
					rect.Union(elementRect);
				}
			}
			VerifyScrollData(avalaibleSize, rect.Size);
			return base.Viewport;
		}

		private Size CheckMDISize(MDIState state, Size mdiSize, Size constraint)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(mdiSize.Width))
			{
				mdiSize.Width = double.PositiveInfinity;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(mdiSize.Height))
			{
				mdiSize.Height = double.PositiveInfinity;
			}
			if (state == MDIState.Maximized)
			{
				mdiSize = constraint;
			}
			return mdiSize;
		}

		private Size CheckConstraints(Size constraint)
		{
			ScrollContentPresenter scrollContentPresenter = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<ScrollContentPresenter>((DependencyObject)this);
			if (double.IsInfinity(constraint.Width))
			{
				constraint.Width = scrollContentPresenter?.ViewportWidth ?? 1000.0;
			}
			if (double.IsInfinity(constraint.Height))
			{
				constraint.Height = scrollContentPresenter?.ViewportHeight ?? 1000.0;
			}
			return constraint;
		}

		protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size arrangeSize)
		{
			Rect rect = default(Rect);
			foreach (UIElement internalChild in base.InternalChildren)
			{
				if (internalChild != null)
				{
					Rect elementRect = GetElementRect(arrangeSize, internalChild);
					rect.Union(elementRect);
					elementRect.X -= base.HorizontalOffset;
					elementRect.Y -= base.VerticalOffset;
					internalChild.Arrange(elementRect);
				}
			}
			VerifyScrollData(arrangeSize, rect.Size);
			return arrangeSize;
		}

		private Rect GetElementRect(Size constraint, UIElement element)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = (element as BaseLayoutItem) ?? DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(element);
			MDIState mDIState = MDIStateHelper.GetMDIState(element);
			Point location = DocumentPanel.GetMDILocation(element);
			Size size = ((mDIState == MDIState.Minimized) ? new Size(double.NaN, double.NaN) : DocumentPanel.GetMDISize(element));
			if (double.IsNaN(size.Height) || double.IsNaN(size.Width))
			{
				Size actualMinSize = baseLayoutItem.ActualMinSize;
				Size actualMaxSize = baseLayoutItem.ActualMaxSize;
				double num = size.Width;
				double num2 = size.Height;
				if (double.IsNaN(num))
				{
					num = MathHelper.MeasureDimension(actualMinSize.Width, actualMaxSize.Width, element.DesiredSize.Width);
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(num2))
				{
					num2 = MathHelper.MeasureDimension(actualMinSize.Height, actualMaxSize.Height, element.DesiredSize.Height);
				}
				size = new Size(num, num2);
			}
			if (mDIState == MDIState.Maximized)
			{
				location = new Point(0.0, 0.0);
				size = constraint;
			}
			return new Rect(location, size);
		}

		private void CheckInternalChildren()
		{
			foreach (UIElement internalChild in base.InternalChildren)
			{
				if (internalChild != null && MDIStateHelper.GetMDIState(internalChild) == MDIState.Maximized)
				{
					InvalidateMeasure();
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnActualSizeChanged(Size value)
		{
			base.OnActualSizeChanged(value);
			CheckInternalChildren();
		}

		protected override void OnLoaded()
		{
			base.OnLoaded();
			CheckInternalChildren();
		}
	}
	public class DocumentTabContainer : LayoutTabControl

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ThemeDependentBackgroundProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey ActualBorderMarginPropertyKey;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey ActualContentBorderThicknessPropertyKey;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey HasTabColorPropertyKey;

		public Brush ActualBackground

		public Thickness BorderMargin

				return (Thickness)GetValue(BorderMarginProperty);

		public Thickness ContentBorderThickness

		public bool IsActive

			get
			{

			}
			set

		public Color TabColor
