		static DocumentTabContainer()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DocumentTabContainer> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DocumentTabContainer>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<DocumentTabContainer>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata(LayoutTabControl.ShowTabForSinglePageProperty, defValue: true);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<Brush>("ThemeDependentBackground", ref ThemeDependentBackgroundProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DocumentTabContainer)dObj).OnBackgroundChanged((Brush)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<Brush>("ActualBackground", ref ActualBackgroundProperty, null, null, (DependencyObject dObj, object value) => ((DocumentTabContainer)dObj).CoerceActualBackground((Brush)value));
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("TabColor", ref TabColorProperty, Colors.Transparent, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DocumentTabContainer)dObj).OnTabColorChanged((Color)e.OldValue, (Color)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("HasTabColor", ref HasTabColorPropertyKey, ref HasTabColorProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("IsActive", ref IsActiveProperty, defValue: false);
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DocumentTabContainer>.New().OverrideMetadata<Brush>(Control.BackgroundProperty, (Action<DocumentTabContainer, Brush, Brush>)delegate(DocumentTabContainer d, Brush oldValue, Brush newValue)
			{
				d.OnBackgroundChanged(newValue);
			}).Register<Thickness>("BorderMargin", ref BorderMarginProperty, default(Thickness), (Action<DocumentTabContainer, Thickness, Thickness>)delegate(DocumentTabContainer d, Thickness oldValue, Thickness newValue)
			{
				d.OnBorderMarginChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<Thickness>("ContentBorderThickness", ref ContentBorderThicknessProperty, default(Thickness), (Action<DocumentTabContainer, Thickness, Thickness>)delegate(DocumentTabContainer d, Thickness oldValue, Thickness newValue)
				{
					d.OnContentBorderThicknessChanged(oldValue, newValue);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.RegisterReadOnly<Thickness>("ActualBorderMargin", ref ActualBorderMarginPropertyKey, ref ActualBorderMarginProperty, default(Thickness), (Func<DocumentTabContainer, Thickness, Thickness>)((DocumentTabContainer d, Thickness value) => d.OnCoerceActualBorderMargin(value)), (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.RegisterReadOnly<Thickness>("ActualContentBorderThickness", ref ActualContentBorderThicknessPropertyKey, ref ActualContentBorderThicknessProperty, default(Thickness), (Func<DocumentTabContainer, Thickness, Thickness>)((DocumentTabContainer d, Thickness value) => d.OnCoerceActualContentBorderThickness(value)), (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected virtual object CoerceActualBackground(Brush value)
		{
			return base.Background ?? ThemeDependentBackground;
		}

		protected override psvSelectorItem CreateSelectorItem()
		{
			return new DocumentPaneItem();
		}

		protected override IView GetView(DockLayoutManager container)
		{
			DocumentPane documentPane = null;
			if (base.TemplatedParent is DocumentPaneContentPresenter documentPaneContentPresenter)
			{
				documentPane = documentPaneContentPresenter.Owner;
			}
			if (documentPane == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return container.GetView(documentPane.GetRootUIScope());
		}

		protected virtual void OnBackgroundChanged(Brush newValue)
		{
			CoerceValue(ActualBackgroundProperty);
		}

		protected virtual void OnBorderMarginChanged(Thickness oldValue, Thickness newValue)
		{
			CoerceValue(ActualBorderMarginProperty);
		}

		protected override void OnCaptionLocationChanged(CaptionLocation captionLocation)
		{
			base.OnCaptionLocationChanged(captionLocation);
			CoerceValue(ActualContentBorderThicknessProperty);
			CoerceValue(ActualBorderMarginProperty);
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected virtual Thickness OnCoerceActualBorderMargin(Thickness value)
		{
			return base.CaptionLocation.RotateThickness(BorderMargin);
		}

		protected virtual Thickness OnCoerceActualContentBorderThickness(Thickness value)
		{
			Thickness thickness = new Thickness(0.0, ContentBorderThickness.Top, 0.0, 0.0);
			return base.CaptionLocation.RotateThickness((base.ViewStyle == DockingViewStyle.Light) ? thickness : ContentBorderThickness);
		}

		protected virtual void OnContentBorderThicknessChanged(Thickness oldValue, Thickness newValue)
		{
			CoerceValue(ActualContentBorderThicknessProperty);
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			base.OnDispose();
			UnsubscribeItem(base.SelectedContent);
		}

		protected override void OnViewStyleChanged(DockingViewStyle oldValue, DockingViewStyle newValue)
		{
			base.OnViewStyleChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			CoerceValue(ActualContentBorderThicknessProperty);
		}

		protected override void OnHasItemsChanged(bool hasItems)
		{
			base.OnHasItemsChanged(hasItems);
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected override void OnSelectedContentChanged(BaseLayoutItem newValue, BaseLayoutItem oldValue)
		{
			base.OnSelectedContentChanged(newValue, oldValue);
			UnsubscribeItem(oldValue);
			SubscribeItem(newValue);
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected virtual void OnTabColorChanged(Color oldValue, Color newValue)
		{
			SetValue(HasTabColorPropertyKey, newValue != Colors.Transparent);
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateLocationState()
		{
			string stateName = "EmptyLocationState";
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, stateName, useTransitions: false);
			stateName = ((base.CaptionLocation == CaptionLocation.Default) ? CaptionLocation.Top : base.CaptionLocation).ToString();
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, stateName, useTransitions: false);
		}

		protected override void UpdateVisualState()
		{
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "ActiveEmptyState", useTransitions: false);
			if (base.HasItems)
			{
				if (base.SelectedContent != null)
				{
					if (base.SelectedContent.IsActive)
					{
						VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Active", useTransitions: false);
					}
					else
					{
						VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Inactive", useTransitions: false);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Empty", useTransitions: false);
			}
			UpdateLocationState();
			base.UpdateVisualState();
		}

		private void OnItemVisualChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		private void SubscribeItem(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				item.VisualChanged += OnItemVisualChanged;
				item.Forward(this, TabColorProperty, "ActualTabBackgroundColor");
				item.Forward(this, IsActiveProperty, "IsActive");
			}
		}

		private void UnsubscribeItem(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				item.VisualChanged -= OnItemVisualChanged;
				ClearValue(TabColorProperty);
				ClearValue(IsActiveProperty);
			}
		}
	}

		public ControlTemplate FormBorderTemplate

		public ControlTemplate SingleBorderTemplate

		static FormBorderControl()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<FormBorderControl> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<FormBorderControl>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<FormBorderControl>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<ControlTemplate>("EmptyBorderTemplate", ref EmptyBorderTemplateProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((FormBorderControl)dObj).SelectContainerTemplate();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<ControlTemplate>("SingleBorderTemplate", ref SingleBorderTemplateProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((FormBorderControl)dObj).SelectContainerTemplate();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<ControlTemplate>("FormBorderTemplate", ref FormBorderTemplateProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((FormBorderControl)dObj).SelectContainerTemplate();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("BorderStyle", ref BorderStyleProperty, FloatGroupBorderStyle.Form, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((FormBorderControl)dObj).OnBorderStyleChanged((FloatGroupBorderStyle)e.OldValue, (FloatGroupBorderStyle)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("IsMaximized", ref IsMaximizedProperty, defValue: false, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((FormBorderControl)dObj).OnIsMaximizedChanged((bool)e.OldValue, (bool)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<Thickness>("ActualBorderMargin", ref ActualBorderMarginProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<Thickness>("ActualShadowMargin", ref ActualShadowMarginProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ActualContentMargin", ref ActualContentMarginProperty, default(Thickness), null, (DependencyObject dObj, object value) => ((FormBorderControl)dObj).CoerceActualContentMargin());
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("SingleBorderMargin", ref SingleBorderMarginProperty, new Thickness(double.NaN), delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((FormBorderControl)dObj).OnContentMarginChanged();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("FormBorderMargin", ref FormBorderMarginProperty, new Thickness(double.NaN), delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((FormBorderControl)dObj).OnContentMarginChanged();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("MaximizedBorderMargin", ref MaximizedBorderMarginProperty, new Thickness(double.NaN), delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((FormBorderControl)dObj).OnContentMarginChanged();
			});
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<FormBorderControl>.New().AddOwner<BaseLayoutItem>(ref LayoutItemProperty, DockLayoutManager.LayoutItemProperty, (BaseLayoutItem)null, (Action<FormBorderControl, BaseLayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem>)delegate(FormBorderControl d, BaseLayoutItem oldValue, BaseLayoutItem newValue)
			{
				d.OnLayoutItemChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			});
		}

		protected virtual void OnContentMarginChanged()
		{
			CoerceValue(ActualContentMarginProperty);
		}

		protected virtual Thickness CoerceActualContentMargin()
		{
			Thickness thickness = MaximizedBorderMargin;
			if (!IsMaximized)
			{
				thickness = ((BorderStyle == FloatGroupBorderStyle.Single) ? SingleBorderMargin : FormBorderMargin);
			}
			if (MathHelper.AreEqual(thickness, new Thickness(double.NaN)))
			{
				return new Thickness(0.0);
			}
			return thickness;
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (PartItemsControl != null)
			{
				PartItemsControl.Dispose();
				PartItemsControl = null;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected virtual void OnBorderStyleChanged(FloatGroupBorderStyle oldValue, FloatGroupBorderStyle newValue)
		{
			CoerceValue(ActualContentMarginProperty);
			SelectContainerTemplate();
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsMaximizedChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			CoerceValue(ActualContentMarginProperty);
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		private void UpdateVisualState()
		{
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, IsMaximized ? "Maximized" : "EmptySizeState", useTransitions: false);
		}

		private void SelectContainerTemplate()
		{
			if (base.IsInitializedCore)
			{
				switch (BorderStyle)
				{
				case FloatGroupBorderStyle.Empty:
					base.Template = EmptyBorderTemplate;
					break;
				case FloatGroupBorderStyle.Single:
					base.Template = SingleBorderTemplate;
					break;
				case FloatGroupBorderStyle.Form:
					base.Template = FormBorderTemplate;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			if (PartItemsControl != null && !LayoutItemsHelper.IsTemplateChild(PartItemsControl, this))
			{
				PartItemsControl.Dispose();
			}
			FormBorderContentControl templateChild = LayoutItemsHelper.GetTemplateChild<FormBorderContentControl>(this);
			PartItemsControl = ((templateChild != null) ? (templateChild.Content as LayoutItemsControl) : LayoutItemsHelper.GetTemplateChild<LayoutItemsControl>(this));
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized()
		{
			base.OnInitialized();
			SelectContainerTemplate();
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsActiveChanged(bool value)
		{
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected virtual void OnLayoutItemChanged(BaseLayoutItem oldValue, BaseLayoutItem newValue)
		{
			if (newValue is FloatGroup control)
			{
				control.Forward(this, BorderStyleProperty, "BorderStyle");
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(BorderStyleProperty);
			}
		}
	}

	public class LabelControl : psvHeaderedContentControl
	{
		protected UIElement PartBorder { get; private set; }

		protected LabelControlCaptionPresenter PartCaption { get; private set; }

		protected LabelControlContentPresenter PartControl { get; private set; }

		protected LabelItem Item => base.LayoutItem as LabelItem;

		static LabelControl()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<LabelControl> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<LabelControl>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<LabelControl>();
		}

		public LabelControl()
		{
			base.LayoutUpdated += OnLayoutUpdated;
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			base.LayoutUpdated -= OnLayoutUpdated;
			ClearValue(DockLayoutManager.DockLayoutManagerProperty);
			ClearValue(DockLayoutManager.LayoutItemProperty);
			if (PartCaption != null)
			{
				PartCaption.Dispose();
				PartCaption = null;
			}
			if (PartControl != null)
			{
				PartControl.Dispose();
				PartControl = null;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			if (PartCaption != null && !LayoutItemsHelper.IsTemplateChild(PartCaption, this))
			{
				PartCaption.Dispose();
			}
			if (PartControl != null && !LayoutItemsHelper.IsTemplateChild(PartControl, this))
			{
				PartControl.Dispose();
			}
			PartBorder = GetTemplateChild("PART_Border") as UIElement;
			PartCaption = GetTemplateChild("PART_Caption") as LabelControlCaptionPresenter;
			PartControl = GetTemplateChild("PART_Content") as LabelControlContentPresenter;
			if (PartControl != null)
			{
				PartControl.EnsureOwner(this);
			}
		}

		private void OnLayoutUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateDesiredSize(base.DesiredSize);
		}

		private void UpdateDesiredSize(Size desiredSize)
		{
			if (Item != null && !Item.HasDesiredSize)
			{
				if (PartBorder != null)
				{
					desiredSize = PartBorder.DesiredSize;
				}
				Item.DesiredSizeInternal = desiredSize;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnActualSizeChanged(Size value)
		{
			base.OnActualSizeChanged(value);
			if (!base.IsDisposing)
			{
				BaseLayoutItem layoutItem = DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(this);
				if (layoutItem != null)
				{
					layoutItem.LayoutSize = value;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	}
	public class LabelControlContentPresenter : BasePanePresenter<LabelControl, LabelItem>

		private class DefaultContentTemplateSelector : DataTemplateSelector

				if (container is LabelControlContentPresenter { Owner: not null } labelControlContentPresenter)

				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		private DataTemplateSelector defaultContentTemplateSelector;

		private DataTemplateSelector _DefaultContentTemplateSelector
		{
			get
			{
				if (defaultContentTemplateSelector == null)
				{
					defaultContentTemplateSelector = new DefaultContentTemplateSelector();
				}
				return defaultContentTemplateSelector;
			}
		}

		protected override bool CanSelectTemplate(LabelItem item)
		{
			return _DefaultContentTemplateSelector != null;
		}

		protected override DataTemplate SelectTemplateCore(LabelItem item)
		{
			return _DefaultContentTemplateSelector.SelectTemplate(item, this);
		}

		protected override LabelItem ConvertToLogicalItem(object content)
		{
			return (LayoutItemData.ConvertToBaseLayoutItem(content) as LabelItem) ?? base.ConvertToLogicalItem(content);
		}

		static BaseDocument()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<BaseDocument> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<BaseDocument>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplate>("ControlHostTemplate", ref ControlHostTemplateProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplate>("LayoutHostTemplate", ref LayoutHostTemplateProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplate>("DataHostTemplate", ref DataHostTemplateProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("IsSelected", ref IsSelectedProperty, defValue: false, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((BaseDocument)dObj).OnIsSelectedChanged((bool)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<object>("LayoutItemContent", ref LayoutItemContentProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((BaseDocument)dObj).OnLayoutItemContentChanged(e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("IsActive", ref IsActiveProperty, defValue: false, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((BaseDocument)dObj).OnIsActiveChanged((bool)e.OldValue, (bool)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("CanMerge", ref CanMergeProperty, defValue: false, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((BaseDocument)dObj).OnCanMergeChanged((bool)e.OldValue, (bool)e.NewValue);

			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("IsMergingTarget", ref IsMergingTargetProperty, defValue: false, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			UnSubscribeInactiveLayer();
			UnMerge();
			ClearValue(ControlHostTemplateProperty);
			ClearValue(LayoutHostTemplateProperty);
			ClearValue(DataHostTemplateProperty);
			ClearValue(IsSelectedProperty);
			ClearValue(CanMergeProperty);
			ClearValue(IsMergingTargetProperty);
			ClearValue(LayoutItemContentProperty);
			if (PartContentPresenter != null)
			{
				PartContentPresenter.Dispose();
				PartContentPresenter = null;
			}
			isChildMenuVisibleChangedHandlers.Clear();
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			if (PartContentPresenter != null && !LayoutItemsHelper.IsTemplateChild(PartContentPresenter, this))
			{
				PartContentPresenter.Dispose();
			}
			PartContentPresenter = GetTemplateChild("PART_ContentPresenter") as DocumentContentPresenter;
			if (PartContentPresenter != null)
			{
				PartContentPresenter.EnsureOwner(this);
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(PartContentPresenter, DockItemContentPresenter<BaseDocument, DocumentPanel>.IsControlItemsHostProperty, base.LayoutItem, "IsControlItemsHost");
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(PartContentPresenter, DockItemContentPresenter<BaseDocument, DocumentPanel>.IsDataBoundProperty, base.LayoutItem, "IsDataBound");
			}
			EnsureTemplateChildren();
		}

		protected void EnsureTemplateChildren()
		{
			PartContent = GetTemplateChild((FrameworkElement x) => x.Name == "PART_Content");
			InactiveLayer = GetTemplateChild((FrameworkElement x) => x.Name == "PART_InactiveLayer");
			if (InactiveLayer != null)
			{
				SubscribeInactiveLayer();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnLayoutItemChanged(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem oldItem)
		{
			base.OnLayoutItemChanged(item, oldItem);
			if (item != null)
			{
				SetBinding(IsSelectedProperty, new Binding("IsSelectedItem")
				{
					Source = item
				});
				SetBinding(CanMergeProperty, new Binding("CanMerge")
				{
					Source = item
				});
				SetBinding(LayoutItemContentProperty, new Binding("Content")
				{
					Source = item
				});
				SetBinding(IsActiveProperty, new Binding("IsActive")
				{
					Source = item
				});
				SetBinding(IsMergingTargetProperty, new Binding("IsMergingTarget")
				{
					Source = item
				});
				if (PartContentPresenter != null)
				{
					BindingHelper.SetBinding(PartContentPresenter, DockItemContentPresenter<BaseDocument, DocumentPanel>.IsControlItemsHostProperty, base.LayoutItem, "IsControlItemsHost");
					BindingHelper.SetBinding(PartContentPresenter, DockItemContentPresenter<BaseDocument, DocumentPanel>.IsDataBoundProperty, base.LayoutItem, "IsDataBound");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, IsSelectedProperty);
				BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, CanMergeProperty);
				BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, IsMergingTargetProperty);
				BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, LayoutItemContentProperty);
				BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, IsActiveProperty);
			}
			CheckIsChildMenuVisible();
		}

		protected virtual bool GetIsChildMenuVisible()
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual bool GetIsChildMenuVisibleForFloatingElement(bool isFloating)
		{
			//IL_0057: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0060: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0062: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			Func<IMergingSupport, bool> predicate = (IMergingSupport x) => (x is IBar && !(x is ClosedItemsBar)) || x is IRibbonControl;
			if (DocumentPanel == null || DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(this) || !BarNameScope.GetService<IElementRegistratorService>((object)this).GetElements<IMergingSupport>((ScopeSearchSettings)1).Any(predicate))
			{
				return true;
			}
			MDIMergeStyle actualMDIMergeStyle = MDIControllerHelper.GetActualMDIMergeStyle(DocumentPanel.GetDockLayoutManager(), DocumentPanel);
			if (!isFloating)
			{
				return (int)actualMDIMergeStyle == 3;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual void OnLayoutItemContentChanged(object oldContent, object newContent)
		{
			if (oldContent != null)
			{
				UnMerge();
			}
			ProcessMergeActions();
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsActiveChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			ProcessMergeActions();
		}

		protected virtual void ProcessMergeActions(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void ProcessMergeActions()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsSelectedChanged(bool selected)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnCanMergeChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			ProcessMergeActions();
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsMergingTargetChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			ProcessMergeActions();
		}

		protected void CheckIsChildMenuVisible()
		{
			IsChildMenuVisibleCore = GetIsChildMenuVisible();
		}

		protected override void OnActualSizeChanged(Size value)
		{
			base.OnActualSizeChanged(value);
			if (!base.IsDisposing && base.LayoutItem != null)
			{
				base.LayoutItem.LayoutSize = value;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnLoaded()
		{
			base.OnLoaded();
			CheckIsChildMenuVisible();
		}

		private T GetTemplateChild<T>(Func<T, bool> predicate)
		{
			return LayoutTreeHelper.GetVisualChildren((DependencyObject)this).OfType<T>().FirstOrDefault(predicate);
		}

		private void SubscribeInactiveLayer()
		{
			//IL_0061: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (InactiveLayer != null)
			{
				InactiveLayer.AllowDrop = true;
				InactiveLayer.MouseDown += InactiveLayer_MouseDown;
				InactiveLayer.DragEnter += InactiveLayer_DragEnter;
				if (DocumentPanel != null)
				{
					BindingHelper.SetBinding(InactiveLayer, UIElement.IsHitTestVisibleProperty, DocumentPanel, DocumentPanel.EnableMouseHoverWhenInactiveProperty, (IValueConverter)new BoolInverseConverter());
				}
			}
		}

		private void UnSubscribeInactiveLayer()
		{
			if (InactiveLayer != null)
			{
				InactiveLayer.MouseDown -= InactiveLayer_MouseDown;
				InactiveLayer.DragEnter -= InactiveLayer_DragEnter;
				BindingHelper.ClearBinding(InactiveLayer, UIElement.IsHitTestVisibleProperty);
			}
		}

		private void InactiveLayer_MouseDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (PartContent != null)
			{
				PartContent.InputHitTest(e.GetPosition(InactiveLayer))?.RaiseEvent(e);
			}
		}

		private void InactiveLayer_DragEnter(object sender, DragEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.Container != null)
			{
				base.Container.Activate(base.LayoutItem);
			}
		}

		protected void UnMerge()
		{
			if (fMergingRequested)
			{
				fMergingRequested = false;
			}
			UnmergeCore();
		}

		protected void Merge()
		{
			if (fMergingRequested && !DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(this))
			{
				MergeCore();
				fMergingRequested = false;
			}
		}

		protected void BeginMerge()
		{
			if (!fMergingRequested)
			{
				fMergingRequested = true;
				InvalidateArrange();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UnmergeCore()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void MergeCore()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void NotifyListeners()
		{
			foreach (EventHandler isChildMenuVisibleChangedHandler in isChildMenuVisibleChangedHandlers)
			{
				isChildMenuVisibleChangedHandler?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}
	}
	public class DocumentContentPresenter : DockItemContentPresenter<BaseDocument, DocumentPanel>
	{
		private class DefaultContentTemplateSelector : DataTemplateSelector
		{
			public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
			{
				DocumentContentPresenter documentContentPresenter = container as DocumentContentPresenter;
				if (item is DocumentPanel documentPanel && documentContentPresenter != null && documentContentPresenter.Owner != null)
				{
					if (!documentPanel.IsControlItemsHost)
					{
						if (!documentPanel.IsDataBound)
						{
							return documentContentPresenter.Owner.ControlHostTemplate;
						}
						return documentContentPresenter.Owner.DataHostTemplate;
					}
					return documentContentPresenter.Owner.LayoutHostTemplate;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		private DataTemplateSelector defaultContentTemplateSelector;

		private DataTemplateSelector _DefaultContentTemplateSelector
		{
			get
			{
				if (defaultContentTemplateSelector == null)
				{
					defaultContentTemplateSelector = new DefaultContentTemplateSelector();
				}
				return defaultContentTemplateSelector;
			}
		}

		public DockBarContainerControl PartBarContainer { get; private set; }

		public UIElementPresenter PartControl { get; private set; }

		public psvContentPresenter PartLayout { get; private set; }

		public psvContentPresenter PartContent { get; private set; }

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (PartBarContainer != null)
			{
				PartBarContainer.Dispose();
				PartBarContainer = null;
			}
			if (PartControl != null)
			{
				PartControl.Dispose();
				PartControl = null;
			}
			if (PartLayout != null)
			{
				PartLayout.Dispose();
				PartLayout = null;
			}
			if (PartContent != null)
			{
				PartContent.Dispose();
				PartContent = null;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override bool CanSelectTemplate(DocumentPanel document)
		{
			return _DefaultContentTemplateSelector != null;
		}

		protected override DataTemplate SelectTemplateCore(DocumentPanel document)
		{
			return _DefaultContentTemplateSelector.SelectTemplate(document, this);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			if (PartBarContainer != null && !LayoutItemsHelper.IsTemplateChild((DependencyObject)(object)PartBarContainer, this))
			{
				PartBarContainer.Dispose();
			}
			PartBarContainer = LayoutItemsHelper.GetTemplateChild<DockBarContainerControl>((DependencyObject)this);
			if (PartControl != null && !LayoutItemsHelper.IsTemplateChild(PartControl, this))
			{
				PartControl.Dispose();
			}
			PartControl = LayoutItemsHelper.GetTemplateChild<UIElementPresenter>(this);
			if (PartLayout != null && !LayoutItemsHelper.IsTemplateChild(PartLayout, this))
			{
				PartLayout.Dispose();
			}
			ScrollViewer templateChild = LayoutItemsHelper.GetTemplateChild<ScrollViewer>(this);
			if (templateChild != null)
			{
				PartLayout = templateChild.Content as psvContentPresenter;
			}
			if (PartContent != null && !LayoutItemsHelper.IsTemplateChild(PartContent, this))
			{
				PartContent.Dispose();
			}
			PartContent = LayoutItemsHelper.GetTemplateChild<psvContentPresenter>(this, acceptRoot: false);
		}
	}
	public class Document : BaseDocument
	{
		static Document()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<Document> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<Document>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<Document>();
		}

		protected override bool GetIsChildMenuVisible()
		{
			return GetIsChildMenuVisibleForFloatingElement(base.DocumentPanel == null || base.DocumentPanel.IsFloating);
		}

		protected override void ProcessMergeActions()
		{
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0046: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			if (base.LayoutItem == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag;
			if (!base.CanMerge)
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			else
			{
				MDIMergeStyle actualMDIMergeStyle = MDIControllerHelper.GetActualMDIMergeStyle(base.LayoutItem.GetDockLayoutManager(), base.LayoutItem);
				switch ((int)actualMDIMergeStyle)
				{
				case 0:
				case 2:
					flag = true;
					break;
				case 3:
					flag = false;
					break;
				case 4:
					flag = base.IsMergingTarget;
					break;
				default:
					flag = base.IsActive;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				BeginMerge();
			}
			else
			{
				UnMerge();
			}
		}

		protected override void Subscribe(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			base.Subscribe(item);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, LayoutPanel.MDIMergeStyleProperty, item, LayoutPanel.MDIMergeStyleProperty);
		}
	}
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_Header", Type = typeof(UIElement))]
	public class MDIDocument : BaseDocument
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsMaximizedProperty;

		public bool IsMaximized
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsMaximizedProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsMaximizedProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected UIElement PartHeader { get; private set; }

		static MDIDocument()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<MDIDocument> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<MDIDocument>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<MDIDocument>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("IsMaximized", ref IsMaximizedProperty, defValue: false, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((MDIDocument)dObj).OnIsMaximizedChanged((bool)e.OldValue, (bool)e.NewValue);
			});
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(MDIDocument), AccessKeyManager.AccessKeyPressedEvent, new AccessKeyPressedEventHandler(OnAccessKeyPressed));
		}

		private static void OnAccessKeyPressed(object sender, AccessKeyPressedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is MDIDocument mDIDocument)
			{
				BaseLayoutItem layoutItem = DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(mDIDocument);
				if (layoutItem != null && !layoutItem.IsActive && LayoutHelper.IsChildElement((DependencyObject)mDIDocument, (DependencyObject)e.Target))
				{
					e.Target = null;
				}
			}
		}

		public MDIDocument()
		{
			KeyboardNavigation.SetTabNavigation(this, KeyboardNavigationMode.Cycle);
			KeyboardNavigation.SetDirectionalNavigation(this, KeyboardNavigationMode.Cycle);
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			ClearValue(DocumentPanel.MDILocationProperty);
			ClearValue(DocumentPanel.MDISizeProperty);
			ClearValue(MDIStateHelper.MDIStateProperty);
			ClearValue(Panel.ZIndexProperty);
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			SetConstraintBindings();
			PartHeader = GetTemplateChild("PART_Header") as UIElement;
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		private void SetConstraintBindings()
		{
			SetBinding(FrameworkElement.MinWidthProperty, new Binding("ActualMinSize")
			{
				Converter = new MinSizeConverter(isWidth: true)
			});
			SetBinding(FrameworkElement.MinHeightProperty, new Binding("ActualMinSize")
			{
				Converter = new MinSizeConverter(isWidth: false)
			});
			SetBinding(FrameworkElement.MaxWidthProperty, new Binding("ActualMaxSize")
			{
				Converter = new MaxSizeConverter(isWidth: true)
			});
			SetBinding(FrameworkElement.MaxHeightProperty, new Binding("ActualMaxSize")
			{
				Converter = new MaxSizeConverter(isWidth: false)
			});
		}

		private void SetBindings(DocumentPanel document)
		{
			if (document != null)
			{
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, DocumentPanel.MDILocationProperty, document, DocumentPanel.MDILocationProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay);
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, DocumentPanel.MDISizeProperty, document, DocumentPanel.MDISizeProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay);
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, MDIStateHelper.MDIStateProperty, document, MDIStateHelper.MDIStateProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay);
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, LayoutPanel.MDIMergeStyleProperty, document, LayoutPanel.MDIMergeStyleProperty);
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, IsMaximizedProperty, document, LayoutPanel.IsMaximizedProperty);
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, Panel.ZIndexProperty, document, Panel.ZIndexProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay);
			}
		}

		protected override void Subscribe(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			base.Subscribe(item);
			if (item != null)
			{
				item.VisualChanged += OnItemVisualChanged;
				SetBindings(item as DocumentPanel);
			}
		}

		protected override void Unsubscribe(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			base.Unsubscribe(item);
			if (item != null)
			{
				item.VisualChanged -= OnItemVisualChanged;
			}
		}

		private void OnItemVisualChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateVisualState()
		{
			if (base.DocumentPanel != null)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, base.DocumentPanel.IsActive ? "Active" : "Inactive", useTransitions: false);
				if (base.DocumentPanel.IsMaximized)
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Maximized", useTransitions: false);
				}
				else if (base.DocumentPanel.IsMinimized)
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Minimized", useTransitions: false);
				}
				else
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "EmptyMDIState", useTransitions: false);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnActualSizeChanged(Size value)
		{
			base.OnActualSizeChanged(value);
			if (!base.IsDisposing && DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(this) is DocumentPanel documentPanel)
			{
				documentPanel.MDIDocumentSize = value;
				if (documentPanel.Parent is DocumentGroup documentGroup && PartHeader != null)
				{
					documentGroup.MDIDocumentHeaderHeight = Math.Max(PartHeader.RenderSize.Height, documentGroup.MDIDocumentHeaderHeight);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ProcessMergeActions()
		{
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			if (base.LayoutItem != null)
			{
				bool flag;
				if (!base.CanMerge)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				else
				{
					MDIMergeStyle actualMDIMergeStyle = MDIControllerHelper.GetActualMDIMergeStyle(base.LayoutItem.GetDockLayoutManager(), base.LayoutItem);
					flag = (actualMDIMergeStyle - 2) switch
					{
						0 => true, 
						1 => false, 
						2 => base.IsMergingTarget, 
						_ => base.IsActive, 
					};
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					BeginMerge();
				}
				else
				{
					UnMerge();
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsMaximizedChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			CheckIsChildMenuVisible();
		}

		protected override bool GetIsChildMenuVisible()
		{
			return GetIsChildMenuVisibleForFloatingElement(!IsMaximized);
		}
	}

		{

			{
				EnsureTemplateChildren();
			}
		}
	}

		public LayoutTabControl()

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			//IL_008f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			PartHeadersPresenter = GetTemplateChild("PART_HeadersPanelPresenter") as ItemsPresenter;
			PartSelectedPage = GetTemplateChild("PART_SelectedPage") as FrameworkElement;
			PartControlBox = GetTemplateChild("PART_ControlBox") as BaseControlBoxControl;
			if (PartFastRenderPanel != null && !LayoutItemsHelper.IsTemplateChild(PartFastRenderPanel, this))
			{
				PartFastRenderPanel.Dispose();
			}
			PartFastRenderPanel = GetTemplateChild("PART_FastRenderPanel") as LayoutTabFastRenderPanel;
			if (PartFastRenderPanel != null)
			{
				PartFastRenderPanel.Initialize(this, ActualTabContentCacheMode);
			}
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected void CheckSelectionInGroup()
		{
			if (DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(this) is LayoutGroup layoutGroup)
			{
				int selectedIndex = base.SelectedIndex;
				layoutGroup.CoerceValue(LayoutGroup.SelectedItemProperty);
				if (layoutGroup is TabbedGroup tabbedGroup && tabbedGroup.SelectedTabIndex != selectedIndex)
				{
					tabbedGroup.SelectedTabIndex = selectedIndex;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ClearGroupBindings(LayoutGroup oldValue)
		{
			ClearValue(psvSelector<BaseLayoutItem>.SelectedIndexProperty);
			ClearValue(TabHeaderLayoutTypeProperty);
			ClearValue(CaptionLocationProperty);
			ClearValue(CaptionOrientationProperty);
			ClearValue(IsAutoFillHeadersProperty);
			ClearValue(ScrollIndexProperty);
			ClearValue(DestroyContentOnTabSwitchingProperty);
			ClearValue(TabContentCacheModeProperty);
			ClearValue(ItemsControl.ItemContainerStyleProperty);
			ClearValue(ItemsControl.ItemContainerStyleSelectorProperty);
			ClearValue(ShowTabForSinglePageProperty);
			ClearValue(VisiblePagesCountProperty);

			ClearValue(ArrangeAllCachedTabsProperty);
			ClearValue(TabbedGroupDisplayModeProperty);
		}

		}

		protected override void EnsureItemsPanelCore(Panel itemsPanel)
		{
			base.EnsureItemsPanelCore(itemsPanel);
			partHeadersPanel = itemsPanel as TabHeadersPanel;
			EnsureTabHeadersPanel();
		}

		protected virtual void EnsureTabHeadersPanel()
		{
			if (PartHeadersPanel == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			PartHeadersPanel.Orientation = HeadersPanelHelper.GetOrientation(CaptionLocation);
			PartHeadersPanel.TabHeaderLayoutType = TabHeaderLayoutType;
			PartHeadersPanel.IsAutoFillHeaders = IsAutoFillHeaders;
			PartHeadersPanel.FixedMultiLineTabHeaders = FixedMultiLineTabHeaders;
			this.Forward(PartHeadersPanel, BaseHeadersPanel.ClipMarginProperty, "ActualClipMargin");
			this.Forward(PartHeadersPanel, BaseHeadersPanel.AutoScrollOnOverflowProperty, "AutoScrollOnOverflow");
			PartHeadersPanel.ScrollIndex = ScrollIndex;
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				PartHeadersPanel.SelectedIndex = base.SelectedIndex;
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					PartHeadersPanel.AllowAnimation = true;
				}, DispatcherPriority.Render);
			});
			UpdatePanelMeasure();
		}

		protected void EnsureSelectedContent()
		{
			if (base.SelectedContent != null)
			{
				base.SelectedContent.SelectTemplate();
			}
		}

		}

		}

		protected virtual void OnHasScrollChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			if (!newValue || PartControlBox == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action<FrameworkElement>)delegate(FrameworkElement x)
			{
				x.InvalidateMeasure();
				x.With((FrameworkElement y) => y.Parent as FrameworkElement).Do(delegate(FrameworkElement y)
				{
					y.InvalidateMeasure();
				});
			}, PartControlBox);
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsAutoFillHeadersChanged(bool autoFill)
		{
			if (PartHeadersPanel != null)
			{
				PartHeadersPanel.IsAutoFillHeaders = autoFill;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnLayoutGroupChanged(LayoutGroup group)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnLayoutGroupChanged(LayoutGroup oldValue, LayoutGroup value)
		{
			OnLayoutGroupChanged(value);
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				ClearGroupBindings(oldValue);
				oldValue.WeakItemsChanged -= weakItemsChangedHandler;
				ClearValue(DockLayoutManager.LayoutItemProperty);
				if (!base.IsDisposing)
				{
					ClearItemsSource();
				}
			}
			if (value != null)
			{
				SetValue(DockLayoutManager.LayoutItemProperty, value);
				SetValue(ItemsControl.ItemsSourceProperty, value.Items);
				value.WeakItemsChanged += weakItemsChangedHandler;
				SetGroupBindings(value);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnLayoutItemChanged(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnLayoutItemChanged(BaseLayoutItem oldValue, BaseLayoutItem value)
		{
			OnLayoutItemChanged(value);
			OnLayoutGroupChanged(oldValue as LayoutGroup, value as LayoutGroup);
		}

		protected virtual void OnScrollIndexChanged(int index)
		{
			if (PartHeadersPanel != null)
			{
				PartHeadersPanel.ScrollIndex = index;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSelectedContentChanged(BaseLayoutItem newValue, BaseLayoutItem oldValue)
		{
			//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			base.OnSelectedContentChanged(newValue, oldValue);
			if (base.Container != null)
			{
				base.Container.InvalidateView(LayoutGroup);
			}
			if (oldValue != null && (int)ActualTabContentCacheMode == 0)
			{
				using (new LogicalTreeLocker(base.Container, oldValue))
				{
					oldValue.ClearTemplate();
				}
			}
			newValue?.SelectTemplate();
			RaiseSelectedContentChanged(oldValue, newValue);
		}

		protected override void OnSelectedIndexChanged(int index, int oldIndex)
		{

			if (PartHeadersPanel != null)

				PartHeadersPanel.SelectedIndex = index;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSelectedItemChanged(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem oldItem)
		{
			base.OnSelectedItemChanged(item, oldItem);
			if (PartHeadersPanel != null)
			{
				PartHeadersPanel.InvalidateMeasure();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnShowTabForSinglePageChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)

		}

		protected virtual void OnTabbedGroupDisplayModeChanged(TabbedGroupDisplayMode oldValue, TabbedGroupDisplayMode newValue)

		protected virtual void OnTabCacheModeChanged()

			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ActualTabContentCacheMode = (TabContentCacheMode)((!DestroyContentOnTabSwitching) ? 2 : ((int)TabContentCacheMode));
		}

		protected override void PrepareSelectorItem(psvSelectorItem selectorItem, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			base.PrepareSelectorItem(selectorItem, item);
			if (selectorItem is TabbedPaneItem tabbedPaneItem)
			{
				tabbedPaneItem.CaptionOrientation = CaptionOrientation;
				tabbedPaneItem.CaptionLocation = CaptionLocation;
			}
			item.EnsureTemplate();
		}

		protected virtual void RaiseItemsChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)

		protected virtual void SetGroupBindings(LayoutGroup group)
		{
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, psvSelector<BaseLayoutItem>.SelectedIndexProperty, group, LayoutGroup.SelectedTabIndexProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, TabHeaderLayoutTypeProperty, group, LayoutGroup.TabHeaderLayoutTypeProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, CaptionLocationProperty, group, BaseLayoutItem.CaptionLocationProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, CaptionOrientationProperty, group, LayoutGroup.CaptionOrientationProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, IsAutoFillHeadersProperty, group, LayoutGroup.TabHeadersAutoFillProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, ScrollIndexProperty, group, LayoutGroup.TabHeaderScrollIndexProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, DestroyContentOnTabSwitchingProperty, LayoutGroup, LayoutGroup.DestroyContentOnTabSwitchingProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, TabContentCacheModeProperty, LayoutGroup, LayoutGroup.TabContentCacheModeProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, ItemsControl.ItemContainerStyleProperty, group, LayoutGroup.TabItemContainerStyleProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, ItemsControl.ItemContainerStyleSelectorProperty, group, LayoutGroup.TabItemContainerStyleSelectorProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, FixedMultiLineTabHeadersProperty, group, LayoutGroup.FixedMultiLineTabHeadersProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, VisiblePagesCountProperty, group, LayoutGroup.VisiblePagesCountProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, AutoScrollOnOverflowProperty, group, LayoutGroup.AutoScrollOnOverflowProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, HasScrollProperty, group, LayoutGroup.TabHeaderHasScrollProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, ShowTabHeadersProperty, group, LayoutGroup.ShowTabHeadersProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, ViewStyleProperty, group, BaseLayoutItem.DockingViewStyleProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, ArrangeAllCachedTabsProperty, group, LayoutGroup.ArrangeAllCachedTabsProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, TabbedGroupDisplayModeProperty, group, LayoutGroup.TabbedGroupDisplayModeCoreProperty);
			if (group is TabbedGroup)
			{
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, ShowTabForSinglePageProperty, group, TabbedGroup.ShowTabForSinglePageProperty);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateVisualState()
		{
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, AreTabHeadersVisible ? "HeaderVisible" : "HeaderHidden", useTransitions: false);
		}

		private object CoerceActualClipMargin(Thickness value)
		{
			double num = ((ScreenHelper.DpiThicknessCorrection < 1.0) ? 1.0 : ScreenHelper.DpiThicknessCorrection);
			return ThicknessHelper.Multiply(RotateMargin(ClipMargin), num);
		}

		private object CoerceActualTabPanelMargin(Thickness value)
		{
			return ThicknessHelper.Multiply(RotateMargin(TabPanelMargin), ScreenHelper.DpiThicknessCorrection);
		}

		private void OnClipMarginChanged(Thickness oldValue, Thickness newValue)
		{
			CoerceValue(ActualClipMarginProperty);
			InvalidateMeasure();
			InvalidateArrange();
		}

		private void OnGroupItemsChanged(object sender, EventArgs ea)
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e = (ea as NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs) ?? new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset);
			CheckSelectedItemRemoved(e);
			if ((int)ActualTabContentCacheMode == 1)
			{
				foreach (object item in (IEnumerable)base.Items)
				{
					if (item is BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem)
					{
						baseLayoutItem.SelectTemplate();
					}
				}
			}
			RaiseItemsChanged(e);
			UpdatePanelMeasure();
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		private void OnShowTabHeadersChanged(bool newValue)
		{
			UpdateHeaderVisibility();
		}

		private Thickness RotateMargin(Thickness thickness)
		{
			return CaptionLocation switch
			{
				CaptionLocation.Left => new Thickness(thickness.Top, thickness.Right, thickness.Bottom, thickness.Left), 
				CaptionLocation.Right => new Thickness(thickness.Bottom, thickness.Left, thickness.Top, thickness.Right), 
				CaptionLocation.Bottom => new Thickness(thickness.Right, thickness.Bottom, thickness.Left, thickness.Top), 
				_ => thickness, 
			};
		}

		private void UpdateHeaderVisibility()
		{
			AreTabHeadersVisible = TabbedGroupDisplayMode == TabbedGroupDisplayMode.Default && ShowTabHeaders && ((VisiblePagesCount == 1) ? ShowTabForSinglePage : (VisiblePagesCount > 1));
		}

		private void UpdateItemsLocation()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				if (base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(i) is TabbedPaneItem tabbedPaneItem)
				{
					tabbedPaneItem.CaptionLocation = CaptionLocation;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateItemsOrientation()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				if (base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(i) is TabbedPaneItem tabbedPaneItem)
				{
					tabbedPaneItem.CaptionOrientation = CaptionOrientation;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdatePanelMeasure()
		{
			if (PartHeadersPanel != null)
			{
				PartHeadersPanel.Visibility = BooleanExtensions.ToVisibility(AreTabHeadersVisible);
			}
			_ = base.ItemContainerGenerator.Status;
			_ = 2;
		}
	}
	public class LayoutTabControlSelectionChangedEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		public object NewContent { get; private set; }

		public object OldContent { get; private set; }

		public LayoutTabControlSelectionChangedEventArgs(object oldContent, object newContent)
		{
			OldContent = oldContent;
			NewContent = newContent;
		}
	}
	public class LayoutTabFastRenderPanel : psvPanel
	{
		private class FastRenderPanelContentControl : ContentControl
		{
			public FastRenderPanelContentControl()
			{
				base.Focusable = false;
				ContentControlHelper.SetContentIsNotLogical((ContentControl)this, true);
			}
		}

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ArrangeAllCachedTabsProperty;

		private readonly Dictionary<object, FastRenderPanelContentControl> itemsHash = new Dictionary<object, FastRenderPanelContentControl>();

		private FastRenderPanelContentControl SelectedContent;

		private TabContentCacheMode tabContentCacheMode;

		public bool ArrangeAllCachedTabs
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(ArrangeAllCachedTabsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ArrangeAllCachedTabsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public LayoutTabControl Owner { get; private set; }

		public TabContentCacheMode TabContentCacheMode
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				return tabContentCacheMode;
			}
			set
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (tabContentCacheMode != value)
				{
					tabContentCacheMode = value;
					OnTabContentCacheModeChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		static LayoutTabFastRenderPanel()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<LayoutTabFastRenderPanel>.New().Register<bool>("ArrangeAllCachedTabs", ref ArrangeAllCachedTabsProperty, false, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsArrange);
		}

		public void Initialize(LayoutTabControl owner, TabContentCacheMode cacheMode)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			TabContentCacheMode = cacheMode;
			if (Owner != owner)
			{
				UnsubscribeOwner();
				Owner = owner;
				SubscribeOwner();
			}
			SyncItems(null, Owner.Items);
			SyncSelection(null, Owner.SelectedContent);
		}

		protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size finalSize)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (SelectedContent == null)
			{
				return base.ArrangeOverride(finalSize);
			}
			if ((int)TabContentCacheMode != 0 && ArrangeAllCachedTabs)
			{
				foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
				{
					child.Arrange(new Rect(finalSize));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SelectedContent.Arrange(new Rect(finalSize));
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (SelectedContent == null)
			{
				return base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
			}
			if ((int)TabContentCacheMode == 0)
			{
				SelectedContent.Measure(availableSize);
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
				{
					child.Measure(availableSize);
				}
			}
			return SelectedContent.DesiredSize;
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			UnsubscribeOwner();
			ClearChildren();
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected virtual void SubscribeOwner()
		{
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				Owner.ItemsChanged += Owner_ItemsChanged;
				Owner.SelectionChanged += Owner_SelectionChanged;
				Owner.Forward(this, ArrangeAllCachedTabsProperty, LayoutTabControl.ArrangeAllCachedTabsProperty);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UnsubscribeOwner()
		{
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				Owner.ItemsChanged -= Owner_ItemsChanged;
				Owner.SelectionChanged -= Owner_SelectionChanged;
				ClearValue(ArrangeAllCachedTabsProperty);
			}
		}

		private void ClearChildren()
		{
			ClearItemsHash();
			base.Children.Clear();
			SelectedContent = null;
		}

		private void ClearItemsHash()
		{
			foreach (FastRenderPanelContentControl value in itemsHash.Values)
			{
				value.ClearValue(ContentControl.ContentProperty);
				base.Children.Remove(value);
			}
			itemsHash.Clear();
		}

		private void HidePresenter(FrameworkElement presenter)
		{
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (presenter != null)
			{
				presenter.Visibility = (((int)TabContentCacheMode == 1) ? Visibility.Hidden : Visibility.Collapsed);
			}
		}

		private void OnTabContentCacheModeChanged()
		{
			ClearChildren();
		}

		private void Owner_ItemsChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset)
			{
				ClearChildren();
				SyncItems(null, Owner.Items);
				SyncSelection(null, Owner.SelectedContent);
			}
			else
			{
				SyncItems(e.OldItems, e.NewItems);
				SyncSelection(null, Owner.SelectedContent);
				InvalidateMeasure();
			}
		}

		private void Owner_SelectionChanged(object sender, LayoutTabControlSelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			SyncItems(null, Owner.Items);
			SyncSelection(e.OldContent, e.NewContent);
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		private void SyncItems(IList oldItems, IList newItems)
		{
			if (oldItems != null)
			{
				foreach (object oldItem in oldItems)
				{
					if (itemsHash.ContainsKey(oldItem))
					{
						FastRenderPanelContentControl fastRenderPanelContentControl = itemsHash[oldItem];
						fastRenderPanelContentControl.ClearValue(ContentControl.ContentProperty);
						base.Children.Remove(fastRenderPanelContentControl);
						itemsHash.Remove(oldItem);
					}
				}
			}
			if (newItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (object newItem in newItems)
			{
				if (!itemsHash.ContainsKey(newItem))
				{
					FastRenderPanelContentControl fastRenderPanelContentControl2 = new FastRenderPanelContentControl
					{
						Content = newItem,
						ContentTemplate = Owner.SelectedContentTemplate
					};
					itemsHash.Add(newItem, fastRenderPanelContentControl2);
					base.Children.Add(fastRenderPanelContentControl2);
					HidePresenter(fastRenderPanelContentControl2);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SyncSelection(object oldContent, object content)
		{
			if (content == null || !itemsHash.ContainsKey(content))
			{
				HidePresenter(SelectedContent);
				SelectedContent = null;
				return;
			}
			FastRenderPanelContentControl fastRenderPanelContentControl = itemsHash[content];
			if (SelectedContent != null)
			{
				Panel.SetZIndex(SelectedContent, 0);
				if (SelectedContent != fastRenderPanelContentControl)
				{
					HidePresenter(SelectedContent);
				}
			}
			SelectedContent = fastRenderPanelContentControl;
			Panel.SetZIndex(SelectedContent, 1);
			SelectedContent.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
		}
	}

		{

			{
				return ((FrameworkElement)this).GetLayoutClip(layoutSlotSize);

			Rect rect = new Rect(ClipMargin.Left, ClipMargin.Top, layoutSlotSize.Width - (ClipMargin.Left + ClipMargin.Right), layoutSlotSize.Height - (ClipMargin.Top + ClipMargin.Bottom));
			return new RectangleGeometry

	public class RenderTransformPanel : Panel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty OrientationProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DockProperty;

		public Dock Dock
		{
			get
			{
				return (Dock)GetValue(DockProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DockProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public Orientation Orientation
		{
			get
			{
				return (Orientation)GetValue(OrientationProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(OrientationProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static RenderTransformPanel()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<RenderTransformPanel> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<RenderTransformPanel>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("Orientation", ref OrientationProperty, Orientation.Vertical, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((RenderTransformPanel)d).OnOrientationPropertyChanged();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("Dock", ref DockProperty, Dock.Top, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((RenderTransformPanel)d).OnDockChanged((Dock)e.OldValue, (Dock)e.NewValue);
			});
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
		{
			if (base.Children.Count == 0)
			{
				return Size.Empty;
			}
			UIElement uIElement = base.Children[0];
			uIElement.Measure(GetCorrectSize(availableSize));
			return GetCorrectSize(uIElement.DesiredSize);
		}

		protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size finalSize)
		{
			if (base.Children.Count == 0)
			{
				return Size.Empty;
			}
			UIElement uIElement = base.Children[0];
			Size correctSize = GetCorrectSize(finalSize);
			uIElement.Arrange(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, correctSize.Width, correctSize.Height));
			base.RenderTransform = GetTransform(correctSize);
			return GetCorrectSize(correctSize);
		}

		private Size GetCorrectSize(Size size)
		{
			if (Orientation != Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				return new Size(size.Height, size.Width);
			}
			return size;
		}

		private Transform GetTransform(Size size)
		{
			TransformGroup transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
			switch (Dock)
			{
			case Dock.Left:
				transformGroup.Children.Add(new RotateTransform
				{
					Angle = -90.0
				});
				transformGroup.Children.Add(new TranslateTransform
				{
					Y = size.Width
				});
				break;
			case Dock.Right:
				transformGroup.Children.Add(new RotateTransform
				{
					Angle = 90.0
				});
				transformGroup.Children.Add(new TranslateTransform
				{
					X = size.Height
				});
				break;
			case Dock.Bottom:
				transformGroup.Children.Add(new RotateTransform
				{
					Angle = 180.0
				});
				transformGroup.Children.Add(new TranslateTransform
				{
					X = size.Width
				});
				transformGroup.Children.Add(new TranslateTransform
				{
					Y = size.Height
				});
				break;
			}
			return transformGroup;
		}

		private void OnOrientationPropertyChanged()
		{
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		protected virtual void OnDockChanged(Dock oldValue, Dock newValue)
		{
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}
	}

			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(CaptionLocationProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static TabHeaderBackgroundPanel()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<TabHeaderBackgroundPanel> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<TabHeaderBackgroundPanel>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("CaptionLocation", ref CaptionLocationProperty, CaptionLocation.Default, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs ea)
			{
				((TabHeaderBackgroundPanel)dObj).OnCaptionLocationChanged(ea.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("CaptionOrientation", ref CaptionOrientationProperty, Orientation.Horizontal, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs ea)
			{
				((TabHeaderBackgroundPanel)dObj).OnCaptionOrientationChanged(ea.NewValue);
			});
		}

		public TabHeaderBackgroundPanel()
		{
			UpdateProperties();
		}

		protected virtual void OnCaptionLocationChanged(object newValue)
		{
			UpdateProperties();
		}

		protected virtual void OnCaptionOrientationChanged(object newValue)
		{
			UpdateProperties();
		}

		private void UpdateProperties()
		{
			base.Orientation = ((CaptionOrientation == Orientation.Horizontal) ? Orientation.Vertical : Orientation.Horizontal);
			base.Dock = CaptionLocation.ToDock();
			if (CaptionOrientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				if (base.Dock == Dock.Top || base.Dock == Dock.Bottom)
				{
					base.Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal;
				}
			}
			else if (base.Dock == Dock.Left || base.Dock == Dock.Right)
			{
				base.Orientation = Orientation.Vertical;
			}
		}
	}

			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("BottomMargin", ref BottomMarginProperty, default(Thickness), delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs ea)

			});
		}

		{
			UpdateChildMargin();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateChildMargin()
		{
			if (Child is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
			{
				frameworkElement.Margin = GetActualChildMargin();
			}
		}

		protected virtual Thickness GetActualChildMargin()
		{
			return CaptionLocation switch
			{
				CaptionLocation.Left => ThicknessHelper.Multiply(LeftMargin, ScreenHelper.DpiThicknessCorrection), 
				CaptionLocation.Top => ThicknessHelper.Multiply(TopMargin, ScreenHelper.DpiThicknessCorrection), 
				CaptionLocation.Bottom => ThicknessHelper.Multiply(BottomMargin, ScreenHelper.DpiThicknessCorrection), 
				CaptionLocation.Right => ThicknessHelper.Multiply(RightMargin, ScreenHelper.DpiThicknessCorrection), 
				_ => ThicknessHelper.Multiply(DefaultMargin, ScreenHelper.DpiThicknessCorrection), 
			};
		}
	}

	{
		public LayoutGroup LayoutGroup => base.LayoutItem as LayoutGroup;

		static BaseGroupContentControl()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<BaseGroupContentControl> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<BaseGroupContentControl>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<BaseGroupContentControl>();
		}

		public BaseGroupContentControl()
		{
			ContentControlHelper.SetContentIsNotLogical((ContentControl)this, true);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			if (base.LayoutItem != null)
			{
				UpdateVisual();
			}
		}

		protected override void Subscribe(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			base.Subscribe(item);
			if (item != null)
			{
				item.VisualChanged += item_VisualChanged;
			}
		}

		protected override void Unsubscribe(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			base.Unsubscribe(item);
			if (item != null)
			{
				item.VisualChanged -= item_VisualChanged;
			}
		}

		private void item_VisualChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateVisual();
		}

		private void UpdateVisual()
		{
			UpdateVisualState();
			UpdateCaptionBackground();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateVisualState()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateCaptionBackground()
		{
		}
	}
	public class GroupContentControl : BaseGroupContentControl
	{
		protected virtual bool IsCaptionVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.LayoutItem != null && base.LayoutItem.IsCaptionVisible)
				{
					if (!base.LayoutItem.HasCaption)
					{
						return base.LayoutItem.HasCaptionTemplate;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		static GroupContentControl()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<GroupContentControl>();
		}

		protected override void UpdateVisualState()
		{
			base.UpdateVisualState();
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, IsCaptionVisible ? "CaptionVisible" : "CaptionHidden", useTransitions: false);
		}
	}
	public class GroupBoxContentControl : GroupContentControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty CaptionBackgroundProperty;

		protected override bool IsCaptionVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.LayoutItem != null)
				{
					return base.LayoutItem.IsCaptionVisible;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public Brush CaptionBackground
		{
			get
			{
				return (Brush)GetValue(CaptionBackgroundProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(CaptionBackgroundProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static GroupBoxContentControl()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<GroupBoxContentControl> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<GroupBoxContentControl>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<GroupBoxContentControl>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<Brush>("CaptionBackground", ref CaptionBackgroundProperty);
		}

		protected override void UpdateVisualState()
		{
			base.UpdateVisualState();
			if (base.LayoutGroup != null)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, base.LayoutGroup.IsExpanded ? "Expanded" : "Collapsed", useTransitions: false);
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateCaptionBackground()
		{
			base.UpdateCaptionBackground();
			AppearanceObject actualAppearanceObject = base.LayoutItem.ActualAppearanceObject;
			if (actualAppearanceObject != null)
			{
				CaptionBackground = actualAppearanceObject.Background;
			}
		}
	}
	public class OverlappingDockPanel : DockPanel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty DisplayModeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DisplayMode", typeof(AutoHideMode), typeof(OverlappingDockPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(AutoHideMode.Default, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));

		public AutoHideMode DisplayMode
		{
			get
			{
				return (AutoHideMode)GetValue(DisplayModeProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DisplayModeProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size arrangeSize)
		{
			if (DisplayMode == AutoHideMode.Inline)
			{
				return base.ArrangeOverride(arrangeSize);
			}
			UIElementCollection internalChildren = base.InternalChildren;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = internalChildren.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				internalChildren[i]?.Arrange(new Rect(arrangeSize));
			}
			return arrangeSize;
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size constraint)
		{
			if (DisplayMode == AutoHideMode.Inline)
			{
				return base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			}
			Size result = default(Size);
			UIElementCollection internalChildren = base.InternalChildren;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = internalChildren.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = internalChildren[i];
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					uIElement.Measure(constraint);
					result.Width = Math.Max(result.Width, uIElement.DesiredSize.Width);
					result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, uIElement.DesiredSize.Height);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public class ElementSizer : Control
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty OrientationProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ThicknessProperty;

		private const string HorizontalRootElementName = "HorizontalRootElement";

		private const string VerticalRootElementName = "VerticalRootElement";

		public Orientation Orientation
		{
			get
			{
				return (Orientation)GetValue(OrientationProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(OrientationProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double Thickness
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(ThicknessProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ThicknessProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected FrameworkElement HorizontalRootElement { get; private set; }

		protected FrameworkElement VerticalRootElement { get; private set; }

		static ElementSizer()
		{
			OrientationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Orientation", typeof(Orientation), typeof(ElementSizer), new PropertyMetadata(Orientation.Vertical));
			ThicknessProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Thickness", typeof(double), typeof(ElementSizer), null);
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<ElementSizer>();
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			HorizontalRootElement = GetTemplateChild("HorizontalRootElement") as FrameworkElement;
			VerticalRootElement = GetTemplateChild("VerticalRootElement") as FrameworkElement;
			UpdateTemplate();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateTemplate()
		{
			if (HorizontalRootElement != null)
			{
				UIElementExtensions.SetVisible((UIElement)HorizontalRootElement, Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal);
				if (UIElementExtensions.GetVisible((UIElement)HorizontalRootElement))
				{
					base.Cursor = HorizontalRootElement.Cursor;
				}
			}
			if (VerticalRootElement != null)
			{
				UIElementExtensions.SetVisible((UIElement)VerticalRootElement, Orientation == Orientation.Vertical);
				if (UIElementExtensions.GetVisible((UIElement)VerticalRootElement))
				{
					base.Cursor = VerticalRootElement.Cursor;
				}
			}
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}
	}

				return null;

		}
	}
