	internal static class ControlExtension
	{
		public static void StartListen(this FrameworkElement control, DependencyProperty property, string target, BindingMode mode = BindingMode.OneWay)
		{
			control.SetBinding(property, new Binding(target)
			{
				Source = control,
				Mode = mode
			});
		}

		public static void Forward(this FrameworkElement control, FrameworkElement target, DependencyProperty targetProperty, string property, BindingMode mode = BindingMode.OneWay)
		{
			target.SetBinding(targetProperty, new Binding(property)
			{
				Source = control,
				Mode = mode
			});
		}

		public static void Forward(this FrameworkElement control, FrameworkElement target, DependencyProperty targetProperty, DependencyProperty property, BindingMode mode = BindingMode.OneWay)
		{
			target.SetBinding(targetProperty, new Binding
			{
				Path = new PropertyPath(property),
				Source = control,
				Mode = mode
			});
		}

		public static void AttachToolTip(this FrameworkElement control, object tooltip)
		{
			control.ToolTip = tooltip;
		}

		public static void InvalidateVisual(this UIElement control)
		{
			control?.InvalidateVisual();
		}
	}
	internal static class DependencyPropertyExtension
	{
		public static object GetDefaultValue(this DependencyProperty property, Type ownerType = null)
		{
			return property.DefaultMetadata.DefaultValue;
		}
	}
	public class UIElementPresenter : psvDecorator
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty UIElementProperty;

		public UIElement UIElement
		{
			get
			{
				return (UIElement)GetValue(UIElementProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(UIElementProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static UIElementPresenter()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<UIElementPresenter> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<UIElementPresenter>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<UIElement>("UIElement", ref UIElementProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((UIElementPresenter)dObj).OnUIElementChanged((UIElement)e.NewValue);
			});
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			ClearValue(psvDecorator.ChildProperty);
			ClearValue(FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty);
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		private void OnUIElementChanged(UIElement element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				DependencyObject parent = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(element);
				if (parent is UIElementPresenter uIElementPresenter)
				{
					uIElementPresenter.Child = null;
				}
				if (parent is DocumentSelectorPreview.DetachedElementDecorator detachedElementDecorator)
				{
					detachedElementDecorator.Child = null;
				}
			}
			base.Child = element;
		}

		protected override UIElementCollection CreateUIElementCollection(FrameworkElement logicalParent)
		{
			return new UIElementCollection(this, null);
		}
	}
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_HorizontalRootElement", Type = typeof(FrameworkElement))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_VerticalRootElement", Type = typeof(FrameworkElement))]
	public class SeparatorControl : psvContentControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty OrientationProperty;

		private const string HorizontalRootElementName = "PART_HorizontalRootElement";

		private const string VerticalRootElementName = "PART_VerticalRootElement";

		protected FrameworkElement PartHorizontalRootElement { get; set; }

		protected FrameworkElement PartVerticalRootElement { get; set; }

		public Orientation Orientation
		{
			get
			{
				return (Orientation)GetValue(OrientationProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(OrientationProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static SeparatorControl()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<SeparatorControl> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<SeparatorControl>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<SeparatorControl>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("Orientation", ref OrientationProperty, Orientation.Horizontal, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((SeparatorControl)dObj).OnOrientationChanged((Orientation)e.NewValue);
			});
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			ClearValue(DockLayoutManager.DockLayoutManagerProperty);
			ClearValue(DockLayoutManager.LayoutItemProperty);
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			PartHorizontalRootElement = GetTemplateChild("PART_HorizontalRootElement") as FrameworkElement;
			PartVerticalRootElement = GetTemplateChild("PART_VerticalRootElement") as FrameworkElement;
			UpdateTemplateParts();
		}

		public void OnOrientationChanged(Orientation orientation)
		{
			UpdateTemplateParts();
		}

		private void UpdateTemplateParts()
		{
			if (PartHorizontalRootElement != null)
			{
				PartHorizontalRootElement.Visibility = VisibilityHelper.Convert(Orientation == Orientation.Vertical);
			}
			if (PartVerticalRootElement != null)
			{
				PartVerticalRootElement.Visibility = VisibilityHelper.Convert(Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal);
			}
		}
	}
	public class psvContentPresenter : ContentPresenter, IDisposable
	{
		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		internal static readonly DependencyProperty ContentInternalProperty;

		public bool IsDisposing { get; private set; }

		static psvContentPresenter()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<psvContentPresenter> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<psvContentPresenter>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<object>("ContentInternal", ref ContentInternalProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((psvContentPresenter)dObj).OnContentChanged(e.NewValue, e.OldValue);
			});
		}

		public psvContentPresenter()
		{
			base.Focusable = false;
			this.StartListen(ContentInternalProperty, "Content");
			base.Loaded += psvContentPresenter_Loaded;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (!IsDisposing)
			{
				IsDisposing = true;
				base.Loaded -= psvContentPresenter_Loaded;
				ClearValue(ContentInternalProperty);
				ClearValue(ContentPresenter.ContentProperty);
				OnDispose();
				DockLayoutManager.Release(this);
			}
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		private void psvContentPresenter_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnLoaded();
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			DockLayoutManager.Ensure(this);
		}

		protected virtual void OnDispose()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnLoaded()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnContentChanged(object content, object oldContent)
		{
		}
	}
	[DXToolboxBrowsable(false)]
	public class psvItemsControl : ItemsControl, IDisposable
	{
		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		internal static readonly DependencyProperty HasItemsInternalProperty;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		internal static readonly DependencyProperty ActualSizeProperty;

		public bool IsDisposing { get; private set; }

		protected ItemsPresenter PartItemsPresenter { get; private set; }

		protected Panel PartItemsPanel { get; private set; }

		protected DockLayoutManager Container { get; private set; }

		static psvItemsControl()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<psvItemsControl> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<psvItemsControl>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("HasItemsInternal", ref HasItemsInternalProperty, defValue: false, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((psvItemsControl)dObj).OnHasItemsChanged((bool)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ActualSize", ref ActualSizeProperty, Size.Empty, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((psvItemsControl)dObj).OnActualSizeChanged((Size)e.NewValue);
			});
		}

		public psvItemsControl()
		{
			base.Focusable = false;
			base.IsTabStop = false;
			this.StartListen(HasItemsInternalProperty, "HasItems");
			base.Loaded += psvItemsControl_Loaded;
			base.Unloaded += psvItemsControl_Unloaded;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (!IsDisposing)
			{
				IsDisposing = true;
				base.Loaded -= psvItemsControl_Loaded;
				base.Unloaded -= psvItemsControl_Unloaded;
				UnsubscribeUpdateLayout();
				ClearValue(HasItemsInternalProperty);
				OnDispose();
				ClearItemsSource();
				ClearValue(ActualSizeProperty);
				DockLayoutManager.Release(this);
				if (PartItemsPanel != null)
				{
					ReleaseItemsPanelCore(PartItemsPanel);
				}
				PartItemsPanel = null;
				PartItemsPresenter = null;
				Container = null;
			}
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		protected virtual void ClearItemsSource()
		{
			ClearValue(ItemsControl.ItemsSourceProperty);
		}

		public static void Clear(psvItemsControl itemsControl)
		{
			itemsControl?.ClearItemsSource();
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			base.PrepareContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
			PrepareContainer(element, item);
		}

		protected override void ClearContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			ClearContainer(element);
			base.ClearContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
		}

		protected virtual void PrepareContainer(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void ClearContainer(DependencyObject element)
		{
		}

		private void psvItemsControl_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnLoaded();
		}

		private void psvItemsControl_Unloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnUnloaded();
		}

		protected sealed override void OnRenderSizeChanged(SizeChangedInfo sizeInfo)
		{
			SetValue(ActualSizeProperty, sizeInfo.NewSize);
			base.OnRenderSizeChanged(sizeInfo);
		}

		protected sealed override void OnInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnInitialized(e);
			OnInitialized();
		}

		private void SubscribeUpdateLayout()
		{
			if (PartItemsPresenter != null)
			{
				PartItemsPresenter.LayoutUpdated += OnLayoutUpdated;
				PartItemsPresenter.SizeChanged += OnLayoutUpdated;
			}
		}

		private void UnsubscribeUpdateLayout()
		{
			if (PartItemsPresenter != null)
			{
				PartItemsPresenter.LayoutUpdated -= OnLayoutUpdated;
				PartItemsPresenter.SizeChanged -= OnLayoutUpdated;
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			ClearTemplateChildren();
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			Container = DockLayoutManager.Ensure(this);
			PartItemsPresenter = LayoutItemsHelper.GetTemplateChild<ItemsPresenter>(this);
			SubscribeUpdateLayout();
		}

		protected virtual void ClearTemplateChildren()
		{
			UnsubscribeUpdateLayout();
			if (PartItemsPanel != null && !LayoutItemsHelper.IsTemplateChild(PartItemsPanel, this))
			{
				ReleaseItemsPanelCore(PartItemsPanel);
				PartItemsPanel = null;
			}
		}

		private void OnLayoutUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UnsubscribeUpdateLayout();
			EnsureItemsPanelCore();
		}

		protected virtual void ReleaseItemsPanelCore(Panel itemsPanel)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void EnsureItemsPanelCore(Panel itemsPanel)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnDispose()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnLoaded()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnUnloaded()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnHasItemsChanged(bool hasItems)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnActualSizeChanged(Size value)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnInitialized()
		{
		}

		private void EnsureItemsPanelCore()
		{
			if (PartItemsPresenter != null)
			{
				Panel templateChild = LayoutItemsHelper.GetTemplateChild<Panel>(PartItemsPresenter);
				if (templateChild != PartItemsPanel)
				{
					PartItemsPanel = templateChild;
				}
				if (PartItemsPanel != null)
				{
					EnsureItemsPanelCore(PartItemsPanel);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void EnsureItemsPanel()
		{
			EnsureItemsPanelCore();
		}
	}
	public class psvControl : Control, IDisposable
	{
		private int preparingContainerForItem;

		public bool IsDisposing { get; private set; }

		protected bool IsInitializedCore { get; private set; }

		protected bool IsPreparingContainerForItem => preparingContainerForItem > 0;

		protected DockLayoutManager Container { get; private set; }

		static psvControl()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<psvControl>.New().OverrideMetadata(UIElement.FocusableProperty, (object)false, (Action<psvControl>)null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None).OverrideMetadata(Control.IsTabStopProperty, (object)false, (Action<psvControl>)null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None);
		}

		public psvControl()
		{
			base.Loaded += psvControl_Loaded;
			base.Unloaded += psvControl_Unloaded;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (!IsDisposing)
			{
				IsDisposing = true;
				base.Loaded -= psvControl_Loaded;
				base.Unloaded -= psvControl_Unloaded;
				OnDispose();
				DockLayoutManager.Release(this);
				Container = null;
			}
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		private void psvControl_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnLoaded();
		}

		private void psvControl_Unloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnUnloaded();
		}

		protected sealed override void OnInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnInitialized(e);
			IsInitializedCore = true;
			OnInitialized();
		}

		public void BeginPrepareContainer()
		{
			preparingContainerForItem++;
		}

		public void EndPrepareContainer()
		{
			if (--preparingContainerForItem == 0)
			{
				OnPrepareContainerForItemComplete();
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			Container = DockLayoutManager.Ensure(this);
		}

		protected virtual void OnDispose()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnLoaded()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnUnloaded()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnPrepareContainerForItemComplete()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnInitialized()
		{
		}
	}
	[DXToolboxBrowsable(false)]
	public abstract class psvContentControlBase : ContentControl, IDisposable
	{
		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		internal static readonly DependencyProperty ActualSizeProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey LayoutItemPropertyKey;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty LayoutItemProperty;

		public bool IsDisposing { get; private set; }

		public BaseLayoutItem LayoutItem
		{
			get
			{
				return (BaseLayoutItem)GetValue(LayoutItemProperty);
			}
			internal set
			{
				SetValue(LayoutItemPropertyKey, value);
			}
		}

		protected DockLayoutManager Container { get; private set; }

		static psvContentControlBase()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<psvContentControlBase> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<psvContentControlBase>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ActualSize", ref ActualSizeProperty, Size.Empty, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((psvContentControlBase)dObj).OnActualSizeChanged((Size)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly<BaseLayoutItem>("LayoutItem", ref LayoutItemPropertyKey, ref LayoutItemProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((psvContentControlBase)dObj).OnLayoutItemChanged((BaseLayoutItem)e.NewValue, (BaseLayoutItem)e.OldValue);
			});
		}

		public psvContentControlBase()
		{
			SetCurrentValue(UIElement.FocusableProperty, false);
			base.Loaded += psvContentControl_Loaded;
			base.Unloaded += psvContentControl_Unloaded;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (!IsDisposing)
			{
				IsDisposing = true;
				base.Loaded -= psvContentControl_Loaded;
				base.Unloaded -= psvContentControl_Unloaded;
				ClearValue(ActualSizeProperty);
				OnDispose();
				ClearValue(LayoutItemPropertyKey);
				ClearValue(ContentControl.ContentProperty);
				DockLayoutManager.Release(this);
				Container = null;
			}
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		private void psvContentControl_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnLoaded();
		}

		private void psvContentControl_Unloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnUnloaded();
		}

		protected sealed override void OnRenderSizeChanged(SizeChangedInfo sizeInfo)
		{
			SetValue(ActualSizeProperty, sizeInfo.NewSize);
			base.OnRenderSizeChanged(sizeInfo);
		}

		protected override void OnContentChanged(object oldContent, object newContent)
		{
			LayoutItem = LayoutItemData.ConvertToBaseLayoutItem(newContent);
			base.OnContentChanged(oldContent, newContent);
		}

		protected virtual void Subscribe(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void Unsubscribe(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnLayoutItemChanged(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem oldItem)
		{
			Unsubscribe(oldItem);
			if (item == null)
			{
				ClearValue(DockLayoutManager.LayoutItemProperty);
			}
			else
			{
				SetValue(DockLayoutManager.LayoutItemProperty, item);
			}
			EnsureUIElements(item, oldItem);
			Subscribe(item);
		}

		private void EnsureUIElements(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem oldItem)
		{
			if (this is IUIElement element)
			{
				oldItem?.UIElements.Remove(element);
				item?.UIElements.Add(element);
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			Container = DockLayoutManager.Ensure(this);
		}

		protected virtual void OnDispose()
		{
			Unsubscribe(LayoutItem);
		}

		protected virtual void OnLoaded()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnUnloaded()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnActualSizeChanged(Size value)
		{
		}
	}

	public class psvSelector<T> : psvItemsControl where T : class
	{
		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty ItemsSourceInternalProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SelectedItemProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SelectedIndexProperty;

		private int syncWithCurrent;

		private int deferredSelectedIndex = -1;

		protected virtual bool AllowsInvalidSelectedIndex => false;

		public T SelectedItem
		{
			get
			{
				return (T)GetValue(SelectedItemProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(SelectedItemProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public int SelectedIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(SelectedIndexProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(SelectedIndexProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static psvSelector()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<psvSelector<T>> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<psvSelector<T>>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<T>("SelectedItem", ref SelectedItemProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((psvSelector<T>)dObj).OnSelectedItemChanged((T)e.NewValue, (T)e.OldValue);
			}, (DependencyObject dObj, object value) => ((psvSelector<T>)dObj).CoerceSelectedItem((T)value));
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("SelectedIndex", ref SelectedIndexProperty, -1, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((psvSelector<T>)dObj).OnSelectedIndexChanged((int)e.NewValue, (int)e.OldValue);
			}, (DependencyObject dObj, object value) => ((psvSelector<T>)dObj).CoerceSelectedIndex((int)value));
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<IEnumerable>("ItemsSourceInternal", ref ItemsSourceInternalProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((psvSelector<T>)dObj).OnItemsSourceInternalChanged();
			});
		}

		public psvSelector()
		{
			this.StartListen(ItemsSourceInternalProperty, "ItemsSource");
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			deferredSelectedIndex = -1;
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		private void OnItemsSourceInternalChanged()
		{
			if (syncWithCurrent <= 0)
			{
				bool flag = IsValidIndex(deferredSelectedIndex);
				if (!flag)
				{
					syncWithCurrent++;
				}
				CoerceValue(SelectedIndexProperty);
				CoerceValue(SelectedItemProperty);
				deferredSelectedIndex = -1;
				if (!flag)
				{
					syncWithCurrent--;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnItemsChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnItemsChanged(e);
			CheckSelectedItemRemoved(e);
		}

		protected void CheckSelectedItemRemoved(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove && e.OldItems.Contains(SelectedItem))
			{
				if (IsValidIndex(SelectedIndex))
				{
					SetValue(SelectedItemProperty, base.Items[SelectedIndex]);
				}
				else
				{
					ClearValue(SelectedItemProperty);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectedItemChanged(T item, T oldItem)
		{
			ChangeSelection(oldItem, selected: false);
			if (IsValidItem(item, out var index))
			{
				ChangeSelection(oldItem, selected: false);
				SetValue(SelectedIndexProperty, index);
				ChangeSelection(item, selected: true);
			}
			else
			{
				CoerceValue(SelectedIndexProperty);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectedIndexChanged(int index, int oldIndex)
		{
			if (IsValidIndex(index))
			{
				SetValue(SelectedItemProperty, base.Items[index]);
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(SelectedItemProperty);
			}
		}

		protected virtual T CoerceSelectedItem(T item)
		{
			if (syncWithCurrent > 0)
			{
				return GetCurrentItem();
			}
			if (!base.Items.Contains(item))
			{
				if (base.Items.Contains(SelectedItem))
				{
					return SelectedItem;
				}
				if (!IsValidIndex(SelectedIndex))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return (T)base.Items[SelectedIndex];
			}
			return item;
		}

		protected virtual object CoerceSelectedIndex(int index)
		{
			if (TrySetDeferredSelectedIndex(ref index))
			{
				return index;
			}
			if (syncWithCurrent > 0)
			{
				return GetCurrentPosition();
			}
			if (!IsValidIndex(index) && !AllowsInvalidSelectedIndex)
			{
				if (base.Items.Count > 0 && SelectedIndex != index)
				{
					return SelectedIndex;
				}
				return base.Items.IndexOf(SelectedItem);
			}
			return index;
		}

		private int GetCurrentPosition()
		{
			return base.Items.CurrentPosition;
		}

		private T GetCurrentItem()
		{
			return (T)base.Items.CurrentItem;
		}

		private bool TrySetDeferredSelectedIndex(ref int index)
		{
			if (base.IsDisposing)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (deferredSelectedIndex == -1)
			{
				if (base.ItemsSource == null)
				{
					deferredSelectedIndex = index;
					index = -1;
					return true;
				}
			}
			else if (base.ItemsSource != null)
			{
				index = deferredSelectedIndex;
				deferredSelectedIndex = -1;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsValidItem(T item, out int index)
		{
			index = base.Items.IndexOf(item);
			return index != -1;
		}

		private bool IsValidIndex(int index)
		{
			if (index >= 0)
			{
				return index < base.Items.Count;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ChangeSelection(T item, bool selected)
		{
			if (base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(item) is psvSelectorItem psvSelectorItem2)
			{
				psvSelectorItem2.IsSelected = selected;
			}
		}

		protected sealed override bool IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(object item)
		{
			return item is psvSelectorItem;
		}

		protected sealed override DependencyObject GetContainerForItemOverride()
		{
			return CreateSelectorItem();
		}

		protected sealed override void PrepareContainer(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			base.PrepareContainer(element, item);
			if (element is psvSelectorItem psvSelectorItem2)
			{
				psvSelectorItem2.Content = item;
				psvSelectorItem2.IsSelected = object.Equals(SelectedItem, item);
				PrepareSelectorItem(psvSelectorItem2, (T)item);
			}
		}

		protected sealed override void ClearContainer(DependencyObject element)
		{
			if (element is psvSelectorItem psvSelectorItem2)
			{
				psvSelectorItem2.IsSelected = false;
				ClearSelectorItem(psvSelectorItem2);
				psvSelectorItem2.Dispose();
			}
		}

		protected virtual psvSelectorItem CreateSelectorItem()
		{
			return new psvSelectorItem();
		}

		protected virtual void ClearSelectorItem(psvSelectorItem selectorItem)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void PrepareSelectorItem(psvSelectorItem selectorItem, T item)
		{
		}
	}
	[DXToolboxBrowsable(false)]

	public class psvSelectorItem : psvContentControlBase
	{
		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey IsSelectedPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsSelectedProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ViewStyleProperty;

		private const double AlignPrecision = 1.0000000001;

		public bool IsSelected
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsSelectedProperty);
			}
			internal set
			{
				SetValue(IsSelectedPropertyKey, value);
			}
		}

		public DockingViewStyle ViewStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return (DockingViewStyle)GetValue(ViewStyleProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ViewStyleProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static psvSelectorItem()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<psvSelectorItem> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<psvSelectorItem>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("IsSelected", ref IsSelectedPropertyKey, ref IsSelectedProperty, defValue: false, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((psvSelectorItem)dObj).OnIsSelectedChanged((bool)e.NewValue);
			});
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<psvSelectorItem>.New().Register<DockingViewStyle>("ViewStyle", ref ViewStyleProperty, DockingViewStyle.Default, (Action<psvSelectorItem, DockingViewStyle, DockingViewStyle>)delegate(psvSelectorItem d, DockingViewStyle oldValue, DockingViewStyle newValue)
			{
				d.OnViewStyleChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		internal void GetItemAlignment<TParent>(bool isHorizontal, out bool isLeftAligned, out bool isRightAligned) where TParent : FrameworkElement
		{
			TParent val = LayoutTreeHelper.GetVisualParents((DependencyObject)this, (DependencyObject)null).OfType<TParent>().FirstOrDefault();
			if (val != null && ViewStyle == DockingViewStyle.Light)
			{
				Point point = TranslatePoint(default(Point), val);
				LayoutPanel obj = base.LayoutItem as LayoutPanel;
				double precesion = ((obj != null && obj.IsFloatingRootInTabbedGroup) ? 1.0000000001 : 1E-10);
				if (isHorizontal)
				{
					isLeftAligned = MathHelper.AreDoubleClose(point.X, 0.0, 1.0000000001);
					isRightAligned = MathHelper.AreDoubleClose(TranslatePoint(new Point(base.ActualWidth, 0.0), val).X, val.ActualWidth, precesion);
				}
				else
				{
					isRightAligned = MathHelper.AreDoubleClose(point.Y, 0.0, 1.0000000001);
					isLeftAligned = MathHelper.AreDoubleClose(TranslatePoint(new Point(0.0, base.ActualHeight), val).Y, val.ActualHeight, precesion);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				isLeftAligned = false;
				isRightAligned = false;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void AfterArrange()
		{
		}

		protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size arrangeBounds)
		{
			Size result = base.ArrangeOverride(arrangeBounds);
			AfterArrange();
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsSelectedChanged(bool selected)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnViewStyleChanged(DockingViewStyle oldValue, DockingViewStyle newValue)
		{
		}

		protected override void Subscribe(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			base.Subscribe(item);
			if (item != null)
			{
				item.Forward(this, UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, "IsEnabled");
				item.Forward(this, ViewStyleProperty, BaseLayoutItem.DockingViewStyleProperty);
				item.Forward(this, UIElement.VisibilityProperty, UIElement.VisibilityProperty);
			}
		}

		protected override void Unsubscribe(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			ClearValue(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty);
			ClearValue(ViewStyleProperty);
			ClearValue(UIElement.VisibilityProperty);
			base.Unsubscribe(item);
		}
	}
	public class psvDecorator : psvPanel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ChildProperty;

		public UIElement Child
		{
			get
			{
				return (UIElement)GetValue(ChildProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ChildProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static psvDecorator()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<psvDecorator> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<psvDecorator>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<UIElement>("Child", ref ChildProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((psvDecorator)dObj).OnChildChanged((UIElement)e.NewValue, (UIElement)e.OldValue);
			});
		}

		protected virtual void OnChildChanged(UIElement child, UIElement oldChild)
		{
			if (oldChild != null)
			{
				base.Children.Remove(oldChild);
			}
			if (child != null)
			{
				base.Children.Add(child);
			}
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size constraint)
		{
			UIElement child = Child;
			if (child != null)
			{
				child.Measure(constraint);
				return child.DesiredSize;
			}
			return default(Size);
		}

		protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size arrangeSize)
		{
			Rect finalRect = new Rect(default(Point), arrangeSize);
			Child?.Arrange(finalRect);
			return arrangeSize;
		}
	}

	public class ScrollablePanel : psvPanel, IScrollInfo
	{
		private class ScrollData
		{
			internal Point _offset;

			internal Size _viewport;

			internal Size _extent;
		}

		private const double LineSize = 16.0;

		private const double WheelSize = 48.0;

		private ScrollData scrollData;

		protected Size Viewport => scrollData._viewport;

		public bool CanHorizontallyScroll { get; set; }

		public bool CanVerticallyScroll { get; set; }

		public double ExtentHeight => scrollData._extent.Height;

		public double ExtentWidth => scrollData._extent.Width;

		public double HorizontalOffset => scrollData._offset.X;

		public ScrollViewer ScrollOwner { get; set; }

		public double VerticalOffset => scrollData._offset.Y;

		public double ViewportHeight => scrollData._viewport.Height;

		public double ViewportWidth => scrollData._viewport.Width;

		private static double ComputeScrollOffset(double topView, double bottomView, double topChild, double bottomChild)
		{
			bool flag = topChild < topView && bottomChild < bottomView;
			bool flag2 = bottomChild > bottomView && topChild > topView;
			bool flag3 = bottomChild - topChild > bottomView - topView;
			if (!flag && !flag2)
			{
				return topView;
			}
			if ((flag && !flag3) || (flag2 && flag3))
			{
				return topChild;
			}
			return bottomChild - (bottomView - topView);
		}

		public ScrollablePanel()
		{
			scrollData = new ScrollData();
		}

		public void LineDown()
		{
			SetVerticalOffset(VerticalOffset + 16.0);
		}

		public void LineLeft()
		{
			SetHorizontalOffset(HorizontalOffset - 16.0);
		}

		public void LineRight()
		{
			SetHorizontalOffset(HorizontalOffset + 16.0);
		}

		public void LineUp()
		{
			SetVerticalOffset(VerticalOffset - 16.0);
		}

		public Rect MakeVisible(Visual visual, Rect rectangle)
		{
			if (rectangle.IsEmpty || visual == null || !IsAncestorOf(visual))
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			rectangle = visual.TransformToAncestor(this).TransformBounds(rectangle);
			return MakeVisibleCore(rectangle);
		}

		private Rect MakeVisibleCore(Rect rectangle)
		{
			Rect rect = new Rect(HorizontalOffset, VerticalOffset, ViewportWidth, ViewportHeight);
			rectangle.X += rect.X;
			rectangle.Y += rect.Y;
			rect.X = ComputeScrollOffset(rect.Left, rect.Right, rectangle.Left, rectangle.Right);
			rect.Y = ComputeScrollOffset(rect.Top, rect.Bottom, rectangle.Top, rectangle.Bottom);
			SetHorizontalOffset(rect.X);
			SetVerticalOffset(rect.Y);
			rectangle.Intersect(rect);
			rectangle.X -= rect.X;
			rectangle.Y -= rect.Y;
			return rectangle;
		}

		protected void VerifyScrollData(Size viewport, Size extent)
		{
			if (double.IsInfinity(viewport.Width))
			{
				viewport.Width = extent.Width;
			}
			if (double.IsInfinity(viewport.Height))
			{
				viewport.Height = extent.Height;
			}
			scrollData._extent = extent;
			scrollData._viewport = viewport;
			scrollData._offset.X = Math.Max(0.0, Math.Min(scrollData._offset.X, ExtentWidth - ViewportWidth));
			scrollData._offset.Y = Math.Max(0.0, Math.Min(scrollData._offset.Y, ExtentHeight - ViewportHeight));
			if (ScrollOwner != null)
			{
				ScrollOwner.InvalidateScrollInfo();
			}
		}

		public void MouseWheelDown()
		{
			SetVerticalOffset(VerticalOffset + 48.0);
		}

		public void MouseWheelLeft()
		{
			SetHorizontalOffset(HorizontalOffset - 48.0);
		}

		public void MouseWheelRight()
		{
			SetHorizontalOffset(HorizontalOffset + 48.0);
		}

		public void MouseWheelUp()
		{
			SetVerticalOffset(VerticalOffset - 48.0);
		}

		public void PageDown()
		{
			SetVerticalOffset(VerticalOffset + ViewportHeight);
		}

		public void PageLeft()
		{
			SetHorizontalOffset(HorizontalOffset - ViewportWidth);
		}

		public void PageRight()
		{
			SetHorizontalOffset(HorizontalOffset + ViewportWidth);
		}

		public void PageUp()
		{
			SetVerticalOffset(VerticalOffset - ViewportHeight);
		}

		public void SetHorizontalOffset(double offset)
		{
			offset = Math.Max(0.0, Math.Min(offset, ExtentWidth - ViewportWidth));
			if (offset != scrollData._offset.X)
			{
				scrollData._offset.X = offset;
				InvalidateArrange();
			}
		}

		public void SetVerticalOffset(double offset)
		{
			offset = Math.Max(0.0, Math.Min(offset, ExtentHeight - ViewportHeight));
			if (offset != scrollData._offset.Y)
			{
				scrollData._offset.Y = offset;
				InvalidateArrange();
			}
		}
	}
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_HorizontalRootElement", Type = typeof(FrameworkElement))]

	public class SplitterControl : BaseSplitterControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty LayoutItemProperty;

		private const string HorizontalRootElementName = "PART_HorizontalRootElement";

		private const string VerticalRootElementName = "PART_VerticalRootElement";

		public BaseLayoutItem LayoutItem
		{
			get

			}

		protected FrameworkElement PartVerticalRootElement { get; set; }

		static SplitterControl()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<SplitterControl> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<SplitterControl>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<SplitterControl>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<BaseLayoutItem>("LayoutItem", ref LayoutItemProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((SplitterControl)dObj).OnLayoutItemChanged((BaseLayoutItem)e.NewValue);
			});
		}

		public SplitterControl()
			: base(null)
		{
			SplitterWidth = LayoutSplitter.LayoutSplitterWidth;
			SplitterHeight = LayoutSplitter.LayoutSplitterHeight;
		}

		protected override Grid GetParentGrid()
		{
			return LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<Grid>((DependencyObject)this);
		}

		protected override int GetCurrent(bool isColumns)
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = (DependencyObject)(((object)LayoutItem) ?? ((object)this));
			return (int)dependencyObject.GetValue(isColumns ? Grid.ColumnProperty : Grid.RowProperty);
		}

		protected override int GetNext(int current)
		{
			if (base.LayoutGroup != null && LayoutItem != null)
			{
				int num = base.LayoutGroup.Items.IndexOf(LayoutItem);
				for (int i = num; i < base.LayoutGroup.Items.Count; i++)
				{
					BaseLayoutItem item = base.LayoutGroup.Items[i];
					if (BaseSplitterItem.IsResizableItem(item, base.IsHorizontal))
					{
						return base.LayoutGroup.ItemsInternal.IndexOf(item);
					}
				}
			}
			return current;
		}

		protected override int GetPrev(int current)
		{
			if (base.LayoutGroup != null && LayoutItem != null)
			{
				int num = base.LayoutGroup.Items.IndexOf(LayoutItem);
				for (int num2 = num; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					BaseLayoutItem item = base.LayoutGroup.Items[num2];
					if (BaseSplitterItem.IsResizableItem(item, base.IsHorizontal))
					{
						return base.LayoutGroup.ItemsInternal.IndexOf(item);
					}
				}
			}
			return current;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			DockLayoutManager.Ensure(this);
			PartHorizontalRootElement = GetTemplateChild("PART_HorizontalRootElement") as FrameworkElement;
			PartVerticalRootElement = GetTemplateChild("PART_VerticalRootElement") as FrameworkElement;
			UpdateTemplateParts();
			if (base.LayoutGroup != null)
			{
				if (!base.IsActivated)
				{
					Activate();
				}
				bool horizontal = base.LayoutGroup.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal;
				InitSplitThumb(horizontal);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnLayoutItemChanged(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				base.LayoutGroup = item.Parent;
			}
			else
			{
				base.LayoutGroup = null;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnOrientationChanged(Orientation orientation)
		{
			base.OnOrientationChanged(orientation);
			UpdateTemplateParts();
		}

		private void UpdateTemplateParts()
		{
			if (PartHorizontalRootElement != null)
			{
				PartHorizontalRootElement.Visibility = VisibilityHelper.Convert(base.Orientation == Orientation.Vertical);
			}
			if (PartVerticalRootElement != null)
			{
				PartVerticalRootElement.Visibility = VisibilityHelper.Convert(base.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal);
			}
		}
	}

	internal class SerializationHelper
	{
		private DockLayoutManager Container;

		private Stream memoryStream;

		public SerializationHelper(DockLayoutManager container)
		{
			Container = container;
		}

		public void RestoreLayout()
		{
			if (Container != null)
			{
				if (WindowHelper.IsXBAP)
				{
					RestoreLayoutFromStream(memoryStream);
				}
				else
				{
					RestoreLayoutFromFile();
				}
			}
		}

		public void SaveLayout()
		{
			if (Container != null)
			{
				if (WindowHelper.IsXBAP)
				{
					SaveLayoutToStream();
				}
				else
				{
					SaveLayoutToFile();
				}
			}
		}

		private void SaveLayoutToFile()
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0038: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ISaveFileDialogService service = (ISaveFileDialogService)new SaveFileDialogService
			{
				DefaultFileName = "Layout",
				DefaultExt = ".xml",
				Filter = "*.xml|*.xml",
				Window = WindowServiceHelper.GetWindow(Container)
			};
			if (service.ShowDialog())
			{
				Container.SaveLayoutToXml(service.GetFullFileName());
			}
		}

		private void RestoreLayoutFromFile()
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			IOpenFileDialogService service = (IOpenFileDialogService)new OpenFileDialogService
			{
				DefaultFileName = "Layout",
				Filter = "*.xml|*.xml",
				Window = WindowServiceHelper.GetWindow(Container)
			};
			if (service.ShowDialog())
			{
				Container.RestoreLayoutFromXml(service.GetFullFileName());
			}
		}

		private void RestoreLayoutFromStream(Stream stream)
		{
			if (stream != null)
			{
				stream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
				Container.RestoreLayoutFromStream(stream);
			}
		}

		private void SaveLayoutToStream()
		{
			Ref.Dispose(ref memoryStream);
			memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			Container.SaveLayoutToStream(memoryStream);
		}
	}

		{

			return TextWrapping.NoWrap;

		protected virtual object CoerceToolTip(object tooltip)
		{
			if (tooltip != null)
			{
				return tooltip;
			}
			string text = (RecognizeAccessKey ? AccessKeyHelper.RemoveAccessKeyMarker(CaptionText) : CaptionText);
			if (IsTextTrimmed(PartText, text))
			{
				return text;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual DependencyProperty GetCaptionTextProperty()
		{
			return BaseLayoutItem.ActualCaptionProperty;
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size constraint)
		{
			Size result = base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			string text = (RecognizeAccessKey ? AccessKeyHelper.RemoveAccessKeyMarker(CaptionText) : CaptionText);
			if (PartText != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				FormattedText formattedText = GetFormattedText(PartText, text);
				double widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace = formattedText.WidthIncludingTrailingWhitespace;
				double num = (double)MathHelper.Round(widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace + 1.0) - widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace;
				double width = PartText.DesiredSize.Width;
				bool flag = false;
				if (widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace - width > 0.0 && widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace - width < 1.0)
				{
					result = new Size(result.Width + num, result.Height);
					flag = true;
				}
				double width2 = constraint.Width;
				if (widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace - width2 > 0.0 && widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace - width2 < 1.0)
				{
					result = new Size(width2 + num, result.Height);
					flag = true;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					base.MeasureOverride(new Size(width2 + num, constraint.Height));
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual void SetLayoutItemBindings()
		{
			SetupToolTipService();

			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, TextWrappingProperty, Item, BaseLayoutItem.TextWrappingProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, CaptionTextProperty, Item, GetCaptionTextProperty());
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, AppearanceProperty, Item, BaseLayoutItem.ActualAppearanceObjectProperty);
		}

		protected void UpdateAppearance()
		{
			if (ItemAppearance != null)
			{
				Brush brush = Control.BackgroundProperty.DefaultMetadata.DefaultValue as Brush;
				bool flag = CanUseDefaultBackground();
				ActualAppearance.Background = ((!flag && ItemAppearance.Background != null) ? ItemAppearance.Background : brush);
				ActualAppearance.Foreground = (Brush)TryGetValue(CanUseAlternateForeground() ? AlternateForegroundProperty : Control.ForegroundProperty, ItemAppearance.Foreground);
				ActualAppearance.FontWeight = (FontWeight)TryGetValue(Control.FontWeightProperty, ItemAppearance.FontWeight);
				ActualAppearance.FontFamily = (FontFamily)TryGetValue(Control.FontFamilyProperty, ItemAppearance.FontFamily);
				ActualAppearance.FontSize = (double)TryGetValue(Control.FontSizeProperty, ItemAppearance.FontSize);
				ActualAppearance.FontStretch = (FontStretch)TryGetValue(Control.FontStretchProperty, ItemAppearance.FontStretch);
				ActualAppearance.FontStyle = (FontStyle)TryGetValue(Control.FontStyleProperty, ItemAppearance.FontStyle);
			}
		}

		private bool CanUseAlternateForeground()
		{
			if (Item is LayoutControlItem && DependencyObjectExtensions.IsPropertyAssigned((DependencyObject)Item, Control.ForegroundProperty))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (AlternateForeground != null)
			{
				return GetParentStyle(Item) == GroupBorderStyle.Tabbed;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool CanUseDefaultBackground()
		{
			if (Item is LayoutGroup layoutGroup)
			{
				return layoutGroup.GroupBorderStyle == GroupBorderStyle.GroupBox;
			}
			return Item is LayoutPanel;
		}

		private void EnsureAppearance()
		{
			if (ActualAppearance == null)
			{
				ActualAppearance = new AppearanceObject
				{
					Background = base.Background,
					Foreground = base.Foreground,
					FontWeight = base.FontWeight,
					FontFamily = base.FontFamily,
					FontSize = base.FontSize,
					FontStretch = base.FontStretch,
					FontStyle = base.FontStyle
				};
			}
		}

		private FormattedText GetFormattedText(FrameworkElement textBlock, string text)
		{
			if (formattedText == null || formattedText.Text != text)
			{
				Typeface typeface = new Typeface(TextBlock.GetFontFamily(textBlock), TextBlock.GetFontStyle(textBlock), TextBlock.GetFontWeight(textBlock), TextBlock.GetFontStretch(textBlock));
				formattedText = new FormattedText(text, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, FrameworkElement.GetFlowDirection(textBlock), typeface, TextBlock.GetFontSize(textBlock), TextBlock.GetForeground(textBlock));
			}
			return formattedText;
		}

		private GroupBorderStyle GetParentStyle(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return GroupBorderStyle.NoBorder;
			}
			if (item is LayoutGroup layoutGroup && ((layoutGroup.GroupBorderStyle == GroupBorderStyle.Tabbed && layoutGroup.TabbedGroupDisplayModeCore != TabbedGroupDisplayMode.ContentOnly) || layoutGroup.GroupBorderStyle == GroupBorderStyle.GroupBox))
			{
				return layoutGroup.GroupBorderStyle;
			}
			return GetParentStyle(item.Parent);
		}

		private bool IsTextTrimmed(FrameworkElement textBlock, string text)
		{
			if (textBlock == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return false;
			}
			FormattedText formattedText = GetFormattedText(textBlock, text);
			return formattedText.WidthIncludingTrailingWhitespace - textBlock.DesiredSize.Width > 1.0;
		}

		private void OnDataContextChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			Item = base.DataContext as BaseLayoutItem;
		}

		private void OnItemChanged()
		{
			if (Item is LayoutControlItem)
			{
				Target = ((LayoutControlItem)Item).Control;
			}
			SetLayoutItemBindings();
			UpdateAppearance();
		}

		private void ResetToolTipService()
		{
			BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, ToolTipService.PlacementProperty);
			BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, ToolTipService.BetweenShowDelayProperty);
			BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, ToolTipService.HasDropShadowProperty);
			BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, ToolTipService.HorizontalOffsetProperty);
			BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, ToolTipService.InitialShowDelayProperty);
			BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, ToolTipService.IsEnabledProperty);
			BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, ToolTipService.PlacementRectangleProperty);
			BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, ToolTipService.ShowDurationProperty);
			BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, ToolTipService.ShowOnDisabledProperty);
			BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, ToolTipService.VerticalOffsetProperty);
		}

		private void SetupToolTipService()
		{
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, ToolTipService.PlacementProperty, Item, ToolTipService.PlacementProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, ToolTipService.BetweenShowDelayProperty, Item, ToolTipService.BetweenShowDelayProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, ToolTipService.HasDropShadowProperty, Item, ToolTipService.HasDropShadowProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, ToolTipService.HorizontalOffsetProperty, Item, ToolTipService.HorizontalOffsetProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, ToolTipService.InitialShowDelayProperty, Item, ToolTipService.InitialShowDelayProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, ToolTipService.IsEnabledProperty, Item, ToolTipService.IsEnabledProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, ToolTipService.PlacementRectangleProperty, Item, ToolTipService.PlacementRectangleProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, ToolTipService.ShowDurationProperty, Item, ToolTipService.ShowDurationProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, ToolTipService.ShowOnDisabledProperty, Item, ToolTipService.ShowOnDisabledProperty);
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, ToolTipService.VerticalOffsetProperty, Item, ToolTipService.VerticalOffsetProperty);
		}

		private object TryGetValue(DependencyProperty property, object value)
		{
			return value ?? GetValue(property);
		}

		private object TryGetValue(DependencyProperty property, double value)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(value))
			{
				return GetValue(property);
			}
			return value;
		}
	}

		static TemplatedCaptionControl()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<TemplatedCaptionControl>();
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<TemplatedCaptionControl>.New().OverrideMetadata(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty, (Action<TemplatedCaptionControl>)delegate(TemplatedCaptionControl d)
			{
				d.IsParentMeasureValid = false;
			}).Register<object>("ActualCaption", ref ActualCaptionProperty, (object)null, (Action<TemplatedCaptionControl, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(TemplatedCaptionControl dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				dObj.OnItemPropertyChanged();
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<double>("ActualCaptionWidth", ref ActualCaptionWidthProperty, double.NaN, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<object>("ActualDataContext", ref ActualDataContextProperty, (object)null, (Action<TemplatedCaptionControl, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(TemplatedCaptionControl dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
				{
					dObj.OnItemPropertyChanged();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<DataTemplate>("CaptionTemplate", ref CaptionTemplateProperty, (DataTemplate)null, (Action<TemplatedCaptionControl>)delegate(TemplatedCaptionControl d)
				{
					d.OnItemPropertyChanged();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<ControlTemplate>("CaptionControlTemplate", ref CaptionControlTemplateProperty, (ControlTemplate)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<DataTemplateSelector>("CaptionTemplateSelector", ref CaptionTemplateSelectorProperty, (DataTemplateSelector)null, (Action<TemplatedCaptionControl>)delegate(TemplatedCaptionControl d)
				{
					d.OnItemPropertyChanged();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<ImageSource>("CaptionImage", ref CaptionImageProperty, (ImageSource)null, (Action<TemplatedCaptionControl>)delegate(TemplatedCaptionControl d)
				{
					d.CoerceValue(IsCaptionImageVisibleProperty);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<ControlTemplate>("ContentPresenterTemplate", ref ContentPresenterTemplateProperty, (ControlTemplate)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<Thickness>("CaptionMargin", ref CaptionMarginProperty, default(Thickness), (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<BaseLayoutItem>("LayoutItem", ref LayoutItemProperty, (BaseLayoutItem)null, (Action<TemplatedCaptionControl, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(TemplatedCaptionControl dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs ea)
				{
					dObj.OnLayoutItemChanged((BaseLayoutItem)ea.OldValue, (BaseLayoutItem)ea.NewValue);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("ShowCaptionImage", ref ShowCaptionImageProperty, true, (Action<TemplatedCaptionControl>)delegate(TemplatedCaptionControl d)
				{
					d.CoerceValue(IsCaptionImageVisibleProperty);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.RegisterReadOnly<object>("ActualContent", ref ActualContentPropertyKey, ref ActualContentProperty, (object)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.RegisterReadOnly<DataTemplate>("ActualContentTemplate", ref ActualContentTemplatePropertyKey, ref ActualContentTemplateProperty, (DataTemplate)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.RegisterReadOnly<DataTemplateSelector>("ActualContentTemplateSelector", ref ActualContentTemplateSelectorPropertyKey, ref ActualContentTemplateSelectorProperty, (DataTemplateSelector)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.RegisterReadOnly<bool>("IsCaptionImageVisible", ref IsCaptionImageVisiblePropertyKey, ref IsCaptionImageVisibleProperty, false, (Func<TemplatedCaptionControl, bool, bool>)((TemplatedCaptionControl d, bool value) => d.OnCoerceIsCaptionImageVisible(value)), (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			PartCaption = (CaptionControl)GetTemplateChild("PART_Caption");
			PartCaptionPresenter = (ContentPresenter)GetTemplateChild("PART_CaptionPresenter");
		}

		public void OnItemPropertyChanged()
		{
			SelectTemplate();
			OnItemPropertyChangedOverride();
		}

		internal virtual bool CanSetDesiredCaptionWidth()
		{
			if (LayoutItem.CaptionLocation == CaptionLocation.Bottom || LayoutItem.CaptionLocation == CaptionLocation.Top || LayoutItem.IsLogicalTreeLocked)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return VisibilityHelper.GetIsVisible(this);
		}

		protected virtual object GetActualContent()
		{
			return LayoutItem.Caption ?? LayoutItem.DataContext;
		}

		protected virtual DataTemplate GetActualContentTemplate()
		{
			return LayoutItem?.CaptionTemplate;
		}

		protected virtual DataTemplateSelector GetActualContentTemplateSelector()
		{
			return LayoutItem?.CaptionTemplateSelector;
		}

		protected virtual bool GetHasCaptionTemplate(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			return item.HasCaptionTemplate;
		}

		protected virtual bool OnCoerceIsCaptionImageVisible(bool value)
		{
			if (CaptionImage != null)
			{
				return ShowCaptionImage;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size arrangeBounds)
		{
			UpdateDesiredCaptionWidth(base.DesiredSize.Width);
			return base.ArrangeOverride(arrangeBounds);
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			Unsubscribe();
			if (PartCaption != null)
			{
				PartCaption.Dispose();
				PartCaption = null;
			}
			ClearValue(CaptionControlTemplateProperty);
			ClearValue(ContentPresenterTemplateProperty);
			ClearValue(LayoutItemProperty);
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized()
		{
			base.OnInitialized();
			SelectTemplate();
		}

		protected virtual DependencyProperty GetCaptionImageProperty()
		{
			return BaseLayoutItem.CaptionImageProperty;
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemPropertyChangedOverride()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnLayoutItemChanged(BaseLayoutItem oldValue, BaseLayoutItem newValue)
		{
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				if (CanUpdateDesiredCaptionWidth)
				{
					Subscribe();
				}
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, ActualCaptionProperty, newValue, BaseLayoutItem.CaptionProperty);
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, ActualDataContextProperty, newValue, FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty);
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, CaptionTemplateProperty, newValue, BaseLayoutItem.CaptionTemplateProperty);
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, CaptionTemplateSelectorProperty, newValue, BaseLayoutItem.CaptionTemplateSelectorProperty);
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, Control.HorizontalContentAlignmentProperty, newValue, BaseLayoutItem.CaptionHorizontalAlignmentProperty);
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, Control.VerticalContentAlignmentProperty, newValue, BaseLayoutItem.CaptionVerticalAlignmentProperty);
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, FrameworkElement.HorizontalAlignmentProperty, newValue, BaseLayoutItem.CaptionHorizontalAlignmentProperty);
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, FrameworkElement.VerticalAlignmentProperty, newValue, BaseLayoutItem.CaptionVerticalAlignmentProperty);
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, CaptionImageProperty, newValue, GetCaptionImageProperty());
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, ShowCaptionImageProperty, newValue, BaseLayoutItem.ShowCaptionImageProperty);
			}
			else
			{
				Unsubscribe();
				BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, ActualCaptionProperty);
				BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, ActualDataContextProperty);
				BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, CaptionTemplateProperty);
				BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, CaptionTemplateSelectorProperty);
				BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, Control.HorizontalContentAlignmentProperty);
				BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, Control.VerticalContentAlignmentProperty);
				BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, FrameworkElement.HorizontalAlignmentProperty);
				BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, FrameworkElement.VerticalAlignmentProperty);
				BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, CaptionImageProperty);
				BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, ShowCaptionImageProperty);
			}
			OnItemPropertyChanged();
		}

		protected void Subscribe()
		{
			Unsubscribe();
			base.LayoutUpdated += OnLayoutUpdated;
		}

		protected void Unsubscribe()
		{
			base.LayoutUpdated -= OnLayoutUpdated;
		}

		private void OnLayoutUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateDesiredCaptionWidth(base.DesiredSize.Width);
		}

		private void SelectTemplate()
		{
			if (LayoutItem != null)
			{
				bool shouldUseCaptionTemplate = ShouldUseCaptionTemplate;
				base.Template = (shouldUseCaptionTemplate ? CaptionControlTemplate : ContentPresenterTemplate);
				if (!shouldUseCaptionTemplate)
				{
					ActualContent = GetActualContent();
					ActualContentTemplate = GetActualContentTemplate();
					ActualContentTemplateSelector = GetActualContentTemplateSelector();
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateDesiredCaptionWidth(double desiredWidth)
		{
			if (!CanUpdateDesiredCaptionWidth)
			{
				return;
			}
			CaptionControl partCaption = PartCaption;
			if (partCaption != null && partCaption.IsCaptionTextTrimmed)
			{
				return;
			}
			LayoutControlItem layoutControlItem = (LayoutControlItem)LayoutItem;
			if (!layoutControlItem.HasDesiredCaptionWidth && CanSetDesiredCaptionWidth())
			{
				layoutControlItem.DesiredCaptionWidth = (layoutControlItem.HasVisibleCaption ? desiredWidth : 0.0);
				InvalidateMeasure();
			}
			if (!IsParentMeasureValid)
			{
				(base.VisualParent as FrameworkElement).Do(delegate(FrameworkElement x)
				{
					x.InvalidateMeasure();
				});
				IsParentMeasureValid = true;
			}
		}

		internal FrameworkElement GetActualCaptionPart()
		{
			if (!ShouldUseCaptionTemplate)
			{
				return PartCaptionPresenter;
			}
			return PartCaption;
		}
	}
	public class TemplatedTabCaptionControl : TemplatedCaptionControl
	{
		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty ActualTabCaptionProperty;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty TabCaptionTemplateProperty;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty TabCaptionTemplateSelectorProperty;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty ShowTabCaptionImageProperty;

		public override bool CanUpdateDesiredCaptionWidth => false;

		protected override bool ShouldUseCaptionTemplate => !base.LayoutItem.ShouldUseTabCaptionTemplate;

		private bool ShowTabCaptionProperty => (bool)GetValue(ShowTabCaptionImageProperty);

		private DataTemplate TabCaptionTemplate => (DataTemplate)GetValue(TabCaptionTemplateProperty);

		private DataTemplateSelector TabCaptionTemplateSelector => (DataTemplateSelector)GetValue(TabCaptionTemplateSelectorProperty);

		static TemplatedTabCaptionControl()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<TemplatedTabCaptionControl> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<TemplatedTabCaptionControl>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<TemplatedTabCaptionControl>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<object>("ActualTabCaption", ref ActualTabCaptionProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((TemplatedCaptionControl)dObj).OnItemPropertyChanged();
			});
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<TemplatedTabCaptionControl>.New().OverrideMetadata<bool>(TemplatedCaptionControl.ShowCaptionImageProperty, (Action<TemplatedTabCaptionControl>)delegate
			{
			}, (Func<TemplatedTabCaptionControl, bool, bool>)((TemplatedTabCaptionControl d, bool value) => d.OnCoerceShowCaptionImageProperty(value))).Register<DataTemplate>("TabCaptionTemplate", ref TabCaptionTemplateProperty, (DataTemplate)null, (Action<TemplatedTabCaptionControl>)delegate(TemplatedTabCaptionControl d)
			{
				d.OnItemPropertyChanged();
			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<DataTemplateSelector>("TabCaptionTemplateSelector", ref TabCaptionTemplateSelectorProperty, (DataTemplateSelector)null, (Action<TemplatedTabCaptionControl>)delegate(TemplatedTabCaptionControl d)
				{
					d.OnItemPropertyChanged();
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("ShowTabCaptionProperty", ref ShowTabCaptionImageProperty, false, (Action<TemplatedTabCaptionControl>)delegate(TemplatedTabCaptionControl d)
				{
					d.CoerceValue(TemplatedCaptionControl.ShowCaptionImageProperty);
				}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		protected override object GetActualContent()
		{
			return base.LayoutItem.TabCaption ?? base.LayoutItem.DataContext;
		}

		protected override DataTemplate GetActualContentTemplate()
		{
			if (base.LayoutItem == null || !base.LayoutItem.HasTabCaptionTemplate)
			{
				return base.GetActualContentTemplate();
			}
			return base.LayoutItem.TabCaptionTemplate;
		}

		protected override DataTemplateSelector GetActualContentTemplateSelector()
		{
			if (base.LayoutItem == null || !base.LayoutItem.HasTabCaptionTemplate)
			{
				return base.GetActualContentTemplateSelector();
			}
			return base.LayoutItem.TabCaptionTemplateSelector;
		}

		protected override bool GetHasCaptionTemplate(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (!base.GetHasCaptionTemplate(item))
			{
				return item.HasTabCaptionTemplate;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void OnItemPropertyChangedOverride()
		{
			base.OnItemPropertyChangedOverride();
			InvalidateMeasure();
			DependencyObject tabHeader = LayoutTreeHelper.GetVisualParents((DependencyObject)this, (DependencyObject)null).FirstOrDefault((DependencyObject x) => x is ITabHeader);
			if (tabHeader != null)
			{
				LayoutTreeHelper.GetVisualParents((DependencyObject)this, (DependencyObject)null).TakeWhile((DependencyObject x) => x != tabHeader).Concat(tabHeader.Yield())
					.OfType<UIElement>()
					.ForEach(delegate(UIElement x)
					{
						x.InvalidateMeasure();
					});
			}
		}

		protected override void OnLayoutItemChanged(BaseLayoutItem oldValue, BaseLayoutItem newValue)
		{
			base.OnLayoutItemChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, ActualTabCaptionProperty, newValue, BaseLayoutItem.TabCaptionProperty);
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, Control.HorizontalContentAlignmentProperty, newValue, BaseLayoutItem.TabCaptionHorizontalAlignmentProperty);
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, Control.VerticalContentAlignmentProperty, newValue, BaseLayoutItem.TabCaptionVerticalAlignmentProperty);
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, TabCaptionTemplateProperty, newValue, BaseLayoutItem.TabCaptionTemplateProperty);
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, TabCaptionTemplateSelectorProperty, newValue, BaseLayoutItem.TabCaptionTemplateSelectorProperty);
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, FrameworkElement.HorizontalAlignmentProperty, newValue, BaseLayoutItem.TabCaptionHorizontalAlignmentProperty);
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, FrameworkElement.VerticalAlignmentProperty, newValue, BaseLayoutItem.TabCaptionVerticalAlignmentProperty);
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, TemplatedCaptionControl.ActualCaptionWidthProperty, newValue, BaseLayoutItem.TabCaptionWidthProperty);
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, ShowTabCaptionImageProperty, newValue, BaseLayoutItem.ShowTabCaptionImageProperty);
			}
			else
			{
				BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, TabCaptionTemplateProperty);
				BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, TabCaptionTemplateSelectorProperty);
				BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, ActualTabCaptionProperty);
				BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, Control.HorizontalContentAlignmentProperty);
				BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, Control.VerticalContentAlignmentProperty);
				BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, FrameworkElement.HorizontalAlignmentProperty);
				BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, FrameworkElement.VerticalAlignmentProperty);
				BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, TemplatedCaptionControl.ActualCaptionWidthProperty);
				BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, ShowTabCaptionImageProperty);
			}
		}

		protected override DependencyProperty GetCaptionImageProperty()
		{
			return BaseLayoutItem.TabCaptionImageProperty;
		}

		private bool OnCoerceShowCaptionImageProperty(bool value)
		{
			if (base.LayoutItem == null || !DependencyObjectExtensions.IsPropertySet((DependencyObject)base.LayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem.ShowTabCaptionImageProperty))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return ShowTabCaptionProperty;
		}
	}

	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_Caption", Type = typeof(ControlItemCaptionPresenter))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_Control", Type = typeof(ControlItemControlPresenter))]
	public class ControlItem : psvHeaderedContentControl
	{
		public ControlItemCaptionPresenter PartCaption { get; private set; }

		public ControlItemControlPresenter PartControl { get; private set; }

		protected FrameworkElement PartBorder { get; private set; }

		protected LayoutControlItem Item => base.LayoutItem as LayoutControlItem;

		static ControlItem()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<ControlItem> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<ControlItem>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<ControlItem>();
		}

		public ControlItem()
		{
			base.LayoutUpdated += OnLayoutUpdated;
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			base.LayoutUpdated -= OnLayoutUpdated;
			if (PartCaption != null)
			{
				PartCaption.Dispose();
				PartCaption = null;
			}
			if (PartControl != null)
			{
				PartControl.Dispose();
				PartControl = null;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			PartBorder = GetTemplateChild("PART_Border") as FrameworkElement;
			if (PartCaption != null && !LayoutItemsHelper.IsTemplateChild(PartCaption, this))
			{
				PartCaption.Dispose();
			}
			PartCaption = GetTemplateChild("PART_Caption") as ControlItemCaptionPresenter;
			if (PartCaption != null)
			{
				PartCaption.EnsureOwner(this);
			}
			if (PartControl != null && !LayoutItemsHelper.IsTemplateChild(PartControl, this))
			{
				PartControl.Dispose();
			}
			PartControl = GetTemplateChild("PART_Control") as ControlItemControlPresenter;
			if (PartControl != null)
			{
				PartControl.EnsureOwner(this);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnActualSizeChanged(Size value)
		{
			base.OnActualSizeChanged(value);
			if (!base.IsDisposing && Item != null)
			{
				Item.LayoutSize = value;
			}
		}

		private void OnLayoutUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateDesiredSize(base.DesiredSize);
		}

		private void UpdateDesiredSize(Size desiredSize)
		{
			if (Item != null && !Item.HasDesiredSize)
			{
				if (PartBorder != null)
				{
					desiredSize = PartBorder.DesiredSize;
				}
				Item.DesiredSizeInternal = desiredSize;
			}
		}
	}

	[ValueConversion(typeof(Dock), typeof(Thickness))]
	[Obsolete]
	public class DockTypeToThicknessRotateConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public Thickness Thickness { get; set; }

		public bool Inverted { get; set; }

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			double left;
			double top;
			double right;
			double bottom;
			switch ((Dock)value)
			{
			case Dock.Left:
				left = Thickness.Bottom;
				top = Thickness.Left;
				right = Thickness.Top;
				bottom = Thickness.Right;
				break;
			case Dock.Top:
				left = Thickness.Left;
				top = Thickness.Bottom;
				right = Thickness.Right;
				bottom = Thickness.Top;
				break;
			case Dock.Right:
				left = Thickness.Top;
				top = Thickness.Left;
				right = Thickness.Bottom;
				bottom = Thickness.Right;
				break;
			default:
				left = Thickness.Left;
				top = Thickness.Top;
				right = Thickness.Right;
				bottom = Thickness.Bottom;
				break;
			}
			return new Thickness(left, top, right, bottom);
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return Inverted ? Dock.Right : Dock.Left;
		}
	}
	[ValueConversion(typeof(Dock), typeof(Thickness))]
	public class DockTypeToThicknessConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public double All { get; set; }

		public bool Inverted { get; set; }

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			Dock dock = (Dock)value;
			Thickness thickness = new Thickness(Inverted ? 0.0 : All);
			switch (dock)
			{
			case Dock.Left:
				if (Inverted)
				{
					thickness.Right = All;
				}
				else
				{
					thickness.Left = 0.0;
				}
				break;
			case Dock.Top:
				if (Inverted)
				{
					thickness.Bottom = All;
				}
				else
				{
					thickness.Top = 0.0;
				}
				break;
			case Dock.Right:
				if (Inverted)
				{
					thickness.Left = All;
				}
				else
				{
					thickness.Right = 0.0;
				}
				break;
			case Dock.Bottom:
				if (Inverted)
				{
					thickness.Top = All;
				}
				else
				{
					thickness.Bottom = 0.0;
				}
				break;
			}
			return thickness;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			Thickness thickness = (Thickness)value;
			double num = (Inverted ? All : 0.0);
			Dock dock = (Inverted ? Dock.Right : Dock.Left);
			if (thickness.Top == num)
			{
				dock = ((!Inverted) ? Dock.Top : Dock.Bottom);
			}
			if (thickness.Right == num)
			{
				dock = ((!Inverted) ? Dock.Right : Dock.Left);
			}
			if (thickness.Bottom == num)
			{
				dock = (Inverted ? Dock.Top : Dock.Bottom);
			}
			return dock;
		}
	}

		{

			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

	internal class BooleanAndConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public bool UseNullableValues { get; set; }

		public bool NullValue { get; set; }

		public BooleanAndConverter()
		{
			UseNullableValues = false;
			NullValue = false;
		}

		object IMultiValueConverter.Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			foreach (object obj in values)
			{
				if (obj == DependencyProperty.UnsetValue)
				{
					return DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
				}
				bool flag = false;
				if (!((!UseNullableValues) ? ((bool)obj) : (((bool?)obj).HasValue ? ((bool?)obj).Value : NullValue)))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		object[] IMultiValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

	public class OptionsPanel : psvControl
	{
		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty AllowInvisbleItemsInternalProperty;

		protected CheckEdit PartCheckShowAll { get; private set; }

		static OptionsPanel()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<OptionsPanel> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<OptionsPanel>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<OptionsPanel>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("AllowInvisbleItemsInternal", ref AllowInvisbleItemsInternalProperty, defValue: true, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs ea)
			{
				((OptionsPanel)dObj).OnAllowInvisibleItemsInternalChanged((bool)ea.NewValue);
			});
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			DependencyObject templateChild = GetTemplateChild("PART_CheckShowAll");
			PartCheckShowAll = (CheckEdit)(object)((templateChild is CheckEdit) ? templateChild : null);
			if (PartCheckShowAll != null)
			{
				PartCheckShowAll.Content = DockingLocalizer.GetString(DockingStringId.CheckBoxShowInvisibleItems);
				if (base.Container != null)
				{
					BindingHelper.SetBinding((DependencyObject)(object)PartCheckShowAll, CheckEdit.IsCheckedProperty, base.Container, DockLayoutManager.ShowInvisibleItemsProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay);
					BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, AllowInvisbleItemsInternalProperty, base.Container, "ShowInvisibleItemsInCustomizationForm");
				}
			}
			base.Focusable = false;
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, AllowInvisbleItemsInternalProperty);
			if (PartCheckShowAll != null)
			{
				BindingHelper.ClearBinding((DependencyObject)(object)PartCheckShowAll, CheckEdit.IsCheckedProperty);
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		public void OnAllowInvisibleItemsInternalChanged(bool value)
		{
			if (base.Container != null)
			{
				((UIElement)(object)PartCheckShowAll).Visibility = VisibilityHelper.Convert(value);
				if (value)
				{
					BindingHelper.SetBinding((DependencyObject)(object)PartCheckShowAll, CheckEdit.IsCheckedProperty, base.Container, DockLayoutManager.ShowInvisibleItemsProperty, BindingMode.TwoWay);
				}
				else
				{
					BindingHelper.ClearBinding((DependencyObject)(object)PartCheckShowAll, CheckEdit.IsCheckedProperty);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public enum TreeItemState
	{
		Default,
		Selected,
		Dragged,
		Hovered
	}
	public class TreeItem : BaseCustomizationItem, IDockLayoutManagerListener
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty TreeItemStateProperty;

		public Border PartBorder { get; private set; }

		public Image PartImage { get; private set; }

		public TreeItemState TreeItemState
		{
			get
			{
				return (TreeItemState)GetValue(TreeItemStateProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(TreeItemStateProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static TreeItem()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<TreeItem> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<TreeItem>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("TreeItemState", ref TreeItemStateProperty, TreeItemState.Default);
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<TreeItem>();
		}

		public TreeItem()
		{
			base.Focusable = false;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			PartBorder = GetTemplateChild("PART_Border") as Border;
			PartImage = GetTemplateChild("PART_Image") as Image;
			if (PartImage != null)
			{
				PartImage.Source = ImageHelper.GetImageForItem(base.LayoutItem);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnLayoutItemChanged(BaseLayoutItem oldValue, BaseLayoutItem newValue)
		{
			base.OnLayoutItemChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			if (newValue != null && newValue.IsSelected)
			{
				BringIntoView();
				TreeItemState = TreeItemState.Selected;
			}
		}

		private void OnDragInfoChanged(object sender, DragInfoChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Info != null && base.LayoutItem == e.Info.Item)
			{
				TreeItemState = TreeItemState.Dragged;
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(TreeItemStateProperty);
			}
		}

		private void OnLayoutItemSelectionChanged(object sender, LayoutItemSelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Selected && e.Item == base.LayoutItem)
			{
				BringIntoView();
			}
			if (base.LayoutItem.IsSelected)
			{
				TreeItemState = TreeItemState.Selected;
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(TreeItemStateProperty);
			}
		}

		void IDockLayoutManagerListener.Subscribe(DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			SubscribeEvents(manager);
		}

		void IDockLayoutManagerListener.Unsubscribe(DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			UnsubscribeEvents(manager);
		}

		protected virtual void SubscribeEvents(DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			manager.CustomizationController.DragInfoChanged += OnDragInfoChanged;
			manager.LayoutItemSelectionChanged += OnLayoutItemSelectionChanged;
		}

		protected virtual void UnsubscribeEvents(DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			if (!manager.IsDisposing)
			{
				manager.CustomizationController.DragInfoChanged -= OnDragInfoChanged;
				manager.LayoutItemSelectionChanged -= OnLayoutItemSelectionChanged;
			}
		}
	}
