	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_Content", Type = typeof(FrameworkElement))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_Bounds", Type = typeof(FrameworkElement))]
	public class DropBoundsControl : ContentControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty DropTypeProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsDragSourceProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LayoutItemProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty UseOptimizedTemplateProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty CenterElementTemplateProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SideElementTemplateProperty;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty IsCenterElementVisibleProperty;

		protected BaseLayoutItem itemCore;

		private DockLayoutManager Container;

		private int lockChanged;

		private Splitter nextSplitter;

		private Splitter prevSplitter;

		public DataTemplate CenterElementTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return (DataTemplate)GetValue(CenterElementTemplateProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(CenterElementTemplateProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public DropType DropType
		{
			get
			{
				return (DropType)GetValue(DropTypeProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DropTypeProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsDragSource
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsDragSourceProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsDragSourceProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public BaseLayoutItem LayoutItem
		{
			get
			{
				return (BaseLayoutItem)GetValue(LayoutItemProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LayoutItemProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public DataTemplate SideElementTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return (DataTemplate)GetValue(SideElementTemplateProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(SideElementTemplateProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool UseOptimizedTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(UseOptimizedTemplateProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(UseOptimizedTemplateProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected ColumnDefinition Col0 { get; private set; }

		protected ColumnDefinition Col1 { get; private set; }

		protected ColumnDefinition Col2 { get; private set; }

		protected BaseLayoutItem Item => LayoutItem ?? itemCore;

		protected FrameworkElement PartBounds { get; private set; }

		protected FrameworkElement PartCenter { get; private set; }

		protected RowDefinition Row0 { get; private set; }

		protected RowDefinition Row1 { get; private set; }

		protected RowDefinition Row2 { get; private set; }

		private bool CanShowCenterZone
		{
			get
			{
				if (Item is LayoutGroup)
				{
					return ((LayoutGroup)Item).GroupBorderStyle != GroupBorderStyle.Tabbed;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool IsCenterElementVisible
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsCenterElementVisibleProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsCenterElementVisibleProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static DropBoundsControl()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DropBoundsControl> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DropBoundsControl>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<DropBoundsControl>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("DropType", ref DropTypeProperty, DropType.None, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DropBoundsControl)dObj).OnDropTypeChanged((DropType)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("IsDragSource", ref IsDragSourceProperty, defValue: false, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DropBoundsControl)dObj).OnIsDragSourceChanged((bool)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<BaseLayoutItem>("LayoutItem", ref LayoutItemProperty);
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DropBoundsControl>.New().Register<bool>("UseOptimizedTemplate", ref UseOptimizedTemplateProperty, true, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null).Register<DataTemplate>("CenterElementTemplate", ref CenterElementTemplateProperty, (DataTemplate)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<DataTemplate>("SideElementTemplate", ref SideElementTemplateProperty, (DataTemplate)null, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("IsCenterElementVisible", ref IsCenterElementVisibleProperty, false, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		public DropBoundsControl()
		{
			base.Focusable = false;
			base.Loaded += DropBoundsControl_Loaded;
			base.Unloaded += DropBoundsControl_Unloaded;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			DockLayoutManager.Ensure(this);
			itemCore = base.DataContext as BaseLayoutItem;
			PartCenter = GetTemplateChild("PART_Center") as FrameworkElement;
			PartBounds = GetTemplateChild("PART_Bounds") as FrameworkElement;
			Row0 = GetTemplateChild("PART_Row0") as RowDefinition;
			Row1 = GetTemplateChild("PART_Row1") as RowDefinition;
			Row2 = GetTemplateChild("PART_Row2") as RowDefinition;
			Col0 = GetTemplateChild("PART_Col0") as ColumnDefinition;
			Col1 = GetTemplateChild("PART_Col1") as ColumnDefinition;
			Col2 = GetTemplateChild("PART_Col2") as ColumnDefinition;
		}

		protected virtual void OnDropTypeChanged(DropType type)
		{
			if (lockChanged > 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			lockChanged++;
			UpdateVisualState();
			EnsureSplitters();
			EnsureCollapsedWithAnimation();
			if (type != DropType.None)
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				if (Item.Parent != null)
				{
					Splitter splitter = DropBoundsHelper.ChooseSplitter(type, prevSplitter, nextSplitter);
					bool flag = Item.Parent.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal;
					num = ((splitter == null || Item.Parent.Orientation != type.ToOrientation()) ? 0.0 : (flag ? splitter.ActualWidth : splitter.ActualHeight));
					SelectSplitter(type, splitter);
				}
				double num2 = ((type.ToOrientation() == Orientation.Horizontal && Item.ItemType == LayoutItemType.ControlItem) ? 32.0 : 14.0);
				num2 = ((num > num2) ? 4.0 : (num2 - num));
				GridLength to = new GridLength(Math.Min(num2, Math.Max(4.0, PartBounds.ActualWidth * 0.15)), GridUnitType.Pixel);
				GridLength to2 = new GridLength(Math.Min(num2, Math.Max(4.0, PartBounds.ActualHeight * 0.15)), GridUnitType.Pixel);
				switch (type)
				{
				case DropType.Left:
					ExpandWithAnimation(Col0, ColumnDefinition.WidthProperty, GridLengthAnimation.Zero, to);
					break;
				case DropType.Right:
					ExpandWithAnimation(Col2, ColumnDefinition.WidthProperty, GridLengthAnimation.Zero, to);
					break;
				case DropType.Top:
					ExpandWithAnimation(Row0, RowDefinition.HeightProperty, GridLengthAnimation.Zero, to2);
					break;
				case DropType.Bottom:
					ExpandWithAnimation(Row2, RowDefinition.HeightProperty, GridLengthAnimation.Zero, to2);
					break;
				case DropType.Center:
					if (CanShowCenterZone)
					{
						ShowCenterZoneWithAnimation(PartBounds.ActualWidth * 0.6, PartBounds.ActualHeight * 0.6);
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			lockChanged--;
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsDragSourceChanged(bool newValue)
		{
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected virtual void SubscribeEvents(DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			if (!manager.IsDisposing && manager.CustomizationController != null)
			{
				manager.CustomizationController.DragInfoChanged += OnDragInfoChanged;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UnsubscribeEvents(DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			if (!manager.IsDisposing && manager.CustomizationController != null)
			{
				manager.CustomizationController.DragInfoChanged -= OnDragInfoChanged;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateVisualState()
		{
			if (DropType == DropType.Center)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "DropCenterState", useTransitions: false);
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, IsDragSource ? "DragSourceState" : "EmptyDraggingState", useTransitions: false);
			}
		}

		private void ChangeSplitterSelection(DropType type)
		{
			if (type == DropType.None || type == DropType.Center)
			{
				if (nextSplitter != null)
				{
					nextSplitter.IsDragDropOver = false;
				}
				if (prevSplitter != null)
				{
					prevSplitter.IsDragDropOver = false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Splitter splitter = DropBoundsHelper.ChooseSplitter(type, prevSplitter, nextSplitter);
				if (splitter != null)
				{
					splitter.IsDragDropOver = type.ToOrientation() == Item.Parent.Orientation;
				}
			}
		}

		private FrameworkElement CreateElement(bool center)
		{
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle
			{
				Opacity = 0.15,
				IsHitTestVisible = false
			};
			if (center)
			{
				rectangle.RadiusX = 2.0;
				rectangle.RadiusY = 2.0;
				rectangle.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center;
				rectangle.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Center;
				rectangle.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			BindingHelper.SetBinding(rectangle, Shape.FillProperty, this, Control.BackgroundProperty);
			return rectangle;
		}

		private FrameworkElement CreateElement(DataTemplate fromTemplate, int row, int column, bool center = false)
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = null;
			if (fromTemplate != null)
			{
				frameworkElement = fromTemplate.LoadContent() as FrameworkElement;
			}
			if (frameworkElement == null)
			{
				frameworkElement = CreateElement(center);
			}
			Grid.SetRow(frameworkElement, row);
			Grid.SetColumn(frameworkElement, column);
			return frameworkElement;
		}

		private void DropBoundsControl_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			Container = DockLayoutManager.FindManager(this);
			if (Container != null)
			{
				SubscribeEvents(Container);
			}
		}

		private void DropBoundsControl_Unloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Container != null)
			{
				UnsubscribeEvents(Container);
				Container = null;
			}
		}

		private void EnsureCollapsedWithAnimation()
		{
			Storyboard storyboard = new Storyboard();
			storyboard.Children.Add(DropBoundsHelper.CreateGridLengthAnimation(Col0, ColumnDefinition.WidthProperty, Col0.Width, GridLengthAnimation.Zero));
			storyboard.Children.Add(DropBoundsHelper.CreateGridLengthAnimation(Col2, ColumnDefinition.WidthProperty, Col2.Width, GridLengthAnimation.Zero));
			storyboard.Children.Add(DropBoundsHelper.CreateGridLengthAnimation(Row0, RowDefinition.HeightProperty, Row0.Height, GridLengthAnimation.Zero));
			storyboard.Children.Add(DropBoundsHelper.CreateGridLengthAnimation(Row2, RowDefinition.HeightProperty, Row2.Height, GridLengthAnimation.Zero));
			storyboard.Completed += OnCollapseAnimationCompleted;
			PartBounds.BeginStoryboard(storyboard);
			PartCenter.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty);
			PartCenter.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.HeightProperty);
		}

		private void EnsureSplitters()
		{
			nextSplitter = null;
			prevSplitter = null;
			if (Item.Parent != null)
			{
				ObservableCollection<object> itemsInternal = Item.Parent.ItemsInternal;
				int num = itemsInternal.IndexOf(Item);
				if (num - 1 > 0)
				{
					prevSplitter = itemsInternal[num - 1] as Splitter;
				}
				if (num + 1 < itemsInternal.Count - 1)
				{
					nextSplitter = itemsInternal[num + 1] as Splitter;
				}
			}
		}

		private void EnsureVisualTree()
		{
			if (PartBounds is Grid grid && Row0 == null)
			{
				grid.RowDefinitions.Clear();
				grid.ColumnDefinitions.Clear();
				Row0 = new RowDefinition
				{
					Height = DefinitionsHelper.ZeroLength
				};
				Row1 = new RowDefinition
				{
					Height = new GridLength(1.0, GridUnitType.Star)
				};
				Row2 = new RowDefinition
				{
					Height = DefinitionsHelper.ZeroLength
				};
				Col0 = new ColumnDefinition
				{
					Width = DefinitionsHelper.ZeroLength
				};
				Col1 = new ColumnDefinition
				{
					Width = new GridLength(1.0, GridUnitType.Star)
				};
				Col2 = new ColumnDefinition
				{
					Width = DefinitionsHelper.ZeroLength
				};
				grid.RowDefinitions.Add(Row0);
				grid.RowDefinitions.Add(Row1);
				grid.RowDefinitions.Add(Row2);
				grid.ColumnDefinitions.Add(Col0);
				grid.ColumnDefinitions.Add(Col1);
				grid.ColumnDefinitions.Add(Col2);
				PartCenter = CreateElement(CenterElementTemplate, 1, 1, center: true);
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(PartCenter, UIElement.VisibilityProperty, this, IsCenterElementVisibleProperty, new BooleanToVisibilityConverter());
				grid.Children.Add(PartCenter);
				grid.Children.Add(CreateElement(SideElementTemplate, 0, 1));
				grid.Children.Add(CreateElement(SideElementTemplate, 2, 1));
				grid.Children.Add(CreateElement(SideElementTemplate, 1, 0));
				grid.Children.Add(CreateElement(SideElementTemplate, 1, 2));
			}
		}

		private void ExpandWithAnimation(DependencyObject element, DependencyProperty property, GridLength from, GridLength to)
		{
			Storyboard storyboard = new Storyboard();
			storyboard.Children.Add(DropBoundsHelper.CreateGridLengthAnimation(element, property, from, to));
			storyboard.Completed += OnExpandAnimationCompleted;
			PartBounds.BeginStoryboard(storyboard);
		}

		private void OnCollapseAnimationCompleted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ChangeSplitterSelection(DropType);
		}

		private void OnDragInfoChanged(object sender, DragInfoChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			EnsureVisualTree();
			if (e.Info == null)
			{
				ClearValue(DropTypeProperty);
				ClearValue(IsDragSourceProperty);
			}
			else
			{
				DropType = DropBoundsHelper.CalcDropType(Item, e.Info);
				IsDragSource = e.Info.Item == Item;
			}
			IsCenterElementVisible = DropType == DropType.Center;
		}

		private void OnExpandAnimationCompleted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ChangeSplitterSelection(DropType);
		}

		private void SelectSplitter(DropType type, Splitter splitter)
		{
			if (splitter != null && type != DropType.None && type != DropType.Center && type.ToOrientation() == Item.Parent.Orientation)
			{
				splitter.IsDragDropOver = true;
			}
		}

		private void ShowCenterZoneWithAnimation(double width, double height)
		{
			Storyboard storyboard = new Storyboard();
			storyboard.Children.Add(DropBoundsHelper.CreateDoubleAnimation(PartCenter, FrameworkElement.WidthProperty, 0.0, width));
			storyboard.Children.Add(DropBoundsHelper.CreateDoubleAnimation(PartCenter, FrameworkElement.HeightProperty, 0.0, height));
			PartCenter.BeginStoryboard(storyboard);
		}
	}
	public class DropBoundsHelper
	{
		public static DropType CalcDropType(BaseLayoutItem item, DragInfo info)
		{
			DropType type = info.Type;
			BaseLayoutItem target = info.Target;
			BaseLayoutItem item2 = info.Item;
			if (item == null || LayoutItemsHelper.IsParent(target, item2))
			{
				return DropType.None;
			}
			if (item == target && type == DropType.Center)
			{
				return type;
			}
			DropType result = DropType.None;
			if (item.Parent == null || item == item2 || target == item2)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (item != null && target != null)
			{
				LayoutGroup parent = item.Parent;
				if (type.ToOrientation() != parent.Orientation)
				{
					if (target != item)
					{
						return DropType.None;
					}
					return type;
				}
				if (target == item)
				{
					result = type;
					if (LayoutItemsHelper.AreInSameGroup(item2, item))
					{
						bool? flag = LayoutItemsHelper.IsNextNeighbour(item2, item);
						if (flag.HasValue)
						{
							if (flag.Value)
							{
								if (type == DropType.Left || type == DropType.Top)
								{
									result = DropType.None;
								}
							}
							else if (type == DropType.Right || type == DropType.Bottom)
							{
								result = DropType.None;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else if (LayoutItemsHelper.AreInSameGroup(target, item))
				{
					bool? flag2 = LayoutItemsHelper.IsNextNeighbour(target, item);
					if (flag2.HasValue)
					{
						if (flag2.Value)
						{
							if (type == DropType.Right)
							{
								result = DropType.Left;
							}
							if (type == DropType.Bottom)
							{
								result = DropType.Top;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							if (type == DropType.Left)
							{
								result = DropType.Right;
							}
							if (type == DropType.Top)
							{
								result = DropType.Bottom;
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static Splitter ChooseSplitter(DropType type, Splitter prev, Splitter next)
		{
			switch (type)
			{
			case DropType.Top:
			case DropType.Left:
				return prev;
			case DropType.Bottom:
			case DropType.Right:
				return next;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		public static DoubleAnimation CreateDoubleAnimation(DependencyObject element, DependencyProperty property, double from, double to)
		{
			DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation = new DoubleAnimation
			{
				From = from,
				To = to,
				BeginTime = TimeSpan.Zero,
				Duration = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(25.0)
			};
			Storyboard.SetTarget(doubleAnimation, element);
			Storyboard.SetTargetProperty(doubleAnimation, new PropertyPath(property));
			return doubleAnimation;
		}

		public static GridLengthAnimation CreateGridLengthAnimation(DependencyObject element, DependencyProperty property, GridLength from, GridLength to)
		{
			GridLengthAnimation gridLengthAnimation = new GridLengthAnimation
			{
				From = from,
				To = to,
				BeginTime = TimeSpan.Zero,
				Duration = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(20.0)
			};
			Storyboard.SetTarget(gridLengthAnimation, element);
			Storyboard.SetTargetProperty(gridLengthAnimation, new PropertyPath(property));
			return gridLengthAnimation;
		}
	}
	[DXToolboxBrowsable(false)]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_DocumentSelectorPreview", Type = typeof(DocumentSelectorPreview))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_PanelsListBox", Type = typeof(DocumentSelectorListBox))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_DocumentsListBox", Type = typeof(DocumentSelectorListBox))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_PanelsListBoxCaption", Type = typeof(UIElement))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_DocumentsListBoxCaption", Type = typeof(UIElement))]
	public class DocumentSelector : psvControl, IControlHost
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty PanelIndexProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DocumentIndexProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PanelsCaptionProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DocumentsCaptionProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey SelectedItemPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SelectedItemProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty BindableDocumentIndexProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty BindablePanelIndexProperty;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty IsActiveProperty;

		private ObservableCollection<LayoutPanel> selectedItemsCore;

		private int selectedItemLock;

		private bool keyLeftCtrl;

		private bool keyRightCtrl;

		private readonly Locker closeLocker = new Locker();

		private int lockDocumentIndex;

		private int lockPanelIndex;

		public int SelectedIndex
		{
			get
			{
				if (SelectedItems != Panels)
				{
					return DocumentIndex;
				}
				return PanelIndex;
			}
			internal set
			{
				if (SelectedItems == Panels)
				{
					PanelIndex = value;
				}
				else
				{
					DocumentIndex = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public int BindableDocumentIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(BindableDocumentIndexProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(BindableDocumentIndexProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public int BindablePanelIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(BindablePanelIndexProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(BindablePanelIndexProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public int PanelIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(PanelIndexProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(PanelIndexProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public int DocumentIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(DocumentIndexProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DocumentIndexProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public string PanelsCaption
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(PanelsCaptionProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(PanelsCaptionProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public string DocumentsCaption
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(DocumentsCaptionProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DocumentsCaptionProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public LayoutPanel SelectedItem => (LayoutPanel)GetValue(SelectedItemProperty);

		public bool HasItemsToShow => Panels.Count + Documents.Count > 1;

		public ObservableCollection<LayoutPanel> SelectedItems
		{
			get
			{
				return selectedItemsCore;
			}
			internal set
			{
				selectedItemsCore = value;
			}
		}

		public ObservableCollection<LayoutPanel> Panels { get; internal set; }

		public ObservableCollection<LayoutPanel> Documents { get; internal set; }

		public DocumentSelectorPreview PartDocumentSelectorPreview { get; private set; }

		public DocumentSelectorListBox PartPanelsListBox { get; private set; }

		public DocumentSelectorListBox PartDocumentsListBox { get; private set; }

		public UIElement PartPanelsListBoxCaption { get; private set; }

		public UIElement PartDocumentsListBoxCaption { get; private set; }

		protected internal bool IsCollectionChanging { get; set; }

		protected ThemedWindow WindowContainer { get; set; }

		protected DependencyObject VisualContainer { get; set; }

		private bool IsSelectedItemLocked => selectedItemLock > 0;

		private bool IsDocumentIndexLocked => lockDocumentIndex > 0;

		private bool IsPanelIndexLocked => lockPanelIndex > 0;

		static DocumentSelector()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DocumentSelector> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DocumentSelector>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<DocumentSelector>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("PanelsCaption", ref PanelsCaptionProperty, string.Empty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("DocumentsCaption", ref DocumentsCaptionProperty, string.Empty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("PanelIndex", ref PanelIndexProperty, -1, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DocumentSelector)dObj).OnPanelIndexChanged();
			}, (DependencyObject dObj, object value) => ((DocumentSelector)dObj).CoercePanelIndex(value));
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("DocumentIndex", ref DocumentIndexProperty, -1, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DocumentSelector)dObj).OnDocumentIndexChanged();
			}, (DependencyObject dObj, object value) => ((DocumentSelector)dObj).CoerceDocumentIndex(value));
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly<LayoutPanel>("SelectedItem", ref SelectedItemPropertyKey, ref SelectedItemProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DocumentSelector)dObj).OnSelectedItemChanged((LayoutPanel)e.NewValue);
			}, (DependencyObject dObj, object value) => ((DocumentSelector)dObj).CoerceSelectedItem((LayoutPanel)value));
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("BindableDocumentIndex", ref BindableDocumentIndexProperty, -1, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DocumentSelector)dObj).OnBindableDocumentIndexChanged((int)e.OldValue, (int)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("BindablePanelIndex", ref BindablePanelIndexProperty, -1, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DocumentSelector)dObj).OnBindablePanelIndexChanged((int)e.OldValue, (int)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("IsActive", ref IsActiveProperty, defValue: false, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DocumentSelector)dObj).OnIsActiveChanged((bool)e.OldValue, (bool)e.NewValue);
			});
		}

		public DocumentSelector()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Panels = new ObservableCollection<LayoutPanel>();
			Documents = new ObservableCollection<LayoutPanel>();
			Documents.CollectionChanged += OnDocumentsCollectionChanged;
			Panels.CollectionChanged += OnPanelsCollectionChanged;
			SelectedItems = Documents;
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			Documents.CollectionChanged -= OnDocumentsCollectionChanged;
			Panels.CollectionChanged -= OnPanelsCollectionChanged;
			if (PartPanelsListBox != null)
			{
				PartPanelsListBox.MouseLeftButtonUp -= SelectorListBox_MouseLeftButtonUp;
			}
			if (PartDocumentsListBox != null)
			{
				PartDocumentsListBox.MouseLeftButtonUp -= SelectorListBox_MouseLeftButtonUp;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectedItemChanged(LayoutPanel value)
		{
			if (VisualContainer != null)
			{
				DockLayoutManager.SetLayoutItem(VisualContainer, value);
			}
			DockLayoutManager.SetLayoutItem(this, value);
		}

		protected virtual LayoutPanel CoerceSelectedItem(LayoutPanel value)
		{
			if (SelectedItems == null || SelectedItems.Count == 0 || SelectedIndex == -1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return SelectedItems[SelectedIndex];
		}

		protected virtual void OnBindableDocumentIndexChanged(int oldValue, int newValue)
		{
			if (!IsDocumentIndexLocked && newValue != -1)
			{
				DocumentIndex = newValue;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnBindablePanelIndexChanged(int oldValue, int newValue)
		{
			if (!IsPanelIndexLocked && newValue != -1)
			{
				PanelIndex = newValue;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsActiveChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			try
			{
				selectedItemLock++;
				if (!newValue)
				{
					CloseContainer();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				selectedItemLock--;
			}
		}

		private void OnPanelsCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdatePanelsVisibility();
		}

		private void UpdatePanelsVisibility()
		{
			if (PartPanelsListBoxCaption != null)
			{
				PartPanelsListBoxCaption.Visibility = GetVisibility(Panels);
			}
			if (PartPanelsListBox != null)
			{
				PartPanelsListBox.Visibility = GetVisibility(Panels);
			}
		}

		private void OnDocumentsCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateDocumentsVisibility();
		}

		protected void UpdateDocumentsVisibility()
		{
			if (PartDocumentsListBox != null)
			{
				PartDocumentsListBox.Visibility = GetVisibility(Documents);
			}
			if (PartDocumentsListBoxCaption != null)
			{
				PartDocumentsListBoxCaption.Visibility = GetVisibility(Documents);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnLoaded()
		{
			if (VisualContainer is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
			{
				frameworkElement.PreviewKeyDown -= OnVisualContainerPreviewKeyDown;
				frameworkElement.PreviewKeyDown -= OnVisualContainerPreviewKeyUp;
			}
			ClearValue(IsActiveProperty);
			VisualContainer = LayoutHelper.FindRoot((DependencyObject)this, false);
			if (VisualContainer != null)
			{
				DockLayoutManager.SetLayoutItem(VisualContainer, SelectedItem);
				if (VisualContainer is FrameworkElement frameworkElement2)
				{
					frameworkElement2.PreviewKeyDown += OnVisualContainerPreviewKeyDown;
					frameworkElement2.PreviewKeyUp += OnVisualContainerPreviewKeyUp;
				}
				SetBinding(IsActiveProperty, new Binding
				{
					Path = new PropertyPath(FloatingContainer.IsActiveProperty),
					Source = VisualContainer,
					Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
				});
			}
			DockLayoutManager.SetLayoutItem(this, SelectedItem);
		}

		private void OnVisualContainerPreviewKeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			OnPreviewKeyDownCore(e);
		}

		private void OnVisualContainerPreviewKeyUp(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			OnPreviewKeyUpCore(e);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			keyLeftCtrl = Keyboard.IsKeyDown(Key.LeftCtrl);
			keyRightCtrl = Keyboard.IsKeyDown(Key.RightCtrl);
			Window window = Window.GetWindow(this);
			WindowContainer = (ThemedWindow)(object)((window is ThemedWindow) ? window : null);
			PartDocumentSelectorPreview = GetTemplateChild("PART_DocumentSelectorPreview") as DocumentSelectorPreview;
			PartPanelsListBox = GetTemplateChild("PART_PanelsListBox") as DocumentSelectorListBox;
			if (PartPanelsListBox != null)
			{
				PartPanelsListBox.MouseLeftButtonUp += SelectorListBox_MouseLeftButtonUp;
			}
			PartDocumentsListBox = GetTemplateChild("PART_DocumentsListBox") as DocumentSelectorListBox;
			if (PartDocumentsListBox != null)
			{
				PartDocumentsListBox.MouseLeftButtonUp += SelectorListBox_MouseLeftButtonUp;
			}
			PartPanelsListBoxCaption = GetTemplateChild("PART_PanelsListBoxCaption") as UIElement;
			PartDocumentsListBoxCaption = GetTemplateChild("PART_DocumentsListBoxCaption") as UIElement;
			UpdateDocumentsVisibility();
			UpdatePanelsVisibility();
			SelectContent();
		}

		private static Visibility GetVisibility(ICollection collection)
		{
			if (collection.Count <= 0)
			{
				return Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			return Visibility.Visible;
		}

		private void SelectorListBox_MouseLeftButtonUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			CloseContainer();
		}

		private void CloseContainer()
		{
			if (Locker.op_Implicit(closeLocker))
			{
				return;
			}
			Locker val = closeLocker.Lock();
			try
			{
				BaseLayoutItem selected = SelectedItem;
				ClearValue(DocumentIndexProperty);
				ClearValue(PanelIndexProperty);
				if (PartDocumentSelectorPreview != null)
				{
					PartDocumentSelectorPreview.OnClosing();
				}
				if (WindowContainer != null)
				{
					((UIElement)(object)WindowContainer).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				Documents.Clear();
				Panels.Clear();
				if (!IsSelectedItemLocked)
				{
					base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
					{
						base.Container.Activate(selected);
						base.Container.Update();
					});
				}
				ClearValue(IsActiveProperty);
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public void Close()
		{
			CloseContainer();
		}

		private void OnPreviewKeyUpCore(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if ((e.Key == Key.LeftCtrl && keyLeftCtrl) || (e.Key == Key.RightCtrl && keyRightCtrl))
			{
				CloseContainer();
			}
		}

		private void OnPreviewKeyDownCore(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			keyLeftCtrl = Keyboard.IsKeyDown(Key.LeftCtrl);
			keyRightCtrl = Keyboard.IsKeyDown(Key.RightCtrl);
			if (e.Key == Key.Tab && (Keyboard.Modifiers & (ModifierKeys.Control | ModifierKeys.Shift)) == (ModifierKeys.Control | ModifierKeys.Shift))
			{
				SelectPrevItemWrap();
			}
			else if (e.Key == Key.Tab && (Keyboard.Modifiers & ModifierKeys.Control) == ModifierKeys.Control)
			{
				SelectNextItemWrap();
			}
			else if (e.Key == Key.Up)
			{
				SelectPrevItem();
			}
			else if (e.Key == Key.Down)
			{
				SelectNextItem();
			}
			else if (e.Key == Key.Left || e.Key == Key.Right)
			{
				ToggleActiveItems();
			}
		}

		public void SelectNextItem()
		{
			SelectItemCore(changeCollection: false, isNext: true);
		}

		public void SelectPrevItem()
		{
			SelectItemCore(changeCollection: false, isNext: false);
		}

		public void SelectNextItemWrap()
		{
			SelectItemCore(changeCollection: true, isNext: true);
		}

		public void SelectPrevItemWrap()
		{
			SelectItemCore(changeCollection: true, isNext: false);
		}

		public void ToggleActiveItems()
		{
			ToggleActiveCollectionCore();
		}

		protected internal void SetSelectedItem()
		{
			SelectedItems = ((Documents.Count > 0) ? Documents : Panels);
			SelectActiveItem();
			if (KeyHelper.IsShiftPressed)
			{
				SelectPrevItemWrap();
			}
			else
			{
				SelectNextItemWrap();
			}
		}

		protected internal void InitializeItems(DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			InitializeItemsCore(manager);
		}

		private void InitializeItemsCore(DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			Panels.Clear();
			Documents.Clear();
			CollectItemsByType(manager.GetItems());
		}

		private void SelectActiveItem()
		{
			DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = base.Container ?? DockLayoutManager.Ensure(this);
			if (Panels.Count != 0 || Documents.Count != 0)
			{
				if (Documents.Count > 0)
				{
					DocumentPanel documentPanel = dockLayoutManager.ActiveDockItem as DocumentPanel;
					SelectedIndex = ((documentPanel != null) ? Documents.IndexOf(documentPanel) : 0);
				}
				else if (Panels.Count > 0 && dockLayoutManager.ActiveDockItem is LayoutPanel item)
				{
					SelectedIndex = Panels.IndexOf(item);
				}
				else
				{
					SelectedIndex = 0;
				}
			}
		}

		protected void CollectItemsByType(BaseLayoutItem[] items)
		{
			foreach (BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem in items)
			{
				if (baseLayoutItem is LayoutPanel { IsClosed: false, IsVisibleCore: not false, ShowInDocumentSelector: not false } layoutPanel)
				{
					if (layoutPanel.ItemType == LayoutItemType.Document)
					{
						Documents.Add(layoutPanel);
					}
					else if (layoutPanel.ItemType == LayoutItemType.Panel)
					{
						Panels.Add(layoutPanel);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected void SelectContent()
		{
			if (PartDocumentSelectorPreview != null)
			{
				PartDocumentSelectorPreview.Target = SelectedItem;
			}
		}

		protected internal void SelectItemCore(bool changeCollection, bool isNext)
		{
			if (SelectedItems.Count == 0)
			{
				SelectedIndex = -1;
				return;
			}
			IsCollectionChanging = CalcIsCollectionChanging(changeCollection);
			SelectedIndex += (isNext ? 1 : (-1));
		}

		protected bool CalcIsCollectionChanging(bool isChanging)
		{
			if (isChanging || !NotActiveItemsAreEmpty())
			{
				return isChanging;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected bool NotActiveItemsAreEmpty()
		{
			if (!NotActivePanelsAreEmpty())
			{
				return NotActiveDocumentsAreEmpty();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected bool NotActivePanelsAreEmpty()
		{
			if (SelectedItems == Documents)
			{
				return Panels.Count == 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool NotActiveDocumentsAreEmpty()
		{
			if (SelectedItems == Panels)
			{
				return Documents.Count == 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected void SelectActiveItems(ObservableCollection<LayoutPanel> activeItems)
		{
			if (SelectedItems != activeItems && activeItems.Count != 0)
			{
				SelectActiveItemsIndex(activeItems);
				SelectedItems = activeItems;
			}
		}

		protected void SelectActiveItemsIndex(ObservableCollection<LayoutPanel> activeItems)
		{
			if (activeItems == Documents)
			{
				if (PanelIndex >= Documents.Count)
				{
					PanelIndex = Documents.Count - 1;
				}
				DocumentIndex = PanelIndex;
			}
			else
			{
				if (DocumentIndex >= Panels.Count)
				{
					DocumentIndex = Panels.Count - 1;
				}
				PanelIndex = DocumentIndex;
			}
		}

		protected void ToggleActiveCollectionCore()
		{
			IsCollectionChanging = false;
			SelectActiveItems((SelectedItems == Panels) ? Documents : Panels);
			SelectContent();
		}

		protected void OnPanelIndexChanged()
		{
			OnIndexPropertyChangedCore(isPanelIndex: true);
			try
			{
				lockPanelIndex++;
				BindablePanelIndex = PanelIndex;
			}
			finally
			{
				lockPanelIndex--;
			}
		}

		protected void OnDocumentIndexChanged()
		{
			OnIndexPropertyChangedCore(isPanelIndex: false);
			try
			{
				lockDocumentIndex++;
				BindableDocumentIndex = DocumentIndex;
			}
			finally
			{
				lockDocumentIndex--;
			}
		}

		protected void OnIndexPropertyChangedCore(bool isPanelIndex)
		{
			DependencyProperty dependencyProperty = null;
			if (PanelIndex != -1 || DocumentIndex != -1)
			{
				if (isPanelIndex)
				{
					SelectedItems = ((PanelIndex == -1) ? Documents : Panels);
					dependencyProperty = DocumentIndexProperty;
				}
				else
				{
					SelectedItems = ((DocumentIndex == -1) ? Panels : Documents);
					dependencyProperty = PanelIndexProperty;
				}
			}
			if (PanelIndex != -1 && DocumentIndex != -1 && dependencyProperty != null)
			{
				CoerceValue(dependencyProperty);
			}
			CoerceValue(SelectedItemProperty);
			SelectContent();
		}

		protected object CoercePanelIndex(object baseValue)
		{
			return CoerceIndexCore(isPanel: true, (int)baseValue);
		}

		protected object CoerceDocumentIndex(object baseValue)
		{
			return CoerceIndexCore(isPanel: false, (int)baseValue);
		}

		protected int CoerceIndexCore(bool isPanel, int baseValue)
		{
			if (PanelIndex != -1 && DocumentIndex != -1)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return CalcIndex(isPanel, baseValue);
		}

		protected int CalcIndex(bool isPanel, int baseValue)
		{
			int num = (isPanel ? Panels.Count : Documents.Count);
			if (baseValue >= num)
			{
				return CalcIndexGreaterOrEqual(isPanel);
			}
			if (baseValue < 0)
			{
				return CalcIndexLess(isPanel);
			}
			return baseValue;
		}

		protected int CalcIndexGreaterOrEqual(bool isPanelIndex)
		{
			int num = ((!IsCollectionChanging) ? (-1) : 0);
			if (num == -1)
			{
				AdjustIndex(isPanelIndex, 0);
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected int CalcIndexLess(bool isPanel)
		{
			int num = (isPanel ? (Panels.Count - 1) : (Documents.Count - 1));
			int num2 = (IsCollectionChanging ? num : (-1));
			if (num2 == -1)
			{
				AdjustIndex(isPanel, isPanel ? (Documents.Count - 1) : (Panels.Count - 1));
			}
			return num2;
		}

		protected void AdjustIndex(bool isPanel, int index)
		{
			if (isPanel)
			{
				AdjustDocumentIndex(index);
			}
			else
			{
				AdjustPanelIndex(index);
			}
		}

		protected void AdjustDocumentIndex(int index)
		{
			if (Documents.Count != 0)
			{
				DocumentIndex = index;
			}
		}

		protected void AdjustPanelIndex(int index)
		{
			if (Panels.Count != 0)
			{
				PanelIndex = index;
			}
		}

		public FrameworkElement[] GetChildren()
		{
			return new FrameworkElement[3] { PartPanelsListBox, PartDocumentsListBox, PartDocumentSelectorPreview };
		}
	}

		public static ThemedWindow CreateDocumentSelectorContainer(DockLayoutManager manager, object content)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ThemedWindow val = new ThemedWindow();
			((Window)(object)val).Owner = Window.GetWindow(manager);
			((Window)(object)val).ResizeMode = ResizeMode.NoResize;
			((ContentControl)(object)val).Content = content;
			val.ControlBoxButtonSet = (ControlBoxButtons)0;
			val.ShowIcon = false;
			((DependencyObject)(object)val).SetValue(WindowChrome.CaptionHeightProperty, (object)0.0);
			((Control)(object)val).BorderThickness = new Thickness(0.0);
			((Control)(object)val).Padding = new Thickness(0.0);
			((DependencyObject)content).SetValue(DockLayoutManager.DockLayoutManagerProperty, manager);
			return val;
		}

		public static DataTemplate GetTemplate(DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			DocumentSelectorElementsThemeKeyExtension obj = new DocumentSelectorElementsThemeKeyExtension
			{
				ResourceKey = DocumentSelectorElements.Template
			};
			((ThemeKeyExtensionGeneric)obj).ThemeName = DockLayoutManagerExtension.GetThemeName(manager);
			return ResourceHelper.FindResource((FrameworkElement)manager, (object)obj) as DataTemplate;
		}

		public static Size GetSize(DockLayoutManager manager, Size minSize)
		{
			return new Size(Math.Max(minSize.Width, manager.ActualWidth * 0.6), Math.Max(minSize.Height, manager.ActualHeight * 0.6));
		}

		public static Point GetLocation(DockLayoutManager manager, Size size)
		{
			Point point = new Point((manager.ActualWidth - size.Width) * 0.5, (manager.ActualHeight - size.Height) * 0.5);
			if (manager.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
			{
				point.X += size.Width;
			}
			return ScreenHelper.GetScreenLocation(point, (FrameworkElement)manager, false);
		}
	}

	[DXToolboxBrowsable(false)]
	public class DocumentSelectorListBox : ListBox
	{
		public DocumentSelectorListBox()
		{
			base.Focusable = false;
			base.ItemContainerGenerator.StatusChanged += delegate
			{
				if (base.ItemContainerGenerator.Status == GeneratorStatus.ContainersGenerated)
				{
					FocusContainer(base.SelectedItem);
				}
			};
			base.IsVisibleChanged += delegate(object s, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				if ((bool)e.NewValue)
				{
					base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
					{
						FocusContainer(base.SelectedItem);
					});
				}
			};
		}

		protected override DependencyObject GetContainerForItemOverride()
		{
			return new DocumentSelectorListBoxItem();
		}

		protected override void OnItemsChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnItemsChanged(e);
			if (!base.HasItems)
			{
				ClearAnchorItem();
			}
		}

		private void ClearAnchorItem()
		{
			PropertyInfo property = typeof(ListBox).GetProperty("AnchorItem", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
			if (property != null)
			{
				property.SetValue(this, null, null);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSelectionChanged(SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnSelectionChanged(e);
			FocusContainer(base.SelectedItem);
		}

		private void FocusContainer(object item)
		{
			item.Do(delegate(object x)
			{
				(base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(x) as UIElement).Do(delegate(UIElement y)
				{
					y.Focus();
				});
			});
		}
	}

	[DXToolboxBrowsable(false)]
	public class DocumentSelectorPreview : psvControl
	{
		internal class DetachedElementDecorator : Decorator
		{
			private UIElement childCore;

			public override UIElement Child
			{
				get
				{
					return childCore;
				}
				set
				{
					if (childCore != value)
					{
						if (childCore != null)
						{
							RemoveVisualChild(childCore);
						}
						childCore = value;
						if (childCore != null)
						{
							AddVisualChild(childCore);
						}
					}
				}
			}

			protected override int VisualChildrenCount
			{
				get
				{
					if (childCore != null)
					{
						return 1;
					}
					return 0;
				}
			}

			public DetachedElementDecorator()
			{
				base.InheritanceBehavior = InheritanceBehavior.SkipToAppNow;
			}

			protected override Visual GetVisualChild(int index)
			{
				return childCore;
			}

			protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size constraint)
			{
				return base.MeasureOverride(IsInfiniteSize(constraint) ? new Size(1000.0, 1000.0) : constraint);
			}

			private static bool IsInfiniteSize(Size size)
			{
				if (double.IsPositiveInfinity(size.Width))
				{
					return double.IsPositiveInfinity(size.Height);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public static readonly DependencyProperty TargetProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey PreviewBrushPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PreviewBrushProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey PreviewWidthPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PreviewWidthProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey PreviewHeightPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PreviewHeightProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey CutHorizontalPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty CutHorizontalProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey CutVerticalPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty CutVerticalProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey BorderTemplatePropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty BorderTemplateProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DocumentBorderTemplateProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PanelBorderTemplateProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsInPreviewProperty;

		private DetachedElementDecorator detachedElementDecoratorCore;

		private Dictionary<BaseLayoutItem, FrameworkElement> elementCache = new Dictionary<BaseLayoutItem, FrameworkElement>(4);

		public LayoutPanel Target

		static DocumentSelectorPreview()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DocumentSelectorPreview> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DocumentSelectorPreview>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<DocumentSelectorPreview>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<LayoutPanel>("Target", ref TargetProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DocumentSelectorPreview)dObj).OnTargetChanged((LayoutPanel)e.OldValue, (LayoutPanel)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly<VisualBrush>("PreviewBrush", ref PreviewBrushPropertyKey, ref PreviewBrushProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("PreviewWidth", ref PreviewWidthPropertyKey, ref PreviewWidthProperty, 150.0);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("PreviewHeight", ref PreviewHeightPropertyKey, ref PreviewHeightProperty, 250.0);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("CutHorizontal", ref CutHorizontalPropertyKey, ref CutHorizontalProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("CutVertical", ref CutVerticalPropertyKey, ref CutVerticalProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly<DataTemplate>("BorderTemplate", ref BorderTemplatePropertyKey, ref BorderTemplateProperty, null, null, (DependencyObject dObj, object value) => ((DocumentSelectorPreview)dObj).CoerceBorderTemplate((DataTemplate)value));
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplate>("DocumentBorderTemplate", ref DocumentBorderTemplateProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplate>("PanelBorderTemplate", ref PanelBorderTemplateProperty);
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DocumentSelectorPreview>.New().RegisterAttached<DependencyObject, bool>("GetIsInPreview", ref IsInPreviewProperty, false, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits);
		}

		public static bool GetIsInPreview(DependencyObject target)
		{
			return (bool)target.GetValue(IsInPreviewProperty);
		}

		public static void SetIsInPreview(DependencyObject target, bool value)
		{
			target.SetValue(IsInPreviewProperty, value);
		}

		public DocumentSelectorPreview()
		{
			PreviewBrush = new VisualBrush
			{
				AlignmentX = AlignmentX.Left,
				AlignmentY = AlignmentY.Top,
				Stretch = Stretch.None
			};
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			PartPreview = GetTemplateChild("PART_Preview") as Border;
			if (PartPreview != null)
			{
				PartPreview.FlowDirection = FlowDirection.LeftToRight;
			}
			PartView = GetTemplateChild("PART_View") as FrameworkElement;
			UpdateCut();
		}

		protected virtual DataTemplate CoerceBorderTemplate(DataTemplate value)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem target = Target;
			if (target == null)
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (target.ItemType != LayoutItemType.Document)
			{
				return PanelBorderTemplate;
			}
			return DocumentBorderTemplate;
		}

		protected virtual void OnTargetChanged(LayoutPanel oldTarget, LayoutPanel target)
		{
			if (oldTarget != null)
			{
				SetIsInPreview(oldTarget, value: false);
			}
			if (target != null)
			{
				SetIsInPreview(target, value: true);
			}
			CoerceValue(BorderTemplateProperty);
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = null;
			if (target != null)
			{
				frameworkElement = GetPreviewElement(target);
				if (frameworkElement != null)
				{
					if (!frameworkElement.IsMeasureValid)
					{
						frameworkElement.Measure(new Size(1000.0, 1000.0));
					}
					if (!frameworkElement.IsArrangeValid)
					{
						frameworkElement.Arrange(new Rect(default(Point), new Size(1000.0, 1000.0)));
					}
					PreviewWidth = Math.Max(48.0, Math.Max(frameworkElement.DesiredSize.Width, frameworkElement.ActualWidth));
					PreviewHeight = Math.Max(48.0, Math.Max(frameworkElement.DesiredSize.Height, frameworkElement.ActualHeight));
					UpdateCut();
				}
			}
			if (frameworkElement == null)
			{
				frameworkElement = new TextBlock
				{
					Text = "Preview unavailable",
					HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Center,
					VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center
				};
				ClearValue(PreviewWidthPropertyKey);
				ClearValue(PreviewHeightPropertyKey);
				ClearValue(CutHorizontalPropertyKey);
				ClearValue(CutVerticalPropertyKey);
			}
			if (detachedElementDecoratorCore != null)
			{
				detachedElementDecoratorCore.Child = null;
			}
			if (VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(frameworkElement) == null)
			{
				if (PartPreview != null)
				{
					PartPreview.FlowDirection = FlowDirection.LeftToRight;
				}
				detachedElementDecoratorCore = new DetachedElementDecorator
				{
					Width = PreviewWidth,
					Height = PreviewHeight
				};
				detachedElementDecoratorCore.Child = frameworkElement;
				PreviewBrush.Visual = detachedElementDecoratorCore;
			}
			else
			{
				if (PartPreview != null)
				{
					PartPreview.FlowDirection = base.FlowDirection;
				}
				PreviewBrush.Visual = frameworkElement;
			}
			InvalidateMeasure();
			UpdateLayout();
		}

		private FrameworkElement GetPreviewElement(LayoutPanel item)
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = item.ContentPresenter as FrameworkElement;
			if (frameworkElement == null)
			{
				if (elementCache.ContainsKey(item))
				{
					frameworkElement = elementCache[item];
				}
				else
				{
					frameworkElement = new ContentPresenter
					{
						Content = item.Content,
						ContentTemplate = item.ContentTemplate,
						ContentTemplateSelector = item.ContentTemplateSelector
					};
					AddLogicalChild(frameworkElement);
					elementCache.Add(item, frameworkElement);
				}
			}
			return frameworkElement;
		}

		internal void OnClosing()
		{
			if (detachedElementDecoratorCore != null)
			{
				detachedElementDecoratorCore.Child = null;
			}
			elementCache.Clear();
		}

		private void UpdateCut()
		{
			if (PartView != null)
			{
				CutHorizontal = PreviewWidth > PartView.ActualWidth;
				CutVertical = PreviewHeight > PartView.ActualHeight;
			}
		}
	}

		private static bool CalcAllowDrop(bool? value)
		{

				return value.Value;
			}

		}

			((BarContainerControl)this).OnApplyTemplate();

		protected virtual void OnLayoutItemChanged(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				BindingHelper.SetBinding((DependencyObject)(object)this, BindableAllowDropProperty, item, "HeaderBarContainerControlAllowDrop");
				BindingHelper.SetBinding((DependencyObject)(object)this, BindableNameProperty, item, "HeaderBarContainerControlName");
			}
			else
			{
				BindingHelper.ClearBinding((DependencyObject)(object)this, BindableAllowDropProperty);
				BindingHelper.ClearBinding((DependencyObject)(object)this, BindableNameProperty);
			}
		}
	}
	[DXToolboxBrowsable(false)]
	public abstract class BaseHeadersPanel : psvPanel

		private class Interval : Tuple<double, double>
		{
			public double Start => base.Item1;

			public double End => Start + Length;

			public double Length => base.Item2;

			[Obsolete("Use Start property instead")]
			public new double Item1 { get; set; }

			[Obsolete("Use Length property instead")]
			public new double Item2 { get; set; }

			public Interval(double start, double length)
				: base(start, length)
			{
			}
		}

		private class OrientationHelper
		{
			private static readonly OrientationHelper Vertical = new OrientationHelper
			{
				IsHorz = false
			};

			private static readonly OrientationHelper Horizontal = new OrientationHelper
			{
				IsHorz = true
			};

			public bool IsHorz { get; private set; }

			private OrientationHelper()
			{
			}

			public static OrientationHelper GetInstance(bool horz)
			{
				if (!horz)
				{
					return Vertical;
				}
				return Horizontal;
			}

			public double GetLength(Rect rect)
			{
				return TabHeaderHelper.GetLength(IsHorz, rect);
			}

			public double GetLength(Size size)
			{
				return TabHeaderHelper.GetLength(IsHorz, size);
			}

			public double GetValue(Point point)
			{
				if (!IsHorz)
				{
					return point.Y;
				}
				return point.X;
			}

			public Size GetSize(double length, double dim)
			{
				return TabHeaderHelper.GetSize(IsHorz, length, dim);
			}

			public Point GetPoint(double x, double y)
			{
				if (!IsHorz)
				{
					return new Point(y, x);
				}
				return new Point(x, y);
			}

			public double GetDim(Size size)
			{
				if (!IsHorz)
				{
					return size.Width;
				}
				return size.Height;
			}
		}
