		internal bool AllowAnimation { get; set; }

		protected virtual bool StretchItems => false;

		private OrientationHelper _OrientationHelper => OrientationHelper.GetInstance(IsHorizontal);

		static BaseHeadersPanel()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<BaseHeadersPanel> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<BaseHeadersPanel>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideMetadataNotDataBindable(Panel.IsItemsHostProperty, defValue: true);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ClipMargin", ref ClipMarginProperty, new Thickness(0.0, -2.0, 0.0, -2.0), FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsArrange);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("Orientation", ref OrientationProperty, Orientation.Horizontal, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((BaseHeadersPanel)dObj).OnOrientationChanged((Orientation)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("TabHeaderLayoutType", ref TabHeaderLayoutTypeProperty, TabHeaderLayoutType.Default, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((BaseHeadersPanel)dObj).OnTabHeaderLayoutChanged((TabHeaderLayoutType)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("IsAutoFillHeaders", ref IsAutoFillHeadersProperty, defValue: false, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((BaseHeadersPanel)dObj).OnIsAutoFillHeadersChanged((bool)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ScrollOffset", ref ScrollOffsetProperty, 0.0, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((BaseHeadersPanel)dObj).OnScrollOffsetChanged((double)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ScrollIndex", ref ScrollIndexProperty, 0, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((BaseHeadersPanel)dObj).OnScrollIndexChanged((int)e.NewValue, (int)e.OldValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("SelectedIndex", ref SelectedIndexProperty, -1, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((BaseHeadersPanel)dObj).OnSelectedIndexChanged((int)e.NewValue, (int)e.OldValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("TransparencySize", ref TransparencySizeProperty, 7.0);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("FixedMultiLineTabHeaders", ref FixedMultiLineTabHeadersProperty, defValue: false, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((BaseHeadersPanel)dObj).OnFixedMultiLineTabHeadersChanged((bool)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("AutoScrollOnOverflow", ref AutoScrollOnOverflowProperty, AutoScrollOnOverflow.AnyItem);
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<BaseHeadersPanel>.New().AddOwner<BaseLayoutItem>(ref LayoutItemProperty, DockLayoutManager.LayoutItemProperty, (BaseLayoutItem)null, (Action<BaseHeadersPanel, BaseLayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem>)delegate(BaseHeadersPanel d, BaseLayoutItem oldValue, BaseLayoutItem newValue)
			{
				d.OnLayoutItemChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			});
		}

		public BaseHeadersPanel()
		{
			DockPane.SetHitTestType(this, HitTestType.PageHeaders);
		}

		protected virtual void OnFixedMultiLineTabHeadersChanged(bool newValue)
		{
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		protected virtual void OnScrollOffsetChanged(double scrollOffset)
		{
			InvalidateArrange();
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsAutoFillHeadersChanged(bool isAutoFill)
		{
			InvalidateMeasure();
			InvalidateArrange();
		}

		protected virtual void OnLayoutItemChanged(BaseLayoutItem oldValue, BaseLayoutItem newValue)
		{
			(ItemsControl.GetItemsOwner(this) as psvItemsControl)?.EnsureItemsPanel();
		}

		protected virtual void OnTabHeaderLayoutChanged(TabHeaderLayoutType type)
		{
			InvalidateMeasure();
			InvalidateArrange();
		}

		protected virtual void OnOrientationChanged(Orientation orientation)
		{
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		protected virtual void OnScrollIndexChanged(int index, int oldIndex)
		{
			canAnimate = true;
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectedIndexChanged(int index, int oldIndex)
		{
			if (CanEnsureTabHeaderScrollIndex() && DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(this) is LayoutGroup layoutGroup)
			{
				BaseLayoutItem item;
				if (AutoScrollOnOverflow == AutoScrollOnOverflow.AnyItem)
				{
					item = layoutGroup.ItemFromIndex(index);
				}
				else
				{
					ITabHeader tabHeader = base.InternalChildren[SelectedIndex] as ITabHeader;
					int tabIndex = ((tabHeader.ScrollIndex < 0) ? index : tabHeader.ScrollIndex);
					item = layoutGroup.ItemFromTabIndex(tabIndex);
				}
				layoutGroup.EnsureTabHeaderScrollIndex(item);
			}
		}

		protected virtual ITabHeaderLayoutCalculator GetCalculator(TabHeaderLayoutType type)
		{
			return HeaderLayoutCalculatorFactory.GetCalculator(type);
		}

		protected virtual ITabHeaderLayoutOptions GetOptions(Size availableSize)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem layoutItem = DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(this);
			bool selectedRowFirst = layoutItem != null && (layoutItem.CaptionLocation == CaptionLocation.Right || layoutItem.CaptionLocation == CaptionLocation.Bottom);
			return new TabHeaderOptions(availableSize, IsHorizontal, IsAutoFillHeaders, ScrollIndex, selectedRowFirst, FixedMultiLineTabHeaders, offset);
		}

		protected override void OnActualSizeChanged(Size value)
		{
			base.OnActualSizeChanged(value);
			if (CanEnsureTabHeaderScrollIndex() && DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(this) is LayoutGroup layoutGroup)
			{
				layoutGroup.EnsureTabHeaderScrollIndex(layoutGroup.SelectedItem);
			}
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
		{
			base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
			ITabHeaderLayoutCalculator calculator = GetCalculator(TabHeaderLayoutType);
			ITabHeaderLayoutOptions options = GetOptions(availableSize);
			ITabHeaderLayoutResult tabHeaderLayoutResult = Measure(calculator, options);
			LayoutGroup layoutGroup = DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(this) as LayoutGroup;
			hasScroll = false;
			if (layoutGroup != null && !tabHeaderLayoutResult.IsEmpty)
			{
				bool flag = (layoutGroup.TabHeaderHasScroll = tabHeaderLayoutResult.HasScroll);
				hasScroll = flag;
				if (tabHeaderLayoutResult.HasScroll)
				{
					layoutGroup.TabHeaderMaxScrollIndex = tabHeaderLayoutResult.ScrollResult.MaxIndex;
					layoutGroup.TabHeaderScrollIndex = tabHeaderLayoutResult.ScrollResult.Index;
					layoutGroup.TabHeaderCanScrollPrev = tabHeaderLayoutResult.ScrollResult.CanScrollPrev;
					layoutGroup.TabHeaderCanScrollNext = tabHeaderLayoutResult.ScrollResult.CanScrollNext;
					offset -= tabHeaderLayoutResult.ScrollResult.ScrollOffset;
					if (AllowAnimation && canAnimate)
					{
						canAnimate = false;
						StartScrollAnimation(tabHeaderLayoutResult, layoutGroup);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					offset = 0.0;
					layoutGroup.TabHeaderScrollIndex = -1;
				}
			}
			return tabHeaderLayoutResult.Size;
		}

		protected virtual ITabHeaderLayoutResult Measure(ITabHeaderLayoutCalculator calculator, ITabHeaderLayoutOptions options)
		{
			return HeadersPanelHelper.Measure(base.InternalChildren, calculator, options);
		}

		protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size finalSize)
		{
			bool isHorizontal = IsHorizontal;
			foreach (UIElement internalChild in base.InternalChildren)
			{
				if (!(internalChild is ITabHeader { ArrangeRect: var arrangeRect } tabHeader))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (!arrangeRect.IsEmpty)
				{
					if (!tabHeader.IsPinned)
					{
						RectHelper.Offset(ref arrangeRect, isHorizontal ? ScrollOffset : 0.0, isHorizontal ? 0.0 : ScrollOffset);
					}
					if (StretchItems)
					{
						if (isHorizontal)
						{
							arrangeRect.Height = finalSize.Height;
						}
						else
						{
							arrangeRect.Width = finalSize.Width;
						}
					}
					internalChild.Arrange(arrangeRect);
				}
				else
				{
					internalChild.Arrange(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0));
				}
			}
			UpdateOpacityMask(finalSize);
			return finalSize;
		}

		private bool CanEnsureTabHeaderScrollIndex()
		{
			if (base.InternalChildren.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (SelectedIndex < 0 || SelectedIndex > base.InternalChildren.Count - 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.InternalChildren[SelectedIndex] is ITabHeader tabHeader)
			{
				return !tabHeader.IsPinned;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetOpacityMask(UIElement element)
		{
			element.OpacityMask = null;
			element.Opacity = 1.0;
			element.IsHitTestVisible = true;
		}

		private void UpdateOpacityMask(Size finalSize)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			OrientationHelper orientationHelper = _OrientationHelper;
			double num3 = orientationHelper.GetLength(finalSize);
			foreach (UIElement internalChild in base.InternalChildren)
			{
				ResetOpacityMask(internalChild);
				if (internalChild is ITabHeader { IsPinned: not false, ArrangeRect: { IsEmpty: false } arrangeRect } tabHeader)
				{
					double length = orientationHelper.GetLength(arrangeRect);
					if (tabHeader.PinLocation == TabHeaderPinLocation.Far)
					{
						num3 = Math.Min(num3, orientationHelper.GetValue(arrangeRect.Location));
					}
					else
					{
						num2 = Math.Max(num2, orientationHelper.GetValue(arrangeRect.BottomRight));
					}
					num += length;
				}
			}
			if (num > 0.0 && hasScroll)
			{
				Point point = orientationHelper.GetPoint(num2, 0.0);
				Size size = orientationHelper.GetSize(((num3 > num2) ? num3 : orientationHelper.GetLength(finalSize)) - num2, orientationHelper.GetDim(finalSize));
				Rect available = new Rect(point, size);
				UpdateOpacityMask(available);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateOpacityMask(Rect available)
		{
			bool isHorizontal = IsHorizontal;
			OrientationHelper orientationHelper = _OrientationHelper;
			foreach (UIElement internalChild in base.InternalChildren)
			{
				if (!(internalChild is ITabHeader { ArrangeRect: { IsEmpty: false } arrangeRect, IsPinned: false }))
				{
					continue;
				}
				RectHelper.Offset(ref arrangeRect, IsHorizontal ? ScrollOffset : 0.0, isHorizontal ? 0.0 : ScrollOffset);
				Rect rect = Rect.Intersect(arrangeRect, available);
				Interval interval = new Interval(orientationHelper.GetValue(rect.Location), orientationHelper.GetLength(rect));
				Interval interval2 = new Interval(orientationHelper.GetValue(arrangeRect.Location), orientationHelper.GetLength(arrangeRect));
				double length = interval2.Length;
				if (interval.Length == length)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (rect.IsEmpty || interval.Length < TransparencySize)
				{
					internalChild.Opacity = 0.0;
					internalChild.IsHitTestVisible = false;
					continue;
				}
				Interval interval3 = new Interval(0.0, interval.Start - interval2.Start);
				Interval interval4 = new Interval(interval3.End, TransparencySize);
				Interval interval5 = new Interval(interval.End - interval2.Start, interval2.End - interval.End);
				Interval interval6 = new Interval(interval5.Start - TransparencySize, TransparencySize);
				LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush
				{
					StartPoint = orientationHelper.GetPoint(0.0, 0.5),
					EndPoint = orientationHelper.GetPoint(1.0, 0.5)
				};
				if (interval.Start != interval2.Start)
				{
					linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(Colors.Transparent, 0.0));
					linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(Colors.Transparent, interval3.Length / length));
				}
				linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(Colors.Black, (interval3.Length + interval4.Length) / length));
				if (interval.End != interval2.End)
				{
					linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(Colors.Black, interval6.Start / length));
					linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(Colors.Transparent, interval6.End / length));
					linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(Colors.Transparent, 1.0));
				}
				internalChild.OpacityMask = linearGradientBrush;
			}
		}

		private void StartScrollAnimation(ITabHeaderLayoutResult result, LayoutGroup group)
		{
			if (lockStartAnimation <= 0)
			{
				lockStartAnimation++;
				group.IsAnimated = true;
				ScrollAnimation = new DoubleAnimation
				{
					From = result.ScrollResult.ScrollOffset,
					To = 0.0,
					Duration = new Duration(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(150.0))
				};
				ScrollAnimation.Completed += OnScrollAnimationCompleted;
				BeginAnimation(ScrollOffsetProperty, ScrollAnimation);
			}
		}

		private void OnScrollAnimationCompleted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ScrollAnimation.Completed -= OnScrollAnimationCompleted;
			ScrollAnimation = null;
			if (DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(this) is LayoutGroup layoutGroup)
			{
				layoutGroup.IsAnimated = false;
			}
			lockStartAnimation--;
		}

		protected override Geometry GetLayoutClip(Size layoutSlotSize)
		{
			Thickness clipMargin = GetClipMargin();
			Rect rect = new Rect(clipMargin.Left, clipMargin.Top, layoutSlotSize.Width - (clipMargin.Left + clipMargin.Right), layoutSlotSize.Height - (clipMargin.Top + clipMargin.Bottom));
			return new RectangleGeometry
			{
				Rect = rect
			};
		}

		protected virtual Thickness GetClipMargin()
		{
			return ThicknessHelper.Multiply(ClipMargin, ScreenHelper.DpiThicknessCorrection);
		}

		public static void Invalidate(DependencyObject dObj)
		{
			BaseHeadersPanel baseHeadersPanel = dObj as BaseHeadersPanel;
			if (baseHeadersPanel == null && dObj != null)
			{
				baseHeadersPanel = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<BaseHeadersPanel>(dObj);
			}
			baseHeadersPanel?.InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return (AutomationPeer)(object)new BaseHeadersPanelAutomationPeer(this);
		}
	}
	public interface ITabHeader
	{
		Rect ArrangeRect { get; }

		bool IsPinned { get; }

		TabHeaderPinLocation PinLocation { get; }

		int ScrollIndex { get; }

		ITabHeaderInfo CreateInfo(Size size);

		void Apply(ITabHeaderInfo info);
	}
	public class TabHeaderOptions : ITabHeaderLayoutOptions
	{
		public Size Size { get; }

		public bool IsHorizontal { get; }

		public bool IsAutoFill { get; }

		public bool SelectedRowFirst { get; }

		public int ScrollIndex { get; }

		public bool FixedRows { get; }

		public double Offset { get; }

		public TabHeaderOptions(Size size, bool horz, bool autoFill, int scrolIndex, bool selectedRowFirst, bool fixedRows, double offset)
		{
			Size = size;
			IsHorizontal = horz;
			IsAutoFill = autoFill;
			ScrollIndex = scrolIndex;
			SelectedRowFirst = selectedRowFirst;
			FixedRows = fixedRows;
			Offset = offset;
		}
	}
	public static class HeadersPanelHelper
	{
		public static ITabHeaderLayoutResult Measure(UIElementCollection children, ITabHeaderLayoutCalculator calculator, ITabHeaderLayoutOptions options)
		{
			Size size = (options.IsHorizontal ? new Size(options.Size.Width, double.PositiveInfinity) : new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, options.Size.Height));
			ITabHeaderInfo[] headerInfos = GetHeaderInfos(children, size);
			ITabHeaderLayoutResult result = calculator.Calc(headerInfos, options);
			ApplyMeasure(headerInfos);
			return result;
		}

		private static ITabHeaderInfo[] GetHeaderInfos(UIElementCollection children, Size size)
		{
			List<ITabHeaderInfo> list = new List<ITabHeaderInfo>(children.Count);
			foreach (UIElement child in children)
			{
				ITabHeaderInfo tabHeaderInfo = ((ITabHeader)child).CreateInfo(size);
				if (tabHeaderInfo != null)
				{
					list.Add(tabHeaderInfo);
				}
			}
			list.Sort(Compare);
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private static int Compare(ITabHeaderInfo info1, ITabHeaderInfo info2)
		{
			if (info1 == info2)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return ((BaseHeaderInfo)info1).Index.CompareTo(((BaseHeaderInfo)info2).Index);
		}

		private static void ApplyMeasure(ITabHeaderInfo[] headers)
		{
			foreach (ITabHeaderInfo tabHeaderInfo in headers)
			{
				if (tabHeaderInfo.TabHeader is ITabHeader tabHeader)
				{
					tabHeader.Apply(tabHeaderInfo);
				}
			}
		}

		public static Orientation GetOrientation(CaptionLocation captionLocation)
		{
			if (captionLocation == CaptionLocation.Left || captionLocation == CaptionLocation.Right)
			{
				return Orientation.Vertical;
			}
			return Orientation.Horizontal;
		}
	}
	public class BaseHeaderInfo : ITabHeaderInfo
	{
		public int Index { get; private set; }

		public object TabHeader { get; private set; }

		public Rect Rect { get; set; }

		public bool IsVisible { get; set; }

		public bool IsSelected { get; set; }

		public bool ShowCaption { get; set; }

		public bool ShowCaptionImage { get; set; }

		public int ZIndex { get; set; }

		public Size DesiredSize { get; private set; }

		public Size CaptionImage { get; private set; }

		public Size CaptionText { get; private set; }

		public Size ControlBox { get; private set; }

		public double CaptionImageToCaptionDistance { get; private set; }

		public double CaptionToControlBoxDistance { get; private set; }

		public TabHeaderPinLocation PinLocation { get; private set; }

		public bool IsPinned { get; private set; }

		public int ScrollIndex { get; set; }

		public IMultiLineLayoutResult MultiLineResult { get; set; }

		public BaseHeaderInfo(UIElement tabHeader, FrameworkElement caption, bool isCaptionHorz, BaseControlBoxControl controlBox, bool selected, TabHeaderPinLocation pinLocation, bool isPinned)
		{
			TabHeader = tabHeader;
			BaseLayoutItem layoutItem = DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(tabHeader);
			LayoutGroup layoutGroup = layoutItem.Parent ?? (LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(layoutItem) as LayoutGroup);
			if (layoutGroup != null)
			{
				Index = layoutGroup.TabIndexFromItem(layoutItem);
			}
			DesiredSize = tabHeader.DesiredSize;
			CaptionControl captionControl = caption as CaptionControl;
			if (caption != null)
			{
				if (captionControl != null)
				{
					if (captionControl.PartText != null)
					{
						CaptionText = captionControl.PartText.DesiredSize;
					}
					if (captionControl.PartImage != null)
					{
						CaptionImage = captionControl.PartImage.DesiredSize;
					}
					if (captionControl.PartSpace != null)
					{
						CaptionImageToCaptionDistance = captionControl.PartSpace.Width.Value;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					CaptionText = caption.DesiredSize;
				}
			}
			if (controlBox != null)
			{
				ControlBox = controlBox.DesiredSize;
				CaptionToControlBoxDistance = 0.0;
			}
			IsSelected = selected;
			if (!isCaptionHorz)
			{
				CaptionText = new Size(CaptionText.Height, CaptionText.Width);
				CaptionImage = new Size(CaptionImage.Height, CaptionImage.Width);
			}
			if (caption != null && caption.IsVisible && captionControl == null)
			{
				DesiredSize = MathHelper.MeasureMinSize(new Size[2] { DesiredSize, CaptionText });
			}
			PinLocation = pinLocation;
			IsPinned = isPinned;
		}

		public BaseHeaderInfo(UIElement tabHeader, FrameworkElement caption, BaseControlBoxControl controlBox, bool selected)
			: this(tabHeader, caption, isCaptionHorz: true, controlBox, selected, TabHeaderPinLocation.Default, isPinned: false)
		{
		}
	}
	internal class VisualStateController : VisualStateControllerBase<FrameworkElement>, IDisposable
	{
		public const string NormalState = "Normal";

		public const string PressedState = "Pressed";

		public const string MouseOverState = "MouseOver";

		public const string DisabledState = "Disabled";

		public static readonly DependencyProperty VisualStateControllerProperty;

		private List<FrameworkElement> VisualChildren = new List<FrameworkElement>();

		static VisualStateController()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<VisualStateController> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<VisualStateController>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterAttached<VisualStateController>("VisualStateController", ref VisualStateControllerProperty);
		}

		public VisualStateController(FrameworkElement owner)
		{
			Attach(owner);
		}

		protected override void OnAttached()
		{
			base.OnAttached();
			SetIsEnabled(base.Owner.IsEnabled);
			VisualChildren.Add(base.Owner);
		}

		protected override void Subscribe()
		{
			base.Subscribe();
			base.Owner.IsEnabledChanged += owner_IsEnabledChanged;
		}

		protected override void Unsubscribe()
		{
			base.Owner.IsEnabledChanged -= owner_IsEnabledChanged;
			base.Unsubscribe();
		}

		private void owner_IsEnabledChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			SetIsEnabled((bool)e.NewValue);
			UpdateVisualState(useTransitions: true);
		}

		public void UpdateState()
		{
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected override void UpdateVisualState(bool useTransitions = false)
		{
			foreach (FrameworkElement visualChild in VisualChildren)
			{
				UpdateChildVisualState(visualChild, useTransitions);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateChildVisualState(FrameworkElement child, bool useTransitions)
		{
			if (child is ISupportVisualStates supportVisualStates)
			{
				supportVisualStates.UpdateVisualState();
			}
			if (base.IsEnabled)
			{
				UpdateVisualStateCore(child, "Normal", useTransitions);
				if (base.IsMousePressed)
				{
					UpdateVisualStateCore(child, "Pressed", useTransitions);
				}
				else if (base.IsMouseOver)
				{
					UpdateVisualStateCore(child, "MouseOver", useTransitions);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateVisualStateCore(child, "Disabled", useTransitions: false);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateVisualStateCore(FrameworkElement child, string stateName, bool useTransitions)
		{
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(child, stateName, useTransitions);
		}

		internal void Add(FrameworkElement child)
		{
			VisualChildren.Add(child);
		}

		internal void Remove(FrameworkElement child)
		{
			VisualChildren.Remove(child);
		}

		void IDisposable.Dispose()
		{
			VisualChildren.Clear();
		}
	}
	internal class VisualStateControllerBase<T> where T : FrameworkElement
	{
		protected T Owner { get; private set; }

		protected bool IsMousePressed { get; private set; }

		protected bool IsMouseOver { get; private set; }

		protected bool IsEnabled { get; private set; }

		protected void SetIsEnabled(bool isEnabled)
		{
			IsEnabled = isEnabled;
		}

		protected void Detach(T owner)
		{
			Unsubscribe();
			Owner = null;
		}

		protected void Attach(T owner)
		{
			Owner = owner;
			Subscribe();
			OnAttached();
		}

		protected virtual void OnAttached()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void Unsubscribe()
		{
			Owner.MouseEnter -= owner_MouseEnter;
			Owner.MouseLeave -= owner_MouseLeave;
			Owner.MouseLeftButtonDown -= owner_MouseLeftButtonDown;
			Owner.MouseLeftButtonUp -= owner_MouseLeftButtonUp;
			Owner.LostMouseCapture -= Owner_LostMouseCapture;
			Owner.Loaded -= owner_Loaded;
		}

		protected virtual void Subscribe()
		{
			Owner.MouseEnter += owner_MouseEnter;
			Owner.MouseLeave += owner_MouseLeave;
			Owner.MouseLeftButtonDown += owner_MouseLeftButtonDown;
			Owner.MouseLeftButtonUp += owner_MouseLeftButtonUp;
			Owner.LostMouseCapture += Owner_LostMouseCapture;
			Owner.Loaded += owner_Loaded;
		}

		private void owner_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		private void Owner_LostMouseCapture(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!Owner.IsMouseOver)
			{
				IsMouseOver = false;
			}
			IsMousePressed = false;
			UpdateVisualState(useTransitions: true);
		}

		private void owner_MouseLeftButtonUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			Owner.ReleaseMouseCapture();
			IsMousePressed = false;
			UpdateVisualState(useTransitions: true);
		}

		private void owner_MouseLeftButtonDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			IsMousePressed = true;
			Owner.CaptureMouse();
			UpdateVisualState(useTransitions: true);
		}

		private void owner_MouseLeave(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			IsMouseOver = false;
			UpdateVisualState(useTransitions: true);
		}

		private void owner_MouseEnter(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			IsMouseOver = true;
			UpdateVisualState(useTransitions: true);
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateVisualState(bool useTransitions = false)
		{
		}
	}
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_SplitThumb", Type = typeof(UIElement))]
	public class BaseSplitterControl : BaseSplitterItem
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsDragDropOverProperty;

		protected double SplitterWidth;

		protected double SplitterHeight;

		protected UIElement PartSplitThumb { get; private set; }

		public bool IsDragDropOver
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsDragDropOverProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsDragDropOverProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static BaseSplitterControl()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<BaseSplitterControl> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<BaseSplitterControl>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("IsDragDropOver", ref IsDragDropOverProperty, defValue: false);
		}

		public override void Deactivate()
		{
			DockLayoutManager.Release(this);
			base.Deactivate();
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			PartSplitThumb = GetTemplateChild("PART_SplitThumb") as UIElement;
		}

		public void InitSplitThumb(bool horizontal)
		{
			if (PartSplitThumb != null)
			{
				PartSplitThumb.SetValue(horizontal ? FrameworkElement.WidthProperty : FrameworkElement.HeightProperty, horizontal ? SplitterWidth : SplitterHeight);
				PartSplitThumb.ClearValue(horizontal ? FrameworkElement.HeightProperty : FrameworkElement.WidthProperty);
			}
		}

		public BaseSplitterControl(LayoutGroup group)
		{
			base.LayoutGroup = group;
			Panel.SetZIndex(this, 1);
			SplitterWidth = DockLayoutManagerParameters.DockingItemIntervalHorz;
			SplitterHeight = DockLayoutManagerParameters.DockingItemIntervalVert;
		}
	}
	public class Splitter : BaseSplitterControl, IUIElement
	{
		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty DockLayoutManagerProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ViewStyleProperty;

		public DockingViewStyle ViewStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return (DockingViewStyle)GetValue(ViewStyleProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ViewStyleProperty, value);
			}
		}

		IUIElement IUIElement.Scope => DockLayoutManager.GetUIScope(this);

		UIChildren IUIElement.Children => null;

		static Splitter()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<Splitter>();
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<Splitter>.New().AddOwner<DockLayoutManager>(ref DockLayoutManagerProperty, DockLayoutManager.DockLayoutManagerProperty, (DockLayoutManager)null, (Action<Splitter, DockLayoutManager, DockLayoutManager>)delegate(Splitter d, DockLayoutManager oldValue, DockLayoutManager newValue)
			{
				d.OnDockLayoutManagerChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			}).Register<DockingViewStyle>("ViewStyle", ref ViewStyleProperty, DockingViewStyle.Default, (Func<Splitter, DockingViewStyle, DockingViewStyle>)((Splitter d, DockingViewStyle value) => d.OnCoerceDockingViewStyle(value)), (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		public Splitter(LayoutGroup group)
			: base(group)
		{
		}

		protected virtual DockingViewStyle OnCoerceDockingViewStyle(DockingViewStyle viewStyle)
		{
			if (!base.LayoutGroup.Items.ContainsLayoutControlItemOrGroup())
			{
				return viewStyle;
			}
			return DockingViewStyle.Default;
		}

		protected virtual void OnDockLayoutManagerChanged(DockLayoutManager oldValue, DockLayoutManager newValue)
		{
			ClearValue(ViewStyleProperty);
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, ViewStyleProperty, newValue, DockLayoutManager.ViewStyleProperty);
			}
		}

		protected override IResizeCalculator ResolveResizeCalculator()
		{
			if (!DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(this))
			{
				return new RecursiveResizeCalculator
				{
					Orientation = base.Orientation
				};
			}
			return base.ResolveResizeCalculator();
		}
	}

			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplate>("LayoutHostTemplate", ref LayoutHostTemplateProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplate>("DataHostTemplate", ref DataHostTemplateProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<Brush>("CaptionActiveBackground", ref CaptionActiveBackgroundProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<Brush>("CaptionNormalBackground", ref CaptionNormalBackgroundProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<Brush>("CaptionActiveForeground", ref CaptionActiveForegroundProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<Brush>("CaptionNormalForeground", ref CaptionNormalForegroundProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<Brush>("ActualCaptionBackground", ref ActualCaptionBackgroundProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<Brush>("ActualCaptionForeground", ref ActualCaptionForegroundProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<Brush>("FloatingActiveBorderBrush", ref FloatingActiveBorderBrushProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DockPane)d).OnBorderBrushChanged();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly<Brush>("ActualBorderBrush", ref ActualBorderBrushPropertyKey, ref ActualBorderBrushProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("CaptionCornerRadius", ref CaptionCornerRadiusProperty, new CornerRadius(0.0));
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("FloatingCaptionCornerRadius", ref FloatingCaptionCornerRadiusProperty, new CornerRadius(0.0));
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ActualCaptionCornerRadius", ref ActualCaptionCornerRadiusProperty, new CornerRadius(0.0));
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("BorderMargin", ref BorderMarginProperty, new Thickness(0.0));

			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ActualBorderThickness", ref ActualBorderThicknessProperty, new Thickness(0.0));
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ActualBorderMargin", ref ActualBorderMarginProperty, new Thickness(0.0));

			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ContentMargin", ref ContentMarginProperty, new Thickness(0.0));

		public static HitTestType GetHitTestType(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (HitTestType)obj.GetValue(HitTestTypeProperty);
		}

		public static void SetHitTestType(DependencyObject obj, HitTestType value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(HitTestTypeProperty, value);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			if (PartHeader != null && !LayoutItemsHelper.IsTemplateChild(PartHeader, this))
			{
				PartHeader.Dispose();
			}
			PartHeader = GetTemplateChild("PART_Header") as DockPaneHeaderPresenter;
			if (PartHeader != null)
			{
				PartHeader.EnsureOwner(this);
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(PartHeader, DockPaneHeaderPresenter.IsCaptionVisibleProperty, base.LayoutItem, "IsCaptionVisible");
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(PartHeader, DockPaneHeaderPresenter.BackgroundProperty, this, "ActualCaptionBackground");
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(PartHeader, DockPaneHeaderPresenter.ForegroundProperty, this, "ActualCaptionForeground");
			}
			if (PartContent != null && !LayoutItemsHelper.IsTemplateChild(PartContent, this))
			{
				PartContent.Dispose();
			}
			PartContent = GetTemplateChild("PART_Content") as DockPaneContentPresenter;
			if (PartContent != null)
			{
				PartContent.EnsureOwner(this);
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(PartContent, DockItemContentPresenter<DockPane, LayoutPanel>.IsControlItemsHostProperty, base.LayoutItem, "IsControlItemsHost");
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(PartContent, DockItemContentPresenter<DockPane, LayoutPanel>.IsDataBoundProperty, base.LayoutItem, "IsDataBound");
			}
			if (base.LayoutItem is LayoutPanel panel)
			{
				UpdateBrushes(panel);
				UpdateGeometry(panel);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnActualSizeChanged(Size value)
		{
			base.OnActualSizeChanged(value);
			if (!base.IsDisposing && base.LayoutItem != null)
			{
				base.LayoutItem.LayoutSize = value;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnBorderBrushChanged()
		{
			LayoutPanel layoutPanel = LayoutPanel;
			if (layoutPanel != null)
			{
				UpdateActualBorderBrush(layoutPanel);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (PartContent != null)
			{
				PartContent.Dispose();
				PartContent = null;
			}
			if (PartHeader != null)
			{
				PartHeader.Dispose();
				PartHeader = null;
			}
			ClearValue(ControlHostTemplateProperty);
			ClearValue(LayoutHostTemplateProperty);
			ClearValue(DataHostTemplateProperty);
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnLayoutItemChanged(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem oldItem)
		{
			base.OnLayoutItemChanged(item, oldItem);
			if (item is LayoutPanel panel)
			{
				if (PartHeader != null)
				{
					BindingHelper.SetBinding(PartHeader, DockPaneHeaderPresenter.IsCaptionVisibleProperty, base.LayoutItem, "IsCaptionVisible");
				}
				if (PartContent != null)
				{
					BindingHelper.SetBinding(PartContent, DockItemContentPresenter<DockPane, LayoutPanel>.IsControlItemsHostProperty, base.LayoutItem, "IsControlItemsHost");
					BindingHelper.SetBinding(PartContent, DockItemContentPresenter<DockPane, LayoutPanel>.IsDataBoundProperty, base.LayoutItem, "IsDataBound");
				}
				UpdateBrushes(panel);
				UpdateGeometry(panel);
				base.LayoutItem.Forward(this, ViewStyleProperty, BaseLayoutItem.DockingViewStyleProperty);
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(ViewStyleProperty);
			}
		}

		protected override void Subscribe(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			base.Subscribe(item);
			if (item != null)
			{
				item.VisualChanged += OnItemVisualChanged;
				item.GeometryChanged += OnItemGeometryChanged;
			}
		}

		protected override void Unsubscribe(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			base.Unsubscribe(item);
			if (item != null)
			{
				item.VisualChanged -= OnItemVisualChanged;
				item.GeometryChanged -= OnItemGeometryChanged;
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateBrushes(LayoutPanel panel)
		{
			UpdateActualCaptionBackground(panel);
			UpdateActualCaptionForeground(panel);
			UpdateActualBorderBrush(panel);
		}

		protected void UpdateGeometry(LayoutPanel panel)
		{
			UpdateActualBorderThickness(panel);
			UpdateActualBorderMargin(panel);
			UpdateActualBorderPadding(panel);
			UpdateCaptionCornerRadius(panel);
			UpdatePartContentMargin(panel);
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		private bool HasBorderCore()
		{
			if (base.LayoutItem is LayoutPanel layoutPanel)
			{
				bool flag = layoutPanel.DockingViewStyle == DockingViewStyle.Light && !LayoutItemsHelper.IsFloatingRootItem(base.LayoutItem);
				if (layoutPanel.HasBorder && !layoutPanel.IsDockedAsDocument)
				{
					return !flag;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void OnItemGeometryChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is LayoutPanel panel)
			{
				UpdateGeometry(panel);
			}
		}

		private void OnItemVisualChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is LayoutPanel panel)
			{
				UpdateBrushes(panel);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateActualBorderBrush(LayoutPanel panel)
		{
			bool isActive = panel.IsActive;
			bool isFloatingRootItem = panel.IsFloatingRootItem;
			ActualBorderBrush = ((isActive && isFloatingRootItem) ? FloatingActiveBorderBrush : base.BorderBrush);
		}

		private void UpdateActualBorderMargin(LayoutPanel panel)
		{
			Thickness thickness = BorderMargin;
			thickness = (ActualBorderMargin = ((!panel.IsTabPage || panel.IsDockedAsDocument) ? new Thickness(HasBorderCore() ? thickness.Left : 0.0) : new Thickness(thickness.Left, thickness.Top, thickness.Right, 0.0)));
		}

		private void UpdateActualBorderPadding(LayoutPanel panel)
		{
			Thickness borderPadding = BorderPadding;
			borderPadding = ((!panel.IsTabPage || panel.IsDockedAsDocument || panel.DockingViewStyle == DockingViewStyle.Light) ? default(Thickness) : new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, borderPadding.Bottom));
			ActualBorderPadding = borderPadding;
		}

		private void UpdateActualBorderThickness(LayoutPanel panel)
		{
			Thickness actualBorderThickness = base.BorderThickness;
			if (panel.IsTabPage)
			{
				actualBorderThickness = new Thickness(actualBorderThickness.Left, actualBorderThickness.Top, actualBorderThickness.Right, 0.0);
			}
			if (!HasBorderCore())
			{
				actualBorderThickness = new Thickness(0.0);
			}
			ActualBorderThickness = actualBorderThickness;
		}

		private void UpdateActualCaptionBackground(LayoutPanel panel)
		{
			Brush actualCaptionBackground = (panel.IsActive ? CaptionActiveBackground : CaptionNormalBackground);
			if (panel.ActualAppearanceObject != null && panel.ActualAppearanceObject.Background != null)
			{
				actualCaptionBackground = panel.ActualAppearanceObject.Background;
			}
			ActualCaptionBackground = actualCaptionBackground;
		}

		private void UpdateActualCaptionForeground(LayoutPanel panel)
		{
			Brush actualCaptionForeground = (panel.IsActive ? CaptionActiveForeground : CaptionNormalForeground);
			if (panel.ActualAppearanceObject != null && panel.ActualAppearanceObject.Foreground != null)
			{
				actualCaptionForeground = panel.ActualAppearanceObject.Foreground;
			}
			ActualCaptionForeground = actualCaptionForeground;
		}

		private void UpdateCaptionCornerRadius(LayoutPanel panel)
		{
			CornerRadius actualCaptionCornerRadius = (panel.IsFloatingRootItem ? FloatingCaptionCornerRadius : CaptionCornerRadius);
			if (!panel.ShowCaption)
			{
				actualCaptionCornerRadius = new CornerRadius(0.0, 0.0, actualCaptionCornerRadius.BottomRight, actualCaptionCornerRadius.BottomLeft);
			}
			if (!HasBorderCore())
			{
				actualCaptionCornerRadius = default(CornerRadius);
			}
			ActualCaptionCornerRadius = actualCaptionCornerRadius;
		}

		private void UpdatePartContentMargin(LayoutPanel panel)
		{
			if (PartContent != null)
			{
				bool flag = HasBorderCore();
				PartContent.BarContainerMargin = (flag ? BarContainerMargin : new Thickness(0.0));
				PartContent.ContentMargin = (flag ? ContentMargin : new Thickness(0.0));
			}
		}
	}
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_Caption", Type = typeof(CaptionControl))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_CaptionBackground", Type = typeof(Border))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_ControlBox", Type = typeof(BaseControlBoxControl))]
	public class DockPaneHeaderPresenter : BasePanePresenter<DockPane, LayoutPanel>
	{
		private class DefaultHeaderTemplateSelector : DefaultItemTemplateSelectorWrapper.DefaultItemTemplateSelector
		{
			public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
			{
				if (container is DockPaneHeaderPresenter { Owner: not null } dockPaneHeaderPresenter)
				{
					return dockPaneHeaderPresenter.Owner.HeaderTemplate;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsCaptionVisibleProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty BackgroundProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ForegroundProperty;

		private DataTemplateSelector defaultCaptionTemplateSelector;

		private DataTemplateSelector _DefaultCaptionTemplateSelector
		{
			get
			{
				if (defaultCaptionTemplateSelector == null)
				{
					defaultCaptionTemplateSelector = new DefaultHeaderTemplateSelector();
				}
				return defaultCaptionTemplateSelector;
			}
		}

		public bool IsCaptionVisible
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsCaptionVisibleProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsCaptionVisibleProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public Brush Background
		{
			get
			{
				return (Brush)GetValue(BackgroundProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(BackgroundProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public Brush Foreground
		{
			get
			{
				return (Brush)GetValue(ForegroundProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ForegroundProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected TemplatedCaptionControl PartCaptionPresenter { get; private set; }

		protected Border PartCaptionBackground { get; private set; }

		protected BaseControlBoxControl PartControlBox { get; private set; }

		static DockPaneHeaderPresenter()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DockPaneHeaderPresenter> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DockPaneHeaderPresenter>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("IsCaptionVisible", ref IsCaptionVisibleProperty, defValue: true, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DockPaneHeaderPresenter)dObj).OnIsCaptionVisibleChanged((bool)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<Brush>("Background", ref BackgroundProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<Brush>("Foreground", ref ForegroundProperty);
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, IsCaptionVisibleProperty);
			BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, BackgroundProperty);
			BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, ForegroundProperty);
			if (PartCaptionPresenter != null)
			{
				PartCaptionPresenter.Dispose();
				PartCaptionPresenter = null;
			}
			if (PartControlBox != null)
			{
				PartControlBox.Dispose();
				PartControlBox = null;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsCaptionVisibleChanged(bool visible)
		{
			base.Visibility = VisibilityHelper.Convert(visible);
		}

		protected override bool CanSelectTemplate(LayoutPanel panel)
		{
			return _DefaultCaptionTemplateSelector != null;
		}

		protected override DataTemplate SelectTemplateCore(LayoutPanel panel)
		{
			return _DefaultCaptionTemplateSelector.SelectTemplate(panel, this);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			PartCaptionPresenter = GetTemplateChild("PART_CaptionControlPresenter") as TemplatedCaptionControl;
			if (PartCaptionPresenter != null)
			{
				this.Forward(PartCaptionPresenter, Control.ForegroundProperty, "Foreground");
			}
			PartCaptionBackground = GetTemplateChild("PART_CaptionBackground") as Border;
			if (PartCaptionBackground != null)
			{
				this.Forward(PartCaptionBackground, Border.BackgroundProperty, "Background");
			}
			if (PartControlBox != null && !LayoutItemsHelper.IsTemplateChild(PartControlBox, this))
			{
				PartControlBox.Dispose();
			}
			PartControlBox = GetTemplateChild("PART_ControlBox") as BaseControlBoxControl;
		}

		protected override LayoutPanel ConvertToLogicalItem(object content)
		{
			return (LayoutItemData.ConvertToBaseLayoutItem(content) as LayoutPanel) ?? base.ConvertToLogicalItem(content);
		}
	}
	public class DockPaneContentPresenter : DockItemContentPresenter<DockPane, LayoutPanel>
	{
		private class DefaultContentTemplateSelector : DataTemplateSelector
		{
			public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
			{
				DockPaneContentPresenter dockPaneContentPresenter = container as DockPaneContentPresenter;
				if (item is LayoutPanel layoutPanel && dockPaneContentPresenter != null && dockPaneContentPresenter.Owner != null)
				{
					if (!layoutPanel.IsControlItemsHost)
					{
						if (!layoutPanel.IsDataBound)
						{
							return dockPaneContentPresenter.Owner.ControlHostTemplate;
						}
						return dockPaneContentPresenter.Owner.DataHostTemplate;
					}
					return dockPaneContentPresenter.Owner.LayoutHostTemplate;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public static readonly DependencyProperty BarContainerMarginProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ContentMarginProperty;

		private DataTemplateSelector defaultContentTemplateSelector;

		private DataTemplateSelector _DefaultContentTemplateSelector
		{
			get
			{
				if (defaultContentTemplateSelector == null)
				{
					defaultContentTemplateSelector = new DefaultContentTemplateSelector();
				}
				return defaultContentTemplateSelector;
			}
		}

		public Thickness BarContainerMargin
		{
			get
			{
				return (Thickness)GetValue(BarContainerMarginProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(BarContainerMarginProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public Thickness ContentMargin
		{
			get
			{
				return (Thickness)GetValue(ContentMarginProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ContentMarginProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsControlItemsHost
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(DockItemContentPresenter<DockPane, LayoutPanel>.IsControlItemsHostProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DockItemContentPresenter<DockPane, LayoutPanel>.IsControlItemsHostProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public DockBarContainerControl PartBarContainer { get; private set; }

		public psvContentPresenter PartLayout { get; private set; }

		public UIElementPresenter PartControl { get; private set; }

		public psvContentPresenter PartContent { get; private set; }

		static DockPaneContentPresenter()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DockPaneContentPresenter> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DockPaneContentPresenter>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("BarContainerMargin", ref BarContainerMarginProperty, new Thickness(0.0));
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ContentMargin", ref ContentMarginProperty, new Thickness(0.0));
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (PartBarContainer != null)
			{
				PartBarContainer.Dispose();
				PartBarContainer = null;
			}
			if (PartControl != null)
			{
				PartControl.Dispose();
				PartControl = null;
			}
			if (PartLayout != null)
			{
				PartLayout.Dispose();
				PartLayout = null;
			}
			if (PartContent != null)
			{
				PartContent.Dispose();
				PartContent = null;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override bool CanSelectTemplate(LayoutPanel panel)
		{
			return _DefaultContentTemplateSelector != null;
		}

		protected override DataTemplate SelectTemplateCore(LayoutPanel panel)
		{
			return _DefaultContentTemplateSelector.SelectTemplate(panel, this);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			if (PartBarContainer != null && !LayoutItemsHelper.IsTemplateChild((DependencyObject)(object)PartBarContainer, this))
			{
				PartBarContainer.Dispose();
			}
			PartBarContainer = LayoutItemsHelper.GetTemplateChild<DockBarContainerControl>((DependencyObject)this);
			if (PartBarContainer != null)
			{
				((FrameworkElement)(object)PartBarContainer).Margin = BarContainerMargin;
			}
			if (PartControl != null && !LayoutItemsHelper.IsTemplateChild(PartControl, this))
			{
				PartControl.Dispose();
			}
			PartControl = LayoutItemsHelper.GetTemplateChild<UIElementPresenter>(this);
			if (PartControl != null)
			{
				PartControl.Margin = ContentMargin;
			}
			if (PartLayout != null && !LayoutItemsHelper.IsTemplateChild(PartLayout, this))
			{
				PartLayout.Dispose();
			}
			ScrollViewer templateChild = LayoutItemsHelper.GetTemplateChild<ScrollViewer>(this);
			if (templateChild != null)
			{
				PartLayout = templateChild.Content as psvContentPresenter;
			}
			if (PartContent != null && !LayoutItemsHelper.IsTemplateChild(PartContent, this))
			{
				PartContent.Dispose();
			}
			PartContent = LayoutItemsHelper.GetTemplateChild<psvContentPresenter>(this, acceptRoot: false);
		}
	}
	public abstract class FloatPanePresenter : BaseFloatingContainer, IUIElement, IDisposable
	{
		[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_Content", Type = typeof(UIElement))]
		[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_SingleBorder", Type = typeof(Grid))]
		[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_FormBorder", Type = typeof(Grid))]
		[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_ResizeBorders", Type = typeof(Grid))]
		public class FloatingContentPresenter : ManagedContentPresenter
		{
			public static readonly DependencyProperty ActualContentMarginProperty;

			public static readonly DependencyProperty ActualShadowMarginProperty;

			public static readonly DependencyProperty ActualBorderMarginProperty;

			public UIElement PartContent { get; private set; }

			public FrameworkElement PartSingleBorder { get; private set; }

			public FrameworkElement PartFormBorder { get; private set; }

			public FrameworkElement PartResizeBorders { get; private set; }

			public DockLayoutManager Manager { get; private set; }

			public FormBorderControl PartBorderControl { get; private set; }

			private FloatPanePresenter Presenter => (FloatPanePresenter)(object)((ManagedContentPresenter)this).Container;

			public Thickness ActualShadowMargin
			{
				get
				{
					return (Thickness)((DependencyObject)this).GetValue(ActualShadowMarginProperty);
				}
				set
				{
					((DependencyObject)this).SetValue(ActualShadowMarginProperty, (object)value);
				}
			}

			public Thickness ActualBorderMargin
			{
				get
				{
					return (Thickness)((DependencyObject)this).GetValue(ActualBorderMarginProperty);
				}
				set
				{
					((DependencyObject)this).SetValue(ActualBorderMarginProperty, (object)value);
				}
			}

			public Thickness ActualContentMargin
			{
				get
				{
					return (Thickness)((DependencyObject)this).GetValue(ActualContentMarginProperty);
				}
				set
				{
					((DependencyObject)this).SetValue(ActualContentMarginProperty, (object)value);
				}
			}

			static FloatingContentPresenter()
			{
				DependencyPropertyRegistrator<FloatingContentPresenter> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<FloatingContentPresenter>();
				dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ActualContentMargin", ref ActualContentMarginProperty, new Thickness(0.0));
				dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ActualShadowMargin", ref ActualShadowMarginProperty, new Thickness(0.0));
				dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ActualBorderMargin", ref ActualBorderMarginProperty, new Thickness(0.0));
			}

			public FloatingContentPresenter(FloatPanePresenter container)
				: base((BaseFloatingContainer)(object)container)
			{
			}

			public override void OnApplyTemplate()
			{
				((FrameworkElement)this).OnApplyTemplate();
				Manager = DockLayoutManager.Ensure((DependencyObject)(object)this);
				if (Manager != null && Manager.ViewAdapter.GetView(((ManagedContentPresenter)this).Container) is FloatingView floatingView)
				{
					floatingView.Initialize((IUIElement)((ManagedContentPresenter)this).Container);
				}
				PartContent = ((FrameworkElement)this).GetTemplateChild("PART_Content") as UIElement;
				PartSingleBorder = ((FrameworkElement)this).GetTemplateChild("PART_SingleBorder") as FrameworkElement;
				PartFormBorder = ((FrameworkElement)this).GetTemplateChild("PART_FormBorder") as FrameworkElement;
				PartResizeBorders = ((FrameworkElement)this).GetTemplateChild("PART_ResizeBorders") as FrameworkElement;
				PartBorderControl = ((FrameworkElement)this).GetTemplateChild("PART_FormBorderControl") as FormBorderControl;
				UpdateBorderStyle(Presenter.BorderStyle);
				UpdateResizeBordersVisibility(Presenter.IsMaximized);
				SetupBindings();
			}

			private void SetupBindings()
			{
				if (PartBorderControl != null)
				{
					BindingHelper.SetBinding(PartBorderControl, FormBorderControl.ActualBorderMarginProperty, Presenter, FloatPanePresenter.ActualBorderMarginProperty);
					BindingHelper.SetBinding(PartBorderControl, FormBorderControl.ActualShadowMarginProperty, Presenter, FloatPanePresenter.ActualShadowMarginProperty);
					BindingHelper.SetBinding(PartBorderControl, FormBorderControl.IsMaximizedProperty, Presenter, IsMaximizedProperty);
				}
			}

			internal void UpdateBorderStyle(FloatGroupBorderStyle borderStyle)
			{
				UpdateSingleBorderVisibility(borderStyle);
				UpdateFormBorderVisibility(borderStyle);
			}

			internal void UpdateResizeBordersVisibility(bool maximized)
			{
				if (PartResizeBorders != null)
				{
					PartResizeBorders.Visibility = (maximized ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
				}
			}

			private void UpdateSingleBorderVisibility(FloatGroupBorderStyle borderStyle)
			{
				if (PartSingleBorder != null)
				{
					PartSingleBorder.Visibility = ((borderStyle != FloatGroupBorderStyle.Single) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
				}
			}

			private void UpdateFormBorderVisibility(FloatGroupBorderStyle borderStyle)
			{
				if (PartFormBorder != null)
				{
					PartFormBorder.Visibility = ((borderStyle != FloatGroupBorderStyle.Form) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
				}
			}

			public Thickness GetFloatingMargin()
			{
				ILayoutElement viewElement = Presenter.Container.GetViewElement(Presenter);
				BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = ((IDockLayoutElement)viewElement).Item;
				if (!(baseLayoutItem is FloatGroup floatGroup))
				{
					return default(Thickness);
				}
				if (floatGroup.HasSingleItem)
				{
					baseLayoutItem = floatGroup.Items[0];
				}
				return baseLayoutItem.GetFloatingBorderMargin();
			}
		}

		static FloatPanePresenter()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<FloatPanePresenter> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<FloatPanePresenter>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.OverrideFrameworkMetadata(BaseFloatingContainer.IsOpenProperty, defValue: true);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("BorderStyle", ref BorderStyleProperty, FloatGroupBorderStyle.Empty, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)

			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("IsMaximized", ref IsMaximizedProperty, defValue: false, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)

			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ShadowMargin", ref ShadowMarginProperty, new Thickness(double.NaN), delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)

			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("BorderMargin", ref BorderMarginProperty, new Thickness(double.NaN), delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((FloatPanePresenter)(object)dObj).OnBorderMarginChanged();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ActualBorderMargin", ref ActualBorderMarginProperty, new Thickness(0.0), null, (DependencyObject dObj, object value) => ((FloatPanePresenter)(object)dObj).CoerceActualBorderMargin());
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ActualShadowMargin", ref ActualShadowMarginProperty, new Thickness(0.0), null, (DependencyObject dObj, object value) => ((FloatPanePresenter)(object)dObj).CoerceActualShadowMargin());
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("SingleBorderMargin", ref SingleBorderMarginProperty, new Thickness(double.NaN), delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((FloatPanePresenter)(object)dObj).OnContentMarginChanged();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("FormBorderMargin", ref FormBorderMarginProperty, new Thickness(double.NaN), delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((FloatPanePresenter)(object)dObj).OnContentMarginChanged();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("MaximizedBorderMargin", ref MaximizedBorderMarginProperty, new Thickness(double.NaN), delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((FloatPanePresenter)(object)dObj).OnContentMarginChanged();
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("ActualContentMargin", ref ActualContentMarginProperty, new Thickness(0.0), null, (DependencyObject dObj, object value) => ((FloatPanePresenter)(object)dObj).CoerceActualContentMargin());
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (!isDisposing)
			{
				isDisposing = true;
				DeactivateContentHolder();
				OnDisposing();
				((BaseFloatingContainer)this).Owner = null;
				if (((BaseFloatingContainer)this).Presenter != null)
				{
					((ContentPresenter)(object)((BaseFloatingContainer)this).Presenter).Content = null;
				}
				if (((BaseFloatingContainer)this).Decorator != null)
				{
					((BaseFloatingContainer)this).Decorator.Child = null;
				}
				DockLayoutManager.Release((DependencyObject)(object)((BaseFloatingContainer)this).Presenter);
				DockLayoutManager.Release((DependencyObject)(object)this);
			}
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		protected virtual void OnBorderStyleChanged(FloatGroupBorderStyle borderStyle)
		{
			((DependencyObject)this).CoerceValue(ActualContentMarginProperty);
			if (((BaseFloatingContainer)this).Presenter != null)
			{
				((FloatingContentPresenter)(object)((BaseFloatingContainer)this).Presenter).UpdateBorderStyle(borderStyle);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnContentMarginChanged()
		{
			((DependencyObject)this).CoerceValue(ActualContentMarginProperty);
		}

		protected virtual void OnBorderMarginChanged()
		{
			((DependencyObject)this).CoerceValue(ActualBorderMarginProperty);
			((DependencyObject)this).CoerceValue(ActualShadowMarginProperty);
		}

		protected virtual Thickness CoerceActualContentMargin()
		{
			Thickness thickness = MaximizedBorderMargin;
			if (!IsMaximized)
			{
				thickness = ((BorderStyle == FloatGroupBorderStyle.Single) ? SingleBorderMargin : FormBorderMargin);
			}
			if (MathHelper.AreEqual(thickness, new Thickness(double.NaN)))
			{
				return new Thickness(0.0);
			}
			return thickness;
		}

		protected virtual Thickness CoerceActualShadowMargin()
		{
			Thickness thickness = ((!IsMaximized) ? ShadowMargin : new Thickness(0.0));
			if (MathHelper.AreEqual(thickness, new Thickness(double.NaN)))
			{
				return new Thickness(0.0);
			}
			return thickness;
		}

		protected virtual Thickness CoerceActualBorderMargin()
		{
			Thickness thickness = ((!IsMaximized) ? BorderMargin : new Thickness(0.0));
			if (MathHelper.AreEqual(thickness, new Thickness(double.NaN)))
			{
				return new Thickness(0.0);
			}
			return thickness;
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsMaximizedChanged(bool maximized)
		{
			((DependencyObject)this).CoerceValue(ActualContentMarginProperty);
			((DependencyObject)this).CoerceValue(ActualBorderMarginProperty);
			((DependencyObject)this).CoerceValue(ActualShadowMarginProperty);
			if (((BaseFloatingContainer)this).Presenter != null)
			{
				((FloatingContentPresenter)(object)((BaseFloatingContainer)this).Presenter).UpdateResizeBordersVisibility(maximized);
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			((FrameworkElement)this).OnApplyTemplate();
			Container = DockLayoutManager.Ensure((DependencyObject)(object)this);
		}

		public void Activate(DockLayoutManager container)
		{
			this.BringToFront(container);
			ActivateContentHolder();
		}

		public void Deactivate()
		{
			((BaseFloatingContainer)this).OnIsOpenChanged(false);
			DeactivateContentHolder();
		}

		protected override void OnContentChanged(object content)
		{
			Container = DockLayoutManager.Ensure((DependencyObject)(object)this);
			if (content == null && Container == null)
			{
				Deactivate();
			}
			((BaseFloatingContainer)this).Owner = Container;
			((BaseFloatingContainer)this).OnContentChanged(content);
		}

		protected override ManagedContentPresenter CreateContentPresenter()
		{
			return (ManagedContentPresenter)(object)new FloatingContentPresenter(this);
		}

		protected override void OnHierarchyCreated()
		{
			((BaseFloatingContainer)this).OnHierarchyCreated();
			((FrameworkElement)(object)this).Forward((FrameworkElement)(object)((BaseFloatingContainer)this).Presenter, FloatingContentPresenter.ActualContentMarginProperty, "ActualContentMargin");
			((FrameworkElement)(object)this).Forward((FrameworkElement)(object)((BaseFloatingContainer)this).Presenter, FloatingContentPresenter.ActualBorderMarginProperty, "ActualBorderMargin");
			((FrameworkElement)(object)this).Forward((FrameworkElement)(object)((BaseFloatingContainer)this).Presenter, FloatingContentPresenter.ActualShadowMarginProperty, "ActualShadowMargin");
		}

		protected override void OnContentUpdated(object content, FrameworkElement owner)
		{
		}

		protected abstract void OnDisposing();

		protected abstract void ActivateContentHolder();

		protected abstract void DeactivateContentHolder();

		internal virtual void EnsureOwnerWindow()
		{
		}

		internal virtual Thickness GetFloatingMargin()
		{
			if (((BaseFloatingContainer)this).Presenter == null)
			{
				return default(Thickness);
			}
			return ((FloatingContentPresenter)(object)((BaseFloatingContainer)this).Presenter).GetFloatingMargin();
		}

		public static void Invalidate(DependencyObject dObj)
		{
		}

		internal abstract bool TryGetActualRenderSize(out Size autoSize);
	}
	public class FloatingWindowPresenter : FloatPanePresenter
	{
		private FloatingPaneWindow windowCore;

		private AdornerWindow adornerWindowCore;

		private bool _isLoading;

		private bool isFloatingWindowLocked;

		private bool isTemplateAssigned;

		private bool lockShow;

		private bool Win32Compatible
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Container.IsTransparencyDisabled)
				{
					return EnvironmentHelper.IsWinXP;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public AdornerWindow AdornerWindow => EnsureAdornerWindow();

		protected internal FloatingPaneWindow Window => windowCore;

		protected override bool IsAlive => windowCore != null;

		protected override void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			_isLoading = true;
			try
			{
				((BaseFloatingContainer)this).OnLoaded(sender, e);
				EnsureAdornerWindow();
				isFloatingWindowLocked = false;
			}
			finally
			{
				_isLoading = false;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			DisposeAdornerWindow();
			((BaseFloatingContainer)this).OnUnloaded(sender, e);
		}

		protected override void OnDisposing()
		{
			DisposeAdornerWindow(force: true);
			Ref.Dispose(ref windowCore);
		}

		private void DisposeAdornerWindow(bool force = false)
		{
			if (!Win32Compatible || force)
			{
				Ref.Dispose(ref adornerWindowCore);
			}
		}

		protected virtual AdornerWindow GetWin32AdornerWindow(FloatingPaneWindow window)
		{
			return base.Container.Win32AdornerWindowProvider.GetWindow(window, base.Container);
		}

		protected virtual AdornerWindow CreateAdornerWindow(FloatingPaneWindow window)
		{
			return new AdornerWindow(window, base.Container);
		}

		protected override UIElement CreateContentContainer()
		{
			windowCore = CreateWindow();
			if (DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem((DependencyObject)(object)this) is FloatGroup floatGroup)
			{
				((BaseFloatingContainer)this).UpdateFloatingBoundsCore(floatGroup.FloatBounds);
			}
			return (UIElement)(object)windowCore;
		}

		protected virtual FloatingPaneWindow CreateWindow()
		{
			return new FloatingPaneWindow((BaseFloatingContainer)(object)this);
		}

		protected override void OnIsOpenChanged(bool isOpen)
		{
			if (Window != null)
			{
				if (!isOpen)
				{
					isFloatingWindowLocked = true;
					((Window)(object)Window).Owner = null;
				}
				else
				{
					Window.UpdateOwnerWindow();
				}
			}
			((BaseFloatingContainer)this).OnIsOpenChanged(isOpen);
		}

		protected override void OnContainerTemplateChanged(DataTemplate newValue)
		{
			if (((BaseFloatingContainer)this).Content != null && newValue != null)
			{
				((BaseFloatingContainer)this).UpdateContainer(((BaseFloatingContainer)this).Content);
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdatePresenterContentTemplate()
		{
			((BaseFloatingContainer)this).UpdatePresenterContentTemplate();
			isTemplateAssigned = ((BaseFloatingContainer)this).ContainerTemplate != null;
			if (isTemplateAssigned && ((BaseFloatingContainer)this).IsAlive && Window.hiddenInitialization)
			{
				((BaseFloatingContainer)this).CheckBoundsInContainer();
				Window.hiddenInitialization = false;
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateFloatingBoundsCore(Rect bounds)
		{
			if (((BaseFloatingContainer)this).IsOpen && ((FrameworkElement)(object)this).IsLoaded && !_isLoading)
			{
				isFloatingWindowLocked = false;
			}
			if (!isFloatingWindowLocked)
			{
				if (((FrameworkElement)(object)Window).FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
				{
					bounds.X = bounds.Left + bounds.Width;
				}
				((WindowContentHolder)Window).SetFloatingBounds((FrameworkElement)base.Container, bounds);
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateIsOpenCore(bool isOpen)
		{
			if ((((BaseFloatingContainer)this).IsOpen && (((BaseFloatingContainer)this).Content == null || ((BaseFloatingContainer)this).ContainerTemplate == null)) || lockShow)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (isOpen)
			{
				if (((UIElement)(object)Window).IsVisible)
				{
					return;
				}
				FloatGroup floatGroup = DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem((DependencyObject)(object)this) as FloatGroup;
				if (base.Container.EnableWin32Compatibility && floatGroup != null && !floatGroup.IsActuallyVisible)
				{
					return;
				}
				bool allowsTransparency = ((Window)(object)Window).AllowsTransparency;
				bool flag = (((Window)(object)Window).ShowActivated = base.Container.IsFloating || ((Window)(object)Window).WindowState == WindowState.Maximized);
				bool flag3 = flag;
				if (allowsTransparency)
				{
					((UIElement)(object)Window).Opacity = 0.0;
				}
				Window.UpdateRenderOptions();
				lockShow = true;
				Window.LockHelper.Lock(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.FloatingBounds);
				((Window)(object)Window).Show();
				if (((BaseFloatingContainer)this).IsAlive)
				{
					Window.LockHelper.Unlock(FloatingWindowLock.LockerKey.FloatingBounds);
					lockShow = false;
					if (flag3)
					{
						WindowHelper.BringToFront((DependencyObject)(object)Window);
					}
					if (allowsTransparency)
					{
						DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation = new DoubleAnimation(1.0, new Duration(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(100.0)));
						doubleAnimation.Freeze();
						((UIElement)(object)Window).BeginAnimation(UIElement.OpacityProperty, (AnimationTimeline)doubleAnimation);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				((Window)(object)Window).Hide();
			}
		}

		protected override void AddDecoratorToContentContainer(NonLogicalDecorator decorator)
		{
			((ContentControl)(object)Window).Content = decorator;
		}

		protected override void ActivateContentHolder()
		{
			if (Window != null && !((Window)(object)Window).IsActive)
			{
				((Window)(object)Window).Activate();
			}
		}

		protected override void DeactivateContentHolder()
		{
			Window window = ((Window != null) ? ((Window)(object)Window).Owner : null);
			Ref.Dispose(ref windowCore);
			DisposeAdornerWindow();
			if (window != null && !base.Container.FloatGroups.Any((FloatGroup x) => x.IsActuallyVisible))
			{
				window.Activate();
			}
		}

		internal AdornerWindow EnsureAdornerWindow()
		{
			if (!((BaseFloatingContainer)this).IsAlive)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (Win32Compatible)
			{
				return GetWin32AdornerWindow(Window);
			}
			if (adornerWindowCore == null || adornerWindowCore.IsDisposing)
			{
				adornerWindowCore = CreateAdornerWindow(Window);
			}
			return adornerWindowCore;
		}

		internal override void EnsureOwnerWindow()
		{
			if (Window != null && ((BaseFloatingContainer)this).IsOpen)
			{
				if (base.Container.OwnsFloatWindows)
				{
					Window.UpdateOwnerWindow();
				}
				else
				{
					((Window)(object)Window).Owner = null;
				}
			}
		}

		internal override bool TryGetActualRenderSize(out Size autoSize)
		{
			FloatingPaneWindow window = Window;
			autoSize = window?.TranslateWindowSizeToFloatSize() ?? default(Size);
			return window != null;
		}
	}
	public class FloatingAdornerPresenter : FloatPanePresenter
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty SizeToContentProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SizeToContent", typeof(SizeToContent), typeof(FloatingAdornerPresenter), new PropertyMetadata(SizeToContent.Manual, OnSizeToContentChanged));

		private FloatingPaneAdornerElement adornerElementCore;

		public SizeToContent SizeToContent
		{
			get
			{
				return (SizeToContent)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(SizeToContentProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(SizeToContentProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		protected internal FloatingPaneAdornerElement AdornerElement => adornerElementCore;

		protected override bool IsAlive => adornerElementCore != null;

		private static void OnSizeToContentChanged(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (dObj is FloatingAdornerPresenter floatingAdornerPresenter)
			{
				floatingAdornerPresenter.OnSizeToContentChanged((SizeToContent)e.OldValue, (SizeToContent)e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		private static bool CanUpdateFloatingBounds(DockLayoutManager container)
		{
			UIElement topContainerWithAdornerLayer = LayoutHelper.GetTopContainerWithAdornerLayer((UIElement)container);
			if (topContainerWithAdornerLayer != null && topContainerWithAdornerLayer.IsArrangeValid)
			{
				return container.IsArrangeValid;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void OnDisposing()
		{
			adornerElementCore = null;
		}

		protected virtual void OnSizeToContentChanged(SizeToContent oldValue, SizeToContent newValue)
		{
			((BaseFloatingContainer)this).UpdateFloatingBoundsCore(new Rect(((BaseFloatingContainer)this).FloatLocation, ((BaseFloatingContainer)this).FloatSize));
		}

		protected virtual void OnFloatStateChanged(FloatState oldValue, FloatState newValue)
		{
			((BaseFloatingContainer)this).UpdateFloatingBoundsCore(new Rect(((BaseFloatingContainer)this).FloatLocation, ((BaseFloatingContainer)this).FloatSize));
		}

		protected override void AddDecoratorToContentContainer(NonLogicalDecorator decorator)
		{
			AdornerElement.Child = (UIElement)(object)decorator;
			((PlacementAdorner)base.Container.DragAdorner).Register((UIElement)AdornerElement);
			((PlacementAdorner)base.Container.DragAdorner).SetVisible((UIElement)AdornerElement, true);
		}

		protected override UIElement CreateContentContainer()
		{
			((BaseSurfacedAdorner)base.Container.DragAdorner).Activate();
			adornerElementCore = CreateAdornerElement(base.Container);
			return adornerElementCore;
		}

		protected override void OnHierarchyCreated()
		{
			base.OnHierarchyCreated();
			adornerElementCore.EnsureFlowDirection();
		}

		protected virtual FloatingPaneAdornerElement CreateAdornerElement(DockLayoutManager container)
		{
			return new FloatingPaneAdornerElement((BaseFloatingContainer)(object)this);
		}

		protected override void UpdateFloatingBoundsCore(Rect bounds)
		{
			((UIElement)(object)this).LayoutUpdated -= OnLayoutUpdated;
			if (CanUpdateFloatingBounds(base.Container))
			{
				InvokeFloatingBoundsUpdate(bounds);
			}
			else
			{
				((UIElement)(object)this).LayoutUpdated += OnLayoutUpdated;
			}
		}

		private void OnLayoutUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((UIElement)(object)this).LayoutUpdated -= OnLayoutUpdated;
			InvokeFloatingBoundsUpdate(new Rect(((BaseFloatingContainer)this).FloatLocation, ((BaseFloatingContainer)this).FloatSize));
		}

		private void InvokeFloatingBoundsUpdate(Rect bounds)
		{
			if (!base.Container.IsDisposing && AdornerElement != null)
			{
				bounds = base.Container.CorrectBoundsInAdorner(bounds);
				if (!MathHelper.IsEmpty(bounds.Size))
				{
					((PlacementAdorner)base.Container.DragAdorner).SetBoundsInContainer((UIElement)AdornerElement, bounds);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateIsOpenCore(bool isOpen)
		{
			((PlacementAdorner)base.Container.DragAdorner).SetVisible((UIElement)AdornerElement, isOpen);
		}

		protected override void ActivateContentHolder()
		{
			((PlacementAdorner)base.Container.DragAdorner).BringToFront((UIElement)AdornerElement);
		}

		protected override void DeactivateContentHolder()
		{
			((PlacementAdorner)base.Container.DragAdorner).Unregister((UIElement)AdornerElement);
		}

		internal override bool TryGetActualRenderSize(out Size autoSize)
		{
			FloatingPaneAdornerElement adornerElement = AdornerElement;
			autoSize = adornerElement?.RenderSize ?? default(Size);
			return adornerElement != null;
		}
	}
	public class LayoutItemsControl : psvItemsControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty OrientationProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LastChildFillProperty;

		public bool LastChildFill
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(LastChildFillProperty);
			}

				SetValue(LastChildFillProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public Orientation Orientation
		{
			get
			{
				return (Orientation)GetValue(OrientationProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(OrientationProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal GroupPanel PartGroupPanel { get; private set; }

		static LayoutItemsControl()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<LayoutItemsControl> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<LayoutItemsControl>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<LayoutItemsControl>();
			OrientationProperty = dependencyPropertyRegistrator.AddOwner("Orientation", StackPanel.OrientationProperty, Orientation.Horizontal);
			LastChildFillProperty = dependencyPropertyRegistrator.AddOwner("LastChildFill", DockPanel.LastChildFillProperty, defValue: true);
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (PartGroupPanel != null)
			{
				PartGroupPanel.Dispose();
				PartGroupPanel = null;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override bool IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(object item)
		{
			if (!(item is Splitter))
			{
				return item is BaseLayoutItem;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainer(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			if (element is MultiTemplateControl multiTemplateControl)
			{
				multiTemplateControl.BeginPrepareContainer();
				multiTemplateControl.LayoutItem = (BaseLayoutItem)item;
				multiTemplateControl.EndPrepareContainer();
			}
			(element as Splitter)?.Activate();
			(element as BaseLayoutItem)?.SelectTemplate();
		}

		protected override void ClearContainer(DependencyObject element)
		{
			if (element is MultiTemplateControl multiTemplateControl)
			{
				multiTemplateControl.LayoutItem = null;
				multiTemplateControl.Dispose();
			}
			(element as Splitter)?.Deactivate();
			(element as BaseLayoutItem)?.ClearTemplate();
		}

		protected void EnsureVisualTreeAffinity(UIElement element)
		{
			if (LayoutItemsHelper.GetVisualParent(element) is GroupPanel groupPanel)
			{
				LayoutItemsControl templateParent = LayoutItemsHelper.GetTemplateParent<LayoutItemsControl>(groupPanel);
				if (templateParent != null && templateParent != this)
				{
					groupPanel.Children.Remove(element);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void EnsureItemsPanelCore(Panel itemsPanel)
		{
			base.EnsureItemsPanelCore(itemsPanel);
			PartGroupPanel = itemsPanel as GroupPanel;
			PartGroupPanel?.InvalidateLayout();
		}

		internal virtual void PrepareForWindowClosing()
		{
		}
	}
