	public class FloatingMultiTemplateControl : MultiTemplateControl
	{
		private bool fHidden;

		private bool fHideRequested;

		private bool fTemplateApplied;

		internal void QueryClearTemplate()
		{
			fHideRequested = true;
			ClearTemplate();
		}

		private void UpdateTemplateOnLoadOrUnload()
		{
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (base.Container == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!base.IsLoaded && base.Container.CloseFloatWindowsOnManagerUnloading)
			{
				if ((int)base.Container.GetRealFloatingMode() == 1 && fTemplateApplied)
				{
					fHideRequested = true;
					base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(ClearTemplate));
				}
				return;
			}
			if (fHideRequested)
			{
				fHideRequested = false;
			}
			if (fHidden || !fTemplateApplied)
			{
				SelectTemplate(base.LayoutItem);
				(base.Container ?? DockLayoutManager.GetDockLayoutManager(this))?.InvalidateView(base.LayoutItem.GetRoot());
			}
		}

		private void ClearTemplate()
		{
			if (fHideRequested)
			{
				fHideRequested = false;
				DependencyObject child = LayoutItemsHelper.GetChild<DependencyObject>(this);
				if (child is IDisposable)
				{
					((IDisposable)child).Dispose();
				}
				ClearValue(Control.TemplateProperty);
				if (child != null)
				{
					DockLayoutManager.Release(child);
				}
				fHidden = true;
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			fTemplateApplied = true;
		}

		protected override void OnLoaded()
		{
			base.OnLoaded();
			UpdateTemplateOnLoadOrUnload();
		}

		protected override void OnUnloaded()
		{
			base.OnUnloaded();
			UpdateTemplateOnLoadOrUnload();
		}
	}
	public class GroupPanel : psvGrid
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty OrientationProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LastChildFillProperty;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty LayoutItemProperty;

		private bool isLayoutDirty;

		private readonly Locker layoutItemLocker = new Locker();

		private double defectiveMeasureCount;

		private DocumentGroup documentHost;

		private readonly Locker rebuildLocker = new Locker();

		public Orientation Orientation
		{
			get
			{
				return (Orientation)GetValue(OrientationProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(OrientationProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool LastChildFill
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(LastChildFillProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LastChildFillProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private bool IsHorizontal => Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal;

		private DocumentGroup DocumentHost => documentHost;

		static GroupPanel()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<GroupPanel> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<GroupPanel>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("Orientation", ref OrientationProperty, Orientation.Horizontal, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GroupPanel)dObj).OnOrientatonChanged((Orientation)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("LastChildFill", ref LastChildFillProperty, defValue: true, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GroupPanel)dObj).OnLastChildFillChanged((bool)e.NewValue);
			});
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<GroupPanel>.New().AddOwner<BaseLayoutItem>(ref LayoutItemProperty, DockLayoutManager.LayoutItemProperty, (BaseLayoutItem)null, (Action<GroupPanel, BaseLayoutItem, BaseLayoutItem>)delegate(GroupPanel d, BaseLayoutItem oldValue, BaseLayoutItem newValue)
			{
				d.OnLayoutItemChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			});
		}

		internal void InvalidateLayout()
		{
			isLayoutDirty = true;
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		protected virtual void OnLayoutItemChanged(BaseLayoutItem oldValue, BaseLayoutItem newValue)
		{
			try
			{
				Locker val = layoutItemLocker.Lock();
				try
				{
					if (newValue is LayoutGroup)
					{
						newValue.Forward(this, LastChildFillProperty, "LastChildFill");
						newValue.Forward(this, OrientationProperty, "Orientation");
					}
					else
					{
						ClearValue(LastChildFillProperty);
						ClearValue(OrientationProperty);
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				InvalidateLayout();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnOrientatonChanged(Orientation orientation)
		{
			InvalidateLayout();
		}

		protected virtual void OnLastChildFillChanged(bool value)
		{
			InvalidateLayout();
		}

		protected void ClearParameters()
		{
			base.RowDefinitions.Clear();
			base.ColumnDefinitions.Clear();
		}

		protected virtual bool SkipRebuildLayout()
		{
			if (!base.IsDisposing && !base.RowDefinitions.IsReadOnly)
			{
				return base.ColumnDefinitions.IsReadOnly;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void QueueInvlidateMeasure()
		{
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(base.InvalidateMeasure));
		}

		private bool CorrectDefectiveMeasure(Size constraint)
		{
			if (defectiveMeasureCount == 0.0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			defectiveMeasureCount = 0.0;
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			foreach (UIElement internalChild in base.InternalChildren)
			{
				BaseLayoutItem layoutItem = GetLayoutItem(internalChild);
				if (layoutItem == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				DefinitionBase definition = DefinitionsHelper.GetDefinition(layoutItem);
				if (definition != null)
				{
					GridLength length = definition.GetLength();
					if (length.IsStar)
					{
						num += length.Value;
						num2 += definition.GetActualLength();
					}
				}
			}
			if (num2 == 0.0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool result = false;
			foreach (UIElement internalChild2 in base.InternalChildren)
			{
				BaseLayoutItem layoutItem2 = GetLayoutItem(internalChild2);
				if (layoutItem2 == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				DefinitionBase definition2 = DefinitionsHelper.GetDefinition(layoutItem2);
				if (definition2 == null || !definition2.GetLength().IsStar)
				{
					continue;
				}
				double actualLength = definition2.GetActualLength();
				double num3 = (IsHorizontal ? layoutItem2.ActualMinSize.Width : layoutItem2.ActualMinSize.Height);
				GridLength gridLength = (GridLength)layoutItem2.GetValue((Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal) ? BaseLayoutItem.ItemWidthProperty : BaseLayoutItem.ItemHeightProperty);
				if (!(actualLength - num3 < 1.0) && gridLength.IsStar)
				{
					GridLength gridLength2 = new GridLength(actualLength * num / num2, GridUnitType.Star);
					if (!gridLength.Equals(gridLength2) && gridLength2 != DefinitionsHelper.ZeroStarLength)
					{
						layoutItem2.SetValue((Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal) ? BaseLayoutItem.ItemWidthProperty : BaseLayoutItem.ItemHeightProperty, gridLength2);
						result = true;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private double GetLength(Size s, bool isHorizontal)
		{
			if (!isHorizontal)
			{
				return s.Height;
			}
			return s.Width;
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size constraint)
		{
			if (isLayoutDirty)
			{
				RebuildLayout();
			}
			bool flag = true;
			if (defectiveMeasureCount > 0.0)
			{
				flag = CorrectDefectiveMeasure(constraint);
			}
			Size size = base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			double length = GetLength(constraint, IsHorizontal);
			double length2 = GetLength(size, IsHorizontal);
			if (flag && length2 - length > 1.0 && length > 0.0)
			{
				defectiveMeasureCount += 1.0;
				QueueInvlidateMeasure();
			}
			return size;
		}

		private DocumentGroup GetDocumentHost(LayoutGroup ownerGroup)
		{
			DocumentGroup documentGroup = null;
			if (ownerGroup != null)
			{
				IEnumerable<DocumentGroup> source = ownerGroup.GetNestedItems().OfType<DocumentGroup>();
				documentGroup = source.FirstOrDefault((DocumentGroup x) => x.HasNotCollapsedItems);
				if (documentGroup == null)
				{
					documentGroup = source.FirstOrDefault((DocumentGroup x) => x.ShowWhenEmpty);
					if (documentGroup == null)
					{
						documentGroup = source.FirstOrDefault();
					}
				}
			}
			return documentGroup;
		}

		private LayoutGroup GetOwnerGroup()
		{
			return DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(this) as LayoutGroup;
		}

		protected internal virtual void RebuildLayout()
		{
			if (Locker.op_Implicit(rebuildLocker) || Locker.op_Implicit(layoutItemLocker))
			{
				return;
			}
			Locker val = rebuildLocker.Lock();
			try
			{
				try
				{
					if (SkipRebuildLayout())
					{
						return;
					}
					InvalidateMeasure();
					ClearParameters();
					int num = 0;
					bool flag = Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal;
					bool flag2 = false;
					documentHost = GetDocumentHost(GetOwnerGroup());
					foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
					{
						BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = GetLayoutItem(child) ?? (child as Splitter).With((Splitter x) => x.LayoutGroup);
						if (baseLayoutItem == null)
						{
							return;
						}
						if (child is Splitter)
						{
							BaseLayoutItem layoutItem = GetLayoutItem(base.Children[num + 1]);
							if (!CanSkipItem(layoutItem) && flag2)
							{
								flag2 = false;
								child.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
							}
							else
							{
								child.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
							}
							((Splitter)child).InitSplitThumb(flag);
							DependencyProperty targetProperty = IntervalHelper.GetTargetProperty(GetLayoutItem(base.Children[num - 1]), GetLayoutItem(base.Children[num + 1]));
							DoubleToGridLengthConverter converter = new DoubleToGridLengthConverter();
							if (flag)
							{
								ColumnDefinition columnDefinition = new ColumnDefinition
								{
									Width = default(GridLength)
								};
								if (child.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
								{
									BindingHelper.SetBinding(columnDefinition, ColumnDefinition.WidthProperty, baseLayoutItem, targetProperty, converter);
								}
								DefinitionsHelper.SetDefinition(child, columnDefinition);
								base.ColumnDefinitions.Add(columnDefinition);
							}
							else
							{
								RowDefinition rowDefinition = new RowDefinition
								{
									Height = default(GridLength)
								};
								if (child.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
								{
									BindingHelper.SetBinding(rowDefinition, RowDefinition.HeightProperty, baseLayoutItem, targetProperty, converter);
								}
								DefinitionsHelper.SetDefinition(child, rowDefinition);
								base.RowDefinitions.Add(rowDefinition);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							if (baseLayoutItem is LayoutControlItem)
							{
								baseLayoutItem.ClearValue(LayoutControlItem.DesiredSizeInternalProperty);
							}
							bool flag3 = !CanSkipItem(baseLayoutItem);
							if (flag3)
							{
								flag2 = true;
							}
							GridLength gridLength = ((DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(this) && baseLayoutItem.IsVisible) ? new GridLength(1.0, GridUnitType.Star) : DefinitionsHelper.ZeroLength);
							if (flag)
							{
								ColumnDefinition columnDefinition2 = new ColumnDefinition
								{
									Width = gridLength
								};
								if (flag3)
								{
									BindingHelper.SetBinding(columnDefinition2, ColumnDefinition.WidthProperty, baseLayoutItem, "ItemWidth");
									columnDefinition2.SetMinSize(baseLayoutItem.ActualMinSize);
									columnDefinition2.SetMaxSize(baseLayoutItem.ActualMaxSize);
								}
								DefinitionsHelper.SetDefinition(baseLayoutItem, columnDefinition2);
								base.ColumnDefinitions.Add(columnDefinition2);
							}
							else
							{
								RowDefinition rowDefinition2 = new RowDefinition
								{
									Height = gridLength
								};
								if (flag3)
								{
									BindingHelper.SetBinding(rowDefinition2, RowDefinition.HeightProperty, baseLayoutItem, "ItemHeight");
									rowDefinition2.SetMinSize(baseLayoutItem.ActualMinSize);
									rowDefinition2.SetMaxSize(baseLayoutItem.ActualMaxSize);
								}
								DefinitionsHelper.SetDefinition(baseLayoutItem, rowDefinition2);
								base.RowDefinitions.Add(rowDefinition2);
							}
						}
						child.SetValue(flag ? Grid.ColumnProperty : Grid.RowProperty, num++);
					}
					UpdateDefinitionsForSingleChild();
					isLayoutDirty = false;
				}
				finally
				{
					documentHost = null;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateDefinitionsForSingleChild()
		{
			if (LastChildFill)
			{
				if (base.RowDefinitions.Count == 1 && !DefinitionsHelper.IsZero(base.RowDefinitions[0]))
				{
					base.RowDefinitions[0].ClearValue(RowDefinition.HeightProperty);
				}
				if (base.ColumnDefinitions.Count == 1 && !DefinitionsHelper.IsZero(base.ColumnDefinitions[0]))
				{
					base.ColumnDefinitions[0].ClearValue(ColumnDefinition.WidthProperty);
				}
			}
		}

		private static BaseLayoutItem GetLayoutItem(DependencyObject element)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem baseLayoutItem = (element as MultiTemplateControl).Return((MultiTemplateControl x) => x.LayoutItem, () => (BaseLayoutItem)null);
			return baseLayoutItem ?? (element as BaseLayoutItem);
		}

		private bool CanSkipItem(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
			{
				return CanSkipGroup(item as LayoutGroup);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool CanSkipGroup(LayoutGroup group)
		{
			if (group == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (group is FloatGroup)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (group is DocumentGroup { Parent: not null } documentGroup)
			{
				if (!documentGroup.HasNotCollapsedItems)
				{
					return documentGroup != DocumentHost;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (!group.HasNotCollapsedItems && group.GroupBorderStyle == GroupBorderStyle.NoBorder)
			{
				return !group.GetIsDocumentHost();
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void OnLoaded()
		{
			base.OnLoaded();
			if (isLayoutDirty)
			{
				RebuildLayout();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnVisualChildrenChanged(DependencyObject visualAdded, DependencyObject visualRemoved)
		{
			base.OnVisualChildrenChanged(visualAdded, visualRemoved);
			if (visualRemoved != null)
			{
				DependencyObject target = (visualRemoved as Splitter) ?? GetLayoutItem(visualRemoved) ?? visualRemoved;
				DefinitionsHelper.SetDefinition(target, null);
			}
		}

		protected override UIElementCollection CreateUIElementCollection(FrameworkElement logicalParent)
		{
			return new UIElementCollection(this, logicalParent);
		}
	}

			}
		}

		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			IDisposable refToDispose = LayoutItemsHelper.GetChild<DependencyObject>(this) as IDisposable;
			Ref.Dispose(ref refToDispose);
			ClearValue(LayoutItemProperty);
			ClearValue(EmptyTemplateProperty);
			ClearValue(ControlItemTemplateProperty);
			ClearValue(PanelTemplateProperty);
			ClearValue(DocumentTemplateProperty);
			ClearValue(MDIDocumentTemplateProperty);
			ClearValue(FloatDocumentTemplateProperty);
			ClearValue(GroupTemplateProperty);
			ClearValue(TabPanelTemplateProperty);
			ClearValue(DocumentPanelTemplateProperty);
			ClearValue(FloatingWindowTemplateProperty);
			ClearValue(FloatingAdornerTemplateProperty);
			ClearValue(SplitterControlTemplateProperty);
			ClearValue(EmptySpaceControlTemplateProperty);
			ClearValue(LabelControlTemplateProperty);
			ClearValue(SeparatorControlTemplateProperty);
			ClearValue(AutoHideGroupTemplateProperty);
			ClearValue(Control.TemplateProperty);
			DockLayoutManager.Release(this);
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		public void ClearTemplateIfNeeded(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			ControlTemplate controlTemplate = SelectTemplateCore(item);
			if (controlTemplate != base.Template)
			{
				LayoutItem = null;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnLayoutItemChanged(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			DependencyObject child = LayoutItemsHelper.GetChild<DependencyObject>(this);
			if (item != null)
			{
				SetValue(DockLayoutManager.LayoutItemProperty, item);
				SelectTemplate(item);
				return;
			}
			if (child is IDisposable)
			{
				((IDisposable)child).Dispose();
			}
			ClearValue(Control.TemplateProperty);
			DockLayoutManager.Release(this);
			if (child != null)
			{
				DockLayoutManager.Release(child);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized()
		{
			base.OnInitialized();
			SelectTemplate(LayoutItem);
		}

		protected override void OnPrepareContainerForItemComplete()
		{
			base.OnPrepareContainerForItemComplete();
			SelectTemplate(LayoutItem);
		}

		protected virtual void SelectTemplate(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (!base.IsDisposing && base.IsInitialized)
			{
				base.Template = SelectTemplateCore(item);
			}
		}

		private ControlTemplate SelectTemplateCore(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return EmptyTemplate;
			}
			ControlTemplate result = null;
			switch (item.ItemType)
			{
			case LayoutItemType.ControlItem:
				result = ControlItemTemplate;
				break;
			case LayoutItemType.Panel:
				result = PanelTemplate;
				break;
			case LayoutItemType.Group:
				result = GroupTemplate;
				break;
			case LayoutItemType.FloatGroup:
				result = GetFloatGroupTemplate();
				break;
			case LayoutItemType.TabPanelGroup:
				result = TabPanelTemplate;
				break;
			case LayoutItemType.Document:
				result = GetDocumentTemplate();
				break;
			case LayoutItemType.DocumentPanelGroup:
				result = DocumentPanelTemplate;
				break;
			case LayoutItemType.LayoutSplitter:
				result = SplitterControlTemplate;
				break;
			case LayoutItemType.EmptySpaceItem:
				result = EmptySpaceControlTemplate;
				break;
			case LayoutItemType.Label:
				result = LabelControlTemplate;
				break;
			case LayoutItemType.Separator:
				result = SeparatorControlTemplate;
				break;
			case LayoutItemType.AutoHideGroup:
				result = AutoHideGroupTemplate;
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private ControlTemplate GetFloatGroupTemplate()
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			ControlTemplate result = null;
			DockLayoutManager dockLayoutManager = DockLayoutManager.Ensure(this);
			if (dockLayoutManager != null)
			{
				result = (((int)dockLayoutManager.GetRealFloatingMode() == 1) ? FloatingWindowTemplate : FloatingAdornerTemplate);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private ControlTemplate GetDocumentTemplate()
		{
			DocumentPanel documentPanel = (DocumentPanel)LayoutItem;
			if (documentPanel.IsFloatingRootItem)
			{
				return FloatDocumentTemplate;
			}
			if (!documentPanel.IsMDIChild)
			{
				return DocumentTemplate;
			}
			return MDIDocumentTemplate;
		}
	}
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_ControlBox", Type = typeof(BaseControlBoxControl))]
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_CaptionControl", Type = typeof(CaptionControl))]
	[DXToolboxBrowsable(false)]
	public class TabbedPaneItem : psvSelectorItem, IUIElement, ITabHeader
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty CaptionOrientationProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty CaptionLocationProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PinnedProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PinLocationProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DragOffsetProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ActualBorderThicknessProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey ActualBorderThicknessPropertyKey;

		private Thickness controlBoxThemeMargin;

		IUIElement IUIElement.Scope => DockLayoutManager.GetUIScope(this);

		UIChildren IUIElement.Children => null;

		public Thickness ActualBorderThickness => (Thickness)GetValue(ActualBorderThicknessProperty);

		public Orientation CaptionOrientation
		{
			get
			{
				return (Orientation)GetValue(CaptionOrientationProperty);
			}
			set

		public CaptionLocation CaptionLocation

			get

		public Thickness DragOffset

		public bool Pinned

			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(PinnedProperty);
			}
			set

		}

		public TabHeaderPinLocation PinLocation

		public BaseControlBoxControl PartControlBox { get; private set; }

		public TemplatedCaptionControl PartCaptionControlPresenter { get; private set; }

		protected virtual CaptionLocation DefaultCaptionLocation => CaptionLocation.Bottom;

		protected virtual bool TransformBorderThickness => true;

		private bool IsLastRow { get; set; }

		public Rect ArrangeRect { get; private set; }

		public int ScrollIndex { get; private set; }

		public CaptionControl PartCaption
		{
			get
			{
				if (PartCaptionControlPresenter == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return PartCaptionControlPresenter.PartCaption;
			}
		}

		static TabbedPaneItem()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<TabbedPaneItem> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<TabbedPaneItem>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<TabbedPaneItem>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("CaptionOrientation", ref CaptionOrientationProperty, Orientation.Horizontal);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("CaptionLocation", ref CaptionLocationProperty, CaptionLocation.Default, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs ea)
			{
				((TabbedPaneItem)dObj).OnCaptionLocationChanged((CaptionLocation)ea.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("Pinned", ref PinnedProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("PinLocation", ref PinLocationProperty, TabHeaderPinLocation.Default);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<Thickness>("DragOffset", ref DragOffsetProperty);
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<TabbedPaneItem>.New().OverrideMetadata<Thickness>(Control.BorderThicknessProperty, (Action<TabbedPaneItem, Thickness, Thickness>)delegate(TabbedPaneItem d, Thickness oldValue, Thickness newValue)
			{
				d.OnBorderThicknessChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			}).RegisterReadOnly<Thickness>("ActualBorderThickness", ref ActualBorderThicknessPropertyKey, ref ActualBorderThicknessProperty, new Thickness(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.0), (Func<TabbedPaneItem, Thickness, Thickness>)((TabbedPaneItem d, Thickness value) => d.OnCoerceActualBorderThickness(value)), (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null);
		}

		public TabbedPaneItem()
		{
			ScrollIndex = -1;
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (PartCaptionControlPresenter != null)
			{
				PartCaptionControlPresenter.Dispose();
				PartCaptionControlPresenter = null;
			}
			if (PartControlBox != null)
			{
				PartControlBox.Dispose();
				PartControlBox = null;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			PartControlBox = GetTemplateChild("PART_ControlBox") as BaseControlBoxControl;
			PartCaptionControlPresenter = GetTemplateChild("PART_CaptionControlPresenter") as TemplatedCaptionControl;
			controlBoxThemeMargin = PartControlBox?.Margin ?? new Thickness(0.0);
			UpdateControlBoxMargins(base.LayoutItem);
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected override void OnLayoutItemChanged(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem oldItem)
		{
			base.OnLayoutItemChanged(item, oldItem);
			if (item != null)
			{
				UpdateControlBoxMargins(item);
			}
		}

		public void Apply(ITabHeaderInfo info)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem layoutItem = DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(this);
			layoutItem.CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsCaptionVisibleProperty);
			layoutItem.CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsCaptionImageVisibleProperty);
			RemeasureIfNeeded(info);
			Panel.SetZIndex(this, info.ZIndex);
			ArrangeRect = info.Rect;
			ScrollIndex = info.ScrollIndex;
			IsLastRow = info.MultiLineResult == null || info.MultiLineResult.RowIndex == 0;
		}

		public ITabHeaderInfo CreateInfo(Size size)
		{
			Measure(size);
			BaseLayoutItem layoutItem = DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(this);
			if (layoutItem == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			layoutItem.CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsCaptionVisibleProperty);
			layoutItem.CoerceValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsCaptionImageVisibleProperty);
			UpdateControlBoxMargins(layoutItem);
			Measure(size);
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = PartCaption;
			if (frameworkElement == null)
			{
				frameworkElement = PartCaptionControlPresenter;
			}
			return new BaseHeaderInfo(this, frameworkElement, CaptionOrientation == Orientation.Horizontal, PartControlBox, base.IsSelected, PinLocation, Pinned);
		}

		protected virtual bool IsControlBoxActuallyVisible(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (!item.IsCloseButtonVisible)
			{
				return item.ControlBoxContent != null;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void UpdateControlBoxMargins(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item != null && PartControlBox != null)
			{
				if (IsControlBoxActuallyVisible(item))
				{
					PartControlBox.Margin = controlBoxThemeMargin;
				}
				else
				{
					PartControlBox.Margin = new Thickness(0.0);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnIsSelectedChanged(bool selected)
		{
			base.OnIsSelectedChanged(selected);
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected virtual void OnCaptionLocationChanged(CaptionLocation captionLocation)
		{
			UpdateVisualState();
			CoerceValue(ActualBorderThicknessProperty);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		private void RemeasureIfNeeded(ITabHeaderInfo info)
		{
			Size size = info.Rect.Size;
			Size desiredSize = info.DesiredSize;
			double num = ((CaptionOrientation == Orientation.Horizontal) ? size.Width : size.Height);
			double num2 = ((CaptionOrientation == Orientation.Horizontal) ? desiredSize.Width : desiredSize.Height);
			if (num < num2 || num == 0.0)
			{
				Measure(size);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateCommonState()
		{
			if (base.IsMouseOver)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "MouseOver", useTransitions: false);
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Normal", useTransitions: false);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateSelectionState()
		{
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "EmptySelectionState", useTransitions: false);
			if (base.IsSelected)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Selected", useTransitions: false);
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Unselected", useTransitions: false);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateLocationState()
		{
			switch (CaptionLocation)
			{
			case CaptionLocation.Left:
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Left", useTransitions: false);
				break;
			case CaptionLocation.Right:
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Right", useTransitions: false);
				break;
			case CaptionLocation.Bottom:
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Bottom", useTransitions: false);
				break;
			default:
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Top", useTransitions: false);
				break;
			}
		}

		protected virtual string GetSvgPaletteState()
		{
			if (base.IsSelected)
			{
				if (!base.LayoutItem.IsActive)
				{
					return "Inactive";
				}
				return "Selected";
			}
			if (!base.IsMouseOver)
			{
				return "Normal";
			}
			return "Hover";
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateSvgPaletteState()
		{
			SvgImageHelper.SetState((DependencyObject)this, GetSvgPaletteState());
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateVisualState()
		{
			UpdateSelectionState();
			if (!base.IsSelected)
			{
				UpdateCommonState();
			}
			UpdateLocationState();
			UpdateSvgPaletteState();
		}

		protected override void Subscribe(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			base.Subscribe(item);
			if (item != null)
			{
				item.VisualChanged += OnItemVisualChanged;
				if (item is LayoutPanel)
				{
					BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, PinLocationProperty, item, "TabPinLocation");
					BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, PinnedProperty, item, "Pinned");
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void Unsubscribe(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			base.Unsubscribe(item);
			if (item != null)
			{
				item.VisualChanged -= OnItemVisualChanged;
				if (item is LayoutPanel)
				{
					BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, PinLocationProperty);
					BindingHelper.ClearBinding(this, PinnedProperty);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemVisualChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected virtual void OnBorderThicknessChanged(Thickness oldValue, Thickness newValue)
		{
			CoerceValue(ActualBorderThicknessProperty);
		}

		protected override void AfterArrange()
		{
			base.LayoutUpdated -= OnLayoutUpdated;
			base.LayoutUpdated += OnLayoutUpdated;
		}

		private void OnLayoutUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			base.LayoutUpdated -= OnLayoutUpdated;
			CoerceValue(ActualBorderThicknessProperty);
		}

		protected override void OnViewStyleChanged(DockingViewStyle oldValue, DockingViewStyle newValue)
		{
			CoerceValue(ActualBorderThicknessProperty);
		}

		protected virtual Thickness OnCoerceActualBorderThickness(Thickness value)
		{
			CaptionLocation captionLocation = ((CaptionLocation == CaptionLocation.Default) ? DefaultCaptionLocation : CaptionLocation);
			GetItemAlignment<LayoutTabControl>(captionLocation.ToDock().ToOrthogonalOrientation() == Orientation.Horizontal, out var isLeftAligned, out var isRightAligned);
			Thickness borderThickness = base.BorderThickness;
			if (base.ViewStyle == DockingViewStyle.Light)
			{
				if (isLeftAligned)
				{
					if (captionLocation == CaptionLocation.Bottom || captionLocation == CaptionLocation.Right)
					{
						borderThickness.Right = 0.0;
					}
					else
					{
						borderThickness.Left = 0.0;
					}
				}
				if (isRightAligned)
				{
					if (captionLocation == CaptionLocation.Bottom || captionLocation == CaptionLocation.Right)
					{
						borderThickness.Left = 0.0;
					}
					else
					{
						borderThickness.Right = 0.0;
					}
				}
				if (IsLastRow)
				{
					borderThickness.Top = 0.0;
				}
			}
			if (!TransformBorderThickness)
			{
				return borderThickness;
			}
			return captionLocation.RotateThickness(borderThickness);
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return (AutomationPeer)(object)new TabbedPaneItemAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected internal bool AutomationClick()
		{
			if (base.LayoutItem != null && base.Container != null)
			{
				base.Container.DockController.Activate(base.LayoutItem);
				return base.LayoutItem.Parent.SelectedItem == base.LayoutItem;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	[DXToolboxBrowsable(false)]
	public class DocumentPaneItem : TabbedPaneItem
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty TabColorProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty HasTabColorProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey HasTabColorPropertyKey;

		public Color TabColor
		{
			get
			{
				return (Color)GetValue(TabColorProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(TabColorProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool HasTabColor => (bool)GetValue(HasTabColorProperty);

		protected override CaptionLocation DefaultCaptionLocation => CaptionLocation.Top;

		protected override bool TransformBorderThickness => false;

		static DocumentPaneItem()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DocumentPaneItem> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DocumentPaneItem>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<DocumentPaneItem>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("TabColor", ref TabColorProperty, Colors.Transparent, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DocumentPaneItem)dObj).OnTabColorChanged((Color)e.OldValue, (Color)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("HasTabColor", ref HasTabColorPropertyKey, ref HasTabColorProperty, defValue: false);
		}

		protected override void UpdateVisualState()
		{
			base.UpdateVisualState();
			UpdateColorState();
		}

		protected override void UpdateSelectionState()
		{
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "EmptySelectionState", useTransitions: false);
			if (base.IsSelected)
			{
				if (base.LayoutItem.IsActive)
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Selected", useTransitions: false);
				}
				else
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Inactive", useTransitions: false);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Unselected", useTransitions: false);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateColorState()
		{
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "EmptyColorState", useTransitions: false);
			if (!HasTabColor)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (base.IsSelected)
			{
				if (base.LayoutItem.IsActive)
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "ColorSelected", useTransitions: false);
				}
				else
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "ColorInactive", useTransitions: false);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, base.IsMouseOver ? "ColorMouseOver" : "ColorUnselected", useTransitions: false);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnLayoutItemChanged(BaseLayoutItem item, BaseLayoutItem oldItem)
		{
			base.OnLayoutItemChanged(item, oldItem);
			if (item != null)
			{
				item.Forward(this, TabColorProperty, "ActualTabBackgroundColor");
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(TabColorProperty);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnTabColorChanged(Color oldValue, Color newValue)
		{
			SetValue(HasTabColorPropertyKey, newValue != Colors.Transparent);
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(UpdateVisualState));
		}

		protected override bool IsControlBoxActuallyVisible(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (!base.IsControlBoxActuallyVisible(item))
			{
				return (bool)item.GetValue(BaseLayoutItem.IsPinButtonVisibleProperty);
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_Content", Type = typeof(TabbedPaneContentPresenter))]
	public class TabbedPane : psvContentControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty TabbedTemplateProperty;

		public DataTemplate TabbedTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return (DataTemplate)GetValue(TabbedTemplateProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(TabbedTemplateProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public TabbedPaneContentPresenter PartContent { get; private set; }

		static TabbedPane()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<TabbedPane> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<TabbedPane>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<TabbedPane>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplate>("TabbedTemplate", ref TabbedTemplateProperty);
		}

		public IUIElement GetRootUIScope()
		{
			if (base.LayoutItem == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return base.LayoutItem.GetRootUIScope();
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			ClearValue(TabbedTemplateProperty);
			if (PartContent != null)
			{
				PartContent.Dispose();
				PartContent = null;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			if (PartContent != null && !LayoutItemsHelper.IsTemplateChild(PartContent, this))
			{
				PartContent.Dispose();
			}
			PartContent = GetTemplateChild("PART_Content") as TabbedPaneContentPresenter;
			if (PartContent != null)
			{
				PartContent.EnsureOwner(this);
			}
		}
	}

	public class PanelTabContainer : LayoutTabControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty TabHeaderBorderThicknessProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ActualTabHeaderBorderThicknessProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey ActualTabHeaderBorderThicknessPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsFloatingRootItemProperty;

		public Thickness ActualTabHeaderBorderThickness
		{
			get
			{
				return (Thickness)GetValue(ActualTabHeaderBorderThicknessProperty);
			}
			private set
			{
				SetValue(ActualTabHeaderBorderThicknessPropertyKey, value);
			}
		}

		public Thickness TabHeaderBorderThickness
		{
			get
			{

			}, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null).RegisterReadOnly<Thickness>("ActualTabHeaderBorderThickness", ref ActualTabHeaderBorderThicknessPropertyKey, ref ActualTabHeaderBorderThicknessProperty, default(Thickness), (Func<PanelTabContainer, Thickness, Thickness>)((PanelTabContainer d, Thickness value) => d.OnCoerceActualTabHeaderBorderThickness(value)), (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null)
				.Register<bool>("IsFloatingRootItem", ref IsFloatingRootItemProperty, false, (Action<PanelTabContainer>)delegate(PanelTabContainer d)

					d.CoerceValue(ActualTabHeaderBorderThicknessProperty);

			{
				tabbedPane = tabbedPaneContentPresenter.Owner;
			}
			if (tabbedPane == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return container.GetView(tabbedPane.GetRootUIScope());
		}

		protected virtual Thickness OnCoerceActualTabHeaderBorderThickness(Thickness value)
		{
			Thickness result = base.CaptionLocation.ToThickness(TabHeaderBorderThickness);
			if (base.ViewStyle != DockingViewStyle.Light || LayoutItemsHelper.IsFloatingRootItem(base.LayoutItem))
			{
				return TabHeaderBorderThickness;
			}
			return result;
		}

		}

			group.Forward(this, IsFloatingRootItemProperty, BaseLayoutItem.IsFloatingRootItemProperty);
		}

	public class MinimizedFloatGroupsItemPanel : Panel
	{
		internal const double DBL_EPSILON = 2.220446049250313E-16;

		private bool AreClose(double value1, double value2)
		{
			if (value1 == value2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			double num = (Math.Abs(value1) + Math.Abs(value2) + 10.0) * 2.220446049250313E-16;
			double num2 = value1 - value2;
			if (0.0 - num < num2)
			{
				return num > num2;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool GreaterThan(double value1, double value2)
		{
			if (value1 > value2)
			{
				return !AreClose(value1, value2);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size constraint)
		{
			Size size = default(Size);
			Size size2 = default(Size);
			Size size3 = new Size(constraint.Width, constraint.Height);
			Size availableSize = new Size(constraint.Width, constraint.Height);
			UIElementCollection internalChildren = base.InternalChildren;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = internalChildren.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = internalChildren[i];
				if (uIElement == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				uIElement.Measure(availableSize);
				Size size4 = new Size(uIElement.DesiredSize.Width, uIElement.DesiredSize.Height);
				if (GreaterThan(size.Width + size4.Width, size3.Width))
				{
					size2.Width = Math.Max(size.Width, size2.Width);
					size2.Height += size.Height;
					size = size4;
					if (GreaterThan(size4.Width, size3.Width))
					{
						size2.Width = Math.Max(size4.Width, size2.Width);
						size2.Height += size4.Height;
						size = default(Size);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					size.Width += size4.Width;
					size.Height = Math.Max(size4.Height, size.Height);
				}
			}
			size2.Width = Math.Max(size.Width, size2.Width);
			size2.Height += size.Height;
			return new Size(size2.Width, size2.Height);
		}

		protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size finalSize)
		{
			int num = 0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			Size size = default(Size);
			Size size2 = new Size(finalSize.Width, finalSize.Height);
			UIElementCollection internalChildren = base.InternalChildren;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = internalChildren.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = internalChildren[i];
				if (uIElement == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				Size size3 = new Size(uIElement.DesiredSize.Width, uIElement.DesiredSize.Height);
				if (GreaterThan(size.Width + size3.Width, size2.Width))
				{
					num2 += size.Height;
					arrangeLine(finalSize.Height - num2, size.Height, num, i);
					size = size3;
					if (GreaterThan(size3.Width, size2.Width))
					{
						num2 += size3.Height;
						arrangeLine(finalSize.Height - num2, size3.Height, i, ++i);
						size = default(Size);
					}
					num = i;
				}
				else
				{
					size.Width += size3.Width;
					size.Height = Math.Max(size3.Height, size.Height);
				}
			}
			if (num < internalChildren.Count)
			{
				arrangeLine(0.0, size.Height, num, internalChildren.Count);
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		private void arrangeLine(double v, double lineV, int start, int end)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			UIElementCollection internalChildren = base.InternalChildren;
			for (int i = start; i < end; i++)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = internalChildren[i];
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					Size size = new Size(uIElement.DesiredSize.Width, uIElement.DesiredSize.Height);
					double width = size.Width;
					uIElement.Arrange(new Rect(num, v, width, lineV));
					num += width;
				}
			}
		}
	}

		static ControlBoxButton()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<ControlBoxButton> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<ControlBoxButton>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<ControlBoxButton>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<object>("Content", ref ContentProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((ControlBoxButton)dObj).OnContentChanged(e.NewValue, e.OldValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplate>("ContentTemplate", ref ContentTemplateProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<DataTemplateSelector>("ContentTemplateSelector", ref ContentTemplateSelectorProperty);
			DependencyPropertyHelper2.AddPropertyChangedCallback(BaseControlBoxControl.ControlBoxProperty, typeof(ControlBoxButton), (PropertyChangedCallback)delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((ControlBoxButton)dObj).ControlBox = (BaseControlBoxControl)e.NewValue;
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<ICommand>("Command", ref CommandProperty, null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((ControlBoxButton)d).OnCommandChanged((ICommand)e.OldValue, (ICommand)e.NewValue);
			});
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<object>("CommandParameter", ref CommandParameterProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<IInputElement>("CommandTarget", ref CommandTargetProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("HasCommand", ref HasCommandPropertyKey, ref HasCommandProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("IsPressed", ref IsPressedPropertyKey, ref IsPressedProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.RegisterReadonly("IsActive", ref IsActivePropertyKey, ref IsActiveProperty, defValue: false);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<Style>("BorderStyle", ref BorderStyleProperty);
			ClickEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("Click", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(RoutedEventHandler), typeof(ControlBoxButton));

		public ControlBoxButton()
		{
			VisualStateController = new VisualStateController(this);
			base.MouseLeftButtonDown += OnMouseLeftButtonDown;
			base.MouseLeftButtonUp += OnMouseLeftButtonUp;
			base.IsVisibleChanged += ControlBoxButton_IsVisibleChanged;
			viewRegisteredHandler = OnRootGroupViewRegistered;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			if (PartButtonBorder != null)
			{
				VisualStateController.Remove(PartButtonBorder);
			}
			if (PartGlyphControl != null)
			{
				VisualStateController.Remove(PartGlyphControl);
			}
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			PartButtonBorder = LayoutItemsHelper.GetTemplateChild<ControlBoxButtonBorder>(this);
			if (PartButtonBorder != null)
			{
				VisualStateController.Add(PartButtonBorder);
				PartButtonBorder.SizeChanged += EnsurePartGlyphControl;
			}
			UpdateStyle();
		}

		internal void PerformClick()
		{
			OnClick();
		}

		protected override void OnRenderSizeChanged(SizeChangedInfo sizeInfo)
		{
			base.OnRenderSizeChanged(sizeInfo);
			Item?.InvalidateTabHeader();
		}

		protected virtual void OnClick()
		{
			RaiseEvent(new RoutedEventArgs(ClickEvent, this));
			CommandHelper.ExecuteCommand(this);
		}

		protected virtual void OnContentChanged(object content, object oldContent)
		{
			RemoveLogicalChild(oldContent);
			if (content != null)
			{
				AddLogicalChild(content);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			Item = null;
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemChanged(BaseLayoutItem oldValue, BaseLayoutItem newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				BaseLayoutItemWeakEventManager.RemoveListener(oldValue, this);
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				BaseLayoutItemWeakEventManager.AddListener(newValue, this);
				SetValue(IsActivePropertyKey, newValue.IsActive);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnLoaded()
		{
			base.OnLoaded();
			if (base.Container.GetView(Item.GetRoot()) != null)
			{
				UpdateCanExecute();
				return;
			}
			LayoutGroup root = Item.GetRoot();
			if (root != null)
			{
				root.ViewRegistered += viewRegisteredHandler;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnLostMouseCapture(System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			SetValue(IsPressedPropertyKey, false);
			base.OnLostMouseCapture(e);
		}

		protected override void OnVisualParentChanged(DependencyObject oldParent)
		{
			base.OnVisualParentChanged(oldParent);
			UpdateStyle();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateVisualState()
		{
			if (Item != null)
			{
				bool flag = ControlBox is TabHeaderControlBoxControl;
				string stateName = (Item.IsActive ? "Active" : ((Item.IsSelectedItem && flag) ? "Selected" : "Inactive"));
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "EmptyActiveState", useTransitions: false);
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, stateName, useTransitions: false);
				if (PartGlyphControl != null)
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(PartGlyphControl, "EmptyActiveState", useTransitions: false);
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(PartGlyphControl, stateName, useTransitions: false);
				}
				if (PartButtonBorder != null)
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(PartButtonBorder, "EmptyActiveState", useTransitions: false);
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(PartButtonBorder, stateName, useTransitions: false);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ControlBoxButton_IsVisibleChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			Item.Do(delegate(BaseLayoutItem x)
			{
				x.InvalidateTabHeader();
			});
		}

		private void EnsurePartGlyphControl(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			PartGlyphControl = LayoutItemsHelper.GetTemplateChild<ControlBoxGlyphPresenter>(this);
			if (PartGlyphControl != null)
			{
				VisualStateController.Add(PartGlyphControl);
				UpdateVisualState();
			}
		}

		private void HookCommand(ICommand command)
		{
			command.CanExecuteChanged += OnCanExecuteChanged;
			UpdateCanExecute();
		}

		private void OnCanExecuteChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateCanExecute();
		}

		private void OnCommandChanged(ICommand oldValue, ICommand newValue)
		{
			SetValue(HasCommandPropertyKey, newValue != null);
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				UnhookCommand(oldValue);
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				HookCommand(newValue);
			}
		}

		private void OnControlBoxChanged(BaseControlBoxControl oldValue, BaseControlBoxControl newValue)
		{
			Item = ((ControlBox != null) ? ControlBox.LayoutItem : null);
			UpdateStyle();
		}

		private void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			SetValue(IsPressedPropertyKey, true);
			CaptureMouse();
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		private void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
			SetValue(IsPressedPropertyKey, false);
			ReleaseMouseCapture();
			if ((e == null || !e.Handled) && base.IsMouseOver)
			{
				OnClick();
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private void OnRootGroupViewRegistered(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is LayoutGroup layoutGroup)
			{
				layoutGroup.ViewRegistered -= viewRegisteredHandler;
			}
			UpdateCanExecute();
		}

		private void UnhookCommand(ICommand command)
		{
			command.CanExecuteChanged -= OnCanExecuteChanged;
			UpdateCanExecute();
		}

		private void UpdateCanExecute()
		{
			CanExecute = Command == null || CommandHelper.CanExecuteCommand(this);
		}

		private void UpdateStyle()
		{
			if (PartButtonBorder != null && ControlBox != null)
			{
				if (ControlBox.ButtonStyle != null)
				{
					base.Style = ControlBox.ButtonStyle;
				}
				else
				{
					ClearValue(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (managerType == typeof(BaseLayoutItemWeakEventManager))
			{
				VisualStateController.UpdateState();
				SetValue(IsActivePropertyKey, Item.IsActive);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		void ISupportVisualStates.UpdateVisualState()
		{
			UpdateVisualState();
		}
	}

			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<ICommand>("Command", ref CommandProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<object>("CommandParameter", ref CommandParameterProperty);
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register<IInputElement>("CommandTarget", ref CommandTargetProperty);

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			if (PartButton != null && !LayoutItemsHelper.IsTemplateChild(PartButton, this))
			{
				PartButton.Dispose();
			}
			PartButton = GetTemplateChild("PART_Button") as ControlBoxButton;
			if (PartButton != null)
			{
				this.Forward(PartButton, UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, "IsEnabled");
				this.Forward(PartButton, ControlBoxButton.CommandTargetProperty, "CommandTarget");
				this.Forward(PartButton, ControlBoxButton.CommandParameterProperty, "CommandParameter");
				this.Forward(PartButton, ControlBoxButton.CommandProperty, "Command");
			}
		}

		[Obsolete]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DXHelpExclude(true)]
		public void SetIsHot(bool isHot)
		{
		}

		[Obsolete]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DXHelpExclude(true)]
		public void SetIsPresesd(bool isPressed)
		{
		}

		internal void SetToolTip(object tooltip)
		{
			this.AttachToolTip(tooltip);
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (PartButton != null)
			{
				PartButton.ClearValue(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty);
				PartButton.Dispose();
				PartButton = null;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		private void OnIsVisibleChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			BaseControlBoxControl.Invalidate(this);
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return (AutomationPeer)(object)new ControlBoxButtonPresenterAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected internal bool AutomationClick()
		{
			if (PartButton == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			PartButton.PerformClick();
			return true;
		}
	}

	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Pinned", GroupName = "PinnedStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Unpinned", GroupName = "PinnedStates")]
	public class DockPaneControlBoxButton : ControlBoxButton
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsAutoHiddenProperty;

		public bool IsAutoHidden
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsAutoHiddenProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsAutoHiddenProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static DockPaneControlBoxButton()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DockPaneControlBoxButton> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DockPaneControlBoxButton>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("IsAutoHidden", ref IsAutoHiddenProperty, defValue: false, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs ea)
			{
				((DockPaneControlBoxButton)dObj).OnIsAutoHiddenChanged((bool)ea.NewValue);
			});
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsAutoHiddenChanged(bool isAutoHidden)
		{
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected override void UpdateVisualState()
		{
			base.UpdateVisualState();
			if (base.Item != null)
			{
				string stateName = ((base.Item.IsPinnedTab || (!base.Item.IsAutoHidden && !base.Item.IsTabDocument)) ? "Pinned" : "Unpinned");
				string stateName2 = (base.Item.Parent as AutoHideGroup).Return((AutoHideGroup x) => x.DockType, () => Dock.Left).ToString();
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, stateName, useTransitions: false);
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, stateName2, useTransitions: false);
				if (base.PartGlyphControl != null)
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(base.PartGlyphControl, stateName, useTransitions: false);
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(base.PartGlyphControl, stateName2, useTransitions: false);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Expanded", GroupName = "ExpandedStates")]
	[TemplateVisualState(Name = "Collapsed", GroupName = "ExpandedStates")]
	public class GroupBoxControlBoxButton : ControlBoxButton
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsExpandedProperty;

		public bool IsExpanded
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsExpandedProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsExpandedProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private LayoutGroup Group => base.Item as LayoutGroup;

		static GroupBoxControlBoxButton()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<GroupBoxControlBoxButton> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<GroupBoxControlBoxButton>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("IsExpanded", ref IsExpandedProperty, defValue: false, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs ea)
			{
				((GroupBoxControlBoxButton)dObj).OnIsExpandedChanged((bool)ea.NewValue);
			});
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			if (Group != null)
			{
				BindingHelper.SetBinding(this, IsExpandedProperty, Group, "IsExpanded");
			}
			UpdateToolTip();
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsExpandedChanged(bool isExpanded)
		{
			UpdateVisualState();
			UpdateToolTip();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateToolTip()
		{
			object toolTip = BaseControlBoxControl.GetToolTip(IsExpanded ? DockingStringId.MenuItemCollapseGroup : DockingStringId.MenuItemExpandGroup);
			this.AttachToolTip(toolTip);
		}

		protected override void UpdateVisualState()
		{
			base.UpdateVisualState();
			string stateName = (IsExpanded ? "Expanded" : "Collapsed");
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, stateName, useTransitions: false);
			if (base.PartGlyphControl != null)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(base.PartGlyphControl, stateName, useTransitions: false);
			}
		}
	}

	public enum DragCursorType
	{
		Item,
		Panel,
		Window
	}
	[TemplatePart(Name = "PART_CaptionControl", Type = typeof(CaptionControl))]
	public class DragCursorControl : psvControl, IControlHost
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty CursorTypeProperty;

		private BaseLayoutItem dragItem;

		public DragCursorType CursorType
		{
			get
			{
				return (DragCursorType)GetValue(CursorTypeProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(CursorTypeProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal BaseLayoutItem DragItem
		{
			get
			{
				return dragItem;
			}
			set
			{
				if (dragItem != value)
				{
					dragItem = value;
					OnDragItemChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		protected TemplatedCaptionControl CaptionControl { get; private set; }

		static DragCursorControl()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DragCursorControl> dependencyPropertyRegistrator = new DependencyPropertyRegistrator<DragCursorControl>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<DragCursorControl>();
			dependencyPropertyRegistrator.Register("CursorType", ref CursorTypeProperty, DragCursorType.Item, delegate(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs ea)
			{
				((DragCursorControl)dObj).OnCursorTypeChanged((DragCursorType)ea.NewValue);
			});
		}

		public FrameworkElement[] GetChildren()
		{
			return new FrameworkElement[1] { CaptionControl };
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			CaptionControl = GetTemplateChild("PART_CaptionControl") as TemplatedCaptionControl;
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected virtual void OnCursorTypeChanged(DragCursorType type)
		{
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		private void OnDragItemChanged()
		{
			if (DragItem != null)
			{
				BaseLayoutItem selectedItem = DragItem;
				if (DragItem is TabbedGroup { CaptionImage: null, CaptionTemplate: null, Caption: null } tabbedGroup && string.IsNullOrEmpty(tabbedGroup.ActualCaption) && tabbedGroup.SelectedItem != null)
				{
					selectedItem = tabbedGroup.SelectedItem;
				}
				base.DataContext = selectedItem;
				DockLayoutManager.SetLayoutItem(this, selectedItem);
				CursorType = GetDragCursorType();
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty);
				DockLayoutManager.SetLayoutItem(this, null);
			}
		}

		private DragCursorType GetDragCursorType()
		{
			if (DragItem.IsItemWithRestrictedFloating() && DragItem.AllowFloat)
			{
				return DragCursorType.Window;
			}
			LayoutItemType[] source = new LayoutItemType[4]
			{
				LayoutItemType.Panel,
				LayoutItemType.Document,
				LayoutItemType.TabPanelGroup,
				LayoutItemType.FloatGroup
			};
			if (!source.Contains(DragItem.ItemType))
			{
				return DragCursorType.Item;
			}
			return DragCursorType.Panel;
		}

		private void UpdateVisualState()
		{
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, (CursorType == DragCursorType.Item) ? "CursorTypeItem" : "CursorTypePanel", useTransitions: false);
		}
	}
	public class DragCursorFactory
	{
		public static FloatingContainer CreateDragCursorContainer(DockLayoutManager manager, object content)
		{
			return CreateDragCursorContainer(manager, content, default(Size));
		}

		public static FloatingContainer CreateDragCursorContainer(DockLayoutManager manager, object content, Size size)
		{
			FloatingContainer val = (FloatingContainer)(object)new DragCursorWindowContainer();
			((BaseFloatingContainer)val).BeginUpdate();
			((BaseFloatingContainer)val).Owner = manager;
			((BaseFloatingContainer)val).FloatSize = ((size == default(Size)) ? new Size(150.0, 150.0) : size);
			val.ShowActivated = false;
			val.AllowMoving = false;
			val.AllowSizing = false;
			((BaseFloatingContainer)val).ShowContentOnly = true;
			((BaseFloatingContainer)val).Content = content;
			manager.AddToLogicalTree(val, content);
			((BaseFloatingContainer)val).EndUpdate();
			return val;
		}
	}
	internal class DragCursorWindowContainer : FloatingWindowContainer
	{
		protected override WindowContentHolder CreateWindow()
		{
			return (WindowContentHolder)(object)new DragCursorWindow((BaseFloatingContainer)(object)this);
		}
	}
	internal class DragCursorWindow : WindowContentHolder
	{
		public DragCursorWindow(BaseFloatingContainer container)
			: base(container)
		{
		}

		protected override void TrySetOwnerCore(Window containerWindow)
		{
		}
	}
}

	public class ShowMenuEventArgs<T> : RoutedEventArgs where T : BaseLayoutElementMenu
	{
		public T Menu { get; private set; }

		public bool Show { get; set; }

		public ReadOnlyCollection<BarItem> Items { get; private set; }

		public BarManagerActionCollection ActionList => ((CustomizablePopupMenuBase)Menu).Customizations;

		public IInputElement TargetElement => GetTargetElement();

		public ShowMenuEventArgs(T menu)
		{
			Show = true;
			Menu = menu;
			Items = menu.GetItems();
		}

		private IInputElement GetTargetElement()
		{
			UIElement placementTarget = ((Popup)(object)Menu).PlacementTarget;
			if (placementTarget != null)
			{
				return DockLayoutManager.GetLayoutItem(placementTarget) ?? placementTarget;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

			base.RoutedEvent = DockLayoutManager.LayoutItemEndRenamingEvent;

		}
	}

	public class DockLayoutManagerEnumerator : IEnumerator
	{
		private readonly IEnumerator PanelsEnumerator;

		object IEnumerator.Current => ((ILayoutContent)PanelsEnumerator.Current).Control;

		public DockLayoutManagerEnumerator(DockLayoutManager manager)
		{
			BaseLayoutItem[] items = manager.GetItems();
			items = Array.FindAll(items, IsElementWithControl);
			PanelsEnumerator = items.GetEnumerator();
		}

		private bool IsElementWithControl(BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item is ILayoutContent layoutContent)
			{
				return layoutContent.Control != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		bool IEnumerator.MoveNext()
		{
			return PanelsEnumerator.MoveNext();
		}

		void IEnumerator.Reset()
		{
			PanelsEnumerator.Reset();
		}
	}
	public class MergedEnumerator : IEnumerator
	{
		private readonly IEnumerator[] Enumerators;

		private IEnumerator currentEnumerator;

		private int index = -1;

		object IEnumerator.Current
		{
			get
			{
				if (currentEnumerator != null)
				{
					return currentEnumerator.Current;
				}
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		public MergedEnumerator(IEnumerator[] enumerators)
		{
			Enumerators = enumerators;
		}

		bool IEnumerator.MoveNext()
		{
			while (EnsureCurrentEnumerator())
			{
				if (currentEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					return true;
				}
				currentEnumerator = null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool EnsureCurrentEnumerator()
		{
			if (currentEnumerator == null && ++index < Enumerators.Length)
			{
				currentEnumerator = Enumerators[index];
			}
			return currentEnumerator != null;
		}

		void IEnumerator.Reset()
		{
			currentEnumerator = null;
			index = -1;
		}
	}
